Factions and Finance in China

The contemporary Chinese financial system encapsulates two possible futures for China’s economy. On the one hand, extremely rapid financial deepening accompanied by relatively stable prices drives a vigorous growth trajectory that will one day make China the world’s largest economy. On the other hand, the colossal store of nonperforming loans in the banking sector augurs a troubling future. Factions and Finance in China inquires how elite factional politics has given rise to both of these outcomes since the reform in 1978. The competition over monetary policies between generalists in the Chinese Communist Party and politically engaged technocrats has time and again prevented inflation from spinning out of control. Nonetheless, elite politicians, whether party generalists or technocrats, continue to see the banking sector as a ready means of political capital, thus continuing government intervention in the banking sector and slowing down reform. Through quantitative analysis and in-depth case studies, Shih shows that elite politics has exerted a profound impact on monetary policies and banking institutions in contemporary China.
当代中国的金融体系包含了中国经济的两种可能未来。一方面，伴随价格相对稳定的极度快速的金融深化，会推动强劲的增长轨迹，终有一天使中国成为世界上最大的经济体。另一方面，银行业中巨额的不良贷款储备预示着令人担忧的未来。《Factions and Finance in China》探讨自 1978 年改革以来，精英派系政治如何同时导致这两种结果。中国共产党中的泛政治家与积极参与政治的技术官僚之间关于货币政策的竞争，多次阻止了通货膨胀失控。尽管如此，无论是党内的泛政治家还是技术官僚，精英政治人物仍然将银行业视为获取政治资本的现成手段，从而持续对银行业进行干预并放慢改革步伐。通过定量分析和深入案例研究，Shih 展示了精英政治对当代中国货币政策和银行机构产生的深远影响。
Victor C. Shih is a political economist at Northwestern University specializing in China. An immigrant to the United States from Hong Kong, Dr. Shih received his doctorate in government from Harvard University, where he researched banking sector reform in China with the support of the Jacob K. Javits Fellowship and the Fulbright Fellowship. He is the author of numerous articles appearing in academic and business journals, including The China Quarterly and The Far Eastern Economic Review, and frequent adviser to the private sector on the banking industry in China. His current research concerns the political economy of fiscal transfers in China and Chinese policies toward ethnic minorities. Dr. Shih holds a B.A. from George Washington University, where he studied on a University Presidential Fellowship and graduated summa cum laude in East Asian studies with a minor in economics.
Victor C. Shih 是西北大学专门研究中国问题的政治经济学家。作为从香港移居美国的移民，Shih 博士在哈佛大学获得政府学博士学位，在那里他在 Jacob K. Javits Fellowship 和 Fulbright Fellowship 的资助下研究了中国的银行业改革。他在学术和商业期刊上发表过大量文章，包括 The China Quarterly 和 The Far Eastern Economic Review，并经常为私营部门就中国银行业提供咨询。他目前的研究涉及中国财政转移的政治经济学以及中国对少数民族的政策。Shih 博士获得乔治华盛顿大学文学学士学位，在那里他凭借 University Presidential Fellowship 学习，以优等成绩（summa cum laude）完成东亚研究并辅修经济学。

Acknowledgments  致谢

This book is the culmination of nearly a decade of research and reflection, and it would not have succeeded without the inspiration and encouragement of numerous friends, colleagues, and family members. First of all, I would not have entertained social science as a career without a childhood spent reading the many history books my grandmother Lau Kim-ping procured for me. I am grateful that she continues to take great pride in what I have achieved since I immigrated to the United States at the age of twelve. My interest in Chinese politics began at the George Washington University. Bruce Dickson introduced me to the discipline, and I am grateful that he continues to help me navigate the treacherous terrain in my career. I am likewise grateful for the guidance I received from Harry Harding, Ed McCord, and Marty Whyte. It is of great pleasure that I continue to interact with them on a regular basis.
本书是将近十年研究与反思的结晶，若没有众多朋友、同事和家人的启发与鼓励，这本书不可能完成。首先，如果没有祖母刘金平为我寻来并让我童年阅读的那些历史书，我不会把社会科学作为职业。自从十二岁移民美国以来，她一直为我的成就感到自豪，我对此深表感激。我在乔治华盛顿大学开始对中国政治产生兴趣。Bruce Dickson 将我引入这一学科，我很感激他在我职业生涯中继续帮助我在险恶的地形中前行。我同样感谢 Harry Harding、Ed McCord 和 Marty Whyte 给我的指导。很高兴我能继续定期与他们交流。
After my freshman year in college, I spent a listless summer in Hong Kong, where I filled my time reading several of the classics of Chinese politics. Three books I read made particularly deep impressions. The Origins of the Cultural Revolution Part I and II, as well as The Politics of China: The Eras of Mao and Deng first introduced me to the meticulous and well-honed scholarship of Roderick MacFarquhar, as well as the fascinating world of elite Chinese politics. It was an unimaginable delight later when I learned that I would go to Harvard and study with Professor MacFarquhar. Beyond a great scholar, I have since learned that he is also a great mentor and, by popular consensus, one of the most mesmerizing teachers at Harvard. Without his critical inputs, encouragement, and inspiration, this work could not have been completed.
大一学年结束后的那个夏天，我在香港度过了一个无所事事的暑假，用读书来打发时间，读了几本关于中国政治的经典著作。其中三本书给我留下了特别深刻的印象。《The Origins of the Cultural Revolution Part I and II》以及《The Politics of China: The Eras of Mao and Deng》首次把我引入了 Roderick MacFarquhar 那种精细且成熟的学术研究，也把我带入了精英中国政治那引人入胜的世界。后来得知我将去哈佛并师从 Professor MacFarquhar 时，我感到无比欣喜。除了是一位伟大学者之外，我后来还了解到他也是一位杰出的导师，并且被普遍认为是哈佛最具魅力的教师之一。没有他关键的意见、鼓励和启发，这项工作无法完成。
During the same listless summer, I also read Elizabeth Perry’s Rebels and Revolutionaries in North China, which left a deep impression as well. It has been a rare privilege to first participate in her engaging seminar on Chinese politics and political science and later receive her valuable feedback on my dissertation. I continue to look to her for guidance and mentorship, especially on my new project, which comes much closer to her previous work. Robert Bates’s work greatly influenced my thinking as I explored rent-seeking in the Chinese banking
在同一个无精打采的夏天，我还读了 Elizabeth Perry 的《Rebels and Revolutionaries in North China》，这本书也给我留下了深刻印象。我很荣幸先能参加她那场富有吸引力的关于中国政治与政治学的研讨会，后来又得到她对我的学位论文的宝贵反馈。我继续寻求她的指导和指导，尤其是在我的新项目上，这个项目更接近她以往的研究。Robert Bates 的著作在我探索中国银行业寻租问题时对我的思考产生了很大影响。
sector. It was a great honor to have one of the most respected political scientists of our time serve on my dissertation committee. I benefited enormously from his insightful input. As I contemplated ways to test my framework rigorously, I immediately thought of inviting Jas Sekhon to serve on my committee. His methods lectures were paragons of clear pedagogy, and I have benefited greatly from his methodological and career advice, as well as friendship. Last, but certainly not least, Dwight Perkins brought to bear his decades of experience observing the Chinese economy and helped me avoid a great many pitfalls and blind alleys.
部门。这是一种莫大的荣幸，能让我们时代最受尊敬的政治学家之一担任我的学位论文委员会成员。我从他富有洞见的意见中受益匪浅。当我思考如何严格检验我的框架时，我立刻想到邀请 Jas Sekhon 担任我的委员会成员。他的 methods 讲座是清晰教学法的典范，我从他的研究方法和职业建议以及友谊中获益良多。最后但同样重要的是，Dwight Perkins 凭借其数十年观察中国经济的经验，帮助我避免了许多陷阱和死胡同。
Graduate school is often a lonely enterprise, but it was made tolerable by a good group of friends who provided both intellectual and emotional support. The heart of this support network was the “Dimick Street Gang”: Christian Brunelli, Robert Fannion, Magda Hinojosa, Maria Goff, Elisabeth Ivarsflaten, Andy Karch, Piret Loone, and Endre Tvinnerheim. Poker also provided an important reprieve from the daily grind of graduate studies at Dimick Street, and those who dared to venture to Dimick Street regularly included Mette Eilstrup, Andrea Sangiovanni, and Alan Silverleib. Others also joined from time to time, but Christian’s no-fold pledge was too much for some to stomach. Joe and Jen Wong provided crucial friendship and grilled sustenance. Joe, in his usual genius, came up with the best possible title for this book.
研究生阶段常常是一段孤独的历程，但有一群既提供学术支持又给予情感关怀的好友，使其变得可以忍受。这一支持网络的核心是“Dimick Street Gang”：Christian Brunelli、Robert Fannion、Magda Hinojosa、Maria Goff、Elisabeth Ivarsflaten、Andy Karch、Piret Loone 和 Endre Tvinnerheim。扑克牌也为在 Dimick Street 的日常研究生活提供了重要的喘息之机，经常冒险前往 Dimick Street 的还有 Mette Eilstrup、Andrea Sangiovanni 和 Alan Silverleib。其他人也会时不时加入，但 Christian 的“不弃牌”承诺令一些人难以接受。Joe 和 Jen Wong 提供了至关重要的友谊和烧烤食物。Joe 以他一贯的天才想出了这本书的最佳书名。
In Beijing, I was honored to befriend a group of extremely bright young scholars, whose input and help were crucial to the success of this project. Our joint interviews with Chinese officials and forays into the Central Party School remain some of the highlights of my stay in China. I still look for advice and counsel from Bill Hurst, Kun-chin Lin, and Matt Rudolph. Maria and I were further kept sane by a generous group of friends, including Adam Bunds, Jen Lin-Liu, Jens Fischmann, Markus Muessig, Colin Wan, Lorenz Luthi, Shirley Hung, and Nick Bartlett. Five a.m. breakfasts at the Den remain some of my fondest memories. Without a doubt, I owe a great debt to the seventy or so officials and bankers I interviewed for the book. In order to protect their identities, they remain anonymous. For the most part, I admired their determination to perform their duty honorably in the face of great pressure and temptations. Lawrence Alberts provided some crucial introductions that gave early momentum to the interviews. Professor Hexing Shi at Peking University generously offered to host me during my year there.
在北京，我有幸结识了一群极其聪慧的青年学者，他们的意见和帮助对本项目的成功至关重要。我们与中国官员共同进行的访谈以及对中央党校的多次访问，仍然是我在华期间的一些亮点。我仍然向 Bill Hurst、Kun-chin Lin 和 Matt Rudolph 征求建议和法律顾问。Maria 和我在一群慷慨好友的陪伴下保持理智，这些朋友包括 Adam Bunds、Jen Lin-Liu、Jens Fischmann、Markus Muessig、Colin Wan、Lorenz Luthi、Shirley Hung 和 Nick Bartlett。凌晨五点在 The Den 的早餐仍是我最美好的记忆之一。毫无疑问，我欠书中约七十名受访官员和银行家的巨大恩情。为保护他们的身份，他们保持匿名。在大多数情况下，我钦佩他们在巨大压力和诱惑面前仍然坚定地恪尽职守。Lawrence Alberts 提供了一些关键介绍，为早期访谈提供了动力。北京大学的 Hexing Shi 教授慷慨地提出在我在那里的一年里接待我。
Other teachers and classmates also provided important input and encouragement throughout various stages of my graduate studies. I am especially grateful to members of the performance of democracy workshop and the postcommunist workshop, including Sam Huntington, Robert Putnam, Susan Pharr, Eva Bellin, Yoi Herrera, Gerald Easter, Lily Tsai, Kellee Tsai, Ben Read, Maria Popova, Rory MacFarquhar, Dan Gingerich, Naunihal Singh, and Peter Bruland. Yasheng Huang’s work greatly influenced my own thinking on the political economy of China, and it was a privilege to work with him on a project. As I undertook to transform my dissertation into a monograph, many came to my aid with counsel and - in some cases - critical support. None has contributed more to the final publication of this manuscript than Lew Bateman at Cambridge University Press, who saw potential in the manuscript even at a difficult time. His patience and professionalism motivated me to make this manuscript as good as possible. It is no coincidence that he is universally respected in the field. Although a book publication represents the public side of our lives, our private lives are what make public accomplishments possible. I am deeply grateful to my parents, James and Sophia Shih, for courageously starting a new life in America and for devoting themselves to giving us every opportunity to succeed. I hope this book in a small way makes up for the great sacrifices they endured in raising us. My sister Clara, who was only four when we came to the United States, confronted her new environment with innate courage and intelligence. She has blossomed into a Stanford graduate, a Marshall Scholar, a senior executive in a leading company, and - most important - a generous and resourceful person. I am grateful that our bond remains so strong in the face of great changes in our lives. Finally, throughout my studies and the book process, I was greatly inspired by my spouse Maria Goff, who faced her many illnesses with great courage and determination. She has endured some of the most trying experiences anyone can have but still found emotional resources to help me through difficult times. Compared to what she has overcome, this book is a minor accomplishment.
虽然图书出版代表了我们生活的公开一面，但正是我们的私人生活使公开的成就成为可能。我由衷感谢我的父母 James 和 Sophia Shih，感谢他们勇敢地在美国展开新生活，并全心全意为我们提供一切成功的机会。我希望这本书在某种程度上能弥补他们在抚养我们过程中所做出的巨大牺牲。我的妹妹 Clara，来美时只有四岁，她以天生的勇气和聪慧迎接新环境。她已成长为斯坦福毕业生、Marshall Scholar、一家领先公司的高级管理人员，而且——最重要的是——成为一个慷慨且足智多谋的人。我很感激在我们生活发生巨大变化的情况下，我们之间的纽带依然如此牢固。最后，在我的学业和写作过程中，我深受我的配偶 Maria Goff 的鼓舞，她以极大的勇气和决心面对多次病痛。她经受了任何人都可能遇到的最艰难的经历，却仍能找到情感上的力量在我困难时给予帮助。与她所克服的一切相比，这本书只是微不足道的成就。

I

Introduction  引言

One of the most memorable interviews that I conducted in the course of researching for this book took place in a provincial capital along China’s prosperous eastern coast. I interviewed the manager of an asset management company (AMC), which was established to recover the myriad nonperforming loans that had accumulated in China’s state banks. Throughout the interview, he belabored the importance of central directives on reducing nonperforming loans (NPLs) in the banking sector. After Zhu Rongji, with the full backing of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP), had imposed a rigid nonperforming loan reduction quota on all Chinese banks, banks were scrambling to remove NPLs from their balance sheets. The manager himself had to meet a cash recovery quota for the NPLs under his charge or face dismissal. He accomplished this by speedily selling the collateral tied to the NPLs to private and foreign investors. When asked about the fate of NPLs not backed by collateral three or four years down the road, his response was simply, “That’s for my successor to worry about. I plan to get out after a couple of years with my bonus.” Following the interview, he asked if I was hungry. As it was late in the afternoon and my lunch had been a simple bowl of noodles from a street vendor, I thought I could treat him to dinner and we could continue the conversation.
在为本书进行研究期间，我做过的一次最令人印象深刻的访谈发生在中国东部沿海一个省会城市。我采访了一位资产管理公司（AMC）的经理，该公司成立的目的是收回在中国国有银行中积累的大量不良贷款。在整个访谈中，他反复强调中央关于减少银行业不良贷款（NPLs）的指示的重要性。在朱镕基在中国共产党（CCP）全力支持下，对所有中国银行施加了严格的不良贷款减少配额之后，银行们争相将不良贷款从它们的资产负债表上剔除。该经理自己也必须达到对其负责的不良贷款的现金回收配额，否则将面临解职。他通过迅速将与不良贷款相关的抵押物出售给私人和外国投资者来实现这一目标。当被问及三四年后那些没有抵押物的不良贷款的命运时，他的回答很简单：“那留给我的接任者去操心。我打算拿着我的奖金几年后就走人。”访谈结束后，他问我是否饿了。 那天已是午后时分，我的午餐只是街边小贩的一碗简单面条， 我想请他吃晚饭，好继续我们的谈话。
It turned out, however, that he would host the dinner. He first invited six of his friends to join us, then summoned his driver to take us to the most expensive restaurant in town. I was rather nervous by that time because I did not want to spend my entire trip’s budget on a single lavish meal for him and his friends. My worries were quickly allayed when he said off-handedly that dinner was on him. When we arrived at the elegantly decorated club for China’s newly rich, the concierge, who apparently knew my host quite well, directed the eight of us to a private room, where the rich often entertained their guests. My host told us to order whatever we wanted; he was entertaining clients upstairs and would put our expenses on the same tab. He seemed very practiced in this billing method. He then left to discuss the sale of state assets with his clients. Halfway through our sumptuous dinner, he returned to check on our progress.
然而事实是，他请我们吃饭。他先邀请了六位朋友加入，然后叫司机带我们去城里最昂贵的餐馆。到那时我相当紧张，因为我不想把整个出行预算都花在为他和他朋友准备的一顿奢华大餐上。他漫不经心地说晚饭由他请，这很快打消了我的顾虑。我们到达为新富阶层精心装饰的会所时，显然很熟悉我这位东道主的礼宾员把我们八个人引到了一个包间，那是富人们常招待客人的地方。我的东道主让我们随便点菜；他说他在楼上接待客户，会把我们的开销记在同一张账单上。他对这种结账方式似乎很在行。然后他上楼去和客户讨论国有资产的出售。丰盛的晚餐进行到一半时，他回下来查看我们的进度。
After looking at our spread, he berated us for not ordering the most expensive items; this would cause him to lose face at the restaurant. Summoning the concierge, he then ordered us an enormous plate of imported sashimi, whole shark-fins, and other exotic seafood, along with several bottles of fine French wine to wash it all down.
看了我们的点菜后，他斥责我们没有点最贵的菜；这会让他在餐厅丢面子。于是他叫来礼宾人员，点了一大盘进口生鱼片、整只鱼翅和其他奇珍海鲜，还点了几瓶上等法国葡萄酒来配着喝。
When he had completed his negotiations and after several rounds of ganbei (bottoms-up), I asked him whether such extravagance would affect the company’s bottom line at the end of the year. He told me not to worry. All he had to do was fulfill the cash recovery quota for NPLs. The AMC negotiated its annual operating expenses separately with the Ministry of Finance (MOF), which made expenses much more flexible. The MOF, taking its cue from Premier Zhu Rongji’s decrees about NPLs, was similarly concerned only with the recovery quota and gladly provided the asset management companies with the necessary funds to fulfill their quotas. Of course, when the MOF ran short of money, it could always draw on another source of funds, the banking system, thereby creating more NPLs for the future. I dared not think about how many families’ life savings ended up in our stomachs that night.
当他完成谈判并在几轮干杯之后，我问他这种奢侈是否会影响公司年终的利润。他告诉我别担心。他要做的只是完成不良贷款的现金回收配额。资产管理公司与财政部（MOF）单独协商其年度经营费用，这使得开支更加灵活。财政部按照朱镕基总理关于不良贷款的法令行事，同样只关心回收配额，并乐意为资产管理公司提供完成配额所需的资金。当然，当财政部资金短缺时，它总可以动用另一个资金来源——银行系统，从而为未来创造更多不良贷款。我不敢想那晚有多少家庭的积蓄最终落入了我们肚子里。
This particular episode reveals two important features of the CCP-dominated financial system. First, when the CCP is determined to achieve a particular outcome, it has the power to mobilize the vast bureaucracy, whether at the local or central level, to do its bidding. As this book shows, Deng Xiaoping was able to mobilize local officials to invest at an astonishing rate, whereas Chen Yun suppressed inflationary pressure virtually overnight with just a few decrees. This book provides a framework that specifies the conditions under which the highest leadership can garner sufficient political will to achieve various financial outcomes. At the same time, the fundamental fact remains that bank deposits are viewed by officials, including state bankers, as an amply supplied public good that can and should be exploited at will to fulfill a host of policy, political, and private ends. For us that night, bank funds filled our stomachs with exotic seafood and wine. For Zhu Rongji that year, bank deposits financed the enormously expensive and likely wasteful Western development drive. As I spent more time in China, I could not help but grow more sympathetic to the argument made by corrupt officials that their ill-gotten house or car is minuscule compared to the billions and even trillions that are wasted each year on dams, airports, highways, and stadiums. And the banking sector makes it all possible. Why, indeed, would anyone want to change such a wonderful thing?
这一插曲揭示了中共主导的金融体系的两个重要特征。首先，当中共决意实现某一特定目标时，它有能力动员庞大的官僚机构，无论是地方还是中央，去执行其旨意。正如本书所示，邓小平能够动员地方官员以惊人的速度进行投资，而陈云则仅凭几道法令几乎在一夜之间遏制了通胀压力。本书提供了一个框架，明确指出在何种条件下最高领导层能够凝聚足够的政治意志以实现各种金融结果。与此同时，根本事实仍然是，银行存款在官员（包括国有银行家）眼中被视为一种供给充足的公共物品，可以并且应该被任意利用以实现一系列政策、政治和私人目的。对我们那晚而言，银行资金填饱了我们的肚子，提供了奇珍海味和美酒。对朱镕基而言，那一年银行存款资助了耗资巨大且可能浪费的西部大开发。 随着我在中国待的时间越长，我不禁对那些腐败官员的论点愈发产生同情：与每年在大坝、机场、公路和体育场上被浪费的数十亿甚至数万亿相比，他们那来路不正的房子或汽车简直微不足道。而银行业则让这一切成为可能。确实，谁会想要改变如此美妙的事物呢？

Not Quite a Miracle
不完全是奇迹

Since China launched its economic reform nearly three decades ago, the rest of the world has watched in astonishment as it grew rapidly from a povertystricken and isolated state to a country poised to take over from Japan as the premier economic powerhouse in Asia. A number of studies have attempted to
自从中国近三十年前启动经济改革以来，世界其他国家惊讶地看到它从一个贫困且孤立的国家迅速成长为有望取代日本成为亚洲首要经济强国的国家。若干研究试图...
explain China’s seemingly miraculous growth. I I  ^("I "){ }^{\text {I }} The goal of this study is not to provide yet another account of China’s spectacular growth. Rather, it seeks to explain two important financial outcomes intimately tied to China’s longterm growth trajectory: inflation and the efficiency of capital allocation. As Chapter 2 explains, an important precondition of China’s spectacular growth has been its rapid financial deepening accompanied by relative price stability compared with many developing and postcommunist countries. China’s ability to constrain inflation is puzzling, given that it has no institutional credibility against government intervention in monetary policy. With a dominant presence in the banking sector, the CCP can intervene in monetary policy at any time to achieve a host of political and policy objectives. Added to this mix is the at times severe elite rivalry, which has a tendency to engender suboptimal economic outcomes (Alesina and Drazen 1995; Rosenbluth 1989: 287). Indeed, China has witnessed repeated episodes of rapidly rising inflation in the two decades of reform. Yet none of them has exploded into hyperinflation, as has been the case in many developing and postcommunist countries. This study provides an account of how elite political tension provided credibility to monetary policies under certain conditions, thereby preventing hyperinflation from taking place.
解释中国看似奇迹般的增长。本研究的目标并不是提供另一个关于中国惊人增长的叙述。相反，它旨在解释与中国长期增长轨迹密切相关的两个重要金融结果：通货膨胀和资本配置效率。正如第二章所解释的，中国惊人增长的一个重要前提是其金融深化的快速推进，同时与许多发展中国家和后共产主义国家相比，伴随相对的价格稳定。考虑到中国在货币政策上对政府干预缺乏制度上的可信度，中国能够抑制通货膨胀这一点令人费解。中共在银行业占据主导地位，能够随时干预货币政策以实现一系列政治和政策目标。再加上有时严重的精英竞争，这往往会导致次优的经济结果（Alesina and Drazen 1995；Rosenbluth 1989: 287）。事实上，在改革的二十年里，中国已经多次出现快速上升的通货膨胀事件。 但没有一个国家像许多发展中国家和后社会主义国家那样发生过恶性通货膨胀。本研究解释了精英政治紧张关系如何在特定条件下为货币政策提供可信度，从而防止了恶性通胀的发生。
However, the miracle is not all that it seems. A study of the Chinese financial system cannot possibly ignore China’s enormous store of NPLs, estimated at around 50 percent of China’s gross domestic product (GDP) in 2001 . 2 2001 . 2 2001.^(2)2001 .{ }^{2} Chapter 2 also discusses how this pool of bad loans potentially can inflict serious consequences on China’s long-term growth trajectory. The buildup of this harrowing debt stems directly from the persistent failure to reform China’s lumbering banking sector, which continues to serve as an instrument of state policies. Given China’s apparent success in reforming many sectors of the economy, why has reform in the banking sector lagged so far behind? This study makes the argument that the same political dynamic that constrains China’s inflation also precludes fundamental banking reform.
然而，这一奇迹并非表面看起来那么简单。研究中国金融体系不可能忽视中国巨额的不良贷款存量，估计约为中国国内生产总值（GDP）的 50%（见第 2 章）。第 2 章还讨论了这笔不良贷款池如何可能对中国的长期增长轨迹造成严重后果。这一令人不安的债务积累直接源于未能改革中国沉重的银行部门——该部门仍然作为国家政策的工具。鉴于中国在改革许多经济部门方面取得的显著成就，为什么银行部门的改革会落后如此之多？本研究的论点是，约束中国通胀的同一政治动态也阻碍了根本性的银行改革。
The political dynamic in question is factional politics. The starting point of this study is that top Chinese leaders perpetually face threats to their power due to the lack of an institutionalized succession mechanism and the dearth of clear indicators of power. To mitigate this uncertainty, the leaders form factions, which are composed of a loose group of lower officials who have an incentive to provide political support to top leaders in times of political challenges. Senior officials acquire their factions as they cultivate personal relations with junior colleagues during the course of their careers. Over time, these loose networks of mutual obligation and exchange become conduits whereby appointments, economic goods, and policy power are channeled (Nathan 1973: 43). The definition of faction used throughout this study is simply this: a personal network of reciprocity that seeks to preserve and expand the power of the patron. This definition incorporates the three fundamental elements of a faction. First, a faction forms on the basis of personal relationships between the patron and the clients, cultivated as the patron rises in the party hierarchy. Second, this web of personal relationships exists as a channel to exchange goods and influence between the patron and the clients (Cox and Rosenbluth 1996; Nathan and Tsai 1995: 171). Finally, factions ultimately aim to maximize the power of the patron, as every member of a faction benefits from a powerful patron (Huang 2000: 5).
此处讨论的政治动态是派系政治。本研究的出发点是，中国高级领导人由于缺乏制度化的接班机制和缺乏明确的权力标志，持续面临权力受到威胁的状况。为减轻这种不确定性，领导人结成派系，派系由一群松散的下级官员组成，这些下级官员在政治面临挑战时有动机向高级领导人提供政治支持。高级官员在其职业生涯中与下级同僚培养私人关系，从而获得他们的派系。随着时间推移，这些基于相互义务与交换的松散网络成为任命、经济利益和政策权力的通道（Nathan 1973: 43）。本研究所采用的派系定义很简单：旨在维护和扩张庇护人权力的个人互惠网络。该定义包含派系的三个基本要素。首先，派系以庇护人与客户端之间随庇护人升迁于党内阶层时培养起来的私人关系为基础。 其次，这种人际关系网络作为赞助者与受庇护者之间交换物品与影响力的渠道（Cox and Rosenbluth 1996；Nathan and Tsai 1995：171）。最后，派系的最终目标是最大化赞助者的权力，因为派系中的每个成员都从一个强大的赞助者中受益（Huang 2000：5）。
Although factions generally serve the same functions for their political patrons, they are not created in the same fashion and are exogenously endowed with different resources and membership. These distinct endowments have enormous implications for their policy preferences and political strategies, both of which ultimately shape policy-making in China. On the one hand, factions led by senior party functionaries mainly comprise provincial officials and have the strongest control over the party apparatus. Historically, factions of this type labeled generalist factions - vied for supreme power in the CCP precisely because they had broad membership and controlled crucial party apparatuses. This type of faction includes officials from broad segments of the party because of the wide-ranging experience of the patrons. After the establishment of the People’s Republic in 1949, this meant a membership structure dominated by local cadres because they make up the bulk of the cadre population.
尽管派系通常为其政治庇护者履行相同的职能，但它们的产生方式并不相同，且在外生条件下拥有不同的资源和成员构成。这些不同的禀赋对其政策偏好和政治策略具有巨大影响，而两者最终共同塑造了中国的政策制定。一方面，由高级党务人员领导的派系主要由省级官员组成，并对党内机构拥有最强的控制力。历史上，这类被称为通才派系的集团正是因为其广泛的成员基础并控制关键的党组织机构而在中共内部争夺最高权力。此类派系囊括了党内各个广泛群体的官员，源于其庇护人的广泛经历。中华人民共和国于 1949 年建立后，这意味着其成员结构以地方干部为主，因为他们构成了干部队伍的主体。
On the other hand, there are factions led by senior officials with narrower experience in the regime. They often rise vertically within a certain bureaucratic group (xitong) with short stints elsewhere (Lieberthal 2004: 218). This career pattern affects both the preference and favored political strategy of their factions. In the economic arena, factions led by senior economic officials, which I label technocratic factions, have by far the greatest influence among the narrow factions as they directly oversee monetary and investment policies.
另一方面，也有由在体制内经历较窄的资深官员领导的派系。他们经常在某一官僚群体（xitong）内垂直晋升，在其他部门只短暂任职（Lieberthal 2004: 218）。这种职业模式影响了他们派系的偏好和所青睐的政治策略。在经济领域，由资深经济官员领导的派系——我称之为技术官僚派系——在这些狭窄派系中影响力最大，因为他们直接监管货币和投资政策。
Because of their membership composition, generalist factions had a distinct preference for monetary decentralization. In the reform era, local economic performance became a key indicator of evaluating cadres, leading to competition among local officials to maximize local growth (Huang 1996). Although growth promotion can come in the form of an investment-friendly environment
由于成员构成的原因，通才派系明显偏好货币分权。在改革时代，地方经济绩效成为考核干部的关键指标，导致地方官员之间为最大化本地增长而竞争（Huang 1996）。尽管促进增长可以采取营造有利于投资的环境的形式
(Qian and Weingast 1997), given the soft-budget environment in reform-era China, the most expedient method of accelerating growth often was more investment, financed by local coffers and by the rapidly growing banking sector (Huang 1996; Ma 1996). Thus, the preferred monetary policy of the generalist faction is to decentralize money creation to the local level, providing ample liquidity for local development. As many observers have noted, this policy is highly inflationary, precisely because local officials desire to expand money supply regardless of overall price stability (Chen 2005: 263; Ma 1996). In essence, because each local official seeks to maximize investment in his or her jurisdiction, they engage in competitive intervention in the banking sector, which results in a prisoner’s dilemma in which price stability is sacrificed. If local officials voluntarily adhere to borrowing restrictions, inflation would be averted. However, because exceeding central borrowing restrictions is the dominant strategy - it is rational to do so regardless of what other local officials do - every local official has a strong incentive to borrow as much as possible. Thus, the preferred policy of the generalist faction, if unconstrained by another political or institutional force, is expected to generate one consequence: hyperinflation.
（Qian 和 Weingast 1997）指出，在改革时代的中国，由于存在软预算约束，加速增长最便捷的 方法 往往是更多的 投资，由地方财政和快速增长的银行部门提供资金（Huang 1996；Ma 1996）。因此，通才派偏好的 货币政策 是将货币创造下放到地方层面，为地方发展提供充足的 流动性 。正如许多观察者所指出的，这一政策高度 导致 通货膨胀，恰恰因为地方官员无论整体物价稳定如何，仍然希望扩张货币供应（Chen 2005：263；Ma 1996）。本质上，由于每个地方官员都试图在其辖区内最大化 投资 ，他们在银行部门进行竞争性干预，导致了一个囚徒困境，在该困境中牺牲了物价稳定。如果地方官员自愿遵守借款限制，就可以避免通货膨胀。然而，因为超出中央借款限制是占优 策略 —— 无论其他地方官员做什么，采取这一做法都是理性的 —— 每个地方官员都有强烈动机尽可能多地借款。 因此，如果不受其他政治或制度性力量的制约，泛能派的首选政策是，预期将产生一个后果：恶性通货膨胀。
Because their membership is dominated by central technocrats, technocratic factions have a clear preference toward central control over policy tools, including financial resources. Their preference for financial centralization stems from incentives that link promotions and jurisdictional expansion with their ability to solve pressing problems confronting the regime, which often require massive amounts of capital. In the recent past, each monumental task undertaken by the central bureaucracy - building the Three Gorges Dam, developing western China, and state-owned enterprise (SOE) restructuring - has required enormous amounts of capital concentrated at the hands of the central bureaucracy. The preferred policy of this type of faction, financial centralization, decreases inflationary expectation because centralization solves the prisoners’ dilemma problem by putting the lead technocrat rather than a loose collection of local officials in charge of monetary stability. With clear designation of responsibility, the lead technocrat has much stronger incentive to preserve monetary stability.
由于其成员以中央技术官僚为主，技术官僚派系明显偏好将政策工具（包括财政资源）集中于中央。他们对财政集中化的偏好源于一种激励：提拔与管辖权扩展与他们解决政权面临的紧迫问题的能力相关，而这些问题通常需要大量资本。近代以来，中央官僚机构承担的每一项重大任务——三峡大坝建设、西部大开发以及国有企业（SOE）重组——都需要集中在中央官僚手中的巨额资本。这类派系偏好的政策——财政集中化——能够降低通胀预期，因为集中化通过将货币稳定的责任交给首席技术官僚，而不是一群松散的地方官员，解决了囚徒困境问题。在明确责任划分的情况下，首席技术官僚维护货币稳定的动机更为强烈。
Beyond preference for financial centralization, the narrow membership base of this type of factions means that it is unlikely to make a bid for ultimate power within the CCP. Unlike leaders of generalist factions, senior technocrats mostly have careers in a few central agencies, peppered with short stints in local government. Thus, a bid for overall control, which usually requires broad-base support, becomes difficult for senior technocrats. Senior technocrats, however, still maintain ample political resources at their disposal, giving them enormous influence over elite selection. Thus, instead of seeking ultimate control of the Party, leaders of narrow technocratic factions maximize their power through promoting members of the factions and enlarging resources available to agencies controlled by faction members. As the rest of this work reveals, they accomplish these objectives by taking advantage of economic conditions and by bargaining with generalist factions.
除了偏好金融集权之外，这类派系的成员基础狭窄，意味着它不太可能在中共内部发起争夺最高权力的竞选。与通才派系的领导人不同，高级技术官僚大多在少数中央机构开展职业生涯，仅有零星的地方任期。因此，通常需要广泛基础支持的全面掌控之争，对高级技术官僚而言变得困难。然而，高级技术官僚仍掌握充足的政治资源，使他们在精英人事选择上具有巨大影响力。因此，窄型技术官僚派系的领导人并不寻求夺取党内最终控制权，而是通过提拔派系成员并扩大由派系成员掌控的机构可支配资源来最大化其权力。正如本书其余部分所揭示的，他们通过利用经济状况并与通才派系进行博弈来实现这些目标。
Because technocratic factions do not claim ultimate control, the two types of factions generally coexist in a symbiosis, at times punctuated by sharp disagreements over monetary policy. As Chapter 4 details, in a dynamic economy, different economic conditions determine which type of faction holds the upper hand in shaping monetary policy. When perceived high inflation or an economic crisis strikes the economy, the dominant generalist faction does not have the option of doing nothing or of imposing austerity on itself. While doing nothing would lead to an economic collapse, imposing austerity measures on one’s own faction would encourage free-riding from rival generalist factions and the defection of faction members. Given the disastrous outcomes of these options, the dominant generalist faction would rather delegate financial policies to a technocratic faction, which is highly motivated to deprive all provinces of financial authority regardless of factional affiliation. At the same time, as a result of the narrow support base of senior technocrats, they are unlikely to usurp the ultimate power of the dominant generalist faction. In other words, the dominant generalist faction facing an economic crisis and factional rivals prefers preserving the status quo political balance by delegating financial policy to a technocratic faction over the short-term political benefits of financial decentralization. Because technocratic factions have an incentive to lower inflation and the political muscle to sustain centralization policies in the face of opposition, restrictive monetary policy implemented by technocratic factions becomes credible, which successfully lowers inflationary expectation.
由于技术官僚派系不主张最终控制权，两类派系通常以共生方式并存，有时会因货币政策而爆发激烈分歧。如第 4 章所述，在一个动态经济中，不同的经济状况决定了哪类派系在塑造货币政策方面占据上风。当感知到的高通胀或经济危机冲击经济时，主导的一般派系既不能选择无所作为，也不能对自身实施紧缩。无所作为将导致经济崩溃，而对本派系实施紧缩会鼓励对手一般派系的搭便车行为并导致派系成员叛离。鉴于这些选项可能带来的灾难性后果，主导的一般派系宁愿将金融政策委托给技术官僚派系，后者有强烈动机无视派系隶属剥夺各省的金融权力。与此同时，由于高级技术官僚支持基础狭窄，他们不太可能篡夺主导一般派系的最终权力。 换句话说，当主导的一般主义派面临经济危机和派系对手时，为了维持现有的政治平衡，他们更倾向于将金融政策委托给技术官僚派，而不是为追求金融分权的短期政治利益。 因为技术官僚派有动机降低通货膨胀并且在面对反对时具备维持中央集权政策的政治实力，所以由技术官僚派实施的紧缩货币政策变得可信，从而成功降低了通胀预期。
With the passing of an economic crisis, however, the dominant generalist faction no longer needs the technocratic faction to maintain the status quo balance of power and would rather decentralize financial control to faction followers in the provinces. Although technocratic factions fight such decentralization attempts and are at times successful in blocking them, the agenda-setting power enjoyed by the dominant generalist faction ultimately trumps the preferred policies of the technocrats. Monetary decentralization sets off another round of competitive intervention in the banks by local officials. This competition for bank loans gives rise to another round of monetary accumulation and ultimately leads to high inflation or another form of economic crisis. Thus, inflation serves both as dependent and independent variables. It is affected by the type of faction holding sway over monetary policy, but it also influences which type of faction gains the upper hand in monetary policy in a subsequent period. The interplay between generalist and technocratic factions, mediated by varying economic conditions, has engendered monetary cycles in China throughout the nearly three decades of reform.
然而，随着经济危机的过去，占主导地位的通才派就不再需要技术官僚派来维持现有的权力平衡，反而更倾向于将金融控制下放给省级的派系追随者。虽然技术官僚派会抵制这种下放尝试并有时能成功阻止，但占主导的通才派所享有的议程设置权最终会压倒技术官僚的偏好政策。货币下放引发了地方官员对银行的又一轮竞争性干预。这种对银行贷款的竞争导致新一轮货币积累，并最终引发高通货膨胀或另一种形式的经济危机。因此，通货膨胀既是因变量也是自变量。它受控于在货币政策上占上风的派系类型的影响，同时也影响哪种派系在后续时期能在货币政策上取得优势。 通才派与技术官僚派之间在不同经济条件下的相互作用，在近三十年的改革过程中，这导致了中国的货币周期。
At the same time, because top leaders of both generalist and technocratic factions face persistent political threats, they are reluctant to forego the use of a vast supply of funds provided by the banking sector. Party leaders can bolster factional support by giving followers access to bank funds for local development. Rather than reforming the banking system when they control it, bureaucrats also see the banking system as a rich source of funds to build up impressive administrative records, which make them indispensable to the regime and
与此同时，由于既有通才派也有技术官僚派的最高领导人都面临持续的政治威胁，他们不愿放弃由银行部门提供的大量资金的使用权。党内领导人可以通过让追随者获得银行资金用于地方发展来巩固派系支持。官僚们也将银行体系视为一笔丰厚的资金来源，用以积累令人瞩目的行政业绩记录，从而使自己对政权不可或缺，并
permit them to increase or retain power. As a consequence, the leader of a technocratic faction provides only short-term improvements to the financial sector and pursues a strategy of maximizing central control over the financial system, which increases the power of his faction and his personal standing in the Politburo. Because top leaders do not have an interest in truly reforming the banking sector, proposals for reform are either vetoed or diluted, and direct and indirect interventions in the banking system continue unabated.
使他们能够增加或保住权力。因此，技术官僚派的领导人仅对金融部门提供短期改进，并采取最大化对金融体系中央控制的策略，以增强其派系的力量和他本人在政治局的地位。因为最高领导人无意真正改革银行部门，改革提案要么被否决，要么被稀释，对银行体系的直接和间接干预持续不断。
The factional framework thus provides an explanation of two conflicting outcomes in the financial sector: relative success in constraining inflation and an insolvent banking system. The framework, however, leaves room for contingencies. First, although high inflation or an economic crisis provides the structural condition for a takeover by the central bureaucrats, this explanatory framework does not predict the precise timing of such a transition. Similarly, low inflation and high growth do not immediately translate to monetary decentralization. The theory put forth here merely suggests that high growth and stable prices provide the conditions for the generalist faction to decentralize monetary policy. As subsequent discussion reveals, there were instances of failed takeoff and failed retrenchment as the two types of factions employed political weapons at their disposal to obtain or maintain their preferred monetary policy. As Chapters 6 through 8 detail, the health of various leaders, the leaders’ charisma, bargains struck between political elites, and the discovery of corruption cases all intervened to influence the ebb and flow of monetary cycles in China.
派系框架因此为金融部门两种看似矛盾的结果提供了解释：在抑制通货膨胀方面的相对成功与银行体系的资不抵债。然而，该框架仍然留有偶发性的空间。首先，尽管高通胀或经济危机为中央官僚接管提供了结构性条件，但该解释框架并不能预测这种转变的精确时点。同样，低通胀和高增长也不会立即转化为货币分权。这里提出的理论仅表明，高增长与物价稳定为通才派去中心化货币政策提供了条件。正如后文所揭示的，两类派系利用其可动用的政治武器来争取或保持其偏好的货币政策，因此存在起飞失败和收缩失败的例子。正如第 6 至第 8 章所详述，各种领导人的健康状况、领导人的魅力、政治精英之间达成的交易以及腐败案件的发现，都会介入并影响中国货币周期的涨落。

The State, Bureaucracy, and Financial Outcomes
国家、官僚体系与金融结果

The political model developed here seeks to explain two distinct but related outcomes in China: China’s unique inflationary cycles and persistent inefficiency caused by the stagnation of financial reform. This unique combination of outcomes in China cannot be explained adequately by previous understanding of the state’s role in the financial market, which either dismisses state intervention as completely harmful or praises it as the solution to underdevelopment. The explanatory framework presented here provides a more nuanced understanding of state intervention in the economy. Although state intervention can eliminate certain volatility in developing countries, intervention almost inevitably produces rampant inefficiency in the financial system.
本文所构建的政治模型旨在解释中国两类既不同又相关的结果：中国独特的通货膨胀周期与由金融改革停滞引起的长期低效。这种独特的结果组合无法被以往关于国家在金融市场中角色的理解充分解释：那些观点要么将国家干预一概视为完全有害，要么将其赞颂为解决不发达问题的良方。本文提出的解释性框架提供了对国家经济干预更为细致的理解。尽管国家干预能消除发展中国家某些方面的波动性，但干预几乎不可避免地在金融体系中产生肆虐的低效。
At the broadest level, this research follows a long line of scholarship exploring the relationship between the state and development. Gerschenkron (1962: 20) argues that backward countries often need state intervention to concentrate capital and to leap over the technological gap. Theorists of postwar industrialization follow this tradition and further specify preconditions for successful state intervention. Haggard (1986), for example, contends that successful export-oriented growth in East Asia requires a government insulated from the traditional elite and a bureaucracy dedicated to growth promotion. Other scholars examining the East Asian “miracle” have developed similar sets of preconditions for successful state intervention (Amsden 1989; Evans
在最广泛的层面上，本研究延续了一系列探讨国家与发展关系的研究传统。Gerschenkron (1962: 20) 认为，落后国家常常需要国家干预以集中资本并跨越技术鸿沟。战后工业化理论家遵循这一传统，并进一步明确了成功国家干预的先决条件。例如，Haggard (1986) 主张，东亚成功的出口导向型增长需要一个免受传统精英影响的政府和一个致力于促进增长的官僚机构。其他考察东亚“奇迹”的学者也提出了类似的成功国家干预的先决条件（Amsden 1989；Evans）
1995; Johnson 1982; Wade 1990). Haggard and Lee (1995: 7) further point out that, given poor market institutions in developing countries, state intervention reduces information asymmetry and opportunism and increases the efficiency of capital allocation.
1995；Johnson 1982；Wade 1990）。Haggard 和 Lee（1995：7）进一步指出，鉴于发展中国家市场制度薄弱，国家干预可以减少信息不对称和机会主义行为，并提高资本配置效率。
Although the state played an important role in promoting industrialization in Germany and Russia before the war and in Asia after the war, state intervention imposed a price on the long-term growth trajectories of these economies, a fact that is often downplayed by state theorists. The case of reform-era China suggests a more nuanced interpretation of the state’s impact on the financial sector. On the one hand, the tight grip that the CCP has on the banking system and China’s elite political dynamic prevented inflation from becoming uncontrollable. On the other hand, the case of China demonstrates that even with an insulated government and a competent technocracy, state intervention in the financial market ultimately resulted in rampant inefficiency in the allocation of capital. In other words, the Chinese case suggests that intervention by a strong, coherent state provides the preconditions for spectacular growth through ensuring macroeconomic stability, although state allocation of capital constitutes a drag on the economy.
尽管在战前德国和俄罗斯以及战后亚洲，国家在促进工业化方面发挥了重要作用，但国家干预对这些经济体的长期增长轨迹施加了代价，这一点常被国家理论家所淡化。改革时期的中国案例则表明，需要对国家对金融部门的影响作出更为细致的解读。一方面，中国共产党对银行体系的严格控制以及中国的精英政治动力防止了通货膨胀失控。另一方面，中国的例子表明，即便政府具有隔离性且技术官僚队伍胜任，国家对金融市场的干预最终仍导致资本配置方面的严重低效。换言之，中国案例表明，强大且具有内在连贯性的国家通过确保宏观经济稳定为惊人增长提供了先决条件，尽管国家对资本的配置却成为经济的拖累。
The state theorists’ optimism about state intervention is intimately tied to their assumptions about technocrats in the government. Ever since Weber (1958) defined the bureaucracy as impersonal, apolitical, and rule abiding, scholars of all stripes, including both state theorists from political science and sociology and neoclassical economists, have put enormous faith in competent technocrats to implement policies that promote growth, price stability, and efficiency. Beginning with Johnson’s (1982) work on Japan’s growth miracle, scholars of the Asian “miracle” have placed technocrats at the center of their respective success stories (Amsden 1989; Aoki and Patrick 1994; Haggard, Lee, and Maxfield 1993; Wade 1990). Interestingly, many neoclassical economists place similar faith on “change teams” of technocrats, especially those trained as economists, to overcome entrenched interests and to implement reform (Blanchard and Schleifer 2000; Harberger 1993; Nelson 1988, 1993; Williamson 1994). In the same vein, the literature on central bank independence (CBI) makes similar assumptions about the leanings of central bankers. Because central bankers are presumed to prefer price stability, giving them legal autonomy from political intervention would impose an anti-inflationary bias in monetary policy (Cukierman 1994; Fischer 1995; Rogoff 1985).
国家理论家对国家干预的乐观态度与他们对政府技术官僚的假设密切相关。自韦伯（1958）将官僚体制定义为非人格化、非政治化且遵循规则以来，各类学者——包括来自政治学和社会学的国家理论家以及新古典经济学家——都对能够胜任的技术官僚寄予厚望，期望他们执行促进增长、价格稳定和效率的政策。自约翰逊（1982）关于日本增长奇迹的研究以来，亚洲“奇迹”的学者们便将技术官僚置于各自成功故事的中心（Amsden 1989；Aoki 和 Patrick 1994；Haggard、Lee 和 Maxfield 1993；Wade 1990）。有趣的是，许多新古典经济学家同样信任由技术官僚组成的“变革团队”，尤其是那些受过经济学训练的人，认为他们能够克服既得利益并推进改革（Blanchard 和 Schleifer 2000；Harberger 1993；Nelson 1988, 1993；Williamson 1994）。同样，关于中央银行独立性（CBI）的文献也对中央银行家的倾向作出类似假设。 因为人们假定中央银行家偏好价格稳定，赋予他们法律上的独立以免受政治干预，会在货币政策上带来反通胀偏向（Cukierman 1994；Fischer 1995；Rogoff 1985）。
In light of the financial problems across Asia in the late 1990s, as well as unsuccessful reform in many Latin American countries, we have to ask whether the ghost of Weber has blinded us from closely examining the actual motives of bureaucrats and central bankers. Even highly insulated bureaucrats in a professional bureaucracy have an interest in getting promoted, and financial resources constitute a powerful policy tool that can quickly bolster one’s administrative accomplishments and thus speed up promotion (Grimes 2001; Kessler 1998; Schamis 1999; Silva 1997). At the same time, technocrats who control credit allocation gain little from the efficient allocation of capital (Kang 2002). If
鉴于 1990 年代末亚洲的金融问题以及许多拉丁美洲国家改革的失败，我们必须质问：韦伯的幽灵是否让我们忽视了对官僚和中央银行家实际动机的细致审视。即便是高度隔离的专业官僚，也有晋升的利益，而财政资源构成了一种强有力的政策工具，能够迅速增强一个人的行政业绩，从而加速晋升（Grimes 2001；Kessler 1998；Schamis 1999；Silva 1997）。与此同时，掌控信贷分配的技术官僚从资本的有效配置中获益甚少（Kang 2002）。如果
government officials have the incentive to manipulate state-controlled financial resources to gain a political or career advantage, does it matter if the state is completely insulated from societal forces? Even if politicians and bureaucrats have no career ambitions, without a stake on the returns of the investment, they would hardly bother to allocate capital efficiently. 3 3 ^(3){ }^{3} Closer scrutiny of the careers and political incentives of bureaucrats and bankers allows us to make realistic predictions about their preferred policies and whether these policies are likely to generate real reform.
如果政府官员有动机操纵国家控制的金融资源以获取政治或仕途上的优势，那么即便国家完全与社会力量隔离，这一点重要吗？即使政治家和官僚没有仕途野心，若他们对投资回报没有利害关系，也很难会去有效地配置资本。 3 3 ^(3){ }^{3} 对官僚和银行家职业生涯及其政治激励的更仔细审视，使我们能够对他们偏好的政策以及这些政策是否可能产生真正的改革做出现实的预测。
This is not to say that the self-interested intentions of bureaucrats and politicians who intervene in the financial system cannot produce any positive results for the economy. A perennial problem in developing countries is that they seldom enjoy the luxury of a completely credible legal framework that makes effective central bank independence possible (Alesina and Summers 1993; Cukierman 1994; Fischer 1995; Maxfield 1994). The lack of credible institution is a problem in China, particularly because the CCP dominates in every part of the formal financial system. Moreover, because China has relatively effective capital control, it cannot establish monetary credibility through a fixed exchange rate regime (Broz 2002). Given the political reality in China, technocrats can only set credible monetary policies in one way: by playing the political game and defending their turf against encroachment by generalist factions. Contrary to the causal logic of the CBI framework, the inclusion of Chinese technocrats in elite politics provides credibility for their credit plan and anti-inflationary policies. Political motives drive Chinese technocrats to exploit inflationary crises to hoard power, which lowers inflationary expectation. The politicized technocrats might not be successful in centralizing monetary policies all the time, but their political clout enables them to exact a substantial toll on generalist factions attempting to wrest financial control away from the central bureaucracy. Knowing that, local officials find credibility in anti-inflationary policies when the Politburo delegates financial authority to the bureaucrats. The broader lesson for developing countries is that independent central banking institutions may be insufficient to ensure price stability. Rather, what developing countries first need are politically powerful actors who have a stake in fighting for stable monetary policy.
这并不是说那些干预金融体系的官僚和政治家出于自身利益的意图不能为经济带来任何积极结果。发展中国家长期存在的一个问题是，它们很少有享受完全可信的法律框架的奢侈，而这种框架能够使有效的中央银行独立成为可能（Alesina and Summers 1993；Cukierman 1994；Fischer 1995；Maxfield 1994）。在中国，缺乏可信制度是一个问题，尤其是因为中共在正规金融体系的每一部分都占主导地位。此外，由于中国有相对有效的资本管制，它无法通过固定汇率体制建立货币可信度（Broz 2002）。鉴于中国的政治现实，技术官僚只能通过一种方式确立可信的货币政策：参与政治博弈并捍卫其职责范围，抵御通才派的侵蚀。与中央银行独立（CBI）框架的因果逻辑相反，中国技术官僚参与精英政治为其信贷计划和反通胀政策提供了可信度。 政治动机驱使中国技术官僚利用通货膨胀危机来攫取权力，从而降低通胀预期。这些被政治化的技术官僚并不总能成功实现货币政策的集中，但他们的政治影响力使他们能够对试图从中央官僚体系手中夺取金融控制权的泛能派造成重大打击。基于此，地方官员在政治局将金融权力下放给这些官僚时，会对反通胀政策产生信任。对发展中国家的更广泛教训是，独立的中央银行机构可能不足以确保物价稳定。相反，发展中国家首先需要的是在维护稳定货币政策上有利害关系并且具有强大政治力量的行为主体。
The distinction between generalists with broad-based support and powerful technocrats with a narrow support base further resolves a general paradox that arises in delegation under incomplete legal institutions. That is, given incomplete legal institutions in an authoritarian regime, politicians who want to delegate economic authority to technocrats credibly must give further authority to already powerful technocrats. If the technocrats are only servants of the political generalists, policy delegation would not be credible. However, if technocrats are politically powerful, why are the generalists not afraid that the technocrats would usurp their power, especially given that most authoritarian
在专项权力基础薄弱的情形下，将拥有广泛支持的普通派与拥有狭窄支持基础但权力强大的技术官僚区分开，进一步化解了在不完备法律制度下委托代理所产生的一般性悖论。也就是说，在威权政体中，鉴于法律制度不完备，想要将经济决策权委托给技术官僚的政治人物，必须将更多权力授予那些已经强大的技术官僚，才能使委托具有可信性。如果技术官僚仅仅是政治普通派的仆从，政策委托就不会具有可信性。然而，如果技术官僚在政治上非常强大，普通派为什么不担心技术官僚会篡夺他们的权力，尤其考虑到大多数威权...
regimes are toppled by insiders (Bueno de Mesquita et al. 2003)? The Chinese case reveals that, although delegation to powerful technocrats comes with a heavy price, generalist politicians are willing to do so because they know that technocrats lack the political base to compete with them for ultimate authority. At the same time, knowing that in most cases the incumbent generalist controls vital political resources, politicized technocrats have an incentive to support the incumbent in crucial political struggles even as they bargain with the incumbent to obtain the maximum concession. Although the delegation literature focuses on the expertise and policy bias of technocrats (Bates 1994; Boylan 2001), technocrats’ expertise also tends to limit them to highly specialized positions, which precludes them from gaining ultimate control over the political system even if they are politically active.
政权会被内部人士推翻（Bueno de Mesquita 等，2003）吗？中国的案例表明，尽管将权力委托给强势技术官僚代价高昂，但通才政治家愿意这样做，因为他们知道技术官僚缺乏与自己争夺最终权威的政治基础。与此同时，鉴于在大多数情况下在任通才掌握着重要的政治资源，政治化的技术官僚即便在与在任者讨价还价以争取最大让步时，也有动力在关键政治斗争中支持在任者。尽管委托理论侧重于技术官僚的专业知识和政策偏向（Bates 1994；Boylan 2001），但技术官僚的专业性也倾向于将他们限制在高度专业化的职位上，这使得即便他们积极参与政治，也无法获得对政治体制的最终控制。

Inflationary Cycles and the Impetus for Reform in China
通胀周期与中国改革的动力

Within the literature on the political economy of China, the introduction of a membership-based factional model increases our ability to explain two important outcomes in China: inflationary cycles and the pattern of economic reform. The literature on inflationary cycles in China is quite extensive and has long reached the dangerous threshold of having more articles (explanations) than the number of observations. The earliest attempt to explain reform era inflation in China applies the quantity theory of money, in which an increase in money supply would lead to an increase in price to the same degree. In this vein, Chow (1987) finds that money growth systematically affects inflation. Naughton (1991) disputes this conclusion by arguing that the first inflationary cycles in the early 1980s were fueled by a rise in the relative price of agricultural output, whereas the 1988 inflation was caused by the expansion of the money supply. More recently, Hasan (1999) showed that money supply and inflation are cointegrated, indicating a reliable long-term positive relationship between the two variables. The factional framework adopts quantity theory in that it assumes stable money velocity and predicts a positive relationship between lending - the prime generator of money supply - and inflation rate. However, it is recognized that this relationship is more stable in the long run and may not be as apparent in the short run. In the short run, quantity theory alone does not provide a satisfactory explanation to the cyclical nature of inflation in China, especially given fairly high growth of money supply throughout the reform period.
在关于中国政治经济学的文献中，引入基于成员制的派系模型提升了我们解释中国两项重要结果的能力：通货膨胀周期和经济改革的模式。关于中国通货膨胀周期的文献相当广泛，早已达到一个危险的阈值——相关解释文章的数量多于观测值数量。解释改革时代通货膨胀的最早尝试应用了货币数量论，认为货币供应的增加会以相同程度导致物价上涨。沿着这一思路，Chow (1987) 发现货币增长系统性地影响通货膨胀。Naughton (1991) 对此结论提出异议，认为 1980 年代初的首次通货膨胀周期是由农业产出相对价格上升推动的，而 1988 年的通货膨胀则是由货币供应扩张引起的。更近的研究，Hasan (1999) 显示货币供应与通货膨胀是协整的，表明这两个变量之间存在可靠的长期正相关关系。 派系框架采用数量理论，因为它假定货币流通速度稳定，并预测放贷——作为货币供应的主要来源——与通货膨胀率之间存在正相关关系。然而，需要认识到这种关系在长期内更为稳定，而在短期内可能并不明显。短期内，单靠数量理论无法令人满意地解释中国通货膨胀的周期性，尤其是在改革期间货币供应增长相当高的情况下。
In the political economy vein, several explanations have been put forth to account for inflationary cycles in China. The dominant tradition among political explanations is the decentralization explanation. This argues that inflation in China is a result of the decentralization of monetary authority to the local governments, which have an incentive to competitively intervene in the banking sector to maximize local investment and growth (Bowles and White 1993; Brandt and Zhu 2000; Fan, Woo, and Hai 1996; Gore 1999a; Huang 1996). At the same time, Huang (1996) argues that China manages to contain its
在政治经济学的脉络中，已经提出了若干解释来说明中国的通货膨胀周期。政治解释中的主导传统是分权化解释。该观点认为，中国的通货膨胀是货币权力下放到地方政府的结果，地方政府有激励在银行部门进行竞争性干预以最大化本地投资和增长（Bowles and White 1993；Brandt and Zhu 2000；Fan, Woo, and Hai 1996；Gore 1999a；Huang 1996）。与此同时，Huang (1996) 认为中国设法控制其
inflation because the CCP ultimately can recentralize through its formal institutions, especially its power to demote and dismiss local officials. Although there is little doubt that decentralization of financial authority is intimately tied to inflation and recentralization is tied to price stability, these explanations do not address the cyclical nature of inflation in China. Logically, the central government’s preference for economic stability should trump local preference for high growth all the time because higher party committees demand obedience from subordinates in a Leninist party. With the exception of information asymmetry, the local government has little leverage over the center in the formal institutions. In reality, formal institutions alone have a hard time explaining why some central leaders seemed clearly in favor of local interests and why local interests at times trumped central preferences. Conversely, if decentralization has greatly weakened central authority, why was the center able to impose financial austerity on the provinces repeatedly?
通货膨胀是因为中国共产党最终可以通过其正式机构重新集中权力，特别是通过罢免和撤职地方官员的权力来实现。尽管毫无疑问，金融权力下放与通货膨胀密切相关，而再集中与物价稳定相关，但这些解释并未说明中国通货膨胀的周期性本质。逻辑上，中央政府对经济稳定的偏好应当始终压倒地方对高增长的偏好，因为较高级的党组织在列宁式政党中要求下级服从。除了信息不对称之外，地方政府在正式制度中几乎没有对中央的杠杆作用。实际上，单靠正式制度很难解释为什么某些中央领导人似乎明显倾向于地方利益，以及为什么地方利益有时会胜过中央偏好。反过来，如果权力下放大大削弱了中央权威，为什么中央能够多次向各省实施财政紧缩？
To answer these questions, Zhu and Brandt (2000) argue that the central government’s utility function is composed of economic growth and the danger of an economic crisis. Typically, decentralization is conducive to growth because local agents have more information about local enterprises and, hence, can allot money more efficiently, giving the center incentive to decentralize. However, when inflation creeps up, the cost of growth becomes dangerously high because inflation signals an increasing chance of economic collapse. As such, the central government is forced to recentralize financial authority at the expense of growth to avert a crisis. The crucial variable under this framework would be the central leadership’s level of inflation-aversion.
为回答这些问题，Zhu 和 Brandt (2000) 认为中央政府的效用函数由经济增长和经济危机的风险组成。通常，分权有利于增长，因为地方行为者对地方企业有更多信息，因此可以更有效地分配资金，这激励中央进行分权。然而，当通货膨胀逐渐上升时，增长的代价会变得危险地高，因为通货膨胀表示经济崩溃的可能性在增加。因此，为了避免危机，中央政府被迫以牺牲增长为代价重新集中金融权力。在该框架下的关键变量是中央领导对通货膨胀的厌恶程度。
If we assume relatively stable leadership aversion to inflation and if the level of financial decentralization is a continuous variable, however, there must be a level of centralization at which the utility of the central government is maximized. The government simply can target this level of centralization to ensure both growth and monetary stability. In fact, the credit plans before 1998 and the current indicative credit plan are precisely such targeting instruments. According to Ma (1996), these plans, if followed by the provinces, would generate reasonable growth as well as price stability. Nonetheless, local officials only followed these plans when the central bank could credibly punish them and borrowed beyond these plans during nonausterity periods. If the government engaged in a process of fine-tuning monetary policies, we would expect to see decreasing swings in inflationary cycles. In reality, what we see in the reform era instead is an increasing swing in inflationary cycles, that is, the inflation rate at the peak of each cycle rises higher than in the previous cycle (see Figure 2.1). Moreover, if austerity is simply a temporary fix, why have some austerity periods lasted for several years, for example, 1988 to 1991?
如果我们假定领导层对通货膨胀的厌恶相对稳定，并且财政分权的程度是一个连续变量，那么必然存在一个中央集权的水平，在该水平上中央政府的效用被最大化。政府可以简单地将这一集中化水平作为目标，以确保既有增长又有货币稳定。事实上，1998 年之前的信贷计划以及当前的指标性信贷计划正是此类目标工具。根据 Ma (1996) 的说法，如果各省遵循这些计划，就会同时产生合理的增长和价格稳定。然而，地方官员只有在中央银行能够可信地惩罚他们时才会遵守这些计划，而在非紧缩时期则超出这些计划借款。如果政府进行货币政策的微调过程，我们预计会看到通货膨胀周期摆动幅度减小。现实中，在改革时期我们看到的却是通货膨胀周期摆动幅度增加，也就是说每一轮周期峰值的通胀率比上一轮更高（见图 2.1）。 此外，如果紧缩只是一个临时应对措施，为什么有些紧缩期会持续数年，例如 1988 年到 1991 年？
Another way to explain the cyclical nature of Chinese inflation is to assume shifting preference on the part of the central government (Lin 1996; Ma 1996). In other words, the Chinese government suffers from a time consistency problem, in which it prefers growth when inflation is low and price stability when inflation is high. Although this comprises a more satisfying explanation, it raises
解释中国通货膨胀周期性特征的另一种方式是假定中央政府偏好的转变（Lin 1996；Ma 1996）。换言之，中国政府存在时间一致性问题：当通货膨胀低时偏好增长，而当通货膨胀高时偏好物价稳定。尽管这构成了一个更令人满意的解释，但它又提出了
further questions about the Chinese government. If the central government is a unitary actor, from where does the inconsistent preference arise? If it is not a unitary actor, what are the forces within the central government behind these two preferences? What are the mechanisms that shift the central government’s preference from growth to price stability?
关于中国政府的进一步问题。如果中央政府是一个单一行为体，那么这种不一致的偏好源自何处？如果它不是单一行为体，中央政府内部支持这两种偏好的力量是什么？有哪些机制将中央政府的偏好从增长转向物价稳定？
Answering these questions requires an examination of the political dynamic in China. Scholars of elite Chinese politics in the reform era have long noticed a cyclical pattern of reform in China, which is loosely correlated with inflationary cycles. However, most have interpreted economic signals such as inflation and economic growth as exogenous variables that affect the fortune of ideological groups within the CCP, giving rise to reform cycles (Dittmer and Wu 1995; Fewsmith 1994). Specifically, Dittmer and Wu (1995) predict that rapid growth elevates the reformers, whereas inflation gives ideological conservatives the upper hand. Although historical evidence from the 1980s works fairly well with their argument, the diminishing importance of ideology and the continuation of inflationary cycles in the 1990s suggest that factors other than ideology may have been at work throughout the reform era. As Chapter 7 reveals, the post-Tiananmen bargain between Deng Xiaoping and Chen Yun demonstrates that ideological disagreement was not at the root of the divide between the two leaders. If that were the case, Chen Yun could easily have sided with the ideological conservatives in 1989 to put an end to the reform. Instead, Chen Yun sided with Deng Xiaoping on the issue of reform in exchange for continued central control over the economy.
回答这些问题需要审视中国的政治动态。改革时代的中国精英政治学者长期以来注意到中国存在一种与通货膨胀周期松散相关的改革循环模式。然而，大多数学者将通货膨胀和经济增长等经济信号解释为影响中共内部意识形态集团命运的外生变量，从而导致改革周期（Dittmer 和 Wu 1995；Fewsmith 1994）。具体而言，Dittmer 和 Wu（1995）预测快速增长会提升改革派，而通货膨胀则使意识形态保守派占上风。尽管 20 世纪 80 年代的历史证据相当符合他们的论点，但意识形态重要性的下降以及 90 年代通货膨胀周期的延续表明，在整个改革时代可能存在除意识形态之外的其他因素。正如第 7 章所揭示的，天安门之后邓小平与陈云之间的交易表明，两位领导人之间的分歧并非根源于意识形态分歧。 若真是如此，陈云本可在 1989 年站到意识形态保守派一边，结束改革。相反，陈云在改革问题上选择了与邓小平站在一起，以换取对经济的持续中央控制。
The ideological explanation, moreover, once again begs the question of why the incumbent ideological group cannot simply adjust policies to maximize its chance of retaining control over economic policies. If its preference is simply ideological, the incumbent faction can simply adjust the level of financial centralization to ensure continual control, as long as it does not infringe on its ideological preference. Because centralization and decentralization have been features of both Maoist and reform periods, there is no reason why either centralization or decentralization is fundamentally unpalatable to either the reformers or the conservatives.
此外，意识形态解释再次未能回答这样一个问题：为何在位的意识形态集团不能简单调整政策以最大化其保持对经济政策控制的可能性？如果其偏好纯粹是意识形态性的，在不违背其意识形态偏好的前提下，现任派系完全可以通过调整金融集权的程度来确保持续控制。因为中央集权与分权在毛泽东时期和改革时期都曾出现过，既没有理由认为中央集权对改革派或保守派中的任何一方本质上不可接受，也没有理由认为分权本质上不可接受。
This book develops instead a membership-based framework of factions to account for the inconsistent preference of the Chinese government. Rather than seeing factions as ideologically oriented, this framework posits that factional preference stems from the membership composition of factions, which is a function of the factional patron’s career path. As Chapters 6 through 8 show, generalist factions, primarily composed of provincial officials, have an incentive to intervene in the banking system to distribute capital to selected provinces controlled by faction members. If local government officials sense that this type of faction is in charge of financial policy, the credibility of the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) would be undermined, increasing credit expansion and heightening inflationary expectation. By contrast, a faction composed of central economic bureaucrats has an incentive to pursue policies that centralize financial authority. Thus, when the technocratic faction controls monetary policies, inflationary expectation is lowered. Chapters 5, 6, and 7 provide both
本书转而提出了一个基于成员构成的派系框架，以解释中国政府偏好的不稳定性。与其将派系视为意识形态导向，本框架认为派系偏好源自派系的成员构成，而成员构成又取决于派系恩主的职业路径。正如第 6 至第 8 章所示，由省级官员为主组成的通才派系，有动机干预银行体系，将资本分配给由派系成员控制的特定省份。如果地方政府官员感觉到此类派系主导了金融政策，人民银行（PBOC）的可信度将受到削弱，信贷扩张增加，通胀预期上升。相反，由中央经济官僚组成的派系有动机推行集中金融权力的政策。因此，当技术官僚派系控制货币政策时，通胀预期会被压低。第 5、6 和 7 章同时提供了论证和证据。
quantitative and qualitative evidence that high inflation induces the generalist factions to impart financial control to technocratic factions.
定量和定性证据表明，高通胀促使泛能派将金融控制权转交给技术官僚派。
In sum, the factional explanation accounts for several anomalies not addressed by previous frameworks. First, the existence of two tendencies within the CCP explains why the Chinese government favored monetary decentralization in some periods and centralization in others. It also explains why the central government repeatedly failed to target an optimal money supply level to maximize its utility in terms of growth and price stability. Moreover, basing factional tendencies on membership composition rather than on ideological orientation accounts for the persistence of the centralization/decentralization cycles into the twenty-first century. Finally, identifying the narrow membership base of technocratic factions explains why the leaders of generalist factions were willing to delegate financial authority to politically powerful technocrats.
总之，派系解释能够说明若干先前框架未能解释的异常现象。首先，中共内部存在的两种倾向解释了为何中国政府在某些时期倾向于货币分权而在另一些时期又倾向于货币集中。这也解释了中央政府为何多次未能将货币供应量目标设定到能够在增长与价格稳定之间实现效用最大化的最优水平。此外，将派系倾向建立在成员构成而非意识形态取向之上，可以解释中央集权/分权周期为何持续到二十一世纪。最后，指出技术官僚派成员基础狭窄，解释了为何泛能派领导人愿意将金融权力授权给具有政治影响力的技术官僚。
The second issue in the China literature that this research addresses is the impetus of reform in China. The gradualist reform path China took has indeed produced impressive results in many parts of its economy. Scholars, both political scientists and economists, studying various sectors in China have derived multiple explanations for China’s impressive reform record (Lau, Qian, and Roland 2000; Naughton 1996; Oi 1999; Perkins 1988; Shirk 1993). Yet, China’s reform trajectory has not been without setbacks and stagnation (Fewsmith 1994; Lardy 1998; Steinfeld 1998). As Lardy (1998) points out, the stagnation of reform is particularly evident in the financial sector, in which loan allocation still follows rules made in the late 1970s.
本研究要解决的中国研究领域的第二个问题是改革的动力。中国采取的渐进式改革路径在其经济的许多领域确实取得了显著成就。研究中国各个部门的学者——包括政治学家和经济学家——提出了多种解释来说明中国令人瞩目的改革记录（Lau, Qian, and Roland 2000；Naughton 1996；Oi 1999；Perkins 1988；Shirk 1993）。然而，中国的改革轨迹并非没有挫折和停滞（Fewsmith 1994；Lardy 1998；Steinfeld 1998）。正如 Lardy (1998) 指出，改革的停滞在金融部门表现得尤为明显，该部门的贷款分配仍遵循 20 世纪 70 年代后期制定的规则。
The prevailing explanation of reform in China relies on the leadership’s desire to reform and the diffusion of market-enhancing ideas. In the now famous analogy, Chinese leaders have been “crossing the river by feeling for stones” (moshi guohe). Because Chinese leaders have an intrinsic desire to reform, they are willing to experiment with a wide range of reforms. Any setbacks in the reform stem from incomplete information on how to implement a particular reform, not from entrenched interests that block reform. With the diffusion of ideas on the market economy, “mistakes” should decrease over time, and market-promoting institutions should replace socialist institutions to increase the efficiency of the economy. 4 4 ^(4){ }^{4} In a slightly different version of the ideational model, Fewsmith (1994) and Baum (1994) argue that setbacks in reform are caused primarily by the resistance of ideological conservatives in the CCP. According to this framework, reform should proceed smoothly if ideological conservatives die or lose power.
对中国改革的主流解释依赖于领导层的改革意愿和市场促进性思想的传播。在现已著名的比喻中，中国领导人是“摸着石头过河”（moshi guohe）。由于中国领导人有内在的改革愿望，他们愿意对各种改革进行试验。任何改革上的挫折都源于关于如何实施某项具体改革的信息不完整，而不是由阻碍改革的既得利益集团造成的。随着市场经济思想的传播，“错误”应随时间减少，促进市场的制度应取代社会主义制度以提高经济效率。 4 4 ^(4){ }^{4} 在思想模型的一个略有不同的版本中，Fewsmith (1994) 和 Baum (1994) 认为，改革的挫折主要由中共内部意识形态保守派的抵制造成。根据该框架，如果意识形态保守派死亡或失去权力，改革应能顺利推进。
Although not disputing the importance of pro-reform leadership, the diffusion of ideas, and shifting ideology, these explanations alone cannot explain the persistent stagnation in financial sector reform. As Chapter 8 details, technocratic control and the universal acceptance of the market did not bring about
尽管并不否认支持改革的领导层、思想传播和意识形态转变的重要性，仅凭这些解释无法说明金融领域改革长期停滞的原因。正如第 8 章所述，技术官僚的掌控和对市场的普遍接受并未带来
any significant changes in the logic of capital allocation in China in the late 1990s. Meanwhile, ideological opposition to market-oriented reform in effect ended at the Fifteenth Party Congress when General Secretary Jiang Zemin announced that “[we] must encourage and guide the healthy development of individual, private, and other non-state economic entities” (Jiang 1997). Although Western models of financial organization have affected the configurations of some key institutions such as the central bank and the stock market, the state continues to have the same enormous leverage over the distribution of capital that it had in 1978. In fact, throughout the reform era, even into the current administration, the main variation in financial policy has been whether the central government or the provincial governments held control over the distribution of money, not whether policies favored a planned or market economy.
在 1990 年代末，中国资本配置逻辑并未发生重大改变。与此同时，对市场导向改革的意识形态反对实质上在第十五次党代会上结束，当时总书记江泽民宣布“必须鼓励和引导个体、私营及其他非国有经济健康发展”（江 1997）。尽管西方的金融组织模式影响了中央银行和股票市场等一些关键机构的构型，但国家在资本分配上的巨大杠杆仍与 1978 年无异。事实上，在整个改革时期，直至现任政府，金融政策的主要差别一直是中央政府还是省级政府掌控货币分配，而不是政策是否偏向计划经济或市场经济。
The two most compelling among the remaining alternative explanations are opposition by rent-seeking coalitions against financial reform and bureaucratic capture of the premier’s agenda. Although I am not denying that these explanations, as well as ideational ones, play some role in driving policy outcomes, their predictions are not as accurate as those of the factional framework. Shirk (1993) and Qian, Lau, and Roland (2000) assume that Chinese leaders prefer reform. On that basis, they argue that reformers have divided and conquered rent-seeking coalitions by offering a subset of the rent-seekers continuing rent or new rent-seeking opportunities. In this manner, inconsistencies in the reform path stemmed from incomplete information and complications in building a pro-reform coalition. Although costly, the overall path of the reform eventually would turn China into a fully marketized economy.
在剩下的替代理论中，最有说服力的两个是寻租利益集团反对金融改革以及官僚对总理议程的掣肘。虽然我并不否认这些解释——以及意识形态类解释——在推动政策结果方面起到了一定作用，但它们的预测并不像派系框架那样准确。Shirk (1993) 和 Qian, Lau, and Roland (2000) 假定中国领导人偏好改革。在此基础上，他们认为改革派通过向部分寻租者持续提供租金或新的寻租机会，分化并征服了寻租联盟。通过这种方式，改革路径中的不一致源于信息不完全以及构建亲改革联盟时的复杂性。尽管代价高昂，改革的大体路径最终仍将使中国转变为一个完全市场化的经济体。
Despite the applicability of this framework in other sectors of the economy, it still has a hard time explaining the continuing stagnation in financial sector reform. As Chapters 7 and 8 detail, Premier Zhu Rongji managed to implement reforms that substantially weakened a politically powerful group: local government officials. Zhu’s centralization effort deprived local officials access to cheap credit from banks, drastically increasing their dependence on the central bureaucracy for funding. Under the framework of manipulating rent-seekers to implement reform, we would have expected Zhu to steadily move toward a marketized financial sector during his tenure. Contrary to this prediction, however, after financial control was taken away from the local government, Zhu simply concentrated financial power in the central bureaucracy and the large SOEs. At the same time, more fundamental reforms, such as the legalization of private banks and interest rate liberalization, were not pursued despite enjoying strong support by affluent coastal provinces.
尽管该框架在经济其他部门也适用，但它仍然难以解释金融领域改革持续停滞的现象。如第 7 章和第 8 章所详述，朱镕基总理设法推行了实质性削弱一支政治上颇有实力的群体——地方政府官员——的改革。朱的中央集权努力剥夺了地方官员从银行获得廉价信贷的渠道，极大地增加了他们对中央官僚体系资金的依赖。按照通过操纵寻租者来推动改革的框架，我们本会预期朱在其任期内稳步推进金融部门市场化。然而与这一预测相反，在地方政府对金融的控制被剥夺后，朱只是将金融权力集中到了中央官僚体系和大型国有企业手中。与此同时，更根本性的改革，例如私营银行合法化和利率市场化，尽管受到富裕沿海省份的强烈支持，却并未被推进。
Bureaucratic capture, which argues that bureaucratic interests dictate the implementation of financial policies, provides another compelling alternative explanation. According to the framework, financial policies implemented by central technocrats should have systematically benefited the interests of a subset of bureaucracies (Bachman 1991: 8). As Chapters 7 and 8 demonstrate, the centralization efforts by Zhu Rongji indeed expanded the authority of the State Economic and Trade Commission (SETC), the PBOC, and the MOF.
官僚俘获理论认为，官僚利益决定了金融政策的执行，为此提供了另一种有力的替代性解释。根据该框架，由中央技术官僚实施的金融政策应系统性地有利于部分官僚机构的利益（Bachman 1991：8）。正如第 7 章和第 8 章所示，朱镕基的中央集权努力确实扩大了国家经贸委（SETC）、中国人民银行（PBOC）和财政部（MOF）的权力。
Nonetheless, although Zhu’s policies increased the discretion of these bureaucracies dramatically, they also created enormous problems for them in the medium and long term. As faction members who cared only about maintaining and expanding the influence of the factional patron, however, it was perfectly logical for them to support short-term solutions. For example, although many bank and PBOC officials supported interest rate liberalization, the premier and the governor of the PBOC felt that it might engender instability and, more important, deprive the center of a source of cheap capital in the short term. Thus, they repeatedly vetoed or amended proposals to liberalize interest rates, despite Zhu’s known sympathy toward the PBOC (he had served as governor).
尽管如此，尽管朱的政策大幅增加了这些官僚机构的自主权，但从中长期来看，它们也因此面临巨大问题。然而，作为只关心维持和扩大派系主事人影响力的派系成员，支持短期解决方案对他们来说完全合乎逻辑。例如，虽然许多银行和中国人民银行的官员支持利率市场化，但总理和中国人民银行行长认为这可能引发不稳定，更重要的是在短期内剥夺中央获取廉价资本的来源。因此，尽管人们知道朱对中国人民银行有同情（他曾任行长），他们仍多次否决或修改利率市场化的提案。
Although it is difficult to confirm the effects of any specific explanatory framework on a small number of policy outcomes, the factional framework provides predictions that are most consistent with patterns of financial policy implementation. In the factional framework, both types of factions seek first and foremost to maintain and expand power vis-à-vis the other factions. When generalist factions control the banking sector, they encourage provincial followers to utilize bank deposits for local development. Although local control over the financial sector encourages local experiments with interest rate liberalization and other reform, it is difficult for generalist factions to coordinate nationallevel reform efforts. When technocratic factions control the banking system, they aggressively pursue a strategy of maximizing central control, regardless of the reform implications.
虽然很难在少数政策结果上确认任何特定解释框架的影响，但派系框架所提供的预测与金融政策执行的模式最为一致。在派系框架中，两类派系首先也是最重要的目标是相对于其他派系维持并扩张权力。当泛能派系控制银行业时，他们鼓励省级追随者动用银行存款用于地方发展。尽管对金融部门的地方控制鼓励在利率放开和其他改革方面进行地方试验，但泛能派系很难协调全国层面的改革努力。当技术官僚派系控制银行体系时，他们会积极推行最大化中央控制的策略，而不顾及对改革的影响。
Overall, the factional argument by no means contradicts the rent-seeking framework. In fact, the politics of factionalism is the politics of rent-seeking because factions primarily distribute economic rent and offices in exchange for political support. Olson (1982) and works on postcommunist reform (Schleifer, Treisman, and Development Centre of Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development. 1998; Treisman 1999) ascribe difficulties in reform to the struggle between rent-seekers and reformers. In the case of China, two types of rent-seekers, central and local officials, engage in the struggle for financial authority, perpetuating financial inefficiency for decades. Although this competition has an effect on money supply and inflation, it makes no significant improvement on the efficiency of capital allocation. In other words, Chinese factional politics is a struggle of rent-seekers against rent-seekers.
总体而言，派系论并不与寻租框架相互矛盾。事实上，派系政治就是寻租政治，因为派系主要通过分配经济租金和官职以换取政治支持。Olson (1982) 以及关于后共产主义改革的研究（Schleifer、Treisman 和经济合作与发展组织发展中心，1998；Treisman 1999）将改革困难归因于寻租者与改革者之间的斗争。在中国的情形中，两类寻租者——中央官员与地方官员——在金融权力上展开斗争，使金融低效延续数十年。尽管这种竞争对货币供应和通货膨胀有影响，但并未在资本配置效率上带来显著改善。换言之，中国的派系政治是寻租者之间的斗争。

Methodology  方法论

The overall research strategy used in this study is one of induction-deductioninduction, in which empirical observations about elite political motivations in China are first collected from various sources. From these observations, a theory about how elite incentives drive financial outcomes is derived deductively. Finally, the empirical implications of the theory are systematically tested through both qualitative case studies and statistical analysis.
本研究采用的总体研究策略是归纳-演绎-再归纳，即先从各种来源收集关于中国精英政治动机的实证观察。从这些观察中演绎出一个关于精英激励如何驱动金融结果的理论。最后，通过定性案例研究和统计分析系统地检验该理论的实证含义。
In the first stage, I conducted more than seventy interviews with midand high-level cadres from both the central and the local level in both the
在第一阶段，我对来自中央和地方的不同比例的中高层干部进行了七十余次访谈。
