a “State bankers” includes those who work in the Big Four state banks, the policy banks, and the joint-stock banks, whereas “government officials” are government bureaucrats who do not work in the banks. I include PBOC officials in the category of “government officials.” “Local” level denotes provincial level or below. Most of the local-level interviews were conducted with provincial or city-level officials. In addition to those on this chart, I interviewed four Western journalists and bankers with deep knowledge of China. I interviewed twelve of these subjects more than once.
“国有银行人员”包括在四大国有银行、政策性银行和股份制银行工作的人员，而“政府官员”是指不在银行工作的政府官僚。我将人民银行官员归入“政府官员”类别。“地方”级别指省级或以下。大多数地方级别访谈对象为省级或地级市官员。除本图表所列人员外，我还采访了四位对中国有深入了解的西方记者和银行家。我对其中十二名受访者进行了不止一次的访谈。
government and the state banks to discern the motivation of different types of officials (see Table 1.1). Although the heart of this study concerns top-level leaders beyond the reach of most Western investigators, mid-level officials often have an accurate idea about the political incentives facing top-level leaders, and the consistency of their answers about elite motivation reflects this knowledge. The single clearest message that emerges from the interviews is that, above all else, Chinese leaders care about political survival and actively formulate strategies to expand or maintain power. The interviews also suggest that the survival strategies of individual leaders have an enormous impact on the banking sector. The other important insight from the interviews is that different types of cadres have different ways of bolstering their careers. For local cadres, bringing additional investment and growth to the region is extremely important for promotion. In contrast, central bureaucrats are primarily preoccupied with having sufficient authority and resources to solve pressing policy problems, which speeds up their promotion. Integrating these insights with previous works on Chinese politics, I derive the factional framework of how elite politics impacts financial outcomes.
政府和国有银行，以辨别不同类型官员的动机（见表 1.1）。尽管本研究的核心涉及大多数西方研究者难以触及的高层领导人，但中层官员通常对高层领导面临的政治激励有较为准确的认识，他们关于精英动机的回答一致性反映了这一点。访谈中最清晰的一个信息是，最重要的是，中国领导人关心政治生存，并积极制定扩大或维持权力的策略。访谈还表明，个别领导人的生存策略对银行业有巨大的影响。访谈提供的另一个重要见解是，不同类型的干部有不同的晋升路径。对于地方干部来说，为本地区带来更多投资和增长对于升迁极为重要。相反，中央官僚主要关心拥有足够的权力和资源以解决紧迫的政策问题，这会加速他们的晋升。 将这些见解与先前关于中国政治的研究整合后，我推导出精英政治如何影响金融结果的派系框架。
The logic of the factional framework, presented in its entirety in Chapter 4, is then tested both quantitatively and qualitatively. The quantitative tests presented in Chapter 5 comprise two parts. First, I test the distributive implications of the factional model by examining whether generalist factional ties and technocratic factional ties have different impacts on provincial loan allocation. By regressing provincial bank lending from 1978 to 2004 on factional ties and a host of economic indicators, I show that only ties with a top CCP generalist increase provincial bank lending, whereas ties with a top bureaucrat bring no additional advantage in terms of loan allocation. This finding indicates that there are in fact divergent factional strategies in terms of intervention in the banking sector. The second set of quantitative models tests an important implication of the factional model, that high inflation triggers bureaucratic control over monetary policies, thereby lowering inflationary expectation. To test this, I
派系框架的逻辑在第四章中完整呈现，随后通过定量和定性方法进行检验。第五章呈现的定量检验分为两部分。首先，我通过考察通才派系关系和技术官僚派系关系是否对省级贷款分配有不同影响来检验派系模型的分配含义。通过对 1978 年至 2004 年省级银行放贷与派系关系及一系列经济指标进行回归分析，我发现只有与中共高级通才的关系会增加省级银行放贷，而与高级官僚的关系在贷款分配方面并不带来额外优势。此发现表明在干预银行部门方面确实存在不同的派系策略。第二组定量模型检验了派系模型的一个重要含义：高通货膨胀会触发对货币政策的官僚控制，从而降低通胀预期。为检验这一点，我
collected a quarterly data set from various sources and regress current inflation and lending on past inflation and past growth using time-series models. This analysis reveals that, contrary to the predictions of conventional economic theory, past inflation has a negative impact on current lending, which triggers lower inflation in subsequent quarters, suggesting that past inflation increases the chance of a central bureaucratic takeover. At the same time, high growth in one period is expected to heighten inflationary pressure in a subsequent period. These findings provide strong quantitative support for the notion that elite political struggle constrains inflationary tendencies in China.
从各种来源汇集了季度数据集，并使用时间序列模型将当前通货膨胀和贷款分别回归到过去的通货膨胀和过去的增长。本分析显示，与传统经济理论的预测相反，过去的通货膨胀对当前贷款有负向影响，这会在随后的几个季度触发更低的通货膨胀，表明过去的通货膨胀增加了中央官僚接管的可能性。与此同时，一个时期的高增长预计会在随后的时期加剧通货膨胀压力。这些发现为精英政治斗争制约中国通货膨胀倾向的观点提供了有力的定量支持。
Qualitatively, I test the implications of the factional framework through close scrutiny of the five reform era monetary cycles. Cases throughout the entire reform period are examined in Chapters 6 through 8 for several reasons. First and foremost, this work develops a general explanation of monetary and banking outcomes for the entire reform period. As such, testing the claims of the theory requires careful examination of the entire period. Second, all the relevant actors in the 1990s and even today had served in important positions in the government in the 1980s and thus made policies informed by events in the 1980s. As such, readers would greatly benefit from understanding the origins and political motivations of financial policies in the 1980s. Third, I have much more reliable information about elite politics for the 1980s and early 1990s than for the contemporary period. Although the political context has shifted with the passing of Chen Yun and Deng Xiaoping, the persistence of the CCP and factional politics in the 1990s allows us to use information from the 1980s to help make inferences about the i990s.
在定性上，我通过对改革时期五个货币周期的细致审视来检验该派系框架的含义。第 6 至第 8 章对整个改革期的案例进行了考察，原因有几方面。首先，本书旨在为整个改革期的货币和银行结果提出一个总体解释。因此，要检验理论的主张，就必须对整个时期进行细致审查。其次，1990 年代乃至今天的所有相关行动者在 1980 年代都曾担任政府中的重要职务，并据此制定了受 1980 年代事件影响的政策。因此，读者若能理解 1980 年代金融政策的起源及其政治动机，将大为受益。第三，我对 1980 年代和 1990 年代初的精英政治掌握的信息，比对当代时期的资料可靠得多。尽管随着陈云和邓小平的逝世政治环境发生了变化，但中共及其派系政治在 1990 年代的延续性使我们可以利用来自 1980 年代的信息来对 1990 年代进行推断。
Embedded within each inflationary cycle are two sets of subcases. First, each cycle is divided into the takeoff phase and the retrenchment phase. Instances of both successes and failures occurred in each of the two phases. A failed takeoff occurs when a top CCP leader’s attempt to decentralize finance by making a significant speech in its favor is frustrated by the technocratic faction. Thus, failed takeoffs also can be interpreted as bureaucratic successes in maintaining centralization. Successful takeoffs occur when the dominant generalist faction’s exhortation for decentralization and rapid growth translated to actual financial decentralization and a substantial increase in the money supply. Inquiring about both the success and failure of takeoffs allows us to test whether perceived improvement in economic conditions indeed provided a basis for decentralization and whether central bureaucrats indeed possessed the political clout to block attempts to decentralize finance, as predicted by the factional framework.
在每一轮通货膨胀周期中，都包含两组子情形。首先，每个周期分为起飞阶段和收缩阶段。两阶段中都出现了成功和失败的案例。所谓起飞失败，指的是中共一位高层领导人通过发表重要讲话试图推动金融下放，但被技术官僚派系挫败。因此，起飞失败也可以被解读为官僚体制在维持集中化方面的成功。起飞成功则指占主导地位的通才派系倡导下放与快速增长，并转化为实际的金融下放和货币供应量的大幅增加。考察起飞的成功与失败，使我们能够检验：对经济状况改善的感知是否确实为下放提供了基础，以及正如派系框架所预测的那样，中央官僚是否确实拥有阻止金融下放尝试的政治影响力。
The second half of an inflationary cycle comprises the success and failure to impose central retrenchment. A failed attempt to impose retrenchment occurs when the central bureaucracy signals a recentralization drive through an important speech or through the issuance of a major decree, only to be vetoed or countermanded by a generalist faction. A successful retrenchment, by contrast, is one in which the dominant generalist faction cooperates with the technocratic faction to recentralize the financial system. Tracing the entire life of an inflationary cycle enables us to gain an intimate understanding of the political processes
通货膨胀周期的后半段包括中央收缩政策的推行与未能推行。未能推行收缩政策发生在中央官僚机构通过重要讲话或发布重大法令表明要进行重新集中权力的行动，却被一个强调普遍治理的派系否决或撤销。相反，成功的收缩则是占主导地位的普遍治理派系与技术官僚派系合作，重新集中金融体系。追踪一个通货膨胀周期的整个历程使我们能够深入理解导致通货膨胀与收缩的政治过程
that give rise to inflation and retrenchment. Chapter 6 examines both the first (1978-1982) and the second (1983-1986) inflationary cycles, whereas Chapter 7 inquires about the third (1987-1990) and fourth (1991-1996) cycles. Finally, Chapter 8 provides an in-depth discussion of the most recent cycle (1997-2006). In all but the 1987-1990 cycle, there were instances of both successful and failed takeoffs and retrenchments, providing a wide array of variation in the policy outcomes.
这些政治过程。第 6 章考察了第一（1978–1982）和第二（1983–1986）两个通货膨胀周期，第 7 章探讨了第三（1987–1990）和第四（1991–1996）周期。最后，第 8 章对最近的周期（1997–2006）进行了深入讨论。除 1987–1990 周期外，各周期中都出现过起飞和收缩既成功又失败的例子，为政策结果提供了丰富的变异性。
In addition to cases of success and failure, each inflationary cycle includes the contrasting cases of monetary policies and banking policies. A central contention of this study is that elite factions have strong incentives to fight over which level of government controls monetary policies but little incentive to defend the autonomy of the banking system. Thus, in addition to accounts of the elite struggles over monetary policy, Chapters 6 through 8 describe the elite neglect of banking reform throughout the nearly three decades under examination. Evidence presented in these chapters shows that both types of factions were equally willing to manipulate the banking sector for their own purposes.
除了成败案例外，每一轮通货膨胀周期还包括货币政策与银行政策这两类对照性案例。本研究的一个核心论点是，精英派系在争夺哪个层级的政府控制货币政策方面有强烈动机，但对维护银行体系自主性却缺乏动机。因此，除了关于精英对货币政策争斗的论述外，第 6 至第 8 章还描述了在近三十年研究期内精英对银行改革的忽视。这些章节中呈现的证据表明，两类派系同样愿意为自身目的操纵银行业。
Finally, given the opacity of the Chinese regime, a full set of historical records concerning monetary policy making is simply unavailable. In any event, one can never truly establish the preferences of central leaders through historical records alone. Nonetheless, I use a wide array of internal speeches, party documents, decrees, internal policy documents, and official and unofficial biographies to piece together the main issues of contention: senior leaders’ signals to various audiences, interelite subterfuge, and the linkages between elite signals and policies. The most important empirical implications that the historical evidence establishes are that different types of senior leaders sent different signals to local officials and that their signals also varied depending on the state of the economy at the time.
最后，鉴于中国政权的不透明性，一整套关于货币政策制定的历史记录根本不可得。无论如何，仅凭历史记录也无法真正确立中央领导人的偏好。尽管如此，我仍利用大量内部讲话、党内文件、法令、内部政策文件以及官方和非官方传记，拼凑出主要争议问题：高级领导人对不同受众发出的信号、精英间的暗中策略，以及精英信号与政策之间的关联。历史证据确立的最重要的经验含义是，不同类型的高级领导人向地方官员发出的信号不同，并且他们的信号也会根据当时的经济状况而变化。
I gain the most intimate look at elite politics from The Compilation of Important Documents since the Third Plenum (Sanzhong Quanhui Yilai Zhongyao Wenxian Huibian), a two-volume collection of top-secret (jimi) speeches and decrees compiled for senior officials that covers the years between 1978 and 1982. 5 5 ^(5){ }^{5} Although it is more than two decades old, the main actors covered in these volumes - Deng Xiaoping, Chen Yun, Zhao Ziyang, and Hu Yaobang remained active in elite politics for much of the 1980s and 1990s. These two volumes tell us unambiguously that monetary policy constitutes a crucial point of disagreement between central leaders in the reform period. In these speeches and transcripts, the leaders’ annoyance, frustration, and resentment for each other show through clearly on the issue of monetary centralization. The second major source for the 1980s, A Collection of Central Instructions to Work in Guangdong (Zhongyang dui Guangdong Gongzuo Zhishi Huibian), is a collection of speeches and discussion minutes compiled by the Guangdong Party Committee, which contains fascinating accounts of bargaining sessions between
我从《第三次全会以来重要文件编纂》（Sanzhong Quanhui Yilai Zhongyao Wenxian Huibian）获得了对精英政治最深刻的观察，这是一本为高级官员编纂的两卷本机密（jimi）讲话和法令汇编，涵盖 1978 至 1982 年间的资料。尽管已有二十多年历史，但这些卷册中记载的主要人物——Deng Xiaoping、Chen Yun、Zhao Ziyang 和 Hu Yaobang——在 1980 年代和 1990 年代的大部分时间里仍然活跃于精英政治。这两卷明确告诉我们，在改革时期，货币政策构成了中央领导人之间争论的关键点。在这些讲话和成绩单中，领导人在货币集中化问题上对彼此的恼怒、挫折和怨恨表现得非常清晰。1980 年代的第二大来源是《中央对广东工作指示汇编》（Zhongyang dui Guangdong Gongzuo Zhishi Huibian），这是由广东省委编纂的一部讲话和讨论记录汇集，包含了有关各方谈判会话的引人入胜的记述。
Guangdong cadres and various central leaders. More so than other sources, this collection demonstrates the different relationships that various central leaders had with the province. Zhao Ziyang, who had strong ties with Guangdong, treated Guangdong much more sympathetically than did Yao Yilin, who acted the part of an unforgiving central planner.
广东干部与各级中央领导人。与其他资料相比，这些材料更多地展示了各位中央领导人与该省之间的不同关系。与扮演严厉中央计划者角色、对广东态度不近人情的姚依林相比，与广东关系密切的赵紫阳对广东的态度要宽厚得多。
For the entire period under examination, I also had access to internal financial regulations compiled by the PBOC, published annually in A Collection of Financial Regulations and Systems (Jinrong Guizhang Zhidu Xuanbian). These volumes, which have an internal (neibu) classification, include financial decrees issued by the State Council, the PBOC, and the individual state banks. They enabled me to discern changes in the direction of monetary and banking policies and provide hints of elite disagreements over various policies. Because these volumes are classified and are extremely tedious, I am the first to make extensive use of them. My understanding of the financial policies in the 1990s is further bolstered by a group of internal periodicals about economic and financial policies. These publications offer a rare glimpse into the policy process by publishing debates about a wide range of policy issues. These debates also supply strong indications of elite disagreements on various issues because lowerlevel bureaucrats offer disparate policy proposals according to the preferences of senior leaders (Lieberthal and Oksenberg 1988). Finally, these periodicals provide a more accurate view of the failures and problems of various policies, which tend to be beautified in the unclassified journals.
在整个研究时期，我还能够查阅人民银行编纂并每年出版的内部《金融规章制度选编》（Jinrong Guizhang Zhidu Xuanbian）。这些带有内部（neibu）分类的卷册，收录了国务院、人民银行以及各国有银行发布的金融法令。它们使我能够辨别货币与银行政策方向的变化，并提供有关精英在各项政策上存在分歧的线索。由于这些卷册带有密级且极为繁琐，我是第一个大量利用它们的人。我对 1990 年代金融政策的理解还得到了一批关于经济与金融政策的内部期刊的补充。这些刊物通过刊载关于广泛政策议题的辩论，提供了对政策制定过程的罕见洞见。由于基层官僚会根据高级领导的偏好提出各异的政策建议（Lieberthal and Oksenberg 1988），这些辩论也强烈表明了精英在不同问题上的分歧。 最后，这些期刊比非机密刊物更准确地反映了各项政策的失误和问题，后者往往对政策加以美化。
In addition to official publications, I made full use of official and unofficial memoirs written by elite participants in the financial policy process. Three particularly useful official memoirs are written by Xue Muqiao (1996), Chen Jinhua (2005) - both veteran State Council officials -and Liu Hongru (2000b), a seasoned central banker who lobbied for financial reform for more than two decades. The most compelling unofficial memoirs germane to this work were written by the leftist ideologue Deng Liqun (2005) and one-time Zhao Ziyang speechwriter Wu Guoguang (1997), both of whom provide scintillating accounts of elite politics in the 1980s. These memoirs offer biased, but intricate, accounts of policy debates and elite tension over monetary policy spanning the 1980s and 1990s. In addition to memoirs, the Chen Yun Chronicle (Chen Yun Nianpu) and the Deng Xiaoping Chronicle provide crucial information on the preferences and actions of senior leaders.
除了正式出版物外，我还充分利用了由参与金融政策过程的精英撰写的官方和非官方回忆录。其中三部特别有用的官方回忆录分别是薛暮桥（1996）、陈金华（2005）——两位资深国务院官员——以及刘鸿儒（2000b），这位经验丰富的中央银行家在推动金融改革方面奔走呼号二十余年。与本书相关且最引人注目的非官方回忆录是左派理论家邓力群（2005）和曾任赵紫阳演讲稿撰稿人的吴国光（1997）所著，两人都生动地记述了 20 世纪 80 年代的精英政治。这些回忆录虽有偏见，但对 20 世纪 80 至 90 年代围绕货币政策的政策讨论和精英间的紧张关系提供了复杂详尽的记述。除了回忆录外，《陈云年谱》和《邓小平年谱》也为高层领导的偏好与行动提供了关键信息。
The final group of primary sources used in this study includes unofficially leaked documents, as well as political commentaries published in the Hong Kong press. The two most compelling collections of unofficially leaked documents are the Tiananmen Papers, which provides a top-secret look at the decisions that led up to the Tiananmen massacre, and the Fourth Generation, which offers a summary of the ultra-secret assessment of potential top leaders (Nathan and Link 2001; Zong 2002). While the first collection, if genuine, gives us an unprecedented look at the elite bargaining that took place after the massacre, the second collection contains numerous anecdotes that paint a Machiavellian portrait of elite Chinese politics. I also make use of commentaries on elite Chinese
本研究使用的最后一组第一手资料包括非官方泄露文件以及发表在香港媒体上的政治评论。两组最有说服力的非官方泄露文件集是《天安门文件》，它提供了导致天安门大屠杀决策的绝密内部视角；以及《第四代》，它概述了对潜在最高领导人的超机密评估（Nathan 和 Link 2001；Zong 2002）。前一组若为真，便让我们前所未有地洞见大屠杀后发生的精英讨价还价；后一组则包含大量轶事，勾画出中国精英政治的马基雅维利式画像。我还引用了关于中国精英的评论文章。
politics made by Hong Kong journalists, who base their columns, presumably, on interviews with knowledgeable insiders in Beijing (Gao and He 1998; He and Gao 2000; Lam 1989, 1995; Ren 1999). Although the reliability of these accounts is questionable, I try to only make use of facts that are mentioned by more than one commentator. Although the use of all of these sources still falls far short of complete access to Politburo meeting minutes, I believe that all of these sources together provide reasonable support for the main arguments of this work.
由香港记者撰写的政治报道，这些记者的专栏大概基于与北京内部知情人士的访谈（Gao and He 1998; He and Gao 2000; Lam 1989, 1995; Ren 1999）。尽管这些报道的可靠性存疑，我尽量仅采纳被不止一位评论员提及的事实。尽管利用所有这些来源仍远不能等同于完全获取政治局会议纪要，但我认为这些来源合在一起为本书的主要论点提供了合理的支持。

China's Financial Performance in Comparative Perspective
比较视角下的中国金融表现

Why do we care that China’s inflation has been relatively low and that the banking sector is squandering vast sums of money? In important ways, the inflationary and efficiency outcomes of the Chinese financial system represent two disparate future paths for the Chinese economy. On the one hand, sustained financial deepening, coupled with relatively low inflation, can propel China to become a global economic powerhouse. On the other hand, inefficient financial intermediation, which generates a high nonperforming loan ratio, augurs a financial crisis that spells the end of the “China Miracle” and ushers in a period of economic and possibly political instability. China’s financial system produces the seeds of both future trajectories.
我们为什么要关心中国的通货膨胀相对较低以及银行业在浪费巨额资金？在重要方面，中国金融体系的通货膨胀和效率结果代表了中国经济的两条截然不同的未来路径。一方面，持续的金融深化，加上相对低的通货膨胀，可以推动中国成为全球经济强国。另一方面，效率低下的金融中介产生高比例的不良贷款，预示着可能终结“奇迹中国”的金融危机，并带来经济甚至政治上的不稳定时期。中国的金融体系同时孕育着这两种未来轨迹的种子。
This chapter first discusses why inflation and efficient allocation of capital are important outcomes for China’s growth trajectories. Second, it empirically compares China’s inflationary and efficiency performance relative to other developing and transition countries. Compared with these countries, China’s low rate of inflation has been impressive, if not stellar. This is puzzling, given the lack of institutional guarantees against political intervention in the financial system. At the same time, the banking system’s efficiency, measured by the nonperforming loan ratio, is among the worst in the world.
本章首先讨论了为什么通货膨胀和资本的有效配置对中国的增长轨迹是重要的结果。其次，通过实证比较了中国在通货膨胀和效率方面相对其他发展中国家和转型国家的表现。与这些国家相比，中国的低通货膨胀率令人印象深刻，虽谈不上出色。在缺乏制度性保障以防政治干预金融体系的情况下，这一点更显令人费解。与此同时，以不良贷款率衡量的银行体系效率却位列世界最差之列。

Inflation, Efficient Intermediation, and Long-Term Growth
通货膨胀、有效中介与长期增长

The two main reasons for thinking that inflation might be harmful to growth are transaction costs and uncertainty. High inflation compels companies to change prices on goods constantly and drives consumers to quickly turn cash into durable goods or precious metals or to deposit money into banks (if banks provide inflation-indexed interest rates). Essentially, these activities waste time, and the economy functions much more efficiently without them (Mankiw 1994). The more damning effect of inflation on the economy is that it creates a sense of uncertainty among investors, which decreases both human and physical capital investment, ultimately lowering a country’s long-term growth trajectory.
认为通货膨胀可能对增长有害的两个主要原因是交易成本和不确定性。高通货膨胀迫使公司不断变更商品价格，并促使消费者迅速将现金转为耐用消费品或贵金属，或将钱存入银行（如果银行提供与通胀挂钩的利率）。本质上，这些活动浪费时间，经济在没有这些活动时运作得更有效率（Mankiw 1994）。通货膨胀对经济更为致命的影响是它在投资者中创造了不确定感，这会减少人力资本和实体资本的投资，最终降低一个国家的长期增长轨迹。
Within this rubric, two main mechanisms work to undermine investor confidence. First, inflation usually implies higher price volatility, which decreases the certainty of return to investors. Second, high inflation rates signal to investors that the government is prone to engage in short-sighted macroeconomic policies to appease its constituencies (Fischer 1993). This implies more price volatility and higher taxes in the future, both of which increase the cost of operating a business.
在这一框架下，有两种主要机制削弱投资者信心。首先，通货膨胀通常意味着更高的价格波动性，这降低了投资者对回报的确定性。其次，高通货膨胀率向投资者发出信号，表明政府倾向于采取短视的宏观经济政策以安抚其选民或利益群体（Fischer 1993）。这意味着未来会有更多的价格波动和更高的税负，这两者都会增加经营成本。
The Philips Curve provides that, in the short run, inflationary financing by the government might decrease unemployment temporarily. Nonetheless, empirical works conducted in the past ten years suggest that the medium- and long-term relationship between inflation and growth is in fact negative. Using lagged inflation and prior colonial status as instruments and controlling for a host of developmental indicators, Barro (1995) finds that inflation lowers both growth and investment, although price volatility does not seem to have an independent effect on growth. This suggests that inflation’s primary damage to the economy stems from the negative signal it sends to current and potential investors rather than from the menu cost. The slightly modified model used by Andres and Hernando (1997) also finds a negative relationship between inflation, on the one hand, and growth and investment in OECD countries, on the other. These findings further confirm the conventional wisdom that price stability constitutes an important ingredient for development (Easterly 2002).
菲利普斯曲线认为，在短期内，政府通过通货膨胀性融资可能会暂时降低失业率。然而，过去十年进行的实证研究表明，通货膨胀与增长之间的中长期关系实际上是负相关的。Barro (1995) 使用滞后通货膨胀率和先前的殖民地身份作为工具变量，并控制一系列发展指标，发现通货膨胀降低了增长和投资，尽管价格波动性似乎对增长没有独立影响。这表明通货膨胀对经济的主要损害来自于它向当前和潜在投资者传递的负面信号，而不是来源于点菜成本（menu cost）。Andres 和 Hernando (1997) 使用的稍作修改的模型也发现在一方面通货膨胀，另一方面在经合组织国家的增长和投资之间存在负相关关系。这些发现进一步证实了常识性观点：价格稳定是发展的重要要素（Easterly 2002）。
If low inflation can be maintained, recent research suggests that the sustained accumulation of financial resources in an economy can bring great benefits to it. Financial deepening, a process whereby financial assets constitute a rising share of the economy, promotes growth through facilitating information exchange and through increasing liquidity to capital intensive firms and to new firms (Beck and Levine 2000; Cetorelli and Gambera 1999; Fisman and Love 2003). The combination of low inflation and financial deepening additionally maintains growth through creating a stable environment in which investors are willing to invest in financial instruments, which contributes to growth (Khan 2002).
如果能够维持低通货膨胀，近来的研究表明，经济中财政资源的持续积累可以为其带来巨大收益。金融深化——即金融资产在经济中所占比重不断上升的过程——通过促进信息交流以及向资本密集型企业和新兴企业提供更多流动性来促进增长（Beck and Levine 2000；Cetorelli and Gambera 1999；Fisman and Love 2003）。低通货膨胀与金融深化的结合还通过创造一个稳定的环境来维持增长，在该环境中投资者愿意投资金融工具，从而促进增长（Khan 2002）。
As with inflation, there is an increasing body of evidence that suggests the importance of a well-functioning banking system in sustaining growth. In a financial system dominated by banks, inefficient allocation of capital often means loans are not made and interest is not charged on the basis of the expected return. I I  ^("I "){ }^{\text {I }} In many developing countries, this comes about either through government control over credit allocation or through interest rate regulation imposed by the government. In the short and medium run, it is debatable whether such intervention leads to dead-weight loss to the economy or the channeling of necessary funds toward development (Haggard, Lee, and Maxfield 1993).
与通货膨胀一样，越来越多的证据表明，运作良好的银行体系对于维持增长具有重要性。在以银行主导的金融体系中，资本配置效率低下往往意味着贷款没有按照预期回报进行发放，且利息并非基于预期回报来收取。 I I  ^("I "){ }^{\text {I }} 在许多发展中国家，这种情况要么是通过政府对信贷分配的控制来实现，要么是通过政府实施的利率管制来造成的。在短期和中期内，这种干预是否会导致经济的无谓损失，抑或会将必要资金引导用于发展，仍存在争议（Haggard, Lee, and Maxfield 1993）。
Over the long run, however, it is inevitable that such distortions in the money market would lead to deterioration in bank asset quality. 2 2 ^(2){ }^{2} In addition to the opportunity cost of not allocating money according to market signals, if banks lend money according to criteria other than expected return, banks would not receive interest payments adequate to cover the high risks they undertake for some of the loans. What is more, government intervention in lending creates serious moral hazard problem as banks, often state-owned entities, come to expect government bailouts in the event of financial trouble. This leads to more reckless lending and further deterioration of asset quality, lowering bank profitability and liquidity (Bisignano 1999).
但从长期看，货币市场中这种扭曲不可避免地会导致银行资产质量恶化。除了未能按市场信号配置资金的机会成本之外，如果银行根据除预期收益以外的标准发放贷款，银行将无法从部分高风险贷款中获得足以弥补其承担风险的利息收入。更重要的是，政府对放贷的干预会产生严重的道德风险问题：银行（通常是国有实体）会逐渐预期在发生金融困境时获得政府救助。这会导致更鲁莽的放贷和资产质量的进一步恶化，进而降低银行的盈利能力和流动性（Bisignano 1999）。
Sooner or later, a steady deterioration in bank asset quality leads to a banking crisis, defined as “…significant segments of the banking system [becoming] illiquid or insolvent” (Demirguc-Kunt, Detragiache, and Gupta 2000). 3 3 ^(3){ }^{3} In essence, when a bank’s creditors, including depositors and bond holders, demand more cash from the bank than that which the bank can provide, the bank is illiquid. When illiquidity occurs to a large proportion of banks in a financial system, the system faces a banking crisis. In such a crisis, banks no longer have enough liquidity to lend to needy businesses or must lend at a high interest rate. Depositors might have their deposits frozen, which lowers consumption. Furthermore, the government might have to issue bonds or raise taxes to bail out illiquid banks, both of which discourage future investment. Finally, a desperate government might resort to printing money to provide liquidity, which raises inflationary pressure. In sum, there are multiple mechanisms by which a banking crisis can adversely affect growth.
迟早，银行资产质量的持续恶化会导致银行危机，定义为“…银行系统的重要部分[变得]无流动性或无偿付能力”（Demirguc-Kunt、Detragiache 和 Gupta 2000）。本质上，当银行的债权人，包括存款人和债券持有人，向银行要求的现金超过银行能够提供的金额时，该银行即无流动性。当金融体系中相当大比例的银行出现无流动性时，体系就面临银行危机。在这种危机中，银行不再有足够的流动性向有需要的企业放贷，或不得不以高利率放贷。存款可能被冻结，从而降低消费。此外，政府可能不得不发行债券或提高税收来救助无流动性的银行，这两者都会抑制未来的投资。最后，绝望的政府可能诉诸印钞以提供流动性，这会提高通胀压力。总之，银行危机通过多种机制对增长产生不利影响。
An emerging empirical literature shows that banking crises are in fact associated with and partially responsible for significant negative shocks to the economy. According to Hutchison and McDill (1999), the average output loss during sixty-one episodes of banking crises in the past twenty years is 7.3 percent of GDP. Although growth after a banking crisis tends to recover within three years (Demirguc-Kunt, Detragiache, and Gupta 2000), some countries, the most prominent of which was Japan, became trapped in decade-long recessions during which scarcity of bank credit and low growth reinforced each other (Hutchison and McDill 1999). Data on recent crises also indicate that they cause prolonged contractions in available credit to the private sector and a higher inflation rate, especially in countries where banks play an important role in the economy (Demirguc-Kunt, Detragiache, and Gupta 2000).
新兴的实证文献显示，银行危机实际上与经济遭受重大负面冲击有关，且在一定程度上是其成因之一。根据 Hutchison 和 McDill (1999) 的研究，在过去二十年中发生的六十一次银行危机事件中，平均产出损失为 GDP 的 7.3%。尽管银行危机后的增长通常在三年内恢复（Demirguc-Kunt、Detragiache 和 Gupta 2000），但一些国家——最显著的是日本——陷入了长达数十年的衰退，在此期间银行信贷短缺与低增长相互强化（Hutchison 和 McDill 1999）。关于近期危机的数据也表明，它们会导致可供私营部门使用的信贷长期收缩并伴随更高的通货膨胀率，尤其是在银行在经济中发挥重要作用的国家（Demirguc-Kunt、Detragiache 和 Gupta 2000）。
In the medium and long run, banking crises can prompt reform and more efficient practice by banks. Thus, banking crises per se are not necessarily harmful to the economy in the long run. Nonetheless, the longer one delays reform, which often triggers a crisis, the more severe the crisis is likely to be (Allen and Gale 2001). Delayed reform often translates into a larger bailout when a crisis occurs, which causes a more severe contraction in credit and a higher bailout cost as a percentage of GDP. Again, Japan’s prolonged recession amply illustrates this point. More ominously, as demonstrated by the tragic case of Indonesia, the negative economic shock caused originally by a severe financial collapse can degenerate into political instability and, ultimately, widespread political violence.
在中长期内，银行危机可以促使改革并推动银行采取更高效的做法。因此，银行危机本身在长期内不一定对经济有害。然而，改革拖延得越久（改革往往在危机中被触发），危机可能越严重（Allen 和 Gale 2001）。改革推迟常常意味着危机发生时的救助规模更大，从而导致信贷收缩更严重、救助成本占 GDP 的比重更高。同样，日本长期衰退充分说明了这一点。更为不祥的是，正如印度尼西亚这一悲剧性案例所示，最初由严重金融崩溃引发的负面经济冲击可能进一步恶化为政治不稳定，最终导致广泛的政治暴力。

Inflationary Cycles and Bank Loan Allocation in Comparative Perspective
通胀周期与银行贷款配置的比较视角

Compared with much of the developing world and postsocialist states, China’s growth and inflation record has been stellar. As a result, the investment community expects China to overtake the United States as the biggest destination of FDI (O’Neill 2002). At the same time, China continues to have among the highest level of nonperforming loans as a percentage of GDP. Although the investment community is now paying little heed to the latter phenomenon, both sets of indicators will have an impact on the future growth trajectory of China.
与大部分发展中国家和后社会主义国家相比，中国的增长和通货膨胀记录一直非常出色。因此，投资界预计中国将取代美国成为最大的外国直接投资目的地（O’Neill 2002）。与此同时，中国的不良贷款占国内生产总值的比重仍处于较高水平。尽管投资界目前对后者现象关注较少，但这两组指标都将影响中国未来的增长轨迹。

Inflation  通货膨胀

Throughout much of the Mao period, China experienced virtually no overt inflation because prices were administratively set by the State Planning Commission. The one exception occurred during the Great Leap Forward (19581961), when the devolution of monetary authority was accompanied by a sharp drop in output. The resulting inflation reached 16 percent. In contrast, China witnessed five inflationary cycles during the reform era (1978-present), each, except for the most recent one, more severe than the previous one. Nonetheless, as Figure 2.1 shows, inflation, measured in consumer price index (CPI), has been kept under 30 percent.
在大部分毛泽东时期，中国几乎没有出现公开的通货膨胀，因为价格由国家计划委员会实行行政定价。唯一的例外发生在大跃进时期（1958–1961），当时货币权力下放并伴随产出急剧下降，导致的通货膨胀达到 16%。相比之下，改革时代（1978 年至今）中国经历了五个通货膨胀周期，除最新一次外，每一次都比前一次更严重。然而，正如图 2.1 所示，以居民消费价格指数（CPI）衡量的通货膨胀一直控制在 30%以下。
The first inflationary cycle, which began in the late 1970s, generated inflation upward of 10 percent. The second inflationary cycle reached around 15 percent of inflation before descending. The middle two inflationary cycles, in the late 1980s and the mid-1990s, respectively, both reached nearly the 30 percent level. Finally, the most recent inflation cycle, which began in 2002, only generated inflation rate around 7 percent, although the rate of monetary expansion was similar to previous inflationary cycles. The pattern of these inflationary cycles suggests a strong impetus in the financial system to increase inflationary pressure. When inflation rose, it did so rapidly within a matter of one or two quarters. At the same time, there also was the political will to suppress inflation fairly quickly, usually within three quarters. Inflation inertia - current
第一次通货膨胀周期始于 20 世纪 70 年代末，通货膨胀率超过 10%。第二次通货膨胀周期达到约 15%的通货膨胀率后回落。中间的两个通货膨胀周期，分别在 20 世纪 80 年代末和 90 年代中期，均接近 30%的水平。最后，最近一次始于 2002 年的通货膨胀周期只产生了约 7%的通货膨胀率，尽管货币扩张速度与以往通货膨胀周期相似。这些通货膨胀周期的模式表明金融体系存在强烈的推动力使通胀压力上升。当通货膨胀上升时，通常在一到两个季度内迅速发生。与此同时，政治上也有相当快地抑制通货膨胀的意愿，通常在三个季度内实现。通货膨胀惯性——当前
Figure 3: figure 2.1. Inflationary Cycles in Reform China, 1980-2006 (Quarterly, CPI). Note: Quarterly Database. See Appendix for details.
图 3：图 2.1。改革中国的通货膨胀周期，1980–2006（季度，CPI）。注：季度数据库。详见附录。
inflation causing even more severe inflation in a subsequent period - does not seem to be a problem in China (Fischer, Sahay, and Vegh 2002).
导致随后时期通货膨胀更为严重的通货膨胀——在中国似乎并不是问题（Fischer, Sahay, and Vegh 2002）。
Relative to other developing countries, China’s inflationary record has been impressive. Although China’s inflation has been more volatile than some of its more developed Asian neighbors, its inflation remained well below the disastrous record of Latin America and the former Soviet transition states. Russia, Ukraine, and Kazakhstan all experienced sustained inflation of over ɪ,ooo percent, with Ukrainian inflation reaching as high as 3,500 percent in 1993 (World Bank 2001). In terms of severity, Chinese inflation was similar to that in Eastern European countries. In those countries, however, the inflation rate was much less volatile than that experienced by China. In Hungary, for example, the inflation rate hovered around the 20 percent range for much of the 90 s , whereas Chinese inflation fluctuated between -3 percent and 3 ∘ 3 ∘ 3@3 \circ percent (World Bank 2001).
与其他发展中国家相比，中国的通货膨胀记录令人印象深刻。尽管中国的通货膨胀波动性比一些较为发达的亚洲邻国更大，但其通货膨胀率仍远低于拉丁美洲和前苏联过渡国家的灾难性纪录。俄罗斯、乌克兰和哈萨克斯坦的通货膨胀均持续超过 1,000%，乌克兰在 1993 年通货膨胀甚至高达 3,500%（世界银行 2001）。从严重程度看，中国的通货膨胀与东欧国家相似。然而在那些国家，通货膨胀率的波动远小于中国。以匈牙利为例，通货膨胀率在 90 年代的大部分时间里徘徊在 20%左右，而中国的通货膨胀则在-3%到 3 ∘ 3 ∘ 3@3 \circ %之间波动（世界银行 2001）。
Relative to other major Asian economies, China’s inflationary record also has been more volatile. From the 1980s to the 1990s, the inflation rates in Japan, Korea, and Singapore all generally remained below 10 percent, with minor fluctuations. Hong Kong’s inflationary record was slightly more volatile, partially as a result of influence from China. Nonetheless, its inflation rates remained well below 15 percent even when Chinese inflation reached the 20 percent range. Given that China has a state dominated financial system, inflation volatility suggests that the political impetus for both the expansion and contraction of money supply exists.
与其他主要亚洲经济体相比，中国的通货膨胀记录也更具波动性。从 20 世纪 80 年代到 90 年代，日本、韩国和新加坡的通货膨胀率总体上都保持在 10%以下，波动较小。香港的通货膨胀记录则略显波动，部分原因是受中国的影响。尽管如此，即便在中国的通货膨胀率达到 20%范围时，香港的通胀率仍远低于 15%。鉴于中国拥有以国家为主导的金融体系，通胀波动性表明推动货币供给扩张和收缩的政治动力是存在的。

Despite such volatility, accelerating inflation was suppressed quickly in China time and again. China’s ability to suppress inflation finds expression in the relatively short duration of high inflationary episodes, defined as an annualized inflation rate of over 25 percent (Fischer, Sahay, and Vegh 2002).
尽管存在这种波动性，中国一次又一次地迅速遏制了加速的通货膨胀。中国抑制通货膨胀的能力体现在高通胀时期持续时间相对较短，这里将年化通胀率超过 25%的时期定义为高通胀期（Fischer, Sahay, and Vegh 2002）。
As seen in Table 2.1, although Chinese inflation rose above the dangerous threshold of 25 percent twice, high inflation was much more quickly suppressed than in other developing and transition countries that experienced high inflation. On average, high inflationary episodes in China were over thirty months shorter than similar episodes in market economies between the 1960s and the ɪ990s and forty-nine months shorter than similar episodes among postcommunist countries. Brazil, for example, had inflation above 100 percent from at least 1981 to 1996, whereas Russia experienced high and hyperinflation from 1991 to 1996 and again in 1999.
如表 2.1 所示，尽管中国的通胀两次超过危险阈值 25%，但高通胀被遏制得比其他经历高通胀的发展中国家和转型国家要快得多。总体而言，中国的高通胀时期比 20 世纪 60 年代至 90 年代市场经济体的类似时期平均短三十多个月，比后共产主义国家的类似时期短四十九个月。例如，巴西的通胀率至少从 1981 年持续在 100%以上直至 1996 年，而俄罗斯则在 1991 年至 1996 年以及 1999 年经历了高通胀和恶性通胀。
The truly remarkable aspect of China’s financial development is that it managed to maintain relatively stable monetary environment amid rapid financial deepening. In 1978, financial asset as a share of the economy stood roughly at 50 percent. By the end of 2004, total bank loans stood roughly at 140 percent of GDP, whereas M 2 M 2 M_(2)\mathrm{M}_{2} broad money was 185 percent of GDP (PBOC Monetary Policy Analysis Team 2005). This high level of financial deepening is not seen in other developing countries. Most developing countries at China’s stage of development have a financial asset-GDP ratio of between 30 to 60 percent, except for Japan in the 60s (Ghatak 1995). However, Japan in the 1960s was already much more developed on a per capita basis than China is today. Clearly, Chinese firms have much better access to liquidity, but the question is whether this liquidity is allocated in an efficient way.
中国金融发展真正值得注意的一点是，在金融快速深化的同时，仍然保持了相对稳定的货币环境。1978 年，金融资产占经济的比重约为 50%。到 2004 年底，银行贷款总额约为 GDP 的 140%，而 M 2 M 2 M_(2)\mathrm{M}_{2} 广义货币为 GDP 的 185%（PBOC Monetary Policy Analysis Team 2005）。这一高水平的金融深化在其他发展中国家并不常见。在中国所处的发展阶段，大多数发展中国家的金融资产占 GDP 比率在 30%到 60%之间，60 年代的日本是个例外（Ghatak 1995）。然而，1960 年代的日本在人均水平上显著领先于今天的中国。显然，中国企业获得流动性的能力要强得多，但问题在于这些流动性是否被以高效的方式分配。

Nonperforming Loans and Inefficiency
不良贷款与低效率

Despite the relatively healthy performance in terms of inflation, the efficiency of the banking system is evidently very low, as China has one of the sickest banking systems in the world. Although the incomplete availability of data makes rigorous comparisons difficult, several indicators suggest that the Chinese banking sector was in much worse shape than many of its Asian neighbors even at the height of the Asian Financial Crisis, when asset prices in many of these economies collapsed.
尽管在通货膨胀方面表现相对健康，但银行系统的效率显然非常低下，中国拥有世界上最糟糕的银行系统之一。尽管数据不完整使得严格比较变得困难，但若干指标表明，即使在亚洲金融危机的高峰期（当时许多这些经济体的资产价格崩溃），中国的银行业状况也比许多亚洲邻国差得多。

As can be seen in Table 2.2, even semiofficial nonperforming loan (NPL) figures reported by a Chinese government researcher indicate that the NPL ratio in China was much higher than many of its Asian neighbors throughout the ɪ990s. The official NPL ratio rose steadily throughout the decade despite several rounds of supposed banking reform. After the Asian Financial Crisis, banks in some Asian countries got into even more trouble as asset prices collapsed, but, officially, China was still doing the worst in 2001. According to unofficial figures calculated by private consulting firms, shown in Table 2.2, only Indonesia might have performed worse than China in terms of NPL ratio after the financial crisis.
如表 2.2 所示，即使是由中国政府研究人员报告的半官方不良贷款（NPL）数据也表明，整个 1990 年代中国的不良贷款率远高于许多亚洲邻国。官方不良贷款率在整个十年中稳步上升，尽管进行了若干轮所谓的银行改革。亚洲金融危机后，随着资产价格崩溃，一些亚洲国家的银行陷入了更严重的困境，但官方数据显示，到 2001 年中国的情况仍是最糟糕的。根据私人咨询公司计算的非官方数据（见表 2.2），在金融危机后，只有印度尼西亚在不良贷款率方面可能比中国表现更差。
What is perhaps more important is NPLs as a percentage of GDP because it gives an indication of the cost of fixing the banking sector to the economy. In this regard, independent private sector estimates shown in Figure 2.2 paint a bleak picture of China. Although the NPL ratio in Indonesia in 2001 was at an astounding 65 percent, NPLs as a percentage of GDP stood at a mere io to I 5 percent, suggesting a relatively manageable banking problem. In contrast, because loans outstanding in China have exceeded GDP since the mid-r990s, a 40 − 45 40 − 45 40-4540-45 percent in NPL ratio translated to an astounding 44-55 percent of the GDP in 2001. Again, this indicates that the cost of making the banking sector solvent in China is likely to require an enormous bailout. Although the government devised various schemes to write off the bad debt over an extended time period, it nonetheless translated to significant losses in terms of foregone growth (see Chapter 8). Moreover, despite government injections totaling at least U.S. $ 322 $ 322 $322\$ 322 billion to fix the problem, official NPLs as a share of GDP during the third quarter of 2005 remain dangerously at nearly 50 percent. 4 4 ^(4){ }^{4}
更重要的是，作为占 GDP 比重的坏账（NPLs），因为它表明了修复银行业对经济的成本。在这方面，图 2.2 中所示的独立私营部门估算描绘了一个对中国不利的局面。尽管印度尼西亚在 2001 年的不良贷款率高达惊人的 65%，但不良贷款占 GDP 比重仅为约 10%到 15%，这表明其银行问题在相对可控的范围内。相比之下，由于自 20 世纪 90 年代中期以来中国的未偿贷款已超过国内生产总值，若不良贷款率为 40 − 45 40 − 45 40-4540-45 %，则在 2001 年相当于占 GDP 的惊人 44%–55%。同样，这表明使中国银行业恢复偿付能力的成本很可能需要一笔巨额救助。尽管政府设计了各种方案在较长时间内冲销坏账，但这仍然在增长损失方面转化为重大损失（见第 8 章）。此外，尽管政府为解决该问题至少注入了总计美 $ 322 $ 322 $322\$ 322 亿美元的资金，但截至 2005 年第三季度，官方不良贷款占 GDP 的比重仍危险地接近 50%。 4 4 ^(4){ }^{4}
Figure 4: figure 2.2. Estimated Range of NPLs as a Percentage of GDP in 2001. Note: Data from (Berger, Nast, and Raubach 2002).
图 4：图 2.2. 2001 年不良贷款占 GDP 比例的估计范围。注：数据来自 (Berger, Nast, and Raubach 2002)。
In addition to the high NPL ratio, another indicator of inefficient capital allocation is China’s artificially low interest rates through substantial lengths of time in the reform period. According to financial repression theory, governments in developing countries fix interest rates at an artificially low level and channel cheap capital toward state objectives, which gives rise to the nonmarket allocation of capital (Demetriades and Luintel 1997). Although complete statistics on black market interest rates are unavailable for China, which precludes direct calculation of the level of “repression,” sustained periods of negative real interest rates strongly suggest severe financial repression. Since the reform, China saw twenty-eight quarters of negative real interest rates, something that would not have occurred in a fully functioning financial market. As one PBOC veteran admits, negative real interest rates were maintained because the Chinese government wanted to reduce explicit deficit by providing cheap capital to SOEs, grain procurement, and state construction projects (Dai 2002a).
除了高不良贷款率外，另一个资本配置低效的指标是在改革时期中国长期人为压低的利率。根据金融压抑理论，发展中国家的政府将利率固定在人为偏低的水平，并将廉价资本引导到国家目标，从而产生非市场的资本配置（Demetriades and Luintel 1997）。尽管中国的黑市利率完整统计不可得，无法直接计算“压抑”的程度，但持续的实际利率为负的时期强烈表明存在严重的金融压抑。自改革以来，中国出现了二十八个季度的实际利率为负，这在一个完全运作的金融市场中本不应发生。正如一位中国人民银行资深人士所承认的，实际利率为负是因为中国政府希望通过向国有企业、粮食征购和国家建设项目提供廉价资本来减少显性财政赤字（Dai 2002a）。
Although incidents of negative interest rates essentially mirrored inflationary episodes shown in Figure 2.1, there is no evidence to suggest that capital allocation by state banks was more efficient when inflation rate was low. In fact, negative interest rates increased the incentive for private entrepreneurs to form informal financial institutions to absorb deposits, which may have increased the efficiency of overall capital allocation during high inflationary episodes. The persistent climb in the NPL ratio, seen in Table 2.2, also implies continuous state intervention in capital allocation regardless of the real interest rates. The negative interest rates merely demonstrate the state’s willingness to maintain low interest rates even when the opportunity cost of doing so dramatically rose.
尽管负利率的发生在本质上与图 2.1 所示的通货膨胀时期相呼应，但没有证据表明当通货膨胀率较低时，国有银行的资本配置更有效。事实上，负利率增加了民营企业家设立非正式金融机构以吸收存款的动机，这可能在高通胀时期提高了整体资本配置的效率。表 2.2 中所见的不良贷款率持续上升也意味着无论实际利率如何，国家在资本配置上持续干预。负利率只是表明即便维持低利率的机会成本显著上升，国家仍愿意维持低利率。
China is unique as perhaps the only developing country that sustained this extraordinary level of NPLs and inefficiency without triggering a financial panic. The primary reason for continual stability in the face of insolvency is
中国可能是唯一一个在不引发金融恐慌的情况下长期维持如此高不良贷款率和低效率的发展中国家。这种在资不抵债面前持续保持稳定的主要原因是
China’s enormous foreign exchange reserve, combined with the lack of capital mobility. By the spring of 2007, China held U.S.$1.2 trillion in the foreign exchange reserve, giving it the highest reserve in the world. This has greatly assured both domestic and foreign investors of the solvency of the Chinese financial system. Moreover, despite a thriving underground money-changing and smuggling industry, the cost of smuggling large sums of money out of China remains relatively high and beyond the reach of most ordinary depositors. Even as foreign banks expand their operation in China, they remain highly constrained by regulations that restrict the transfer of funds out of China.
中国庞大的外汇储备，加上资本流动性的缺乏。截至 2007 年春，中国持有 1.2 万亿美元的外汇储备，居世界首位。这极大地向国内外投资者保证了中国金融体系的偿付能力。此外，尽管地下钱庄和走私业蓬勃发展，将大量资金走出中国的成本仍然相对较高，普通储户难以承担。即便外国银行在中国扩大业务，它们仍然受到限制资金转移出中国的监管性法规的严重制约。
Without the threat of capital flight, the Chinese government can resort to authoritarian tactics to prevent a domestic banking panic. The state was successful in containing several local runs on the banks, which occurred in Zhengzhou in 1999, in Lu’an County right next to Beijing in 2000, and in the Kaiping District of Guangdong Province in 2001 (Chang 2001; Lague 2002). These panics were by no means minor affairs. In the Kaiping case alone, some 900 million yuan, or over U.S.$ ɪoo million, was withdrawn in one day from a single branch bank. In each case, rumors of corruption at a local state bank branch triggered a bank run that threatened to spread across the country.
在没有资本外逃威胁的情况下，中国政府可以诉诸威权手段来防止国内银行恐慌。国家成功遏制了几次局部银行挤兑，这些挤兑发生在 1999 年的郑州、靠近北京的六安市（Lu’an County）2000 年，以及广东省开平地区（Kaiping District）2001 年（Chang 2001；Lague 2002）。这些恐慌绝非小事。仅在开平一例，就有约 9 亿元人民币，或超过 1 亿美元，在一天内从同一家支行被提取。在每一起事件中，对地方国有银行支行腐败的传言都引发了可能扩散到全国的挤兑。
Nonetheless, because of its strict control over the banking sector, the police, and the media, the regime quickly quelled panic by shipping trainloads of cash to the trouble spots and by imposing a media blackout on the incidents. The regime’s continual presence in the financial sector also assured depositors of its resolve to provide sufficient liquidity to the banking system. As Allen and Gale (2001) point out, however, it is difficult to predict the precise event that would trigger a financial collapse. This is especially the case in China, because a host of economic and political shocks can undermine people’s confidence in the regime and hence in the banking sector.
尽管如此，由于对银行业、公安和媒体的严格控制，政权迅速通过向事发地区运送整车现金并对相关事件实施媒体封锁来平息恐慌。政权在金融部门的持续存在也让储户相信其有决心为银行体系提供足够的流动性。然而，正如 Allen 和 Gale（2001）指出的，要准确预测会触发金融崩溃的具体事件是困难的。在中国尤其如此，因为各种经济和政治冲击都可能削弱公众对政权乃至对银行业的信心。

Implications  含义

If one takes into account growth, inflation, and banking sector solvency, one can see elements of the China “Miracle,” as well as seeds of a future financial crisis. On the one hand, China has managed to grow at a healthy clip while keeping inflation in check. On those indicators alone, foreign investors are right in choosing China as their favorite investment destination. Yet China’s banks have long since exceeded the bounds of solvency. Even if Chinese banks adopt international best practice today, the current level of NPL will take a long time to completely digest. Unfortunately, the political economy that governs China’s banking sector is far from ready to follow international best practice. Although factional politics in China produced an internal political check on high inflation, the same factional dynamics also provided scant incentive for political leaders in China to introduce fundamental reform in China’s banks.
如果把增长、通货膨胀和银行业偿付能力都考虑在内，就可以看到中国“奇迹”的要素，也能看到未来金融危机的种子。一方面，中国在保持通货膨胀控制的同时实现了较为健康的增长。仅就这些指标而言，外国投资者选择中国作为他们最喜欢的投资目的地是有道理的。然而，中国的银行早已超出了偿付能力的界限。即便中国银行今天采纳国际最佳实践，目前的不良贷款水平也需要很长时间才能完全消化。不幸的是，支配中国银行业的政治经济远未准备好遵循国际最佳实践。尽管中国的派系政治在遏制高通胀方面产生了内部政治制衡，但相同的派系动态也几乎没有为中国的政治领导人推动银行业的根本性改革提供激励。

The Banking System: Flexible Institutions and Party Domination
银行体系：灵活的制度与党的主导

Throughout the nearly three decades of reform, the Chinese banking sector has evolved from an appendage of the Ministry of Finance to a sprawling bureaucracy with specialized roles and an increasingly diversified ownership structure. It also has become a central aspect of China’s economy as total lending climbed well over China’s GDP. As a result of its immense size, the banking sector is also the key to understanding China’s inflation and financial efficiency performance. To the extent that money supply affected inflationary expectation, the speed with which the banking system created money has played a major role in inflationary outcomes. At the same time, the banking sector is still the predominant channel for financing investment in China, making it the key to understanding the efficiency of capital allocation.
在近三十年的改革过程中，中国的银行业已从财政部的一个附属机构发展为一个职责分工明确、所有制结构日益多元化的庞大官僚体系。随着信贷总量大幅超过国内生产总值，它也成为中国经济的核心组成部分。由于规模巨大，银行业也是理解中国通货膨胀和金融效率表现的关键。若货币供应影响通货膨胀预期，那么银行体系创造货币的速度就在通货膨胀结果中发挥了重要作用。与此同时，银行业仍然是中国投资融资的主要渠道，因此也是理解资本配置效率的关键。
Undeniably, the enormously complex set of institutions governing China’s banking sector has affected both monetary expansion and the allocation of capital. Nonetheless, the waves of institutional changes in the reform era have not had a significant, independent impact on our dependent variables: inflation and the efficiency of capital allocation. As this chapter demonstrates, institutional changes often followed shifts in political signals. In other instances, institutional changes, although designed to achieve monetary and distributive outcomes, ultimately had little impact on them. Rather than being an independent causal agent, changes in banking institutions were crucial steps in the causal chain that led from elite political shifts to fluctuations in the dependent variables.
不可否认，治理中国银行业的那套极其复杂的制度体系既影响了货币扩张，也影响了资本配置。然而，改革时期一系列制度变迁并未对我们的因变量产生显著的独立影响：通货膨胀和资本配置效率。正如本章所展示的，制度变化常常是跟随政治信号的转变而发生。在其他情况下，尽管制度变革旨在实现货币和分配方面的目标，但最终对这些目标影响甚微。银行制度的变化并非独立的因果因素，而是在从精英政治转变到因变量波动的因果链中至关重要的环节。
The complexity of China’s banking institutions allowed the political elite to mobilize them toward disparate political purposes. When the Party center urged high-speed growth, local governments and firms blackmailed the state banks for more funds, and the state banks, in turn, forced the central bank to expand the money supply. However, when the Party center signaled its resolve to suppress monetary expansion, the People’s Bank of China - China’s central bank mobilized its impressive organization and monitoring capacity to enforce the
中国银行机构的复杂性使政治精英能够将其动员用于不同的政治目的。当党中心敦促高速增长时，地方政府和企业便以国家银行为胁迫，索取更多资金；国家银行又反过来迫使中央银行扩张货币供应。然而，当党中心发出抑制货币扩张的决心信号时，人民银行——中国的中央银行动员其强大的组织与监测能力来执行这一政策。
loan ceiling, quelling inflationary expectation. Ultimately, the most significant feature of the Chinese banking system was the pervasive influence of the Chinese Communist Party, which induced a high sensitivity among bankers to political signals from the top.
贷款上限，抑制通胀预期。最终，中国银行体系最显著的特征是中国共产党无处不在的影响力，这使得银行家对来自高层的政治信号高度敏感。

General Characteristics  一般特征

Throughout much of the Mao era (1949-1976), the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) served as the primary financial intermediary in China. It mainly absorbed deposits from residents, state-owned enterprises (SOEs), and government units and provided short-term working capital loans to SOEs (Miyashita 1966: 190-200). In 1977, the central government began to use banks more actively as a policy tool for economic growth. This generated two changes in the banking sector. First, rather than merely providing small working capital loans to SOEs, the central government demanded banks to lend more and to support long-term fixed asset investment for SOEs and other government investment projects (Yi 1994). The process of “fiscalizing” the banking sector was by no means uncontroversial and is the subject of Chapter 6. Second, the fiscalization of the banking system led to the rapid growth of financial assets, especially bank loans, in subsequent decades.
在毛泽东时代的大部分时期（1949–1976），中国人民银行（PBOC）是中国的主要金融中介。它主要吸收居民、国有企业（SOEs）和政府单位的存款，并向国有企业提供短期周转资金贷款（Miyashita 1966: 190-200）。1977 年，中央政府开始更积极地将银行作为促进经济增长的政策工具。这在银行业引发了两方面的变化。首先，中央政府不再仅仅要求银行向国有企业提供小额周转贷款，而是要求银行加大放贷力度，支持国有企业和其他政府投资项目的长期固定资产投资（Yi 1994）。将银行部门“财政化”的过程并非没有争议，这也是第 6 章的讨论内容。其次，银行体系的财政化导致随后的几十年里金融资产，尤其是银行贷款，迅速增长。
Despite the recent changes and reforms, the institutional course that the Chinese banking sector took in the early 1980s continues to influence the banking structure today. In 1979, the Agricultural Bank of China (ABC) was reconstituted to handle government financing of grain procurement and rural development. In the same year, the Bank of China (BOC) broke off from the PBOC and took over the foreign currency portfolio. In 1984, the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) separated from the PBOC and financed China’s state-owned enterprises (SOEs). At the same time, the China Construction Bank (CCB), which had been an arm of the Ministry of Finance, gained operational independence and continued providing loans to long-term state investment projects. Thus, the Big Four state banks, which dominate the banking sector even today, were born.
尽管近年来有所变革和改革，上世纪 80 年代初中国银行业所走的制度化道路仍然影响着今天的银行结构。1979 年，中国农业银行（ABC）重组，负责政府对粮食收购和农村发展的融资。同年，中国银行（BOC）从中国人民银行（PBOC）分离，接管了外汇组合。1984 年，中国工商银行（ICBC）从中国人民银行分立，承担对中国国有企业（SOEs）的融资。与此同时，原隶属于财政部的中国建设银行（CCB）获得了经营独立性，继续为长期国家投资项目提供贷款。因此，至今仍主导银行业的四大国有银行就此诞生。
The birth of the Big Four also coincided with two important trends. First, because the government decided to use the banking sector to finance much of the economic reform, banks came to dominate the Chinese financial market. The enormity of the Chinese banking sector gave politicians an almost unlimited supply of money to distribute for political purposes. At the same time, the Big Four banks were required to lend to most of the projects in their respective policy areas, which meant they bore the bulk of the burden in policy loans and loans to the state sector (Lardy 1998). Whereas fiscal expenditure totaled 2.2 trillion yuan in 2002, the state banking system lent over 9 trillion yuan in the same period, most of which to the state sector (National Bureau of Statistics 2004).
四大行的诞生也与两个重要趋势同时出现。首先，由于政府决定利用银行部门为大部分经济改革提供资金，银行开始主导中国的金融市场。中国银行业的庞大规模使政治人物几乎拥有无限的资金可用于政治分配。与此同时，四大行被要求向各自政策领域的大多数项目放贷，这意味着它们承担了政策性贷款和对国有部门贷款的主要负担（Lardy 1998）。而在 2002 年财政支出总额为 2.2 万亿元的同时，国家银行体系在同一时期发放了超过 9 万亿元的贷款，其中大部分流向了国有部门（国家统计局 2004）。
The vital role of the Big Four in economic development allowed their assets and deposits to balloon along with China’s economic growth. Most enterprises
四大行在经济发展中的重要作用使其资产和存款随着中国经济的增长一起膨胀。大多数企业
and individuals had no choice but to deposit their savings into the Big Four banks. In return, the Big Four banks were obligated to lend to enterprises within their policy jurisdiction according to state policies and political demands. This trend continues today, with the Big Four and the policy banks still holding well over 60 percent of China’s 44 trillion yuan (U.S.$5.6 trillion) in bank assets. I I  ^("I "){ }^{\text {I }} As Figure 3.I shows the share of state bank lending and deposits stabilized at around 80 percent throughout the 1990s. In fact, their presence increased between 1995 and 1999 with a 3 percent gain in the share of total bank deposits to 74 percent (see Figure 3.1). In 2001, state bank share of the market dropped significantly because of the reclassification of CITIC Bank and the Bank of Communication from the category of “state bank” to “jointstock bank,” but these two banks were in reality still controlled by the government. After this reclassification, state bank share of the market remained in the 60 percent range. In 1994, three policy banks, the State Development Bank, the Agricultural Development Bank, and the Export-Import Bank, were formed to take over the policy portfolios of the Big Four banks, in theory leaving them to make commercial loans. However, political incentives for Big Four bank managers and weak institutional capacity of these new policy banks required the Big Four banks to continue their involvement in policy tasks.
个人别无选择，只能将储蓄存入国有四大行。作为回报，四大行必须按照国家政策和政治要求在其政策管辖范围内向企业放贷。这一趋势延续至今，四大行和政策性银行仍然掌控着中国约 44 万亿元人民币（5.6 万亿美元）银行资产的 60%以上。 I I  ^("I "){ }^{\text {I }} 如图 3.1 所示，国有银行的贷款和存款份额在整个 1990 年代稳定在约 80%。事实上，1995 年至 1999 年间它们的存在有所增强，银行总存款份额增加 3 个百分点至 74%（见图 3.1）。2001 年，由于中信银行和交通银行从“国有银行”类别重新归类为“股份制银行”，国有银行的市场份额显著下降，但这两家银行实际上仍受政府控制。在此次重新归类之后，国有银行的市场份额保持在 60%范围内。 1994 年，三家政策性银行——国家开发银行、农业发展银行和进出口银行——成立，理论上接手四大行的政策性投资组合，使四大行专注于商业贷款。然而，四大行行长的政治激励以及这些新政策性银行薄弱的制度能力要求四大行继续参与政策性任务。

Controlling Money Supply
控制货币供应

Despite the establishment of institutions that resemble those seen in a Western banking system, administrative decrees rather than monetary instruments such as reserve requirements, interest rate adjustments, and open market operations still played the dominant role in controlling the money supply. The pervasiveness of administrative decrees is symptomatic of the lack of institutional credibility for controlling the money supply. The lack of institutional credibility also meant that the waves of institutional changes in money supply control mechanisms have not significantly affected the trajectories of the various inflationary cycles.
尽管建立了类似西方银行体系的机构，但在控制货币供应方面，行政法令仍然比准备金要求、利率调整和公开市场操作等货币工具起主导作用。行政法令的普遍性反映了在控制货币供应方面制度可信度的缺失。制度可信度的缺乏也意味着货币供应控制机制发生的多次制度性变革，并未显著改变各轮通货膨胀周期的轨迹。
China emerged from the Mao era with a strict system of money control in which PBOC headquarters issued nonnegotiable loan ceilings to the regional branches and channeled most loans only to recipients approved by the State Planning Commission (Miyashita 1966). In the early 1980s, the communist leadership decided to use the banking sector much more actively to finance local development. This policy was formalized when the PBOC issued “A Notice on the Method of Controlling Loan-to-Deposit Difference” (Xindai Cha’e Kongzhi Banfa), which gave local PBOC branches, especially those at the provincial
中国在毛时代结束后保留了一套严格的货币控制体系，PBOC 总部向各地区分行下达不可转让的贷款上限，并且将大部分贷款只发放给经国家计划委员会批准的受贷方（Miyashita 1966）。在 20 世纪 80 年代初，共产党领导层决定更积极地利用银行业为地方发展提供融资。这一政策在 PBOC 发布的《关于控制存贷差办法（Xindai Cha’e Kongzhi Banfa）》时被正式确立，该办法赋予地方 PBOC 分行，特别是省级分行，在各自的信贷配额中为不同地方发展项目分配部分资金的权限（Xie et al. 2001: 7）。
Figure 5: figure 3.r. The Share of State Bank Deposits and Lending: 1990-2004. Note: Figures are state bank lending and deposits as a share of total lending and deposits. Data from Annual Database. See Appendix for details.
图 5：图 3.r。国有银行存款与贷款份额：1990-2004。注：数字为国有银行贷款和存款占全部贷款和存款的比例。数据来自年度数据库。细节见附录。
level, room to distribute a part of their respective credit quotas to different local development projects (Xie et al. 2001: 7).
省级层面上，地方 PBOC 分行有空间将各自信贷配额的一部分分配给不同的地方发展项目（Xie et al. 2001: 7）。
To ensure continual central control over the money supply, the State Council, China’s cabinet, responded with a system of strict quantity control over both national level lending and lending at the provincial and sectoral level. The national credit plan became the key to this system of control. The credit plan specified not only the overall quantity of lending in a given province but also the percentage of that amount that went toward fixed-asset investment and working capital loans (Fei 1995a). In the annual credit allocation cycle, the State Council and the People’s Bank of China first sent a draft credit plan to the provinces and ministries in the autumn every year. After bureaucratic and political bargaining, the State Council issued a final credit plan to which the provinces and ministries were bound (Holz 2000; Ma 1996). The credit plan, however, served merely as a half-opened cage for money supply. As later chapters detail, when elite political signals called for high-speed growth, the state banks routinely exceeded the credit quotas. Retrenchment periods, however, brought the wrath of the central government on those who violated the credit plan.
为确保对货币供应的持续中央控制，国务院（中国的中央政府内阁）制定了对全国性贷款以及省级和部门层面贷款实行严格数量控制的制度。全国信贷计划成为这一控制体系的关键。信贷计划不仅规定了某一省份贷款的总体数量，还规定了其中用于固定资产投资和流动资金贷款的比例（Fei 1995a）。在年度信贷分配周期中，国务院和中国人民银行每年秋季首先向各省和各部委下发信贷计划草案。经过官僚与政治层面的博弈后，国务院发布最终信贷计划，各省和各部委必须遵守该计划（Holz 2000；Ma 1996）。然而，信贷计划不过是对货币供应设置的一只半开着的笼子。正如后续章节所详述，当精英政治信号要求高速增长时，国有银行常常超出信贷配额。而在收缩期，中央政府则会对那些违反信贷计划者施以严厉惩处。
The force of the credit plan meant that other monetary instruments served supplementary roles until recently. Reserve requirements limited lending by individual banks, but provincial governments’ influence over all the bank branches within their jurisdictions meant that the reserve requirements did little to constrain provincial level lending (Ma 1996). If one bank ran low on
信贷计划的强制性意味着其他货币工具直到最近才起补充作用。存款准备金率限制了各个银行的放贷，但省政府对其辖区内所有银行网点的影响力意味着，存款准备金率对省级放贷几乎没有约束力（Ma 1996）。如果某家银行资金短缺，
liquidity, the local government simply ordered another bank to lend to a project. Moreover, as one veteran central banker put it, “the effect of increasing reserve requirements is offset by relending (zaidaikuan) by the PBOC” (Liu 2000 d ) ) )). In other words, when there was political pressure to expand lending, banks facing liquidity shortfall as a result of increased reserve requirements simply approached the local PBOC for a loan. The classic example of this was the PBOC’s attempt to engineer a “soft landing” in 1987. Rather than contracting money supply, the increase of reserve requirement was neutralized by heightened relending to the Big Four banks (Liu 1993: 73). Interest rate adjustments were also seldom used as a way to control money supply. As Figure 3.2 reveals, lending interest rates, represented by the triangle-dotted line, fluctuated only four times before the late i990s, whereas lending, represented by the circle-dotted line, fluctuated wildly during the same period. Only during the Zhu Rongji administration were interest rates used as a tool to increase lending. Given that the government eschewed bond issuance until the late 1980s, open market operations also did not play a large role in changing the money supply until recently. 2 2 ^(2){ }^{2} Although these monetary instruments exerted some effect on money supply and inflationary expectation, they made minor noises to the loud bangs of political signals from the Party center.
流动性短缺时，当地政府就简单地下令另一家银行对一个项目放贷。此外，正如一位资深央行官员所言，“提高存款准备金率的效果被中国人民银行的再贷款（zaidaikuan）所抵消”（Liu 2000 d ) ) )) ）。换言之，当存在扩张信贷的政治压力时，因提高准备金率而面临流动性短缺的银行便直接向当地中国人民银行申请贷款。经典例子是中国人民银行在 1987 年试图实现“软着陆”的做法。央行并没有收缩货币供给，准备金率的提高被对四大行加强再贷款所中和（Liu 1993: 73）。利率调整也很少被用作控制货币供给的手段。如图 3.2 所示，由三角点线表示的贷款利率在 1990 年代后期之前仅波动了四次，而由圆点线表示的放贷在同一时期却剧烈波动。只有在朱镕基执政期间，利率被用作增加信贷的工具。 鉴于政府直到 1980 年代末才放弃发行国债，公开市场操作在最近之前也并未在改变货币供应量方面发挥重要作用。 2 2 ^(2){ }^{2} 尽管这些货币工具对货币供应量和通胀预期产生了一定影响，但相比于来自党中心的政治信号的巨大震荡，它们只是发出微弱的声音。
In the late 1980s and the 1990s, the People’s Bank of China began to experiment with asset-liability management as a way to replace the credit plan. Rather than strictly decreeing the quantity of lending by banks, asset-liability management allowed banks to lend up to a specified percentage of total bank deposits. 3 3 ^(3){ }^{3} This aimed to provide banks with more flexibility on lending quantity and to create more incentive to absorb deposits. With the proliferation of jointstock banks and smaller city banks in the 1990s, asset-liability management also aimed at reducing the PBOC’s cost of controlling the money supply (Xie 1997).
在 1980 年代末和 1990 年代，中国人民银行开始尝试以资产负债管理取代信贷计划。与其严格规定银行放贷的数量，资产负债管理允许银行将放贷额度控制在占银行存款总额的指定百分比以内。 3 3 ^(3){ }^{3} 这旨在为银行提供更多的放贷数量弹性，并创造更多吸纳存款的激励。随着 1990 年代股份制银行和较小的城市商业银行的增多，资产负债管理也旨在降低中国人民银行控制货币供应的成本（Xie 1997）。
In the late 1980s, the PBOC first experimented with asset-liability targets with the newly reformed Bank of Communications. In late 1993, the State
在 1980 年代末，中国人民银行首次在新近改革的交通银行上试行资产负债目标。1993 年底，国务院
Figure 6: figure 3.2. Quarterly Fluctuations of Lending and Lending Interest Rates: 1980-2000. Note: Each observation represents the first difference of the log of lending and lending interest rates, respectively. Data come from Quarterly Database. See Appendix for details.
图 6：图 3.2。1980–2000 年贷款及贷款利率季度波动。注：每个观测值分别表示贷款和贷款利率对数的一阶差分。数据来自季度数据库。详见附录。
Council required commercial banks to implement asset-liability management while adhering to the credit plan, placing banks under “dual management” (Fei 1995b). In principle, all banks were required to maintain a loan-to-deposit ratio of 75 percent, but exceptions were made for different kinds of financial institutions. 4 4 ^(4){ }^{4} More important, some provinces received higher asset-to-liability ratios, or loan-to-deposit ratios, than others (Fei 1995b). 5 5 ^(5){ }^{5} Finally, on January ɪ, 1998, the mandatory credit plan was retired in favor of asset-liability management, although a guidance credit plan survived.
国务院要求商业银行在遵守信贷计划的同时实行资产负债管理，使银行处于“二重管理”之下（Fei 1995b）。原则上，所有银行被要求维持 75%的存贷比，但对不同类型的金融机构有例外。 4 4 ^(4){ }^{4} 更重要的是，某些省份获得了比其他省份更高的资产负债率或存贷比（Fei 1995b）。 5 5 ^(5){ }^{5} 最后，1998 年 1 月ɪ日，强制性的信贷计划被取消，改为资产负债管理，尽管指导性信贷计划仍然存在。
The elaborate credit plan and later the asset-liability management not withstanding, loan expansion routinely rose above the lending targets and the mandated loan-to-deposit ratios. A veteran PBOC researcher laments that actual lending during most years of the reform exceeded the quantity mandated by
尽管有复杂的信贷计划及后来实施的资产负债管理，贷款扩张常常超出贷款目标和规定的存贷比。一位资深人民银行研究人员感叹，在改革的大多数年份里，实际放贷量超过了规定的数量。
the credit plan; between 1991 and 1996, actual lending exceeded the original targeted amount by an average of 31.9 percent (Xie 1997; Xie et al. 2001). Even after the implementation of asset-liability management, provinces routinely deviated from their respective loan-to-deposit targets. This came about either because the provincial branches of the Big Four banks exceeded the loan-to-deposit targets issued by the headquarters or because the local government pressured local branches of the state banks and other financial institutions into extending more loans (Joint Investigation Team of the Financial Research Institute at the Shandong Branch of the PBOC 1998). Despite PBOC monitoring, local branches of the Big Four banks lent money according to political signals from the local government, which in turn responded to political signals from central politicians. What was worse, both the local and the central offices of the PBOC, which were the main gatekeepers of the money supply, also responded to political signals from the Party center.
信贷计划；在 1991 年至 1996 年间，实际放贷平均比最初目标金额超出 31.9%（谢 1997；谢等 2001）。即使在实施资产负债管理之后，各省仍经常偏离各自的存贷比目标。产生这种情况的原因要么是四大行的省级分行超越了总行下发的存贷比目标，要么是地方政府施压国有银行及其他金融机构的地方分支以发放更多贷款（中国人民银行山东分行金融研究所联合调查组 1998）。尽管中国人民银行有监控，四大行的地方分行仍根据地方政府的政治信号放贷，而地方政府又响应中央政治人物的政治信号。更糟的是，作为货币供应主要把关者的中国人民银行地方和中央机构，也都响应来自党中心的政治信号。
Overlending by the Big Four banks, whether under the credit plan or assetliability management, was made possible by PBOC “relending” (zaidaikuan) operations that injected liquidity from the PBOC into the Big Four banks. Although relending declined on the PBOC’s balance sheet in the late 1990s, the enormous magnitude of these operations, especially to the agricultural banks, made relending an important venue through which the money supply expanded in China. If the PBOC lent to a bank, the bank would have more to lend, creating a multiplier effect on the money supply. Unlike in most Western banking systems, Chinese central bank lending often involved long-term loans, not short-term “last resort” loans. This crucial tool of financial expansion also was extremely flexible. When central politicians demanded growth at all costs, the PBOC was able to react quickly to liquidity demand from the banks and lent “on demand” via relending (Liu 1997: 18). During times of retrenchment, however, all relending halted, and banks were forced to stop financing ongoing projects.
无论是在信贷计划下还是通过资产负债管理，四大银行的过度放贷都得以实现，这要归功于 PBOC 的“再贷款”(zaidaikuan) 操作，该操作将流动性从 PBOC 注入四大银行。尽管在 1990 年代后期再贷款在 PBOC 的资产负债表上有所下降，但这些操作的巨大规模，尤其是对农业银行的巨额放贷，使得再贷款成为中国货币供应扩张的重要渠道。如果 PBOC 向某家银行放贷，该银行就会有更多资金可供放贷，从而对货币供应产生乘数效应。与大多数西方银行体系不同，中国中央银行的放贷往往涉及长期贷款，而非短期的“最后贷款人”贷款。这一关键的金融扩张工具也极为灵活。当中央政治人物要求不惜一切代价促进增长时，PBOC 能够迅速响应来自银行的流动性需求，通过再贷款“按需”放贷（Liu 1997: 18）。然而在收缩时期，所有再贷款都会停止，银行被迫停止为正在进行的项目提供融资。
Policy makers in the early I990s argued that PBOC relending generated inflationary pressure because local branches of the PBOC lent to state banks in response to local governmental pressure (Zhu 1998b). The 1993 inflationary crisis allowed central technocrats to implement banking restructuring measures that centralized the relending authority to the PBOC headquarters in an attempt to minimize local intervention. Despite this institutional change, money supply and inflationary pressure continued to rise for another year, as was seen in Figure 2.1. This strongly suggests that both central PBOC officials and local officials were reacting to the same political signals from the Party center. Rapid money supply expansion could not be wholly blamed on enthusiastic local officials. Moreover, this case suggests that institutional changes alone without accompanying political shifts had little impact on the money supply.
在 20 世纪 90 年代初，政策制定者认为中国人民银行再贷款产生了通胀压力，因为人民银行的地方分支在地方政府的压力下向国有银行放贷（Zhu 1998b）。1993 年的通胀危机使中央技术官僚得以实施银行重组措施，将再贷款权集中到中国人民银行总部，试图将地方干预降到最低。尽管有了这一制度性变化，货币供应和通胀压力在接下来的一年仍然继续上升，如图 2.1 所示。这强烈表明，中央人民银行官员和地方官员都在对来自党中心的相同政治信号作出反应。货币供应的快速扩张不能完全归咎于积极的地方官员。此外，这一案例表明，单靠制度变革而没有配套的政治变动，对货币供应几乎没有影响。
In the late i990s, the Chinese government further attempted to minimize political intervention in monetary policy through furnishing policy authorities to a group of financial experts. However, this effort, which culminated to the
在 20 世纪 90 年代后期，中国政府进一步尝试通过将政策权力交给一群金融专家来尽量减少政治对货币政策的干预。然而，这一努力最终导致了...
formation of the monetary policy committee (MPC) in 1997, also failed to filter political signals out of monetary policy. First, even in the charter of the MPC, it was designed as a “consultative discussion organ” with no final decision power (People’s Bank of China 1997b). Second, the MPC was made up of a mix of central bankers, senior technocrats from other economic agencies, and financial experts (People’s Bank of China 1997b). Thus, the MPC soon evolved into an arena for bureaucratic bargaining as each agency attempted to sway monetary policy to favor its own policy mission (PBOC Monetary Policy Committee 2000 c ) 2000 c ) 2000c)2000 \mathrm{c}). For example, during MPC meetings, the representative from the State Economic and Trade Commission, then in charge of SOE reform, repeatedly called for more lending to restructure SOEs (PBOC Monetary Policy Committee 2000a). Moreover, its consultative nature quickly revealed itself. Between 1998 and 1999, the MPC twice decided to hold interest rates in place rather than to lower them to stimulate the economy (PBOC Monetary Policy Committee 2000b; PBOC Monetary Policy Committee 2000d). In both instances, the premier vetoed its decision and lowered interest rates.
1997 年货币政策委员会（MPC）的成立也未能将政治信号从货币政策中剔除。首先，即便在货币政策委员会的章程中，它也被设计为一个“协商讨论机关”，不具有最终决策权（People’s Bank of China 1997b）。第二，货币政策委员会由央行官员、其他经济机构的高级技术官僚和金融专家混合组成（People’s Bank of China 1997b）。因此，货币政策委员会很快演变成各机构为使货币政策有利于自身政策使命而进行的官僚博弈的舞台（PBOC Monetary Policy Committee 2000 c ) 2000 c ) 2000c)2000 \mathrm{c}) ）。例如，在货币政策委员会会议期间，当时负责国企改革的国家经贸委代表多次呼吁增加信贷以重组国有企业（PBOC Monetary Policy Committee 2000a）。此外，其协商性质很快显现出来。1998 年至 1999 年间，货币政策委员会两次决定维持利率不变，而不是降低利率以刺激经济（PBOC Monetary Policy Committee 2000b；PBOC Monetary Policy Committee 2000d）。在这两次情况下，国务院总理都否决了该决定并降低了利率。
Even after banking centralization, the implementation of asset-liability management, and the formation of MPC, a mix of intractable monitoring problems and political intervention continued to create large temporal and interregional variation in the amount of money lent out. When the political signals called for rapid growth, local governments found numerous loopholes in the credit control mechanism to finance local growth. Large sums could be poured into policy tasks within a short time. At the same time, the credit control mechanisms perfected by the State Council throughout the reform era could also halt all lending virtually overnight. The key to this flexibility has been the continual domination of the Communist Party over the banking sector such that all bankers bowed to the prevailing political wind from the Party center or faced dismissal.
即便在银行业集中、实施资产负债管理以及成立货币政策委员会之后，难以解决的监督问题与政治干预仍然导致放贷金额在时间和地区上出现巨大差异。当政治信号要求快速增长时，地方政府在信贷控制机制中发现了众多漏洞以为地方增长提供资金。大量资金可以在短时间内被投入到政策任务中。同时，国务院在整个改革时期完善的信贷控制机制也能够在几乎一夜之间停止所有放贷。这种灵活性的关键在于共产党对银行业的持续主导，所有银行家要么服从来自党中心的主流政治风向，要么面临免职。

Credit Allocation  信贷分配

Because the banking system represented by far the largest portion of the money supply in China, loan allocation by the banks heavily influenced the overall efficiency in capital allocation. Although the formal mechanisms of loan allocation were not the most important factors determining the flow of loans, an analysis of the formal institutions nevertheless allows us to understand the mechanisms by which high politics influenced loan allocation.
由于以银行体系为代表的货币供应在中国占据绝对最大比重，银行的信贷分配对资本配置的整体效率有重大影响。尽管信贷分配的正式机制并非决定贷款流向的最重要因素，但对正式制度的分析仍然使我们能够理解高层政治如何影响信贷分配的机制。
During the height of the national credit plan from the 1980s to the midɪ990s, loan allocation was largely controlled by two processes, national priority projects, on the one hand, and loans supporting local economic growth, on the other. Loans to national priority projects, including major construction projects and policy loans for rural development and grain procurement, were embedded in the national credit plan. The provision of these loans was jointly worked out by the provinces, the line-ministries, and ultimately by the State Planning Commission and the People’s Bank of China (Fei 1995c). This part of
在 20 世纪 80 年代到 90 年代中期全国信贷计划鼎盛时期，信贷分配主要受两种过程控制：一方面是国家优先项目，另一方面是支持地方经济增长的贷款。对国家优先项目的贷款，包括重大建设项目以及用于农村发展和粮食征购的政策性贷款，都被纳入全国信贷计划之中。这些贷款的提供由省级、行业部委，最终由国家计划委员会和中国人民银行共同制定和协商（Fei 1995c）。这部分...
the credit plan closely resembled credit allocation in many socialist countries, with “the Planning Commission ordering the dishes and the banks footing the bill” (Jiwei diancai, yinhang fuqian). Central politicians intending to provide economic advantages to a province often intervened in this process to ensure a higher number of priority projects approved for the province.
信贷计划与许多社会主义国家的信贷分配非常相似，“计划委员会点菜，银行买单”（Jiwei diancai, yinhang fuqian）。中央希望给予某省经济优势的政治人物经常干预这一过程，以确保为该省批准更多优先项目。
On a separate track, local branches of the Big Four banks consulted with the provinces to determine how much working capital would be lent to local SOEs and other local projects, the overall quantity of which was stated in the national credit plan (Ma 1996). In this process, local officials had enormous leverage because the local Party committee influenced the promotion of local bankers. At the height of the credit plan system, provinces, especially those with the right elite political connections, often exceeded lending targets in the credit plan through lending excessively to local enterprises, forcing the PBOC to increase the lending quota and to “relend” to branches of the Big Four banks to finance national priority projects (Ma 1996).
在另一条线上，四大行的地方分行与各省协商，以确定向地方国有企业和其他地方项目发放多少流动资金，这一总体数量在国家信贷计划中已列明（Ma 1996）。在此过程中，地方官员拥有巨大的杠杆作用，因为地方党委影响地方银行家的晋升。在信贷计划体系的鼎盛时期，各省，尤其是那些拥有合适精英政治关系的省，常常通过对地方企业过度放贷来超出信贷计划中的放贷目标，迫使人民银行提高放贷配额并向四大行的分行“再贷款”，以资助国家优先项目（Ma 1996）。
In the 1990s, local branches of the Big Four banks also lent out substantial amounts of working capital to private or semiprivate enterprises, especially in the coastal region. However, interest rate restrictions and an incomplete credit monitoring system prevented risk-averse state banks from switching their portfolios to the private sector for fear of default. Defaults by SOEs, which occurred quite often, did not cause any problem for state bankers because they simply followed orders when lending to SOEs.
在 1990 年代，四大国有银行的地方分支也向私人或半私有企业，尤其是沿海地区，发放了大量营运资金贷款。然而，利率限制和不完善的信贷监控体系使得风险规避的国有银行不敢将其投资组合转向私营部门，以免发生违约。国有企业的违约（相当频繁）对国有银行家并不构成问题，因为他们在向国有企业放贷时只是按命令行事。
The 1998 banking centralization (discussed in Chapter 8) and the implementation of asset-liability management transformed the traditional planning system, but state policies still played an important role in credit allocation. With banking centralization, local branches of the Big Four banks were formally only answerable to headquarters of these banks and to the central government and no longer to the local government. The abolition of the credit plan in theory provided centrally administered banks autonomy to make loans to obtain the best return, so long as banks complied with the multitude of asset-liability targets and interest rate regulations set forth by the PBOC. By all accounts, including interviews with local bank officials, the 1998 change was for a time successful in insulating the Big Four banks from local political influence. 6 6 ^(6){ }^{6}
1998 年的银行集中化（在第 8 章讨论）和资产负债管理的实施改变了传统的计划体系，但国家政策在信贷分配中仍然发挥着重要作用。随着银行集中化，四大银行的地方分支在形式上仅对这些银行的总部和中央政府负责，不再对地方政府负责。理论上，取消信贷计划赋予了由中央管理的银行自主放贷以获取最佳回报的能力，前提是银行遵守中国人民银行设定的大量资产负债目标和利率监管。根据包括对地方银行官员的访谈在内的各种说法，1998 年的变革在一段时间内确实成功地使四大银行免受地方政治影响。 6 6 ^(6){ }^{6}
Nonetheless, this only made banks a tool of national policies. During the Zhu Rongji administration, the banking sector as a whole, and especially the Big Four banks and policy banks, provided trillions in funding to the Three-Year SOE Rescue Plan, the drive to maintain growth at 7 percent, and the massive infrastructure development plan for western China. Through a mix of interest rate policy and administrative decrees, the central government enticed, cajoled, and at times commanded banks to channel credit to fulfill policy goals (PBOC
尽管如此，这仅仅使银行成为国家政策的工具。在朱镕基执政期间，整个银行业，特别是四大行和政策性银行，为三年国企救助计划、保持 7%增长的推动，以及西部大规模基础设施建设计划提供了数万亿的资金。通过利率政策和行政法令的组合，中央政府诱导、劝说，有时甚至命令银行将信贷引导到以实现政策目标（PBOC
Monetary Policy Committee 2000d). The lack of interest rate flexibility meant that banks still lacked any incentive to lend to the private sector; the bureaucratic risk of doing so continued to out-weigh any potential gains. Persistent state intervention found expression in the small proportion of state bank loans flowing to the nonstate sector. State bank lending to the nonstate sector only climbed laboriously from 3 percent in 1990 to around 15 percent at the end of 2003 . 7 2003 . 7 2003.^(7)2003 .^{7}
货币政策委员会 2000d）。利率缺乏灵活性意味着银行对向私营部门放贷仍然没有任何激励；这样做的官僚风险仍然超过任何潜在收益。持续的国家干预表现为流向非国有部门的国有银行贷款比例很小。国有银行对非国有部门的贷款仅从 1990 年的 3%艰难攀升到 2003 . 7 2003 . 7 2003.^(7)2003 .^{7} 年底的约 15%。
As with money supply, the allocation of credit remains largely dictated by administrative decrees and state policies rather than by market signals. Although the allocation of loans to the private sector increased rapidly in absolute terms, the vast majority of banking resources was still destined for SOEs and state construction projects. The underlying dynamic for nonperforming loan creation - the misallocation of credit - continues unabated.
与货币供应相似，信贷的分配在很大程度上仍由行政法令和国家政策主导，而非市场信号。尽管流向私营部门的贷款在绝对量上迅速增加，但绝大多数银行资源仍然用于国有企业和国家建设项目。造成不良贷款的根本动力——信贷错配——持续存在。

The CCP's Dominance over the Banking Industry
中国共产党对银行业的主导地位

Like all other government bureaucracies in China, the state dominated banking sector came under the dual leadership of the state and the Chinese Communist Party (CCP). On the state side, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC), in addition to its crucial role in monetary policy, played an active, although by no means exclusive, role in monitoring and selecting managers throughout the banking system. Most recently, this task has fallen on the newly formed China Banking Regulatory Commission (CBRC). The State Council, China’s cabinet, also had an important say in appointing senior bankers. On the Party side, the Central Organization Department, the Central Disciplinary and Inspection Commission (CDIC), and, for a time, the Central Finance Work Commission (CFWC) appointed and evaluated most senior managers in the banking system. 8 8 ^(8){ }^{8} This constellation of monitoring and enforcement mechanisms dominated by the CCP ensured that bankers at every level paid close attention to policy signals emanating from the highest reaches of the CCP.
像中国所有其他政府官僚机构一样，国家主导的银行业受到国家与中国共产党（CCP）双重领导。在国家方面，除了在货币政策中发挥关键作用外，中国人民银行（PBOC）还在监控和选拔整个银行系统的管理人员方面发挥了积极作用，尽管这并非其唯一职责。最近，这一职能已落到新成立的中国银行业监督管理委员会（CBRC）身上。国务院（中国的内阁）在任命高级银行家方面也有重要发言权。在党的方面，中央组织部、中央纪律检查委员会（CDIC），以及一段时间内的中央金融工作委员会（CFWC）负责任命并考察银行系统的大多数高级管理人员。 8 8 ^(8){ }^{8} 由中共主导的这一监控与执法机制格局确保了各级银行家密切关注来自中共最高层的政策信号。
Monitoring and supervision of banks fell into two general areas: Party discipline and professional supervision. Party discipline encompasses monitoring adherence to Party policies and regulations, cadre evaluation, and anticorruption investigations. The primary agency responsible for Party discipline work is the CDIC, although the CFWC became heavily involved during the Zhu administration. Professional supervision entails ensuring compliance with state lending quotas, asset-liability ratios, nonperforming loan ceilings, mandatory interest rates, and so on.
