It also includes quality control and professional evaluation of managers in the banking system. The primary agency for professional
对银行的监督与监管大致分为两类：党内纪律和专业监管。党内纪律包括监督遵守党政策和法规、干部考核以及反腐调查。负责党内纪律工作的主要机构是中央纪律检查委员会（CDIC），尽管在朱镕基任期内，中纪委（CFWC）也深度介入。专业监管则是确保遵守国家贷款配额、资产负债比率、不良贷款上限、强制性利率等。这还包括对银行体系管理者的质量控制与专业评估。专业监管的主要机构是
supervision throughout much of the reform has been the PBOC, but the Ministry of Supervision and the recently founded China Banking Regulatory Commission (CBRC) also have played an important role in professional supervision in various periods.
在改革的大部分时期，监督工作由 PBOC 负责，但监察部和新成立的中国银行业监督管理委员会（CBRC）在不同时期的专业监督中也发挥了重要作用。

The 1980-1998 System: Decentralized Administration and Monitoring
1980–1998 年的体系：分权的管理与监督

Under the Maoist system of highly centralized banking, the banking system was governed by the State Planning Commission, the Ministry of Finance, and the State Economic Commission. On the Party side, Party groups (dangzu), composed of hand-picked Party officials, presided over all of these organizations. With the more decentralized credit allocation model in 1979, some of the banking sector’s administrative power also devolved to the provincial level. In the decentralized model, senior banking officials were still promoted by the Central Organization Department, which also set the evaluation criteria for all bankers. This meant that bankers had to constantly pay attention to shifting political winds to meet the varying evaluation criteria of the Central Organization Department. For example, “support for SOEs” was included as a new category in the evaluation form for bankers in 1997, causing the state banks to release a deluge of funds to ailing SOEs (Li 1997a).
在高度集中的毛主义银行体制下，银行系统由国家计划委员会、财政部和国家经济委员会管辖。在党的一侧，由挑选出的党官组成的党组织（dangzu）负责监管所有这些机构。随着 1979 年更为分权的信贷配置模式的推行，部分银行业的行政权力也下放到省级。在这种分权模式下，高级银行官员仍由中央组织部提拔，中央组织部也为所有银行家制定考核标准。这意味着银行家必须不断关注变化的政治风向，以满足中央组织部不断变化的考核标准。例如，“支持国有企业”在 1997 年被列为银行家考核表中的一项新类别，导致国有银行向濒危国企释放了大量资金（Li 1997a）。
In the early 1980s, however, local Party committees obtained the authority to jointly appoint local Big Four bank managers and PBOC officials along with the Party groups within the PBOC and the Big Four banks. Local bank managers in turn became important members of the local government, and began to attend local economic planning meetings and to receive “targets” (zhibiao) and “tasks” (renwu) from the local Party committees. In addition to formal power, the local Party committees also put pressure on local banks in innumerable ways, from the allocation of bank workers to the supply of utilities to fee collection. Thus, as Figure 3.3 indicates, both the headquarters of the Big Four banks and the provincial party committees had administrative jurisdiction (indicated by solid-line arrows) over provincial branch banks, which translated to appointment power over provincial bank managers.
然而在 20 世纪 80 年代初，地方党委员会获得了与中国人民银行及四大行内部的党组织共同任命地方四大行行长和中国人民银行官员的权力。地方银行行长反过来成为地方政府的重要成员，开始出席地方经济规划会议，并从地方党委员会接受“指标”(zhibiao)和“任务”(renwu)。除了正式权力外，地方党委员会还通过无数方式对地方银行施加压力，从银行人员的分配到公用事业的供应，再到费用征收。因此，正如图 3.3 所示，四大行总部和省级党委员会都对省级分行拥有行政管辖权（以实线箭头表示），这就转化为对省级银行行长的任命权。
In addition to the Party Committee system, the Party also exerted direct control over the financial system through the disciplinary and inspection network. Party monitoring of the financial sector began in 1985, when the watchdog organization of the Communist Party, the CDIC, stationed special investigation teams at the headquarters of all the banks. Concurrently, local disciplinary and inspection committees (DICs) attached to the local Party committees also stationed investigation teams at local PBOC branches. Within one year of its formation, the financial CDIC/DIC network multiplied to 4,953 teams, involving 13,217 cadres. In this way, the local party committee influenced the banking sector both through appointing local managers and through the DIC team network (CDIC Team Stationed in the Financial System and The Ministry of Supervision Bureau Stationed in the Financial System 1997). Because of the watchdog function of the CDIC/DIC network, it potentially played a crucial role in the appointment and removal of officials in the banking sector. Even
除了党委体制之外，党还通过纪检监察网络对金融体系实行直接控制。党对金融部门的监控始于 1985 年，当时中国共产党纪检机关——中央纪律检查委员会（CDIC）在所有银行总部驻派了专项调查组。与此同时，隶属于地方党委的地方纪律检查委员会（DIC）也在地方人民银行分支机构驻派调查组。成立一年内，金融系统的中央/地方纪检网络扩展到 4,953 个工作组，涉及 13,217 名干部。通过这种方式，地方党委既通过任命地方管理者，又通过纪检工作组网络影响银行业（CDIC Team Stationed in the Financial System and The Ministry of Supervision Bureau Stationed in the Financial System 1997）。由于中央/地方纪检网络的监督职能，它在银行部门官员的任免中可能发挥了关键作用。甚至
Figure 7: figure 3.3. Decentralized Administration of the Banking System: 1980-1998. Note: Arrows indicate the flow of administrative authority.
图 7：图 3.3。银行体系的分权管理：1980-1998。注：箭头表示行政权力的流向。
the initiation of a corruption investigation could ruin careers. Given that the local DIC network took orders from both the local Party committees and from the CDIC, it flexibly served both local and central interests, depending on the prevailing political trend.
腐败调查的启动可能毁掉职业生涯。鉴于地方 DIC 网络既接受地方党委的指令，也接受 CDIC 的指令，它能够灵活地在地方和中央利益之间服务，取决于当时的政治潮流。
For professional supervision, the PBOC served as the lead agency, especially since the enactment of the Central Bank Law in 1995. In addition to the PBOC headquarters in Beijing, which monitored the headquarters of all the banks, PBOC regional and provincial offices monitored the business activities of the Big Four’s regional branches, as well as local banks. Through monthly reports by each bank’s headquarters and their major branches, as well as “on the spot” auditing of the banks’ books, the PBOC ensured that the deposit and lending interest rates did not deviate from the mandated band. 9 9 ^(9){ }^{9} These mechanisms also allowed the PBOC to monitor compliance with the national credit plan and, after 1998, the reserve requirements and minimum
在专业监管方面，PBOC 作为主导机构，尤其是在 1995 年《中央银行法》颁布之后。除了位于北京、监管所有银行总部的 PBOC 总部外，PBOC 的区域和省级办事处还监管四大行的区域分行以及地方性银行的经营活动。通过各银行总部及其主要分行的月报，以及对银行账目的现场审计，PBOC 确保存款和贷款利率未偏离规定区间。 9 9 ^(9){ }^{9} 这些机制也使 PBOC 能够监督国家信贷计划的合规性，并在 1998 年之后监督准备金要求和最低
asset-to-liability and loan-to-deposit ratios for different banks and regions (People’s Bank of China 1999: 138-142). Although central banks in the West monitored some of these figures nationally, the PBOC imposed different mandatory ratios on different localities. 10 10 ^(10){ }^{10} Finally, the State Council and the PBOC routinely issued temporary regulations or decrees which the state banks in particular must follow. Failure to adhere to PBOC targets and regulations could result in warnings and administrative punishments for the violating banks or bank branches and, most important, for the bank managers in charge of these entities.
不同银行和地区的资产对负债比率以及贷存比率（中国人民银行 1999：138-142）。尽管西方的中央银行在全国范围内监督其中一些数据，但 PBOC 对不同地区强制施加了不同的比率要求。 10 10 ^(10){ }^{10} 最后，国务院和 PBOC 经常发布临时法规或法令，国家银行尤其必须遵守。不遵守 PBOC 目标和监管规定可能导致对违规银行或银行网点的警告和行政处罚，最重要的是对负责这些实体的银行经理的处罚。
The heart of the PBOC’s supervision of individual bankers was a record of all bank managers’ professional performance, in terms of adherence to PBOC regulations. This record played an important role in the promotions of bank managers, which required PBOC evaluation and approval. Although the significance of the PBOC vetting process for promotions varied through time and across various localities, the record of administrative accomplishments (zhengji) kept by the PBOC nonetheless served as an important foundation for a banker’s resume (Wang and Wang 1997 ) II ) II  )^("II "))^{\text {II }}.
PBOC 对个别银行家监督的核心是对所有银行经理专业表现的记录，即对其遵守 PBOC 监管规定情况的记录。这一记录在银行经理的晋升中起着重要作用，晋升需要 PBOC 的评估和批准。尽管 PBOC 审查程序在不同时间和不同地区的重要性有所不同，但 PBOC 保存的行政业绩记录（zhengji）仍然是银行家简历的重要基础（Wang and Wang 1997 ) II ) II  )^("II "))^{\text {II }} ）。
PBOC monitoring aimed at a steady money supply and the allocation of credit according to state policies. Thus, PBOC evaluation criteria at times clashed with the Party’s evaluation criteria, which shifted more frequently depending on the political environment. However, because the PBOC itself was governed by the Party, bankers at every level knew that it was more important to obey political criteria set forth by the Party than the technical standards of the PBOC. Only when top bureaucrats gained the political upper-hand did technical standards become important for the bankers. Bankers who broke the credit quota during high growth periods could always blame political pressure and local intervention after the fact. The PBOC, knowing the political reality full well, could do little to punish bankers.
中国人民银行的监督目标是保持货币供应稳定并按国家政策配置信贷。因此，中国人民银行的评价标准有时会与党对官员的评价标准发生冲突，而党的评价标准会根据政治环境更频繁地发生变化。然而，由于中国人民银行本身受党领导，各级银行家都知道遵从党的政治评价标准比遵循中国人民银行的技术标准更为重要。只有当最高级的官僚在政治上占据上风时，技术标准对银行家才会变得重要。在高增长时期突破信贷配额的银行家事后总能将责任归咎于政治压力和地方干预。中国人民银行充分了解这种政治现实，却很难对银行家进行惩处。
Beyond the PBOC, other government agencies, such as the Ministry of Finance and the State Economic and Trade Commission, also issued regulations pertaining to the balance sheet and write-off procedures of the state banks. Although these agencies did not keep a record of bankers’ administrative performance, they were fully capable of alerting the PBOC to a bank or a banker’s transgression against these agencies’ decrees.
除了 PBOC 之外，其他政府机构，如财政部和国家经济贸易委员会，也发布了有关国有银行资产负债表和核销程序的法规。尽管这些机构没有记录银行家行政绩效，但它们完全有能力就银行或银行家违反这些机构法令的行为向 PBOC 发出警示。

A New Centralization: Bank Structure after the 1998 Change
一种新的中央集权：1998 年变革后的银行结构

As will be seen in Chapter 8, Premier Zhu Rongji took the opportunity of the Asian Financial Crisis, which greatly alarmed the Party leadership of the financial system’s fragility, to centralize the banking sector to an unprecedented degree. The centerpiece of the restructuring was the Central Finance Work
正如在第 8 章中将看到的，朱镕基总理利用亚洲金融危机这一契机——该危机极大地警示了党对于金融体系脆弱性的担忧——将银行业集中化到前所未有的程度。重组的核心是中央金融工作
Commission (CFWC), which answered only to the Central Committee (CC). Vice Premier and Politburo member Wen Jiabao served as its chairman, while his longtime protégé, Yan Haiwang, served as the executive vice chairman. Although PBOC Governor Dai Xianglong, who had a long career in the banking sector, was a vice chairman, he took orders from Yan Haiwang, who spent much of his career in propaganda work.
委员会（CFWC），只向中央委员会（CC）负责。国务院副总理兼政治局委员温家宝担任主席，他的长期门生阎海旺担任执行副主席。尽管有着长期银行业经历的中国人民银行行长戴相龙是副主席，但他听命于阎海旺，阎海旺的大部分职业生涯在宣传工作中度过。
The founding mission of the CFWC was to “lead, guarantee, manage, monitor, and coordinate” the financial sector. In the inaugural meeting of the CFWC, Chairman Wen stated that the CFWC would “… protect the independent legal person status of the state commercial banks and other financial institutions” but also would “guarantee the implementation of the lines, principles, and policies of the CCP Central Committee and the guidance and decisions of the State Council…” (Wen 1999: 797). The Party’s longtime conflicting desire to commercialize and to retain control over the banking sector could find no better expression.
CFWC 的创立使命是“领导、保障、管理、监督和协调”金融部门。在 CFWC 的首次会议上，委员长温指出，CFWC 将“…维护国家商业银行和其他金融机构的独立法人地位”，但也将“保障中共中央的路线、方针、政策的贯彻执行以及国务院的指导和决策的落实……”（温，1999：797）。党长期以来既想使银行业商业化又想保持对其控制的矛盾愿望，莫过于此。
After the 1998 restructuring, the headquarters of the Big Four banks nominated senior managers, subject to approval by the PBOC, the CFWC, and ultimately the CCP Central Organization Department (Heilmann 2005). The headquarters of each bank appointed local managers, subject to approval only by the PBOC and the CFWC. The local government no longer played a direct role in appointing Big Four branch managers. Rather than answering to the local Party committees, Party members in the financial system now had their own Party committee hierarchy, headed ultimately by the CFWC (Liu and Lu 1999: 135). The CFWC also gained the authority to approve appointments of managers in joint-stock banks and local banks, although shareholders and local Party committees presumably had more leeway to nominate candidates in these banks (Yan 1999). Institutionally, the era of local domination over the Big Four banks came to an end in 1998. Nonetheless, informal intervention by the local government, especially if the political atmosphere was right, continued to be a regular feature of the banking system. As shown in Figure 3.4, only the headquarters of the state banks had direct control over the provincial branch banks, whereas local government retained only informal influence. Nonetheless, 1998 saw the introduction of an even more bewildering array of central agencies on both the state and the party side that could directly or indirectly influence appointments and major policy shifts in state owned commercial banks (Figure 3.4).
1998 年重组后，大型四行总部提名高级管理人员，这些提名须经 PBOC、CFWC 批准，最终还要经 CCP 中央组织部批准（Heilmann 2005）。各银行总部任命地方行经理人选，仅需经 PBOC 和 CFWC 批准。地方政府不再直接参与任命大型四行的支行经理。金融体系内的党员不再向地方党委负责，而是有了自己的党内委员会等级体系，最终由 CFWC 领导（Liu 和 Lu 1999：135）。CFWC 还获得了批准股份制银行和地方银行经理任命的权力，尽管这些银行的股东和地方党委在提名人选方面大概拥有更多回旋余地（Yan 1999）。在制度上，对大型四行的地方主导时代在 1998 年宣告结束。尽管如此，地方政府的非正式干预，尤其是在政治气氛合适时，仍然是银行体系的常见特征。 如图 3.4 所示，只有国家银行总行对省级分行拥有直接控制权，而地方政府仅保留非正式影响力。尽管如此，1998 年出现了更多令人困惑的中央机构体系，这些机构无论在国家层面还是党内层面都可以直接或间接影响国有商业银行的人事任命和重大政策调整（见图 3.4）。
In addition to consolidating management appointments, CFWC also concentrated Party discipline work within the financial system. The CDIC inspection teams transformed into the Central Finance Disciplinary Work Committee (Zhongyang Jinrong Jilu Gongzuo Weiyuanhui), headed by both the CFWC and the CDIC (Wen 1999: 798). The CFWC also had the additional power to send monitoring committees (jianchahui) to the headquarters and branch offices of any state-related financial institution in China to examine its books (Heilmann 2005). Although the monitoring committees were tasked with
除了整合管理任命外，CFWC 还将党纪工作集中在金融体系内部。CDIC 的检查小组转变为中央金融纪律工作委员会（中央金融纪律工作委员会，Zhongyang Jinrong Jilu Gongzuo Weiyuanhui），由 CFWC 和 CDIC 共同领导（Wen 1999: 798）。CFWC 还拥有向中国任何与国家有关的金融机构的总部和分支机构派出监查委员会（jianchahui）以审查其账目的额外权力（Heilmann 2005）。尽管监查委员会的任务是
Figure 8: figure 3.4. Centralized Administration of the Banking System: Post-1998. Note: Arrows indicate the flow of administrative authority.
图 8：图 3.4. 银行业体系的集中管理：1998 年后。注：箭头表示行政权力的流向。
investigating cases of corruption, their reports also had a bearing on the promotion of managers. 12 12 ^(12){ }^{12} As with the appointment system, this new monitoring structure minimized the influence of the local Party committee.
在调查腐败案件时，他们的报告也影响了对管理者的晋升。 12 12 ^(12){ }^{12} 与任命制度一样，这种新的监督结构最大限度地减少了地方党委员会的影响力。
Despite drastic institutional changes, the weight of the Party in the financial system did not diminished, as shown in Figure 3.4. The CFWC oversaw the PBOC, the Big Four state banks, as well as policy banks and joint-stock banks. After the abolition of the CFWC in 2002, the CCP established the Leading Group on State-owned Banking Reform, headed by Vice Premier Huang Ju and the newly appointed governor of the PBOC, Zhou Xiaochuan. Although some of the regulatory duties of the CFWC were moved to the newly established China Banking Regulatory Commission, a state organ, the Leading Group maintained appointment power and policy power over the major state-owned banks, as shown in Figure 3.4 (Shih 2005). Thus, the Party’s tight grip over the financial sector did not relax even after the latest round of restructuring.
尽管制度发生了巨大变化，但党在金融体系中的分量并未减轻，如图 3.4 所示。CFWC 监管着 PBOC、四大国有银行，以及政策性银行和股份制银行。2002 年 CFWC 被撤销后，中共成立了由副总理黄菊和新任 PBOC 行长周小川领导的国有银行改革领导小组。尽管 CFWC 的一些监管职责被转移到新成立的国家机关——中国银行业监督管理委员会，领导小组仍然对主要国有银行保持任命权和政策权力，如图 3.4 所示（Shih 2005）。因此，即使在最新一轮重组之后，党对金融部门的紧密控制也没有放松。
Throughout both the decentralized period and the centralized period, senior managers, especially those in the Big Four banks and the policy banks, were
在分权时期和集权时期，尤其在四大银行和政策性银行中，高级管理人员，尤其是那些在四大银行和政策性银行的管理者，一直是
politicians whose careers rode on the central leadership’s perception of them. Banking insiders repeatedly admitted to me that they were still politicians responsive to the political signals emanating from the Politburo. 13 13 ^(13){ }^{13} Because of this, formal institutions, although significant, were not the determining factor in monetary policies and reform outcomes.
那些政治生涯取决于中央领导对他们看法的官员。银行内部人士多次对我承认，他们仍然是对来自政治局的政治信号作出反应的政治人物。 13 13 ^(13){ }^{13} 因此，尽管正式制度具有重要性，但并非货币政策和改革结果的决定性因素。
To be sure, the decentralized administrative structure of the banking system before 1998 gave local government an advantage in taking control over local monetary policies. Yet, time and again, they ceded that control to the central government when they sensed that the central leadership was determined to centralize monetary policy. Similarly, although the 1998 restructuring gave those who favored centralized monetary policy a weapon to prevent local influence, local government officials continued their intervention in the banking sector when they received favorable signals from their factional patrons in the Standing Committee. The monitoring system governed by the Party was as capable of punishing violators of formal rules as it was of turning a blind eye to them.
诚然，1998 年之前银行体系的分权行政结构使地方政府在掌控地方货币政策方面占有优势。然而，当他们感到中央领导决心将货币政策集中化时，他们一次又一次地将这种控制让渡给中央政府。同样，尽管 1998 年的重组为主张集中货币政策者提供了一种防止地方影响的手段，但当地方政府官员从常务委员会的派系保护者那里收到有利信号时，仍然继续干预银行业。由党所主导的监控体系既有能力惩罚违反正式规则者，也有能力对其视而不见。

Conclusion  结论

The institutions that controlled money supply in China could release a deluge of funds into the economy. At the same time, the central government retained multiple levers to constrain the expansion of money supply. The national credit plan and later the asset-liability management had numerous loopholes, which allowed local officials to exploit the banking system for local growth. Yet the Party and the PBOC retained the ability to track the amount of funds released into the economy such that when the central government had the political resolve, it could still halt the expansion of credit and punish those who violated credit restrictions.
控制货币供应的机构可以向中国经济释放大量资金。与此同时，中央政府保留了多种杠杆来约束货币供应的扩张。国家信贷计划以及后来的资产负债管理存在诸多漏洞，使地方官员能够利用银行体系促进地方增长。尽管如此，党和中国人民银行仍保留追踪释放到经济中的资金数量的能力，因此当中央政府具有政治决心时，仍然可以阻止信贷扩张并惩处那些违反信贷限制的人。
Knowing these institutional features, however, gives us little analytical leverage to predict financial performance in China. Although the central bank independence literature (Alesina and Summers 1993; Fischer 1995; Rogoff 1985) informs us that the Chinese economy probably suffers from higher inflation rates than countries with an independent central bank, we cannot use this framework to predict the extent of China’s inflation problem. At the same time, East Asian miracle theorists would have us believe that China, because of its highly insulated financial policy-making process, has the perfect institutional environment for high growth, low inflation, and high efficiency (Lee and Haggard 1995). As Chapter 2 showed, this prediction is also inaccurate.
然而，仅了解这些制度特征并不能为我们预测中国的金融表现提供多少分析杠杆。尽管中央银行独立性文献（Alesina and Summers 1993；Fischer 1995；Rogoff 1985）告诉我们，与拥有独立中央银行的国家相比，中国经济很可能遭受更高的通货膨胀率，但我们无法用该框架来预测中国通胀问题的程度。与此同时，东亚奇迹理论者会让我们相信，由于中国具有高度封闭的金融决策过程，它拥有实现高增长、低通胀和高效率的完美制度环境（Lee and Haggard 1995）。正如第 2 章所示，这一预测也不准确。
As later chapters contend, political signals sent through both the formal channels and through the factional network, rather than shifting institutional configurations, were the primary determinants of monetary policy in reformera China. Throughout much of the period, the decentralized structure of the banking system provided an advantage to those in favor of monetary decentralization. Yet, ample mechanisms existed for centralizers, or members of
正如后面的章节所论述的那样，通过正式渠道和党派网络所传递的政治信号，而非制度配置的变动，才是改革时代中国货币政策的主要决定因素。在大部分时期内，银行体系的分权结构为支持货币分权的人士提供了优势。然而，集权者或属于
the technocratic factions, to rein in banking power when the political conditions presented themselves. Under the right political condition, central bureaucrats took advantage of these mechanisms to regain control. As we saw in the most recent inflationary cycle, local leaders exploited favorable political conditions to force banks to finance local development projects even under a set of highly centralized financial institutions. It is precisely the political conditions for monetary centralization and decentralization that this work mainly concerns.
技术官僚派系在适当的政治条件出现时，会利用这些机制遏制银行权力。在合适的政治条件下，中央官僚利用这些手段重新夺回控制权。正如我们在最近一次通胀周期中所见，当地领导人在有利的政治条件下，利用银行为地方发展项目提供资金，即便在高度集中的金融机构体系下也是如此。本书主要关注的，正是导致货币集中化与分散化的政治条件。

Factional Politics and its Financial Implications
派系政治及其金融影响

How do relatively low inflation in the form of inflationary cycles and chronic inefficiency in capital allocation, two phenomena that suggest different policy making processes, coexist in the same financial system? While manageable inflation rates and the absence of hyperinflation suggest technocratic control over financial policies, chronic inefficiency in the form of high nonperforming loan ratios indicates political intervention in the banking sector. In brief, the answer provided in this chapter - and in the entire work - is that top leaders’ desire for power and the uncertain political environment in which they operate compel them to pursue factional politics, which creates the political environment for inflationary cycles and the dearth of significant financial market reform.
相对较低的通货膨胀（以通货膨胀周期的形式表现）与资本配置长期低效这两种看似由不同政策制定过程导致的现象，如何在同一金融体系中共存？可控的通货膨胀率和没有出现恶性通货膨胀表明在金融政策上存在技术官僚式的控制，而高不良贷款率等长期低效则表明银行业受到政治干预。简言之，本章——以及整部著作——给出的答案是：最高领导人的权力欲望和他们所处的不确定政治环境迫使他们从事派系政治，这为通货膨胀周期的出现和重大金融市场改革缺失创造了政治基础。
This chapter builds on institutional features described in Chapter 3 and on China’s elite political dynamics to derive a factional model to explain inflationary cycles and inefficiency in the Chinese financial system. The two types of factions - one endowed with broad membership across the party apparatus and the provinces and the other endowed with technocrats in the central government compete with one another over the degree of monetary centralization, which induces inflationary cycles. Although the competitions between the generalist and technocratic factions are not zero-sum contests for ultimate control of the party, they have clearly divergent preferences over monetary policies, which compel them to mobilize political resources at their disposal to gain the upper hand. This tense interaction manages to constrain inflation in China. However, because factional politics cultivates short time horizon, both types of factions prioritize short-term factional gains over other objectives. The resulting lack of cohesive long-term financial strategy chronically hinders significant financial system reform.
本章在第 3 章所述的制度特征及中国精英政治动态的基础上，推导出一个帮派模型，以解释通货膨胀周期和中国金融体系的低效率。这两类帮派——一类在党务系统和省级层面拥有广泛成员基础，另一类则由中央政府的技术官僚组成——在货币集中度问题上相互竞争，从而引发通货膨胀周期。尽管泛能型帮派与技术官僚型帮派之间的竞争并非为党内最终控制权的零和争夺，但他们在货币政策上有明显分歧的偏好，这迫使他们动员手中可用的政治资源以争取上风。这种紧张的互动在一定程度上制约了中国的通货膨胀。然而，由于帮派政治培育了短期视角，两类帮派都将短期帮派利益置于其他目标之上。由此导致的缺乏连贯的长期金融战略长期阻碍了重大金融体系改革。

Power Seeking in an Uncertain Environment
在不确定环境中的权力寻求

Because of the CCP’s total domination over the banking system, top Chinese leaders have ample opportunities to intervene in the banks. That fact alone,
由于中共对银行体系的全面控制，最高领导人有充足的机会干预银行。仅凭这一事实，
however, does not give us analytical leverage over the preferences of top leaders, which inform us how they would intervene in the banking system. Without knowing the origins of elite preferences and the way in which intervention occurs, we cannot generate hypotheses about the effect these interventions have on banking sector performance and on the economy overall. Thus, this chapter first provides an account of the leadership’s preferences by examining the role factions play in Chinese politics.
并不能为我们对最高领导人的偏好提供分析上的杠杆，后者决定了他们会如何干预银行体系。如果不知道精英偏好的来源以及干预的发生方式，我们就无法提出关于这些干预对银行业绩及整体经济影响的假设。因此，本章首先通过考察派系在中国政治中所起的作用来阐述领导层的偏好。
The emphasis on factions stems from two fundamental assumptions about Chinese politics. First, top leaders in the Chinese political system value the retention and expansion of power above any ideological or policy preference. Second, because of the dearth of credible formal institutions and procedures to measure and transfer power at the elite level, top leaders face incessant threats to their authority. These assumptions are by no means uncontroversial, but, on the whole, they accord with political reality in China. The first assumption comes from a rich tradition in political science dating at least from Machiavelli and, more recently, from the concept of the politicians as office-seekers (Mayhew 1974). The argument here is twofold. First, even if politicians have a strong preference for a set of policies or ideas, they need to retain power in order to realize them. Second, as Ramseyer and Rosenbluth (1998: 5) put it, “politicians who ignore their competitors eventually disappear.”
对派系的重视源自关于中国政治的两个基本假设。第一，中国政治体系中的最高领导人把保有和扩张权力置于任何意识形态或政策偏好之上。第二，由于缺乏可信的正式制度和程序来衡量并在精英层面转移权力，最高领导人面临不断的权威威胁。这些假设并非毫无争议，但总体上与中国的政治现实相符。第一个假设来自政治学的丰富传统，至少可以追溯到马基雅维利，最近也体现在把政治家视为谋求官职者的观点（Mayhew 1974）。这里的论点有两层。其一，即便政治家对某一套政策或思想有强烈偏好，他们也需要保有权力才能实现这些偏好。其二，正如 Ramseyer 和 Rosenbluth（1998：5）所言，“忽视竞争对手的政治家最终会消失。”
In the Chinese context, although official positions do not always translate to actual power, a politician, whether holding an office or not, needs to retain a certain amount of influence in order to affect the policy process (Huang 2000: 5). A strong manifestation of the power-seeking tendency of most senior officials is the prevalence of bandwagoning behavior. Essentially, when senior cadres sense that the tide is turning against a colleague, they seldom lend a helping hand, even if that person is in the right (Goldstein 1991). The most glaring example of this phenomenon took place during the Lushan Conference in 1959. At the conference, the vast majority of cadres stood by while Peng Dehuai, who had written a private letter to Mao on the disastrous result of the Great Leap Forward, was publicly berated then purged by Mao (MacFarquhar 1983: 187). A more contemporary example was Wan Li’s support of the 1989 Tiananmen massacre. Although he initially supported a more moderate approach toward the students, he ultimately joined the hard-liners when the tide had turned against Zhao Ziyang (Nathan and Link 2001:305). Even at times when a strong moral protest could have made a difference, Chinese leaders seldom chose to exercise that option.
在中国语境中，尽管正式职务并不总是等同于实际权力，但一位政治家，无论是否掌握职务，都需要保有一定的影响力以影响政策进程（Huang 2000: 5）。大多数高级官员追逐权力倾向的一个强烈表现是从众行为的普遍存在。本质上，当高级干部感觉形势对某位同僚转向不利时，他们很少伸出援手，即便那个人是正确的（Goldstein 1991）。这一现象最显著的例子发生在 1959 年的庐山会议。会议上，绝大多数干部袖手旁观，而彭德怀因向毛写了一封关于“大跃进”灾难性后果的私人信件，被毛公开训斥并随后被清洗（MacFarquhar 1983: 187）。一个更当代的例子是万里对 1989 年天安门屠杀的支持。尽管他最初主张对学生采取更温和的办法，但当反赵紫阳的潮流形成时，他最终加入了强硬派（Nathan and Link 2001:305）。 即便在强烈的道德抗议本可以起到作用的时候，中国领导人很少选择行使这一选项。
The bandwagoning tendency fortifies the second argument that the process of politics eventually eliminates or transforms the pure idealists. In China, where the same group of leaders interacted for over half a century, this especially holds true. Those who were unwilling to bend with the political wind were inevitably eliminated. Idealists who were eliminated early on included the Communist Party’s founder Chen Duxiu and later loyal Comintern agent Li Lisan. The survivors of this three-quarter-century-long political struggle - with the exception
从众倾向强化了第二个论点，即政治的进程最终会消除或改造纯粹的理想主义者。在中国，同一批领导人互动超过半个世纪，这一点尤为明显。不愿随政治潮流而动的人不可避免地被淘汰。早期被淘汰的理想主义者包括共产党创始人陈独秀，以及后来忠诚的共产国际代理人李立三。在这场延续了三分之一个世纪的政治斗争中幸存下来的人——除毛之外——往往不是第一个倡导某个观点的人，而是那些保持沉默的人。
of Mao - often were those who kept quiet rather than those who were the first to advocate an idea. They often tested the political wind before making their positions clear. They also readily abandoned their allies and friends in order to maintain their power. The two great survivors in the Chinese political system, Zhou Enlai and Deng Xiaoping, were skilled at bowing to the strong and at betraying former allies.
他们常常在表明立场之前先试探政治风向。他们也会为保住权力而毫不犹豫地抛弃同盟与朋友。中国政治体制中的两位伟大幸存者周恩来和邓小平，善于向强者屈服并背叛昔日盟友。
The task of retaining and expanding power in the Chinese political system is complicated by the lack of institutional definition of power and procedures for transferring power. Although an official post confers a degree of actual power, the degree to which one is able to exercise official power often depends on one’s informal influence. For example, Mao’s designated successor Hua Guofeng held all of the top positions but lost most of his informal power at the Third Plenum in 1978 when Deng and his allies overturned Hua’s policies (Baum 1994: 66). At the same time, Deng Xiaoping and Chen Yun had an enormous impact on economic policies in reform-era China, although both held only honorary positions by the early 1990s. With vaguely defined authority, Chinese leaders need to ensure that their informal influence keeps up with or even surpasses their formal positions.
在中国政治体制中，保有和扩大权力的任务因缺乏对权力的制度性界定与权力移交程序而变得复杂。尽管一个正式职务赋予一定程度的实际权力，但能否有效行使这一正式权力常常取决于个人的非正式影响力。例如，毛指定的接班人华国锋虽掌握所有最高职务，但在 1978 年第三次全体会议上，邓小平及其盟友推翻华的政策后，华失去了大部分非正式权力（Baum 1994: 66）。与此同时，邓小平和陈云在改革时代对经济政策产生了巨大影响，尽管到 1990 年代初他们仅担任名誉性职务。由于权威界限不明，中国领导人需要确保其非正式影响力能够追赶甚至超过其正式职务。
To make matters worse, threats to one’s power can materialize at any time, not just before elections or Party congresses. Whereas the transference of power in democracies is often well defined and regular, power in China can slip from one’s grasp with one unfavorable article in the People’s Daily, the official mouthpiece of the Party. I I ^(I){ }^{\mathrm{I}} The reason for this highly uncertain environment is historical. Simply put, the Chinese Communist Party early on invested in an organizational model that bestows enormous power on individual leaders, has a strict hierarchy, and pays little attention to formal procedures (Huang 2000: 6; Lu 2000).
更糟糕的是，权力受到威胁可以随时出现，不仅仅在选举或党代会之前。与民主国家中权力移交通常界定清晰且有规律不同，在中国，一篇刊登在《人民日报》——党的官方喉舌——的不利文章就可能使权力从你的掌握中滑落。 I I ^(I){ }^{\mathrm{I}} 造成这种高度不确定环境的原因是历史性的。简言之，中国共产党早期选择了一种赋予个别领导人巨大权力、等级森严且不重视正式程序的组织模式（Huang 2000: 6；Lu 2000）。
Officially, power is transferred through two mechanisms, the Party congresses, which take place only once every five years, and the annual sessions of the National People’s Congress (NPC). The former selects the Party’s top leaders, while the latter elects leaders to state positions. In most instances, however, formal elections in these two bodies represent the end of power struggles. With some important exceptions, the formal meetings of the Central Committee (CC), Party congresses, and NPC sessions merely rubberstamped what had already been decided by the top leaders in the Party. 2 2 ^(2){ }^{2} Hu Yaobang
官方上，权力通过两种机制进行移交：每五年一次的党代表大会和每年一次的全国人民代表大会（NPC）年会。前者选拔党的最高领导人，后者选举国家职务的领导人。然而在大多数情况下，这两个机关的正式选举只是权力斗争的终结。除若干重要例外外，中共中央委员会（CC）、党代表大会和人大会议的正式会议不过是对党内最高领导人已作决定的形式性批准。 2 2 ^(2){ }^{2} 胡耀邦
and Zhao Ziyang, the two General Secretaries in the 1980s, both lost their jobs in the midst of their tenures after highly irregular enlarged Politburo meetings.
赵紫阳，这两位在 1980 年代担任总书记的领导人，都在任期内因几次高度不规范的扩大政治局会议而被迫下台。
The uncertainty in elite politics is further exacerbated by the dearth of reliable indicators of power. The resulting fog invites challenges to one’s power whenever a rival faction perceives weakness. To deter such challenges, a top leader in China constantly has to signal to potential rivals and lower level officials that he still retains control and influence over vital resources in the system. 3 3 ^(3){ }^{3} Favorable editorials in the People’s Daily signal one’s influence over the media. The promotion of one’s protégé denotes one’s control over the nomenklatura. Finally, favorable allocation of economic goods to one’s protégés signals one’s sway over economic policies. 4 4 ^(4){ }^{4} With little legal definition of the scope and tenure of the offices and few transparent indicators of power, a top leader must furnish the means of maintaining power himself.
精英政治中的不确定性因缺乏可靠的权力指示器而进一步加剧。由此产生的迷雾在对手派系感到对方薄弱时，会激发对权力的挑战。为遏制此类挑战，中国的最高领导人必须不断向潜在对手和下级官员发出信号，表明他仍掌握着对体制内重要资源的控制和影响力。 3 3 ^(3){ }^{3} 《人民日报》上的有利社论表明其对媒体的影响力。提拔自己的门生表明其对干部人事的掌控。最后，对自己门生有利的经济物资分配显示其对经济政策的影响力。 4 4 ^(4){ }^{4} 由于对职务范围和任期的法律界定很少，且缺乏透明的权力指标，最高领导人必须亲自提供维持权力的手段。

Factions and Political Survival
派系与政治生存

With the relentless need to maintain one’s influence, practitioners of politics require a coherent strategy to mitigate the fundamental uncertainty in the political system. As others have argued before me, the strategy that emerges to provide just such an insurance policy is the faction system. Lucian Pye long ago argued that “the prime basis for factions among cadres is the search for career security and the protection of power” (Pye 1981: 7).
为了持续保持影响力，政治从业者需要一套连贯的策略来减轻政治体制中的根本性不确定性。正如此前许多人所论述的那样，作为这种“保险制度”应运而生的策略就是派系体系。Lucian Pye 早在很久以前就指出，“在干部中形成派系的主要原因是追求职业安全和权力的保护”（Pye 1981: 7）。
Founded for this specific purpose, factions thus are distinct from opinion groups and interest groups in important ways. As stated in the introduction to this book, faction is a personal network of reciprocity that seeks to preserve and expand the power of the patron. Whereas a faction is semipermanent, based on a quest for power, and reliant on lower officials for support, an opinion group is temporary, based on a single issue, and composed only of top leaders (Dittmer 1995; Schurmann 1968: 55). At the same time, an interest group seeks to maximize well-defined economic or ideational interests and usually outlasts the leadership of any particular individual, whereas a faction seldom survives its patron. 5 5 ^(5){ }^{5} Although opinion groups have an important impact on some policy outcomes, they are coalitions of convenience and thus cannot provide a
派系为达到这一特定目的而成立，因此在重要方面有别于意见集团和利益集团。如本书导言所述，派系是一个以互惠为基础的私人网络，旨在维护并扩大恩主的权力。派系具有半永久性，基于对权力的追求，并依赖下级官员的支持；而意见集团是临时性的，基于单一议题，并且仅由最高领导层组成（Dittmer 1995；Schurmann 1968：55）。与此同时，利益集团追求最大化明确的经济或观念利益，通常比任何特定个人的领导任期更持久，而派系很少能在其恩主之后存续。 5 5 ^(5){ }^{5} 虽然意见集团对某些政策结果有重要影响，但它们是出于权宜的联盟，因此无法提供一种
consistent explanation of financial outcomes throughout the reform. For example, Chen Yun made temporary alliances with ideological conservatives to attack the special economic zones (SEZs) in the 1980s. However, as I will show in Chapter 6, these alliances aimed to protect factional interests through pressuring Deng into acquiescing to financial centralization. Opinion groups were merely temporary means to the consistent end of factional interests. Although there were a few cases of genuine interest groups, most local or sectoral leaders obtained preferential policies and financial allocations through their connections with individual leaders in the Politburo. 6 6 ^(6){ }^{6} Moreover, the ultimate goal of lobbying was often personal or factional advancement rather than the promotion of an impersonal interest.
在整个改革过程中，关于金融结果的解释是一致的。例如，陈云在 1980 年代与意识形态保守派结成临时联盟，抨击经济特区（SEZ）。然而，正如我将在第 6 章展示的，这些联盟旨在通过施压邓小平让步以保护派系利益，从而推动金融集中化。舆论群体不过是实现派系利益这一始终如一目标的暂时手段。尽管确有少数真正的利益群体案例，但大多数地方或部门领导是通过与政治局个别领导人的关系获得优惠政策和财政拨款的。此外，游说的最终目标往往是个人或派系的晋升，而非促进一种无人格的利益。
In order to clarify the roles factions play in the political system, I first make a distinction between two strata of officials: top leaders and high level cadres who are not at the center of power. These two strata of officials compose the patrons and clients of elite factions respectively. Top leaders are each their own “mountaintop.” They often serve in the Standing Committee of the Politburo, although sometimes they have enormous authority without any formal position (Lieberthal and Oksenberg 1988: 36). Among the top leaders, one “helmsman” often wields more influence than the others, which bestows on him the dominant faction. The dominant faction often controls the most powerful offices in the CC and has a great deal of agenda-setting power in Politburo meetings. Nevertheless, with the exception of a few brief dictatorial periods under Mao, discussions, debates, and political struggle among top leaders played a crucial role in the outcome of almost every important issue. Moreover, despite a strong advantage from holding formal offices, the dominant faction remains vulnerable to political attacks by rival factions, especially when a major policy failure occurs. In the classic example, Hua Guofeng lost power quickly despite concurrently holding the positions of Party Chairman, Premier, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission.
为了阐明派系在政治体制中所起的作用，我首先区分两类官员：最高领导人和不处于权力中心的高级干部。这两类官员分别构成了精英派系的赞助者和客户。最高领导人各自都是他们自己的“山顶”。他们通常在中央政治局常务委员会任职，尽管有时即使没有任何正式职务也拥有巨大的权力（Lieberthal and Oksenberg 1988: 36）。在最高领导人中，常有一位“舵手”比其他人更具影响力，这赋予他主导派系的地位。主导派系往往掌控中央委员会中最有权势的职务，并在政治局会议中拥有很大的议程设置权。然而，除了在毛泽东统治下的少数短暂独裁时期外，最高领导人之间的讨论、辩论和政治斗争在几乎每一个重大问题的结果中都发挥了关键作用。此外，尽管在掌握正式职务方面具有显著优势，主导派系仍然易受对立派系的政治攻击，尤其是在发生重大政策失败时。 在经典例子中，华国锋尽管同时担任党主席、总理，却迅速失势，中央军委主席。
Senior cadres, by contrast, are officials at the vice minister/vice governor/vice provincial Party secretary level or above. Some of them are eventually promoted to the Politburo Standing Committee and even become factional patrons themselves. Although they tend to be outside of the top leadership and obey orders issued by the Politburo, they nonetheless provide valuable resources to top leaders engaging in power competition. The provincial leadership has historically served as the main mover in the implementation of central policies at the grassroots level (Cheung 1998b). As such, central leaders who want to launch a new set of policies have to appeal to the enthusiasm of the provincial leadership. Moreover, provincial leaders control the provincial propaganda
相比之下，高级干部是指副部长、副省长或省委副书记级别及以上的官员。他们中有些人最终会被提升为政治局常务委员会成员，甚至成为派系的赞助者。尽管他们往往处于最高领导层之外并服从政治局发布的命令，但他们仍为参与权力竞争的最高领导人提供重要资源。历来，省级领导在中央政策向基层落实中发挥着主导作用（Cheung 1998b）。因此，想要推出一套新政策的中央领导必须争取省级领导的积极配合。此外，省级领导掌控着省级宣传工作
apparatus, which is often used by senior leaders to launch ideological attacks against rivals.
该机构常被高层领导用来对竞争对手发动意识形态攻击。
In the State Council, ministers hold important positions because they set the agenda for specific policies by providing important information to the top leaders (Bachman 1991: 8). Moreover, top bureaucrats can paralyze policy implementation by not resolving the myriad conflicts of interests that arise with every policy (Lieberthal and Oksenberg 1988: 131). Also, the representation of this stratum of officials in the Central Committee confers them at least the formal authority over the selection of top leaders, which affects the ability of faction members to advance into the Politburo (Shirk 1993: 7I). Finally, this stratum of officials produces rumors that establish the reputation of top leaders, which can make or break a leader. In sum, provincial and ministerial officials control valuable resources that factional patrons can mobilize in the course of political struggles.
在国务院，部长们占据重要位置，因为他们通过向最高领导提供重要信息来为具体政策设定议程（Bachman 1991：8）。此外，高级官僚可以通过不解决每项政策都会产生的众多利益冲突而瘫痪政策执行（Lieberthal 和 Oksenberg 1988：131）。另外，这一层级官员在中央委员会的代表性赋予他们至少在形式上对高层领导人选的权威，这影响了派系成员晋升到政治局的能力（Shirk 1993：71）。最后，这一层级的官员制造的谣言会建立或破坏高层领导人的声誉，从而成就或毁掉一位领导人。总之，省级和部级官员控制着派系恩主在政治斗争过程中可以动员的有价值资源。
In the exchange relationship of a faction, top leaders use factions to maintain a network of loyal officials who support them during political challenges. Factions are also useful to demonstrate the top leaders’ power between challenges to discourage attacks. Meanwhile, protégés obtain political protection, either lateral or vertical promotions, preferential allocation of financial resources, and control over policies through the faction system. At its heart, factional distribution of offices and economic goods increases the opportunity cost of defection to another faction, which decreases uncertainty for top leaders. 7 7 ^(7){ }^{7} Essentially, if followers defect to another faction, they would forgo certain payoffs at the current faction for uncertain payoffs at another faction (Bueno de Mesquita et al. 2003: 83). This motivates factional followers to remain loyal even when another faction launches an attack. Of course, as the probability of being overwhelmed by another faction increases, followers of a faction would inevitably defect to another faction. Despite the inevitability of bandwagoning as the outcome of a struggle becomes clear, the distribution of resources to factional members prevents them from defecting at the first sign of trouble, which allows factional leaders to launch counterattacks against rivals. 8 8 ^(8){ }^{8} For example, Mao relied on the Party apparatus in Shanghai to set the stage for the Cultural Revolution. Similarly, Deng mobilized the Shanghai Party apparatus and later the Guangdong
在派系的交换关系中，最高领导人利用派系维持一张忠诚官员网络，在政治挑战中提供支持。派系也有助于在挑战之间展示最高领导人的权力，以威慑进攻。与此同时，门徒通过派系体系获得政治保护、横向或纵向的晋升、财政资源的优先分配以及对政策的控制。派系在分配职务和经济利益方面的核心作用是提高叛离到其他派系的机会成本，从而降低了最高领导人的不确定性。 7 7 ^(7){ }^{7} 本质上，如果追随者叛变到其他派系，他们将放弃在当前派系获得的确定收益，去换取在另一派系的不确定收益（Bueno de Mesquita 等，2003：83）。这促使派系追随者即使在另一个派系发动攻击时也保持忠诚。当然，随着被另一派系碾压的概率增加，派系的追随者不可避免地会叛变到其他派系。 尽管随着斗争结果变得明朗，跟风站队成为不可避免的结果，但向派系成员分配资源使他们不会在出现第一个问题迹象时就背离，从而使派系领导人能够对对手发起反击。例如，毛依靠上海的党组织为文化大革命铺平了道路。 类似地，邓动员了上海党部机关，后来又动员了广东
Party committee in 1991 and 1992 to launch his criticism of the central technocratic faction (see Chapter 7).
在 1991 年和 1992 年，他动员了党委员会来发起对中央技术官僚派系的批评（见第 7 章）。
Without clear indicators of the top leaders’ relative power, the ability to distribute investment and offices to factional followers also signals the power of a top leader. The promotion of a protégé to either the CC or to the Politburo not only increases the patron’s political support in these institutions but also communicates to rivals of one’s power. Similarly, protection of factional followers from purges or corruption investigations provides security to the followers, but also signals the power of the patron. For example, Jiang Zemin’s ability to stop the corruption investigation of his protégé Jia Qinglin, who served as Party secretary of Fujian during the height of smuggling, informed his rivals and followers alike of his rising power (Lin 2000). Essentially, the promotion and protection of factional followers constitute credible signals of power, which deter others from attacking the faction.
在缺乏明确显示最高领导人相对权力的指标时，分配投资和官职给派系追随者的能力也会传达出最高领导人的权力。将门生提拔到中央委员会或政治局不仅增加了恩主在这些机构中的政治支持，也向竞争对手传递了其权力。同样，保护派系追随者免遭清洗或腐败调查不仅为追随者提供了安全保障，同时也表明了恩主的权力。例如，江泽民阻止对其门生贾庆林的腐败调查——贾在走私高峰期曾任福建省委书记——就向其竞争对手和追随者都传递了他权力上升的信息（Lin 2000）。本质上，对派系追随者的提拔和保护构成了可信的权力信号，从而威慑他人对该派系发动攻击。
Although factions provide political insurance to high-level cadres mainly through the allocation and the preservation of official positions, the faction system has evolved to allocate other scarce goods in the political system, especially economic goods and control over policies. The allocation of economic goods through the factions serves the familiar purposes of maintaining loyalty and strengthening the perceived power of the patron. In Walder’s classic study, he shows that the absolute rule of the Party secretary at the firm level enabled him or her to allocate vital resources to favorite underlings, including housing, medical care, and special food (Walder 1986). Although reform has diminished the CCP’s monopoly over economic resources to a considerable extent, the Party still has the authority to allocate substantial nonmarket rent, including favorable investment policies, tax breaks, bank loans, and direct fiscal subsidies. Another type of good that can be distributed is the right to distribute nonmarket rent. Top leaders can determine which bureaucracy or level of government has the authority to make favorable investment policies or to dictate the credit ceiling of the various regions and sectors. 9 9 ^(9){ }^{9}
尽管派系主要通过官职的分配与保全为高层干部提供政治保险，但派系体系已经演变为在政治体系中分配其他稀缺物品，尤其是经济物品和对政策的控制。通过派系分配经济物品的目的仍是维护忠诚并强化主客（patron）被感知的权力。在 Walder 的经典研究中，他表明在企业层面上党书记的绝对权力使其能够将重要资源分配给偏爱的下属，包括住房、医疗和特色菜（Walder 1986）。尽管改革在很大程度上削弱了中共对经济资源的垄断，党仍然有权分配大量的非市场租金，包括优惠的投资政策、税收减免、银行贷款和直接财政补贴。另一类可以被分配的物品是分配非市场租金的权利。 最高领导人可以决定哪个官僚机构或哪个政府层级有权制定有利的投资政策或规定各地区和各行业的信贷上限。 9 9 ^(9){ }^{9}
In terms of the allocation of economic resources, at least two distinct types of preferences should be recognized on the demand side. These preferences form the basis of the two types of factions discussed later. First, provincial leaders have a strong preference for the distribution of economic goods for their own sake. Although they scramble for control over policies, their ultimate objective is to obtain more capital with which to pursue provincial economic growth (Gore 1999b; Huang 1996: 63). 10 10 ^(10){ }^{10} The single-minded pursuit of money and growth aims at increasing a provincial leader’s chance of promotion and at providing more opportunities for rent-seeking activities.
在经济资源分配方面，需求端至少应识别出两种不同类型的偏好。这些偏好构成了后文讨论的两类派系的基础。首先，省级领导人对经济资源的分配有强烈的偏好，出于自身利益。尽管他们争夺对政策的控制，但他们的最终目标是获得更多资本以推动省域经济增长（Gore 1999b；Huang 1996：63）。单纯追求金钱和增长旨在提高省级领导人晋升的机会，并提供更多寻租活动的机会。
Central bureaucrats who have the rank of vice minister or above constitute the second type of cadres among potential factional clients. Unlike provincial leaders, their careers and prestige are dependent on their control over policies.
具有副部长或以上级别职务的中央官僚构成了潜在派系客户中的第二类干部。与省级领导不同，他们的职业生涯和声望依赖于他们对政策的控制。
According to interviewees, central and local governments and different agencies of the central government struggle endlessly for control over various policies. The goal of hoarding discretion over important policy areas is for ministers to accumulate “administrative merits” (zhengji), which, together with patronage from the top, pave the way for a bureaucrat’s rise to the top of the State Council or to the Politburo. II II  ^("II "){ }^{\text {II }} Since the reform, cultivating the perceived ability to resolve pressing issues confronting the regime has served as an effective strategy of obtaining promotion. Zhu Rongji himself rose rapidly through the ranks by “solving” the hyperinflation problem in 1993 and the triangular debt quagmire in the early 1990s. In order to do so effectively, discretion over a policy area and the control of crucial resources, especially the banking system, become vital. In fact, Zhu solved both of these problems through manipulating various aspects of the banking sector. Thus, there is an important distinction between the motivation of top bureaucrats in China and that of their counterparts in the developed world. Whereas mid-level bureaucrats in the United States often are motivated by the autonomy and survival of the bureaus - as Wilson (1989) and Downs (1967) note -, ministers and vice ministers in China are motivated instead by their career prospects and advancement in the CCP-dominated hierarchy.
据受访者称，中央与地方政府以及中央政府的不同机构为争夺各项政策的控制权而不断斗争。囤积对重要政策领域的裁量权的目标是让部长们积累“行政功绩”（zhengji），这些功绩连同来自高层的庇护，共同为官僚升至国务院首席或进入政治局铺平道路。 II II  ^("II "){ }^{\text {II }} 自改革以来，培养解决困扰政权的紧迫问题的被感知能力已成为获取晋升的有效策略。朱镕基本人就是通过在 1993 年“解决”恶性通货膨胀问题和在 1990 年代初解决三角债泥潭而迅速晋升的。要有效做到这一点，对一个政策领域的裁量权以及对关键资源，尤其是银行体系的控制就变得至关重要。事实上，朱是通过操控银行业的各个方面来解决这两个问题的。因此，中国高层官僚的动机与发达国家同行的动机之间存在一个重要区别。 在美国，中层官僚通常以部门的自主权和生存为动机——正如 Wilson (1989) 和 Downs (1967) 所指出的——而在中国，部长和副部长则更多以其在 CCP 主导的层级中的职业前途和晋升为动机。
These two distinct types of preferences, one emphasizing the decentralization of money creation and the other on the concentration of policy power, form the bases of two distinct types of factions, two political strategies, and two monetary outcomes in the Chinese economy.
这两种不同的偏好类型：一种强调货币创造的分权，另一种强调政策权力的集中，构成了两类不同派系、两种政治策略以及中国经济中两种货币结果的基础。

Two Types of Factions, Two Strategies, Two Outcomes
两类派系、两种策略、两种结果

The two types of preferences stated earlier coincide with fairly stable factional types because of institutional features in the CCP that channel officials into distinct career paths. Cadres typically spend more than half of their careers rising through a particular xitong, or bureaucratic system, which is divided both geographically and functionally (Lieberthal 2004: 218). 12 12 ^(12){ }^{12} The Central Organization Department (COD) then rotates some cadres through a series of different positions across the state and the Party, whereas other cadres become specialists and rise vertically more or less in a given bureaucracy. This tendency is further enforced in the reform era when the COD began to vet cadres in the economic bureaucracies separately from party functionaries (Cui 2003: 455). As cadres in these two types of career tracks move upward, they acquire factional followers with distinct makeup.
前述的两类偏好由于中共内部的制度性特征而与相对稳定的派系类型相吻合，这些制度性特征将官员引导到不同的职业路径中。干部通常在某一特定的系统（xitong，或官僚体制）中度过其职业生涯的一半以上，该系统在地域和职能上都有划分（Lieberthal 2004: 218）。中央组织部（COD）随后把部分干部在国家和党内的一系列不同岗位间轮换，而另一些干部则成为专业人才，在某一既定的官僚机构中或多或少垂直晋升。改革时期中央组织部开始将经济官僚与党务官员分别考察（Cui 2003: 455），进一步强化了这种倾向。当处于这两类职业轨迹的干部上升时，他们会带来构成各异的派系追随者。
For our purposes here, the two relevant types of factions are the generalist factions and the technocratic factions, which essentially have the two types of preferences outlined in the previous section. As can be seen in Figure 4.1, the
在我们这里的讨论中，两个相关的派系类型是通才派系和技术官僚派系，二者基本上对应前一节所述的两类偏好。如图 4.1 所示，...
leaders of both types of factions are survivors of the cut-throat climb into the Standing Committee of the Politburo, giving them considerable political power. A generalist faction is headed by a senior Party leader with extensive experience in local governments and in the Party apparatus. This career trajectory allows him to recruit followers from the provinces, the army, and central party organs during the course of his rise through the ranks (see Figure 4.I). The resulting membership composition affords generalist factions control of provinces, army commands, and central Party organs, which equip them for the competition for supremacy in the Party. Without these important linkages, it would be difficult for a leader to hold on to power for long. For the same reason, however, generalist factions are often latent or explicit rivals of each other because every generalist faction has the means of usurping power. In the 1980s, generalist factions included those led by Deng Xiaoping, Hu Yaobang, Zhao Ziyang, and Ye Jianying. In the 1990s, the key generalist factions were led by Jiang Zemin, Hu Jintao, Li Ruihuan, and Qiao Shi.
两类派系的领导人都是经过激烈攀爬进入政治局常务委员会的幸存者，这使他们拥有相当大的政治权力。综合型派系由在地方政府和党内机关具有丰富经验的资深党内领导人领导。这种职业轨迹使他在晋升过程中能够从各省、军队和中央党机关吸收追随者（参见图 4.I）。由此形成的成员构成使综合型派系控制了省级地方、军区指挥以及中央党机关，使他们具备在党内争夺最高权力的条件。如果没有这些重要的联结，领导人很难长期掌权。但也正因为如此，综合型派系常常彼此潜在或公开对立，因为每个综合型派系都具备篡夺权力的手段。在 20 世纪 80 年代，综合型派系包括邓小平、胡耀邦、赵紫阳和叶剑英领导的派系。到了 90 年代，关键的综合型派系由江泽民、胡锦涛、李瑞环和乔石领导。
In contrast, there are narrow factions led by senior cadres who rise through a single bureaucratic grouping and ultimately are inducted into the Standing Committee. These senior leaders do not have broad connections with various segments of the CCP but instead have extensive connections with one group of agencies (Lieberthal and Oksenberg 1988: 37). In the economic arena, the most important narrow faction is the central technocratic faction, typically led by cadres who have extensive experience in the central economic bureaucracy. 13 13 ^(13){ }^{13} The narrow powerbases of the technocratic factions - especially their lack of ties with army commanders - prevent them from competing for overall supremacy in the CCP. Despite having access to a relatively narrow range of resources, patrons of technocratic factions are nonetheless powerful politicians with a voice in leadership selection and access to the most sensitive information. Thus, they have the capacity to make life very difficult for the generalist factions. Chen Yun was one of the founders of the central economic bureaucracy in the 1950s and had cultivated myriad followers in various economic agencies by the 1980s (Huang 2000: 139). In the 1990s, Zhu Rongji, who only had three years of local administration, emerged as the head of the technocratic faction. With the bulk of his career in the State Council, his followers also rose up through the central bureaucracy (see Chapters 7 and 8).
相反，也存在由在同一官僚集团内晋升并最终进入常务委员会的高级干部领导的狭窄派系。这些高级领导人与中共各个阶层没有广泛的联系，而是与某一类机构有广泛联系（Lieberthal and Oksenberg 1988: 37）。在经济领域，最重要的狭窄派系是中央技术官僚派系，通常由在中央经济官僚机构具有丰富经验的干部领导。 13 13 ^(13){ }^{13} 技术官僚派系的狭窄权力基础——尤其是他们与军队指挥官缺乏联系——阻止了他们在中共内争夺整体最高权力。尽管只能接触相对狭窄的资源范围，技术官僚派系的庇护人仍然是有影响力的政治人物，参与领导人选拔并能获得最敏感的信息。因此，他们有能力让普遍派系的处境变得非常艰难。陈云是 1950 年代中央经济官僚机构的创始人之一，并在 1980 年代之前在各个经济机构培植了大量追随者（Huang 2000: 139）。 在 1990 年代，朱镕基在地方行政岗位仅有三年经验，却崛起为技术官僚派系的领袖。由于他的主要职业生涯在国务院，他的追随者也通过中央官僚体系晋升（见第 7 章和第 8 章）。
Finally, although technocratic factions seem to cater to the interests of particular agencies, they in fact seek first and foremost to strengthen their own influence and not necessarily the power and influence of particular agencies per se. Commenting on bureaucratic politics in the 1970s, Swain observes that, “Individual leaders do play a crucial role as ‘patrons’ for general bureaucratic tendencies, but their identification with such tendency by no means prohibits them from altering their interest in the face of specific objective conditions or changes in the power structure at the top” (Swaine 1986: 15). In other words, leaders of
最后，尽管技术官僚派系似乎迎合特定机构的利益，但它们实际上首先寻求的是加强自身的影响力，而不必然是某一特定机构本身的权力和影响力。关于 1970 年代的官僚政治，Swaine 指出，“个人领导者确实作为一般官僚倾向的‘保荐人’发挥着关键作用，但他们与这种倾向的认同并不意味着在面临具体客观条件或高层权力结构变化时不能改变自己的利益取向”（Swaine 1986: 15）。换言之，
the technocratic factions are perfectly willing to promote policies detrimental to the long-term interests of particular agencies for factional advancement.
技术官僚派系的领导者完全愿意为派系利益推动有损特定机构长期利益的政策。
Once factions are formed, they maintain relatively coherent membership composition because of institutional features that increase the transaction cost of recruiting faction members from another type of factions. According to Nathan, factions depend on “the hierarchy and established communications and authority flow of the existing organization…” (Nathan 1973:44). Essentially, since both the Party and the state have established communication channels, it is easier for senior State Council officials to cultivate and maintain ties with state bureaucrats and for senior Party generalists to cultivate ties with provincial leaders, army commanders, and members of the central Party organs. The State Council holds regular meetings chaired by the premier and attended by ministers, whereas Party cadres from provincial and the central governments meet regularly during CC plenums, national conferences on Party work, and inspection trips made by Politburo members. Both the State Council and the CC have general offices that handle communication with subordinate units.
一旦派系形成，由于制度性特征提高了从另一类派系中招募成员的交易成本，派系成员构成便能维持相对一致。正如 Nathan 所指出的，派系依赖“现有组织的等级制度以及既定的沟通和权威流程……”（Nathan 1973:44）。本质上，由于党和国家都已建立了沟通渠道，国务院的高级官员更容易培养并维持与国家官僚的联系，而党的高级通才则更容易与省级领导、军区司令以及中央党机关成员建立联系。国务院由总理主持、部长出席，定期召开会议；而来自省级和中央政府的党干部则在中央委员会全体会议、全国党务会议以及政治局委员的视察行程中定期会面。国务院和中央委员会均设有负责与下属单位沟通的办公厅/办公机构。
Whereas the appointments of senior State Council bureaucrats require nomination by the state, appointments of provincial Party secretaries and governors are under the strict control of the CCP Central Organization Department (Wu 1997: 142). As such, it is easier for the leaders of generalist factions to maneuver favorite underlings into provincial leadership positions than it is for them to strictly control the appointment of central ministers. Likewise, the leaders of the technocratic factions have more discretion over the appointments of ministers than of provincial cadres. For example, Jiang Zemin maneuvered many of his protégés into provincial Party secretary seats, including Jia Qingling of Beijing, Li Changchun of Guangdong, and Zhang Gaoli, who was promoted from Shenzhen to head Shangdong Province (Lam 2001; Li 2001). Likewise, Premier Zhu Rongji appointed his protégés to head the People’s Bank of China, the State Economic System Reform Office, and the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) (Chen 1998a; Lam 2000). Thus, although members of the generalist factions cross over to each others’ camps, a technocratic faction typically contains very few provincial officials, and few central bureaucrats become active members of a generalist faction. 14 14 ^(14){ }^{14}
国务院高级官员的任命需要由国家提名，而省委书记和省长的任命则由中共中央组织部严格控制（Wu 1997: 142）。因此，对通才派领导者来说，把自己偏爱的下属调到省级领导岗位要比严格控制中央部委部长的任命容易得多。同样， technocratic factions 的领导在部长级人事任命上比在省级干部任命上拥有更多自主权。例如，江泽民把许多门生安插到省委书记的席位上，包括北京的贾庆林、广东的李长春，以及从深圳提拔到山东省负责工作的张高丽（Lam 2001；Li 2001）。同样，朱镕基总理提拔他的亲信出任中国人民银行、国家经济体制改革办公室和中国证券监督管理委员会（CSRC）的负责人（Chen 1998a；Lam 2000）。 因此，尽管通才派的成员会互相串联投靠，技术官僚派通常包含的省级官员很少，而很少有中央官僚成为通才派的活跃成员。 14 14 ^(14){ }^{14}
Because factional clients with two distinct sets of preferences tend to fall into two different types of factions, leaders of these two types of factions pursue two distinct financial strategies to expand factional influence and ultimately to bolster their own positions in the Standing Committee of the Politburo. For the leader of a generalist faction, his imperative is to allocate capital to the provinces. To reiterate, this strategy benefits the entire faction because the clients improve their promotion prospects while the patron obtains loyalty, signals to others his power, and increases the probability of gaining a useful ally in the Central Committee or the Politburo. As Huang (1996: 19) points out, however,
由于拥有两类不同偏好的派系客户倾向于落入两种不同类型的派系，这两类派系的领导人为扩大派系影响并最终巩固自己在政治局常务委员会的地位，会采取两种截然不同的金融策略。对于通才派的领导人来说，其首要任务是将资本分配到各省。重申一下，这一策略有利于整个派系，因为客户的晋升前景得到改善，而恩主则获得忠诚、向他人示威其权力，并增加在中央委员会或政治局获得有用盟友的概率。正如黄（1996：19）指出的，
Figure 9: figure 4.1. Membership Composition of the Two Types of Faction.
图 9：图 4.1 两类派系的成员构成。
the devolution of financial control to the localities is fundamentally inflationary, as it creates a collective action problem where each province strives to maximize credit expansion regardless of its effect on overall inflation. With the decentralization of monetary control, the province that does not maximize borrowing lags behind in available funding and would still suffer the inflationary consequences of credit expansion by other provinces. To avoid this sucker’s payoff, every province has strong incentive to maximize credit expansion. Likewise, if the patron of a generalist faction orders his provincial followers to refrain from borrowing, his faction’s fortune would decline relative to generalist factions whose followers are maximizing credit expansion. In the meantime, every province still suffers from the inflationary consequences of overall credit expansion. Thus, between different generalist factions, there also exists a strong incentive to strictly maximize credit expansion in provinces controlled by factional followers. The pursuit of this strategy without constraint would result in high inflation.
将金融控制权下放到地方从根本上具有通货膨胀性，因为这会产生集体行动问题：每个省都力图最大化信贷扩张，而不顾其对整体通胀的影响。随着货币控制的分权，未能最大化借贷的省份在可用资金上会落后，并仍须承受其他省份信贷扩张带来的通胀后果。为了避免这种“吃亏”的结果，每个省都有强烈动机去最大化信贷扩张。同样地，如果一个泛能派的恩主命令其省级追随者停止借贷，该派在与那些追随者正在最大化信贷扩张的泛能派相比时，其势力将会衰落。与此同时，每个省仍要承受整体信贷扩张带来的通胀后果。因此，在不同的泛能派之间，也存在在其追随者控制的省份严格最大化信贷扩张的强烈动机。若不加约束地追求这一策略，将导致高通胀。
Meanwhile, the leader of a technocratic faction strengthens his power by expanding the policy jurisdiction of his preferred ministries. In doing so, the overall aim is to wrest control over financial policies away from the provincial governments and to return it to designated central agencies. As in the case of the generalist faction, the strategy of maximizing the central government’s power is mutually beneficial to the patron and to the clients. For the patron, heightened authority over the financial sector connotes greater capacity to use financial resources to bargain for political support in the Politburo. 15 15 ^(15){ }^{15} Stricter control over financial resources also increases the central government’s ability to provide short-term, apparent fixes to the economy, which increases the top technocrat’s standing and importance in the leadership. 16 16 ^(16){ }^{16} As other Politburo members perceive the head of the technocratic faction as an indispensable problemsolver, they are less likely to replace him. The strengthening of central power also gives factional followers the necessary tools with which to accumulate
与此同时，一位技术官僚派系的领导通过扩大其偏好部委的政策管辖权来强化自己的权力。这样做的总体目标是将对金融政策的控制从省级政府手中夺回，归还给指定的中央机构。与通才派系的情况一样，最大化中央政府权力的策略对主 patron 和其客户都是互惠的。对于主 patron 来说，对金融部门权威的提升意味着有更大的能力利用金融资源在政治局内为争取政治支持进行讨价还价。 15 15 ^(15){ }^{15} 对金融资源的更严格控制也增强了中央政府提供短期、表面上能缓解经济问题的能力，从而提升这位最高技术官僚在领导层中的地位和重要性。 16 16 ^(16){ }^{16} 当其他政治局成员将该技术官僚派系的首脑视为不可或缺的问题解决者时，他们就不太可能替换他。中央权力的加强也为派系追随者提供了必要的工具，以便积累
administrative merits and to obtain promotions. Increased policy discretion to ministries governed by factional followers also allows followers to benefit from distributing rent to large SOEs or to the provinces. Finally, the ability of a technocratic faction to centralize policy authority signals the continual power of that faction and deters potential challengers.
获得行政绩效并谋取晋升。对由派系追随者掌控的部委赋予更大的政策裁量权，也使追随者能够通过向大型国有企业或省级政府分配租金而获利。最后，一个技术官僚派系集中政策权力的能力，表明该派系持续的权力，并威慑潜在挑战者。
In centralizing financial policy, the leader of a technocratic faction also gains strong incentive to keep inflation in check. When financial power is centralized, the collective action problem disappears because the blame for high inflation would fall squarely on the top bureaucrat in charge of monetary policy. As Chapter 7 shows, Li Peng failed to rein in inflation in 1993 and lost his position as the dominant technocrat to Zhu Rongji. Given the concentration of responsibility, the lead technocrat must carefully weigh the benefits of credit expansion against the political damage of inflation to him personally. For these reasons, central bureaucratic control over the financial system generates less inflationary pressure than local government control of it does.
在中央集中金融政策时，技术官僚派系的领导人也有强烈动机控制通货膨胀。当金融权力被集中时，集体行动问题消失了，因为高通胀的责任会完全落在负责货币政策的最高官员身上。正如第 7 章所示，李鹏在 1993 年未能遏制通胀，因而失去了作为主导技术官僚的地位，取而代之的是朱镕基。鉴于责任的高度集中，首席技术官僚必须谨慎权衡信贷扩张的利益与对其个人造成的政治性通胀损害。出于这些原因，中央官僚对金融体系的控制比地方政府控制时产生的通胀压力更小。

A Model of Inflationary Cycles
通胀周期模型

How do these two countervailing forces translate into inflationary cycles and inefficient allocation of capital in the reform era? In essence, although inflationary cycles are caused by the differing inflationary tendencies of the two types of factions, neither type has any incentive to improve the efficiency of capital allocation in China. A fair assumption to make on the outset is that the dominant generalist faction likely has the initial upper hand to allocate resources to the provinces at the expense of the central bureaucracy. The generalist faction’s advantage stems first from its control over the appointment of government officials, including those in the central bureaucracy. The dominant generalist faction also has control over the Party’s internal communication channels and the mass media. Local officials watch for central policy direction first and foremost through the internal Party communication channel (Lieberthal, Tong, and Yeung 1978). If the central bureaucracy issues regulations that contradict with the Party’s decrees, local officials would obey the directives from the Party over those issued by the central bureaucracy. In fact, this phenomenon occurred quite frequently, as Chapters 6 and 7 reveal.
这两种相互对立的力量如何在改革时代转化为通货膨胀周期和资本配置低效？本质上，尽管通货膨胀周期是由两类派系不同的通胀倾向所引发的，但任何一类派系都没有动机去改善中国的资本配置效率。一个合理的前提是假定占主导地位的通才派系很可能在初期占据上风，将资源分配给各省，从而损害中央官僚体制的利益。通才派系的优势首先来自于其对政府官员任命的控制，包括对中央官僚机构人员的任命。占主导地位的通才派系还掌控着党的内部传播渠道和大众媒体。地方官员首先通过党的内部传播渠道关注中央政策方向（Lieberthal, Tong, and Yeung 1978）。如果中央官僚机构发布的监管与党的法令相抵触，地方官员会服从党的法令而非中央官僚机构发布的监管。 事实上，这种现象相当频繁地发生，正如第 6 章和第 7 章所揭示的那样。
With the generalist factions in charge of monetary policy, any coordination to target money supply becomes impossible between the factions and between the provinces. Without the threat of an economic crisis, the most powerful generalist faction has an incentive to renege on any agreement between the factions to stabilize price level in order to allocate more credit to provinces controlled by its followers. Like Meiji oligarchs who competed with each other to build mass political parties (Ramseyer and Rosenbluth 1998), rival generalist factions scramble to grant preferential loans or lending authority to their favorite provinces, thereby undermining the central bank’s credit plan in classic prisoners’ dilemma fashion. Moreover, generalist control over financial policy engenders expectation of a loose monetary environment even before the PBOC
当通才派掌管货币政策时，各派系之间以及各省之间就不可能协调以以货币供应量为目标。没有经济危机的威胁，最有权势的通才派有动力违背各派系之间为稳定物价水平达成的任何协议，以便向其追随者控制的省份分配更多信贷。就像明治的寡头们彼此竞争以构建大规模政党（Ramseyer 和 Rosenbluth 1998）一样，相互对立的通才派争相向其偏爱的省份提供优惠贷款或放贷权，从而以经典的囚徒困境方式破坏中央银行的信贷计划。此外，通才派对金融政策的控制甚至在中国人民银行采取行动之前就会导致对宽松货币环境的预期。
provides more funds. If local government officials sense that a generalist faction is in charge of financial policy, they would enthusiastically launch new investment projects and set up local financial institutions to make loans against PBOC regulations in anticipation of a looser monetary environment. With their factional patrons in charge, local officials have no compunction about violating PBOC decrees and exceeding the credit plan. Furthermore, expectation of a loose monetary environment and of a building boom might compel private investors to hoard building supply, which further exacerbates inflationary pressure. Through these mechanisms, the collapse of the credit plan’s credibility quickly gives rise to accelerating inflationary pressure.
提供更多基金。如果地方政府官员感觉通才派掌握金融政策，他们会热情地启动新的投资项目并设立地方金融机构，违背 PBOC 的规定发放贷款，预期货币环境将放松。在其派系后台掌权的情况下，地方官员毫不顾忌地违反 PBOC 法令并超出信贷计划。此外，对宽松货币环境和建筑热潮的预期可能促使私人投资者囤积建筑材料，进一步加剧通胀压力。通过这些机制，信贷计划信誉的崩溃会迅速引发加速的通胀压力。
With rising inflation or another form of economic crisis, the dominant generalist faction is faced with three unpalatable choices. First, the leader of the dominant generalist faction can do nothing, which would end in hyperinflation or economic collapse. Although there are some strategic advantages to waiting, such as gaining information about the strength of one’s rival (Alesina and Drazen 1995), the leader of the dominant faction risks dismissal or the downfall of the entire CCP regime by doing nothing. He has no wish to see either outcome, given that his faction reaps the majority of the benefits under the existing regime. Second, the leader of the dominant faction can order members of his own faction to stop intervening in the provincial banks. However, this would encourage free-riding as rival generalist factions take advantage of the self-imposed austerity to continue intervening in the banking system, thereby increasing their power relative to the dominant faction. Furthermore, on the margin, members of the dominant generalist faction would defect to rival factions because they can obtain more loans in a rival faction. Given the deleterious effects of a self-imposed austerity for the dominant faction, any claim of a selfimposed austerity would not be credible and would not be taken seriously by rival factions or by members of the dominant faction. Rapid monetary expansion would continue unabated, leading to hyperinflation.
随着通货膨胀上升或出现其他形式的经济危机，占据主导地位的泛能派面临三种令人难以接受的选择。首先，该派系的领导人可以不采取任何行动，但这将以超级通货膨胀或经济崩溃告终。虽然等待有一些战略上的好处，比如获取有关对手实力的信息（Alesina and Drazen 1995），但主导派系的领导人若选择不作为，就有被免职或导致整个中共政权垮台的风险。鉴于在现有体制下他的派系占有大部分利益，他无意看到任何一方结果。第二，主导派系的领导人可以命令本派系成员停止干预省级银行。然而，这将鼓励搭便车行为——对手泛能派会利用这种自我实施的紧缩继续干预银行体系，从而相对增强其权力。此外，在边际上，主导泛能派的成员会倒向对手派系，因为在对手派系那里他们能获得更多贷款。 鉴于对主导派系实行自我紧缩所带来的有害影响，任何关于自我紧缩的宣称都不会令人信服，也不会被对立派系或主导派系内部成员认真对待。 快速的货币扩张将会持续不受抑制，导致恶性通货膨胀。
Instead of facing these eventualities, a preferred strategy of the dominant generalist faction is to delegate monetary policy to a “neutral” faction. Although the technocratic faction is expected to make self-serving policies, its action is unlikely to change the relative balance of power between the different generalist factions. This is so because technocratic factions have an interest in making credible monetary policy through centralization, which deprives every province the authority to expand money supply, not just a subset of provinces. This prevents followers of rival factions from free-riding on the austerity measures followed by the dominant faction. At the same time, because central technocrats only have narrow support within the central bureaucracy, they are unlikely to usurp the dominant generalist’s power. Under most circumstances, central technocrats, as members of the ruling coalition, are also unlikely to side with a challenging faction because the dominant generalist faction still holds control over crucial political resources. Exceptions arise when a challenging generalist, such as Deng Xiaoping in the late 1970s, is seen as having the ability to mobilize a challenge with a high chance of success. Given the narrow base of
与其直接面对这些可能发生的情况，占主导地位的综合派系更倾向于将货币政策委托给一个“中立”派系。尽管技术官僚派系预计会制定有利于自身的政策，但其动作不太可能改变不同综合派系之间的相对权力平衡。原因在于，技术官僚派系有利于通过中央集权来打造可信的货币政策，使每个省都失去扩张货币供应的权力，而不是仅仅剥夺部分省份的权力。这可以防止对手派系的追随者搭便车，借助占主导地位派系所实行的紧缩措施获益。与此同时，由于中央技术官僚在中央官僚体系内仅有有限的支持，他们不太可能篡夺占主导地位的综合派系的权力。在大多数情况下，作为执政联盟成员的中央技术官僚也不太可能站到挑战派系一边，因为占主导地位的综合派系仍然掌控着关键的政治资源。 当像 1970 年代末的邓小平这样具有挑战性的广泛型领导者被视为有能力发起一场极有可能成功的挑战时，就会出现例外。鉴于技术官僚的基础狭窄
the technocrats, the dominant generalist faction is ultimately willing to accept the cost of delegating monetary policies to the central technocrats during an economic crisis when not delegating entails graver costs. Furthermore, if the economic crisis continues, the dominant generalist can shift or share the blame with the head of the technocratic faction.
在经济危机期间，如果不委托中央技术官僚处理会带来更严重的代价，占主导地位的广泛型派系最终愿意承担将货币政策（Monetary policy[Finance]）委托给中央技术官僚的代价。此外，如果经济危机持续，占主导地位的广泛型派系可以将责任转移或与技术官僚派系的首脑分担。
In the following chapters, we will see that Deng showed a willingness to delegate financial power to Chen Yun in the early 1980s as he completed his struggle against the remaining forces of Hua Guofeng and after the Tiananmen massacre to preserve his dominance in the CCP. Likewise, Jiang conceded financial power to Zhu Rongji during the mid-ı999os inflation and during the Asian Financial Crisis as he struggled to establish his own dominance in the Party over rival factions. 17 17 ^(17){ }^{17} The delegation of financial authorities to the technocratic faction is credible because it is costly for all generalist factions, including the dominant one, to reverse it. Once financial control is delegated to the technocratic factions, generalist factions would have to engage in costly political maneuvers to win it back.
在接下来的章节中，我们将看到，邓小平在完成对华国锋残余势力的斗争并在天安门屠杀后为维护他在中共的主导地位时，曾在 20 世纪 80 年代初表现出将金融权力委托给陈云的意愿。同样，江泽民在 20 世纪 90 年代中期的通货膨胀期间以及亚洲金融危机期间，为了在党内与对立派系争夺自身的主导地位，也将金融权力让渡给朱镕基。将金融权力下放给技术官僚派系是可信的，因为要扭转这种安排对所有泛派系（包括占主导地位的那个）来说都代价高昂。一旦金融控制被下放给技术官僚派系，泛派系就必须通过代价高昂的政治手段来将其夺回。
Thus, an economic crisis provides the top bureaucrat in the Politburo an opportunity to disrupt the decentralization process and to impose a harsh regime of disinflationary measures or other remedies, most of which involve recentralizing financial power. 18 18 ^(18){ }^{18} Because the central bureaucracy, which has an incentive to exaggerate an economic crisis, holds a monopoly on reliable economic information, the leaders of various generalist factions often do not heed warnings about inflation coming from the central bureaucracy until inflation has risen to alarming proportions. Conflicts over monetary policy arise between generalist and technocratic factions because while technocrats are enthusiastic about centralization, the generalists are reluctant to deprive provinces of easy access to capital. Nonetheless, when the dominant generalist perceives the imminence of an economic crisis, he ultimately goes along with these harsh measures to avoid an economic collapse.
因此，经济危机为政治局的最高官员提供了一个中断分权进程并实施严厉去通货膨胀措施或其他补救措施的机会，其中大多数措施都涉及金融权力的再集中。 18 18 ^(18){ }^{18} 由于中央官僚机构对可靠经济信息拥有垄断地位，并且有夸大经济危机的激励，各个泛能派系的领导人在中央官僚发出通货膨胀警告之前，常常不会予以重视，直到通货膨胀上升到令人警觉的程度。关于货币政策，泛能派和技术官僚派之间存在冲突，因为技术官僚热衷于中央集权，而泛能派则不愿剥夺省份对资本的便捷获取。尽管如此，当占主导地位的泛能派察觉到经济危机即将来临时，为避免经济崩溃，他最终还是会接受这些严厉措施。
Because local officials know that central economic bureaucrats have a strong incentive to centralize financial authority, the central bank’s credit plan regains credibility when the central Party apparatus broadcasts unambiguously that financial authority has been turned over to the central bureaucrats. Furthermore, local officials know that the dominant generalist faction cannot easily retake financial control from the technocratic faction because top bureaucrats sit on the Standing Committee and have a variety of political resources. It would not be costless even for the dominant generalist faction to countermand retrenchment measures. Consequently, even local officials belonging to the dominant generalist faction realize that they can be punished for
因为地方官员知道中央经济官僚有强烈动机将金融权力中央化，当中央党组织明确宣布把金融权力交给中央官僚时，中央银行的信贷计划就会恢复可信度。此外，地方官员也知道，占主导地位的通才派系并不容易从技术官僚派手中重新夺回金融控制权，因为高级官僚在常委会中任职并拥有多种政治资源。即便是占主导地位的通才派系，反对紧缩措施也不会毫无代价。因此，即使属于占主导地位通才派系的地方官员也意识到他们可能会因
transgressing central financial decrees. In this manner, the combination of the bureaucrats’ preference for centralization and their ability to retain control provides retrenchment policies a measure of credibility.
违抗中央金融法令而受到惩罚。通过这种方式，官僚们对中央化的偏好及其保持控制的能力相结合，为紧缩政策提供了一定程度的可信度。
When central bureaucrats command financial policies, their imperative is to maximize control, not to increase the efficiency of capital allocation. Instead of implementing significant financial reforms, which would provide a long-term solution to the problem of inflation, the technocratic faction uses control over financial resources to enlarge the jurisdiction of the central bureaucracy. 19 19 ^(19){ }^{19} In recent years, this has been done through the expansion of central regulatory authority and the strengthening of “strategic” and “pillar” SOEs, which are directly controlled by the central bureaucracy rather than by the provincial government.
当中央官僚主导金融政策时，其首要目标是最大化控制，而不是提高资本配置的效率。技术官僚派并未实施能从根本上解决通货膨胀问题的重大金融改革，而是利用对金融资源的控制来扩大中央官僚体系的管辖权。 19 19 ^(19){ }^{19} 近年来，这一做法通过扩大中央监管权力以及加强由中央官僚直接控制、而非省级政府控制的“战略性”和“支柱型”国有企业来实现。
The power enjoyed by the central planners, however, is not permanent. As the economy stabilizes and as growth increases, generalist factions regain the incentive and the political leverage to unlock the technocrats’ grip on the financial system. The pressure to intervene in the banking system rises with economic recovery because high growth increases the demand for credit, which intensifies provincial lobbying for more credit. Also, increasing growth coupled with price stability signals to the generalist factions that the economic crisis has passed, which makes it easier for the dominant generalist faction to renege against retrenchment policies without an economic collapse. With increasing incentive and opportunity, the dominant generalist faction exerts increasing pressure on the bureaucracy to favor certain provinces in allocating credit quotas. At the beginning of the next inflationary cycle, the dominant generalist faction resets the agenda through the Party communications channels to devolve significant financial power to the provinces, especially those governed by the members of the faction. For example, the Central Committee can launch a campaign to support township and village enterprises, which requires the devolution of credit control for working capital to the provinces. This signals to everyone the end of central domination and undermines the central bank’s credit plan, which sets off another round of rapid monetary expansion and ultimately inflation.
然而，中央计划者所享有的权力并非永久不变。随着经济稳定和增长的提升，通才派重新获得了动机和政治杠杆来打破技术官僚对金融体系的控制。随着经济复苏，对银行体系进行干预的压力增大，因为高速增长提高了信贷需求，从而加剧了各省为获取更多信贷而进行的游说。同时，增长上升伴随物价稳定向通才派传递出经济危机已过的信号，这使得占主导地位的通才派在不导致经济崩溃的情况下更容易违背缩减政策。随着动机和机会的增加，占主导地位的通才派对官僚体制施加越来越大的压力，促使在分配信贷配额时偏袒特定省份。到了下一个通胀周期开始时，占主导地位的通才派通过党内通讯渠道重置议程，将重要的金融权力下放到各省，特别是由该派成员管辖的省份。 例如，中央委员会可以发起一项支持乡镇企业的运动，这就要求将用于营运资金的信贷控制下放到省级。 这向所有人宣告了中央主导地位的终结，并削弱了中央银行的信贷计划，从而引发新一轮快速的货币扩张并最终导致通货膨胀。
In this model, although financial power changes hands, the efficiency of capital allocation does not improve significantly regardless of who has control. If the generalists control it, local governments would allocate funds toward local developmental projects, which are a mix of growth-promoting investment and wasteful rent-seeking opportunities. Likewise, central technocrats allocate funds toward large-scale projects, which again can be wasteful on a larger scale. Because both types of factions comprise political actors with short time horizon, neither is likely to allocate funds much more efficiently than the other.
在该模型中，尽管金融权力易手，资本配置效率并不会因控制者不同而有显著改善。如果由通才掌控，地方政府会将资金分配给地方发展项目，这些项目既包含促进增长的投资，也夹杂着浪费性寻租机会。同样，中央技术官僚会将资金投向大规模项目，这些项目在更大范围内同样可能是浪费性的。由于这两类派系都由具有短期视野的政治行为者组成，任何一方都不太可能比另一方更高效地配置资金。
One pernicious implication of this model is that senior technocrats in fact have a disincentive to truly fix the economy, as they gain control over the economy only during a crisis. In the short run, their standing depends on an apparent
该模型的一个有害含义是，高级技术官僚实际上没有真正修复经济的激励，因为他们只有在危机期间才能掌控经济。短期内，他们的地位取决于对经济的表面修补。
Figure 10: figure 4.2. How Factional Dynamics Generate Inflationary Cycles.
fix of the economy. In the medium term, however, they need to plant the seeds for the next economic crisis because they know that the generalist factions would soon take their power away. Generalist factions, although wanting to stabilize the economy, still face an uncertain political environment in which they need to channel favors to faction members. As such, they engage in short-term behavior and cannot resist reclaiming control over the financial system from the bureaucrats. The reality of Chinese political economy is probably not as cynical as implied by the “rational expectation” version of this model. As we will see in Chapter 7, however, there is considerable evidence that the central bureaucracy intentionally allowed the dominant generalist faction to walk into an economic crisis in order to regain control.
然而中期来看，他们需要为下一次经济危机埋下伏笔，因为他们知道一般派系很快就会夺走他们的权力。尽管一般派系希望稳定经济，但他们仍面临不确定的政治环境，需要向派系成员输送好处。因此，他们会采取短期行为，无法抵挡从官僚手中夺回对金融体系控制的冲动。中国政治经济的现实可能并不像该模型的“理性预期”版本所暗示的那样犬儒。不过正如我们将在第 7 章看到的，有大量证据表明中央官僚体系故意让占主导地位的一般派系陷入经济危机，以便收回控制权。

Conclusion  结论

The model outlined in this chapter builds on the existence of two types of factions, one that prefers financial decentralization and the other centralization. Because both types of factions are headed by powerful politicians inside the CCP, their struggle for control over financial resources gives rise to monetary cycles and thus inflationary cycles in China. This complex model generates many observable claims. First, this model predicts that followers of generalist and technocratic factions would distribute money in different ways. Furthermore, contrary to predictions of classical monetary theories, this model predicts a negative relationship between current inflation and future inflation because rising inflation provides technocrats the political opportunity to centralize
本章所述模型基于两类派系的存在：一种偏好金融分权，另一种偏好金融集中。由于这两类派系均由中共内部的强势政治人物领导，他们为控制金融资源的斗争导致了货币周期，从而形成了中国的通货膨胀周期。该复杂模型产生了许多可观察的论断。首先，模型预测，泛能型和技术官僚派系的追随者会以不同方式分配货币。此外，与经典货币理论的预测相反，该模型预测当前通货膨胀与未来通货膨胀之间存在负相关关系，因为通货膨胀上升为技术官僚提供了实现金融集中化的政治机会。
monetary control. Again, in contrast to monetary theory, this model predicts a short-term positive relationship between output growth and inflation, as output growth signals economic recovery, which prompts generalists to intervene in the economy. These general predictions will be tested by quantitative method in the next chapter.
货币控制。同样，与货币理论相反，该模型预测产出增长与通货膨胀在短期内呈正相关，因为产出增长表明经济正在恢复，这会促使泛能派干预经济。下一章将通过定量方法检验这些一般性预测。
These patterns also will be tested in the case studies in subsequent chapters, which reconstruct the complex political processes that gave rise to monetary cycles and reform stagnation in China. The qualitative case studies explore whether patrons of technocratic and generalist factions consistently gave different instructions to bank officials regarding monetary policies. Although this model does not predict the timing of monetary centralization and decentralization, it informs us when the structural preconditions for inflation and disinflation are present.
