The qualitative case studies demonstrate how these changing structural conditions drive political actors to pursue shifting strategies, causing monetary swings in China. If the preconditions for an outcome are absent, contingent factors are unlikely to induce that outcome. Finally, the case studies give readers a sense of the richness of Chinese politics, where charisma, corruption scandals, and the health of factional leaders all weave together a rich story.
这些模式也将在随后的章节个案研究中得到检验，这些章节重建了导致中国货币周期和改革停滞的复杂政治过程。定性个案研究探讨了技术官僚派系与通才派系的后台是否持续性地向银行官员发出不同的货币政策指令。尽管该模型并不预测货币集中化与分散化的时间点，但它能告诉我们何时存在导致通货膨胀与通货紧缩的结构性前提条件。定性个案研究展示了这些不断变化的结构性条件如何推动政治行为者采取转变中的策略，从而引发中国的货币波动。如果某一结果的前提条件缺失，偶发因素不太可能引发该结果。最后，个案研究使读者感受到中国政治的丰富性——魅力型领导、贪腐丑闻以及派系领导人的健康状况等因素交织在一起，构成了一个丰富的故事。

Factional Politics, Distribution of Loans, and Inflationary Cycles
派系政治、贷款分配与通货膨胀周期

Several Quantitative Tests
若干定量检验

This chapter statistically assesses the factional model in two ways. The first statistical model tests the impact of the two types of factions on provincial lending. A bedrock of this work is that membership composition of factions affects their preference for financial policies. Whereas generalist factions with substantial membership at provincial governments strive to increase monetary disbursements to the provinces, technocratic factions with members primarily in the central government have little incentive to do likewise. This starting point is not taken as given and is tested empirically. Thus, the first model examines whether factional ties give rise to the predicted effects and measures the extent to which provinces with connections with generalist factions benefit relative to provinces with no connection or with connections with technocratic factions.
本章通过两种方式对派系模型进行统计评估。第一个统计模型检验两类派系对省级放贷的影响。本研究的基石是：派系的成员构成影响其对金融政策的偏好。具有大量省级政府成员的一般派系（generalist factions）倾向于增加对各省的货币拨付，而以中央政府成员为主的技术官僚派系（technocratic factions）则没有类似的激励。这个出发点并非理所当然，而是通过实证加以检验。因此，第一个模型考察派系纽带是否产生了预测中的效应，并衡量与一般派系有联系的省份相较于与之没有联系或与技术官僚派系有联系的省份所获得利益的程度。
The second statistical test measures the impact, if any, of the factional dynamics on inflation and lending. The factional model generates a series of predictions that counter the predictions of standard monetary theory. Thus, these counterintuitive predictions need to be tested by time series models. These findings, in combination with the qualitative findings presented in Chapters 6 through 8, provide strong empirical support for the factional model. First, the factional model predicts that high inflation systematically decreases first lending, then inflation in subsequent quarters because inflation creates a favorable political environment for technocratic factions to centralize credit, thereby lowering inflation in a later period. This prediction deviates from the usual phenomenon of inflation inertia, where high inflation in one period increases inflation in a subsequent period. Furthermore, because the pressure on generalist factions to circumvent central credit restrictions increases with economic recovery, the factional model predicts that increased output in one period augurs higher inflation in a subsequent period. Again, this prediction runs counter to the classic prediction of quantity theory, which posits a negative relationship between output growth and inflation. To determine whether these claims are consistent with empirical reality, the second section uses a battery of time series models to rigorously test them.
第二个统计检验衡量派系动态对通货膨胀和贷款的影响（如果有的话）。派系模型产生了一系列与标准货币理论预测相反的结论。因此，这些违反直觉的预测需要通过时间序列模型加以检验。这些发现与第 6 至第 8 章中呈现的定性发现相结合，为派系模型提供了有力的实证支持。首先，派系模型预测，高通货膨胀会系统性地先降低贷款，然后在随后数季度降低通货膨胀，因为通货膨胀为技术官僚派系集中信贷创造了有利的政治环境，从而在后期降低通货膨胀。该预测偏离了通货膨胀惯性这一常见现象——即一个时期的高通货膨胀会增加随后时期的通货膨胀。此外，由于随着经济恢复，对通用派系绕过中央信贷限制的压力增加，派系模型还预测，一个时期的产出增加预示着随后时期更高的通货膨胀。 同样，这一预测与经典货币数量论的预测相悖，后者假定产出增长与通货膨胀之间存在负相关关系。 为了判断这些主张是否与经验证据相一致，第二部分使用一系列时间序列模型对其进行严格检验。

The Existence and the Distributional Effects of Factions
派系的存在及其分配效应

In order to test the existence of divergent factional strategy with respect to the disbursement of bank loans to the provinces, this section first develops an indicator to measure factional affiliation between provincial leaders and patrons of various factions in the center. Then, regression analysis reveals that throughout the reform era members of generalist factions indeed received significantly more bank credit than members of technocratic factions who were rotated to the provinces for stints. This pattern is robust even when a host of control variables are included and when different modeling assumptions are used.
为了检验在向各省发放银行贷款方面是否存在分歧的派系策略，本节首先构建了一个指标来衡量省级领导人与中央各派系资助者之间的派系隶属关系。随后，回归分析表明，在整个改革时期，确实属于一般派系的成员比被轮岗到省级任职的技术官僚派系成员获得了显著更多的银行信贷。即使在纳入大量控制变量以及采用不同建模假设的情况下，这一模式仍然稳健。
As was pointed out in Chapter 4, factions have long been conceived of as vertical networks of mutual exchange “… motivated by the individuals’ pursuit of relatively tangible and immediate incentives…” (Nathan and Tsai 1995). With this definition, one can reasonably hypothesize that membership in a given faction entails preferential distribution of resources. Put another way, although bureaucratic procedure allocates X amount of resources to a cadre, his or her informal ties with a powerful patron in the upper reaches of the Party hierarchy would appropriate X + n X + n X+n\mathrm{X}+\mathrm{n} amount of resources, where n represents the premium of factional ties.
正如第 4 章所指出的，派系长期以来被视为垂直的相互交换网络，“……由个人追求相对可见且即时的激励所驱动……”（Nathan 和 Tsai 1995）。根据这个定义，可以合理地假设，隶属于某一派系会带来资源的优先分配。换句话说，尽管官僚程序向一名干部分配了 X 数量的资源，但他或她与党内高层某位有权势的赞助人之间的非正式关系会占用 X + n X + n X+n\mathrm{X}+\mathrm{n} 数量的资源，其中 n 代表派系关系的溢价。
More specifically, the factional framework posits that different types of factions have different effects on the distribution of money and goods to the provinces. The leader of a generalist faction, who has a sizable number of followers in the provinces, exercises his power to channel more loans to provinces where his protégés serve as either governor or Party secretary because higher growth increases his protégés’ chances of promotion. As previously suggested, this strategy procures various benefits to the faction and on average increases the factional leader’s chance of survival. In contrast, the leader of a technocratic faction has much less incentive to do likewise, even though the economic bureaucracy has the most direct access to the banking system. Because technocratic factions are primarily composed of ministers and vice ministers in the State Council, they generally benefit more from central control over financial policies than from the distribution of additional funds to particular provinces. Although members of technocratic factions are rotated to the provinces for stints, these rotations are typically understood as temporary assignments to demonstrate these bureaucrats’ readiness for leadership positions in the center. Thus, provincial growth performance does not have a significant impact on a bureaucrat’s political future. I I  ^("I "){ }^{\text {I }} In fact, members of technocratic factions serving in the provinces have an incentive to strictly adhere to State Council directives
更具体地说，派系框架假设不同类型的派系在向各省分配货币和物资方面有不同影响。一个综合型派系的领导人，在各省拥有大量追随者，会利用其权力把更多贷款引导到由其门客担任省长或党书记的省份，因为更高的增长会增加其门客晋升的机会。如前所述，这一策略为派系带来各种好处，并且平均上提高了派系领导人的存续几率。相反，技术型派系的领导人即便经济官僚体系对银行体系拥有最直接的通道，也没有太大动力采取同样做法。由于技术型派系主要由国务院的部长和副部长组成，他们通常从中央对金融政策的控制中获益更多，而不是从向特定省份分配额外资金中获益更多。 虽然技术官僚派系的成员会被轮调到地方任职，但这些轮调通常被理解为临时任命，用以证明这些官僚有能力担任中央的领导职务。因此，省级的增长表现并不会对官僚的政治前途产生显著影响。 事实上，在省任职的技术官僚派系成员有动机严格遵守国务院关于放贷的指示
on lending in order to appease their factional patrons. 2 2 ^(2){ }^{2} This implies that provinces headed by members of technocratic factions receive less money than provinces headed by members of generalist factions. For example, Shanghai, which had been under Chen Yun’s sway during the 1980s, consistently had loan-to-deposit ratios well below that of Guangdong until Shanghai party secretary Jiang Zemin became the Party Secretary General in the 1990s (Shih 2004).
以安抚他们的派系恩主。这意味着由技术官僚派系成员领导的省份获得的资金比由通才派系成员领导的省份要少。例如，上海在 1980 年代处于陈云影响之下，其贷款与存款比率一直远低于广东，直到 1990 年代上海市委书记江泽民成为党总书记为止（Shih 2004）。

Measuring and Coding Factions
衡量与编码派系

Despite the centrality of factions in Chinese politics, they are extremely difficult to observe in a systematic manner, especially in an opaque political system such as the one in China. 3 3 ^(3){ }^{3} Nevertheless, previous research by China scholars greatly aids the process of constructing a variable that roughly records factional ties. China scholars in general agree that factions are often based on shared characteristics between members of a faction (Dittmer 1995; Dittmer and Wu 1995; Li 1994a). Lieberthal and Oksenberg (1988:156), for example, explain guanxi wang, or networks of informal ties, in the following terms:
尽管派系在中国政治中居于核心地位，但在系统性地观察它们方面极为困难，尤其是在像中国这样不透明的政治体制中。然而，中国研究学者以往的研究在构建大致记录派系关系的变量过程中提供了极大帮助。中国学者普遍认为，派系往往基于派系成员之间的共同特征（Dittmer 1995；Dittmer 和 Wu 1995；Li 1994a）。例如，Lieberthal 和 Oksenberg（1988:156）如下解释 guanxi wang，或非正式关系网络：
Bonds of guanxi entail mutual obligation. These bonds arise from family connections, common geographical origin, shared experience (school or military service ties), or shared loyalty toward the same patron or commander. (such as having served Zhou Enlai or Liu Shaoqi)
关系纽带包含相互义务。这些纽带源于家庭关系、共同的地理出身、共同经历（学校或服兵役的联系），或对同一资助人或指挥官的共同忠诚。（例如曾为周恩来或刘少奇效力）
As outsiders, we can only observe what are commonly thought of as the bases of factions. But, as Dittmer put it, “an objective basis for an affinity does not necessarily create one” (Dittmer 1995). Despite this problem, all else being equal, we can infer that those cadres with shared ascriptive ties, including birth, school, and work, are more likely to be in the same faction than those without such ties. The implicit argument here is that shared experience or shared primordial ties between cadres lower the cost of searching for a faction leader or faction followers. For one, shared experience and primordial ties furnish marginal information about the character of another person, decreasing the risk of faction building. Socially, it is less awkward to approach someone with whom one shares common experience or primordial ties. Indeed, an internal Chinese circular outlined the precise process whereby factions are formed “…some leading cadres encourage friends, relations, fellow natives (tongxiang), classmates, old colleagues, and old subordinates to beg them for positions in the government (paoguan yaoguan)” (Editors 1998). These logical inferences serve as the foundation of the index of informal ties used here. The index focuses on possible informal ties between provincial governors and Party secretaries and members
作为外部观察者，我们只能观察到通常被认为是派系基础的因素。但是，正如 Dittmer 所言，“一种亲和力的客观基础并不一定会创造出亲和力”(Dittmer 1995)。尽管存在这个问题，其他条件相同的情况下，我们可以推断，那些具有共同属性性联系的干部，包括出生、学校和工作背景，比没有此类联系的干部更有可能属于同一派系。这里的隐含论点是，干部之间的共同经历或共同的原初联系降低了寻找派系领导人或派系追随者的成本。一方面，共同经历和原初联系提供了关于他人人格的边际信息，降低了结成派系的风险。在社会交往上，接近与自己有共同经历或原初联系的人也较不尴尬。事实上，一份内部中文通报概述了派系形成的具体过程，“……一些领导干部鼓励朋友、亲属、同乡、同学、老同事和老下属到他们面前求职（跑官要官）”(Editors 1998)。 这些逻辑推断构成了此处使用的非正式关系指数的基础。该指数侧重于省长和省委书记与政治局常务委员会成员之间可能存在的非正式关系
of the Standing Committee of the Politburo. Essentially, governors and Party secretaries who share birth, school, work, or native ties with a member of the Standing Committee are presumed to be a member of his faction.
本质上，与常务委员会成员在出生地、学校、工作或籍贯上有共同点的省长和省委书记，被假定为该成员的派系成员。
Applying this logic, I construct a panel data set that records common characteristics of provincial leaders and Standing Committee members in thirty provinces, directly administered cities, and autonomous regions between 1978 and 2004. In this data set, I code dummy variables that record a one when a province’s Party secretary or governor has shared birth, work, or educational ties with a member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo and zero otherwise. 4 4 ^(4){ }^{4} Moreover, through interviews in China, I also learned that senior cadres in the Party often recruit faction members from among the provincial leaders of their native provinces. 5 5 ^(5){ }^{5} Therefore, I also code a dummy variable that records a one when a province is the birth province of a serving Standing Committee member. With these variables, as well as their derivatives, one can test whether inferred faction ties have a systematic effect on the distribution of resources in the Chinese political system.
基于这一逻辑，我构建了一个面板数据集，记录了 1978 年至 2004 年间三十个省、直辖市和自治区的省级领导和政治局常务委员会成员的共同特征。在该数据集中，我为当省的党委书记或省长与政治局常务委员会成员存在同生地、同工作经历或同受教育背景的情况编码虚拟变量：存在则记为 1，否则为 0。 4 4 ^(4){ }^{4} 此外，通过在中国的访谈，我还了解到党内高级干部常常从其籍贯省的省级领导中招募派系成员。 5 5 ^(5){ }^{5} 因此，我还为当省是某在任常务委员会成员的出生省份的情况编码一个虚拟变量：存在则记为 1。利用这些变量及其派生变量，可以检验推断出的派系联系是否对中国政治体制内资源分配具有系统性影响。
Because these faction ties are inferred ones rather than actual ones, it puts an extra hurdle on testing the effects of factions. Because factional ties are presumed to exist given the presence of objective bases, some of the coded faction ties in reality are false positives. Similarly, actual ties in fact exist in some of the observations where faction ties are not coded. This implies a high likelihood of measurement error in these variables. Nonetheless, because the error is due to imperfect knowledge of the researcher rather than to some characteristics about China, there is every reason to believe that the measurement error is randomly distributed with respect to the error term of the final model and to the other independent variables. Given random measurement errors, the coefficients of the faction variables are likely to bias downward toward zero, creating a higher hurdle for testing the effects of the faction variables (Achen 1984). Significant coefficients for the factional variables would give us a high degree of confidence about the existence of the factional effect. At the same time, if the coefficients of the factional variables turn out to be insignificant or close to zero, we would be uncertain of the actual effect of factions.
因为这些派系联系是推断出来的而非实际观测到的，这给检验派系影响增加了额外障碍。由于在存在客观基础的情况下假定存在派系联系，因此一些被编码为有派系联系的案例实际上是伪阳性。同样，在一些没有被编码为有派系联系的观察中，实际上也存在真实联系。这意味着这些变量很可能存在较高的测量误差。尽管如此，由于误差源于研究者知识的不完备而非中国的某些特征，我们有充分理由相信该测量误差相对于最终模型的误差项和其他自变量是随机分布的。鉴于测量误差是随机的，派系变量的系数很可能向零偏倚，从而增加了检验派系变量影响的难度（Achen 1984）。如果派系变量的系数显著，则会让我们对派系效应的存在有高度信心。 同时，如果派系变量的系数被证明不显著或接近于零，我们就无法确定派系的实际影响。
In order to test the effects of the two types of factions, I consolidate the birth, education, work, and native ties into two factional variables: Ties with Party Secretary General ( i t ) ( i t ) _((it)){ }_{(i t)} and Ties with Technocrats ( i t ) ( i t ) _((it)){ }_{(i t)}. The first variable records the putative factional ties between the serving General Secretary of the CCP and provincial officials. With very few exceptions, the General Secretary during the
为了检验这两类派系的影响，我将出生、教育、工作和同乡关系整合为两个派系变量：与党中央总书记的关系 ( i t ) ( i t ) _((it)){ }_{(i t)} 和与技术官僚的关系 ( i t ) ( i t ) _((it)){ }_{(i t)} 。第一个变量记录在任中共中央总书记与省级官员之间的推定派系关系。除了极少数例外，担任总书记期间的
reform era tended to be the head of the dominant generalist faction. Although other Standing Committee members intervened in banks occasionally as well, the rate of success was probably not as consistent. 6 6 ^(6){ }^{6} I also add Deng Xiaoping in this variable because he was the quintessential Party politician throughout much of the reform era. As Table 5.1 reveals, some 40 percent of provincial leadership between 1978 and 2004 had putative ties with the General Secretary or with Deng. 7 7 ^(7){ }^{7}
改革时期的领导者往往是占主导地位的通才派系的首脑。尽管其他中央政治局常委偶尔也会对银行进行干预，但他们成功的频率可能没有那么稳定。 6 6 ^(6){ }^{6} 我还将邓小平纳入此变量，因为在很大一段改革时期里，他是典型的 Party 政治人物。正如表 5.1 所示，1978 年至 2004 年间约有 40%的省级领导被认为与总书记或邓小平存在假定的联系。 7 7 ^(7){ }^{7}
The Ties with Technocrats variable tracks the factional ties of Standing Committee members who were reputed to be the leaders of the central economic bureaucracy. As stated in Chapter 4, they include Chen Yun, who oversaw the planning bureaucracy throughout the 1980s and the early 1990s, his protégés Yao Yilin and Song Ping, as well as Li Peng and Zhu Rongji. These officials spent the majority of their careers in the central economic bureaucracy and built a coterie of followers who also based their careers on posts in the central bureaucracy. Although Zhao Ziyang served as premier, the nominal head of the bureaucracy, in the early 1980s, his followers were mainly provincial officials serving in Hunan, Guangdong, and Sichuan (Cheung 1998a; Wu 1997: 86). Furthermore, because of resistance from Chen Yun, Zhao was never able to build a strong network in the economic bureaucracy (see Chapters 6 and 7). As such, Zhao Ziyang is considered a Party leader rather than a leader of the bureaucracy throughout this period. The mean value of the technocrat variable on Table 5.1 reveals that relative to the generalist factions, half as many provincial governments were staffed by members of technocratic factions ( 23 percent). This is as expected as members of technocratic factions spend the bulk of their careers in the central bureaucracy. But since they serve in important provincial positions in over 20 percent of the observations, we are able to gauge their impact on provincial level credit distribution.
“Ties with Technocrats” 变量追踪被认为是中央经济官僚体系领导人的常务委员会成员的派系联系。如第 4 章所述，这些人包括在整个 1980 年代和 1990 年代初监管计划经济官僚体系的陈云、他的门徒姚依林和宋平，以及李鹏和朱镕基。这些官员的大部分职业生涯都在中央经济官僚体系中度过，并且建立了一批追随者，这些追随者也基于在中央官僚体系的职务发展其职业生涯。尽管赵紫阳在 1980 年代初曾任总理，即名义上的官僚体系首脑，但他的追随者主要是在湖南、广东和四川任职的省级官员（Cheung 1998a；Wu 1997: 86）。此外，由于陈云的阻力，赵从未能在经济官僚体系中建立起强大的网络（见第 6 章和第 7 章）。因此，在此期间赵紫阳被视为一位党的领导人，而非官僚体系的领导人。 表 5.1 中技术官僚派系变量的平均值显示，与通才派系相比，由技术官僚派系成员组成的省级政府只占一半（23%）。这在预料之中，因为技术官僚派系成员的大部分职业生涯都在中央官僚体系中度过。 但由于他们在超过 20%的观测中担任重要的省级职务，我们得以评估他们对省级信贷分配的影响。

The Model  模型

The dependent variable in this model is state bank lending in every province between 1978 and 2004. Specifically, lending is operationalized as the loan-todeposit ratio within a given province. The PBOC has targeted this ratio as a way to determine how much the local branches of the state banks could lend since the 1980s. As Lardy (1997; 1998) points out, varying loan-to-deposit targets between the provinces tantamount to an interregional redistribution of financial resources. Ma (1996) further explains that PBOC loan-to-deposit targets were often superceded because daring provincial leaders shifted funds earmarked for government priority project to support local industries, forcing the PBOC to lend more money to the local banks. These factors generate clear variation in the loan-to-deposit ratio between provinces and over time that
这个模型的因变量是 1978 年至 2004 年间各省的国有银行放贷额。具体来说，放贷用各省的贷款存款比来操作化。自 20 世纪 80 年代以来，PBOC 一直以该比率为目标来决定国有银行地方分行可贷出的资金规模。正如 Lardy (1997; 1998) 指出，不同省份之间不同的贷款存款目标等同于金融资源的跨区域再分配。Ma (1996) 进一步解释说，PBOC 的贷款存款目标经常被取代，因为一些大胆的省级领导将原本用于政府优先项目的资金转移以支持地方产业，迫使 PBOC 向地方银行提供更多贷款。这些因素在省际之间以及随时间产生了贷款存款比的明显变异，导致
needs to be explained. Some provinces were clearly more willing to flaunt the PBOC’s credit plan.
需要解释清楚。有些省份显然更愿意公开挑战 PBOC 的信贷计划。
Because we are interested in the effect of factional ties in addition to the impact of economic variables, I also control for a series of economic variables that represent four main determinants of how credit is distributed in China. They are developmental, fiscal, bureaucratic, and welfare, respectively. 8 8 ^(8){ }^{8} Controlling for these variables also serves the purpose of seeing how these criteria perform when one controls for the factional effect.
因为我们感兴趣的不仅是派系关系的影响，还包括经济变量的影响，所以我还控制了一系列代表中国信贷分配四个主要决定因素的经济变量。它们分别是发展性、财政性、官僚性和福利性。 8 8 ^(8){ }^{8} 控制这些变量的目的也是为了在控制派系影响时观察这些标准的表现。
There are always good reasons to control for the level of development. In this case, lending in affluent regions is more likely to be under stricter central supervision due to the prominent role they play in the economy overall. Rapid expansion of credit as a share of deposits in affluent regions may well have a substantial effect on the overall money supply as a result of the relatively large size of the deposits in rich regions. This then would prompt stricter central monitoring. Finally, according to Lardy (1998: 88), central government uses the banking system to transfer money from affluent to poor regions, generating a negative relationship between the level of development and the loan-to-deposit ratio. To test this effect, I include the log of provincial GDP per capita between 1978 and 2004 in the equation.
控制发展水平总是有充分理由。在本例中，富裕地区的贷款更可能受到中央更严格的监管，因为这些地区在整体经济中扮演着重要角色。富裕地区贷款占存款比重的快速扩张，鉴于这些地区存款规模相对较大，可能会对总体货币供应产生实质性影响。这反过来会促使更严格的中央监测。最后，根据 Lardy (1998: 88)，中央政府利用银行系统将资金从富裕地区转移到贫困地区，从而在发展水平与贷款／存款比率之间产生负相关关系。为检验这一效应，我在方程中加入了 1978 至 2004 年间省级人均 GDP 的对数。
The fiscal effect on loan distribution involves a province’s increased ability to bargain for more financial resources if it hands over large sums of revenue to the central government (Wu and Zheng 1995). The fiscal effect is represented by the log of total revenue collected by a province in a given year. Furthermore, scholars have long argued that the distorted financial system in China allocated bank funds to places with strong SOE presence due to the legacy of the planned economy (Huang 2003: 106). Thus, money, rather than being allocated by the market or by welfare considerations, is instead allocated according to the size of the local SOE economy. To represent this effect, I include the log of SOE gross output of industry.
财政对贷款分配的影响体现在：如果一个省向中央政府上缴大量财政收入，则该省有更强的议价能力以争取更多的财政资源（Wu and Zheng 1995）。财政效应用该省在某一年度所征收总收入的对数来表示。此外，学者长期认为中国扭曲的金融体系由于计划经济的遗留问题，将银行资金配置给国有企业（SOE）占比高的地区（Huang 2003: 106）。因此，资金并非由市场或福利考量来配置，而是根据地方国有企业经济规模来分配。为表示这一效应，我引入了工业部门国有企业产值总量的对数。
Finally, Lardy (1998: 15) and Pei (1998) argue that welfare considerations of the CCP regime have an important impact on the distribution of bank loan. Specifically, through an analysis of loan-to-deposit ratios among Chinese provinces, Lardy (1997) concludes that deposits from richer provinces are routinely redistributed to poor inland provinces which rely mostly on agricultural production. Moreover, bank loans are disbursed to provinces with a large SOE base, presumably to sustain the welfare of SOE workers (Lardy 1997; Pei 1998). However, the level of development and the gross output of the SOE sector might represent other causal logics, as suggested earlier. Therefore, to directly represent the welfare effect, two variables that measure the welfare needs of a province are used: percentage of population employed by SOEs and percentage of employment that is rural employment. If the signs of these two variables are positive, it would lend credence to the idea that Chinese banks
最后，Lardy (1998: 15) 和 Pei (1998) 认为，中共政权的福利考量对银行贷款的分配有重要影响。具体来说，通过对中国各省存贷比的分析，Lardy (1997) 得出结论：来自较富省份的存款常被再分配到主要依赖农业生产的贫困内陆省份。此外，银行贷款也发放给拥有大量国有企业基础的省份，可能是为了维持国有企业职工的福利（Lardy 1997；Pei 1998）。然而，如前所述，发展水平和国有企业部门的总产出可能代表其他因果逻辑。因此，为了直接表示福利效应，使用了两个衡量省级福利需求的变量：由国有企业雇用的人口比例和农村就业占就业的比例。如果这两个变量的符号为正，则会支持这样的观点：中资银行

are systematically mobilized to enhance the welfare of workers and farmers. In sum, the full model has five sets of variables: faction, developmental, fiscal, bureaucratic, and welfare.
被系统动员以增进工人和农民的福利。总之，完整模型包含五类变量：派系、发展、财政、官僚和福利。
To estimate this model, I employ both ordinary least square (OLS) and panel corrected standard error (PCSE) models, the latter of which rectifies the timeseries, cross-sectional nature of the data set (Beck and Katz 1995). For the PCSE models, I further estimate the first order autoregressive error to correct the high likelihood of autoregressive shocks (Beck and Katz 2004). I also add year dummies to control for the effect of annual economic fluctuations on the error structure. For example, loan-to-deposit ratio was unusually high in 1993 for the entire country. The annual dummy variable for 1993 would absorb this effect. To demonstrate the robustness of the findings, I run the regressions with both Ties variables together and also separately in regressions presented on Table 5.2. Heeding Achen (2005) and Clarke’s (2005) caution against “garbage-can” models, I run the PCSE regressions with only logged GDP per capita and year dummies as control variables and present the results on Table 5.3.9
为了估计该模型，我同时采用普通最小二乘法（OLS）和面板修正标准误（PCSE）模型，后者能够校正数据集的时间序列-横截面性质（Beck 和 Katz 1995）。对于 PCSE 模型，我进一步估计一阶自回归误差以修正自回归冲击的高可能性（Beck 和 Katz 2004）。我还加入年度虚拟变量以控制年度经济波动对误差结构的影响。例如，1993 年全国家庭的存贷比异常偏高，1993 年的年度虚拟变量可以吸收这一影响。为证明结果的稳健性，我在表 5.2 中既将两个 Ties 变量同时放入回归，也在单独回归中分别放入。鉴于 Achen（2005）和 Clarke（2005）对“垃圾桶”模型的警示，我在表 5.3 中仅以对数人均 GDP 和年度虚拟变量作为控制变量运行 PCSE 回归并展示结果。
These findings contain two unambiguous outcomes closely related to the heart of this study. First, they show that factional ties indeed exert a systematic effect on the distribution of bank loans to the provinces. The positive and significant coefficients of Ties with Party Secretary General reveal that having birth, education, work, or native ties with the serving Party Secretary General or with Deng Xiaoping on average provides an advantage of obtaining loans equivalent to 2.3 to 9 percent of the provincial deposit. In the reform era, when the total bank deposits in some provinces reached hundreds of billions of yuan, an advantage of a few percentage points easily translates to billions in additional loans. Granted, this effect is substantially diminished once we control for first-order autoregressive effects in equations 2 and 4 on Table 5.2 and in equations 1 and 2 on Table 5.3. Nonetheless, the advantage of having
这些发现包含两个与本研究核心密切相关的明确结论。首先，它们表明派系关系确实对各省银行贷款的分配产生系统性影响。与总书记的联系（出生、教育、工作或籍贯关系）以及与邓小平的联系的正向且显著的系数表明，拥有这些关系平均上能获得相当于省级存款 2.3%到 9%的贷款优势。在改革时代，当某些省份的银行总存款达到数千亿元时，几个百分点的优势很容易转化为数十亿的额外贷款。当然，一旦我们在表 5.2 的方程 2 和方程 4 以及表 5.3 的方程 1 和方程 2 中控制了一阶自回归效应，这种影响会明显减弱。尽管如此，拥有

省级领导层中一名通才派系成员在包含该变量的所有方程中其系数始终为正且显著。
Second, the coefficients of the Ties with Technocrat variable strongly suggest that ties with the leading bureaucrats in the Standing Committee do not yield any systematic advantage to a province in terms of obtaining loans. The coefficients of the variable remain minute and insignificant throughout all of the above equations. The difference between ties with the General Secretary and ties with the leading technocrat strongly suggests the existence of the two types of factional strategies postulated by the factional model. Whereas a General Secretary supplies factional followers in the provinces with added investment and bank loans to bolster the growth rates of the provinces over which they govern, a leading bureaucrat has little incentive to do likewise. This finding is even more striking when one considers that the leading technocrats in the State Council have more direct access to the banking system than any Party generalists, who can only exert indirect pressure.
其次，“与技术官僚的关系”变量的系数强烈表明，与常务委员会中主导的官僚建立关系并不会在获取贷款方面为一个省带来任何系统性的优势。该变量的系数在上述所有方程中始终微小且不显著。与总书记关系和与主导技术官僚关系之间的差异有力地表明了派系模型所假设的两种派系策略的存在。总书记会向其在省级的派系追随者提供额外的投资和银行贷款，以支撑其所治理省份的增长率，而一位主导的官僚则几乎没有动机这样做。当考虑到国务院的主导技术官僚比任何党内通才都更能直接接触银行体系——党内通才只能施加间接压力——这一发现就更加引人注目。
The coefficients of the economic variables also shed important light on the political economy of China, especially given the presence of the factional variables. First, as Lardy argues, the banking system seems to systematically channel funds to poorer regions, as the coefficient for logged GDP per capita is consistently negative and significant. Nonetheless, as the results shown later suggest, this could be the product of stricter monitoring of more affluent regions rather than an active transfer of loans to less developed regions for welfare purposes.
经济变量的系数在中国的政治经济方面也提供了重要见解，尤其是在存在派系变量的情况下。首先，正如 Lardy 所指出的，银行体系似乎系统性地将资金输送到较贫困地区，因为人均 GDP 取对数的系数始终为负且显著。然而，正如随后结果所示，这可能是对较富裕地区更严格监管的产物，而非出于福利目的主动将贷款转移到欠发达地区。
Fiscal contribution seems to exert a negative systematic influence on the loan-todeposit ratio, especially in the PCSE equations with autoregressions. Contrary to the expectation of the bargaining theorists, all else being equal, sending more revenue to the central government seems to limit localities’ access to the banking system. This outcome, however, could be the result of collinearity between GDP per capita and fiscal contribution. As expected by scholars of the planned economy, the banking sector displays a robust tendency to allocate loans to regions with high SOE presence. Again, although autocorrelation accounts for much of this effect, even when we take autocorrelation into account, SOE output strongly predicts the allocation of bank loans.
财政上缴对存贷比率似乎产生负向的系统性影响，尤其在带自回归项的 PCSE 方程中更为明显。与讨价还价理论者的预期相反，其他条件相同的情况下，上缴更多财政收入给中央政府似乎限制了地方对银行体系的访问。然而，这一结果可能是人均 GDP 与财政上缴之间共线性的结果。正如计划经济研究者所预期的那样，银行业确实表现出将贷款配置给国有企业占比较高地区的稳健倾向。同样，尽管自相关解释了这一效应的大部分，但即便在考虑自相关的情况下，国有企业产出仍能强有力地预测银行贷款的配置。
The final factor to consider is the impact of the regime’s welfare consideration on the distribution of lending. There is ample anecdotal and cross-tabulation evidence to suggest that the regime uses the banking system to inject capital to distressed and poor provinces (Lardy 1998: 15). Nonetheless, these results reveal an ambiguous picture. On the one hand, provinces with lower GDP per capita are clearly the recipients of central subsidies through the banking system, further confirming Park and Sehrt’s (2001) empirical discoveries. Moreover, provinces with a heavier presence of SOEs receive more subsidies through the banking sector. On the other hand, more direct indicators of welfare, including the percentage of SOE workers in the population and the percentage of rural labor in the employed population, have on a whole a negative effect on the loan-to-deposit ratio. Although the share of SOE population exhibits extremely powerful autocorrelation, the coefficient for the variable nonetheless remains negative throughout all of the equations on Table 5.2. At the very least, this finding suggests that provinces saddled with SOE workers are no more able to attract bank loans than provinces with fewer SOE workers as a proportion of population. At the same time, a ɪ percent increase in rural labor in a province brought about at least 0.24 percent decrease in loans. This finding is negative and significant throughout all of the equations on Table 5.2. Again, these findings indicate that provinces burdened with SOE workers and surplus rural labor forces are less able to obtain loans than more urbanized provinces.
最后需要考虑的因素是政权的福利考量对贷款分配的影响。有大量轶事和交叉表证据表明，政权利用银行体系向困境省份和贫困省份注入资本（Lardy 1998: 15）。尽管如此，这些结果呈现出模糊的图景。一方面，人均 GDP 较低的省份显然是通过银行体系获得中央补贴的接受者，这进一步验证了 Park 和 Sehrt（2001）的实证发现。此外，国有企业（SOE）占比较重的省份也通过银行部门获得更多补贴。另一方面，更直接的福利指标，包括国有企业在业人员占总人口的比例以及农村劳动力在就业人口中的比重，总体上对存贷比率有负向影响。尽管国有企业人口比例表现出极强的自相关性，该变量的系数在表 5.2 的所有方程中仍然保持为负。 至少，这一发现表明，国有企业从业人员占比较高的省份在吸引银行贷款方面并不优于国有企业从业人员占比较低的省份。同时，某省农村劳动力增加 1 个百分点至少会导致贷款减少 0.24 个百分点。该发现在线表 5.2 的所有方程中均为负且显著。再次说明，负担有大量国有企业从业人员和过剩农村劳动力的省份比更城市化的省份更难获得贷款。
Overall, the findings indicate that the distribution of loans in China is largely driven by bureaucratic and political processes rather than by purely welfare considerations. Politically, local administrators use their membership in powerful generalist factions to obtain more money. Moreover, the center retains the ability to impose tighter supervision on more affluent provinces. At the same time, provinces with larger SOE presence in terms of output are automatically allocated more loans in the remnant planned economy. Nonetheless, the regime as a whole does not seem concerned with the burdens of excessive SOE workers or surplus rural labor when they decide where to allocate bank loans. A particular telling comparison is the difference in the effect of SOE output and SOE workers. Whereas SOE output, which is an indicator of a province’s bureaucratic clout in the planned economy, exerts a positive effect on lending, the percentage of SOE workers, which records the actual magnitude of the SOE employment problem, exerts a generally negative effect on lending. In a bureaucratic
总体而言，研究结果表明，中国的贷款分配主要由官僚和政治过程驱动，而不是纯粹的福利考量。从政治上看，地方行政官员利用他们在强大综合派系中的成员身份来获取更多资金。此外，中央保留对较富裕省份实施更严格监管的能力。与此同时，在残余计划经济中，产出规模较大的国有企业所在省份会自动分配到更多贷款。尽管如此，整个政权在决定银行贷款分配时似乎并不关心过多的国企员工或农村剩余劳动力的负担。有一个特别有说服力的对比是国企产出和国企就业人数比例的效果差异。作为计划经济中省级官僚影响力的指标，国企产出对贷款有正向影响；而记录国企就业问题实际规模的国企员工比例总体上对贷款有负向影响。在官僚体系中
economy where capital and market are both controlled by the CCP, it is not at all surprising that purely welfare considerations have little effect on the allocation of money. In fact, perversely, they determine where money would not go.
在一个资本和市场都由中共控制的经济体中，仅出于福利考量对货币配置几乎没有影响，这并不令人惊讶。事实上，反常的是，福利考量决定了资金不会流向何处。

Factions and Inflationary Cycles
派系与通货膨胀周期

An important implication of the factional model is that the PBOC’s ability to constrain inflationary pressure is intimately tied to signals the central government sends to local governments, which are dependent on inflation rates. In the absence of a major economic crisis, provincial officials, especially those with intimate ties with elite Party politicians, have no qualms about flaunting the central bank’s credit plan by pressuring local financial institutions to support local investment. Without an inflationary crisis, leaders of generalist factions also have no compunction about directing more central investment to provinces governed by factional members. However, as inflation increases as a result of the expansion of credit, the credibility of the central bank actually increases because the central technocratic faction can centralize financial power in a less costly fashion during a perceived crisis. Meanwhile, the leader of the dominant generalist faction is more likely to delegate financial control to the technocratic faction in order to avoid a financial collapse. Thus, high inflation in one period increases the probability of a central reaction against lending in a subsequent period, producing disinflation.
派系模型的一个重要含义是，中国人民银行（PBOC）抑制通货膨胀压力的能力，与中央政府向地方政府发出的信号密切相关，而这些信号又取决于通货膨胀率。在没有重大经济危机的情况下，省级官员，尤其是与党内精英政治人物关系密切的官员，毫不犹豫地通过向地方金融机构施压以支持地方投资，从而公然无视中央银行的信贷计划。在没有通货膨胀危机时，泛行政派系的领导人也无顾忌地将更多中央投资导向由派系成员治理的省份。然而，随着信贷扩张导致的通货膨胀上升，中央银行的可信度实际上会提高，因为在被视为危机的情况下，中央技术官僚派系可以以较低成本集中金融权力。与此同时，为了避免金融崩溃，主导的泛行政派系领导人更有可能将金融控制权下放给技术官僚派系。 因此，一期的高通货膨胀会增加中央对下一期信贷进行反制的可能性，从而产生去通胀效果。
Unlike in the Western political economy literature, what ultimately undermines the central bank’s credibility is not high unemployment, which compels a Western central bank to release credit if a leftist government can intervene in monetary policy (Boix 2000; Keech 1995:71). In China, signs of economic recovery toward the end of an austerity period increase the demand for money balance from both societal agents and local government officials, who begin to lobby their patrons at the center for credit relief. IO IO  ^("IO "){ }^{\text {IO }} At the same time, economic recovery signals to everyone the passing of the economic crisis, which emboldens leaders of generalist factions to once again intervene in monetary policy. Although this tends to be a gradual process with the most powerful politicians intervening first, followed by less powerful leaders, the eventual outcome is the collapse of central bank credibility, which augurs the beginning of another inflationary cycle.
与西方政治经济学文献不同，最终破坏中央银行信誉的并非高失业率（在西方，高失业率会迫使中央银行在左翼政府能干预货币政策时释放信贷（Boix 2000；Keech 1995:71））。在中国，紧缩期接近尾声时的经济复苏迹象会增加社会主体和地方政府官员对货币余额的需求，他们开始向中央的裙带或上级游说以获得信贷宽松。同时，经济复苏向所有人传达了经济危机已过的信号，这使得泛职业派系的领导人再次敢于干预货币政策。尽管这一过程通常是渐进的，最有权势的政治人物先行干预，然后权力较小的领导跟进，但最终结果是中央银行信誉的崩溃，这预示着另一个通货膨胀周期的开始。
In order to test these propositions quantitatively, a time-series approach is needed. Three sets of time-series models are used to test the implications of the
为了对这些命题进行定量检验，需要采用时间序列方法。使用三组时间序列模型来检验派系框架的含义。
factional framework. The first set of models tests whether past inflation and autoregressive shocks exert a systematic, negative effect on contemporary inflation. The second set of models also tests the retrenchment effect by examining whether past inflation has a negative effect on current lending. Presumably, high inflation in the past would result in financial centralization, which lowers the overall level of lending. Finally, the third set of models tests whether past output growth indeed exerts positive pressure on contemporary inflation. The time-series estimations here reveal that high inflation in one period suppresses first lending, then inflation in subsequent periods. This accords well with the theoretical prediction of how inflationary cycles work in China. Furthermore, high output in one period consistently triggers high inflation in a subsequent period.
第一组模型检验过去的通货膨胀和自回归冲击是否对当期通货膨胀产生系统性的负向影响。第二组模型通过检验过去的通货膨胀是否对当前放贷有负面影响来测试收缩效应。一般认为，过去的高通货膨胀会导致金融集中化，从而降低整体放贷水平。最后，第三组模型检验过去的产出增长是否确实对当期通货膨胀施加正向压力。时间序列估计在此处表明，一个时期的高通货膨胀会先抑制随后的放贷，然后抑制随后的通货膨胀。这与关于通货膨胀周期在中国如何运行的理论预测相吻合。此外，一个时期的高产出会持续触发后续时期的高通货膨胀。
The major weakness of this model is that it does not specify the time frame within which past inflation and growth affect current inflation and lending. The impact, however, is presumed to be a short-term one. That is, high inflation in one period should have a negative impact on future inflation sooner rather than later. After all, the key to China’s success in reining in inflation is the central bureaucracy’s ability to retake control over monetary policies before hyperinflation takes hold. Unfortunately, because of exogenous political factors described in Chapters 6 to 8, the actual takeover can take anywhere between two to six quarters. Thus, the time-series models here also aim to empirically assess the time it takes to suppress lending and inflation. Using models with various lags and a Bayesian method of choosing the most efficient model, I am able to measure the average time it takes for high inflation to suppress lending and inflation and for high growth to induce inflation.
该模型的主要弱点在于它没有明确规定过去的通货膨胀和增长在多长时间范围内影响当前的通货膨胀和放贷。不过，这种影响被假定为短期的。也就是说，一个时期内的高通货膨胀应当较快地对未来的通货膨胀产生负面影响。毕竟，中国能够控制通货膨胀的关键在于中央官僚机构在恶性通货膨胀形成之前收回对货币政策的控制的能力。不幸的是，由于第 6 至第 8 章所述的外生政治因素，实际的接管可能需要两到六个季度不等。因此，本章中的时间序列模型也旨在通过经验方法评估抑制放贷和通胀所需的时间。通过使用具有各种滞后期的模型并采用贝叶斯方法选择最有效的模型，我能够测量高通货膨胀抑制放贷和通胀以及高增长引发通胀所需的平均时间。

The Inflation Models  通货膨胀模型

In the first set of models, the explanatory variables are the lagged and autoregressive terms of inflation. These variables gauge the role of past inflation in bolstering the central bank’s credibility. The expected sign of the coefficients here is negative, which is the opposite of the predictions generated by conventional economic theory. Both expectation theory (Mankiw 1994) and empirical findings by Fischer and others (2002) suggest a positive relationship between past and current inflation. According to expectation theory, inflation feeds on itself because it compels people to switch from cash holding to material goods, which further drives up prices. Moreover, as inflation increases, rising inflationary expectation compels societal agents to make contracts at higher prices than they otherwise would, which worsens inflation (Agenor and Taylor 1993). The dampening of inflationary pressure is usually achieved by exogenous interventions that strengthen the central bank’s credibility, including exchange rate anchors, institutional changes, and inflation targeting policies (Agenor and Taylor 1993; Alesina and Summers 1993; Cukierman 1994; Mishkin 2001). The factional framework, however, predicts that factional competition over monetary policy produces a negative relationship between past inflation and current inflation because the probability of realizing austerity increases with rising inflation.
在第一组模型中，解释变量是滞后项和自回归项的通货膨胀。这些变量衡量过去通货膨胀在增强中央银行信誉方面的作用。这里系数的预期符号为负，这与传统经济理论的预测相反。预期理论（Mankiw 1994）和 Fischer 等人的实证发现（2002）均表明过去通货膨胀与当前通货膨胀之间存在正相关关系。根据预期理论，通货膨胀自我强化，因为它迫使人们从持有现金转向持有实物商品，从而进一步推高价格。此外，随着通货膨胀上升，日益增长的通胀预期迫使社会主体以比原本更高的价格订立合约，从而加剧通货膨胀（Agenor 和 Taylor 1993）。抑制通胀压力通常通过外生干预来实现，以增强中央银行的信誉，包括汇率锚、制度变革和通胀目标政策（Agenor 和 Taylor 1993；Alesina 和 Summers 1993；Cukierman 1994；Mishkin 2001）。 然而，派系框架，然而，预测党派间在货币政策上的竞争会导致过去的通货膨胀与当前通货膨胀之间呈负相关，因为随着通货膨胀上升，实现紧缩的概率也随之增加。
The effect that past inflation has on current inflation can be broken down into two elements. First, central bureaucrats constantly watch for signs of high inflation in the economy because they present opportunities to regain central control over the financial system. Thus, they establish thresholds for dangerous levels of inflation throughout the reform era, although, as Chapters 6 to 8 reveal, these thresholds are highly contested by the two types of factions. To predict when the economy might exceed these thresholds, central bureaucrats monitor fluctuations of key indicators, including lending, industrial growth rate, fixed asset investment, and cash circulation (Editors 1993a; Jin and Wang 1991; Xue 1996). If inflation exceeds a certain threshold, the central bureaucracy would earnestly begin to maneuver for a centralization drive. Although top bureaucrats are politically powerful in their own right, a high inflationary environment provides the most favorable conditions for them to wrest power from generalist factions. This mechanism creates a systematic lag effect on current inflation. In addition to the systematic element, however, inflation at times exceeds the expectation of the central bureaucrats, as in the case of 1988. When unexpected exogenous shocks such as panic buying and political intervention generate inflation that exceeds expectation, they create an extra sense of urgency that facilitates a takeover by the technocratic faction. Thus, we should also observe an auto-regressive effect on contemporary inflation. That is, we should see a negative effect of past shock on current shock.
过去通货膨胀对当前通货膨胀的影响可以分解为两个要素。首先，中央官僚不断关注经济中通货膨胀的体征，因为它们为收回对金融体系的中央控制提供了机会。因此，在整个改革时期，他们为危险的通货膨胀水平设定了阈值，尽管正如第 6 至第 8 章所揭示的，这些阈值在两类派系之间备受争议。为了预测何时经济可能超出这些阈值，中央官僚监测若干关键指标的波动，包括贷款、工业增长率、固定资产投资和现金流通（Editors 1993a；Jin and Wang 1991；Xue 1996）。如果通货膨胀超过某一阈值，中央官僚会认真地开始谋划一场中央集权的推动。尽管高级官僚本身在政治上已经具有强大权力，但高通胀环境为他们从通才派系手中夺取权力提供了最有利的条件。这一机制对当前通货膨胀产生了系统性的滞后效应。 然而，除了制度性因素外，通货膨胀有时会超出中央官僚预期，正如 1988 年的情况。当恐慌性抢购和政治干预等意外外生冲击导致超出预期的通货膨胀时，会产生额外的紧迫感，从而有利于技术官僚派系的接管。因此，我们还应观察到对当期通胀的自回归效应。 也就是说，我们应当看到过去冲击对当前冲击的负向影响。
This test uses quarterly national data from 1980 to 2001 (see the Appendix for details). The dependent variable is inflation, which is the consumer price index, CPI ( t ) CPI ( t ) CPI_((t))\mathrm{CPI}_{(\mathrm{t})}. II II  ^("II "){ }^{\text {II }} The independent variables include both lags of the dependent variable and the auto-regressive terms. It is unclear whether inflation is a stationary variable (see Figure 2.1). If it is not, it can lead to spurious regression. As such, I conduct the Dickey-Fuller test on unit root, which reveals that CPI might have a nonstationarity problem. To rectify this problem, I calculate the percentage change of CPI (Figure 5.1). 12 12 ^(12){ }^{12} After transforming the variable, I reestimate the P value for the new variable DCPI ( t ) DCPI ( t ) DCPI_((t))\mathrm{DCPI}_{(\mathrm{t})} with the Dickey-Fuller test and find that one can reject the hypothesis that DCPI ( t ) DCPI ( t ) DCPI_((t))\mathrm{DCPI}_{(\mathrm{t})} has a unit root, denoting stationarity for the new variable.
本测验使用 1980 年至 2001 年的季度全国数据（详情见附录）。因变量为通货膨胀，即消费价格指数（CPI）， CPI ( t ) CPI ( t ) CPI_((t))\mathrm{CPI}_{(\mathrm{t})} 。 II II  ^("II "){ }^{\text {II }} 自变量包括因变量的滞后项和自回归项。通货膨胀是否为平稳变量尚不清楚（见图 2.1）。若非平稳，可能导致伪回归。因此，我对单位根进行了 Dickey-Fuller 检验，结果显示 CPI 可能存在非平稳性问题。为纠正该问题，我计算了 CPI 的百分比变化（图 5.1）。 12 12 ^(12){ }^{12} 变换变量后，我对新变量使用 Dickey-Fuller 检验重新估计 P 值，并发现可以拒绝 DCPI ( t ) DCPI ( t ) DCPI_((t))\mathrm{DCPI}_{(\mathrm{t})} 存在单位根的假设，表明新变量为平稳序列。 DCPI ( t ) DCPI ( t ) DCPI_((t))\mathrm{DCPI}_{(\mathrm{t})}
The model is estimated as an autoregressive time-series model with different lags of the dependent variable, which go back to six quarters in the past. I include two autoregressive terms for both methodological and theoretical reasons. Methodologically, plotting the autocorrelation function of DCPI reveals that the first two coefficients of autocorrelation likely exert a significant influence on contemporary inflation. There is no need to include additional

autoregressive terms because the autocorrelation function meanders toward zero after t-2 (Pindyck and Rubinfeld 1998: 531). Theoretically, the government is unlikely to immediately react to a change in inflation rate because high inflation is unlikely to become a clear signal to all political actors unless it persists for at least two quarters. Moreover, leaders of generalist factions are probably unwilling to cede financial authority to the technocratic faction unless it becomes clear that the economy is in crisis, which takes time. Thus, although the t -ı coefficient of autocorrelation is expected to be positive because of inflationary inertia, the t − 2 t − 2 t-2\mathbf{t}-\mathbf{2} coefficient of autocorrelation can be negative because unexpected inflation might increase the likelihood of a central bureaucratic takeover after one quarter.
自回归项，因为自相关函数在 t-2 之后趋于零（Pindyck and Rubinfeld 1998: 531）。理论上，政府不太可能对通货膨胀率的变化立即作出反应，因为除非通货膨胀至少持续两个季度，否则高通货膨胀不太可能成为对所有政治行为者都明显的信号。此外，通才派领导人可能不愿将金融权力移交给技术官僚派，除非经济明显陷入危机，而判断这一点需要时间。因此，尽管由于通货膨胀惰性，t-1 的自相关系数预计为正，但 t-0 的自相关系数可能为负，因为意外的通货膨胀可能会在一个季度后增加中央官僚接手的可能性。
Because the theory does not specify the number of lags, I estimate five different models with rising number of lags and use the Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) to select the most efficient model specification. In essence, BIC is a form of corrected R 2 R 2 R^(2)\mathrm{R}^{2}, which takes into account both the goodness of the fit and the efficiency of the model by punishing a model for having too many parameters (Pindyck and Rubinfeld 1998:238; Sekhon 2003). 13 13 ^(13){ }^{13}
由于理论并未指定滞后阶数，我估计了五个滞后数递增的不同模型，并使用贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）来选择最有效的模型规格。本质上，BIC 是一种修正后的 R 2 R 2 R^(2)\mathrm{R}^{2} ，它既考虑拟合优度又考虑模型的效率，通过对参数过多的模型施以惩罚来实现（Pindyck and Rubinfeld 1998:238；Sekhon 2003）。 13 13 ^(13){ }^{13}

In the remaining two models, inflation also produces a negative, albeit insignificant, impact on current inflation. The insignificant coefficients in the last two models likely stem from the presence of multicollinearity in the models. Looking at the BIC, it is minimized at the t − 4 t − 4 t-4\mathrm{t}-4 model on the fourth column from the left, suggesting that it has the best model specification.
过去的通货膨胀对当前通货膨胀产生负向影响。在五个模型中有三个模型显示过去的通货膨胀对当前通货膨胀有负向且显著的影响。在其余两个模型中，通货膨胀同样对当前通货膨胀产生负向但不显著的影响。最后两个模型中不显著的系数很可能源于模型中存在多重共线性。查看 BIC，可见在从左数第四列的 t − 4 t − 4 t-4\mathrm{t}-4 模型处达到最小值，表明该模型具有最佳的模型设定。
In the t − 4 t − 4 t-4\mathrm{t}-4 model, inflation from four quarters ago wields a negative and significant impact on contemporary inflation. If inflation from four quarters ago increases by ɪ percent, current inflation is expected to decline by 0.26 percent. This finding strongly suggests that despite the absence of any credible central banking institutions, the Chinese political system has an internal check against high inflation. In addition to the systematic element of past inflation, the two models presented on the second and third columns also show that the autocorrelation terms of inflation exert a negative and significant influence on current inflation. This finding suggests that unexpected inflation in the past
在 t − 4 t − 4 t-4\mathrm{t}-4 模型中，四个季度前的通货膨胀对当期通货膨胀有负向且显著的影响。如果四个季度前的通货膨胀上升了ɪ个百分点，则预期当前通货膨胀将下降 0.26 个百分点。该发现强烈表明，尽管缺乏任何有公信力的中央银行制度，中国的政治体制内部存在对高通货膨胀的制衡。除了过去通货膨胀的系统性因素外，第二列和第三列中呈现的两个模型也显示，通货膨胀的自相关项对当前通货膨胀有负向且显著的影响。该发现表明，过去的意外通货膨胀进一步抑制了当前的通货膨胀压力。
further dampens current inflationary pressure. However, in the t - 4 model on the fourth column from the left, where the BIC is minimized, neither of the coefficients of autocorrelation seems to have any impact on current inflation. Thus, it is unclear whether unexpected inflation in the past exercises an additional negative influence on current inflation.
然而，在从左数第四列的 t - 4 模型中（其 BIC 最小），自相关系数似乎都对当前通货膨胀没有任何影响。因此，尚不清楚过去的意外通货膨胀是否对当前通货膨胀施加了额外的负面影响。
Overall, the findings of the inflation models strongly indicate that high inflation in one quarter triggers an internal reaction against further inflation. According to the findings above, a reaction against high inflation probably takes between two and four quarters. As subsequent chapters detail, political exigencies at times delayed the imposition of retrenchment, but the Chinese government succeeded time and again to quell inflationary expectation.
总体而言，通货膨胀模型的结果强烈表明，一个季度内的高通货膨胀会触发对进一步通货膨胀的内部反应。根据上述发现，针对高通货膨胀的反应可能需要两到四个季度。正如后续章节所详述，政治上的紧迫情况有时会延迟收缩政策的实施，但中国政府一次又一次成功地平息了通货膨胀预期。

The Lending Models  贷款模型

Related to the inflation implication, another prediction of the factional framework is that high inflation in one quarter would lower lending in a subsequent quarter because central retrenchment first and foremost targets lending. As such, this set of models tests whether past inflation systematically suppresses contemporary lending. The dependent variable here is the total amount of state bank lending in a particular quarter. 14 14 ^(14){ }^{14} As in the previous model, I first calculate the percentage change of lending from the previous quarter to ensure stationarity of the variable. I call the transformed variable D-Lending ( t ) ( t ) _((t)){ }_{(t)}. The independent variables are current inflation, as well as various lags of inflation up to the t − 6 t − 6 t-6\mathrm{t}-6 period. I use the transformed inflation variable, DCPI ( t ) DCPI ( t ) DCPI_((t))\operatorname{DCPI}_{(\mathrm{t})}, used in the previous model.
关于通货膨胀的含义，派系框架的另一个预测是：某一季度的高通货膨胀会降低随后的季度贷款，因为中央紧缩首先针对的是信贷。因此，这组模型检验的是过去的通货膨胀是否系统性地抑制当期信贷。这里的因变量是某一季度国有银行贷款的总额。 14 14 ^(14){ }^{14} 与前一个模型一样，我首先计算本季度与上季度贷款额的百分比变化以保证变量的平稳性。我将变换后的变量称为 D-Lending ( t ) ( t ) _((t)){ }_{(t)} 。自变量为当期通货膨胀，以及最多到第 t − 6 t − 6 t-6\mathrm{t}-6 期的若干滞后期通货膨胀。我使用前一模型中使用的变换后通货膨胀变量， DCPI ( t ) DCPI ( t ) DCPI_((t))\operatorname{DCPI}_{(\mathrm{t})} 。
Plotting the autocorrelation function of D-Lending ( t ) ( t ) _((t)){ }_{(\mathrm{t})} to discern the appropriate autoregressive moving average (ARMA) model specification, one finds an uncommon autocorrelation function for the state bank lending variable. 15 15 ^(15){ }^{15} Although the autocorrelation of the first three lags are not significantly different from zero, the fourth, the eighth, and the twelfth lags are significantly different from zero. As such, I employ an unconventional moving average structure that uses the error term of the lag variables from t − 4 , t − 8 t − 4 , t − 8 t-4,t-8\mathrm{t}-4, \mathrm{t}-8, and t − 12 t − 12 t-12\mathrm{t}-12 to estimate the equation. As with the inflation models, I specify five different models, each with current inflation and the different lags of inflation. Again, I use the BIC to select the best specification for the estimation.

The results of the lending models, presented in Table 5.5, report a negative relationship between past inflation and current lending. In all five models, inflation in the t − 2 t − 2 t-2\mathrm{t}-2 and the t − 3 t − 3 t-3\mathrm{t}-3 periods exhibits a negative correlation with contemporary lending. Moreover, the negative coefficients are significant in all five models, strongly suggesting that past inflation exerts a negative and systematic influence on current lending. minimized at the t − 6 t − 6 t-6\mathrm{t}-6 model, in which inflation from three quarters ago exerts a negative impact on current lending. According to the findings of the t − 6 t − 6 t-6\mathrm{t}-6 model, a ɪ percent increase in inflation from three quarters ago is expected to decrease current lending by 0.3 percent.
在 t − 6 t − 6 t-6\mathrm{t}-6 模型处达到最小化，其中三个季度前的通货膨胀对当前放贷产生负向影响。根据 t − 6 t − 6 t-6\mathrm{t}-6 模型的发现，三个季度前通货膨胀上升 ɪ 个百分点预计会使当前放贷减少 0.3 个百分点。
The findings of the t − 6 t − 6 t-6\mathrm{t}-6 model match up nicely with the findings of the t − 4 t − 4 t-4\mathrm{t}-4 inflation model presented previously. The results of these two models suggest that inflation from three quarters ago lowers current lending, which in turn decreases inflation in the subsequent quarter. This causal pattern follows classical monetary theory, with the contraction in money supply quelling subsequent inflation. The findings of these two models also suggest that there is a larger time gap between inflation and retrenchment than between retrenchment and
t − 6 t − 6 t-6\mathrm{t}-6 模型的发现与先前呈现的 t − 4 t − 4 t-4\mathrm{t}-4 通货膨胀模型的发现相吻合。两个模型的结果表明，三个季度前的通货膨胀降低了当前放贷，进而在随后季度减少了通货膨胀。这一因果模式符合古典货币理论，即货币供应收缩遏制了随后通货膨胀。这两个模型的发现还表明，通货膨胀与收缩之间的时间间隔比收缩与...
eventual disinflation. Although high inflation on average requires three quarters to induce a reduction in lending, austerity policies that limit lending take only one quarter to stifle inflationary pressure. This statistical pattern accords with qualitative findings presented in the subsequent chapters. Essentially, generalist factions often contested the imposition of austerity policies, thus delaying retrenchment even when it became obvious that inflation had risen to an alarming level. When the generalist factions eventually signed on to austerity measures, however, they took effect fairly swiftly. As Chapter 3 explained, the CCP never lacked the institutional capacity with which to suppress inflation. Rather, postponement in inflation control was a function of elite political tension between generalist factions and technocratic factions.
最终的通货紧缩。尽管平均而言，高通胀需要三个季度才能促使放贷减少，限制放贷的紧缩政策却只需一个季度就能遏制通胀压力。这一统计模式与后续章节呈现的定性发现相一致。本质上，全才派系常常对紧缩政策的实施提出异议，因此即便通胀显然已上升到令人担忧的水平，也会延迟收缩。然而，当全才派系最终签署并支持紧缩措施时，这些措施生效相当迅速。如第 3 章所述，中共从未缺乏压制通货膨胀的制度能力。推迟控制通胀的原因，反而是全才派系与技术官僚派系之间的精英政治张力。

The Output Models  输出模型

Finally, the factional model predicts that high output in one period generates increasing inflationary pressure in a subsequent period because high output increases the pressure on generalist factions to release money into the economy. This prediction, however, is contrary to the prediction of standard economic theory. According to the quantity theory of MV=PY, there is a negative relationship between real growth and inflation, where M is money stock, V is money velocity, P is price, and Y is output. 16 16 ^(16){ }^{16} On the margin, if we assume fixed money velocity, we have:
最后，派系模型预测，一个时期的高产出会在随后时期产生不断增加的通货膨胀压力，因为高产出会增加对通才派将货币释放到经济中的压力。然而，这一预测与标准经济理论的预测相悖。根据货币数量论 MV=PY，实际增长与通货膨胀之间存在负相关关系，其中 M 是货币存量，V 是货币流通速度，P 是价格，Y 是产出。 16 16 ^(16){ }^{16} 在边际上，如果我们假定货币流通速度固定，则有：
Δ M ( t ) = Δ P ( t ) + Δ Y ( t ) Δ M ( t ) = Δ P ( t ) + Δ Y ( t ) DeltaM_((t))=DeltaP_((t))+DeltaY_((t))\Delta M_{(t)}=\Delta P_{(t)}+\Delta Y_{(t)}
or  或
Δ P ( t ) = Δ M ( t ) − Δ Y ( t ) Δ P ( t ) = Δ M ( t ) − Δ Y ( t ) DeltaP_((t))=DeltaM_((t))-DeltaY_((t))\Delta P_{(t)}=\Delta M_{(t)}-\Delta Y_{(t)}
Thus, given a fixed money supply, an increase in output is expected to decrease inflationary pressure. In the case of China, however, rising output signifies escalating demand for liquidity, which increases the pressure on generalist factions to circumvent the central bank’s credit plan and to allocate loans to factional followers. Increasing output also denotes an economy in recovery and prompts generalist factions to intervene in banks. Although there is likely to be a long-term negative relationship between output and inflation (Chow 1987), in the short run accelerating output signals to local government officials the end of an austerity period, which decreases the credibility of the PBOC and increases inflationary pressure.
因此，在货币供应量不变的情况下，产出增加预期会降低通货膨胀压力。然而在中国，产出上升意味着对流动性的需求加剧，这加大了综合派别规避中央银行信贷计划、将贷款分配给派系追随者的压力。产出增加也表示经济正在复苏，并促使综合派别对银行进行干预。尽管长期来看产出与通货膨胀之间可能存在负相关关系（Chow 1987），但在短期内，产出加速向地方政府官员发出紧缩期结束的信号，这削弱了 PBOC 的可信度并增加了通货膨胀压力。
In order to test this, I once again use a time-series model with inflation, DCPI ( t ) DCPI ( t ) DCPI_((t))\operatorname{DCPI}_{(t)}, as the dependent variable and SOE industrial production and its lags as independent variables. I use SOE industrial production rather than GDP or export because it is the only complete quarterly series that approximates
为了检验这一点，我再次使用以通货膨胀率 DCPI ( t ) DCPI ( t ) DCPI_((t))\operatorname{DCPI}_{(t)} 为因变量、国有企业工业产出及其滞后项为自变量的时间序列模型。我使用国有企业工业产出而不是 GDP 或出口，因为它是唯一近似且完整的季度序列。
Figure 12: figure 5.2. Percentage Change in SOE Industrial Output from the Previous Quarter: 1978-2000. Source: Data from Quarterly Database. See Appendix for detail.
图 12：图 5.2。国有企业工业产出环比百分比变化：1978–2000。来源：季度数据库数据。详情见附录。
output. Ideally, I would use quarterly export figures because they are exogenous to lending and inflation. However, quarterly data for export do not go back to the early 1980s. Calculating the percentage change in quarterly industrial production, however, produces a series that exhibits a high degree of seasonality. Because the series reports SOE output, the data necessarily reflect the seasonal characteristics unique to state-owned enterprises, which continued to follow planned production for much of the reform (Naughton 1996: 114, 224). As one can see in Figure 5.2, this series resembles random noise and, when regressed on inflation, produces no significant correlation with the dependent variable.
输出。理想情况下，我会使用季度出口数据，因为它们对信贷和通货膨胀是外生的。然而，季度出口数据并未回溯到 20 世纪 80 年代初。计算季度工业生产的百分比变化会产生一条表现出高度季节性的序列。由于该序列报告的是 SOE 产出，数据必然反映国有企业独有的季节性特征，而国有企业在大部分改革期间仍按计划生产（Naughton 1996: 114, 224）。如图 5.2 所示，该序列类似随机噪声，并且在以通货膨胀为自变量进行回归时，与因变量未表现出显著相关性。
Because of the severe seasonality in this data, it is necessary to smooth out the seasonality in this series. Although there are many approaches to smooth out seasonality, I simply use the method most often used by the Chinese government, taking the percentage change from four quarters ago. This approach erases distinct features of a particular season and instead reveals changes in current industrial output from the same quarter one year ago. Because this practice is prevalent in the Chinese government, it also makes theoretical sense to use this approach of smoothing out seasonality. If Chinese government officials themselves compare output in the current quarter relative to the same quarter the previous year, a sharp rise in output relative to four quarters ago, rather than a similar increase from the previous quarter, would suggest to them a loosening monetary environment. In other words, this analysis takes seasonality into account in the same way that Chinese officials would.
由于该数据存在严重的季节性，必须对序列进行季节性平滑。尽管有许多方法可以消除季节性，我这里只采用中国政府最常用的方法：与四个季度前相比的百分比变化。该方法抹去了某一特定季节的独特特征，而是揭示当前工业产出相较于一年前同一季度的变化。由于这一做法在中国政府内部很普遍，采用这种季节性平滑方法在理论上也是合理的。如果中国政府官员本身将本季度产出与上年同一季度比较，那么相对于四个季度前的产出大幅上升（而非与上一季度相比的类似增长）会向他们暗示货币环境在放松。换言之，本分析以与中国官员相同的方式考虑季节性。
Figure 13: FIGURE 5.3. Percentage Change in SOE Industrial Output from Four Quarters Ago: 1978-2000.
图 13：图 5.3. 国有企业工业产出较四个季度前的百分比变化：1978–2000。
In Figure 5.3, the seasonally adjusted series exhibits much less volatility and a more noticeable cyclical pattern. The Dickey-Fuller test on this new series reveals its stationarity. Because the dependent variable is DCPI, an AR(2) autoregressive structure is used again. Similar to the previous models, the output models regress current inflation on the various lags of the seasonally adjusted SOE output. The findings are reported in Table 5.6.
在图 5.3 中，经季节调整的序列表现出明显较小的波动性和更显著的周期性。对该新序列进行的 Dickey-Fuller 检验表明其为平稳序列。因为被解释变量是 DCPI，所以再次采用 AR(2)自回归结构。与先前模型类似，产出模型将当前通货膨胀对经季节调整的国有企业产出各滞后项进行回归。结果列于表 5.6。
According to the findings presented in Table 5.6, there is clear evidence that output in one period exacerbates inflationary pressure in a subsequent period. Across all five models, an increase in seasonally adjusted SOE industrial output from two quarters ago systematically heightens inflation in the current quarter. According to the BIC, the model that provides the best fit is the t − 2 t − 2 t-2\mathbf{t}-\mathbf{2} model. In that model, a ɪ percent increase in seasonally adjusted SOE output from two quarters ago is expected to elevate inflation by o.I percent. Although the effect is not a steep one, a significant increase in SOE output can substantially heighten inflationary pressure. As seen in Figure 5.3 , a 20 percent increase in SOE output was a commonplace occurrence during the past two decades, and a rise in output of that magnitude on average increases inflation by 2 percent. This finding accords with the notion that a rapid increase in output provides the economic precondition for a decentralization campaign. Nonetheless, as will be seen in Chapters 6 to 8, many exogenous political factors also played an important role in the actual process of unlocking the bureaucrats’ grip on the economy. Thus, it is not surprising that the effect of economic growth on inflation is not a strong one.
根据表 5.6 的发现，有明确证据表明一个时期的产出会在随后的时期加剧通货膨胀压力。在所有五个模型中，来自两个季度前经季节调整的国有企业工业产出增加，都会系统性地提高本季度的通货膨胀率。根据 BIC，拟合效果最好的模型是 t − 2 t − 2 t-2\mathbf{t}-\mathbf{2} 模型。在该模型中，两个季度前经季节调整的国有企业产出增加ɪ个百分点，预计将使通货膨胀上升 0.1 个百分点。尽管该效应并不陡峭，但国有企业产出的显著增加可以大幅加剧通货膨胀压力。如图 5.3 所示，在过去二十年中，国有企业产出增加 20%是常见现象，而如此幅度的产出增长平均会使通货膨胀上升 2%。这一发现与这样一种观点相符：产出的快速增长为一次去中心化运动提供了经济先决条件。然而，正如第 6 至第 8 章将看到的，许多外生政治因素在真正解除官僚对经济控制的过程中也起了重要作用。 因此，经济增长对通货膨胀的影响并不显著也就不足为奇。

Summary  摘要

Figuring out how much politics in China affects economic outcomes is at best an exploratory exercise. The opacity of the political system does not lend itself to careful scrutiny by outside investigators. Nonetheless, it is precisely under these circumstances that statistical methodologies can provide the most important analytical leverage with which we can pry open the black box of elite political economy. This chapter began by making the assumption that coincidences in ascriptive ties between central and provincial leaders indicate the existence of factional ties between them. If this holds true on average, then factions indeed exert a systematic influence on the distribution of scarce bank capital to the provinces. Moreover, the findings reveal two different factional strategies that accord with the two types of factions in China: generalist factions and technocratic factions.
弄清中国政治在多大程度上影响经济结果充其量是一项探索性工作。政治体制的不透明性不利于外部研究者进行细致审查。然而，正是在这种情况下，统计方法学可以提供最重要的分析杠杆，让我们撬开精英政治经济学的黑匣子。本章一开始假定中央与省级领导之间在某些属性上的巧合表明他们之间存在派系联系。如果这一假设在平均意义上成立，那么派系确实对稀缺银行资本在各省之间的分配施加系统性影响。此外，研究结果揭示了两种不同的派系策略，与中国的两类派系相一致：通才派系和技术官僚派系。
To test the time-series effect of the factional model, this chapter posits that the perception of an economic crisis, measured as the change in inflation and the change in unexpected inflation, has a systematic impact on Party politicians’ willingness to delegate financial authority to the technocratic faction. Indeed, high inflation in one quarter exerts a systematic, negative effect first on lending, then on inflation in subsequent quarters, which reflects a delayed reaction by the central government to delegate financial authority to the central bureaucracy. Delegating financial authority to the technocratic faction guarantees the end of the inflationary crisis because the faction has a strong incentive to centralize financial authority. The third set of time-series models provides evidence that increasing growth undermines the credibility of the PBOC’s credit plan and creates pressure for higher inflation. This occurs as generalist faction leaders become confident that an economic crisis has passed and that the factional competition to allocate capital to the provinces can begin anew. Having tested the quantitative predictions of the factional model, the subsequent chapters examine whether one can find patterns predicted by the factional model in the complex, messy interplay between top leaders in China.
为了检验该派系模型的时间序列效应，本章假设对经济危机的感知（以通货膨胀的变化和意外通货膨胀的变化来衡量）对党内政治人物将金融权力下放给技术官僚派系的意愿具有系统性影响。事实上，一个季度的高通货膨胀首先对放贷产生系统性的负向影响，随后在后续季度对通货膨胀产生影响，这反映了中央政府在将金融权力下放给中央官僚机构时的滞后反应。将金融权力下放给技术官僚派系可以保证通货膨胀危机的终结，因为该派系有强烈动机集中金融权力。第三组时间序列模型提供的证据表明，增长的增加削弱了 PBOC 信贷计划的可信度并产生了更高通货膨胀的压力。随着综合派系领导人确信经济危机已经过去并且针对向各省分配资本的派系竞争可以重新开始，这种情况就会发生。 在检验了派系模型的定量预测之后，后续章节考察在中国高层领导人之间复杂、杂乱无章的相互作用中是否能发现派系模型所预测的模式。

The Collapse of Discipline
纪律的崩溃

The First Two Inflationary Cycles and the Fiscalization of Chinese Banks
最初两轮通货膨胀周期与中国银行的财务化

The theory put forth here argues that the struggle to control financial policies between generalist factions, which favor decentralization, and technocratic factions, which champion centralization, gives rise to inflationary and antiinflationary pressure, respectively. But because both types of factions exploit the banking sector to fund their respective political aims, there is a persistent failure to commercialize the banking system in China. This chapter fully demonstrates this dual logic by examining two “classic” cases of inflationary cycles: the 1978-1982 cycle and the 1983-1986 cycle, respectively.
本文提出的理论认为，主张分权的一般派系与主张集中化的技术官僚派系之间围绕金融政策的控制权斗争，分别产生通胀与反通胀压力。但由于两类派系都利用银行部门为其各自的政治目的提供资金，中国的银行体系长期未能实现商业化。本章通过审视两个“典型”通胀周期案例——1978–1982 年周期和 1983–1986 年周期，全面论证了这一双重逻辑。
The two cycles are essential for the main argument for several reasons. First, this period saw the first two inflationary cycles since the 1978 reform. These two inflationary cycles exhibited a “classic” pattern in which generalist factions galvanized local enthusiasm for investment through manipulating the agenda at important party meetings and through restructuring vital economic decision bodies such as the Finance and Economic Committee. Because of the latent competition between generalist factions, they competed to decentralize financial resources to provincial followers, which increased inflationary pressure. When inflation rose above a certain threshold, the central bureaucracy mobilized against the generalist factions in order to regain control over finances. Closely examining the policy coalitions that formed on investment and monetary policies in this period allows us to evaluate whether the assumptions of the theory roughly accords with political reality in China.
这两个周期之所以对主要论点至关重要，有几个原因。首先，该时期出现了自 1978 年改革以来的前两个通货膨胀周期。这两个通货膨胀周期呈现出一种“经典”模式：泛能派通过操控重要党内会议议程并通过重组诸如财经委员会等关键经济决策机构，激发地方对投资的热情。由于泛能派之间存在潜在竞争，他们相互争夺将财政资源下放给省级跟随者，从而加剧了通货膨胀压力。当通胀升至某一阈值以上时，中央官僚机构会动员起来对抗泛能派，以重新掌控财政。仔细审视该时期在投资和货币政策上形成的政策联盟，使我们能够评估该理论的假设是否大致与中国的政治现实相符。
Equally important, the historical evidence allows us to evaluate competing explanations for monetary outcomes in China. Through detailed historical examination, we see that although factors such as institutions and ideology played a part in the monetary policy process, they were not the crucial variables determining the major shifts in monetary policy. Rather, it was the factional imperatives derived from the membership composition of the factions that drove policy preferences and political maneuvering. For example, although Zhao Ziyang was the nominal head of the central bureaucracy, his long-standing relationship with several provinces caused him to bestow more
同样重要的是，历史证据使我们能够评估关于中国货币政策结果的竞争性解释。通过详尽的历史考察，我们发现尽管制度和意识形态等因素在货币政策过程中发挥了一定作用，但它们并非决定货币政策重大转变的关键变量。相反，推动政策偏好和政治操弄的是源于派系成员构成的派系必要性。例如，尽管赵紫阳名义上是中央官僚体系的首脑，他与若干省份的长期关系使他更倾向于给予更多
loans and investment authority to them. His formal position could not have accounted for his behavior. A close examination of the policy preferences of the central bureaucrats informs that they were not simply the opponents of reform. In fact, Chen Yun had allied with Deng Xiaoping on a number of reform issues. They strongly disagreed with each other over the financial issue because the level of financial centralization was vital to the political strategy of each faction. These two cases also show very clearly that it was indeed high inflation that increased the political power of the central technocratic faction, and thus the credibility of the central bank’s credit ceiling. In both of these cases, high inflation led to a retreat by Deng’s dominant generalist faction, which allowed the central bureaucracy to harshly punish local officials for violating the central credit ceiling.
把贷款和投资权力交给他们。他的正式职务无法解释他的行为。对中央官僚政策偏好的仔细考察表明，他们并非单纯的改革反对者。事实上，陈云在若干改革议题上曾与邓小平结盟。两人在金融问题上严重分歧，是因为金融集中程度对各派的政治策略至关重要。这两个案例也非常清楚地表明，确实是高通货膨胀提高了中央技术官僚派的政治权力，从而增强了中央银行信用上限的可信度。在这两种情况下，高通货膨胀都导致邓主导的一般派退却，使中央官僚得以严厉惩处违反中央信用上限的地方官员。
The period between 1978 and 1986 also saw a major shift in the central leadership’s perception of the banking system. Rather than seeing it as the accounting arm of the state budget, the central leadership from both types of factions began to see the banking system as a separate treasury that provided an alternative source of funding for policy and political needs. In contrast to the fierce debates over the level of monetary centralization, both generalist factions and the technocratic factions agreed that the growing deposits in banks should be mobilized to serve the state. In this manner, the disciplined view of the banking system that had prevailed quickly collapsed, leaving banks completely at the mercy of administrative interventions from either the local or the central state.
1978 年至 1986 年间，中央领导对银行体系的认识也发生了重大转变。中央领导中的两类派系不再把银行看作国家预算的核算工具，而开始把银行体系视为一个独立的金库，为政策和政治需要提供替代性的资金来源。与围绕货币集中程度的激烈争论形成对比的是，无论是通才派系还是技术官僚派系都同意，应当动员银行中日益增长的存款来为国家服务。这样，曾经占主导地位的对银行体系的纪律化认识迅速瓦解，银行完全沦为地方或中央国家行政干预的牺牲品。
Finally, particular attention is paid to this period because we have the most information about high politics and financial policies in this period. By chance, I stumbled across a two-volume set, which contains dozens of topsecret speeches by individual leaders on economic issues from that period (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 1982). Unlike publicly available speeches, these speeches reflect the divergence of opinions within the leadership. I also have access to all the internal banking decrees from the period, as well as a rich collection of memoirs and official chronicles of senior officials at that time. Finally, we have two extremely valuable volumes documenting the interaction between the Guangdong leadership and their patrons in the central government, which afford us a rare glimpse into the inner workings of a faction.
最后，特别关注这一时期是因为我们对于该时期的高层政治和金融政策掌握的信息最为充足。偶然间，我发现了一套两卷本资料，收录了该时期多位领导人在经济问题上的数十篇绝密讲话（Document Research Center of the CCP CC 1982）。与公开发表的讲话不同，这些讲话反映了领导层内部意见的分歧。我还获得了该时期所有内部银行法令，以及大量回忆录和当时高级官员的官方年谱。最后，我们有两卷极其珍贵的资料，记录了广东地方领导人与中央政府中其支持者之间的互动，使我们得以难得地窥见一个派系的内部运作。

The Main Actors and their Factions: The Deng-Chen Dichotomy
主要参与者及其派系：邓陈二分法

At the end of the Cultural Revolution and the Hua Guofeng interregnum, the Chinese leadership was united on most issues. The foremost two factions at that time, led by Deng Xiaoping and Chen Yun, respectively, were mainly composed of victims of the Cultural Revolution. I I  ^("I "){ }^{\text {I }} Chen Yun had been instrumental
在文化大革命结束和华国锋过渡时期， 中国领导层在大多数问题上保持一致。 当时最主要的两个派系分别由邓小平和陈云领导， 这些派系主要由文化大革命的受害者组成。 I I  ^("I "){ }^{\text {I }} 陈云在其中发挥了重要作用
in organizing the coup against the Gang of Four after Mao’s death in 1976 and had also played a large part in restoring Deng Xiaoping to power in 1977 (MacFarquar 1997: 313). 2 2 ^(2){ }^{2} Chen Yun also sided with Deng as Deng sought to ease Hua Guofeng, a beneficiary of the Cultural Revolution and the Party Chairman at the time, out of power (MacFarquhar 1997:319). In gratitude for Chen’s support, Deng helped Chen edge out his longtime rival, Yu Qiuli, from the economic policy arena and supported Chen Yun’s policy of fiscal balance and more light industrial development (Swaine 1986). 3 3 ^(3){ }^{3}
在组织 1976 年毛泽东去世后对四人帮的政变中发挥了作用，并在 1977 年恢复邓小平的权力中也起了重要作用（MacFarquar 1997: 313）。 2 2 ^(2){ }^{2} 陈云在邓试图将华国锋——一位文化大革命的受益者、当时的党主席——逐出权力中心的过程中也站在邓一边（MacFarquar 1997:319）。为感谢陈的支持，邓帮助陈将其长期对手于丘离开经济政策舞台，并支持陈云关于财政平衡和更加偏重轻工业发展的政策（Swaine 1986）。 3 3 ^(3){ }^{3}
Despite their alliance at the end of the Cultural Revolution, the two men came from very different revolutionary pedigrees. More important, their disparate career paths translated to different membership composition of their respective factions. This created divergent opinions on the issues of investment and monetary policies between the two factions.
尽管在文化大革命结束时两人结成了联盟，但他们出身于截然不同的革命血统。更重要的是，他们不同的职业生涯导致各自派系的成员构成不同。这就造成了两派在投资和货币政策问题上的分歧。

Deng and His Faction
邓及其派系

Deng Xiaoping began his life in the Communist Party as a young apprentice in a French factory. There, he met Zhou Enlai and Zhu De, two of the first Chinese communists, and was soon involved with the CCP (Deng 1995). On his return to China in 1926, he organized and led a series of uprisings in Southwestern China. In 1931, he led his army in southwestern China to join Mao’s forces in the Jiangxi Soviet (Liu and Shen 1992). From that point on, he served as Mao’s loyal lieutenant and took on a series of increasingly important command positions in the Red Army, the precursor of the People’s Liberation Army. By the Chinese Civil War (1946-1949), he co-commanded the Fourth Field Army, which liberated southwestern China. He then served as the regional governor of southwestern China before going to Beijing to take up positions in the central Party apparatus.
邓小平在共产党开始他的生涯，最初是作为一名在法国工厂的年轻学徒。在那里，他结识了周恩来和朱德——两位最早的中国共产主义者，并很快加入了中共（Deng 1995）。1926 年回到中国后，他在中国西南组织并领导了一系列起义。1931 年，他在中国西南率军与毛的部队在江西苏维埃会合（Liu and Shen 1992）。从那时起，他作为毛的忠实副手，担任了一系列在红军（一切后来的人民解放军的前身）中越来越重要的指挥职务。到中国内战（1946–1949）时期，他与人共同指挥第四野战军，解放了中国西南。随后他先在中国西南担任地方省长，随后赴北京在中央党组织任职。
whereas others suffered extreme torment in the hands of the Red Guards. Although Chen Yun was not formally purged in the late 1960s, he was nonetheless excluded from important decision making from 1969 to 1972. Both he and Deng Xiaoping were rehabilitated in 1972 after Lin Biao’s coup. By all accounts, neither suffered the worst treatment during the Cultural Revolution. See Document Research Center of the CCP CC. 2000. Chen Yun Nianpu (The Chen Yun Chronicle). Vol. 3. Beijing: Central Documentation Publisher.
而其他人则在红卫兵手中遭受极端折磨。尽管陈云在 1960 年代后期并未被正式清洗，但他在 1969 年至 1972 年间仍被排除在重要决策之外。林彪政变后，1972 年他与邓小平均获平反。根据所有记载，在文化大革命期间他们并未遭受最严重的待遇。见中共中办文献研究中心。2000。《陈云年谱》第 3 卷。北京：中央文献出版社。
2 2 ^(2){ }^{2} In March 1977, Chen Yun made a speech at the Central Work Conference arguing that Deng had nothing to do with the Tiananmen demonstrations in 1976 and thus should be reinstated. See Ibid.
2 2 ^(2){ }^{2} 1977 年 3 月，陈云在中央工作会议上发表讲话，认为邓小平与 1976 年天安门事件无关，因此应予平反。见同上。
3 3 ^(3){ }^{3} In addition to Chen Yun, Yu Qiuli was possibly the most respected authority on the economy in the late 1970s. He headed the petroleum faction in the State Council, which competed for dominance in the economic arena with Chen’s faction in the late 1970s. Formally, Yu served as head of the State Planning Commission (SPC). In 1979, however, Chen Yun, with the help of Deng and Li Xiannian, created the Finance and Economic Commission headed by Chen to circumvent Yu’s power. Soon after, Yao Yilin, a Chen loyalist, replaced Yu as the head of the SPC. For details of the Chen-Yu struggle, see Lieberthal, Kenneth, and Michel Oksenberg. 1988. Policy Making in China: Leaders, Structures, and Processes. Princeton, NJ: Princeton University Press, 252-255 Fewsmith, Joseph. 1994. Dilemmas of Reform in China: Political Conflict and Economic Debate. Armonk, NY: M. E. Sharpe, 58-59.
除了陈云之外，于秋礼在 1970 年代末可能是最受尊敬的经济权威。他在国务院主导石油派系，该派系在 1970 年代末与陈的派系在经济领域争夺主导地位。名义上，于担任国家计划委员会（SPC）主任。然而在 1979 年，陈云在邓小平和李先念的帮助下，设立了由陈云主持的财经委员会以规避于的权力。不久之后，陈的忠诚支持者姚依林接替于出任国家计划委员会主任。关于陈—于斗争的详细情况，见 Lieberthal, Kenneth, and Michel Oksenberg. 1988. Policy Making in China: Leaders, Structures, and Processes. Princeton, NJ: Princeton University Press, 252-255；Fewsmith, Joseph. 1994. Dilemmas of Reform in China: Political Conflict and Economic Debate. Armonk, NY: M. E. Sharpe, 58-59.
His preliberation career in the army provided Deng with an extensive network of friendly colleagues and loyal followers both in the military and in the Party apparatus, whose leaders primarily came from the army. According to Huang (2000: 384), Deng’s faction at the beginning of reform included Hu Yaobang, Zhao Ziyang, Wan Li, Xi Zhongxun, Fan Yi, Hu Qiaomu, Chen Peixan, Hu Qili, Yang Shangkun, Wang Zhen, Wei Guoqing, Yang Dezhi, Geng Biao, Fang Yi, Huang Hua, Zhang Jinfu, and Qiao Shi. The key members of his factions had spent most of their careers in the central or provincial Party apparatus or in the military. Even officials such as Zhang Jinfu and Zhao Ziyang, who ended up in the State Council at the height of their careers, had spent the bulk of their careers in local administration and Party affairs. This meant that the followers of Deng’s immediate clients were mostly Party and military cadres at the provinces.
在解放前的军旅生涯为邓小平提供了一个广泛的友好同僚和忠实追随者网络，这些人既分布在军队也分布在党政机构中，而这些机构的领导者主要出身于军队。根据黄（2000: 384），改革初期邓的派系包括胡耀邦、赵紫阳、万里、习仲勋、范毅、胡乔木、陈培贤、胡启立、杨尚昆、王震、魏国清、杨得志、耿飚、方毅、黄华、张劲夫和乔石。他派系的核心成员的大部分职业生涯都在中央或省级党政机构或军队中度过。即便是像张劲夫和赵紫阳这样最终在其职业生涯巅峰进入国务院的官员，也在地方行政和党务中度过了大部分职业生涯。这意味着邓直接客户的追随者大多是省级的党政和军队干部。
Two stars in Deng Xiaoping’s faction deserve special mention, as they both played an important role in the subsequent narrative on the inflationary cycles. First, Hu Yaobang, Deng’s subordinate during the Civil War and a longtime leader of the Communist Youth League (CYL), owed his entire career to Deng Xiaoping (Liu and Shen 1992: 267). In 1980, with the backing of the Deng faction, Hu was elevated to the Standing Committee of the Politburo and became the General Secretary of the CCP, the highest position in the Party. Because CYL leaders tended to go into careers in local administration and Party affairs, Hu’s key followers, including Hu Qili and Zhu Houze, were at that time serving in the provinces (Zong 2002: 38-39). This made him an enthusiastic supporter of a decentralized financial system. He also had a coterie of followers in the central propaganda system, including Zhou Yang, Wang Ruoshui, and Qin Chuan (Deng 2005: 266-267).
在邓小平派系中有两位重要人物值得特别提及，因为他们都在随后关于通货膨胀周期的叙述中扮演了重要角色。首先，胡耀邦，内战时期邓的下属和长期的共青团（CYL）领导人，他的整个仕途都归功于邓小平（Liu and Shen 1992: 267）。1980 年，在邓小平派系的支持下，胡被提升为政治局常务委员并出任中共中央总书记，成为党内的最高领导职务。由于共青团领导人倾向于从事地方行政和党务工作，胡的主要追随者，包括胡启立和朱厚泽，当时都在各省任职（Zong 2002: 38-39）。这使他成为分权化金融体系的热心支持者。他在中央宣传系统中也有一批追随者，包括周扬、王若水和秦川（Deng 2005: 266-267）。
Into the mid-1980s, the relations between Hu and Deng became increasingly strained, as Hu pursued his own agendas to the neglect or even in direct contradiction with Deng’s decrees (Baum 1994: 164). Hu’s action follows the classic pattern of a designated successor, who tries to establish his own agenda and shore up his factional network before the passing of the current helmsman. Although perfectly rational, this strategy invites suspicion and distrust between the successor and the incumbent (Huang 2000: 18). Hu’s preemptive action created a complex situation in which Deng’s dominant generalist faction had to deal with an emerging generalist faction while contending with the technocrats on economic issues. The technocratic faction led by Chen Yun naturally exploited the situation fully, especially when inflation was high.
到 20 世纪 80 年代中期，胡与邓的关系日益紧张，因胡推进自己的议程，忽视甚至直接与邓的法令相抵触（Baum 1994: 164）。胡的动作遵循指定继承人的经典模式：他在现任掌舵人去世前，试图确立自己的议程并巩固其派系网络。尽管这种做法完全合乎理性，但它也会在继任者与现任者之间引发怀疑和不信任（Huang 2000: 18）。胡的先发制人之举造成了一种复杂局面：邓所主导的通才派不得不在经济问题上应对一个新兴的通才派，同时还要与技术官僚派争斗。以陈云为首的技术官僚派自然充分利用了这一局面，尤其是在通货膨胀高企时。
In many ways, Zhao Ziyang’s path to the top tied him even more intimately to provincial leaders than Hu’s career did. Zhao had joined the revolution later than Hu had and had served only as district Party secretary during World War II (Liu and Shen 1992). After the liberation, he became the right-hand man of Tao Zhu, a Party elder who governed the entire southern China. Formally, Zhao held a series of leadership positions in the Guangdong Party apparatus for much of the time before Mao’s death. After the Third Plenum, Zhao was
在许多方面，赵紫阳通往最高层的路径使他比胡耀邦与省级领导人的联系更为紧密。赵比胡入党较晚，在二战期间只担任过区级党书记（Liu and Shen 1992）。解放后，他成为党内元老陶铸的左右手，陶铸当时主政整个中国南方。形式上，赵在毛去世前的大部分时间里担任广东党务系统的一系列领导职务。三中全会后，赵被
rapidly promoted from the post of provincial Party secretary of Sichuan to the vice premier slot and eventually to the office of the premier in 1980. As the subsequent discussion reveals, despite the fact that he served as the head of the State Council, he still looked after his followers in Guangdong through a myriad of preferential policies, including devolving control over the banks and extra national priority projects.
