During these first two inflationary cycles, Zhao faithfully served Deng’s wishes in both the economic and political arenas. After the fall of Hu Yaobang in 1987, however, Zhao became the designated successor and likewise pursued his own political agenda, which ultimately led to his downfall in 1989.
迅速从四川省委书记一职晋升为国务院副总理，最终于 1980 年出任总理。正如接下来的讨论所揭示的，尽管他担任国务院首脑，他仍通过各种优惠政策照顾他在广东的追随者，包括下放对银行的控制权和额外的国家优先项目。在最初的两轮通货膨胀周期中，赵在经济和政治领域忠实地执行了邓的意愿。然而，1987 年胡耀邦下台后，赵成为指定接班人，并同样推行自己的政治议程，这最终导致他在 1989 年垮台。

Chen's Faction  陈的派系

Chen Yun was another giant in the Communist Party, but he followed a very different career trajectory than Deng’s. Like Deng, Chen Yun began his career in the Party as an apprentice, but it was in the Commercial Press in Shanghai rather than in France. Because of his familiarity with Shanghai workers, he specialized in union organization and underground work in “white” areas occupied by the Kuomintang (KMT) for much of the 1920s and 1930s. In 1937, Chen Yun joined the main communist forces in Yan’an and became the head of the Central Organization Department in charge of cadre promotion and evaluation. In Yan’an, Chen also began to develop his specialty in economic affairs. By the end of the Chinese civil war, Chen Yun had taken up position as the head of the Northeast Finance and Economic Committee for the newly liberated Manchuria. He remained the regime’s foremost expert in economic affairs until his death almost fifty years later.
陈云是中国共产党内的另一位巨擘，但他的职业轨迹与邓小平截然不同。与邓一样，陈云也是以学徒身份开始党内生涯，但他是在上海的商务印书馆，而不是在法国。由于熟悉上海工人阶层，他在 20 世纪 20 至 30 年代大部分时间专注于工会组织和在国民党控制的“白区”进行地下工作。1937 年，陈云加入延安的共产党主力，并成为负责干部提拔与考核的中央组织部部长。在延安，陈云也开始发展他在经济事务方面的专长。到中国内战结束时，陈云已出任新解放的东北地区的东北财政经济委员会主任。他在经济事务方面一直是政权的首席专家，直到近五十年后去世。
When the communists took power in 1949, China was plagued by hyperinflation because the outgoing regime had engaged in reckless currency expansion to pay for the civil war and to fill the pockets of corrupt officials. Chen Yun brought in his “change team” of communist economic officials and transformed the Chinese economy. Whereas army generals such as Deng often reminisced about battles they had fought, Chen, even in the early 1980s, looked back to the early i950s as the height of his life’s achievements. In a speech to Planning Commission cadres in 1982, Chen reminisced “the best period was from 1949 to 1956; we had a lot of problems, but we experimented and solved them all, like stabilizing prices, unifying the economy, and unifying procurement and retailing. That created socialism” (Chen 1982a: 1495). Chen Yun also was one of the very few who had dared to challenge Mao’s decentralizing economic policies in 1957, although when Mao launched the Great Leap Forward in 1958, he knew enough to keep quiet (Teiwes and Sun 1997).
1949 年共产党夺取政权时，中国饱受恶性通货膨胀之苦，因为前政权为支付内战开支并敛取腐败官员的私利而进行鲁莽的货币扩张。陈云带来了他的“换班”经济官员团队，改造了中国经济。与常常怀念自己参战经历的军队将领如邓不同，陈云即便在 1980 年代初，仍把 20 世纪 50 年代初视为他一生业绩的巅峰。在 1982 年对计划委员会干部的讲话中，陈云回忆道“最好的时期是从 1949 年到 1956 年；我们有许多问题，但我们进行了试验并都解决了，比如稳定物价、统一经济、统一购销。这创造了社会主义”（Chen 1982a: 1495）。陈云也是极少数在 1957 年敢于挑战毛的分权经济政策的人之一，尽管当毛在 1958 年发动大跃进时，他明智地选择了沉默（Teiwes and Sun 1997）。
The innumerable problems that Chen and his colleagues solved in the early 1950s became the standard by which all subsequent Chinese technocrats were judged. Just as all Party members were expected to overcome impossible odds as the Long Marchers did, Chinese technocrats made their marks by rescuing the regime from impending crises or by solving difficult problems facing the country. This created the incentive among bureaucrats to constantly search for
陈及其同僚在 20 世纪 50 年代初解决的无数问题，成为衡量此后所有中国技术官僚的标准。正如所有党员都被期望像长征者一样克服不可能的困难，中国技术官僚通过将政权从迫近的危机中拯救出来或解决国家面临的难题来证明自己的能力。这在官僚中形成了不断寻找
the next crisis. It also induced them to hoard power over economic resources in preparation for the next crisis. In the context of factional politics, Chen worked to concentrate economic power to the central government, specifically to agencies controlled by his most loyal followers.
下一个危机的动机。它也促使他们为下一个危机囤积对经济资源的控制权。在派系政治的背景下，陈努力将经济权力集中到中央政府，特别是集中到由他最忠诚追随者控制的机构手中。
As Chen spent the bulk of his career in organization and economic work, members of his faction also rose predominantly through the central bureaucracy. Key members of Chen’s coterie in the early 1980s included Yao Yilin, Song Ping, Chen Muhua, Bo Yibo, Li Xiannian, Jin Ming, Jiang Zemin, Li Peng, and Xu Xiangqian (Chen 1982e; Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000; Huang 2000: 364). 4 4 ^(4){ }^{4} The core members of Chen’s faction had all spent the bulk of their careers in the State Council bureaucracy managing various aspects of the economy. Yao Yilin was in charge of domestic commerce for much of the Mao era. Song Ping spent much of his post-1949 career in the State Planning Commission. Chen Muhua took charge of external trade during the Mao era and became the head of the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) in the 1980s. Other elders who belonged to Chen’s faction, including Bo Yibo and Li Xiannian, had all spent the bulk of their postliberation careers in the State Council. Younger members of Chen’s faction, such as Jiang Zemin and Li Peng, worked their way up the heavy industrial bureaucracy throughout the Mao era. Although Jiang later became the leader of the Party, he was still very much a technocrat in the early 1980s. Li Peng, whom Chen Yun forcefully promoted in the early 1980s, went on to become the head of a powerful technocratic faction. 5 5 ^(5){ }^{5}
由于陈云的大部分职业生涯都从事组织和经济工作，其派系成员也主要在中央官僚体系中晋升。1980 年代初陈云小圈子中的主要成员包括姚依林、宋平、陈慕华、薄一波、李先念、金明、江泽民、李鹏和徐向前（陈 1982e；中共中央文献研究室 2000；黄 2000：364）。陈云派的核心成员大多在国务院官僚体系中度过了职业生涯的大部分时间，负责管理经济的各个方面。姚依林在很大程度上负责国内商业事务，任期横跨大部分毛泽东时期。宋平在 1949 年后的大部分时间里在国家计划委员会工作。陈慕华在毛泽东时期负责对外贸易，1980 年代曾出任中国人民银行行长。属于陈云派的其他资深人物，包括薄一波和李先念，解放后的大部分职业生涯也都在国务院度过。陈云派的年轻一代成员，如江泽民和李鹏，则在毛泽东时期通过重工业官僚体系逐步晋升。 尽管江后来成为党的领导人，但在 20 世纪 80 年代初他仍然很有技术官僚色彩。陈云在 80 年代初大力提拔的李鹏，后来成为一个强大技术官僚派系的首脑。 5 5 ^(5){ }^{5}

From Unity to Contradiction: The Deng-Chen Split and the First Inflationary Cycle
从团结到矛盾：邓陈分裂与第一次通货膨胀周期

After the Third Plenum of the Eleventh CC in late 1978, Deng became the leader of the dominant generalist faction in the CCP, triumphing over Mao’s designated successor, Hua Guofeng. Chen Yun, meanwhile, became the lead technocrat as
在 1978 年底中共第十一届三中全会之后，邓小平成为中共占主导地位的泛化派系的领导人，战胜了毛指定的接班人华国锋。与此同时，陈云成为主要的技术官僚领导，正当...
head of the Finance and Economic Committee and sidelined his main rival, Yu Qiuli. In the aftermath of the disastrous Cultural Revolution, both Deng and Chen firmly agreed that restoring order and setting a firm foundation for the future were of vital importance. Thus, they worked closely with each other to address several vital issues: the rehabilitation of Cultural Revolution victims, the promotion of younger cadres, and increasing the autonomy of farmers and state-owned enterprises (Fewsmith 1994: 60).
任财政经济委员会主任，并将他的主要对手余秋里排挤到一旁。在灾难性的文化大革命之后，邓小平和陈云一致认为恢复秩序并为未来奠定坚实基础至关重要。因此，他们密切合作，处理若干重要问题：对文化大革命受害者的康复、提拔年轻干部，以及增加农民和国有企业的自主权（Fewsmith 1994: 60）。
Between 1979 and 1980, however, Chen Yun gradually realized that his drive to restore central control over fixed asset investment and to restore a balanced budget was hampered not just by Hua Guofeng’s residual force, but also by Deng’s faction. While Deng, Zhao, and Hu encouraged local officials to increase investment using budgetary funds and, increasingly, bank loans, Chen fought back with ineffective directives from the State Council urging restraint. Toward the end of 1980, the new leadership encountered its first perceived crisis as inflation rose to 8 percent, a level not seen since the disastrous Great Leap Forward. This allowed Chen to recentralize control over investment, slow the pace of price reform, and build up institutions that ensured some degree of central control over the banking sector.
然而在 1979 年至 1980 年间，陈云逐渐意识到，他恢复对固定资产投资的中央控制并恢复收支平衡的努力，不仅受到了华国锋残余势力的阻碍，也受到邓小平派系的阻碍。邓小平、赵紫阳和胡启立鼓励地方官员动用预算资金并日益依赖银行贷款扩大投资，而陈云则以国务院关于克制的无力指示进行反制。到 1980 年末，随着通货膨胀上升到 8％——这是自灾难性的“大跃进”以来未见的水平——新领导层遇到了其首次认为的危机。这使得陈云得以重新集中对投资的控制，放慢价格改革步伐，并建立起能在一定程度上确保中央对银行业控制的制度。

The Beginning of the Split
分裂的开始

At the Third Plenum in 1978, Hua Guofeng, Chairman Mao’s designated successor and the proponent of the neo-Maoist theory of “Two-Whateverism,” suffered a crippling defeat at the hand of the Deng Xiaoping-Chen Yun alliance (Baum 1994: 48). Yet Deng’s position was not as secure as we imagine today. Until his eviction from the Politburo, Hua and his disgruntled allies in the army threatened to strike back at Deng at the first sign of trouble (Baum 1994: 122). After the Third Plenum, Deng and Chen continued to maneuver against Hua’s leadership by attacking his economic program, which was designed by his chief economic advisor Yu Qiuli and centered on high-speed growth and rapid modernization through large-scale import of foreign equipment. 6 6 ^(6){ }^{6} In its place, the Deng-Chen alliance proposed a program of “adjustment, reform, rectification, and improvement” (tiaozheng, gaige, zhengdun, tigao). As later events reveal, this program was a compromise between the ideal policies of Deng Xiaoping and of Chen Yun. Deng favored reform and improvement of the economy, while Chen Yun championed adjustment and rectification, which stood for centralized control of the economy. With an internally contradictory platform, the coalition on the economy was doomed from its inception.
1978 年第三次全会上，毛主席指定的接班人、提出“两个凡是”新毛主义理论的华国锋在邓小平—陈云联盟手中遭遇了沉重失败（Baum 1994: 48）。然而邓的地位并不像我们今天想象的那样稳固。在被逐出政治局之前，华与他在军中不满的盟友曾威胁一旦出现风吹草动就向邓发起反击（Baum 1994: 122）。第三次全会后，邓与陈继续通过抨击华的经济方案来对抗他的领导。该方案由他的首席经济顾问余秋里设计，核心是通过大规模进口外国设备实现高速增长和快速现代化。 6 6 ^(6){ }^{6} 取而代之，邓—陈联盟提出了“调整、改革、整顿、提高”（tiaozheng, gaige, zhengdun, tigao）的一套方案。正如后来的事件所表明的，这一方案是在邓小平与陈云理想政策之间达成的妥协。邓偏向于对经济进行改革和提高，而陈云则主张调整和整顿，代表对经济的集中控制。 具有内部矛盾的平台，关于经济的联盟从一开始就注定要失败。
In the spring of 1979, both Deng and Chen adhered to the previously sealed pact. In March 1979, Chen Yun argued in favor of a larger role for the market in allocating goods (Chen 1982b). His remarks implicitly supported the Wuxi Conference in April, which explored different ways of allowing market
1979 年春，邓小平和陈云都遵守了之前封存的协议。1979 年 3 月，陈云主张在商品配置中扩大市场的作用（Chen 1982b）。他的言论在暗中支持了 4 月的无锡会议，该会议探讨了允许市场不同运作方式的可能性
forces to play a larger role in the economy (Fewsmith 1994: 63). Furthermore, Chen lent his support to the household responsibility system, which allowed the legalization of the system at the September 1979 Fourth Plenum (CCP Central Committee 1982). 7 7 ^(7){ }^{7} Finally, Chen also endorsed another one of Deng’s favorite projects, setting up special economic zones (SEZs) in Fujian and Guangdong (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000). Deng in turn reciprocated by supporting Chen’s retrenchment plans in public, although he expressed dissatisfaction with the slow pace of growth in private. In a January 1979 private discussion with Rong Yiren, the most influential “noncommunist” in the regime and a former industrialist in Shanghai, Deng put a heavy emphasis on growth: “In the past we wasted too much time. It won’t do if we do not (grow) faster” (Deng 2000a). 8 8 ^(8){ }^{8} Despite Deng’s feeling, Chen Yun’s role in Deng’s re-emergence and perhaps his support for the war in Vietnam could not be easily forgotten, so for the moment, Deng remained silent about Chen’s program to stifle local growth initiatives.
促使国有企业在经济中发挥更大作用（Fewsmith 1994: 63）。此外，陈云支持家庭联产承包责任制，该制度在 1979 年 9 月第四次全体会议上得到合法化（中共中央 1982）。 7 7 ^(7){ }^{7} 最后，陈云还支持了邓的小平另一项偏好项目，即在福建和广东设立经济特区（Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000）。邓则回报性地在公开场合支持陈云的收缩政策，尽管他对私人部门增长的缓慢表示不满。1979 年 1 月，邓在与荣毅仁——政权中最有影响力的“非共产党人”、前上海实业家——的私人谈话中，着重强调增长：“过去我们浪费了太多时间。如果我们不（增长）更快，那是不行的”（Deng 2000a）。 8 8 ^(8){ }^{8} 尽管邓有此感受，但陈云在邓复出中的作用以及他可能对越南战争的支持不易被忘记，因此在当时，邓对陈云遏制地方增长计划保持沉默。
The fissure began to emerge in late spring soon after the formation of the Finance and Economic Committee (FEC), a superministry that coordinated the entire economy headed by Chen Yun and his loyal protégé Yao Yilin. 9 9 ^(9){ }^{9} In April 1979, the FEC convened a central work conference, attended by both central and local officials. In addition to further criticizing Yu’s policies and calling for more balanced growth, the meeting also castigated local officials for expanding investment recklessly. In classic planners’ fashion, over seven hundred investment projects were axed, while over ɪɪ০,૦૦૦ local investment projects were scaled down significantly. The proposed investment quota for 1979 fell to below 50 billion yuan from the 52 billion yuan set at the beginning of the year (Li 1982d). Li Xiannian, speaking on behalf of Chen Yun, also recommended sending work teams composed of central officials to the provinces to supervise the austerity program (Li 1982d). In July, Chen’s control over the
分歧开始在晚春显现，不久便在由陈云及其忠实门徒姚依林领导、负责统筹整个经济的超级部门——财经委员会（FEC）成立后浮现。 9 9 ^(9){ }^{9} 1979 年 4 月，FEC 召开了一次中央工作会议，中央和地方官员均出席。除了进一步批评于的政策并呼吁更加均衡的增长外，会议还严厉指责地方官员盲目扩大投资。按照经典的计划者作风，七百多项投资项目被取消，而超过ɪɪ০,০০০项地方投资项目被大幅缩减。1979 年拟定的投资定额从年初设定的 520 亿元降至低于 500 亿元（Li 1982d）。李先念代表陈云发言时也建议派由中央官员组成的工作组下省督导紧缩计划（Li 1982d）。今年 7 月，陈的控制权正当...
economy was temporarily strengthened with the appointment of Yao Yilin as the vice premier in charge of the economy.
随着姚依林被任命为主管经济的副总理，经济暂时得到加强。
This steep reduction of investment stifled Hua’s growth program and damaged Yu’s support base in the heavy industrial sector, but it also took billions away from Deng’s provincial supporters and potential allies at a time when their support was still needed in the final fight against Hua. The crucial province in question at this point was Guangdong Province. It was the powerbase of three of Deng’s core followers: Zhao Ziyang, Yang Shangkun, and Xi Zhongxun. Zhao, a longtime leader in the province, had recently been promoted to the central government as Premier, whereas Yang, the patron of a powerful military faction, provided Deng with crucial support within the military. In addition, Deng was hoping that generosity toward Guangdong would shore up his ties with Marshal Ye Jianying, one of the few senior officials who had remained unscathed throughout the Cultural Revolution and the patron of a powerful army faction. Marshal Ye played a crucial role in the downfall of the Gang of Four and had given Deng reluctant endorsement in his struggle against Hua Guofeng at the Third Plenum (Huang 2000: 253). Deng likely hoped that generous investment money for Guangdong - Ye’s native province - would finally garner Ye’s support for his final drive against Hua.
这种对投资的急剧削减扼杀了华的增长计划并削弱了俞在重工业部门的支持基础，但同时也在邓仍然需要他们在最后对抗华的关键时刻，从邓的省级支持者和潜在盟友那里夺走了数十亿资金。此时关键的省份是广东省。它是邓三位核心追随者的权力基地：赵紫阳、杨尚昆和习仲勋。赵长期在该省任职，最近被提升到中央政府出任总理，而杨作为一个强大军方派系的恩主，为邓在军队内部提供了关键支持。此外，邓希望对广东的慷慨支持能巩固他与叶剑英元帅的关系，叶是文革期间少数未受重创的高级官员之一，也是一个强大军队派系的恩主。叶元帅在四人帮倒台中发挥了关键作用，并在第三次全会中对邓与华国锋的斗争给予了勉强的支持（Huang 2000: 253）。邓小平很可能希望大量流向广东——叶的家乡省份——的投资资金最终能换来叶对他最后一次针对华的冲击的支持。
Because Chen’s investment reduction directly threatened his political strategy at the time, Deng soon acted to undermine Chen’s program. The fall of 1979 saw an increasing chorus of complaints from the local Party secretaries against Chen Yun’s austerity program. Chen and his followers in the State Council were clearly aware of grassroots frustration and tried to justify the central bureaucracy’s position. In early September 1979, Chen had Vice Premier Yao Yilin reprint several State Council documents about previous retrenchments and their harmful effects on the economy and distributed them to the other Politburo members and to local Party officials (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000). I0 I0  ^("I0 "){ }^{\text {I0 }} In a FEC meeting later that month attended by local officials, Chen drove home the lessons of these documents: “Currently, people demand a relatively fast pace of economic development, but they do not want the gallop cut short . . . We should explore a more appropriate pace of development” (Chen 1982d). In essence, Chen Yun warned Deng’s faction that impatience might lead to a crisis and further reduction in investment.
由于陈云的减投直接威胁到他当时的政治策略，邓小平很快采取行动削弱陈云的政策。1979 年下半年，地方党组织书记对陈云的紧缩政策的抱怨声日益增多。陈及其在国务院的支持者显然意识到基层的不满，并试图为中央官僚体制的立场辩护。1979 年 9 月初，陈让副总理姚依林重印了几份关于以往缩减支出及其对经济有害影响的国务院文件，并分发给其他政治局成员和地方党政官员（中共中央文献研究室 2000）。 I0 I0  ^("I0 "){ }^{\text {I0 }} 当月晚些时候在一次由地方官员出席的 FEC 会议上，陈再次强调这些文件的教训：“当前人民要求较快的经济发展步伐，但又不希望快马加鞭未及……我们应探索一个更合适的发展步伐”（陈 1982d）。本质上，陈云是在警告邓小平的派系：急躁可能导致危机并进一步减少投资。
Tension came to a head at an October 1979 Party meeting attended by Deng’s main constituent, the Party secretaries from the provinces and major cities. At that meeting, Deng, as the head of the dominant generalist faction, unambiguously supported the local desire for high growth and investment autonomy. Deng first revealed that his disagreement with Chen Yun stemmed from the numerous specific complaints he had received from the provinces about Chen’s harsh method of investment reduction. Deng echoed these complaints to Chen: "Now, there are numerous reports on the budget and the banks. There are now
紧张局势在 1979 年 10 月的一次由省级和直辖市党秘书等邓小平主要支持者出席的党内会议上达到顶点。在那次会议上，作为占主导地位的通才派领袖，邓小平明确支持地方对高增长和投资自主权的诉求。邓首先透露他与陈云的分歧源于他从各省收到的大量关于陈云严格削减投资方法的具体抱怨。邓将这些抱怨转述给陈云：“现在，有很多关于预算和银行的报告。现在有”
many good projects that only require several hundred thousand yuan to make them work. But the budgetary and the banking system would not approve (the funds), so they languish. I am afraid this happens frequently, not rarely" (Deng 2000b). In making these remarks, Deng directly accused Chen’s coterie of state planners of hoarding resources in the budget and in the banking system, stifling local economic initiatives. Deng went one step further and countermanded the State Council’s earlier goal of cutting overall investment “… projects in the tens of millions range can work very quickly, so the budget and the banks should support them”(Deng 2000b). In one brief statement, local officials received the green light from the highest authority to ignore the State Council’s earlier order to trim investment. Furthermore, Deng overturned the overall policy of “an appropriate pace of development” by stating that “… if we cannot have higher growth in 1982 and 1983, we are not doing a good job” (Deng 2000b). Finally, Deng urged Chen Yun to give further financial leeway to the local governments to make their own development plans (Deng 2000a).
许多只需要几十万元就能运作的好项目，却因为预算和银行系统不批准（资金），而被搁置。我担心这种情况常发生，而不是少见”（邓小平 2000b）。在发表这些言论时，邓直接指责陈一伙的国家计划者在预算和银行体系中囤积资源，扼杀了地方的经济主动性。邓更进一步，撤销了国务院此前削减总体投资的目标，“……数千万规模的项目能很快见效，所以预算和银行应该支持它们”（邓小平 2000b）。一句简短的话，当地官员便从最高权威那里得到信号，可以无视国务院先前削减投资的命令。此外，邓通过声明“……如果我们在 1982 年和 1983 年不能有更高的增长，那我们就没做好工作”（邓小平 2000b），推翻了“适度的发展速度”的总体政策。最后，邓敦促陈云给予地方政府更大的财政自主权，以便制定自己的发展规划（邓小平 2000a）。
Sensing that he was at a disadvantage, Chen beat a retreat by admitting that disagreements existed between him and Deng and that the problem should be debated further. This admission came in flowery Party language, but its meaning was clear to everyone who attended: “Great disagreements on economic work not only exist among comrades engaged in finance and economic work, but also within the Party center, and between the center and the localities”(Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000:252). In one sentence, Chen accurately identified the different coalitions on investment and lending policy in the fall of 1979. The main cleavage on financial policy was now between Deng’s faction of provincial officials and Chen’s faction of bureaucrats. This first showdown between Deng and Chen revealed that they supported different investment policies because of their distinct factional bases. Furthermore, this first clash indicated that Deng had the upper hand because as the head of the dominant generalist faction, he controlled agenda setting during important Party meetings.
察觉自己处于劣势后，陈采取了退让，承认他与邓之间存在分歧，问题应当进一步讨论。这一承认以花言巧语的党内表述出现，但对所有与会者其含义是清楚的：“在经济工作方面存在的重大分歧，不仅存在于从事财政和经济工作的同志之间，也存在于党中心内部以及中心与地方之间”（中共中央文献研究室 2000：252）。一句话，陈在 1979 年秋准确地指出了在投资和放贷政策上的不同联盟。金融政策上的主要分歧现在是邓所代表的省级官员派系与陈所代表的官僚派系之间的对立。这场邓与陈之间的第一次对决显示出他们支持不同的投资政策是由于各自不同的派系基础。此外，这次首次冲突也表明邓占据上风，因为作为占主导地位的通才派系的首脑，他在重要党内会议上掌控议程设置。
Chen Yun did not give up the fight entirely. The day following his hasty retreat, he threatened local officials with the specter of an economic crisis by once again recounting the horrors of inflation and budgetary imbalance in the early 50 s and after the Great Leap. He might have fought Deng’s agenda more, but he collapsed the next day and was rushed to the hospital, where he underwent surgery for colon cancer (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000). For the next few months, China’s top technocrat did not have the luxury of worrying about the economy or the well-being of his faction.
陈云并未完全放弃斗争。在他匆忙撤退后的第二天，他再次向地方官员讲述上世纪 50 年代初和大跃进后的通货膨胀与预算失衡的恐怖景象，借此以经济危机的幽灵威胁他们。他本可以更多地反对邓的议程，但第二天便倒下并被紧急送医，接受了结肠癌手术（中共中央文献研究室 2000）。在接下来的几个月里，中国这位最高技官没有闲暇去担心经济或其派系的福祉。
In the absence of an actual economic crisis and with Chen falling ill, Deng and his provincial followers called the bureaucrats’ bluff. With Deng’s countermand of Chen’s austerity plan, the discipline over fixed asset investment collapsed in the last quarter of 1979. Investment reached 52.3 billion yuan by the end of 1979, over 2 billion yuan above Chen’s earlier goal of reducing investment to below 50 billion yuan (Department of Comprehensive Statistics of National Bureau of Statistics 1999). Because the central government
在没有出现实际的经济危机且陈云病倒的情况下，邓小平及其省级跟随者揭穿了官僚们的虚张声势。随着邓对陈的紧缩计划的撤销，固定资产投资的约束在 1979 年最后一个季度崩溃。到 1979 年底，投资达到 523 亿元，超过陈先前将投资降至低于 500 亿元目标的预期 20 多亿元（国家统计局综合统计司 1999）。由于中央政府
still had relatively tight control over budgetary disbursement, this new surge of investment at the local level was predominantly financed by another source: bank loans.
仍然对预算拨付保持相对严格的控制，但这一新一轮地方投资热潮主要由另一个来源融资：银行贷款。

Deng's Triumph and the Onset of Inflation
邓的小胜与通货膨胀的开始

The year 1980 began splendidly for Deng’s followers. The February Fifth Plenum saw the creation of the Central Secretariat, an organization designed to run the day-to-day affairs of the Party. Deng’s followers dominated it. Hu Yaobang was elected to the position of General Secretary of the Party, the highest position in the Party besides the soon-to-be-abolished post of Party Chairman (MacFarquhar 1997: 325). In the spring, Zhao Ziyang, one of Deng’s favorite local officials, was promoted to vice premier before taking over the position of premier a few months later.
1980 年对邓的小圈子来说开局辉煌。二月五中全会设立了中央秘书处——一个负责处理党日常事务的机构。邓的小圈子在其中占主导。胡耀邦当选为党的总书记，作为即将废除的党主席之外党的最高职务（MacFarquhar 1997: 325）。春季，邓钟意的地方官员之一赵紫阳被提升为国务院副总理，数月后接任总理。
On the economic front, Deng further undermined Chen Yun’s centralization program during the January Central Cadre Conference. In his speech at the conference, Deng stressed the importance of growth to China’s position in the world: “. . . from the first year of the 1980s, we must not delay (danwu) for one day and concentrate wholeheartedly on the Four Modernization” (Deng 1982b: 400). Although Deng still valued Chen for his support in the drive against the Hua faction, he also directly criticized Chen for being too reserved when it came to the economy. Although giving Chen a perfunctory praise for restoring economic order after the Cultural Revolution, Deng also said:
在经济方面，邓小平在一月中央干部会议上进一步削弱了陈云的集中化方案。在会议讲话中，邓强调增长对中国在世界上地位的重要性：“……从 1980 年代的第一年起，我们一天也不能耽误（danwu），要把全副精力放在四个现代化上”（Deng 1982b: 400）。尽管邓仍然重视陈云在反对华国锋派系斗争中的支持，但他也直接批评陈云在经济问题上过于谨慎。邓在对陈云恢复文革后经济秩序给予敷衍的赞扬的同时，还说：
On the other hand, quite a few cadres have stood on the side for a few years in the past, so their understanding of the situation was cut off. Since they have only recently returned to their jobs, even those cadres who used to hold those jobs face new problems and are unfamiliar or cannot comprehend the current situation domestically and internationally. As such, it is unavoidable that their work is a bit wanting. If we all humbly study the new situation and new problems, our work will continue to improve. (Deng 1982b)
另一方面，相当多的干部在过去几年中曾置身事外，因此他们对形势的了解被切断了。由于他们最近才回到岗位，即便是那些曾经担任这些职务的干部也面临新问题，对当前国内外形势不熟悉或无法理解。因此，他们的工作难免有些欠缺。如果我们都虚心学习新形势和新问题，我们的工作就会不断改进。（邓 1982b）
Because Yu Qiuli and his followers had been in charge of the economy throughout much of the Cultural Revolution, the reference to those who “have stood on the side for a few years” almost certainly referred to Chen Yun and his followers, who were removed from the State Council during the height of the Cultural Revolution. Although the criticism was mild and Deng supported Chen’s proposal to boost investment in light industry, it sent yet another clear signal to local officials that Deng disputed the State Council’s directives to rein in investment.
因为于秋厉及其追随者在文化大革命的大部分时期一直掌管经济，“在旁边站了几年”的指称几乎可以肯定是指陈云及其追随者，他们在文化大革命高峰期被免去了国务院职务。尽管批评较为温和，且邓支持陈提出的增加轻工业投资的建议，但这又向地方官员发出了一个明确的信号：邓不同意国务院收紧投资的指示。
Chen’s faction did not simply accept defeat in the face of Deng’s maneuvers to dismantle the austerity measures, but their reactions were largely ineffective. During Chen Yun’s convalescence, Li Xiannian, the Vice Chairman of the FEC, continued to speak out on behalf of the central bureaucracy. In a central cadre conference on February 10, 1980, which prepared for the Fifth Plenum, Li predictably put an emphasis on readjustment rather than on reform and growth. As Chen had done earlier, Li warned that impatience could lead to “chaos,” which referred to high inflation (Li 1982b). Nonetheless, Li’s comments fell
陈云的派系并没有在邓的拆除紧缩措施的行动面前简单地接受失败，但他们的反应在很大程度上是无效的。在陈云休养期间，中央财经领导小组副组长李先念继续代表中央官僚体系发声。在为第五次全会做准备的 1980 年 2 月 10 日的中央干部会议上，李像人们预期的那样强调的是调整而不是改革与增长。正如陈早先所做的，李警告说急躁可能导致“混乱”，这里指的是高通货膨胀（Li 1982b）。尽管如此，李的评论却
on deaf ears because the economy was in fact doing fine. In a March meeting with provincial cadres, Li repeated his warning, but still had to refer to the “latent” dangers of the growing deficit and overinvestment (Li 1982c).
遭到充耳不闻，因为经济事实上运转良好。在 3 月与省级干部的会议上，李重申了他的警告，但仍不得不提及不断扩大的赤字和过度投资的“潜在”危险（Li 1982c）。
Although Chen’s health had improved by March 1980, Deng further sidelined Chen by forming the Central Finance and Economic Leading Group to replace the Finance and Economic Committee. Rather than getting an experienced State Council bureaucrat to serve as its head, Deng appointed Zhao Ziyang, who had recently been promoted from provincial administration (The Fourth Editorial Bureau of the Central Document Research Center 1999). Although Chen Yun’s protégé Yao Yilin became the vice chairman of the new organization, his power was checked by other members in the group, namely Deng’s follower Wan Li, as well as Yu Qiuli and his protégé Gu Mu. With this lineup at the Leading Group, Deng in effect prevented Chen’s faction from dominating economic policies. Although Yu’s faction lost much of its influence in the central bureaucracy because of the declining influence of Hua Guofeng, it remained useful to Deng. As former protégés of Hua Guofeng, members of Yu’s faction dared not oppose Deng because they retained their positions at Deng’s pleasure. In fact, a member of Yu’s crumbling faction, Gu Mu, soon became an active champion of Guangdong Province as the head of the State Council Special Economic Zone Office. Although Chen still had great influence in the vast planning bureaucracy, his power was for the moment eclipsed by the newly promoted Premier, Zhao Ziyang. This example illustrates that as head of the dominant generalist faction, Deng had the authority to fashion an institutional change that greatly weakened the formal power of the technocratic faction, especially when economic conditions were favorable.
尽管到 1980 年 3 月陈的健康有所好转，邓小平仍通过成立中央财经领导小组来取代财经委员会，从而进一步边缘化陈。邓没有任命一位有经验的国务院官员出任该小组组长，而是任命了刚从省级行政部门提拔上来的赵紫阳（中央文献研究室第四编辑局 1999）。尽管陈云的门生姚依林成为该新机构的副组长，但他的权力受到小组其他成员的制衡，即邓的小跟班万里，以及于起利和其门生谷牧。凭借这个领导小组的阵容，邓实际上阻止了陈的派系主导经济政策。尽管由于华国锋影响力的下降，于派在中央官僚机构中的影响大为削弱，但对邓仍然有用。作为华国锋的前门生，于派成员不敢反对邓，因为他们的职位取决于邓的恩准。 事实上，于氏派系正在瓦解，其一名成员顾穆很快以国务院经济特区办公室主任的身份，成为广东省的积极支持者。尽管陈仍在庞大的规划官僚体系中拥有重大影响力，但他当时的权势被新晋总理赵紫阳所掩盖。这个例子说明，作为主导的通才派系首脑，邓有权力推动一项制度性变化，从而大大削弱了技术官僚派系的正式权力，尤其是在经济形势有利时。
It is instructive to examine the relationship between patrons of a generalist faction and their key provincial followers because it sheds light on the role factions played in allocating scarce financial resources to the provinces. Soon after becoming Premier in August 1980, Zhao convened a reporting meeting (huibaohui) just for cadres from Guangdong at Zhongnanhai, the central leadership compound. In reality, this was a friendly bargaining session between Zhao Ziyang, who was likely acting on behalf of Deng, and factional followers from Guangdong. The attendees of this meeting included outgoing Guangdong Party secretary Xi Zhongxun, Deng’s close friend and the head of the Guangdong Military Region Yang Shangkun, Guangdong Governor Liu Tianfu, General Secretary Hu Yaobang, Deng follower and Vice Premier Wan Li, Gu Mu, and Yao Yilin. Yao was Chen Yun’s only representative at the meeting.
考察一个泛能派系的恩主与其关键省级追随者之间的关系具有启发性，因为这有助于说明派系在向省级分配稀缺财政资源中所起的作用。赵在 1980 年 8 月成为国务院总理后不久，就在中央领导机关中南海召集了一次仅针对广东干部的汇报会（huibaohui）。实际上，这是赵紫阳（很可能代表邓小平行事）与来自广东的派系追随者之间的一次友好谈判。出席这次会议的有即将离任的广东省委书记习仲勋、邓的密友兼广东军区司令杨尚昆、广东省省长刘田夫、总书记胡耀邦、邓的追随者兼国务院副总理万里、顾穆和姚依林。姚依林是陈云在会上的唯一代表。
During the course of the meeting, Governor Liu Tianfu made a series of proposals for central subsidies, and Zhao approved most of them. For example, Liu asked Zhao for control over the Bank of China branch in Guangdong, which was in charge of foreign exchange. Zhao’s reply was swift:
在会议过程中，省长刘田夫提出了一系列中央补贴的建议，赵批准了其中大部分。例如，刘向赵请求掌控驻广东的中国银行分行，该行负责外汇事务。赵的回复很快：
Liu Tianfu: Now, when we deposit foreign exchange in the bank, Guangdong cannot use the funds. This is very disadvantageous toward our external economic activities. G u M u G u M u GuMuG u M u : I am in charge of solving this problem. I heard that this is not the case.
刘天福：现在我们把外汇存到银行，广东不能动用这些资金。这对我们的对外经济活动非常不利。 G u M u G u M u GuMuG u M u ：我负责解决这个问题。我听说并非如此。
Zhao: We can do this - the Bank of China branch in Guangdong will serve at the same time as the bank for Guangdong Province and will become a provincial bank. You can write up some regulations… (Office of the Guangdong Party Committee 1986)
赵：我们可以这样做——中国银行广东分行同时担任广东省的银行，成为一家省级银行。你们可以拟定一些规定……（广东省委办公室 1986）
Now vested with the authorities of a central leader (zhongyang lingdao), Zhao did not hesitate to show off his power to his former colleagues. Despite Gu’s reluctance, Zhao simply handed the Bank of China branch over to the Guangdong provincial government. II II  ^("II "){ }^{\text {II }}
现在掌握了中央领导（zhongyang lingdao）权限的赵，不犹豫地向他的老同事们展示自己的权力。尽管顾不愿意，赵还是把中国银行分行交给了广东省政府。 II II  ^("II "){ }^{\text {II }}
Other members of Deng’s faction, perhaps trying to curry favors with the new Premier and Deng’s close friend Yang Shangkun, also readily agreed to Guangdong’s requests. I2 I2  ^("I2 "){ }^{\text {I2 }} For example, when Xi Zhongxun asked for more grain, Wan Li , the vice premier in charge of agriculture, simply asked, “How much do you need?” Without bargaining, Wan handed Guangdong one billion jin in extra grain (Office of the Guangdong Party Committee 1986). Similarly, when Governor Liu asked for central subsidies for repairing the Beijing-Guangdong railroad, Hu Yaobang quickly acceded, and Zhao added that the central government would provide subsidies to fix the local lines as well (Office of the Guangdong Party Committee 1986).
邓的派系中的其他成员，或许想讨好新任总理兼邓的挚友杨尚昆，也乐于同意广东的请求。例如，当习仲勋要求更多粮食时，负责农业的副总理万里只是问道：“需要多少？”万里没有讨价还价，就额外拨给广东十亿斤粮食（广东省委办公室 1986）。类似地，当省长刘某请求中央补贴修理京广铁路时，胡耀邦迅速同意，赵又补充说中央也会补贴修理地方线路（广东省委办公室 1986）。
Yao Yilin, who had been sitting quietly through much of the proceedings, finally spat out a sarcastic comment on what he must have thought was a wanton exercise of factional favoritism (Office of the Guangdong Party Committee 1986):
姚依林在大部分过程中一直默不作声，终于吐出一句讥讽性的评论，显然他认为这是任意行使派系偏袒的行为（广东省委办公室 1986）：
Let’s just make Guangdong into an independent country. If it wants special policies, then it should get even more independence. But now Guangdong wants more food, which we don’t have. At the same time, there are not enough goods from the rest of the country to absorb all the liquidity in Guangdong.
干脆把广东变成一个独立的国家吧。要是它想要特殊政策，那就应该获得更大的独立。但现在广东想要更多粮食，而我们没有。同时，来自全国其他地区的商品不足以吸收广东所有的流动性。
In all fairness, the way that Deng’s faction treated Guangdong demonstrated obvious favoritism. Guangdong, already one of the fastest growing destinations of foreign investment, was earning and keeping more foreign currency than most of the other provinces. At the same time, Guangdong had gained more fiscal autonomy, making it one of China’s richest provinces. Although we have no record of similar bargaining sessions between Zhao and other provincial leaders, it was clear that the special relationship among Deng, Zhao, and Guangdong provided it with an enormous advantage in gaining access to funds and preferential policies. No other province at the time could have met with the premier, the party secretary general, and two vice premiers in one sitting. From the perspective of the central technocrats, the high degree of autonomy
公平地说，邓派对待广东的方式明显存在偏袒。广东作为外资流入最快的目的地之一，比大多数其他省份赚得并留存了更多外汇。与此同时，广东获得了更多的财政自主权，使其成为中国最富有的省份之一。尽管我们没有赵与其他省级领导人进行类似博弈会谈的记录，但显然邓、赵与广东之间的特殊关系为广东在获取资金和优惠政策方面提供了巨大优势。当时没有其他省份能在一次会面中同时见到国务院总理、党总书记和两位副总理。从中央技术官僚的角度看，高度的自主权
and preferential treatment given to Guangdong meant nothing less than a flagrant encroachment by Deng’s faction into their core area of responsibility. This prompted them to look for the first opportunity to regain economic authority.
对广东的优待无异于邓派对他们核心职责范围的公然侵蚀。这促使他们寻机夺回经济权威。
By the fall of 1980, Deng’s strategy of galvanizing local support for his final drive to eliminate Hua had succeeded. In a tearful self-criticism at a November 10 Politburo meeting, Marshal Ye admitted that his support for Hua had been influenced by his “feudal” loyalty to the dying Mao, who had designated Hua his successor (Deng 2005: 170). After Marshal Ye withdrew his support, Hua was promptly demoted to vice-chairman of the Party, making way for Hu Yaobang to take over the top post. At the same time, Deng’s generous investment policy toward the provinces led to a collapse of Chen’s plan to rein in monetary growth. In September the previous year, Chen had planned on 25 billion yuan in fixed asset investment for 1980 (Chen 1982d). Actual investment in 1980 reached 75.8 billion yuan, three times the amount planned by Chen. 13 13 ^(13){ }^{13} The continual expansion of the money supply predictably created inflationary pressure.
到 1980 年秋，邓用以动员地方支持、为最后一搏以清除华的策略已取得成功。11 月 10 日的一次政治局会议上，叶帅在泪流满面的自我批评中承认，他对华的支持受到了对垂死的毛的“封建”忠诚的影响，毛曾指定华为接班人（Deng 2005: 170）。在叶帅撤回支持后，华很快被降为党中央副主席，胡耀邦得以接任最高职务。与此同时，邓对各省的大量投资政策导致陈抑制货币增长计划的失败。陈在前一年的 9 月曾计划 1980 年固定资产投资为 250 亿元（Chen 1982d）。但 1980 年实际投资达到 758 亿元，是陈计划的三倍。 13 13 ^(13){ }^{13} 货币供应的持续扩张可预见地产生了通货膨胀压力。

The Planners Strike Back: Inflationary Crisis and Retrenchment
计划者反击：通胀危机与收缩

Although Deng had the upper hand within the Party, high inflation provided Chen Yun’s faction the opportunity to highlight the one great weakness of Deng’s decentralization policy, the potential for hyperinflation. After Chen’s retreat in the fall of 1979, his followers in the economic bureaucracy began to lay the intellectual groundwork for centralization, but the key ingredient for reasserting central control, an economic crisis, was still missing. At the end of 1979, Xu Yi, one of Chen’s followers, founded the Chinese Finance Society, which aimed at producing articles that supported more central control (Fewsmith 1994: 95). In May 1980, Chen’s followers managed to publish several editorials in the People’s Daily, the Party’s official mouthpiece, against excessive investment (Fewsmith 1994: 99). Soon after, several key members of Yu Qiuli’s faction came under attack for various policy failures (Fewsmith 1994: 100). This was likely Chen’s attempt to lessen the influence of Yu’s faction and, indirectly, Deng’s sway, in the Finance and Economic Leading Group. However, these acts did not seem particularly effective toward Deng’s faction. Local officials managed to launch or keep afloat many investment projects in 1980 with the local budget and with bank loans (Xue 1996: 365).
尽管在党内邓小平占上风，但高通货膨胀为陈云的派系提供了一个机会，以凸显邓的分权政策的一个重大弱点——发生恶性通货膨胀的潜在可能性。1979 年秋陈云退缩后，他在经济官僚体系中的追随者开始为中央集权奠定思想基础，但重新确立中央控制的关键因素——一场经济危机——仍然缺失。1979 年底，陈云的一名追随者许毅创立了中国财政学会，旨在撰写支持更多中央控制的文章（Fewsmith 1994: 95）。1980 年 5 月，陈的追随者设法在党的喉舌《人民日报》上发表了几篇反对过度投资的社论（Fewsmith 1994: 99）。不久之后，余秋里的若干核心成员因各种政策失败受到抨击（Fewsmith 1994: 100）。这很可能是陈试图削弱余派在财经领导小组中的影响力，并间接削弱邓的影响力的举措。然而，这些行动似乎对邓的派系并不特别有效。 地方官员设法在 1980 年用地方预算和银行贷款启动或维持了许多投资项目（Xue 1996: 365）。
In November 1980, the much-anticipated inflation finally arrived. Reports of rapidly increasing prices flooded in from China’s major cities. Average inflation in cities rose to 8 percent, a level not seen since the Great Leap Forward. State Council bureaucrats immediately drafted emergency notices to the Premier (Xue 1996: 363). Not having seen this level of inflation since the last great economic
1980 年 11 月，期待已久的通货膨胀终于到来。来自中国主要城市的价格快速上涨的报告如潮涌来。城市的平均通货膨胀率上升到 8%，这是自大跃进以来未见的水平。国务院官僚们立即起草了给总理的紧急通报（Xue 1996: 363）。自上一次重大经济危机以来，他们还未见过这种程度的通货膨胀。
disaster, Deng and his faction took the price increase seriously. If the crisis spun out of control, Chen and his followers and allies who sat on the Politburo could mobilize a coalition to weaken Deng’s presence in the Politburo by blaming the disaster on either Hu Yaobang or Zhao Ziyang. There also was a small chance that Hua Guofeng’s residual faction - especially officers in the army - could spring back to life with a major policy failure by Deng. The Dengists knew of only one way to resolve the crisis and to preserve their factional strength delegating economic policies, especially in the realm of investment and finance, back to the central planners.
灾难发生后，邓和他的派系严肃对待了物价上涨。如果危机失控，陈云及其在政治局中的追随者和盟友可以动员一个联盟，通过将灾难归咎于胡耀邦或赵紫阳来削弱邓在政治局的影响力。还有一小概率，华国锋的残余派系——尤其是军队中的将领——会在邓的一次重大政策失败后死灰复燃。邓派只知道一种解决危机并保全其派系实力的办法：将经济政策，特别是在投资和 finance 领域的政策，重新委托给中央计划者。
With prices careening out of control, Chen went on the offensive at the November 28, 1980 Politburo and Party Secretariat Meeting dedicated to the economy. Specifically countering Deng’s previous remarks of not wanting to delay growth further, Chen had this caustic rebut: “How much time have we wasted since the Opium War? What’s the big deal with ‘delaying’ (danwu) another three years!” (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000: 262). Rather than an investment ceiling in the 50 billion yuan range, Chen called for fixing investment at 32 billion yuan for the next three years. Because of inflation, Deng had little choice but to concur with Chen’s economic program of lower investment and a modest growth rate of between 4 and 5 percent. Perhaps getting back at Deng for the humiliation he had suffered in the previous year, Chen Yun rudely interrupted Deng during his remarks with sarcastic comments: “A 4 percent growth is not face-losing, nor is it a simple matter”(Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000: 262). I4 I4  ^("I4 "){ }^{\text {I4 }} More important for Chen, Deng announced to the Party that he completely agreed with Chen that periods of readjustment required the centralization of economic authority (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000: 262).
随着物价失控地飙升，陈在 1980 年 11 月 28 日专门讨论经济问题的政治局和中央书记处会议上采取了攻势。针对邓此前表示不愿进一步延缓增长的言论，陈做出了如下尖刻反驳：“自鸦片战争以来我们浪费了多少时间？再‘耽误’（danwu）三年有什么大不了的！”（中共中央文献研究室 2000：262）。陈主张把未来三年的投资固定在 320 亿元，而不是在 500 亿元左右设定投资上限。由于通货膨胀，邓几乎别无选择，只能同意陈关于降低投资并把温和增长率控制在 4%至 5%之间的经济方案。也许是为了报复前一年所遭受的羞辱，陈云在邓发言时粗鲁地打断并讥讽道：“4%的增长并不丢人，也不是一件简单的事”（中共中央文献研究室 2000：262）。 对陈更重要的是，邓向党宣布他完全同意陈的观点，即在调整时期需要集中经济权力（中共中央文献研究室 2000：262）。
Although the November Politburo meeting decided the general thrust of the readjustment program, the vast majority of local cadres still needed convincing that the central bureaucrats were once again in charge of the economy. To send a clear message to local officials, the Central Committee convened a special work conference in the middle of December attended by Party secretaries of all the provinces. During the conference, top leaders took turns emphasizing that the central technocrats were taking control of the economy and would punish those who exceeded the investment ceiling. Chen’s speech warned that “instability in the economic situation can cause instability in the political situation,” the most menacing argument in the technocrats’ arsenal (Chen 1982c: 803). He also announced a program of strict investment reduction, price control, and a freeze of provincial budgetary surpluses for the next few years, all unthinkable policies just a few months ago (Chen 1982c). Furthermore, he repeated his message that “delaying” for three more years was not a big loss, clearly communicating to local officials that his policies had triumphed over Deng’s anti “delaying” line (Chen 1982c: 804).
尽管十一月的政治局会议决定了调整方案的总体方向，但绝大多数地方干部仍需被说服，中央官僚再次掌控经济。为向地方官员传达明确信号，中共中央在十二月中旬召开了一个特别工作会议，出席者为各省的党书记。在会议上，最高领导人依次强调中央技术官僚正在接管经济，并将惩罚那些超出投资上限的人。陈的讲话警告说“经济形势的不稳定会导致政治形势的不稳定”，这是技术官僚武器库中最具威胁性的论点（Chen 1982c: 803）。他还宣布了一项严格削减投资、控制价格以及在未来几年冻结省级预算结余的计划，而这些政策在几个月前还是不可想象的（Chen 1982c）。 此外，他重申了“再拖三年也不是大损失”的信息，明确向地方官员传达了他的政策已战胜邓的反“拖延”路线（Chen 1982c: 804）。
In his speech, Premier Zhao, who had taken charge of economic policies as the head of the Finance and Economic Leading Group, made the main self-criticism on behalf of the Deng faction. He first admitted that the 17 billion yuan budget deficit required a cash write-off from the People’s Bank of China (PBOC), which contributed to inflation. Although the previous discussion shows clearly that Zhao and others in Deng’s faction enthusiastically pushed for high investment, high lending, and high growth, Zhao blamed inflation on a misunderstanding: “For a period of time in the past, we did not have an adequate understanding of the latent danger in the economy…” (Zhao 1982c: 808). He even placed the blame on the Gang of Four and “leftist commandism,” although the Gang of Four had been out of power for nearly four years (Zhao 1982c)!
在他的讲话中，作为财经领导小组负责人、负责经济政策的赵总理代表邓派作了主要的自我批评。他首先承认，170 亿元的预算赤字需要由中国人民银行（PBOC）进行现金冲销，这助长了通货膨胀。尽管前文讨论已清楚显示赵及邓派的其他人热衷于高投资、高放贷和高增长，赵却把通货膨胀归咎于一种误解：“在过去一段时间里，我们对经济中的潜在危险认识不够……”（赵 1982c：808）。他甚至将责任归咎于四人帮和“左倾指令主义”，尽管四人帮已下台将近四年（赵 1982c）！
Regardless of where he placed the blame, Zhao was on board with Chen’s program of economic centralization. He announced that the central government would achieve budgetary balance, lending balance (xindai pingheng), and price stability in 1981 (Zhao 1982c: 809). Lending balance stood for a rough equality between the growth of deposits and the growth of lending, which aimed at controlling the growth of money supply. As lending became an ever larger factor in the economy, central planners increasingly relied on lending balance to maintain price stability (Bi 1987: 116). To ensure lending balance, Zhao announced that no locality could break its credit ceiling without the authorization of the PBOC and that “those who violate the rules will be punished accordingly” (Zhao 1982c: 813). In addition to these policies, Zhao also announced painful cutbacks in budgetary expenditure and a mandatory 8 billion yuan “loan” by rich provinces to repay part of the central deficit (Zhao 1982c: 811).
无论他把责任归咎于何处，赵都支持陈的经济集权方案。他宣布中央政府将在 1981 年实现预算收支平衡、信贷平衡（xindai pingheng）和价格稳定（Zhao 1982c: 809）。信贷平衡指的是存款增长与放贷增长大致相等，旨在控制货币供应增长。随着贷款在经济中所占比重不断增加，中央计划者越来越依赖信贷平衡来维持价格稳定（Bi 1987: 116）。为确保信贷平衡，赵宣布任何地方未经 PBOC 授权不得突破其信贷额度，并且“违反规定者将按法处置”（Zhao 1982c: 813）。除了这些政策外，赵还宣布在预算开支上进行痛苦的削减，并要求富裕省份强制性“借出”80 亿元以偿还中央部分赤字（Zhao 1982c: 811）。
At the end of the meeting, Deng made his appearance to give his reluctant endorsement of the austerity program. To signal to Chen Yun that he was sincere in giving economic authorities back to the planners, Deng had two of the planners’ conservative ideologue allies, Deng Liqun and Hu Qiaomu, draft his remarks at the meeting (Deng 2005: 183). These remarks sent the necessary message to lower level officials. As Zhao had done, Deng admitted that the central leadership had been divided over the pace of growth and investment and that Chen Yun’s call for readjustment had been correct all along. He went on to emphasize that the main task for the next few years would be readjustment and that centralization would be the main mode of managing the economy (Deng 1982a: 828). There was now no doubt about who was in charge of the economy, although Deng exacted a small vengeance against Chen by shutting down one of Chen’s central investment projects, the construction of Bao Steel in Shanghai (Chen 2005). I5 I5  ^("I5 "){ }^{\text {I5 }}
会议结束时，邓出现并勉强为紧缩方案背书。为了向陈云示意自己将经济权力交还给计划者是认真的，邓请了两位计划派保守意识形态盟友邓力群和胡乔木起草他在会上要讲的话（Deng 2005: 183）。这些讲话向下级官员传达了必要的信息。正如赵所做的，邓承认中央领导在增长和投资节奏问题上存在分歧，并且陈云关于调整的主张一直是正确的。他接着强调，未来几年工作的主要任务将是调整，中央集权将是管理经济的主要方式（Deng 1982a: 828）。现在谁掌管经济已毫无疑问，尽管邓对陈进行了小小的报复，关闭了陈的一个中央投资项目——上海宝钢的建设（Chen 2005）。 I5 I5  ^("I5 "){ }^{\text {I5 }}
The Party and State Council machinery swung into motion after the central work conference to issue a stream of decrees that spelled out the specific elements of the retrenchment program. As was typical in the CCP policy process, the CC first distributed key remarks by central leaders to mid-level cadres (Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party 1982a). This document conveyed the general aims of the retrenchment program. Shortly thereafter, in January 1981, the State Council issued “Decision concerning balancing the budget and strictly managing the budget,” which spelled out in more concrete details how budgetary and lending balances were achieved (State Council 1982a). Essentially, the document ordered all work units to freeze new investment and lending and to wait for State Council instructions. A subsequent State Council decree centralized investment and lending related to major projects to the Planning Commission, which was controlled by Yao Yilin (State Council 1982b).
中央工作会议后，党的和国务院的机构开始运作，发布了一连串法令，阐明紧缩课程的具体要素。正如中共决策过程的典型做法，中央委员会先将中央领导的要点分发给中层干部（Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party 1982a）。该文件传达了紧缩课程的一般目标。不久之后，1981 年 1 月，国务院发布了《关于平衡预算和严格管理预算的决定》，更具体地说明了如何实现预算和平衡以及借贷平衡（State Council 1982a）。本质上，该文件要求所有单位冻结新的投资和借贷，等待国务院指示。随后，国务院的一项法令将与重大项目有关的投资和借贷集中到由姚依林控制的计划委员会（Planning Commission）（State Council 1982b）。
In early February 1981, the PBOC concocted its own set of specific regulations to realize the general spirit of the retrenchment, as well as the specific goals set out by the State Council documents. The PBOC document spelled out the loan ceilings and restrictions that applied to various categories of loans, as well as ways to deal with companies that had defaulted on loans (People’s Bank of China 1983a). Another PBOC document specified the institution of a new reporting system which provided central bureaucrats with money supply figures every five days (People’s Bank of China 1983b). Finally, throughout the year, individual banks issued even more specific regulations about how to implement the directives and goals specified by all the previous documents from the higher levels. The Bank of China regulations, for example, did not appear until July (Bank of China 1983). Regardless of the issuance of decrees, however, the tone of the policy environment had shifted, giving central agencies firm authority to halt lending and investment at the local level.
1981 年 2 月初，中国人民银行制定了一套具体的规章，以实现紧缩的一般精神以及国务院文件规定的具体目标。中国人民银行的文件列明了适用于各类贷款的贷款上限和限制，以及处理违约企业的办法（中国人民银行 1983a）。另一份中国人民银行的文件规定建立一套新的报告制度，向中央官僚每五天提供一次货币供应量数据（中国人民银行 1983b）。最后，在全年中，各个银行发布了更为具体的规定，说明如何执行之前各级文件中规定的指示和目标。例如，中国银行的规定直到 7 月才出台（中国银行 1983）。无论法令如何颁布，政策环境的基调已经发生变化，赋予中央机构在地方层面停止放贷和投资的坚决权力。
The shifting tone of economic policy environment clearly constrained the ability of factional patrons to disburse favors to followers at the provinces. On an inspection to Guangdong in August 1981, for example, Zhao took a very different stance toward local officials. First, he began his remarks by quoting Chen Yun on the importance of price stability. Rather than generously doling out preferential policies to Guangdong, Zhao stuck closely to the Deng-Chen compromise of retrenchment while continuing reform. The following remarks typified his ambivalence:
经济政策环境语气的转变明显限制了派系保护人向省级追随者分发利益的能力。例如，1981 年 8 月在一次对广东的视察中，赵对地方官员采取了完全不同的态度。首先，他在讲话开头引用了陈云关于价格稳定重要性的论述。赵没有慷慨地向广东下放优惠政策，而是紧紧遵循邓陈在收缩中继续改革的妥协。下面的讲话体现了他的矛盾态度：
. . . since the end of last year, we have proposed adjustment and emphasized concentration and unity. On the whole, we are not saying that we will backtrack. Of course when this type of policies are conveyed, it immediately took effect within one quarter to concentrate (economic powers), which stabilized things. After that, Comrade Chen Yun said that we can gradually relax our grip after some consideration. On a whole, this was necessary. Of course, in some places, if things were not as rigid (si), it would have been better. Looking back, those places that weren’t as rigid are better off today, but in the
……自从去年年底以来，我们提出了调整，强调集中和团结。总的来说，我们不是说要后退。当然，这种政策一传达，就在一个季度内立即起作用，实行了集中（经济权力），这稳定了局势。之后，陈云同志说经过一些考虑可以逐步放松我们的控制。总体上，这是必要的。当然，在一些地方，如果事情不是那么僵化（si），情况会更好。回头看起来，那些不那么僵化的地方今天反而更好，但在…
end, if we did not put on the brakes back then, there would have been instability. (Zhao 1986c: 204)
要不是当时我们踩刹车，后果将是不稳定的。（赵 1986c：204）
Sarcastic remarks against Chen’s economic policies were absent, replaced by a sense of helplessness toward the existing policy environment. Zhao’s message to his followers in Guangdong was that although he disliked the current policy environment, Guangdong would have to adhere to central directives. Zhao even used the logic of the free-rider problem to persuade his doubtless frustrated followers of the necessities of restricting money supply: “If the entire country does what Guangdong did, there would be great problems” (Zhao 1986c: 204). Although Zhao still doled out a small amount of railroad subsidies to his longtime colleagues, he was clearly unable to give as much as he would have liked: “Look, when I come here to listen to you, I feel very good and feel that I should give you some things, but when I return to Beijing, things change immediately. My standpoint immediately changes” (Zhao 1986c: 217). Here, Zhao was likely referring to Chen Yun’s wrath if he deviated from the retrenchment too much.
对陈的经济政策的讽刺性言论消失了，取而代之的是对现有政策环境的无奈感。赵对其在广东的追随者传达的信息是：尽管他不喜欢当前的政策环境，广东也必须遵守中央指示。赵甚至用搭便车问题的逻辑来劝说那些无疑感到沮丧的追随者，说明限制货币供应的必要性：“如果全国都像广东那样做，就会有大问题”（赵 1986c：204）。尽管赵仍然给了他多年的同僚少量的铁路补贴，但显然无法给予他想给的那样多：“你看，我到这里听你们讲话的时候，心里很高兴，觉得应该给你们一些东西，可是回到北京，事情立刻就变了。我的立场立刻就变了”（赵 1986c：217）。在这里，赵很可能指的是如果他过度偏离紧缩路线会招致陈云的怒火。
Zhao’s circumspection reveals that Chen’s participation in elite politics created sufficient credibility for the retrenchment program such that local officials believed Zhao’s hands were tied in the matters of investment policy. Local officials knew that Zhao had no authority to override Chen because Chen Yun was not just a bureaucratic “agent” of the premier but a political heavyweight in his own right with a dense network of supporters and voting power in the Politburo. Even Deng, the de facto boss of the Party, had to wait for the right moment to reverse Chen’s policies. As the following discussion reveals, a failed attempt to reverse Chen’s policy could be costly for Deng’s faction.
赵的谨慎表明，陈参与高层政治为紧缩方案建立了足够的可信度，使地方官员相信在投资政策问题上赵已束手无策。地方官员知道赵无权推翻陈，因为陈云不仅是总理的官僚“代理人”，还是一位有着广泛支持网络和在政治局拥有投票权的政治重量级人物。即使是党内的事实上的首领邓小平，也必须等待合适时机才能扭转陈的政策。正如下文所示，试图扭转陈的政策若失败，对邓的派系可能代价高昂。

The Failure of Deng's Counteroffensive and Continual Retrenchment
邓的反攻失败与持续的紧缩政策

The technocratic faction not only needed the power to initiate a centralization drive. It also needed the political resources to maintain centralization. The crux of the top bureaucrats’ credibility was their ability to resist political demands from the generalists. Because local officials expected the bureaucrats to fight vigorously to retain control over the economy and, more specifically, over the money supply, they adhered to the central credit ceiling, at least until they received new information. In this instance, faced with a growing counteroffensive from Deng’s camp, Chen’s faction used its resources to defeat it. Without the ability to defend itself, the technocratic faction’s preferred policies would not have been credible.
技术官僚派不仅需要发起集中化运动的权力，还需要维持集中化的政治资源。顶层官僚信誉的核心在于他们抵抗泛政治人物要求的能力。因为地方官员预期官僚会为保住对经济、更具体地说对货币供应量的控制而奋力抗争，所以他们遵守中央的信贷上限，至少在收到新信息之前是如此。在这一情形下，面对来自邓小平阵营日益增强的反击，陈的派系动用其资源将其击败。若无自我防卫的能力，技术官僚派所偏好的政策就不会具有可信性。
The seeds of the generalist faction’s rebellion against bureaucratic control were planted at Zhao’s August 1981 meeting with Guangdong cadres. During the speech, Zhao launched into a lengthy discussion on money supply. He noted that money supply in fact expanded by 40 billion yuan in the first quarter of 1981, the highest level seen in PRC history. Yet, inflation did not increase further as expected. Zhao wondered out loud whether this was a result of higher demand for cash in the new market economy (Zhao 1986c: 205). Objectively,
普通派对官僚控制发起反抗的种子在赵在 1981 年 8 月与广东干部的会议上埋下。在讲话中，赵长篇大论地讨论了货币供应。他指出，1981 年第一季度货币供应实际上扩张了 400 亿元，为中华人民共和国历史上见到的最高水平。然而，通货膨胀并没有像预期那样进一步上升。赵当众猜测这是否是新市场经济中对现金需求增加的结果（Zhao 1986c: 205）。客观上，
the lack of inflation in the first quarter likely resulted from both declining inflationary expectation after the December conference and the rising demand for cash. Politically, however, Zhao’s analysis aimed to raise doubt about Chen’s argument that rapid monetary expansion equated disaster for the economy.
第一季度通货膨胀缺失很可能既源于十二月会议后通胀预期的下降，也源于对现金需求的上升。然而，在政治上，赵的分析旨在对陈所提出的快速货币扩张等于经济灾难的论断提出怀疑。
The generalist faction’s counteroffensive gained further momentum on July 3, 1981, when Deng spoke at a work meeting of provincial party secretaries. Rather than strictly adhering to the official retrenchment line, Deng began to raise doubts about austerity:
普通派的反攻在 1981 年 7 月 3 日进一步获得动力，当时邓在一次省委书记工作会议上发言。邓没有严格坚持官方的紧缩路线，而开始对节俭提出质疑：
The speed of economic construction cannot be quick during readjustment, but we will encounter some problems if, after three years of adjustment, the economy does not grow at a certain speed. I support the perspective that we should plan for our economic construction in three-year’s time. If we do not consider it now, we will not have time in three years…we cannot begin too many major investment projects. Nonetheless, a coal mine with fifteen million tons of production capacity is a major project, and we should support this kind of project. Without this kind of basic construction, our speed (of economic growth) will be slow. (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2004: 754)
在调整时期经济建设的速度不能太快，但如果经过三年调整后经济仍然没有达到一定速度，我们就会遇到一些问题。我支持在三年内对我们的经济建设作出规划的观点。如果现在不考虑，三年后就没有时间……我们不能开工太多大型投资项目。不过，一个年产能一千五百万吨的煤矿就是一个重大项目，我们应当支持这样的项目。没有这种基础建设，我们的速度（经济增长）就会慢。（中共中央文献研究室 2004：754）
Although Deng did not denounce the austerity program outright, he raised doubts about the degree of investment reduction, signaling to local officials his disagreement with Chen. In August 1981, Hu Yaobang further lent support to his patron’s offensive during a meeting on propaganda and ideology. Although Hu Yaobang’s remarks at the meeting mostly concerned ideological matters, he began his speech with a few cryptic remarks on the economy:
尽管邓没有公开否定节约方针，他对投资减少的幅度提出了质疑，向地方官员表明他不同意陈的意见。1981 年 8 月，在一次宣传思想工作会议上，胡耀邦进一步在他恩主的进攻中表示支持。虽然胡耀邦在会上多半谈的是意识形态问题，但他在讲话一开始就对经济作了几句意味深长的评述：
Since the Sixth Plenum, Comrade Deng Xiaoping made two important sets of remarks. The first was remarks on economic problems in his talks with Comrades Wan Li, Yu Qiuli, Gu Mu, and Yao Yilin. The record of these talks has not be edited and distributed, but I think they should be. The main point of the talks was that we should try every means to think of ways to increase growth. The economy should grow at a pace that reflects hard work. If we cannot increase growth, those of us in charge will be criticized. (Hu 1982: 1208)
自第六次全会以来，邓小平同志发表了两组重要谈话。第一组是在他与万里、余秋里、谷牧、姚依林同志谈话中关于经济问题的讲话。这些谈话的记录尚未编辑和发布，但我认为应该公布。谈话的要点是我们应当尽一切办法想办法扩大增长。经济应当以体现艰苦奋斗的速度增长。如果我们不能提高增长，负责的人将受到批评。（胡 1982：1208）
This brief statement was politically salient for several reasons. First, Hu indicated that these pro-growth remarks should be “edited and distributed,” meaning that they should become official policies replacing Chen’s retrenchment program. Through Hu Yaobang, Deng also sent a clear warning to the central technocrats that if growth did not speed up, “those of us in charge” would get into political trouble (Hu 1982: 1208). Although this was short of an open assault on Chen’s policies because the speech was heard only by a handful of officials and Deng continued to espouse the retrenchment line to foreign guests, Deng was certainly testing the water and hoping to gather enough momentum to undo Chen’s policies. To the audience of local officials, they doubtless sensed that their factional patron was maneuvering to unbind the retrenchment. The process, however, did not go smoothly this time.
这段简短的声明在政治上具有重要意义，原因有好几方面。首先，胡表明这些主张增长的言论应当“编辑并下发”，意味着它们应成为正式政策以取代陈的紧缩方案。通过胡耀邦，邓还向中央技术官僚发出明确警告：如果增长不能加快，“我们这些负责的人”将会陷入政治麻烦（胡 1982：1208）。虽然这还不到对陈政策的公开攻击——因为这篇讲话只有少数官员听到，且邓在接待外宾时仍然主张紧缩路线——但邓无疑是在试探水温，寄希望于积聚足够的势头以撤销陈的政策。对地方官员的听众来说，他们无疑感到自己的派系后台正在操盘，试图解除紧缩。然而，这一过程这次并不顺利。
In the midst of rising resentment toward the retrenchment policies, Chen once again emphasized the danger of expanding money supply and inflation in a
在对紧缩政策愈加不满的氛围中，陈再次在一篇讲话中强调扩张货币供应和通货膨胀的危险，」
September 1981 Politburo meeting. Sensing the shifting political tide, however, he paid lip service to Deng’s emphasis on growth, but he also stressed that growth needed “a long-term plan,” implying central coordination (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000: 280). Luckily for Chen, although overall inflation had stabilized at 2.5 percent, the price increase for agricultural goods stubbornly clung to the 6 percent level. In November, he reinforced the danger of price instability by distributing a report from the Beijing Public Security Bureau about people’s dissatisfaction with rising food prices to the other leaders (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000: 283). Thus armed, Chen managed to veto Zhao’s proposal to free up prices and to end price subsidies at the fourth meeting of the Fifth National People’s Congress (Chen 1982f: 1347).
1981 年 9 月的政治局会议。然而，察觉到政治潮流的变化，他对邓强调的增长口头表示支持，但同时也强调增长需要“一个长期计划”，暗示要中央统筹（中共党史资料研究中心 2000：280）。对陈来说幸运的是，尽管总体通货膨胀已稳定在 2.5％，农产品价格上涨却顽固地维持在 6％水平。11 月，他通过向其他领导分发一份来自北京市公安局关于民众对粮食涨价不满的报告，进一步强化了价格不稳定的危险（中共党史资料研究中心 2000：283）。有了这些依据，陈在第五届全国人民代表大会第四次会议上成功否决了赵放开价格和取消价格补贴的提议（陈 1982f：1347）。
Chen Yun further undermined Deng’s counteroffensive by attacking Deng’s pet project, the special economic zones. Besides serving as China’s economic czar, Chen Yun also headed the Central Discipline and Inspection Commission (CDIC) - the Party’s anticorruption watchdog organization. Thus, he regularly received the most sensitive reports on corruption generated by the CDIC network of informants. In late 1981, he came across a series of reports on smuggling in the special economic zones in Guangdong and Fujian. Although these were minor affairs by today’s standard, Chen saw the perfect opportunity to put Deng back on the defensive. He bundled several reports, titled the set “On Rampant Smuggling Activities in Some Places in Guangdong,” and distributed them to Hu, Deng, Zhao, and Li Xiannian. He wrote on it that “for serious economic criminals, I think we should deal with several of them severely, give several of them serious sentences, and even execute several of the most heinous ones”(Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000: 287). Deng and especially Zhao had likely known about these transgressions and had chosen to ignore them to protect the SEZs. Chen’s action, however, forced their hands. They now had to defend the Party’s honor by cracking down on smuggling in the SEZs, even if it put them at the mercy of Chen’s accusations.
陈云通过抨击邓的小宠——经济特区，进一步削弱了邓的反攻势。除了担任中国的经济总管外，陈云还兼任中央纪律检查委员会（CDIC）——党的反腐监察机构。因此，他定期收到由 CDIC 线人网络提供的最敏感的腐败报告。1981 年底，他看到一系列关于广东和福建经济特区走私的报告。按今天的标准这些只是小案，但陈云认为这是把邓重新置于防守地位的绝佳机会。他将几份报告汇编在一起，题为《广东某些地方走私活动猖獗》，并分发给胡、邓、赵和李先念。他在上面写道：“对于严重的经济犯罪分子，我认为应该严办几个人，重判几个人，甚至对最严重的几个执行死刑”（中共中央档案研究室 2000：287）。邓，尤其是赵，很可能早已知道这些违规行为并选择置之不理以保护经济特区。 但是陈的行动迫使他们不得不采取行动。他们现在不得不通过在经济特区严打走私来捍卫党的名誉，即便这会使他们处于陈的指责之下。
On January 11, 1982, the Party Secretariat held an emergency meeting on smuggling and decided to send several central leaders to coastal provinces to direct antismuggling and anticorruption investigations. 16 16 ^(16){ }^{16} Chen’s proposal for prosecuting the worst offenders was adopted (Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party 1982b). In February, cadres from Guangdong and Fujian were summoned to Beijing for a harsh dressing down by Chen and his conservative ideologue allies. Chen Yun and Yao Yilin also successfully turned this meeting into an occasion to criticize Deng and Zhao for a host of economic policies, including investment and lending decentralization. Meanwhile, Zhao, who attended the meeting on behalf of Deng, did his utmost to save the SEZs.
1982 年 1 月 11 日，党中央书记处就走私问题召开紧急会议，决定派出几位中央领导到沿海省份指导反走私和反腐调查。 16 16 ^(16){ }^{16} 陈关于对最严重违法者提起公诉的建议被采纳（中国共产党中央委员会 1982b）。2 月，广东和福建的干部被传唤到北京，接受陈及其保守意识形态同盟的严厉训斥。陈云和姚依林也成功地将此次会议变成一次批评邓小平和赵紫阳的一系列经济政策的机会，包括投资和贷款下放。与此同时，代表邓出席会议的赵紫阳尽最大努力挽救经济特区。
Remarkably, Yao Yilin’s speech at the meeting hardly mentioned the smuggling cases and immediately launched into an attack on the SEZs. Zhao and Yao then engaged in a tense exchange:
值得注意的是，姚依林在会上几乎没有提到走私案件，反而立即转入对经济特区的抨击。随后赵与姚展开了紧张的交锋：
Yao: …we can also consider whether the SEZs are a bit too big.
姚：……我们也可以考虑一下，经济特区是不是有点大了。
Zhao: No, they are not too big; we already eliminated Bao’an County.
赵：不，不是太大；我们已经取消了宝安县。
Yao: To what extent should SEZs still have special and flexible policies? What can be done; what can’t be done?
姚：经济特区在多大程度上仍应有特殊和灵活的政策？可以做什么；不可以做什么？
Zhao: This is a process of understanding. We might even want to give more flexibility . . . Even if they (the SEZs) hit a wall, they should continue. They should not quit just because they have to withdraw a bit after some period or due to some problems.
赵：这是一个认识的过程。我们甚至可能想给予更多灵活性……即使他们（特区）碰到障碍，也应继续。不能仅仅因为经过一段时期需要后退一点或出现一些问题就放弃。
Yao: …the flexible policies of the two provinces have mainly made achievements, but we should carefully study the problems.(Yao 1986a)
姚：……两个省的灵活政策主要是取得了成就，但我们应当认真研究存在的问题。（姚 1986a）
Because of Zhao’s interruption, Yao’s proposal to eliminate some SEZs were struck down, but for the remainder of his speech, Yao focused on excessive investment and money supply expansion in Guangdong. Reeling from Yao’s attack on the SEZs, both Zhao and Hu Yaobang were forced to concede to Yao’s point that investment and lending had to be placed under stricter control to prevent inflation (Yao 1986a). Yao’s deft maneuvers turned a meeting on smuggling to one on monetary polices by tying the issues together, “I think we have to examine all of these problems together, especially the problem of excessive money supply in Guangdong” (Yao 1986a: 288). Because of Yao’s threat, the CC document about this meeting released to the local cadres sent the unambiguous signal that Chen’s agenda of budgetary balance, price stability, and central control over the economy remained very much the Party-line (Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party 1986).
由于赵的打断，姚关于取消部分经济特区的提议被否决，但在余下的发言中，姚把注意力集中在广东的过度投资和货币供应扩张上。受到姚对经济特区的抨击，赵和胡耀邦都被迫让步，承认必须对投资和贷款实施更严格的控制以防止通货膨胀（Yao 1986a）。姚的巧妙策略将一次关于走私的会议转变为一次关于货币政策的会议，通过将这些问题联系起来：“我认为我们必须把所有这些问题一起审视，特别是广东货币供应过多的问题”（Yao 1986a: 288）。因为姚的威胁，中共中央向地方干部发布的关于此次会议的文件明确传达了陈关于预算平衡、价格稳定和中央对经济控制议程仍然是党路线的信号（Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party 1986）。
Outmaneuvered by Chen’s antismuggling charges, Deng and Zhao had to accept Chen’s economic program. In a March 1982 meeting on industry, Zhao echoed Chen’s program of balanced budget, modest growth, and central control (Zhao 1982b). Even in their remarks to foreign guests, both Deng and Zhao adhered to Chen’s line that rapid investment could cause instability, although Deng insisted that small scale investment could benefit the economy (Deng 1982c). Thus, the State Council retained strict control over investment and lending policies from 1982 to 1983 (Xue 1996:370). Through political maneuvers against Deng’s faction, the technocrats successfully maintained the retrenchment program. Because the technocrats had both the dedication and resources to protect their power base, economic actors in China had good reason to take the retrenchment program seriously.
在陈的反走私指控中被策略性地压制后，邓和赵不得不接受陈的经济方案。在 1982 年 3 月的一次关于工业的会议上，赵呼应了陈提出的收支平衡、适度增长和中央控制的方案（Zhao 1982b）。即使在对外宾的讲话中，邓和赵也都坚持陈的观点，认为快速投资可能导致不稳定，尽管邓坚持小规模投资可以有利于经济（Deng 1982c）。因此，国务院在 1982 年至 1983 年期间对投资和放贷政策保持严格控制（Xue 1996:370）。通过对邓派的政治 maneuver，技术官僚成功地维持了收缩政策。由于技术官僚既有保护其权力基础的献身精神又有资源，中国的经济行为者有充分理由认真对待这一收缩方案。

"Bogaidai": The Slippery Slope toward a Fiscalized Banking System
“Bogaidai”：走向财政化银行体系的滑坡

While battles on the degree of centralization raged between the two factions, both Deng and Chen increasingly utilized the banking system to fulfill their respective political goals. For the generalist faction, banks became a useful source of funds to fuel local economic development. For the technocratic faction, the banks provided a large pool of money to tackle a host of policy problems and to keep the deficit at a low level. Despite paying lip service to
在关于中央集权程度的争论在两派之间激烈进行的同时，邓小平和陈云都越来越多地利用银行体系来实现各自的政治目标。对于那一以行政管理者为主的派系，银行成为促进地方经济发展的重要资金来源。对于那一以技术官僚为主的派系，银行则提供了一大笔资金用于应对各种政策问题并将赤字控制在较低水平。尽管在口头上主张
making them into “real banks,” central politicians in both factions soon grew to treat banks as the second treasury. While they bickered on the level of government controlling the banks, both sides readily ordered banks to lend to their pet projects. Over time, this created a mountain of nonperforming loans.
将它们变成“真正的银行”，两派的中央政治人物很快就把银行当成了第二个国库。在争论由哪个层级的政府控制银行的同时，双方都毫不犹豫地下令银行向各自偏好的项目放贷。随着时间推移，这导致了大量的不良贷款。
The household responsibility system and the bonus system in state firms rapidly increased the pool of rural and urban disposable income after 1978. As a result, bank deposits also increased rapidly. Total saving deposits increased from 18 billion yuan in 1977 to 28 billion yuan in 1979 and again to 40 billion yuan in 1980 (Department of Comprehensive Statistics of National Bureau of Statistics 1999). This trend did not escape the notice of central leaders, who began to see banks as a source of funding.
家庭联产承包责任制和国有企业奖赏制度在 1978 年后迅速增加了城乡可支配收入的总量。结果，银行存款也迅速增长。全社会储蓄性存款从 1977 年的 180 亿元增加到 1979 年的 280 亿元，1980 年再次增至 400 亿元（国家统计局综合统计司 1999）。中央领导注意到了这一趋势，开始将银行视为资金来源。
The intellectual justification for using banks was sound. Given that banks had an increasing amount of funds, SOEs that generated profit should rely on bank loans for working capital and investment funds and decrease their reliance on the state budget (Liu 2000a). In this manner, the state’s budgetary obligations decreased, while the increasing pool of saving was put to good use. From the outset, Chinese officials realized that banks should in theory have the autonomy to decide on loan recipients and to demand repayment from debtors. Even in 1979, the PBOC warned its officials that banks should not lend money “according to the wishes of higher level cadres” (State Council 1982c). Nonetheless, it also urged the banks to “rely on the Party at each level to fully realize the banks’ work” (State Council 1982c).
使用银行的理论理由是站得住脚的。鉴于银行掌握的资金日益增多，应当由产生利润的国有企业依靠银行贷款作为流动资金和投资资金，减少对国家预算的依赖（Liu 2000a）。通过这种方式，国家的预算性负担减轻，同时日益增长的储蓄池得以被有效利用。中国官员从一开始就认识到，理论上银行应具有决定贷款对象并向债务人催收还款的自主权。甚至在 1979 年，中国人民银行就曾提醒其官员，银行不应“按照上级干部的意愿放贷”（State Council 1982c）。尽管如此，中央仍敦促银行“依靠各级党组织充分贯彻银行的工作”（State Council 1982c）。
Deng’s generalist faction favored using the banks because they provided another source of funding for local governments to finance development. As we saw previously, Premier Zhao gave control of a major bank branch to the Guangdong provincial government to finance foreign currency needs. Turning banks into fiscal organs also allowed the local governments to circumvent the central bureaucracy, which tightly controlled the disbursement of central budgetary investment funds. As senior Party officials, patrons of a generalist faction could easily order bank managers to disburse loans to the pet projects of factional followers. For example, the Construction Bank, one of the Big Four banks in China, became a directly administered unit under the premier’s office rather than a part of the Ministry of Finance. Premier Zhao Ziyang treated it as a second treasury and regularly invited senior officials from the Construction Bank to policy meetings to “arrange” (anpai) the funding for various projects. 17 17 ^(17){ }^{17}
邓的小集团倾向于利用银行，因为银行为地方政府筹措发展资金提供了另一个来源。正如我们之前所见，赵总理曾将一家大银行的分行交由广东省政府管辖，以满足外汇需求。将银行变成财政机构还使地方政府能够规避对中央预算投资资金拨付实行严格控制的中央官僚体系。作为高级党内官员，属於通才派的恩主可以轻易下令银行经理向派系拥护者的宠爱项目发放贷款。例如，中国四大银行之一的建设银行成为由总理办公室直接管理的单位，而不属于财政部。赵紫阳总理把它视为第二个金库，并经常邀请建设银行的高级官员参加政策会议，以“安排”(anpai) 各种项目的资金。 17 17 ^(17){ }^{17}
The central bureaucrats under Chen were not averse to fiscalizing the banks either. As Liu Hongru, one of the State Council’s foremost experts on banking, wrote in 1980: “Now, the lending capital in banks is much larger than the state budget, and lending capital can turn over. Every time it turns over, lending capital doubles, which is to say that banks can use less money to do more” (Liu 2000 c ) 2000 c ) 2000c)2000 \mathrm{c}). In other words, the State Council could more readily meet the budgetary needs of the legion of SOEs by using banks to finance working capital needs.
陈云领导下的中央官僚们也不反对将银行财政化。正如国务院首席银行问题专家之一的刘鸿儒在 1980 年所写：“现在，银行的放贷资本远大于国家预算，而放贷资本可以周转。每周转一次，放贷资本就翻一番，也就是说银行可以用更少的钱做更多的事”（Liu 2000 c ) 2000 c ) 2000c)2000 \mathrm{c}) ）。换言之，国务院可以更容易地通过让银行为大量国有企业提供流动资金来满足其预算需求。
Furthermore, by using bank funds, the central government’s explicit deficit decreased, which improved the administrative merit of senior bureaucrats in charge of finance and investment. As Yao Yilin plainly put it in 1980, “When the budget is in trouble, banks must step in to help the budget” (Liu 2000e). Without jeopardizing the balanced budget, central bureaucrats could satisfy the capital demands of the various bureaucratic and political priorities. Finally, funding investment through loans reduced the monitoring costs of central bureaucrats who previously had no way of evaluating the effectiveness of various investment projects. As one State Council document put it, SOEs “no longer blindly compete for investment projects because they know they will have to repay (the loan) with interest” (State Council 1998c). In other words, providing loans to SOEs rather than budgetary grants could potentially increase their productivity by placing a harder budget constraint on them. Despite this initial hope, the lack of contract enforcement in China soon taught SOEs to default on their loans.
此外，通过动用银行资金，中央政府的显性赤字减少了，这提升了主管财政和投资的高级官僚的行政功绩。正如姚依林在 1980 年直言的那样，“当预算有困难时，银行必须出面帮助预算”（Liu 2000e）。在不危及预算平衡的情况下，中央官僚可以满足各种官僚和政治优先事项的资本需求。最后，通过贷款为投资提供资金降低了中央官僚的监管成本，此前他们无法评估各项投资项目的有效性。正如一份国务院文件所述，国有企业“不会再盲目争取投资项目，因为他们知道必须连本带利偿还（贷款）”（State Council 1998c）。换言之，向国有企业提供贷款而非预算拨款，可以通过对它们施加更严格的预算约束，潜在地提高其生产率。尽管最初抱有这种希望，但中国合同执行的缺失很快教会了国有企业对其贷款违约。
The actual process of the budget-to-loan (bogaidai) transformation began in February 1979. The PBOC held a meeting of its branch managers to convey the wishes of the central leadership. Still in the midst of the Deng-Chen alliance, the tone of the meeting reflected both Deng and Chen’s wishes. The most important policy announced at the meeting was the budget-to-loan transformation for SOE working capital. Previously, most of the SOE working capital had come directly from the state budget in accordance to the annual plan, but banks had provided emergency working capital loans in the middle of a fiscal year. This meeting called for experimenting with a complete transformation from budgetary allocation of working capital to bank loans (State Council 1982c).
预算拨款向贷款（bogaidai）转变的实际过程始于 1979 年 2 月。中国人民银行召开了各分行行长会议，传达中央领导的意图。在仍处于邓小平—陈云联盟影响之中的情况下，会议基调反映了邓和陈的意愿。会议宣布的最重要政策是对国有企业流动资金实行预算拨款向贷款的转变。此前，大多数国有企业的流动资金按照年度计划直接来自国家预算，但银行会在财政年度中期提供应急流动资金贷款。此次会议要求试点将流动资金的预算拨款全面改为银行贷款（国务院 1982c）。
The other major policy change, one clearly favored by Deng and Zhao, was banking decentralization. Rather than having the PBOC headquarters approve all the loans, the PBOC now set a credit ceiling for working capital but allowed local bank branches to decide where the money should go. The State Planning Commission, however, retained control over the allocation of fixed asset and technical innovation loans (State Council 1982c). Again, this mixture reflected a compromise between Chen and Deng. These experimental measures were implemented in selected locations throughout 1979 and 1980, including the financing of giant central projects, such as Bao Steel (Chen 2005).
另一个明显为邓小平和赵紫阳所支持的主要政策变化是银行下放权限。中央人民银行不再由总行审批所有贷款，而是为流动资金设定信贷上限，同时允许地方银行分支自行决定资金去向。然而，国家计划委员会仍然控制固定资产和技术创新贷款的分配（国务院 1982c）。同样，这种混合做法反映了陈云与邓小平之间的妥协。这些试验性措施在 1979 年和 1980 年在若干选定地区实施，包括对包钢等大型中央项目的融资（陈 2005）。
In June and August 1980, the Finance and Economic Leading Group headed by Zhao convened a series of meetings on the issue of budget-to-loan transformation. Despite the emerging division between Chen and Deng over centralization, Yao Yilin argued in these meetings that banks should fund more fixed asset investment projects, so long as they had short maturity periods and generated profit (Liu 2000e). Zhao likely endorsed Yao’s proposal because Deng had already called for expanding the role of banks at a meeting in late 1979 (Liu 2000a).
1980 年 6 月和 8 月，由赵主持的财经领导小组就拨款改贷问题召开了一系列会议。尽管陈与邓在中央集权问题上出现了分歧，姚依林在这些会议上辩称，只要期限短且有盈利，银行就应为更多固定资产投资项目提供资金（Liu 2000e）。赵很可能支持姚的建议，因为邓在 1979 年底的一次会议上已呼吁扩大银行的作用（Liu 2000a）。
The retrenchment program in late 1980 did not derail the budget-to-loan transformation experiment in the slightest. In fact, the planners made the transformation a part of the retrenchment program. In mid-November 1980, the
1980 年底的紧缩方案丝毫没有破坏拨款改贷的试验。事实上，规划者将这一改造纳入了紧缩方案。1980 年 11 月中旬，
State Council ordered all fixed asset investment to be handled through the China Construction Bank and that all profitable ventures be financed mainly by loans (State Council 1998c). At the December work conference in 1980, both Li Xiannian and Zhao Ziyang’s speeches called for a quantitative limit on the money supply but urged banks to continue providing working capital and investment funds to SOEs (Li 1982a; Zhao 1982a). The only major change was that the central government increased its monitoring and control over lending (The State Council 1982a).
国务院下令所有固定资产投资须通过中国建设银行办理，并且所有有盈利的企业应主要以贷款方式融资（国务院 1998c）。在 1980 年 12 月的工作会议上，李先念和赵紫阳的讲话都主张对货币供给实行数量限制，但同时敦促银行继续为国有企业提供流动资金和投资资金（李 1982a；赵 1982a）。唯一的重大变化是中央政府加强了对信贷的监控和控制（国务院 1982a）。
The retrenchment program, moreover, exacerbated the policy bias against the banks and in favor of the state budget. During the investment boom of 1980, many local firms took out loans that could not be repaid. Rather than enforcing loan repayment, a State Council directive issued in early 1981 specified that only profit generated through production originally financed by bank loans could be used toward loan repayment. Moreover, a company was first and foremost obligated to hand in the mandated amount of taxes to the central government and to pay workers’ wages before repaying banks (The State Council 1982a). As we saw earlier, central bureaucrats were fully aware that loans should be repaid, but their main concern was budgetary balance, not whether banks were solvent. Meanwhile, the State Council ordered investment projects to decrease the proportion financed by the state budget and to increase the proportion financed by bank loans (State Council 1982b). This directive was made with the full knowledge that firms were having trouble repaying banks.
此外，紧缩方案还加剧了对银行的不利政策倾向，而有利于国家预算。在 1980 年的投资热潮中，许多地方企业举借了无法偿还的贷款。国家没有强制催收贷款，反而在 1981 年初发布的一项国务院指示中规定，只有通过银行贷款所资助的生产所产生的利润才能用于偿还贷款。此外，公司首先应向中央缴纳规定数额的税款并支付职工工资，然后才偿还银行贷款（国务院 1982a）。正如我们前面所见，中央官僚完全清楚贷款应当偿还，但他们主要关心的是预算平衡，而不是银行是否有偿付能力。与此同时，国务院下令减少由国家预算承担的投资比例，增加由银行贷款承担的比例（国务院 1982b）。这一指示是在充分知晓企业难以偿还银行贷款的情况下作出的。
Far from trying to maintain the integrity of the banking system during the retrenchment, central planners were perfectly willing to use bank funds to achieve policy tasks, much as Zhao was willing to use bank funds for local development. In 1981, Yao ordered banks to provide sufficient working capital to light industries and to provide technical upgrade funds to SOEs chosen by the State Council (Yao 1982). He made no mention of the banks’ autonomy to choose the recipients of these loans. Setting a dangerous precedent for the future, Yao also ordered banks to supply funds to a group of SOEs in order to reduce triangular debt, or debt that the SOEs owed to each other (Yao 1982). Once again, this policy aimed at improving the position of the central budget. If SOEs were in the red because they did not receive payments from other SOEs, they were less able to hand “profit” up to the central coffer. With bank loans, SOEs could repay debt to each other, increasing the taxes they could pay to the central government. In an indirect way, banks were giving depositors’ money to the central government. Unfortunately for the Chinese depositors, this became a popular tactic to resolve budgetary problems in the coming decades.
中央计划者在紧缩期间不仅没有设法维护银行体系的完整，反而完全愿意动用银行资金来完成政策任务，就像赵某愿意动用银行资金用于地方发展一样。1981 年，姚下令银行为轻工业提供足够的营运资金，并为国务院选定的国有企业提供技术升级资金（Yao 1982）。他没有提到银行有自主选择这些贷款接受者的权利。姚还为未来树立了一个危险的先例，命令银行向一组国有企业提供资金以减少三角债，或国有企业之间的相互欠款（Yao 1982）。这项政策再次旨在改善中央预算的状况。如果国有企业因未收到其他国有企业的付款而亏损，它们就无法向中央上缴“利润”。通过银行贷款，国有企业可以相互偿还债务，从而提高它们向中央政府缴纳的税收。从间接的角度看，银行是在把存款人的钱交给中央政府。 不幸的是，对中国储户来说，这在接下来的几十年里成为一种解决预算问题的流行策略。

A Classic Inflationary Cycle: 1983-1986
经典的通货膨胀周期：1983–1986

The inflationary cycle that peaked in 1985 followed a classic pattern in which money supply directly increased inflationary expectation, and the decrease of money supply quickly dampened inflation. Behind the fluctuation in money supply was the oscillating political signal emanating from the center. The
以 1985 年达到顶峰的通货膨胀周期遵循一个经典模式：货币供应直接增加了通胀预期，而货币供应的减少又迅速抑制了通胀。货币供应波动的背后，是来自中央的摇摆不定的政治信号。

Figures shown are change in inflation and percentage change in state bank lending from four quarters ago, which smooth out the seasonality of the data.
图 14：图 6.1。季度贷款百分比变化与一年期通胀变化：1983–1986。来源：季度数据库。详见附录。图中所示为通胀变化和国家银行贷款较四个季度前的百分比变化，以平滑数据的季节性。
planners’ tight grip on the economy was first loosened when growth far exceeded the plan in 1982 and in 1983. Deng responded by sending a series of political signals to members of his factions in the provinces to increase investment and to take their own initiatives, which culminated in Deng’s trip to the south in 1984. The central bureaucrats’ resistance collapsed after the trip, and local officials quickly reacted by ordering local banks to increase lending. Exactly one year later, high inflation once again forced generalist factions to hand power to the technocrats to avoid an economic disaster.
当增长在 1982 年和 1983 年远远超过计划时，计划者对经济的紧密控制首次被放松。邓小平通过向省里的其派系成员发出一系列政治信号来回应，要求他们增加投资并采取自主行动，这一系列信号在 1984 年邓小平南巡达到了高潮。南巡之后中央官僚的抵抗瓦解，地方官员迅速采取行动，下令地方银行增加放贷。整整一年后，高通货膨胀再次迫使一般派系将权力交给技术官僚，以避免经济灾难。
In Figure 6.1, the circle-dotted line represents percentage change in lending from one year ago, and the triangle-dotted line represents changes in inflation rate from one year ago. As the figure shows, Deng’s trip to the South at the end of the first quarter in 1984, represented by the first vertical line, accelerated loan expansion in the latter two quarters in 1984, which in turn led to inflation rates some io percent higher than in the previous year by the second quarter of 1985. Deng’s effort was greatly augmented by his two competing protégés, each wanting to garner as much local support as possible in preparation for the succession.
