The active decentralization of the generalists in turn prompted the central bureaucrats to clamor for more central control, which culminated in the Meeting for Responsible Cadres at the Provinces. As with the meeting in late 1980, this meeting also sent a clear signal of centralization to local officials and triggered the implementation of a series of centralization policies for finance
在图 6.1 中，圆点线表示较上一年同期贷款的百分比变动，三角点线表示较上一年同期的通货膨胀率变动。如图所示，1984 年第一季度末邓小平的南巡（由第一条竖线表示）加速了 1984 年后两个季度的贷款扩张，进而导致到 1985 年第二季度通货膨胀率比上一年同期高出约 10 个百分点。邓的此番努力被他的两位竞争性门徒大大放大，二者都希望在为接班做准备时尽可能争取更多地方支持。泛化派的积极下放反过来促使中央官僚呼吁更多中央控制，最终在省级主要负责干部会议上达到高潮。与 1980 年底的会议一样，此次会议也向地方官员发出了中央集权的明确信号，并触发了一系列中央对金融的集权政策的实施
and investment. As seen in Figure 6.1, this meeting, represented by the second vertical line, was successful in slowing the growth of lending and in dampening inflation.
和投资。如图 6.1 所示，由第二条竖线表示的这次会议有效地减缓了贷款增长并抑制了通货膨胀。
In addition to this basic pattern, this period also saw the rapid development of the budget-to-loan transformation, which made banks officially responsible for financing much of state investment. This trend persisted even after the onset of retrenchment and the discovery of a large pool of nonperforming loans, demonstrating the centralizers’ willingness to take advantage of the banking system.
除了这一基本模式外，这一时期还出现了预算向贷款转化的快速发展，使得银行在官方层面上负责为大部分国家投资提供融资。即使在紧缩开始并发现大量不良贷款之后，这一趋势仍持续存在，显示出中央集权者愿意利用银行体系的意图。

From Growth to Decentralization and the Impetus for Inflation
从增长到分权及通货膨胀的推动因素

After Deng’s failed attempt to unlock the planners’ grip on the economy in 1981, he remained relatively subdued. In various speeches throughout 1982, Deng insisted on the course of the reform, but he did not press for further decentralization (Deng 1982c; 1982d). In a meeting with the State Planning Commission (SPC) leadership at the end of 1982, Deng said that the country should aim at doubling output twice in twenty years, a conservative pace decided at the Twelfth Party Congress in September (Deng 1993d; Fewsmith 1994). At most, Deng pressed the SPC to do its best to ensure “doubling twice” by the end of the century (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2004: 859). The newly installed Premier Zhao likewise did not challenge Chen’s policies in this period and called for a modest 4 to 5 percent growth rate in a mid-1982 meeting (Zhao 1982b: 1562).
在邓小平 1981 年试图解除计划者对经济控制但失败之后，他保持了相对低调。1982 年间的多次讲话中，邓坚持改革路线，但并未推动进一步的分权（Deng 1982c；1982d）。在 1982 年底与国家计划委员会（SPC）领导层的会晤中，邓表示国家应以二十年内实现产出翻两番为目标，这是在九月的十二大上决定的一个保守进度（Deng 1993d；Fewsmith 1994）。在多大程度上，邓最多也只是督促 SPC 尽最大努力确保在世纪末实现“翻两番”（中国共产党中央委员会文件研究中心 2004：859）。新任总理赵（Zhao）在此期间同样没有挑战陈的政策，并在 1982 年中一次会议中提出一个温和的 4%至 5%的增长率目标（Zhao 1982b：1562）。
The tide began to turn at the beginning of 1983 when the growth statistics from 1982 became available. Rather than the 4 percent growth mandated by the plan, growth registered at 8 percent. Immediately on seeing the statistics, Deng convened a meeting with “responsible cadres” from the SPC, the State Economic Commission, and the Ministry of Agriculture, three of the most important agencies in the central bureaucracy. Deng began by asking the bureaucrats why growth registered twice as high as the planned target, suggesting that they had been overly pessimistic about the economy. He then ordered the SPC to increase the planned growth rate for 1983 (Deng 1993c: 22). At this point, however, Deng was not yet ready to take economic power out of the hands of the central bureaucracy, presumably because he was afraid that another inflationary crisis would occur. At the meeting, he told the planners that he remembered the “very deep lessons of blind advance” (Deng 1993c: 22). 18 18 ^(18){ }^{18}
局势在 1983 年初开始转向，当时 1982 年的增长统计数据披露出来。与计划规定的 4%的增长不同，实际增长为 8%。统计数据一出，邓小平立刻召集了来自国家计委、国家经济委员会和农业部的“负责干部”开会，这三家是中央官僚体系中最重要的机构之一。邓首先问这些官员为什么增长率是计划目标的两倍，暗示他们对经济过于悲观。然后他命令国家计委提高 1983 年的计划增长率（Deng 1993c: 22）。不过在这一点上，邓还不准备把经济权力从中央官僚手中夺走，可能是因为他担心会再次发生通货膨胀危机。在会议上，他告诉计划者他记得“盲目推进的深刻教训”（Deng 1993c: 22）。 18 18 ^(18){ }^{18}
Deng’s talk with the planners loosened the bureaucrats’ hold on the economy as members of the generalist faction signaled to local officials the political feasibility of local growth initiatives. Just days after Deng’s talk in early 1983, Gu
邓小平与规划人员的谈话削弱了官僚对经济的控制，因为通才派成员向地方官员示意地方发展举措在政治上是可行的。就在邓小平 1983 年初谈话几天后，顾
Mu, the head of the SEZ Office of the State Council, told cadres at the Hainan SEZ in Guangdong that “in the past few years, there was economic adjustment, but now we can put the acceleration of Hainan’s development on the agenda” (Gu 1986). The timing of Gu’s comment suggests a direct link between Deng’s signal about higher growth and renewed optimism for Hainan’s development. In February, Zhao got the planners to approve a set of comprehensive reform measures for Chongqing, a major city in Sichuan Province, where Zhao had served as Party secretary (Fewsmith 1994: 126). Again, Deng’s January meeting was probably a decisive factor in this decision because Sichuan leaders and Zhao had been lobbying the planners for this since 1982.
国务院经济特区办公室主任穆在广东海南经济特区对干部说：“过去几年有经济调整，但现在我们可以把加快海南发展提上议程”（Gu 1986）。Gu 的评论时机表明邓关于更高增长的暗示与对海南发展重燃乐观之间存在直接联系。二月，赵使规划部门批准了一套针对重庆的综合改革措施——重庆是四川省的一个重要城市，赵曾在那里担任党委书记（Fewsmith 1994：126）。同样，邓一月的会晤很可能是这一决定的决定性因素，因为四川领导人和赵自 1982 年以来一直在向规划部门游说此事。
Hu Yaobang, the Party Secretary General and Deng’s designated successor, responded to Deng’s signal even more strongly. In January 1983, Hu received a note from Deng urging him to look into Guangdong’s complaint of overregulation by the central ministries (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2004: 879). He immediately accused central ministries of “using the excuse of efficiency to suppress growth” and demanded higher growth (Deng 2005: 256). In February, Hu further took an inspection trip to Guangdong and visited the SEZs. In his conversation with local cadres, Hu was emboldened by Deng’s note to criticize the “birdcage” - Chen Yun’s theory of how the economy should be administered - and the central bureaucracy for administering “ropes and sticks” that stifled the local government (Hu 1986b). He also castigated the central bureaucracy and Gan Ziyu, the vice chairman of the SPC who accompanied Hu, in front of local officials: “Comrade Gan Ziyu, please say something to the central ministries. It’s fine that they do not give money, but please do not give ropes and sticks … This isn’t such a high demand, is it?” (Hu 1986b). Local officials who witnessed Hu’s theatrics likely came to the conclusion that the bureaucracy’s dominance over the economy was slipping.
胡耀邦，党总书记且为邓指定的接班人，对邓的信号反应更加强烈。1983 年 1 月，胡收到邓的一张便条，敦促他调查广东关于中央各部委过度管制的投诉（中共中央文件研究室 2004：879）。他立即指责中央各部委“以效率为名压制增长”，并要求更高的增长（邓 2005：256）。2 月，胡又赴广东进行视察，并考察了经济特区。在与地方干部的谈话中，胡受邓便条鼓舞，批评了“鸟笼”——陈云关于经济应如何管理的理论——以及中央官僚机关通过实施“绳子和棍子”来扼杀地方政府（胡 1986b）。他还在地方官员面前斥责中央官僚和陪同胡的最高人民法院副院长甘自愚：“甘自愚同志，请向中央各部委说几句。他们不给钱可以，但请不要给绳子和棍子……这要求也不是很高，是吧？”（胡 1986b）。目睹了胡的戏剧性表演的地方官员很可能得出结论：官僚机构对经济的主导地位正在减弱。
Deng increased the pressure on the planners by going on an inspection trip to the Yangtze River Delta himself in February 1983. On this trip, Deng urged coastal officials to compete with each other to increase growth. At a dinner meeting with Zhejiang provincial leaders, Deng in effect forced a high-pace growth target on the province: “You know, between 1977 and 1982, Jiangsu doubled its output, so according to this pace, Jiangsu will have doubled its economy twice by 1988. Can Zhejiang realize this goal as well?” (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2004: 888) Clearly, the answer would be yes. On his return, he had another talk with several Standing Committee members and told them that all the provinces should set their own plans (Deng 1993e). This was a shocking suggestion that would have greatly diminished the center’s power and increased provincial discretion over investment and lending.
1983 年 2 月，邓亲自到长江三角洲视察，加大了对计划者的压力。在这次视察中，邓敦促沿海官员相互竞争以提高增长。在与浙江省领导的晚宴会上，邓实际上向该省强加了一个高速增长目标：“你们知道，1977 年到 1982 年，江苏的产出翻了一番，照这样的速度，江苏到 1988 年将实现再翻一番。浙江能实现这个目标吗？”（中共中央文献研究室 2004：888）显然，答案会是肯定的。回京后，他又与几位常委谈话，告诉他们所有省份都应该制定自己的计划（邓 1993e）。这一建议令人震惊，它将大大削弱中央的权力并增加省级在投资和放贷方面的自主权。
Chen Yun, who had been reminiscing about historical issues during the first two months of 1983, immediately sprang into action to put a stop to Deng’s audacious suggestion. 19 19 ^(19){ }^{19} After an emergency meeting with his longtime
陈云在 1983 年前两个月一直在回顾历史问题，随即采取行动制止了邓的大胆建议。 19 19 ^(19){ }^{19} 在与他的长期盟友召开的紧急会议之后
colleague in the central bureaucracy Li Xiannian, Chen Yun decided to go after Hu Yaobang, even though Hu’s action was prompted by Deng. Originally, Chen wanted to convene a small meeting to criticize Hu for intervening in State Council affairs and for violating the “adjustment, reform, rectification, and improvement” line. However, Deng worried that such a dressing down might cause Hu to tender his resignation: “what if he quits?” (Deng 2005: 256) A small meeting was nonetheless convened to discuss Hu’s problems, but Chen Yun boycotted the meeting since Deng did not require Hu’s attendance of the meeting (Deng 2005: 256). Two days after the small meeting, a joint meeting of the Standing Committee of the Politburo and the Central Party Secretariat, the two most powerful organs in the Party, was convened to discuss economic issues. In his remarks, Chen reiterated the correctness of the economic retrenchment and criticized Deng’s suggestion of giving planning power to the localities because “the State Planning Commission needs to concentrate capital from the ministries and localities, or it would lack the means to accomplish great things (ganbucheng dashi)” (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000).
中共中央机构同僚李先念、陈云决定追究胡耀邦责任，尽管胡的行动是由邓促成的。起初，陈想召开小范围会议批评胡干预国务院事务并违反“调整、改革、整顿、提高”的路线。然而，邓担心这样的严厉斥责可能导致胡递交辞呈：“如果他辞职怎么办？”（邓 2005：256）尽管如此，还是召开了小范围会议讨论胡的问题，但因邓并未要求胡出席该会，陈云便抵制了会议（邓 2005：256）。在小范围会议两天后，召开了由政治局常务委员会与中央党务秘书处组成的联合会议——党内最有权势的两个机构——以讨论经济问题。 在他的讲话中，陈重申了经济收缩政策的正确性，并批评邓建议将计划权下放给地方，认为“国家计划委员会需要从各部委和地方集中资金，否则就缺乏完成大事（ganbucheng dashi）的手段”（中共党史资料研究中心 2000）。
Chen further made an important maneuver against Deng’s faction. First, he castigated Hu Yaobang and the Secretariat for getting too involved in finance and economic work: “Now you spend too little time listening to the relevant ministries, and spend 70 to 80 percent of your time talking…[You] must not be so simple-minded” (Li 2005: 800). He then proposed a clear rule to delegate economic policy implementation to the Central Finance and Economic Leading Group (CFELG), where he had a sizable presence. Beyond criticizing Hu for being “simple-minded,” the joint meeting approved Chen’s proposal that the CFELG henceforth served as the sole organ for economic policy coordination upon Politburo Standing Committee approval of a policy, thus setting the pattern for economic policy making for years to come (Deng 2005: 258). This institutional change greatly clarified the economic policy process and substantially weakened the generalists’ influence in economic policy making. After the meeting, Chen Yun wanted to firm up his victory by disseminating the speeches at the meeting to junior officials in order to signal the continuation of retrenchment. Deng, however, vetoed the proposal to disseminate and sealed the records of that meeting (Deng 2005: 258; Li 2005: 802). Given Chen’s threat to directly criticize Hu Yaobang, Deng’s designated successor, Deng backed down from his decentralization drive. Nonetheless, he did not want words of his defeat spread too widely because he knew that favorable economic conditions would soon allow him to try again.
陈进一步对邓派采取了重要的策略。首先，他谴责胡耀邦和秘书处过多介入金融和经济工作：“现在你们听相关部委的时间太少，讲话占了 70%到 80%……你们不能那么简单”（李，2005：800）。然后他提出了一条明确规则，把经济政策执行下放给中央财经领导小组（CFELG），他在该小组中占有相当份额。除了批评胡“简单”之外，联席会议还批准了陈的建议，规定自此在政治局常委批准一项政策后，中央财经领导小组应作为经济政策协调的唯一机构，从而为今后数年的经济决策模式奠定了基础（邓，2005：258）。这一体制变革大大理清了经济政策制定的流程，并实质性削弱了泛能型领导人在经济决策中的影响力。会后，陈云为了巩固胜利，打算将会上的讲话传达给基层官员，以示收缩政策的延续。 然而，邓否决了那项传播提议并封存了那次会议的记录（Deng 2005: 258；Li 2005: 802）。鉴于陈直接批评胡耀邦——邓指定的接班人——的威胁，邓放弃了他的分权推动。 尽管如此，他不希望关于他失败的言论被广泛传播，因为他知道有利的经济条件很快会使他再次尝试成为可能。
Despite behind-the-scene maneuvering by Deng’s faction, central restrictions on investment funds remained in place. In July 1983, when the newly appointed Party secretary of Guangdong, Ren Zhongyi, asked Zhao for more central subsidies to finance construction projects, Zhao’s reply clearly indicated the persistence of central control: "asking the province to shoulder key-point projects is
尽管邓的派系在幕后进行操纵，中央对投资基金的限制仍然存在。1983 年 7 月，当新任广东省委书记任仲夷向赵要求更多中央补贴以资助建设项目时，赵的回复清楚地表明了中央控制的持续存在：“让省里承担重点项目是
problematic, but I cannot over-turn the policy on my own. The SPC must first settle the bill with you" (Zhao 1986a: 70). Similarly, when Guangdong vice governor Yang Deyuan asked Zhao for more control over foreign exchange and the banking system, Zhao told him that the retrenchment would remain in place next year and that he should “make psychological preparation for it” (Zhao 1986b: 554). Again, these episodes reveal that despite his sympathy, Zhao was relatively powerless to overturn the existing policies. Moreover, these encounters demonstrate that Zhao’s own preference for more investment and autonomy for his favorite provinces did not alter after he had become premier.
有问题，但我不能单方面推翻这个政策。首先必须由最高人民法院与你结算账目”（赵 1986a: 70）。同样，当广东省副省长杨德元要求赵对外汇和银行系统给予更多控制时，赵告诉他，明年紧缩措施仍将继续，他应该“为此做好心理准备”（赵 1986b: 554）。这些例子再次表明，尽管赵表示同情，但他相对无力推翻现有政策。此外，这些交涉表明，赵对他偏爱的省份给予更多投资和更大自主权的偏好，在他成为总理之后并未改变。
Chen Yun’s maneuvers in 1983 only gave him a temporary reprieve. In early 1984, the economic figures from 1983 showed continual economic vigor and a thirst for capital from the grassroots level. In the last two quarters of 1983, industrial output registered a healthy 12 percent growth from the previous year, while SOE losses fell to historical lows (Fewsmith 1994: 127; State Statistical Bureau 1985). Meanwhile, the output of township and village enterprises grew by an astonishing 19 percent, complemented by a bumper harvest (Fewsmith 1994: 127). The good news on the economic front undoubtedly increased the cries for funds from the local governments, and gave Deng further political leverage to unlock the central bureaucracy’s grip on the economy.
陈云在 1983 年的应对只是给他带来短暂的缓解。1984 年初，1983 年的经济数据表明经济持续旺盛，基层对资本的需求强烈。1983 年最后两个季度，工业产出较上年增长了健康的 12%，国有企业亏损降至历史低点（Fewsmith 1994: 127；国家统计局 1985）。与此同时，乡镇企业产出惊人地增长了 19%，再加上丰收年（Fewsmith 1994: 127）。经济方面的好消息无疑增加了地方政府对资金的呼声，也进一步增强了邓对解开中央官僚对经济控制的政治筹码。
At the end of January 1984, Deng again took a trip to the prosperous provinces of Guangdong, Fujian, and Shanghai, where he exhorted local officials to “speed up growth and relax regulation a bit” (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2004: 960). On his return, Deng called a meeting with Hu Yaobang, Zhao Ziyang, Wan Li, Yang Shangkun, Hu Qili, and Yao Yilin, a largely friendly audience. Yao was the only representative from the planners to hear Deng’s latest instructions. Deng was impressed with Shenzhen’s progress and wanted to give investment approval power for projects below U.S. $ 5 $ 5 $5\$ 5 million to all the special economic zones. Also, Deng wanted to expand the SEZ experiment to several other coastal cities, including Qingdao and Dalian (Deng 1998a). Yao, who was in charge of investment through the State Planning Commission, doubtless saw Deng’s instruction as the latest political attack against central authority. Two weeks after Deng’s talk, Chen held an urgent meeting with Yao Yilin, Song Ping, and senior Planning Commission cadres to discuss the implications of Deng’s latest policy demands and possible responses (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000: 351). With the economy thriving and with relatively low inflation, however, Chen realized that he was out of cards to play. He left Beijing for Hangzhou four days later. 20 20 ^(20){ }^{20}
1984 年 1 月底，邓小平再次赴广东、福建和上海等繁荣省市考察，他在当地敦促官员“加快增长，放松一些监管”（中共中央信息研究中心 2004：960）。回京后，邓召集胡耀邦、赵紫阳、万里、杨尚昆、胡启立和姚依林开会，出席者总体上对他态度友好。姚依林是来自计划部门的唯一一位代表，听取了邓最新的指示。邓对深圳的进展印象深刻，想把对低于美国 $ 5 $ 5 $5\$ 5 百万美元项目的投资审批权下放给所有经济特区。此外，邓还希望将特区试验扩大到包括青岛和大连在内的其他沿海城市（Deng 1998a）。负责通过国家计划委员会审批投资的姚依林，无疑将邓的指示视为又一次针对中央权威的政治冲击。在邓讲话两周后，陈（陈云/陈总书记等，原文若有具体指代请按上下文确定）与姚依林、宋平及计划委员会高级干部召开紧急会议，讨论邓最新政策要求的影响及可能的应对措施（中共中央信息研究中心 2000：351）。 然而，随着经济繁荣且通货膨胀相对较低，陈意识到自己已无牌可打。四天后他离开北京前往杭州。 20 20 ^(20){ }^{20}
Without Chen’s opposition, Deng’s demand for more investment approval power at the local level and for more SEZs sent a ripple to both the local
没有了陈的反对，邓对在地方层面获得更多投资审批权和设立更多经济特区的要求在地方政府和中央官僚体系都掀起了涟漪。
government and the central bureaucracy. Days after Deng’s meeting in early 1984, Hu Yaobang went on his own inspection trip to Guangdong and doled out generous largesse to the Guangdong government. Most notably, Hu allowed overseas Chinese to take out loans from the Bank of China if the loans went toward local development (Hu 1986a). He also went to the southwestern provinces to encourage them to band together toward a common developmental strategy (Li 2005: 89i).
在 1984 年初邓会晤后数日，胡耀邦独自赴广东视察，并向广东政府大方拨付资金。最引人注目的是，胡允许海外华人向中国银行贷款，前提是贷款用于地方发展（Hu 1986a）。他还前往西南各省，鼓励它们结成联盟，朝共同的发展策略努力（Li 2005: 89i）。
In late April 1984, Deng’s call for decentralization was formalized at the Meeting for Some Coastal Cities, which was convened jointly by the State Council and the Central Committee. Besides approving special policies for fourteen more coastal cities, the meeting also had a strong agenda to devolve investment and lending power to the localities. The beginning of the meeting summary states unambiguously that “just as Comrade Deng Xiaoping pointed out, we must not contract (shou), but should continue to let go (fang)” (CCP Central Committee and State Council 1998). 21 21 ^(21){ }^{21} In the CCP’s political jargon, it was nothing short of a carte blanche to the localities to take economic policies and local growth into their own hands. According to Xue Muqiao, a veteran central bureaucrat, the summer of 1984 saw many local officials calling for accelerated growth. Rather than the official goal of doubling the economy twice by the end of the century, local officials in many places called for “doubling three times in twenty years” or “doubling every five years” (Xue 1996: 408).
1984 年 4 月底，邓的小幅下放呼吁在国务院与中央委员会联合召开的沿海若干城市会议上正式化。除了批准对另外十四个沿海城市的特殊政策外，会议议程还着重将投资和贷款权下放到地方。会议摘要开头明确指出：“正如邓小平同志所指出的，我们不应收而应继续放”（中共中央、国务院 1998）。在中共的政治术语中，这无异于赋予地方一张空白支票，让地方自行掌握经济政策和地方增长。根据老中枢官僚薛暮桥的说法，1984 年夏天许多地方官员都呼吁加快增长。与官方目标——在本世纪末实现经济翻两番——不同，许多地方官员主张“二十年翻三番”或“每五年翻一番”（薛 1996：408）。
The meeting also specified several investment policies to benefit these fourteen cities. For one, all of them received the authority to approve foreign exchange investment projects below U.S. $ 5 $ 5 $5\$ 5 million, with Tianjin and Shanghai receiving the authority to approve projects below U.S. $ 30 $ 30 $30\$ 30 million. 22 22 ^(22){ }^{22} The meeting also ratified a resolution to allow coastal cities to spend billions of U.S. dollars “in the next several years.” The meeting further decreed that the Bank of China, which specialized in foreign exchange loans, would provide “all the necessary foreign exchange” to these investment projects. Finally, since these special zones required new infrastructure, the state would allow the local government to issue bonds and would provide them with preferential loans to finance the construction (CCP Central Committee and State Council 1998). According to one of Hu’s advisors, Chen Yun had anticipated the political tone of the April meeting and boycotted it. To show his displeasure, he also pledged that he would never visit an SEZ (Ruan 1995).
会议还指定了若干旨在惠及这十四个城市的投资政策。首先，所有这些城市都获得了批准低于美国 $ 5 $ 5 $5\$ 5 百万的外汇投资项目的权限，天津和上海获得了批准低于美国 $ 30 $ 30 $30\$ 30 百万项目的权限。 22 22 ^(22){ }^{22} 会议还通过了一项决议，允许沿海城市在“未来若干年”内支出数十亿美元。会议进一步裁定，擅长外汇贷款的中国银行将为这些投资项目提供“所有必要的外汇”。最后，鉴于这些特殊区域需要新的基础设施，国家将允许地方政府发行债券，并为其提供优惠贷款以资助建设（中共中央、国务院 1998）。据胡的一位顾问陈云称，陈云预料到四月会议的政治基调并弃权不参加。为了表示不满，他还承诺永不访问任何一个经济特区（阮 1995）。
Chen’s sentiment was understandable because these new policies greatly weakened the center’s ability to control the economy. It was one thing when special policies only applied to a few outposts scattered in Guangdong and
陈的感受是可以理解的，因为这些新政策大大削弱了中央对经济的控制能力。当特殊政策只适用于零散分布在广东和
Fujian. It was another matter when the local governments in major cities all along the prosperous coast could make their own decisions about investment and lending. In compliance with the decisions made at the meeting, the central bureaucracy was compelled to enact several decentralization measures. The State Planning Commission (SPC), for example, enacted new regulations that allowed localities to approve investment projects less than 30 million yuan, up from the previous limit of 10 million. The SPC also allowed localities to approve construction projects that did not use state funding, retaining only the authority to set the overall amount of such extrabudgetary investment at the beginning of the year (State Council 1998b).
福建的几个前哨时，情况还不一样；但当沿海繁荣地区的各大城市地方政府都可以自行决定投资和放贷时，情况就完全不同了。按照会议决定，中央官僚机构被迫出台若干分权措施。例如，国家计委（SPC）制定了新规定，允许地方批准不超过 3000 万元的投资项目，而此前的上限为 1000 万元。国家计委还允许地方批准不使用国家资金的建设项目，仅保留在年初设定此类预算外投资总体规模的权限（国务院 1998b）。
Meanwhile, Shenzhen acquired additional authority with regard to monetary policy. An experimental State Council policy enacted in May 1984 made the PBOC branch in Shenzhen a “local central bank (bendi de zhongyang yinhang)” (State Council 1986). According this policy, the PBOC branch in Shenzhen secured the authority to adjust the loan ceiling within a certain bound, control foreign currency transactions, approve local bond issuance, and monitor local financial institutions (State Council 1986). As the local PBOC was under the direct leadership of the local government, the local leadership obtained a powerful economic lever with which to stimulate growth.
与此同时，深圳在货币政策方面获得了更多权限。1984 年 5 月实施的一项国务院试行政策将人民银行深圳分行确定为“本地的中央银行（bendi de zhongyang yinhang）”（国务院 1986）。根据该政策，人民银行深圳分行获得了在一定范围内调整贷款上限、控制外汇交易、批准地方债券发行以及监管地方金融机构的权限（国务院 1986）。由于地方人民银行直接受地方政府领导，地方领导人因此获得了一个强有力的经济杠杆以刺激增长。
As Figure 6.1 shows, the political ripple from Deng’s southern tour and from the April meeting in 1984 unleashed local enthusiasm to increase investment and lending. The third quarter and especially the fourth quarter in 1984 saw a rapid acceleration in lending. This impetus was further fueled by a PBOC plan to peg the loan-to-deposit ratio in 1985 to the year-end level in 1984, which set off a frenzy of lending during the fourth quarter as banks tried to maximize their 1985 loan-to-deposit ratios (Xue 1996: 403). Rather than being an independent causal factor, the plan itself was a part of the drive to devolve more lending authority to the local branches of the state banks. As in 1980, the political enthusiasm generated inflationary pressure, giving the central planners the opportunity to reassert power.
如图 6.1 所示，邓小平南巡和 1984 年 4 月会议引发的政治涟漪释放了地方增加投资和放贷的热情。1984 年第三季度，尤其是第四季度，放贷迅速加速。这一势头又因中国人民银行计划将 1985 年的贷款存款比率挂钩到 1984 年年末水平而被进一步助长，该计划在第四季度引发了放贷狂潮，银行试图最大化它们 1985 年的贷款存款比率（Xue 1996: 403）。这一计划本身并非独立的因果因素，而是将更多放贷权限下放到国有银行地方分支的驱动的一部分。与 1980 年一样，政治热情产生了通货膨胀压力，给中央计划者重新确立权力提供了机会。

Inflation and Retrenchment
通货膨胀与紧缩

At the end of 1984, currency in circulation increased by over 26 billion yuan, much higher than the planned increase of 13 billion yuan (Xue 1996: 403). At the same time, inflation climbed to almost double-digit territory. Despite these alarming statistics, the New Year edition of the People’s Daily, the official Party newspaper, rallied for higher growth (Fewsmith 1994: 152). With the economic situation on their side, however, Chen Yun and his associates soon launched another dual-track counterattack against decentralization policies. On the first track, the central bureaucracy once again held a series of meetings with local leaders to send a clear signal of retrenchment. On the second track, Chen launched another round of smuggling investigations against the special economic zones to keep Deng politically unbalanced. If Chen and his associates did not have a political stake in centralizing or the political power to regain control, inflation would have continued its ascent.
1984 年底，流通中的货币增加了超过 260 亿元，远高于计划的 130 亿元增幅（Xue 1996: 403）。与此同时，通货膨胀率攀升至近两位数。尽管这些统计数据令人警觉，但作为官方党的报纸，《人民日报》新年版仍鼓吹更高的增长（Fewsmith 1994: 152）。然而，凭借对经济形势的有利判断，陈云及其同僚很快又发起了针对分权政策的“双轨反击”。在第一条轨道上，中央官僚机构再次与地方领导召开了一系列会议，发出收缩的明确信号。在第二条轨道上，陈云对经济特区发起了新一轮走私调查，以在政治上冲击邓小平的平衡。如果陈云及其同僚既没有在中央集权上有政治利害关系，也没有重新掌控的政治权力，通货膨胀就会继续上升。
As news of high deficit, rapid monetary expansion, dwindling foreign exchange reserve and increasing inflation flooded into the central government. The planners sprang into action. First, Chen Yun convened a private meeting with Li Xiannian and Yao Yilin to plan their strategy. Second, the central bureaucrats convened a report meeting on the economy, attended by Deng, Zhao, Yao, and Hu Qili, a core member of Hu Yaobang’s faction. After hearing the bad news, Deng sensed the planners’ plot to bring about another austerity period and attempted to forestall it:
随着赤字扩大、货币迅速扩张、外汇储备减少和通货膨胀加剧的消息传入中央政府，计划者们立即采取行动。首先，陈云与李先念和姚依林举行了私下会晤，策划他们的策略。其次，中央官僚召开了一次经济汇报会，出席者有邓小平、赵、姚和作为胡耀邦派系核心成员的胡启立。在听到坏消息后，邓察觉到计划者们图谋发动又一轮紧缩，并试图加以阻止：
In reform, we must take one step and evaluate the situation (before taking another step), but we must not lose the opportunity. It would be a shame to lose the opportunity. Although it is a risk to issue so much currency and to lose so much foreign exchange, if we look at it another way, our economic situation is on the whole stable and can support this trial. (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2004: 1027)
在改革中，我们要踏一步、看一下，但不能失去时机。失去时机是遗憾的。发行这么多货币、失去这么多外汇确实有风险，但换一个角度看，我们的经济情况总体稳定，可以支持这一试验。 (中共中央文献研究室 2004: 1027)
Shortly after this meeting, Deng left for yet another inspection trip of Jiangsu, Shanghai, and Guangdong, during which he rallied opposition to centralization with the help of senior PLA generals, including Yu Qiuli, Wang Zhen, and Xu Xiangqian (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2004: 1030). Meanwhile, the planners convened the Conference for Responsible Comrades from the Provinces and Major Cities in February 1985, the first of several conferences convened that year to convey retrenchment policies to local officials. Because of Deng’s opposition, the February Conference did not deliver the unambiguous message of centralization that Chen Yun had desired. Zhao’s remarks at the conference communicated considerable equivocation: “Where we should contract, we will contract; where we need to support, we will do our best to support” (Chen 1998d). Chen Yun was annoyed with Zhao’s ambiguity in wanting to “support” local investment. In Chen’s remarks at a Politburo meeting right after the February Conference, he repeated Zhao’s remarks and added that “I think the latter phrase can be erased. The meaning of the first phrase is enough” (Chen 1998d). The dispute, however, was not settled then.
在这次会晤后不久，邓又赴江苏、上海和广东进行另一轮视察，在此期间他在包括于奇禄、王震和徐向前在内的高级 PLA 将领的帮助下，联合反对集权（中共中央文献研究室 2004：1030）。与此同时，策划者于 1985 年 2 月召开了省市负责同志会议，这是当年为向地方官员传达收缩政策而召开的几次会议中的第一次。由于邓的反对，2 月的会议并未传达出陈云所期望的那种明确的集权信息。赵在会上所作的讲话显示出相当的模棱两可：“该收的要收，该扶的尽量扶”（陈 1998d）。陈云对赵在“扶持”地方投资上的含糊其词感到恼火。在 2 月会议之后的一个政治局会议上，陈云重复了赵的话并补充说“我看后一句可以去掉，前一句的意思就够了”（陈 1998d）。 然而，这场争论，当时尚未解决。
Following the February Conference in 1985, different parts of the government sent conflicting signals about retrenchment to local officials. As a senior bureaucrat at the time observed, “Because understanding was not unified and the interests of the relevant parties conflicted, it was difficult to implement some measures immediately” (Xue 1996:405). Furthermore, because after 1984 localities obtained much more autonomy to approve investment and had much more authority over local bank branches, even shutting off central budgetary grants to investment projects did not necessarily reduce money supply (Xue 1996: 407). As a result, although inflationary pressure did not accelerate, it remained at a relatively high level during the first two quarters of 1985. At the same time, backtracking on decentralization would have greatly reduced the pace of growth in regions headed by followers of Deng, Hu, and Zhao. Thus, Deng conveyed continuing support for high growth to local officials at a March 1985 conference: “If there are things constraining you, then I will help you think of some ways to liberate them” (Deng 1998d). Because of Deng’s
在 1985 年 2 月会议之后，政府不同部门向地方官员传递了关于紧缩的相互矛盾的信号。正如当时一位高级官僚所观察到的：“由于认识不统一、有关方面的利益相冲突，某些措施很难立刻贯彻实施”（Xue 1996:405）。此外，由于 1984 年后地方在审批投资方面获得了更多自主权，并且对地方银行分支机构拥有更大权限，即便中央停止对投资项目的预算拨款也不一定能减少货币供应（Xue 1996:407）。因此，尽管通货膨胀压力没有加速，但在 1985 年前两个季度仍维持在相对较高的水平。与此同时，回撤分权会大幅减缓由邓、胡和赵的追随者主政地区的增长速度。因此，邓在 1985 年 3 月的一次会议上向地方官员表示继续支持高速增长：“如果有事情约束了你们，我就替你们想些办法把它放开来”（Deng 1998d）。由于邓的
tolerant attitude, the patrons of various generalist factions continued to intervene in the banking sector to increase lending in the provinces. When PBOC governor Chen Muhua reported to Yao Yilin the various special requests for funds from the generalist factions in the spring of 1985, Yao was visibly annoyed: “You can stop (the report); just give what the bank can give” (Jin 1995).
包容的态度下，各类通才派系的后台继续干预银行业，推动各省增加放贷。1985 年春，当 PBOC 行长陈慕华向姚依林报告通才派系对资金的各种特殊请求时，姚明显恼火：“你可以停（报告）；就给银行能给的就行”（Jin 1995）。
The ineffectiveness of the February conference to reduce inflationary pressure compelled Vice Premier Yao Yilin to make a personal trip to Guangdong and Fujian in an attempt to force local officials to toe the line. In his remarks to Guangdong cadres, Yao castigated local cadres for expanding money supply too rapidly, spending too much foreign exchange, and not paying banks back in a timely manner (Yao 1986b). Unlike Zhao, Yao’s main concern was local compliance, not the special requests of the local officials.
二月会议未能有效缓解通胀压力，迫使副总理姚依林亲赴广东和福建，试图强制地方官员遵守中央要求。在他对广东干部的讲话中，姚严厉指责地方干部扩大货币供应过快、过度消耗外汇、以及未能及时偿还银行（Yao 1986b）。与赵不同，姚主要关切的是地方的合规性，而不是地方官员的特殊请求。
During the trip, Yao also unveiled the technocrats’ second track of attack against Deng’s faction. For the previous two years, the Hainan SEZ in Guangdong had been importing luxury cars from abroad and reselling them at a high profit to inland provinces. In early 1985, the Central Discipline and Inspection Commission, still under Chen Yun’s sway, launched an investigation of this operation. Soon after, the State Council issued a regulation forbidding all reselling activities by government units (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000). Without warning, Hainan’s profitable import business was rendered illegal. Moreover, with a profit-making enterprise that involved tens of thousands of cars, Chen Yun was bound to find incidents of corruption. It turned out that Premier Zhao had personally approved the car operation in the first place and had given Hainan the permission to spend billions from the foreign exchange reserve without first discussing it at the CFELG (Deng 2005: 520). In this instance, Chen’s main gripe against Zhao was probably not the corrupt activities of the car operation, but rather the unilateral expenditure of such an enormous sum of foreign exchange, a core macroeconomic tool for the planners. Hainan’s massive import of luxury vehicles contributed to the largest drop in the foreign exchange reserve in the country’s history - from U.S.$8.2 billion in 1984 to U.S.$2.6 billion in 1985 (State Administration of Foreign Exchange 2006). Yao’s inspection trip to Guangdong allowed the technocrats to collect more evidence on the “evil teachings and deviant ways” of Deng and Zhao’s Guangdong followers (Yao 1986b).
在这次访问期间，姚还揭露了技术官僚对邓派的第二条攻击路线。前两年，广东的海南经济特区一直从国外进口豪华汽车，并以高利润转售到内陆省份。1985 年初，仍受陈云影响的中央纪律检查委员会对该项业务展开了调查。不久之后，国务院发布了一项禁止政府部门一切转售活动的规定（中国共产党中央委员会文献研究室 2000）。毫无预警地，海南这一盈利的进口生意被判定为非法。而且，涉及数万辆汽车的营利性企业，陈云必然会发现腐败事件。事实证明，赵总理最初亲自批准了该项汽车业务，并在未先在中央财经领导小组讨论的情况下，准许海南动用外汇储备数十亿（Deng 2005: 520）。 在这种情况下，陈对赵的主要不满很可能并非针对轿车运营的腐败行为，而是针对如此巨额外汇的单方面支出——外汇是计划者的核心宏观经济工具。海南大量进口豪华车导致全国外汇储备出现历史上最大的下降——从 1984 年的 82 亿美元降至 1985 年的 26 亿美元（国家外汇管理局 2006）。姚赴广东的视察使技术官僚能够收集更多关于邓和赵在广东追随者“邪教邪说与歪门邪道”的证据（姚 1986b）。
The criminalization of the Hainan car ring gravely jeopardized Zhao’s political future because it was arguably a major policy failure that caused the loss of large sums of state resources. It was the type of failure over which Chen could force Zhao to resign. After Hu received his reprimand for meddling in economic affairs, this was the second time that Chen’s faction had threatened a core member of Deng’s coterie. Although Deng knew that Chen was in no position to take overall control of the CCP, he was certainly capable of causing enormous damage to Deng’s faction. The investigation in Hainan further revived leftist criticism against the SEZs from the other elders in the Party. Deng apparently relented to the wave of criticism and reportedly said that SEZs were still an “experiment” (Fewsmith 1994: 153).
海南贿赂汽车团伙被定性为犯罪，严重危及了赵的政治前途，因为这可以说是一次重大的政策失误，导致大量国家资源流失。这种失误正是陈可以用来逼迫赵辞职的把柄。在胡因干预经济事务受到训诫之后，这是陈的派系第二次对邓的圈内核心成员发起威胁。尽管邓知道陈无力全面掌控中共，但陈确实有能力对邓的派系造成巨大伤害。海南的调查进一步在党内其他元老中重新激起了对经济特区的左翼批评。邓显然对这波批评让步，据报道称经济特区仍然是一次“试验”（Fewsmith 1994: 153）。
To further unbalance Deng politically, Chen had the CDIC author a report on the commercial activities of the “princelings,” or children of high cadres. After reviewing the report, Chen Yun attached a comment stating that princeling participation in commercial activities should be strictly forbidden and that its continuation would “render progress in reform difficult” (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2004: 1037). He then sent it to Deng, whose son Deng Pufang had just formed his own company earlier that year to help finance the China Association for the Disabled (He and Gao 2000: 542). Once again, Chen had backed Deng into a corner because Chen clearly had the moral high ground, even though Deng was doubtless very reluctant to squash his handicapped son’s budding business career. 23 23 ^(23){ }^{23} Deng’s terse reply was “agreed, we must make a decision soon,” which left room for further discussion in the Politburo (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2004: 1037). Although Deng was ultimately able to save Kanghua - his son’s company - the CDIC report put him in a vulnerable position.
为了在政治上进一步削弱邓，陈令牌让 CDIC 起草了一份关于“太子党”——即高级干部子女——商业活动的报告。审阅该报告后，陈云附上一则评语，指出应严格禁止太子党参与商业活动，否则其继续存在将“使改革进展困难重重”（中共中央信息研究中心 2004：1037）。随后他将报告送交邓，邓的儿子邓朴方就在同年早些时候成立了自己的公司，以帮助资助中国残疾人联合会（He and Gao 2000：542）。陈再次将邓逼入角落，因为在道义上陈处于制高点，尽管邓无疑非常不愿扼杀他那位残疾儿子正在起步的商业生涯。邓的简短回复是“同意，须尽快作出决定”，为政治局内进一步讨论留下了余地（中共中央信息研究中心 2004：1037）。尽管邓最终得以保住康华——他儿子的公司——但 CDIC 的报告使他处于脆弱境地。
Under intense political pressure from the planners, Deng finally agreed to recentralize economic policies and to slow down the pace of growth. In his remarks to an Algerian delegation at the end of June, Deng acknowledged the inflation problem and signaled his acceptance of the retrenchment for “a few years” (Deng 1998b: 345). With Deng signing on to the retrenchment program, the planners convened another meeting with local officials in June 1985 to convey a unified stance on the issue. To enforce the investment and lending reduction approved during the meeting, the center also sent work teams to the provinces to monitor implementation (State Council 1987a).
在来自计划者的强大政治压力下，邓小平最终同意使经济政策再度集中并放慢增长步伐。在六月底接见阿尔及利亚代表团时，邓承认了通货膨胀问题，并表示接受“几年”内的收缩（Deng 1998b: 345）。随着邓对收缩方案的签署，中央在 1985 年 6 月又召开了一次与地方官员的会议，以在该问题上传达统一立场。为执行会议上批准的投资和放贷减少，中央还派出工作组到各省监督落实（State Council 1987a）。
The changing political environment in the middle of 1985 produced increasingly strict decrees about investment and lending from the State Council and from the PBOC. One PBOC decree forbade bank lending to all out-of-plan investment, even projects under 50,000 yuan (People’s Bank of China 1987b). This policy starkly contrasted with decrees issued during the previous year, which had encouraged banks to support extrabudgetary investment. At the end of June, a State Council regulation essentially reversed the banking policies enacted during the previous year. The State Council decree states: “Banks can refuse any requests from local government that are against State Council financial regulations. The State Council will hold relevant cadres responsible (zhuijiu zeren) for harassing local banks which adhere to State Council regulations” (Office of the State Council 1987). Rather than encouraging banks to support local development, this new batch of regulations required banks to strictly adhere to the central credit plan.
1985 年中期不断变化的政治环境促使国务院和中国人民银行出台了越来越严格的关于投资和贷款的法令。中国人民银行的一项法令禁止银行对所有计划外投资发放贷款，甚至禁止对低于 5 万元的项目放贷（People’s Bank of China 1987b）。这一政策与前一年颁布的鼓励银行支持预算外投资的法令形成了鲜明对比。六月底，国务院的一项法规实质上扭转了前一年实施的银行政策。国务院法令指出：“对于违反国务院财政监管的地方政府的任何请求，银行可以拒绝。对于骚扰遵守国务院法规的地方银行的有关干部，国务院将追究责任（zhuijiu zeren）”（Office of the State Council 1987）。这一新一轮法规不是鼓励银行支持地方发展，而是要求银行严格遵守中央信贷计划。
However, Deng remained very dissatisfied with the state of affairs. In a July private chat with several Politburo Standing Committee members, Deng expressed his defiance: "Even if there is instability, or even great instability, we
然而，邓小平对当时的局势仍然非常不满。在一次七月与几位政治局常委的私人谈话中，邓表达了他的蔑视：“即使有不稳定，甚至出现严重不稳定，我们
must insist on reform; otherwise, we will not have hope for the next ten years" (Deng 1998g). Had the content of Deng’s talk been revealed to lower officials at the time, it would have dampened retrenchment efforts. There is no evidence, however, that Deng’s private dissatisfaction was made public at the time. Besides Zhao and Deng Pufang’s vulnerability, another reason for Deng’s silence was perhaps Chen’s acquiescence of Deng’s assertion of dominance over the military. At the September Fourth Plenum, a group of veteran marshals retired from the Politburo, replaced by two Deng loyalists in the PLA, Yang Shangkun and Yang Dezhi (Baum 1994: 185). As long as Deng left economic policies alone, Chen did not oppose Deng’s assertion of greater control over other parts of the Party state.
也必须坚持改革；否则，我们在未来十年就没有希望了”（邓 1998g）。如果当时邓的谈话内容被泄露给下级官员，必然会削弱收缩政策的努力。然而，没有证据表明邓的私人不满在当时被公开。除赵紫阳和邓朴方的脆弱性外，邓保持沉默的另一个原因可能是陈云对邓在军队中主导地位的默许。在九月的第四届全会上，一批资深元帅从政治局退休，被两位解放军中对邓忠诚的杨尚昆和杨得志所替代（Baum 1994: 185）。只要邓不干涉经济政策，陈云并不反对邓对党和国家其他部分加强控制的主张。

The First Wave of Nonperforming Loans
不良贷款的第一波

In the previous inflationary cycle and in this cycle, lending played an increasingly important role in the government’s investment plans. The budget-to-loan transformation made bank loans an increasingly significant part of both local and central investment. Inevitably, the investment and lending boom in 1984, the first boom in which loans played a major role, produced the first major batch of nonperforming loans. In a pattern that repeated itself, the central bureaucracy carried out a bailout that it promised would be the last supper for banks. The threat proved to be not credible. Although PBOC regulations were issued to protect the integrity of the banks, both the central and the local governments continued to use banking resources to fulfill policy aims. Those with political clout in both the generalist and the technocratic factions simply did not have sufficient incentive to make banks into commercial entities.
在之前的通货膨胀周期和本轮周期中，信贷在政府的投资计划中扮演着越来越重要的角色。预算向贷款的转化使得银行贷款成为地方和中央投资中日益重要的一部分。不可避免地，1984 年的投资与放贷热潮——这是首个贷款发挥主要作用的热潮——产生了第一批大规模不良贷款。以反复出现的模式为例，中央官僚机构实施了一次救助，并承诺这是对银行的“最后一顿晚餐”。这一威胁被证明并不具可信性。尽管 PBOC 发布了规范以维护银行的完整性，中央和地方政府仍继续利用银行资源来实现政策目标。无论是通才派还是技术官僚派中拥有政治影响力者，都没有足够的激励将银行改造为商业实体。
The first wave of nonperforming loans (NPLs) arose from reckless local investment in 1984 and from the sudden drying up of bank funds to local initiatives. One prime example was the Hainan car ring, which could have thrived as a profitable business. But because of the crackdown, Hainan was stuck with tens of thousands of cars and NPLs to the tune of 3 billion yuan, a substantial sum at that time (Yao 1986b). The investment boom also generated NPLs in other areas. A State Council decree at that time suggests that roughly 50 percent of technical innovation loans and 20 percent of loans to township and village enterprises had become nonperforming (The State Council 1987b). Although loans in those two categories were relatively minor at that time, they likely added several billion yuan to the NPL tab. 24 24 ^(24){ }^{24}
第一波不良贷款（NPLs）起因于 1984 年地方的鲁莽投资以及银行资金突然停止流向地方项目。其中一个典型例子是海南的汽车连锁，原本可以作为一个盈利的生意兴隆发展。但由于镇压，海南被几十万辆汽车和约 30 亿元人民币的不良贷款所拖累，这在当时是一个相当可观的数目（Yao 1986b）。投资热潮也在其他领域产生了不良贷款。国务院当时的一项法令表明，大约 50%的技术创新贷款和 20%的乡镇企业贷款已成为不良贷款（The State Council 1987b）。尽管那时这两类贷款规模相对较小，但很可能为不良贷款总额增加了数十亿元人民币。 24 24 ^(24){ }^{24}
Problems also abounded for working capital loans, the largest category of loans at that time. In late April 1985, the PBOC issued a decree to order a write-off of nonperforming working capital loans for SOEs. The write-off was
营运资金贷款——当时规模最大的贷款类别——的问题也同样严重。1985 年 4 月底，PBOC 发布一项命令，要求对国有企业的不良营运资金贷款进行核销。该核销是
in the amount of 5.5 billion yuan, a mere 1.4 percent of working capital loans outstanding at that time. Nonetheless, it was clear that the government had a rude awakening about the consequences of using the banking system. The decree stressed that this bailout would be the last one:
金额为 55 亿元，仅占当时流动资金贷款余额的 1.4%。尽管如此，政府显然对利用银行系统所带来的后果有了一个痛苦的觉醒。该法令强调此次救助将是最后一次：
This is the last time that the state will take responsibility for lost capital…Capital and material losses from now on will be handled by the enterprises themselves. They can no longer suspend loans (guazhang) for the long run and cannot use state capital to write off debt. (Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, The People’s Bank of China, and The Ministry of Finance 1987)
这是国家最后一次对失去的资本负责……从今以后，资本和物质损失将由企业自行处理。它们不能再长期停发贷款（挂账），也不能用国有资金冲销债务。（中国工商银行、中国人民银行、财政部 1987）
Needless to say, this premature commitment against bailing out SOE losses did not endure long.
不必说，这种过早承诺不再救助国有企业损失的做法并没有持续很久。
In response to this wave of NPLs, technocrats in the PBOC, who were not members of the political elite, proposed both administrative measures and longterm reform to reduce NPLs. The administrative measures were a part of the retrenchment effort which essentially forbade the local government from ordering banks to lend. It also required all borrowers of fixed-asset loans to have start-up capital equivalent to 30 percent of the total investment (Office of the State Council 1987). At the end of 1985, the PBOC also organized a national inspection campaign on loans to ensure compliance to these measures (State Council 1987b).
针对这波不良贷款浪潮，中国人民银行中并非政治精英的技术官僚提出了既有行政措施又有长期改革来减少不良贷款。行政措施是收缩努力的一部分，实质上禁止地方政府指示银行发放贷款。它还要求所有固定资产贷款的借款人必须有相当于总投资 30%的启动资金（国务院办公厅 1987）。在 1985 年底，PBOC 还组织了一次全国性的贷款检查运动，以确保对这些措施的遵守（国务院 1987b）。
On a longer time horizon, the technocrats at the PBOC also strove to make banks commercial entities. After vigorous lobbying, the government founded in 1984 a new bank, the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC), to take over the PBOC’s commercial lending operations in an attempt to reduce the moral hazard prevalent in PBOC commercial lending. Although this measure proved largely fruitless because the PBOC still had to lend to the state banks when they ran short of money, it nonetheless represented a significant movement toward banking autonomy. Their lobbying effort also earned them a section on financial reform in the Proposal for the Seventh Five Year Plan, which was ratified at the Party Representative Conference in October 1985. Although nonbinding, the proposal called for more autonomy for banks to set interest rates, select borrowers, and set fees (Liu 2000e).
从更长远的时间视角来看，中国人民银行的技术官僚也努力将银行转变为商业实体。经过积极游说，政府于 1984 年成立了一家新银行——中国工商银行（ICBC），以接管中国人民银行的商业放贷业务，试图减少中国人民银行商业放贷中普遍存在的道德风险。尽管这一措施在很大程度上未能奏效，因为当国有银行缺钱时中国人民银行仍不得不向其放贷，但它仍然代表了朝向银行自主的重要一步。他们的游说还使他们在《第七个五年计划建议》中获得了一节关于金融改革的内容，该建议于 1985 年 10 月在党的代表大会上获得通过。尽管该建议没有法律约束力，但它呼吁赋予银行在制定利率、选择借款人和设定费用方面更多的自主权（Liu 2000e）。
Despite these milestones, the political logic in the communist system did not permit the optimistic wording in the proposal to become reality. Members of the generalist faction did their best to encourage local officials to intervene in the banks to obtain high growth. During the retrenchment, the bureaucrats did not hesitate to use the banks to finance various pet projects. One prime example was the subsidized loans for developing the electronic industries. In 1984, Jiang Zemin, then the Minister of Electronics, staged a special presentation of computer equipment for Chen Yun. Chen Yun was impressed by both Jiang and his equipment and requested preferential policies for electronics (Gilley 1998: 73). The State Council then set up the Leading Group on Promoting Electronics, headed by then Vice Premier Li Peng and Jiang. At the height of the retrenchment, the Leading Group drafted a policy to provide 200 million
尽管有这些里程碑式的进展，共产主义体制内的政治逻辑并不允许提案中那种乐观措辞成为现实。属于通才派的成员尽最大努力鼓励地方官员干预银行以获得高增长。在紧缩期间，官僚们毫不犹豫地利用银行为各种他们偏好的项目提供资金。一个典型例子是用于发展电子工业的贴息贷款。1984 年，时任电子工业部部长的江泽民为陈云专门展示了一批电脑设备。陈云对江泽民及其设备印象深刻，并要求对电子工业给予优惠政策（Gilley 1998: 73）。国务院随后成立了以时任副总理李鹏和江泽民为首的推进电子工业工作领导小组。在紧缩最严重时期，领导小组起草了一项提供 2 亿的政策。
yuan in subsidized loans to the electronic industry. The loans in this category were approved by the Leading Group rather than by the banks themselves (State Council’s Leading Group on Promoting Electronics et al. 1987). Also, the State Council ordered the banks to provide funds to agricultural procurement, which had been funded by the government budget (People’s Bank of China 1987a). With multiplying policy tasks, the road to banking autonomy would prove to be a long and tortuous one.
向电子工业提供的贴息贷款达数亿元人民币。这类贷款由领导小组批准，而非由银行自行决定（国务院促进电子工业等领导小组 1987）。同时，国务院还命令各银行向原本由政府预算资助的农业收购提供资金（中国人民银行 1987a）。随着政策任务的增多，银行自主之路注定漫长而曲折。

Conclusion  结论

This chapter documented the way in which elite politics affected financial outcomes during the crucial 1978-1986 period. On the issue of monetary policy, Deng’s faction of Party officials disagreed with Chen’s faction of central bureaucrats on the degree of centralization in investment and lending. The struggle between the two factions created the first two reform-era inflationary cycles. Given that there was no central bank independence in China, it was the technocrats’ active participation in politics that gave anti-inflationary policies credibility. Economic actors in China expected the central bureaucrats to fight tooth and nail to retain control over investment and lending, and they did. At the same time, however, leaders from both factions began to see the banking system as a useful source of funds. Because no faction had an incentive to protect the interest of the depositors, banks soon became the government’s other fiscal arm.
本章记录了精英政治如何在 1978–1986 年这一关键时期影响金融结果。关于货币政策问题，邓派的党内官员与陈派的中央官僚在投资和放贷的集中程度上存在分歧。两派之间的斗争导致了改革时期最早的两轮通货膨胀周期。鉴于中国没有中央银行独立性，正是技术官僚积极参与政治使反通胀政策具备了可信度。中国的经济行为者预期中央官僚会拼尽全力保住对投资和放贷的控制，而事实也是如此。与此同时，来自两派的领导人都开始将银行体系视为一个有用的资金来源。由于没有任何一派有动机保护存款人的利益，银行很快成为政府的另一个财政工具。
Unlike some earlier accounts of this period, the above discussion reveals that the Deng-Chen split on economic issues began much earlier in late 1979 (Fewsmith 1994; MacFarquhar 1997). Also, the evidence presented in this chapter strongly suggests that economic policy rather than ideological concerns was the basis of the disagreement between the two factions in the early 1980s. Deng and Chen’s disagreement on economic reform probably stemmed more from control than from ideological differences. Both Deng and Chen had been life-long Marxists, and Deng’s stance on the spiritual pollution issue and in 1989 showed that Deng was as much a zealous guardian of the proletarian dictatorship as Chen was (Deng 2005: 346). Yet he clearly favored a more decentralized, though not necessarily a more marketized, mode of economic management. Evidence from this chapter suggests that membership composition of the two factions likely had more to do with their divergent preferences on economic issues than their ideological dispositions.
与早期一些关于这一时期的论述不同，上述讨论显示邓—陈在经济问题上的分歧早在 1979 年底就已出现（Fewsmith 1994；MacFarquhar 1997）。此外，本章提供的证据强烈表明，经济政策而非意识形态关切，是 1980 年代初两派分歧的根源。邓与陈在经济改革上的分歧很可能更多源于对控制权的争夺，而非意识形态差异。邓和陈都长期是马列主义者，邓在“精神污染”问题上的立场以及 1989 年的态度表明邓在捍卫无产阶级专政方面和陈一样激烈（Deng 2005: 346）。然而，他显然更倾向于一种更去中心化的（但不一定更市场化的）经济管理模式。本章的证据表明，两派在成员构成上的差异，很可能比他们的意识形态倾向更能解释他们在经济问题上的不同偏好。
Finally, the evidence presented here supports Baum’s (1994) argument that ideological cycles and economic cycles each had their distinct logic and did not necessarily coincide. Of course, the smuggling scandal at the end of 1981 and the suppression of the Hainan car ring in 1985 were critical elements in the planners’ strategy of obtaining and retaining financial control. Nonetheless, these actions were motivated more by the desire to retain power than by a coherent ideological vision. The scandals would not have been useful to Chen Yun if they did not involve Deng’s favorite economic experiment, the SEZs. After all,
最后，此处提出的证据支持 Baum（1994）的论点：意识形态周期和经济周期各有其独立逻辑，未必同时发生。当然，1981 年底的走私丑闻和 1985 年对海南汽车走私团伙的镇压，都是计划者获取并保持金融控制的重要策略要素。然而，这些行动的动机更多是为了保住权力，而非出于连贯的意识形态愿景。如果这些丑闻没有牵涉到邓最喜欢的经济试验——SEZs，它们对陈云也不会有用。毕竟，
neither the Democracy Wall Movement nor the Polish workers’ protests, which caused ripples in the ideological debates, seemed to have disturbed the trajectory of the inflationary cycles. Rather, rising complaints from local officials and high inflation seemed to have played the most important role in changing the direction of monetary policies.
无论是民主墙运动，还是在意识形态辩论中引起涟漪的波兰工人抗议，似乎都没有扰乱通货膨胀周期的轨迹。相反，来自地方官员的不断抱怨和高通货膨胀似乎在改变货币政策方向方面起了最重要的作用。
Deng remarked at a July 1985 private meeting that “great instability” was an acceptable price of reform. This statement was perhaps more prophetic than he would have preferred. As the next chapter shows, the next inflationary cycle indeed produced the “great instability” to test the limit of reform and his drive to decentralize the economy.
邓在 1985 年 7 月一次私人会议上曾说过，“巨大的不稳定”是改革可以接受的代价。这句话或许比他愿意承认的更具预见性。正如下一章所示，随后的通货膨胀周期确实带来了检验改革极限及其推进经济下放努力的“巨大不稳定”。

The Height of the Politics of Inflation, 1987-1996
通货膨胀政治的高峰，1987–1996

Although the politics of inflationary cycles began in the late 1970s, the full manifestation of its dynamics did not take place until the late 1980s with the third reform inflationary cycle. The full flowering of the generalist faction’s tendency to promote local financial control and the central bureaucrats’ opposition to it occurred in the 1988 and in the 1993 inflationary cycles. The looming succession meant that junior generalists must firm up their own factions in preparation for the struggle after Deng’s passing. This gave them impetus to devolve financial resources to their main provincial supporters. At the same time, these two inflationary cycles also reveal the dominant generalists’ willingness to delegate financial authorities to the technocrats in order to preserve the status quo balance of power during crises. In the aftermath of the 1989 student protests and in 1995, Deng and his successor Jiang Zemin relied on the technocrats to stabilize the economy as they struggled to preserve or consolidate their power. Thus, the logic outlined in Chapter 4 continued to have an important impact on monetary policies in the rest of the 1980s and into the 1990s.
尽管通货膨胀周期的政治始于 1970 年代末，但其动力的全面显现直到 1980 年代末第三次改革引发的通胀周期才发生。普通派推动地方财政控制的倾向在 1988 年和 1993 年的通胀周期中得到了充分展现，而中央官僚对此的反对也在这两次周期中显现。临近接班意味着年轻的普通派必须巩固自己的派系，为邓逝世后的权力争斗做准备。这促使他们将财政资源下放给主要的省级支持者。与此同时，这两次通胀周期也显示出占主导地位的普通派愿意在危机期间将财政权力委托给技术官僚，以维持现有的权力平衡。在 1989 年学运的余波以及 1995 年，邓和他的继任者江泽民在努力保住或巩固权力时，依靠技术官僚来稳定经济。因此，第 4 章阐述的逻辑在 1980 年代余下时间以及 1990 年代仍对货币政策产生了重要影响。
Examining more recent inflationary cycles also places the ideological hypothesis under rigorous scrutiny. Because debates over financial policies were tinged with ideology in the early 1980s, it is difficult to firmly reject the ideology hypothesis based solely on an examination of the earlier inflationary cycles. Into the late 1980s and the 1990s, however, the rise of a new breed of central bureaucrats, who were conversant in Western economic theory and proponents of building comprehensive market institutions, puts the ideological hypothesis to a true test. If ideology caused the underlying disagreement between the top leaders on monetary policies, the growing consensus on reform and market formation should diminish their disagreement over time. Even if there were disagreements about reform trajectories, the main division over financial policies would not have been over centralization versus decentralization because the main Western debates about financial policies did not fall in that divide. Rather than importing Western debates about financial policies wholesale, the growing economic expert community in China tailored the debate to fit the
考察更近的通货膨胀周期也对意识形态假设提出了严格检验。由于 1980 年代早期金融政策的争论带有意识形态色彩，仅凭对较早通胀周期的考察很难断然否定意识形态假设。然而，到了 1980 年代后期和 1990 年代，一批通晓西方经济理论、主张建立完善市场制度的新型中央官僚的崛起，才真正对意识形态假设进行了检验。如果意识形态是导致最高领导人在货币政策上产生根本分歧的原因，那么随着改革和市场建设共识的不断增强，他们的分歧应当随着时间而减少。即使在改革路径上存在分歧，金融政策的主要分歧也不太可能是集中化与分权化之争，因为西方关于金融政策的主要争论并不落入这一对立之中。中国日益壮大的经济专家群体并没有照搬西方关于金融政策的全部辩论，而是将讨论加以本土化调整以适应实际情况。
main consumers of policy proposals, namely, the generalist factions and the technocratic factions. Despite the ideological and ideational changes and the shifts in leadership over the decade under examination, the generalist factions’ preference for decentralized finance and the technocratic faction’s preference for centralized finance did not diminish.
政策建议的主要接受者，即通才派系和技术官僚派系。尽管在所考察的十年间意识形态和观念发生变化且领导层更迭，通才派系对分权化金融的偏好与技术官僚派系对集权化金融的偏好并未减弱。
Examining these inflationary cycles also allows us to witness the persistent debates about the acceptable level of inflation throughout the cycles. This debate masked the deeper issue of which level of government should control financial resources. The generalist factions argued that society had gained a higher tolerance for inflation or that high inflation was a necessary steppingstone to reform. Their intellectual merits aside, these arguments also conveniently justified decentralized finance. In 1988, Zhao Ziyang brought that argument to its logical extreme when he proposed to bring China down the road of Brazilian hyperinflation. Meanwhile, central bureaucrats in different age cohorts and with different ideological visions consistently argued that high inflation could lead to economic and ultimately political instability. The implication of this argument was of course a more centralized structure for the financial system. Over time, the generalist factions eroded the low tolerance for inflation, but the central bureaucracy repeatedly mobilized its arsenal of political tools to initiate retrenchments. If central bureaucrats did not have a stake in the political consequences of centralized finance, they would not have been such active champions of centralization and such vigilant guardians against high inflation. China would have implemented the preferred policies of the generalist factions and faced high inflation.
检视这些通货膨胀周期也使我们得以看到关于可接受通货膨胀水平的持续争论。这样的争论掩盖了更深层的问题：哪一级政府应当控制财政资源。泛化派认为社会对通货膨胀的容忍度提高了，或者高通货膨胀是改革的必要踏脚石。撇开这些论点的学术价值不谈，它们也恰好为财政权下放提供了正当性。1988 年，赵紫阳把这一论点推向极端，提出要将中国带上巴西式的恶性通货膨胀道路。与此同时，不同年龄群体和不同意识形态视野的中央官僚则一贯主张，高通货膨胀可能导致经济并最终引发政治不稳定。该论点的含意当然是金融体系应更集中化。随着时间推移，泛化派削弱了对低通货膨胀容忍度的坚持，但中央官僚机构反复动用其政治工具库发起收缩政策。 如果中央官僚在集中化金融的政治后果中没有利害关系，他们就不会成为集中化的积极拥护者，也不会如此警惕地防范高通货膨胀。中国本可以实施通才派系偏好的政策，但将面临高通货膨胀。
The parallel analysis of both monetary policy and banking policy throughout the decade is also an instructive study in contrast. Although elite factions fought over monetary control, there were no elite defenders of banking autonomy from administrative intervention. Although technocrats below the Politburo level lobbied vigorously for banking autonomy from the early 1980s, their effort produced few real results. At most, technocrats managed to include clauses supporting banking autonomy in several important policy documents, but the political elite repeatedly violated the spirit of these documents by ordering banks to lend to policy and political ends. Their actions greatly undermined the credibility of these plans and encouraged lower level officials to do the same. Local governments set up their own depository institutions or ordered the local state banks to lend to local development, foreign purchases, and bailing out local SOEs. The central bureaucrats used their control over the banking system to lower explicit deficit, finance national development, and bail out large SOEs.
对货币政策和银行政策在整个十年内的并行分析也是一项有启发性的对比研究。尽管精英派系为货币控制权发生争斗，但并不存在维护银行从行政干预中独立的精英捍卫者。尽管处于政治局以下层级的技术官僚自 20 世纪 80 年代初就积极游说银行自治，但他们的努力几乎没有取得实际成果。充其量，技术官僚设法在若干重要政策文件中加入了支持银行自治的条款，但政治精英反复以命令银行为政策和政治目的放贷的方式违反了这些文件的精神。他们的行为极大地削弱了这些计划的可信度，并鼓励了下级官员效法。地方政府设立了自己的存款机构或命令地方国有银行为地方建设、对外采购和救助地方国企提供贷款。中央官僚利用他们对银行体系的控制以降低显性赤字、为国家发展提供资金以及救助大型国企。

Severe Tests: On the Edge of Hyperinflation and Tiananmen, 1987-1990
严峻考验：通货膨胀边缘与天安门，1987–1990 年

The years between 1987 and 1990 put both Chen Yun’s faction and Deng Xiaoping’s faction to the severest tests since the reform began. Zhao Ziyang, whose way to the top was opened by Hu Yaobang’s removal after the 1986
1987 年至 1990 年间的岁月，对陈云派系和邓小平派系都是自改革开始以来最严峻的考验。赵紫阳在 1986 年胡耀邦被罢免后得以登上高位，...
protests, made even more strenuous effort to bolster his local support base in preparation for the succession. Like Hu Yaobang before him, Zhao was testing the limit to which he could establish his own agenda and factional base without directly challenging Deng. At the same time, his decentralization policies were bolstered by technical arguments from his team of economists, who argued that inflation was an acceptable price of decentralization. This would have been disastrous for Chen’s faction of central bureaucrats because their powers would have been emasculated. For Chen Yun personally, hyperinflation, something he had spent much of his professional life combating, would have become a reality.
抗议活动，他更加努力地巩固自己的地方支持基础，为接班做准备。像胡耀邦一样，赵正在试探在不直接挑战邓的情况下，能够在多大程度上建立自己的议程和派系基础。与此同时，他的分权政策得到了其经济学家团队的技术性论据支持，这些人认为通货膨胀是分权的可接受代价。这对于陈派中央官僚来说本来将是灾难性的，因为他们的权力将被削弱。对陈云个人而言，恶性通货膨胀——他在职业生涯的大部分时间里一直在与之作斗争的东西——将成为现实。
In this cycle, we once again observe the distinct logic between political cycles and economic cycles. Although the technocrats attempted to use Hu Yaobang’s downfall to forestall decentralization policies, they were unable to do so because of high growth and low inflation in that period. Instead, widespread panic buying and runs on the state banks eventually convinced Deng to acquiesce to the centralization drive. To accomplish their aim, the planners had to mobilize all their resources to set a political trap for Deng and Zhao. The theory presented in Chapter 4 suggests that the technocratic faction had an incentive to create an economic disaster to regain control. In 1988, we see some evidence that the technocratic faction allowed Deng and Zhao to steer the country into an economic crisis in order to regain control. More so than the previous inflationary cycles, this case shows that China would indeed have faced high levels of inflation without the intervention of the politically powerful central bureaucrats.
在这一周期中，我们再次观察到政治周期与经济周期之间的不同逻辑。尽管技术官僚试图利用胡耀邦的倒台来阻止分权政策，但由于当时经济高速增长且通货膨胀率较低，他们未能如愿。相反，广泛的抢购和对国有银行的挤兑最终使邓小平被迫默许中央化推进。为实现其目标，计划者不得不动用一切资源为邓与赵设下政治陷阱。第 4 章提出的理论表明，技术官僚派别有动力制造一场经济灾难以重夺控制权。1988 年，我们看到一些证据表明技术官僚派允许邓和赵将国家引入经济危机，以便重新掌控局面。与此前的通货膨胀周期相比，这一案例更清楚地显示，如果没有政治上强势的中央官僚的干预，中国确实会面临高通胀水平。
The generalist factions’ crisis came less than a year later when students took to the streets and protested inflation, corruption, and the uncertainties of reform. For a variety of reasons, the Party ultimately had to use its bluntest instrument to put a stop to the protest. The Tiananmen Square massacre sparked a wholesale criticism of the entire reform process. Deng used all the political resources at his disposal to stem the tide of leftist ideological attacks. In order to save the reform and his legacy, he made the ultimate bargain with the central planners. He agreed to elevate someone with strong central bureaucratic pedigree to the post of General Secretary, greatly diminishing the power of the generalist faction. Deng also signed on to a long retrenchment period of heightened central power. Contrary to previous Western accounts, however, the post-1989 retrenchment was not simply a return to the prereform days. During that period, the central bureaucracy began to reinvent and strengthen itself for the market economy. A new generation of central bureaucrats showed much greater willingness to retool the central bureaucracy to perpetuate its hold over the emerging market economy.
大约不到一年后，全能派的危机便爆发，学生走上街头，抗议通货膨胀、腐败以及改革带来的不确定性。出于多种原因，党最终不得不动用最严厉的手段来制止这场抗议。天安门广场的大屠杀引发了对整个改革进程的全面批评。邓小平动用了他所能调动的一切政治资源，遏制左倾意识形态攻击的浪潮。为了挽救改革和他的政治遗产，他与中央计划者达成了最终的妥协——同意提拔一位具有强烈中央官僚血统的人出任总书记，大大削弱了全能派的权力。邓小平还签署了一个以强化中央权力为特征的长期收缩期。然而，与此前西方的说法相反，1989 年后期的收缩并非简单地回到改革前的时代。在那一时期，中央官僚体系开始为市场经济改造并加强自身。 新一代中央官僚更愿意改造中央官僚机构，以巩固其对新兴市场经济的控制。
In terms of the money supply, this inflationary cycle did not follow the classical pattern of rapid increase in money supply generating inflationary pressure. As seen in Figure 7.1, money supply built up steadily beginning in the second half of 1986. It was inflationary expectation generated by political signals from the top that caused high inflation in 1988. As in previous cycles, it was high
在货币供应方面，这一通胀周期并未遵循货币供应快速增加进而产生通胀压力的经典模式。如图 7.1 所示，货币供应自 1986 年下半年开始稳步积累。正是来自高层的政治信号所产生的通胀预期导致了 1988 年的高通胀。与以往周期一样，高
Figure 15: figure 7.1. Percentage Change in Quarterly Lending and Change in Inflation from One Year Ago: 1986-1991. Source: Quarterly Database. See Appendix for details. Figures are percentage change in state bank lending and change in inflation from four quarters ago.
图 15：图 7.1。季度放贷百分比变化与一年期通胀变化：1986–1991。来源：季度数据库。详情见附录。数字为国有银行放贷的百分比变化以及与四个季度前相比的通胀变化。
inflation and the resulting political reaction that ended the crisis at the end of 1988. More so than the previous cycles, we see the importance of politics in affecting inflation. The inflationary pattern in this cycle also provides further confirmation that the Chinese government was not a unitary actor. If the Chinese government had been a unitary actor, it would have more skillfully targeted money supply rather than allowed it to grow at such a rapid rate in 1986 and in 1987. Instead, the Chinese government did not react until several quarters after inflation had gotten out of control. Loan expansion remained at above 20 percent throughout 1986 and 1987, despite a couple of half-hearted efforts at soft landing. This occurred because one part of the government felt that inflation was not such a grave threat.
通货膨胀及其引发的政治反应在 1988 年底结束了这次危机。与此前的周期相比，我们在本周期中更能看出政治在影响通货膨胀方面的重要性。本周期的通胀模式进一步证明了中国政府并非单一行为体。如果中国政府是一个单一行为体，它本会更巧妙地针对货币供应量进行调控，而不是在 1986 年和 1987 年任由货币供应如此快速增长。相反，中国政府直到通胀失控好几个季度后才有所反应。尽管曾有过几次软着陆的半心半意的努力，1986 年和 1987 年期间贷款扩张仍保持在 20%以上。这是因为政府的某一部分认为通货膨胀并非如此严重的威胁。

The Intellectual and Political Basis of the Inflation Debate
通胀辩论的知识与政治基础

At the end of the previous inflationary cycle in 1985, Zhao mobilized a group of young economists under him to reexamine the implications of inflation. Was inflation necessarily fatal to the Chinese economy, as the planners had claimed all along? Drawing from a wide range of theoretical traditions, economists who supported Zhao’s stance of decentralizing finance devised numerous justifications for allowing inflation to take off, which gradually increased the inflation tolerance of the generalist factions. By 1988, Zhao felt confident enough to ignore the planners’ call for retrenchment, even as inflation crept into the
在上一轮 1985 年的通货膨胀周期结束时，赵动员了他手下一群年轻经济学家重新审视通货膨胀的影响。通货膨胀是否像计划者一直宣称的那样对中国经济致命？支持赵去中心化金融立场的经济学家汲取了多种理论传统，提出了许多容许通货膨胀发生的论证，这些论证逐渐提高了普通派系对通货膨胀的容忍度。到 1988 年，尽管通货膨胀悄然上升，赵仍然自信到可以无视计划者要求收缩的呼声。
20 percent territory. Although these economists merely supplied ideas that suited Zhao’s political demand, their arguments nonetheless gave Zhao the backbone to resist the planners’ call for retrenchment, at least for a few months.
20% 的地盘。尽管这些经济学家只是提供了迎合赵氏政治要求的观点，但他们的论证仍然在几个月内为赵抵制计划者要求紧缩的呼声提供了支撑。
Because of Chen Yun’s domination of the central bureaucracy, Zhao recruited a group of young economists and founded the Economic Reform Institute (ERI) to provide policy proposals independent of those generated by the traditional central bureaucracy (Fewsmith 1994: 136). When inflation reached an alarming level in late 1984, a leading member of the Institute, Zhu Jiaming, authored an article arguing that high growth required the rapid expansion of money supply (Fewsmith 1994: 140). After the center instituted retrenchment policies in 1985, scholars from the ERI issued a report contending that the cure for inflation was not centralization, but ownership reform and a freer labor market (Fewsmith 1994: 140). The appearance of these articles in the midst of the retrenchment was a means for Zhao to criticize the retrenchment unofficially. Although these justifications were ultimately ineffective in undoing the retrenchment in 1985, they served as the intellectual foundation for the fierce debate over acceptable inflation in 1987 and 1988.
由于陈云对中央官僚机构的主导地位，赵招募了一批年轻经济学家并创办了 Economic Reform Institute (ERI)，以提供独立于传统中央官僚机构的政策建议（Fewsmith 1994: 136）。当通货膨胀在 1984 年末达到令人警觉的水平时，该 Institute 的一位主要成员朱家明撰文主张高增长需要货币供应的快速扩张（Fewsmith 1994: 140）。在中央于 1985 年实施紧缩政策后，ERI 的学者发表报告认为，治愈通货膨胀的办法不是中央集权，而是所有制改革和更自由的劳动力市场（Fewsmith 1994: 140）。这些文章在紧缩正进行时的出现，是赵非正式批评紧缩政策的一种方式。尽管这些论证最终未能在 1985 年扭转紧缩，但它们为 1987 年和 1988 年关于可接受通货膨胀水平的激烈争论奠定了思想基础。
In 1986 and 1987, Zhao’s protégés at the ERI continued to produce work on revitalizing the microeconomy in China. It even called for the legalization of the dual-track financial system in which informal financial institutions charging market interest rates coexisted with the state banking system charging artificially low rates (Fewsmith 1994: 167). In the summer of 1986, Li Yining, an economist who became a follower of Hayek after he had studied the HayekLange debate, authored an article stating that inflation was a temporary phenomenon that would disappear after ownership transformation, a politically correct term for privatization (Fewsmith 1994: 186).
1986 年和 1987 年，赵家的门生在经济研究所继续发表关于振兴中国微观经济的研究。它甚至主张将双轨金融体系合法化——在该体系中，以市场利率放贷的非正式金融机构与以人为压低利率的国有银行并存（Fewsmith 1994: 167）。1986 年夏，李毅宁——一位在研读哈耶克与朗格之争后成为哈耶克信徒的经济学家——撰文指出，通货膨胀是一个暂时现象，在所有制变革（对私有化的政治上更可接受的说法）之后将消失（Fewsmith 1994: 186）。
Meanwhile, industrial growth in 1986 only registered at a sluggish 4.4 percent because firms lacked working capital after the retrenchment (Xue 1996: 4 II). Local officials and managers of firms sent a flood of complaints against the centralization policies to the central government. Sensing a possible turn in the political tide, Zhao’s young economists authored several articles that called for “appropriate inflation” to revive industrial production (Xue 1996: 4ɪɪ). Although Gu Mu and Zhao still supported the retrenchment policies on their inspection trips in January and February 1986, the articles likely generated an elite debate about the stiffling effect of the retrenchment efforts (Gu 1988; Zhao 1988). One sign of the debate was the attack on the “appropriate inflation” argument at the April National People’s Congress session by an established State Council think-tank (Xue 1996: 411).
与此同时，1986 年工业增长仅为疲弱的 4.4％，因为在缩减开支后企业缺乏营运资金（Xue 1996：4 II）。地方官员和企业管理者向中央政府发出大量反对集权政策的投诉。感到政治潮流可能出现转向，赵的年轻经济学家撰写了几篇文章，呼吁通过“适度通货膨胀”来恢复工业生产（Xue 1996：4ɪɪ）。尽管顾穆和赵在 1986 年 1 月和 2 月的视察中仍然支持缩减政策，这些文章可能在精英内部引发了关于缩减努力所造成的压抑效应的辩论（Gu 1988；Zhao 1988）。这一辩论的一个迹象是，国务院一所资深智库在 4 月的全国人民代表大会会期上对“适度通货膨胀”论点的抨击（Xue 1996：411）。
Amid the intensifying debate on “appropriate inflation,” Deng scored a major victory to lessen his political vulnerability. In a January 1986 Politburo Standing Committee meeting, Deng managed to shift the main anticorruption effort to the Central Secretariat headed by Qiao Shi, a junior member of Deng’s faction, and away from the CDIC, which was still under Chen Yun’s influence (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2004:1102). Although the CDIC, the CCP’s official anticorruption organ, continued to conduct its own
在关于“适当通货膨胀”争论愈演愈烈之际，邓小平取得了一场重大胜利，从而减轻了他的政治脆弱性。1986 年 1 月的一次政治局常务委员会会议上，邓设法将主要的反腐工作从仍受陈云影响的中央纪律检查委员会转移到由邱实领导的中央书记处——邱实是邓派的一位资历较浅的成员（中共中央文献研究室 2004：1102）。尽管作为中共官方反腐机构的中央纪律检查委员会继续开展其自身的
corruption inquiries, Deng’s faction could now retaliate in kind through the Central Secretariat. Chen Yun no longer had a monopoly on information about the corrupt dealings of his colleagues. Not surprisingly, one of the first cases that the Secretariat investigated involved a subsidiary of the Ministry of Aviation Industry, a heavy industrial ministry directly under the purview of the SPC (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2004: 1106). After this, Deng appeared more emboldened to talk about high-speed development and reform in public. Hu Yaobang likewise urged local cadres in southwestern China to have “the confidence to double (the economy)” (Li 2005: 1076). To regain the initiative, Chen Yun convened a series of anti-corruption and anti smuggling conferences in the spring of 1986 (Fourth Editorial Bureau of the Central Document Research Center 1999). However, no major case broke, rendering these conferences relatively harmless to Deng.
对于腐败调查，邓的派系现在可以通过中央书记处以牙还牙。陈云不再垄断关于同僚腐败交易的信息。不出所料，书记处调查的首批案件之一涉及航空工业部下属的一家子公司——这是一家直接受中央监察体制（SPC）监管的重工业部（中共中央文件研究中心 2004：1106）。此后，邓在公开场合谈及高速发展和改革时显得更加大胆。胡耀邦同样督促西南地区的地方干部要有“把经济翻一番的信心”（李 2005：1076）。为夺回主动权，陈云在 1986 年春召开了一系列反腐败和反走私会议（中央文件研究中心第四编辑局 1999）。然而并未出现重大案件，使这些会议对邓的影响相对有限。
In June 1986, the center’s tight grasp on the money supply began to relax. A PBOC regulation issued at the end of June began: “While we should strive to strengthen and improve macro control over finance, we should support the national economy to grow at an appropriate speed,” an attitude similar to the one proposed by the young economists earlier in the year (People’s Bank of China 1987). In addition to calling for growth, the PBOC decree ordered local branches of the PBOC to provide adequate amount of liquidity to commercial banks to support working capital loans (People’s Bank of China 1987). In one stroke, the credibility of the retrenchment policies was undermined because local branches of the commercial banks could lend to their hearts’ content, only to draw money from the local PBOC when they ran short on liquidity. Although this rule only applied to working capital loans, SOEs were by then well practiced in using working capital loans for fixed asset investment. As Figure 7.1 shows, lending began to grow at a healthy clip from that point onward, although inflationary pressure was not apparent in 1986. As a result of monetary loosening, fixed asset investment in 1986 exceeded the planned amount by 47.7 billion yuan (Xue 1996: 415). In the mean time, Deng took an inspection trip to Tianjin to exhort local officials to “have more courage, grow faster” (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2004: 1130). With low inflation, however, Yao Yilin could only warn local cadres to keep a “clear head” at the Planning Conference at the end of 1986 (Fourth Editorial Bureau of the Central Document Research Center 1999).
1986 年 6 月，中央对货币供应的严格控制开始放松。中国人民银行在 6 月底发布的一项规定开头写道：“在努力加强和完善对金融的宏观调控的同时，应当支持国民经济以适当速度增长，”这一态度与年初那些青年经济学家提出的观点相似（中国人民银行 1987）。除了要求增长外，该人民银行法令还要求人民银行各地分行向商业银行提供足够的流动性以支持周转资金贷款（中国人民银行 1987）。一时间，紧缩政策的可信度被削弱，因为商业银行的地方分行可以尽情放贷，然后在流动性短缺时向当地人民银行抽款。虽然这一规定仅适用于周转资金贷款，但当时国有企业已熟练将周转资金贷款用于固定资产投资。如图 7.1 所示，从那时起贷款开始以健康的速度增长，尽管 1986 年尚未出现明显的通胀压力。 由于货币宽松，1986 年固定资产投资超过计划额 477 亿元（薛 1996: 415）。与此同时，邓赴天津视察，敦促地方官员“多点胆子、多快跑” （中共中央文献研究室 2004: 1130）。然而在通货膨胀率低的情况下，姚依林只能在 1986 年底的计划会议上警告地方干部要保持“清醒的头脑”（中央文献研究室第四编辑室 1999）。
In this loosening environment, Deng’s faction suffered an enormous blow when student protests in late 1986 forced Deng to abandon his designated successor Hu Yaobang. In the ideological realm, Hu Yaobang’s removal introduced a conservative interregnum in which the Party cracked down on manifestations of “spiritual pollution” and “bourgeois liberalization” (Baum 1994: 206). Nonetheless, the damage to Deng personally was limited as even leftist ideologues defended Deng by saying that Hu had tolerated liberal tendencies against Deng’s wishes (Deng 2005: 416). With his authorities intact, Deng managed to appoint his other loyal lieutenant, Zhao Ziyang, to the Party’s top post.
在这种宽松环境中，邓的派系遭受了重创：1986 年末的学生抗议迫使邓放弃其指定接班人胡耀邦。在意识形态领域，胡耀邦被免职引入了一段保守的过渡时期，党对“精神污染”和“资产阶级自由化”的表现进行了打击（鲍姆 1994: 206）。尽管如此，对邓个人的损害有限，因为即便是左翼意识形态者也为邓辩护，称胡在违背邓意愿的情况下容忍了自由倾向（邓 2005: 416）。在权威尚存的情况下，邓设法任命另一位忠诚部下赵紫阳为党的最高职务。
Thus, from January to November 1987, Zhao gained enormous power because he held the posts of premier and CCP General Secretary concurrently.
因此，从 1987 年 1 月到 11 月，赵因为同时担任国务院总理和中共总书记而获得了巨大的权力。
This is not to say that the planners did not try to link Zhao’s renewed drive for decentralization with the student protests. At the infamous January 12, 1987, party life meeting to criticize Hu Yaobang, Yao Yilin and Song Ping, both stalwarts in the planning bureaucracy, spoke out against Hu Yaobang on economic issues. In the case of Song Ping, he blamed “the main comrade of responsibility at the center” for sending confusing signals to local officials, causing the failure of the 1979 economic readjustment (Deng 2005: 451). Song likely used this ambiguous wording to make a veiled attack against Deng himself. Nonetheless, with the economy in good shape, the generalists were able to halt the technocrats’ attempt to link the economic debates with ideological debates by issuing Central Document Number Four, which separated the two sets of issues (Fewsmith 1994: 205).
这并不是说计划派没有试图将赵重新推动的分权与学生抗议联系起来。在臭名昭著的 1987 年 1 月 12 日批判胡耀邦的党内生活会中，计划体制的两位中坚姚依林和宋平在经济问题上对胡耀邦发表了批评。就宋平而言，他将 1979 年经济整顿的失败归咎于“中央负责的主要同志”向地方官员发出混乱信号（Deng 2005: 451）。宋可能使用这种模糊措辞来含蓄地攻击邓本人。尽管如此，在经济状况良好的情况下，泛政治家们通过发布中央四号文件将两类问题分开，从而阻止了技术官僚将经济争论与意识形态争论联系起来的尝试（Fewsmith 1994: 205）。
With the looming succession, Zhao wasted no time to further bolster his popularity among local officials. Almost immediately on Zhao’s promotion to Party Secretary General in mid January, the Central Committee issued a decree encouraging local governments to set up their own financial cooperatives and trust and investment companies to increase investment capital in rural areas. Although local governments had been experimenting with local financial institutions to compete with the state banks, this decree legalized these informal banks “in principle” (CCP Central Committee 1998). In the runup to the fall Thirteenth Party Congress, Zhao lavished more subsidies and preferential policies on his main support base Guangdong. Zhao first allowed Guangdong to increase annual foreign exchange spending by U.S. $ 200 $ 200 $200\$ 200 million for the subsequent few years at a time when the Chinese foreign exchange reserve totaled less than U.S. $ 3 $ 3 $3\$ 3 billion. Furthermore, Zhao granted Guangdong more autonomy to approve foreign direct investment and a 100 million yuan per project limit to help with FDI projects, provided by the PBOC (Central Finance and Economic Leading Group 1988).
随着继任临近，赵没有浪费时间，进一步增强他在地方官员中的人气。几乎在赵于一月中旬晋升为中共中央总书记后不久，中央委员会发布了一项法令，鼓励地方政府建立自己的金融合作社以及信托和投资公司，以增加农村地区的投资资本。尽管地方政府早已在试验与国有银行竞争的地方金融机构，这项法令“原则上”使这些非正式银行合法化（中共中央 1998）。在秋季召开的第十三次党代会筹备期间，赵对他的主要支持基础广东给予了更多补贴和优惠政策。赵首先允许广东在随后几年每年增加用于外汇支出的金额为 U.S. $ 200 $ 200 $200\$ 200 million，而当时中国的外汇储备总额不到 U.S. $ 3 $ 3 $3\$ 3 billion。此外，赵授予广东更多批准外商直接投资的自主权，并由人民银行提供每个项目 1 亿元人民币的上限以扶助外商直接投资项目（中央财经领导小组 1988）。
Unlike previous inflationary cycles, the combination of monetary expansion and rapid growth of consumer goods production generated little inflationary pressure initially. With the economy in relatively stable condition, Chen and the planners lacked the opportunity to reimpose central control over the money supply. Also, the planners might have been placated because one of their own, Li Peng, was chosen to become the new premier at the end of 1987, which deprived Zhao Ziyang the monopoly in economic policy making (Chen 1995a). Because Zhao still headed the Central Finance and Economic Leading Group (CFELG), the technocrats now argued that the decisions of the CFELG should not be binding on the State Council (Chen 1995a). Whereas the technocratic faction had argued for the supremacy of the CFELG previously, they now championed the independence of the State Council from the CFELG because Li Peng, one of their own, was appointed premier. This episode clearly demonstrates that factional considerations drove the redefinition of institutional authorities.
与以往的通货膨胀周期不同，货币扩张与消费品生产的快速增长初期并未产生大的通胀压力。由于经济处于相对稳定状态，陈和规划者们缺乏重新对货币供应施加中央控制的机会。此外，规划者们可能因内部人之一李鹏在 1987 年底被选为新总理而感到安抚，这剥夺了赵紫阳在经济决策中的垄断地位（Chen 1995a）。因为赵仍然主持中央财经领导小组（CFELG），技术官僚们现在主张 CFELG 的决定不应对国务院具有约束力（Chen 1995a）。此前技术官僚派曾主张 CFELG 的至高权威，而在李鹏这一内部人被任命为总理后，他们转而倡导国务院应当独立于 CFELG。此一事件清楚地表明，派系考量推动了对制度权力的重新定义。

The Inflation Debate  通货膨胀之争

The Thirteenth Party Congress in the fall of 1987 elected a new slate of leaders, which gave the technocratic faction more formal control over the economy than any time since the disbanding of the Finance and Economic Committee in 1980. Li Peng, the planner’s designated successor, became Premier, whereas Yao Yilin, the veteran stalwart of the planned economy, retained his post as executive vice premier in charge of the economy. Despite the firm hold over the formal institutions that governed the economy, the planners still lacked control over the CCP’s political machine, which was vital in sending political signals about economic policies to local officials. In other words, without the Central Committee’s full backing, the State Council’s decrees lacked authority and were not obeyed by local officials, whose compliance was crucial for monetary policies. Furthermore, Deng managed to remove Chen Yun from the CDIC and replaced him with his own protégé Qiao Shi, who had been in charge of anticorruption in the Central Secretariat. Thus, Chen Yun lost direct control over a powerful political weapon, the CDIC network that had provided him with information on the corrupt dealings of his colleagues and their families. With diminished political leverage, the technocrats could only regain power when inflation reemerged. But the dominant generalist faction did its best to redefine the bounds of tolerable inflation in order to continue decentralized finance.
1987 年秋季召开的第十三次党代会选举出一批新领导人，这使得技术官僚派对经济的正式控制比自 1980 年财政经济委员会解散以来任何时候都更为牢固。被规划派指定为接班人的李鹏出任国务院总理，而计划经济的资深坚定分子姚依林则保留了主管经济的常务副总理职务。尽管对治理经济的正式体制掌握较牢，但规划者仍然无法控制中共的政治机器，而这对向地方官员传达有关经济政策的政治信号至关重要。换言之，没有中央委员会的全力支持，国务院的法令缺乏权威，地方官员不予遵守，而他们的合规对货币政策至关重要。此外，邓小平设法将陈云从中央纪律检查委员会撤职，改由他自己的门生乔石接替，后者此前在中央书记处负责反腐工作。 因此，陈云失去了对一个强大政治武器的直接控制——为他提供关于同僚及其家属腐败交易信息的 CDIC 网络。随着政治杠杆的减弱，技术官僚们只有在通货膨胀重新出现时才能重新获得权力。但占主导地位的通才派尽最大努力重新界定可容忍通货膨胀的范围，以继续推行分散化的金融。
The Thirteenth Party Congress provided further impetus to monetary decentralization by endorsing the great international cycle theory, which entailed the rapid growth of township and village enterprises to increase export of labor intensive goods (Fewsmith 1994: 215). After receiving Deng’s blessing to “go ahead boldly, increase your pace, and grasp the opportunity” in January 1988, Zhao increased the investment approval authority of the local government and vested the Guangdong PBOC with the power to determine credit ceiling, approve the formation of trust and investment companies, and set the interest rates within a certain band (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2004: 1223; Central Finance and Economic Leading Group 1988; State Council 1988). This was an extension of the local central bank concept first tested in Shenzhen. Despite the planners’ formal control over the State Council, they were powerless to stop Zhao’s continual effort to decentralize monetary control to the provinces.
十三大通过支持大国际周期理论，进一步推动了货币分权化，该理论主张通过乡镇企业的迅速发展来增加劳动密集型商品的出口（Fewsmith 1994: 215）。在 1988 年 1 月得到邓的“大胆前进、加快步伐、把握机遇”的鼓励后，赵增大了地方政府的投资审批权限，并赋予广东 PBOC 决定信贷上限、批准设立信托和投资公司、以及在一定幅度内设定利率的权力（中共中央文献研究中心 2004: 1223；中央财经领导小组 1988；国务院 1988）。这是在深圳首次试验的地方中央银行概念的延伸。尽管规划者对国务院名义上拥有控制权，但他们无力阻止赵持续将货币控制下放到各省的努力。
Beginning in the second half of 1987, however, signs of overheating began to appear.
