Before the Thirteenth Party Congress, State Council economists wrote a series of reports to Zhao, warning him of inflationary pressure on the economy caused by several quarters of rapid increases in lending. At a Politburo meeting, Zhao angrily rebuked these technocrats for depicting the economy as “grave” when it was “in fact lively” and for having “pessimistic attitude that caused one to panic and lose one’s calm” (Xue 1996:415). Countering the claims of the State Council experts, Zhao said that even if demand outstripped supply in the economy, it was simply a matter of 2 0 − 3 0 2 0 − 3 0 20-30\mathbf{2 0 - 3 0} obillion yuan and that the best cure was further growth of production, not retrenchment (Xue 1996: 415). Zhao knew
然而，从 1987 年下半年开始，过热迹象开始出现。在十三大召开之前，国务院的经济学家们给赵写了一系列报告，警告他在连续几个季度信贷快速增长后，经济面临通货膨胀压力。在一次政治局会议上，赵愤怒地斥责这些技术官僚把经济描述为“严重”，而实际上是“活跃”，并指责他们“悲观的态度使人惊慌失措、丧失镇定”（Xue 1996:415）。为反驳国务院专家的主张，赵说即使经济中供不应求，也不过是一个 2 0 − 3 0 2 0 − 3 0 20-30\mathbf{2 0 - 3 0} obillion 元的问题，最好的办法是进一步扩大生产而不是收缩（Xue 1996:415）。赵知道
that the technocrats’ warnings meant the beginning of retrenchment efforts. By dismissing these warnings, he could continue his preferred decentralization policies.
这些技术官僚的警告意味着紧缩努力的开始。通过驳回这些警告，他可以继续他所偏好的分权政策。
This fierce debate about acceptable inflation escalated as the inflation rate climbed rapidly during the first half of 1988. Inflation, especially in major cities, entered double-digit territory, setting off a series of alarms in the State Council bureaucracy. While the State Council issued a stream of reports warning of financial chaos, Zhao’s own economists also shifted into high gear to produce articles supporting “beneficial inflation” and “acceptable inflation” (Xue 1996: 416). Zhao went as far as sending a team of economists to South America to see if China could sustain a high level of inflation similar to that in Latin American countries at the time. Their conclusion, of course, was that China could in fact sustain a high level of inflation (Lam 1995). In a February 1988 CFELG meeting, Yao suggested that the Chinese economy was on the verge of collapse and that retrenchment was urgently needed. Zhao, echoing the arguments of his advisors, argued that a certain degree of inflation was inevitable and that reform should continue despite inflation (Chen 1995a). Even as inflation escalated into the 20 percent range in major cities, Deng told a delegation from North Korea that high speed growth would continue and that “upheavals” were nothing to fear (Deng 1998e). At a Politburo meeting at the end of May 1988, Zhao uttered the notorious comment that suggests how far he was willing to go: “In Brazil, prices increase 15 to 70 percent; how can people live there? - Why can’t we live [with similar price increases?]” (Fewsmith 1994: 223) Although the planners were used to the inflationary preference of Zhao and Deng by that point, they must have been quite shocked by the suggestion to adopt Brazil’s 70 percent inflation.
随着 1988 年上半年通货膨胀率迅速上升，关于可接受通货膨胀的激烈辩论愈演愈烈。通货膨胀，尤其是在大城市，进入了两位数水平，在国务院官僚机构中引发了一连串警报。尽管国务院发布了不断警告金融混乱的报告，赵的经济学家们也加紧行动，撰写支持“有益的通货膨胀”和“可接受的通货膨胀”的文章（Xue 1996：416）。赵甚至派出一个经济学家团队前往南美，考察中国是否能维持类似当时拉美国家的高通货膨胀水平。他们的结论当然是中国事实上可以维持高通货膨胀水平（Lam 1995）。在 1988 年 2 月的一次 CFELG 会议上，姚提出中国经济正处于崩溃边缘，急需收缩政策。赵呼应其顾问的观点，主张一定程度的通货膨胀是不可避免的，尽管有通货膨胀，改革也应继续推进（Chen 1995a）。 即便在主要城市通货膨胀攀升至 20%区间之际，邓小平仍在会见朝鲜代表团时表示高速增长将继续，并且“动乱”无需恐惧（邓 1998e）。在 1988 年 5 月底的一次政治局会议上，赵发表了那句臭名昭著的话，显示出他愿意走多远：“在巴西，物价上涨 15%到 70%；人们怎么能在那里生活？——我们为什么不能（忍受类似的物价上涨）？”]”（Fewsmith 1994: 223）尽管到那时计划者已经习惯了赵和邓的通胀偏好，他们听到要采用巴西那样 70%的通货膨胀建议时一定非常震惊。
As a result of Zhao’s resistance to the State Council’s call for retrenchment, State Council policies to limit money supply did not have the strong language of the previous retrenchments. In any event, local officials did not comply with these decrees because they knew that Deng and Zhao disagreed with the planners. For example, the State Council increased reserve requirement from ɪo percent to 12 percent during the fourth quarter in 1987, but banks continued to lend, forcing the central bank to lend more money to the banks. I I  ^("I "){ }^{\text {I }} Essentially, the effect of increasing the reserve requirement was neutralized by central bank lending to the banks (Liu 2000d). Moreover, the PBOC’s decree on the credit plan issued in March 1988 contained ambiguous provisions that called for strict adherence to fixed asset lending but flexibility in working capital lending (People’s Bank of China 1989c). A June decree from the PBOC contained similar ambivalence in calling for “controlling the macro situation while revitalizing the micro situation,” suggesting local autonomy in lending (People’s Bank of China 1989b).
由于赵抵制国务院的紧缩呼吁，国务院限制货币供给的政策没有像之前那些紧缩政策那样措辞强硬。无论如何，地方官员没有遵守这些法令，因为他们知道邓和赵与计划者意见不一致。例如，国务院在 1987 年第四季度将存款准备金率从 10%提高到 12%，但银行继续放贷，迫使中央银行向银行提供更多贷款。 I I  ^("I "){ }^{\text {I }} 本质上，提高存款准备金率的效果被中央银行对银行的贷款所抵消（Liu 2000d）。此外，中国人民银行在 1988 年 3 月关于信贷计划的法令包含含糊条款，要求对固定资产贷款严格执行但对流动资金贷款保持灵活（People’s Bank of China 1989c）。中国人民银行在 6 月发布的一项法令在“掌控宏观局势并振兴微观局势”方面也表现出类似的模棱两可，暗示地方在放贷方面具有自主权（People’s Bank of China 1989b）。
Unlike their previous reaction of acceding to the planners’ call for contraction, Deng and Zhao held the line on acceptable inflation. Their resolve stemmed from several sources. First, the young economists’ stream of articles about acceptable inflation shifted the debate toward higher tolerance for inflation. Whereas io percent inflation had brought about drastic austerity measures previously, even the planners did not harbor any illusions that io percent inflation would convince Deng to initiate retrenchment in 1988 (Xue 1996: 417). Moreover, Chen and the other central bureaucrats could no longer credibly threaten to abolish the SEZs because they had proved to be such enormous successes. For the moment, the planners did not have any cards to best Deng and Zhao’s audacious call for 70 percent inflation. But because they had a high stake in restoring central control, they did not give up the fight. In May 1988, Chen Yun intimated his deep concern to an old friend: “I no longer manage (monetary policy), but my brain is still thinking about this problem” (Zhao 2005: 27).
与此前为了响应计划者收缩呼声而让步的做法不同，邓小平和赵紫阳在可接受的通货膨胀水平上保持了立场。他们的决心源于几个方面。首先，青年经济学家们关于可接受通货膨胀的一系列文章将讨论转向对更高通胀的容忍。此前 10%的通货膨胀曾导致严厉的紧缩措施，但即便是计划者也不再抱有幻想认为 10%的通货膨胀会说服邓在 1988 年启动收缩（Xue 1996: 417）。此外，陈云和其他中央官僚也不再能可信地威胁要取消经济特区，因为这些特区已被证明取得了巨大的成功。短期内，计划者没有任何筹码能压过邓与赵那大胆主张的 70%通货膨胀。但是由于他们在恢复中央控制方面有重大利益，因而并未放弃斗争。1988 年 5 月，陈云向一位老朋友表示了他深切的担忧：“我不再管理（货币政策），但我的大脑仍在思考这个问题”（Zhao 2005: 27）。

The Price Reform Trap
价格改革陷阱

By the middle of 1988, inflation had climbed past the 20 percent range in many places, but Zhao and Deng continued to broadcast the message of decentralization. In order to regain the policy initiative, the planners knowingly allowed Deng and Zhao to trigger an economic crisis, which resulted in another round of retrenchment. In May 1988, Deng began to call for comprehensive price reform to remove many consumer goods from the list of commodities controlled by the State Planning Commission. When Deng raised the issue at a Politburo meeting in the middle of May, the planners strenuously objected and insisted on a fiveyear timeline (Chen 1995a: 191). Angry about the planners’ opposition, Deng announced his desire for price reform in a series of statements to foreign guests. These remarks increased the pressure on the planners to further decentralize power and liberalize prices. Although Chen Yun had retired from the CDIC by that point, he still had great influence on the massive planning apparatus, which had enormous research and information gathering capabilities. He used these capabilities to set a political trap for Deng and Zhao in order to regain central control.
到 1988 年年中，许多地方的通货膨胀已升至 20%以上，但赵和邓仍继续宣扬分权的信息。为了重夺政策主动权，计划部门有意允许邓和赵引发一场经济危机，导致又一轮紧缩。1988 年 5 月，邓开始呼吁全面价格改革，将许多消费品从国家计划委员会管制的商品清单中剔除。邓在五月中旬的政治局会议上提出此议题时，计划部门强烈反对并坚持五年时间表（Chen 1995a: 191）。对计划部门的反对感到愤怒的邓在一系列对外宾的讲话中宣布了他对价格改革的愿望。这些言论增加了对计划部门进一步分权和放开价格的压力。尽管到那时陈云已从中央财政经济委员会退休，但他仍对庞大的计划机构具有巨大影响力，该机构拥有庞大的研究和信息收集能力。他利用这些能力为邓和赵设下政治圈套，以夺回中央控制权。
Under pressure from Deng, the Politburo decided to speed up price liberalization, but Chen and others insisted that economic policies had to be made by the State Council. Thus, Yao Yilin was put in charge of drafting a plan for price liberalization, to be discussed at the Beidaihe Meeting in August 1988 (Chen 1995a). Predictably, Yao delegated the task to the SPC, which convened a conference in June to discuss the implications of price liberalization. State Council researchers all warned that price liberalization would further increase inflationary pressure and possibly trigger panic buying and that Zhao’s suggestion to provide living expense subsidies to offset the costs of inflation to households would generate even more inflation (Xue 1996:417). 2 2 ^(2){ }^{2} As all the participants
在邓的压力下，政治局决定加快价格放开，但陈云等人坚持认为经济政策必须由国务院制定。因此，姚依林被安排负责起草价格放开的方案，准备在 1988 年 8 月的北戴河会议上讨论（Chen 1995a）。不出所料，姚将这一任务下放给了国家计划委员会，后者于 6 月召开会议讨论价格放开的影响。国务院的研究人员一致警告说，价格放开将进一步增加通货膨胀压力，并可能引发抢购潮；赵的建议，即向家庭提供生活费用补贴以抵消通货膨胀带来的成本，可能会导致更严重的通货膨胀（Xue 1996:417）。 2 2 ^(2){ }^{2} 当所有与会者...
were researchers from the planning bureaucracy, it was not surprising that they drew these conclusions, but they also happened to be right.
他们来自计划机构的研究人员，因此他们得出这些结论并不令人惊讶，但他们恰好也是正确的。
As inflation continued to climb in the summer of 1988, Chen Yun told Yao to organize a secret team of senior SPC officials to draft concrete plans for the upcoming retrenchment (Chen 1995a: 195). How did Chen know that retrenchment was forthcoming? State Council researchers had warned that price liberalization would translate inflation into panic buying and a run on the banks. Knowing that, Chen and Yao gambled that an announcement by the Central Committee to launch price reform would provoke panic buying and a run on the state banking system, which would create a sufficiently grave crisis to initiate austerity. Their best course of action was to put up minimal resistance to price liberalization at the next Beidaihe meeting. The planners had the best of both worlds. On the one hand, Deng and Zhao were the main proponents of price reform, so they would be held responsible if price reform ended in disaster. On the other hand, Yao and Li Peng had actual control over liberalization policies, so they could slow down the process if disaster did not strike.
随着 1988 年夏季通货膨胀持续上升，陈云告诉姚组织一个由最高人民法院高级官员组成的秘密小组，为即将到来的紧缩制定具体计划（Chen 1995a: 195）。陈怎么知道紧缩即将到来？国务院研究人员曾警告说，价格放开会把通货膨胀转化为抢购和银行挤兑。了解这一点后，陈与姚押注中央委员会宣布启动价格改革会引发抢购和对国有银行体系的挤兑，从而制造出足以启动紧缩政策的严重危机。他们最好的策略是在下次北戴河会议上对价格放开做出最小程度的阻力。策划者从中获得了双重利益。一方面，邓小平和赵是价格改革的主要倡导者，因此如果价格改革以灾难告终，他们将被追究责任。另一方面，姚和李鹏实际上掌控着自由化政策，因此如果灾难没有发生，他们可以放慢进程。
When the top leadership reconvened in Beidaihe to discuss comprehensive price reform in the middle of August, Yao presented his still conservative plan for price liberalization. According to one of Zhao’s aids, Zhao was dissatisfied with the pace of liberalization stated in Yao’s plan and proposed a much more comprehensive and rapid liberalization pace in 1989 (Wu 1997: 529). Zhao was not entirely unaware of the risks associated with price reform. At the meeting, Zhao stated that inflation was a possible risk they all had to accept for pushing forward this reform. In order to minimize the impact of price reform, Zhao suggested a simultaneous tightening of fixed asset investment and steel production to prevent the explosion of construction projects (Wu 1997: 530).
当最高领导层在八月中旬重返北戴河讨论全面价格改革时，姚提出了他仍然较为保守的价格放开方案。根据赵的一位助手的说法，赵对姚方案中所述的放开进度不满意，并在 1989 年提出了一个更全面、更迅速的放开进度（Wu 1997: 529）。赵并非完全不了解价格改革所带来的风险。会议上，赵指出通货膨胀是他们为推进这项改革不得不接受的一个可能风险。为了将价格改革的影响降到最低，赵建议同时收紧固定资产投资和钢铁生产，以防止建设项目的爆发性增长（Wu 1997: 530）。
The planners apparently changed course entirely and immediately endorsed price reform in principle (Chen 1995a). What was more, they endorsed the suggestion to “appropriately increase and adjust wages and appropriately increase subsidies to guarantee that the living standard of most workers does not decline” (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000). They supported something that SPC experts had told them repeatedly would exacerbate inflationary pressure, which further suggests their duplicity. At the meeting, one of the few people who spoke up against Zhao’s plan for price reform was then party secretary of Shanghai Jiang Zemin, who argued that “the psychological tolerance of the people (for instability) is low” (Wu 1997: 527). As a junior Politburo member in faraway Shanghai, Jiang was likely unaware of the technocrats’ plan, but his support for conservative price policies doubtless pleased Chen Yun. After receiving a final blessing from Deng on August 19, Zhao had the People’s Daily - the official mouthpiece of the Party - announce the price reform (Wu 1997: 532). On seeing the announcement, urban residents
筹划者显然完全改变了路线，并立即原则上支持价格改革（Chen 1995a）。更重要的是，他们还赞同“适当提高和调整工资，适当增加补贴，保证大多数职工生活水平不降低”的建议（中共中央文献研究室 2000）。他们支持了国家计委专家反复告诉他们会加剧通货膨胀压力的做法，这进一步表明了他们的两面性。在会议上，少数反对赵氏价格改革计划的人之一是时任上海市委书记的江泽民，他认为“人民的心理承受能力（对不稳定的承受力）很低”（Wu 1997: 527）。作为身处遥远上海的年轻政治局委员，江可能并不知情于技术官僚的计划，但他对保守价格政策的支持无疑使陈云感到满意。在 8 月 19 日得到邓的最终首肯后，赵让党的机关报《人民日报》宣布了价格改革（Wu 1997: 532）。在看到这一公告时，城市居民
immediately knew that price reform meant substantial price hikes, and they lost no time going to the stores.
立刻就知道价格改革意味着大幅涨价，于是他们毫不犹豫地赶去商店。
Although the true extent of the panic buying and the concurrent run on the banks remain state secrets, available material suggests that the run on the banks began in Nanjing and Hangzhou and quickly spread to the rest of the country (Liu 1993). Bank deposits, which had been growing at 30 percent for the past few years, suddenly declined, suggesting that massive amounts of funds were suddenly withdrawn and used for purchases (Liu 1993). On receiving reports of these incidents, Zhao immediately saw an economic and political disaster in the making. Economically, in order to meet the demands of depositors, the central bank would have to make large quantities of reloans available to the Big Four banks, which would have further exacerbated inflation. Politically, although both he and Deng were active proponents of the liberalization, Zhao knew he would take the brunt of the criticism from both his rivals and Deng’s rivals, much as Hu Yaobang had taken all the blame for political liberalization. At the same time, he did not want to be the one to tell Deng that price reform had to be abandoned. Zhao’s way out was to call on Yao Yilin to ask for his opinion, and Yao invariably advised retrenchment and a slow-down in liberalization (Wu 1997: 538). Zhao then contacted several Party elders, including Bo Yibo, Wan Li, Yang Shangkun, and Deng’s bodyguard Wang Ruilin, and asked them to gently suggest abandoning price reform to Deng. 3 3 ^(3){ }^{3} Deng concurred, but he was not pleased by the development. When Wang Ruilin broached the subject with Deng, he agreed - likely because he did not want Zhao to also fall from power - but said, “I don’t want to talk about this anymore (butanle)” (Wu 1997: 538).
尽管恐慌性抢购和同时发生的银行挤兑的真实规模仍属国家机密，但现有材料表明，银行挤兑始于南京和杭州，并迅速蔓延到全国其他地区（Liu 1993）。此前几年来一直以 30%速度增长的银行存款突然下降，表明大量资金被突然提取并用于购买（Liu 1993）。在接到这些事件的报告后，赵立即预见到一场正在酝酿的经济和政治灾难。在经济方面，为了满足储户的提款需求，中央银行将不得不向四大银行提供大量再贷款，这将进一步加剧通货膨胀。在政治方面，尽管他和 Deng 都是自由化的积极支持者，赵知道他将像胡耀邦为政治自由化承担全部责任那样，成为他的对手和 Deng 的对手指责的主要对象。同时，他也不愿成为告诉 Deng 必须放弃价格改革的那个人。 赵的出路是请姚依林征求意见，姚总是建议紧缩并放慢自由化步伐（Wu 1997: 538）。随后赵又联系了几位党内元老，包括薄一波、万里、杨尚昆和邓的小舱警王瑞林，请他们婉转地向邓建议放弃价格改革。 3 3 ^(3){ }^{3} 邓表示同意，但他对这一进展并不高兴。当王瑞林向邓提出此事时，邓也同意——很可能是因为他不希望赵也下台——但他说，“我不想再谈这件事了（不谈了）”（Wu 1997: 538）。
With Deng’s acquiescence, the State Council meeting on August 30, 1988, passed a stern resolution to freeze prices and limit investment and lending for the remainder of the year (State Council 1993b). On September 2, a Politburo meeting decided to pursue the goal of “correction and rectification” (zhili zhengdun), while delaying price reform indefinitely. The reversal of policy came less than two weeks after the price reform announcement. The Politburo meeting also gave the planners a chance to criticize Zhao and Deng for pursuing price reform and for ignoring inflationary risks. Li Peng conveyed the most direct criticism: “The reason we have to change course is that we have underestimated certain things” (Wu 1997: 538). There was little that Zhao could have said to rebut Li’s charges. He did underestimate certain risks associated with price liberalization, partly because the planners had kept their analysis from him. Regardless, the failed price reform was a major blow to Zhao’s prestige and to the generalists’ attempt to decentralize monetary control.
在邓的默认下，1988 年 8 月 30 日的国务院会议通过了一项严厉决议，决定冻结物价并在当年余下时间内限制投资和放贷（State Council 1993b）。9 月 2 日，政治局会议决定推行“纠正和整顿”（zhili zhengdun）的目标，同时无限期推迟价格改革。政策的逆转发生在价格改革宣布不到两周后。政治局会议也给了计划者们一个机会，批评赵与邓推动价格改革并忽视通胀风险。李鹏表达了最直接的指责：“我们不得不改变方针的原因是我们低估了一些东西”（吴 1997：538）。赵几乎无话可驳斥李的指控。他确实低估了与价格自由化相关的某些风险，部分原因是计划者对他隐瞒了他们的分析。不管怎样，失败的价格改革对赵的声望以及一般派分散货币控制的尝试都是一次重大打击。
To ensure centralization, Chen Yun launched another dual-track attack on Deng, this time targeting his son Deng Pufang. Originally started by Deng’s son as a way to raise funds for the China Associations for the Disabled, Kanghua Corporation by 1988 had thoroughly exploited the Deng family name and had transformed into a corrupt business empire (He and Gao 2000: 542; Quan 1994). In the summer of 1988, an anonymous commentator penned an editorial in the People’s Daily, the party’s official mouthpiece, detailing corrupt practices at Kanghua (Quan 1994: 152). This editorial, penned by a State Council official, was obviously aimed at unbalancing Deng. At the September 2 Politburo meeting, a beleaguered Zhao defended Deng’s honor by charging that someone who “opposed reform” had been spreading rumors about Deng Xiaoping and other top leaders and that these rumors were groundless. He ended his remarks with an intentional comment: “The problems with Kanghua are not the same as Deng Pufang” (Wu 1997: 540). Although Deng Pufang was never directly implicated, these accusations helped State Council bureaucrats in their main struggle to recentralize financial policies.
为确保中央集权，陈云对邓小平发动了另一轮双轨攻击，这次把矛头指向他的儿子邓朴方。康华公司最初由邓朴方发起，作为为中国残疾人联合会筹款的方式，但到 1988 年，康华已彻底利用邓家名望，变成一个腐败的商业帝国（He and Gao 2000: 542；Quan 1994）。1988 年夏天，一位匿名评论员在党的喉舌《人民日报》上撰写社论，详述康华的腐败行为（Quan 1994: 152）。这篇由一位国务院官员撰写的社论，显然旨在动摇邓小平的地位。在 9 月 2 日的政治局会议上，处于困境的赵紫阳为邓小平辩护，指控有人“反对改革”并散布关于邓小平及其他高层领导的谣言，这些谣言毫无根据。他在发言末尾故意说道：“康华的问题不等同于邓朴方的问题”（Wu 1997: 540）。尽管邓朴方从未被直接牵连，这些指控仍有助于国务院官僚在其旨在重新集中财政策略的主要斗争中取得优势。
After the Politburo made the decision on “correction and rectification,” the central planners quickly implemented the retrenchment plan they had prepared in secret. Investment and monetary centralization was a major component of the correction program. On August 30, 1988, the same day that the State Council first announced retrenchment, the PBOC rolled out its decree to freeze all lending, including working capital loans. The language of the decree left little room for ambiguity: “Whoever breaks the quota will take responsibility, and we will hold the managers of banks responsible” (People’s Bank of China 1989a). Moreover, this decree pronounced that PBOC lending would be frozen at the level of 1987. Local bank managers who exceeded the credit ceiling would be punished, and they could no longer go to the PBOC for an emergency loan. Although compliance was not immediate, decrees issued by the PBOC and the State Council after the end of August left no doubt that local officials who did not adhere to the credit ceiling would be punished. This time, local officials knew the threat was credible because the Party had issued its full backing of the retrenchment.
在中央政治局作出“纠正和整顿”的决定后，中央计划者迅速实施了他们秘密准备的紧缩计划。投资和货币集中是整顿方案的一个重要组成部分。1988 年 8 月 30 日，国务院首次宣布紧缩的同一天，中国人民银行发布了冻结一切贷款（包括流动资金贷款）的法令。该法令的措辞几乎没有模糊余地：“谁突破额度谁负责，我们要追究银行经理的责任”（中国人民银行 1989a）。此外，该法令宣布中国人民银行的放贷将冻结在 1987 年的水平。超出信贷上限的地方银行经理将受到惩处，且不得再向中国人民银行申请紧急贷款。尽管遵守并非立即到位，但中国人民银行和国务院在 8 月底之后发布的法令毫无疑问地表明，不遵守信贷上限的地方官员将受到惩罚。这一次，地方官员知道这一威胁是可信的，因为党已对紧缩给予了全面支持。

Tiananmen  天安门

The combination of the panic buying and a potential investigation of his son frustrated Deng’s call for high growth once again. Nonetheless, Deng recovered fairly quickly and was ready to loosen retrenchment policies in early 1989. In a private conversation with central leaders in February, Deng played down the economic crisis and pressed for faster reform: “A while back, there were some mistakes, but it was not a big deal. It is not worth such a big fuss . . . in the long term, the pace of reform cannot be too slow” (Deng 1998c: 436). Rather than simply expressing this view privately, Deng also disclosed his opinion publicly to the Ugandan president in March 1989: “Many countries in the world have higher inflation than us. If the thinking of the people unite, it will not be hard to correct” (Deng 1993a: 289). In the spring National People’s Congress (NPC)
恐慌性抢购与对其子可能展开的调查再次挫败了邓对高增长的要求。尽管如此，邓很快恢复过来，并在 1989 年初准备放松紧缩政策。2 月在一次与中央领导人的私下谈话中，邓淡化了经济危机并敦促加快改革：“前一阵子确实有些错误，但并不是什么大事。不值得大惊小怪……从长远看，改革的步伐不能太慢”（Deng 1998c: 436）。邓不只是私下表达这一观点，1989 年 3 月他还向乌干达总统公开表明了自己的看法：“世界上许多国家的通货膨胀比我们高。如果大家的思想统一了，纠正起来并不难”（Deng 1993a: 289）。在春季全国人民代表大会（NPC）
session, Zhao Ziyang vetoed a draft of Li Peng’s report to the NPC delegates, which discussed the errors in economic policies in the past few years (Deng 2005: 251). 4 4 ^(4){ }^{4} Clearly, the generalists were prepared to revive decentralization.
会议上，赵紫阳否决了李鹏提交给人大代表的一份报告草案，该草案讨论了过去数年经济政策中的错误（Deng 2005: 251）。 4 4 ^(4){ }^{4} 显然，普遍派已准备好恢复分权。
Before generalists had a chance to revitalize the offensive against the planners, however, the former General Secretary Hu Yaobang suddenly died of a heart attack, triggering massive student protests in Beijing. For the next two months, the central government was completely paralyzed by the political crisis. Ultimately, despite Zhao’s opposition, Deng and the other elders decided to use military force to end the standoff at Tiananmen Square. Even before the final bloody crackdown, the ideological debate over the causes of the Tiananmen Square protest began. Although there was an ideological debate between Deng and his ideological rivals, the planners ended up siding with Deng on the ideological debate but exacted a heavy toll from Deng in terms of centralizing the economy and choosing the successor to Zhao. This bargain between them lends further credence to the notion that disagreement over economic management, rather than ideological disputes, constituted the root of the divide between Deng and Chen. If the planners had been driven by ideological concern, they could have simply made a pact with the ideologues to turn the clock back to Mao’s days. Instead, they opted to support the continuation of reform, albeit in a more centralized manner. Likewise, the dominant generalist faction trusted the technocrats enough to delegate to them enormous economic powers because it knew the technocrats did not aim to take overall control of the Party. Indeed, at Deng’s weakest moment in the aftermath of the Tiananmen Square massacre, Chen Yun’s technocratic faction threw its support behind Deng, thereby preserving Deng’s dominance in the CCP.
然而，在主张改革的一般派有机会重新发动对计划经济派的攻势之前，前中共中央总书记胡耀邦突发心脏病去世，触发了北京的大规模学生抗议。在接下来的两个月里，中央政府因这场政治危机完全瘫痪。最终，尽管赵反对，邓小平和其他元老决定动用军队结束天安门广场的对峙。即便在最后血腥的镇压之前，关于天安门广场抗议原因的意识形态争论已经开始。尽管邓与他的意识形态对手之间存在意识形态上的分歧，计划经济派在意识形态争论中最终站在了邓一边，但他们在经济中央集权和选择赵的接班人方面向邓索取了沉重代价。他们之间的这一交易进一步证明了这样一种观点：围绕经济管理的分歧，而非意识形态争执，是邓与陈之间分歧的根源。如果计划经济派出于意识形态考量，他们完全可以与意识形态者结盟，将时间倒回到毛时代。 相反，他们选择支持改革的延续，尽管以更集中的方式进行。同样，占主导地位的通才派信任技术官僚，愿意把巨大的经济权力下放给他们，因为通才派知道技术官僚并不打算全面掌控党。事实上，在天安门大屠杀后的邓最弱时刻，陈云的技术官僚派系站出来支持邓，从而维护了邓在中共内部的主导地位。
As the student demonstrations intensified in the summer of 1989, Deng’s position became increasingly vulnerable to criticism. This vulnerability stemmed first from Zhao’s lenient stance toward the students. Twice in one decade, Deng’s designated successors proved themselves incapable of defending the dictatorship of the proletariat, which seriously called Deng’s credibility into question. What was worse, the demonstrators in Tiananmen Square were protesting some of the direct results of the reform: inflation, corruption, and inequality. This provided conservative Marxists ample ammunition to criticize Deng’s reform program.
随着 1989 年夏季学生示威的加剧，邓的地位越来越容易受到批评。这种脆弱性首先源于赵对学生的宽容立场。十年间两度，邓指定的接班人证明自己无法捍卫无产阶级专政，这严重动摇了邓的信誉。更糟的是，天安门广场的示威者在抗议改革的一些直接后果：通货膨胀、腐败和不平等。这为保守的马克思主义者提供了充分的弹药来批评邓的改革方案。
By the middle of May, the elders had decided to remove Zhao from the post of CCP General Secretary, and the ideological conservatives were increasingly vocal in their denunciation of the reform. Although their criticism was mainly directed at Zhao, they also criticized Deng and the reform indirectly.
到五月中旬，老一辈已经决定免去赵的中共中央总书记职务，意识形态上的保守派在谴责改革方面愈发高声。尽管他们的批评主要针对赵，但也间接批评了邓和改革。
For example, Hu Qiaomu, a veteran ideologue who had plotted the downfall of Hu Yaobang, remarked: “Comrade Zhao Ziyang never flatly championed privatization, but his reforms were always tilted in favor of enterprises that had low degrees of public ownership” (Secretariat of the Fourth Plenum of the CCP Thirtenth Central Committee 2001). Because everyone knew that Deng had supported Zhao’s call for developing township-village enterprises on the coast, Hu Qiaomu’s comment did not just target Zhao.
例如，资深意识形态工作者胡乔木——曾策划打倒胡耀邦——曾评论说：“赵紫阳同志从来不曾断然支持私有化，但他的改革总是偏向于那些公有成分较低的企业”（中共第十三届中央委员会第四次全体会议秘书处 2001）。因为人人都知道邓曾支持赵关于在沿海发展乡镇企业的主张，胡乔木的这番话并不仅仅是针对赵。
With a possible reversal of the reform, Deng soon approached Chen Yun and Li Xiannian to make a pact to preserve the reform. The pact composed of elevating Jiang Zemin to the post of General Secretary, preserving the overall direction of reform, and a three-year retrenchment to “correct and readjust.” The pact was apparently made between May 21 and 26, when Deng held a series of private meetings with Chen Yun, Li Xiannian and other revolutionary elders to hammer out the future of the regime (Party Central Office Secretariat 2001c). 5 5 ^(5){ }^{5} On May 21, the elders held a preliminary meeting about the successor to Zhao. At the meeting, Li Xiannian and Chen had backed Jiang Zemin, someone with a central bureaucratic pedigree who had dealt with the protests in Shanghai without shedding blood, whereas Deng had supported Li Ruihuan, someone with similar localist disposition as Zhao (Party Central Office Secretariat 2001b). By May 26 - after intense negotiations among Deng, Chen, and the other elders - Chen Yun made a short speech at the Central Advisory Committee stating that everything must be done to preserve the regime “granted to us by 20 million revolutionary martyrs who had forfeited their lives” and that Deng should remain the core of the CCP leadership (Deng 2005: 501). After Chen Yun acknowledged Deng’s continual dominance in the Party, Deng reciprocated at a May 27 meeting by switching his vote to support Jiang Zemin and also by agreeing to elevate Song Ping, a veteran planner and Chen loyalist, to the Standing Committee. In return, Chen voiced his support for the continuation of reform and agreed to elevate Li Ruihuan to the Standing Committee of the Politburo (Party Central Office Secretariat 200Ic). The pact was announced to the rest of the leadership at the end of May when Deng had a discussion with Li Peng and Yao Yilin, who had not attended the May 27 meeting. In his remarks to Li and Yao, Deng left no doubt as to the nature of his pact with Chen and Li: “the policies of reform and opening remain unchanged… I’ve consulted with comrades Li Xiannian and Chen on this, and they both concur” (Party Central Office Secretariat 2001a). Tragically for the students on Tiananmen Square,
随着改革可能被逆转，邓很快与陈云、李先念接触，达成一项维持改革的协议。该协议包括提拔江泽民为总书记、保持改革的总体方向，以及为期三年的“整顿和调整”。这项协议显然是在 5 月 21 日至 26 日之间达成的，期间邓与陈云、李先念及其他革命元老举行了一系列私人会谈，以敲定政权的未来（Party Central Office Secretariat 2001c）。 5 5 ^(5){ }^{5} 5 月 21 日，元老们就赵的接班人举行了预备会议。在会议上，李先念和陈支持江泽民——一位具有中央官僚血统、在上海处理抗议时未流血的人选，而邓则支持李瑞环——一位在地方主义倾向上与赵相似的人选（Party Central Office Secretariat 2001b）。 到 5 月 26 日——在邓小平、陈云和其他元老经过激烈谈判之后——陈云在中央顾问委员会作了简短讲话，称一切必须为维护由“2000 万为国捐躯的革命烈士”赋予我们的政权而做，并主张邓应继续作为中共领导核心（Deng 2005: 501）。在陈云承认邓在党内的持续主导地位后，邓在 5 月 27 日的会议上也以切换票支持江泽民并同意提升陈云的拥护者、资深计划家宋平进入常委作为回报。此外，陈表示支持继续推进改革，并同意将李瑞环提升为政治局常委（Party Central Office Secretariat 200Ic）。在 5 月底邓与当时未出席 5 月 27 日会议的李鹏和姚依林进行讨论后，这一协议向其他领导层公开宣布。 在对李和姚的谈话中，邓毫不含糊地说明了他与陈、李之间协议的性质：“改革开放的方针没有改变……我已就此与李先念同志和陈（云）同志商量过，他们都同意”（中共中央办公厅秘书室 2001a）。 对天安门广场的学生们来说，可悲的是，
the pact between Deng and Chen was predicated on decisive military action to suppress the demonstrations.
邓与陈之间的协议以采取决定性的军事行动镇压示威为前提。
The other element of the pact, the continuation of centralized control, gradually became apparent in the following days. At a Politburo meeting on June 6, Deng echoed Yao’s call for reversing the economic chaos that had been unleashed because of the demonstration (Party Central Office Secretariat 2001d). On June 16, when Deng met with the new Standing Committee for the first time, he urged them to pursue reform, but also stated that “the Party central and the State Council must have the power and the authority in these (economic) affairs” (Party Central Office Secretariat 2001e). In a September 1989 meeting, Deng echoed Chen Yun’s criticism of local autonomy, a reversal of his usual sentiment of encouraging local experimentation: “Comrade Chen Yun said that there are too many dukes (zhuhou, local officials), and they talk but do not decide, decide but do not act, and govern on their own. This criticism is correct” (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000). The pact was formalized at the Fourth Plenum in November, when the Central Committee passed the “Decision to Further Correct and Rectify and to Deepen Reform” (Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party 1989). While affirming the goals of reform and opening, the document also called for further central control over the economy, a slower growth rate of 5 − 6 5 − 6 5-65-6 percent, and a threeyear retrenchment period. In order to preserve the reform and to preserve the political status quo, Deng opted to delegate financial authorities to the central bureaucrats. For the first time since the reform, the bureaucrats had free rein over the economy for a sustained period of time. Deng, however, gave the central bureaucracy barely three years to “correct and readjust.”
协议的另一要素——延续集中控制——在随后几天逐渐显现。6 月 6 日的政治局会议上，邓回应了姚的呼吁，要求扭转因示威而引发的经济混乱（Party Central Office Secretariat 2001d）。6 月 16 日，邓第一次与新的常务委员会会面时，敦促他们推进改革，但也指出“党中央信和国务院必须在这些（经济）事务上拥有权力和威信”（Party Central Office Secretariat 2001e）。在 1989 年 9 月的一次会议上，邓响应了陈云对地方自治的批评，这与他一贯鼓励地方试验的态度相反：“陈云同志说，诸候太多了，他们会说但不决定，决定但不执行，各自行事。这种批评是正确的”（Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000）。这一协议在 11 月的第四次全体会议上被正式化，中央委员会通过了《进一步纠正整顿并深化改革的决定》（Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party 1989）。 在肯定改革开放目标的同时，该文件还要求进一步加强中央对经济的控制，将增长速度放缓到 5 − 6 5 − 6 5-65-6 个百分点，并实行为期三年的收缩期。为了维护改革并维持政治现状，邓小平选择将金融权力委托给中央官僚。自改革以来，这是官僚们首次在一段持续时期内对经济拥有完全自主权。然而，邓小平只给中央官僚大约三年的时间来“纠正和整顿”。”

A New Generation of Central Bureaucrats and the Southern Tour, 1991-1996
新一代中央官僚与南巡，1991–1996

The 1989 crackdown inaugurated a three-year retrenchment period in which macroeconomic policies were highly centralized. Total central control over economic policies did not translate to a return to the planned economy era. Rather, the central bureaucracy undertook to reshape the government from micromanagers of the economy to having more macroleverage over the economy. Rather than a giant setback for reform, this important transformation also brought China closer to a fully functioning market economy. Deng, however, remained extremely dissatisfied with the bureaucrats’ stifling policies because he saw the effect of a stagnating economy on the Soviet Union. As the crescendo of local complaints increased in 1991 because money supply did not provide sufficient liquidity for the rapidly growing economy, Deng decided to embark on two trips to the South to unlock the center’s hold on the economy. He was wildly successful in his effort to unleash high growth, but his trips once again heightened inflationary pressure.
1989 年的镇压开启了为期三年的收缩期，在此期间宏观经济政策高度集中。对经济政策的全面中央控制并没有意味着回到计划经济时代。相反，中央官僚机构着手将政府从经济的事无巨细管理者转变为对经济拥有更大宏观杠杆的角色。这一重要转型并非改革的巨大挫折，而是使中国更接近一个完全运作的市场经济。然而，邓小平对官僚们扼杀性的政策仍极为不满，因为他看到了苏联停滞经济的后果。随着 1991 年地方抱怨的高涨——因为货币供应未能为迅速增长的经济提供足够的流动性——邓决定南巡两次以解除中央对经济的控制。他在推动高增长方面取得了巨大成功，但他的南巡再次加剧了通货膨胀压力。
At the same time, the newly appointed General Secretary Jiang Zemin faced increasing threats from an array of potential challengers after Deng’s passing.
与此同时，新的总书记江泽民在邓逝世后面临来自一系列潜在挑战者的日益增长的威胁。
The succession pressure initially motivated Jiang to echo Deng’s decentralization drive and to channel generous financial resources to his home base Shanghai, and also to politically powerful Guangdong. As inflation climbed into dangerous territory, however, Jiang needed to prevent a slide into financial chaos while maintaining his own tenuous hold on the top post. In 1993, however, the declining health of both Chen Yun and Yao Yilin greatly diminished their ability to rein in inflation. Just as China was poised to enter the realm of hyperinflation, Deng and Chen both agreed to make an unlikely candidate the new economic tsar of China, Zhu Rongji. Although a well-known technocrat by that time, both Deng and Chen struggled in the last years of their lives to make Zhu a credible politician by giving him enormous power that surpassed even the power held by Premier Li Peng. With the rise of Zhu Rongji as a powerful technocrat, Jiang delegated financial authorities to Zhu in order to focus on the task of power consolidation in the regime. Despite the tension between the two leaders over financial and economic policies, they both recognized the need to cooperate in order to consolidate the power of the new leadership in preparation for Deng’s passing.
接班压力最初促使江泽民响应邓小平的分权推动，并把大量财政资源输送到他的老家上海，以及政治上势力强大的广东。然而，随着通货膨胀攀升到危险地带，江必须在维护自己对最高职位的脆弱控制的同时，防止滑入金融混乱。1993 年，陈云和姚依林的健康状况恶化，大大削弱了他们遏制通货膨胀的能力。就在中国即将进入恶性通货膨胀的边缘时，邓和陈都同意任命一个不太可能的人选——朱镕基，成为新的经济总管。尽管那时朱已是知名的技术官僚，但邓和陈在生命的最后几年里努力通过赋予他巨大的权力使他成为一个可信的政治人物，这些权力甚至超过了李鹏总理所掌握的权力。随着朱镕基作为强势技术官僚的崛起，江把金融权力下放给朱，以便集中精力完成对政权的权力巩固任务。 尽管两位领导人在金融和经济政策上存在紧张关系，他们都认识到需要合作以巩固新领导层的权力，为邓的辞世做准备。
More so than the previous cases, this case shows that the main struggle in financial policies during reform era was not an ideological one or one between status quo and reform. Even during the height of retrenchment in the early 1990s, reform did not stall completely. A different kind of reform, one which involved re-engineering central power, took place. Also, the continuation of the struggle between the two kinds of factions over monetary policies after the passing of the original revolutionary generation suggests that the factional framework presented here can be generalized to the entire reform era, not just to the Deng-Chen era.
与前几例相比，本案例更清楚地表明，改革时期金融政策的主要斗争并非意识形态之争，也不是守旧与改革之间的对立。即使在 1990 年代初收缩政策高峰期，改革也并未完全停滞。另一种类型的改革——涉及重构中央权力的改革——正在进行。此外，在原革命一代逝世之后，两类派系在货币政策上的持续斗争表明，此处提出的派系框架可以推广到整个改革时期，而不仅限于邓陈时代。
Finally, the rise of Zhu Rongji illustrates the mechanism by which Chinese officials fall into either a generalist or a technocratic faction. For most officials, that choice came early in their careers when they entered either provincial government or the central bureaucracy. Their choice of faction was determined by the institutional location of their network of supporters. Because of his unusual career pattern, Zhu Rongji had a choice in 1992 to either side with Deng’s drive for decentralization or to establish himself as the next economic tsar of the central government. He chose the latter course because of a political calculation that took into account both his support network and his desire to become the next premier.
最后，朱镕基的崛起揭示了中国官员如何落入“通才派”或“技术官僚派”的机制。对于大多数官员而言，这一选择在其职业生涯早期进入省级政府或中央机关时就已形成。他们派系的选择取决于其支持者网络所处的制度位置。由于其非同寻常的职业轨迹，朱镕基在 1992 年面临两难，可以选择支持邓的小政府分权推动，或确立自己作为中央政府下一任经济权威的地位。他选择了后者，这一选择是基于一种政治权衡，既考虑了他的支持网络，也考虑了他成为下一任国务院总理的愿望。

Macro-Adjustment Power  宏观调节权力

The intellectual foundation for re-engineering the central bureaucracy to serve the market economy was formed in the 1980s. In the mid-1980s, while Zhao’s economists produced treatises on acceptable inflation, researchers who worked in the traditional economic bureaucracy saw the inflationary cycles as a sign of weakening central power. Early proponents of re-engineering central power included Xue Muqiao, Wu Jinglian, and Liu Hongru. Whereas the former two were macroeconomic specialists at a State Council think-tank, the latter was a
在 20 世纪 80 年代，重塑中央官僚机构以服务市场经济的思想基础逐步形成。20 世纪 80 年代中期，当赵家的经济学家撰写关于可接受通货膨胀的论著时，在传统经济官僚体制内工作的研究人员则将这些通货膨胀周期视为中央权力削弱的迹象。重塑中央权力的早期支持者包括薛暮桥、吴敬琏和刘洪儒。前两者是国务院智库的宏观经济专家，而后者是位于...
financial specialist, who served as the vice governor of the PBOC in the mid1980s. According to them, inflation was a product of the center’s loss of control over the money supply. Although fiscal decentralization gave local government the incentive to invest and banking decentralization provided the source of funding, the central government still did not have the means to control the overall money supply. Although it retained traditional administrative measures such as the credit plan, they were ineffective toward extrabudgetary investment. Instead, the center needed a modern central bank system with effective means of controlling money supply, such as open market operations, interest rate adjustments, and reserve requirements (Fewsmith 1994; Liu 2000d; Xue 1996). Wu and Liu both trained legions of students, many of whom became important figures in the central bureaucracy in the 1990s.
金融专业人士，曾在 20 世纪 80 年代中期担任 PBOC 副行长。他们认为，通货膨胀是中央对货币供应失去控制的产物。尽管财政分权为地方政府提供了投资激励，银行分权提供了资金来源，但中央政府仍然没有控制总体货币供应的手段。尽管中央保留了信用计划等传统行政手段，这些手段对预算外投资却无效。相反，中央需要一个现代的中央银行体系，具备控制货币供应的有效手段，例如公开市场操作、利率调整和准备金率（Fewsmith 1994；Liu 2000d；Xue 1996）。吴和刘都培养了大批学生，其中许多人在 1990 年代成为中央官僚机构的重要人物。
The language of increasing the macro-adjustment capability of the center began to enter into the centralizers’ lexicon shortly before Tiananmen. In a March 1989 speech, Li Peng urged the improvement of “our macro control and adjustment tools and means” (Li 1998). After the Tiananmen crackdown, the Fifth Plenum in November 1989 initiated the re-engineering of central authorities by calling for a stronger, more centralized PBOC, the formation of hundreds of state owned corporations directly under the center’s control, and more commercial consideration for state bank lending (The Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party 1989; Zhang 1991). Although the Fifth Plenum also decided to re-impose price control, some of the measures at the core of the retrenchment program actually brought the Chinese banking sector closer to commercialization. For example, a State Council decree required the PBOC to screen local bank managers to ensure their professional qualification (Wang and Wang 1997). Furthermore, the central bank gained more formal control over money supply when relending authorities were centralized to the Beijing headquarters of the PBOC (People’s Bank of China 1989). Instead of opposing reform per se, central bureaucrats were weary of Zhao’s method of blind economic and financial decentralization.
在天安门事件前不久，“提高中央宏观调控能力”的表述开始进入中央集权派的词汇。李鹏在 1989 年 3 月的一次讲话中敦促完善“我们的宏观调控和调整的工具和手段”（Li 1998）。天安门镇压后，1989 年 11 月的第五次全会通过了对中央权力的重组，要求建设更强、更集中的中央银行（PBOC），组建数百家直接由中央控制的国有企业，并在国有银行放贷方面更多考虑商业化因素（The Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party 1989；Zhang 1991）。尽管第五次全会也决定恢复价格管制，但收缩方案中的一些核心措施实际上使中国的银行业更接近商业化。例如，一项国务院法令要求中央银行对地方银行经理进行审查以确保其专业资格（Wang and Wang 1997）。此外，当再贷款权限集中到中央银行北京总部时，中央银行在货币供应上的正式控制权也加强了（People’s Bank of China 1989）。 中央官僚并非反对改革本身， 而是对赵的盲目经济与金融分权的方法感到厌倦。
In the meantime, however, Deng was fast growing impatient with the “correction” program. In a private conversation with Kissinger in November 1989, where he uttered the famous phrase “whoever wants to turn back the clock will fall from power,” Deng also said that “it is correct to strengthen the center’s authorities, but this does not mean changing the reform and opening and decentralization of authorities enacted in the past” (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2004). Unlike in the 1980s, Deng could rely on neither the General Secretary nor the Premier to launch a decentralization drive. Premier Li Peng, who never held a position in local government, obviously had no inclination to help Deng. The new General Secretary Jiang Zemin was made from a different mold than both Zhao and Hu Yaobang. Jiang had spent the bulk of his career up to that point slowly climbing the heavy industrial bureaucracy. After the reform, he became Gu Mu’s deputy in the Export/Import Commission of the State Council, where he first had contact with national level leaders. In 1982, Jiang was promoted to head the Ministry of Electronics, where he impressed
与此同时，邓对“纠偏”方案却越来越不耐烦。1989 年 11 月在一次与基辛格的私下谈话中，他说出了那句著名的话“凡是想把历史倒退的，都会被历史所淘汰”，同时还表示“加强中央权威是对的，但这不意味着要改变过去的改革开放和权力下放” (中共中央文献研究室 2004)。与 20 世纪 80 年代不同，邓无法再依靠总书记或总理来发起一场权力下放的推动。未曾在地方政府任职的李鹏显然没有意愿协助邓。新的总书记江泽民与赵紫阳和胡耀邦有着不同的背景。江在此之前的大部分职业生涯是在重工业官僚体系中缓慢晋升。改革后，他成为国务院进出口贸易委员会（Export/Import Commission）副主任，在那里他首次接触到国家级领导人。1982 年，江被提升为电子工业部部长，在那里给人留下了深刻印象
Chen Yun with a computer demonstration in 1984 (Gilley 1998: 70). Jiang further bolstered his career when he became the mayor of Shanghai in 1985. In the reform era, a solid career in the industrial bureaucracy augmented by a leadership post in a major city often set the foundation for a rise to the pinnacle of the CCP leadership. Despite his four years of service in Shanghai, Jiang’s network of connections with provincial leaders remained limited at that time. Although his new position as General Secretary afforded him ample opportunities to interact with local officials, he still felt obligated to adhere to the centralization line because Chen Yun and Li Xiannian had been the ones who had nominated him, not Deng Xiaoping.
1984 年陈云进行电脑演示（Gilley 1998: 70）。1985 年蒋进一步巩固了他的仕途，出任上海市市长。在改革时期，扎实的工业官僚背景再加上在大城市的领导职务，常常为晋升到中共领导层顶端奠定基础。尽管他在上海工作了四年，但当时蒋与省级领导的关系网仍然有限。虽然他担任总书记的新职务为他提供了大量与地方官员接触的机会，但他仍感到有义务遵循集权路线，因为提名他的人是陈云和李先念，而不是邓小平。
As a result of Jiang’s deep roots in the central bureaucracy, Jiang’s public speeches stuck closely to the Deng-Chen compromise of staying on the course of reform while centralizing economic policies. For example, his remarks at the September 1991 central work conference diplomatically negotiated between Chen and Deng’s lines: “If we only have the center’s enthusiasm, we cannot accomplish our goals. If we only have the localities’ enthusiasm, key construction projects concerning the overall national economy might be affected, and the macroeconomy might lose control” (Jiang 1998a). If the planners had chosen Jiang to curb Deng’s drive to decentralize economic power, they succeeded to a considerable extent. Jiang must have known Deng’s preferred policy of high growth and decentralization, but he faithfully adhered to the 1989 pact, not wanting to offend either one of his patrons.
由于江在中央官僚体系中根基深厚，江的公开讲话紧紧遵循邓陈之间关于坚持改革道路同时收紧经济政策的妥协。例如，他在 1991 年 9 月中央工作会议上的讲话在外交上在陈与邓的路线之间进行了斡旋：“如果只有中央的热情，是不行的；如果只有地方的热情，关系国民经济全局的重点建设项目可能会受到影响，宏观经济可能会失控”（Jiang 1998a）。如果决策者选择江来遏制邓推动经济权力下放的举措，他们在很大程度上是成功的。江一定知道邓偏好的高增长与分权政策，但他忠实地遵守了 1989 年的协议，不想得罪任何一位恩主。

The First Southern Tour and the Rise of Zhu
南巡与朱镕基的崛起

Constrained by the stranglehold of the planners’ dominance, ideological attacks, and a passive General Secretary, Deng had to loosen the planners’ grip step by step. Deng first tried badgering the current leadership into implementing more reform and decentralization measures. In a meeting with Jiang Zemin, Yang Shangkun, and Li Peng in December 1990, Deng stressed to the new Secretary General: “don’t be afraid of taking risks. We now have a certain strength to take some risks” (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2004: 1323). Deng also tried to unlock the technocrats’ grip on the economy by giving a group of affluent coastal provinces his blessing to revolt against a State Council plan to centralize revenue via the new tax sharing system (fenshuizhi) (Fewsmith 2001: 4I). However, it remained difficult to unleash reform momentum, so long as ideological conservatives continued their attacks on the reform. Leftist ideological attacks never threatened the status quo because Deng and Chen, the two dominant players in elite politics, had already agreed in 1989 to preserve the reform that had taken place up to that point. Nonetheless, the planners presumably encouraged leftists to question the reform to keep Deng on his toes. Although Li Ruihuan, a liberal and a Deng loyalist, was put in overall charge of propaganda in 1989, Wang Renzhi, an ideological conservative, controlled the Central Propaganda Department, which ran the day-to-day business of the propaganda apparatus. In that capacity, Wang Renzhi encouraged the People’s Daily to publish articles that either implicitly or explicitly attacked
在计划者主导、意识形态攻击和一个被动的总书记的束缚下，邓不得不一步步放松计划者的控制。邓首先尝试敦促现任领导实施更多改革和下放权力的措施。在 1990 年 12 月与江泽民、杨尚昆和李鹏的会见中，邓对这位新总书记强调：“不要怕冒风险。我们现在有一定的力量可以冒一些风险”（中共中央文件研究室 2004：1323）。邓还试图通过批准一批富裕沿海省份反对国务院通过新的分税制（fenshuizhi）集中财政收入的计划，从而削弱技术官僚对经济的控制（Fewsmith 2001：41）。然而，只要意识形态保守派继续对改革进行攻击，释放改革动力仍然困难。左翼的意识形态攻击从未威胁到现状，因为邓和陈这两位在精英政治中占主导地位的角色，早在 1989 年就已同意保留迄今为止所实施的改革。 尽管如此，策划者大概鼓励左派质疑改革以让邓保持警觉。尽管李瑞环——一位自由派且忠于邓的人——在 1989 年被任命全面负责宣传工作，但意识形态保守派王忍之掌管中央宣传部，负责宣传机构的日常事务。 在那一职务上，王忍之鼓励《人民日报》发表隐含或明确抨击改革的文章（Fewsmith 2001: 35）。
the reform (Fewsmith 2001: 35). When Li Ruihuan objected to the publication of these articles, Wang managed to override Li Ruihuan, probably with the help of Chen Yun. In the face of Wang’s blockade of the main media outlets, Li Ruihuan had to convene conferences nominally on ideology to promote the Dengist agenda of “seeking development amidst adjustment” (Li 1993b).
当李瑞环反对发表这些文章时，王设法压过了李瑞环，可能得到了陈云的帮助。面对王对主要媒体的封锁，李瑞环不得不召开名义上关于意识形态的会议，以推动“在调整中求发展”的邓氏议程（李 1993b）。
In order to go on the offensive, Deng had to first silence the doctrinaires. His first shot against the ideologues was fired from Shanghai on his inspection trip there in early 1991. His offensive took place in Shanghai rather than in Guangdong probably because Guangdong was too closely associated with Zhao’s disobedience of the Party. An inspection trip there would have given the leftists more ammunition with which to attack Deng. Shanghai, although it was governed by a liberal cadre - Zhu Rongji - had long been associated with Chen Yun and now Jiang Zemin. The leftists would not have dared to directly attack Shanghai.
为了发起进攻，邓首先必须压制教条主义者。他对意识形态者的第一枪是在 1991 年初巡视上海时发出的。他的进攻之所以在上海而不是在广东，很可能是因为广东与赵的违党行为联系过于密切。在那里巡视会给左派更多弹药来攻击邓。上海虽然由一位自由派干部——朱镕基——治理，但长期与陈云、并且现在与江泽民有关联。左派不会胆敢直接攻击上海。
In his formal remarks to Shanghai cadres, his criticism of leftist ideologues was relatively mild, saying that they were “not used to” and were “afraid” of the reform (Deng 1998f). After he returned to Beijing, however, a series of editorials, penned by Huangpu Ping - a pseudonym - began to appear in the main newspaper in Shanghai, the Liberation Daily. 6 6 ^(6){ }^{6} Unlike Deng’s formal speech, these editorials, which turned out to be compilations of Deng’s remarks to Shanghai cadres, attacked the leftists directly. The editorials stated that “we must prevent lapsing into certain ‘new thought rigidity’” and urged cadres to “abandon any conservative, rigid, and isolated perspectives …” (Ma and Ling 1998: 172). In direct response to leftists who questioned whether the reform had a “surname of ‘capitalist’ or surname of ‘socialist’,” the Huangpu Ping editorials accused those who raised this question for “losing a great opportunity” (Ma and Ling 1998: 173). Local officials instantly recognized these articles as Deng’s work. Top officials in Guangdong, Tianjin, Hebei, Beijing, and Jiangxi ordered their respective local newspapers to echo the ideas expressed in the editorials (Fewsmith 2001: 46). The central leadership was also not blind to Deng’s wishes and responded by approving twenty-one special technical zones around the country to receive preferential policies (State Council 1993a). Although significant, the approval of twenty-one zones paled in comparison to the hundreds of zones that were established subsequent to Deng’s Southern Tour in 1992.
在他对上海干部的正式讲话中，他对左倾意识形态者的批评相对温和，称他们“不习惯”和“害怕”改革（Deng 1998f）。然而，当他回到北京后，一系列以“黄浦评”为笔名撰写的社论开始在上海的主报《解放日报》上出现。 6 6 ^(6){ }^{6} 与邓的正式讲话不同，这些社论——后来被证实是邓对上海干部讲话的汇编——直接抨击了左派。社论指出“我们必须防止陷入某种‘新思想僵化’”，并敦促干部“摒弃任何保守、僵化和封闭的观点……”（Ma and Ling 1998: 172）。针对质疑改革是“姓‘资本’还是姓‘社’”的左派，黄浦评社论指责提出这一问题的人“错失了重大良机”（Ma and Ling 1998: 173）。地方官员立即认出这些文章为邓的作品。广东、天津、河北、北京和江西的高级官员下令各自的地方报纸呼应社论中表达的观点（Fewsmith 2001: 46）。 中央领导层也并非对邓的意愿视而不见，并通过批准在全国设立二十一个享受优惠政策的特殊技术区作出回应（国务院 1993a）。尽管具有重要意义，但与 1992 年邓的南巡之后设立的数百个园区相比，批准二十一处显得微不足道。
Despite rising local frustration with the existing policies, the central stranglehold on the economy remained largely in place even after Deng’s trip. The key to the continual conservatism was Jiang Zemin. Unlike Zhao or Hu, who readily responded to Deng’s signals with central meetings and decrees to decentralize investment powers, Jiang continued to toe the line of the 1989 compromise. Strictly speaking, Jiang was not disobeying Deng’s wishes. The 1989 compromise preserved the overall course of the reform, and Jiang faithfully repeated this message in all of his remarks. Nonetheless, he stopped well short of urging
尽管地方对现行政策的不满日增，但即便在邓的南巡之后，中央对经济的控制在很大程度上仍然存在。持续保守的关键人物是江泽民。与赵或胡不同，他们会迅速响应邓的信号，通过中央会议和法令下放投资权，江则继续遵循 1989 年妥协的路线。严格来说，江并未违背邓的意愿。1989 年的妥协维持了改革的总体方向，江在所有讲话中都忠实地重复了这一信息。然而，他远未达到敦促...
local leaders to “dare to take some risk and do something unprecedented,” as the Huangpu Ping editorials had urged (Ma and Ling 1998:91). It was difficult for Deng to broadcast political signals about decentralization without Jiang’s cooperation because Deng no longer held any formal positions in the Party. Although Li Ruihuan did his best to spread Deng’s message, his influence was limited by barriers erected by Wang Renzhong and by his inability to issue direct orders to local leaders, something that only Jiang could do as secretary general.
地方领导要“敢于冒一些风险，做一些前所未有的事情”，正如《黄埔评》社论所鼓励的那样（Ma and Ling 1998:91）。由于邓不再担任党内任何正式职务，缺少江的配合，邓很难对分权问题发出政治信号。尽管李瑞环尽力传播邓的意见，但王任重设置的障碍以及李无法向地方领导发出只有作为秘书长的江才有权发出的直接命令，限制了他的影响力。
Although Deng was doubtless frustrated with Jiang, he was pleased with Zhu Rongji, Jiang’s successor in Shanghai. Zhu Rongji had hosted Deng’s trip to Shanghai and had ordered the local newspaper to publish Deng’s editorials. Zhu’s background, however, suggests that he would have been on the side of the central planners. Similar to Jiang, Zhu also climbed his way up the central bureaucracy as a cadre in the planning bureaucracy. If anything, Zhu’s early career in the State Planning Commission suggests that he had stronger ties with Chen Yun than Jiang did. Despite his meteoric rise at the beginning of his career in the SPC, he became a victim of the Anti-Rightist Movement in 1957. The Central Committee had issued a quota for purging cadres, and Zhu, who had apparently voiced a mild criticism against the SPC, was sent down to the countryside for reeducation. This put his career on hold for the next twenty years (Gao and He 1998). Although many in his cohort were eventually purged during the Cultural Revolution, they all had an additional ten years at the SPC before they were purged. After the Cultural Revolution, many in his cohort and even those younger than him were quickly elevated to the center of power. Although Zhu was recognized as one of the most brilliant technocrats of his generation, his black mark from 1957 only allowed him to return as a section head (chuzhang) at the State Economic Commission, a weaker rival of the State Planning Commission that was more sympathetic to Zhao’s coastal development strategy (Gao and He 1998; Zeng 1994). Although he was promoted to the mayoral seat of Shanghai in 1987, he only became an alternate member of the Central Committee at the age of sixty, which meant that he would have ended his career at the ministerial/provincial level at the Fourteenth Party Congress.
尽管邓无疑对江感到沮丧，但他对江在上海的接班人朱镕基感到满意。朱镕基曾接待过邓的上海之行，并曾命令当地报纸刊登邓的社论。然而，朱的背景表明他会站在中央计划者一边。与江类似，朱也是以计划体制内干部的身份攀升到中央官僚体系的。如果说有什么不同的话，朱在早年于国家计划委员会的工作经历表明他比江与陈云的联系更为密切。尽管他在国家计委早期事业发展迅速，但在 1957 年的反右运动中成为受害者。中央制定了清除干部的名额，而朱因曾对国家计委发表过温和批评，被下放到农村接受再教育。这使他的职业生涯在接下来的二十年中被中断（Gao and He 1998）。尽管他这一批中的许多人在文化大革命期间最终被清洗，但在被清洗之前他们在国家计委还有额外的十年任期。 文化大革命结束后，他同一时期的许多人乃至比他年轻的人都被迅速提拔到权力核心。尽管朱被公认为他那一代最杰出的技术官僚之一，但他在 1957 年的污点只使他回到国家经济委员会担任处长（chuzhang），该委员会是国家计委的较弱竞对，对赵的沿海开发战略更为同情（Gao and He 1998；Zeng 1994）。尽管他在 1987 年被提拔为上海市长，但他直到六十岁才成为中央委员会的候补委员，这意味着他将在第十四次党代会上以部长/省级结干部位结束他的职业生涯。
Zhu was by no means politically unambitious. Because he knew he lagged behind others in his age group, he had to pursue an unconventional strategy to climb to the top. The one gamble that paid off handsomely was publishing Deng’s editorials, which helped Deng send political signals about decentralization through the back channel. Deng might have seen in Zhu a new force in the central leadership to push forward reform and decentralization. After all, Zhu had rallied for Zhao’s coastal strategy in the 1980s and had openly disputed the planners’ centralization policies in 1990 (Fewsmith 2001: 41). On Deng’s return in the spring of 1991, he told Li Peng that Zhu had to be made a vice premier. Li reluctantly agreed but delayed giving Zhu a portfolio at the State Council. He only relented after Deng ordered him to do so through Yang Shangkun (Gao and He 1998: 370). To be fair,
朱绝非没有政治野心。因为他知道自己在同龄人中落后，他不得不采取不同寻常的策略攀登到权力顶端。一次大获成功的赌博是发表邓的社论，这帮助邓通过非公开渠道发出关于权力下放的政治信号。邓也许在朱身上看到了一股推动改革与权力下放的中央新生力量。毕竟，朱在 20 世纪 80 年代曾为赵的沿海开放战略奔走，并在 1990 年公开与规划者的集中化政策发生争论（Fewsmith 2001: 41）。1991 年春邓回国时，他告诉李鹏必须让朱成为副总理。李鹏勉强同意，但推迟在国务院给朱分配工作。直到邓通过杨尚昆下令他这么做后他才勉强服从（Gao and He 1998: 370）。公平地说，
resentment toward Zhu was completely understandable. By becoming a vice premier before the Fourteenth Party Congress, Zhu gained a real chance of entering the Politburo at the Fourteenth Party Congress, a rare three-step jump from an alternate in the Central Committee to the Politburo in one term. Zhu in the end exceeded even that expectation by entering the Standing Committee of the Politburo. His “helicopter” rise doubtless excited much jealousy in the State Council.
对朱的怨恨完全可以理解。通过在第十四次党代会前成为副总理，朱获得了在第十四次党代会上进入政治局的真正机会——这是一次罕见的跨越，从中央委员会候补委员在一个任期内跃升到政治局的三步跳。最终，朱甚至超出了这一预期，进入了政治局常务委员会。他这种“直升机式”的上升无疑在国务院引起了很多嫉妒。
Although Deng played a crucial role in Zhu’s elevation, Chen Yun also gave his blessing to Zhu’s rise. His motivation, however, was less clear at the time. Chen Yun was probably annoyed with Zhu for helping Deng defeat the leftists, which lessened Deng’s vulnerability. Nonetheless, Chen Yun might have also calculated that Zhu had the best chance of becoming the next economic tsar of China, replacing Chen himself. Li Peng, a long-time favorite of the planners, had become too politically vulnerable because of his dominant role in Tiananmen. Yao was getting sicker by the day. Among the other vice premiers at the time, Zou Jiahua and Li Tieying were either too incompetent or too unpopular to make viable candidates for the head of the central bureaucracy (He and Gao 2000 ). Having met Zhu several times in Shanghai, Chen likely knew that Zhu had been a proponent of Wu Jinglian’s idea of strengthening the central government’s macro-adjustment powers (Yang 2005: 266; Zhao 2005:28). Finally, although Zhu was on the periphery of Chen’s coterie, he had a solid career in the central bureaucracy, which translated to a dense network of contacts at the center. Before Zhu’s departure for Beijing in May 1991, Chen had a talk with Zhu and gave him the following advice: “Do not just obey your superior; do not just obey the books; only obey reality; take care to exchange, compare, and rethink” (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000). The first phrase presumably warned Zhu not to obey Deng’s wishes completely. If Chen’s endorsement of Zhu was a gamble to find his own replacement, he made the right wager. Likewise, if Deng had elevated Zhu in order to revitalize economic decentralization, he grossly miscalculated.
虽然邓在朱的晋升中起了关键作用，陈云也为朱的崛起表示了支持。然而，他当时的动机并不十分明确。陈云可能因朱帮助邓打败左派、从而减少了邓的脆弱性而对朱感到恼火。不过，陈云也可能计算过，朱最有机会成为中国下一任经济“沙皇”，取代他自己。作为长期受到计划派青睐的人，李鹏因其在天安门事件中的主导角色而在政治上变得过于脆弱。姚正日益病重。当时的其他副总理中，邹家华和李铁映要么能力不足，要么不够受欢迎，无法成为中央官僚机构首脑的可行人选（He and Gao 2000）。陈在上海与朱见过几次面，可能知道朱曾支持吴敬琏提出的加强中央政府宏观调控权力的观点（Yang 2005: 266；Zhao 2005:28）。最后，尽管朱在陈的圈子中属于边缘人物，但他在中央官僚机构有坚实的仕途，这转化为中央密集的人脉网络。 在朱于 1991 年 5 月离京之前，陈曾与朱谈话并给了他如下建议：“不要只是服从上级；不要只是服从书本；只服从现实；注意交换、比较和重新思考”（中共中央文献研究室 2000）。第一句话大概是在提醒朱不要完全服从邓的意愿。若陈对朱的支持是为寻找自己的接班人而打的一场赌，那他押对了。同样，若邓提拔朱是为了重振经济分权，他则大大估错了。
With Deng’s order, Li Peng reluctantly handed Zhu two important portfolios, as head of the State Council’s Production Office (Shengban) and the State Council Triangular Debt Office. Although complying with Deng’s wishes, Li Peng also deliberately gave Zhu two of the most difficult policy portfolios, probably in a bid to set Zhu up for failure. A major problem facing the CCP regime in the early i990s was mounting losses by the large and medium SOEs. Fierce competition with township-village enterprises for both input and market, high interest rates, and the inherent inefficiency of the SOEs drove SOE losses up by 89 percent in 1990 (Fewsmith 2001: 40; Lin, Cai, and Li 1998; Wedeman 2003: 94). As a result, SOEs’ debt to each other, or triangular debt, had ballooned to 300 billion yuan, or a full 16 percent of the GDP in 1991. This enormous debt generated chronic cash shortage within many SOEs, forcing them to survive completely on working capital loans from the state banks. More important, the high level of debt translated to decreasing profit margins for SOEs and less remittance to the central coffer, which reflected badly on the
在邓的命令下，李鹏勉强把两个重要的投资组合交给了朱，任国务院生产办公室（生办）和国务院三角债办公室负责人。尽管服从了邓的意愿，李鹏也有意把两项最棘手的政策组合交给朱，可能是企图让朱失败。1990 年代初中共政权面临的一个主要问题是大中型国有企业亏损不断加剧。与乡镇企业在要素和市场上的激烈竞争、高利率，以及国企固有的低效率，使国企在 1990 年的亏损增长了 89%（Fewsmith 2001: 40；Lin, Cai, and Li 1998；Wedeman 2003: 94）。因此，国企之间的相互欠债，即三角债，在 1991 年已膨胀到 3000 亿元，占当年 GDP 的 16%。这一巨额债务导致许多国企长期现金短缺，迫使它们完全依赖国有银行的流动资金贷款生存。更重要的是，高企的债务水平导致国企利润率下降，上缴中央财政的款项减少，这对...
premier’s administrative record. Both Li Peng and Yao Yilin had tried to tackle the problem, but with little success (Gao and He 1998: 331).
总理的行政记录。李鹏和姚依林都曾试图解决这个问题，但收效甚微（Gao and He 1998: 331）。
Zhu’s solution to the triangular debt problem reflected both political and economic savvy. Zhu ordered the state banks to inject loans to the largest debtors and ordered the recipients of these funds to repay debt owed to other state enterprises and so on. By 1992, the state banking system had injected a total of 8 o billion yuan to pay off 38 o billion in triangular debt, a multiplier effect of 4.75 (Wang 1999: 106). Although this method of dealing with triangular debt had been used before, the scale of this bailout was much larger than the previous ones. The 1986 bailout, for example, was only 5 billion yuan (Liu 1993: 84). The downside of this method was, of course, that SOE liability to banks increased dramatically, which further exposed banks to the dilapidated SOE sector. In 1991 alone, bad debt in the state banking sector increased by 42 percent from 70 billion yuan to 104 billion yuan (Liu 2000d). 7 7 ^(7){ }^{7} Politically, Zhu’s administrative record now included the grand accomplishment of decreasing the net debt of SOEs by 300 billion yuan. Although Zhu later gained the reputation as the defender of bank autonomy, he in fact established himself as a reliable technocrat at the center by ordering banks to lend to the SOEs. Without firm control over the banking system, it would have been impossible for central bureaucrats to register such impressive administrative accomplishments. For this reason, the central bureaucrats had a disincentive to promote genuine banking commercialization.
朱镕基对三角债问题的解决方案既体现了政治智慧，也体现了经济手腕。朱下令国家银行向最大的债务方注入贷款，并责成这些资金的接收方偿还对其他国有企业的债务，依此类推。到 1992 年，国家银行体系累计注入 80 亿元以偿还 380 亿元的三角债，乘数效应为 4.75（Wang 1999: 106）。尽管这种处理三角债的方法此前也曾使用过，但这次救助的规模远大于以往。例如，1986 年的救助仅为 50 亿元（Liu 1993: 84）。这种方法的弊端当然是国有企业对银行的负债大幅增加，进一步暴露了银行对日渐衰败的国有企业部门的风险。仅 1991 年，国家银行业的不良债权就从 700 亿元增加 42%，达到 1040 亿元（Liu 2000d）。 7 7 ^(7){ }^{7} 在政治上，朱的行政记录现在包括了一项重大成就：将国有企业的净债务减少了 3000 亿元。 尽管朱后来获得了维护银行自主性的名声，事实上他通过命令银行向国有企业放贷，确立了自己作为中央可信赖技术官僚的地位。若不能牢牢控制银行体系，中央官僚就不可能取得如此令人瞩目的行政成就。 因此，中央官僚没有动力推动真正的银行商业化。

The Second Southern Tour and Inflation
第二次南巡与通货膨胀

If Deng had intended for Zhu to galvanize enthusiasm for decentralization, he would have been sorely disappointed. When he arrived in Beijing, Zhu began to speak the “Beijing dialect” of centralization in earnest. He did little to advance the cause of the local government. Deng once again tried to exhort the timid leadership into more daring action. In a meeting with the central leadership in August 1991, Deng stated emphatically that “while it is correct to emphasize stability, too much emphasis on it would lead one to lose the opportunity” (Deng 1993g: 368). Deng’s concern with the slow pace of growth was intimately related to the collapse of the Soviet Union and the rapid rise of the other Asian countries. He told his younger colleagues that “if we do not ensure that the economy jumps to the next stage…we will lag behind” (Deng 19939: 396). His remarks, however, failed to stir the leadership into launching a decentralization campaign, compelling him to go on another Southern Tour at the beginning of 1992 to finally unlock local enthusiasm.
如果邓小平本意是让朱镕基激发对分权的热情，他会大失所望。朱到北京后，就开始认真讲起中央集权的“北京话”。他几乎没有推动地方政府事业的发展。邓再次试图敦促畏缩的领导层采取更大胆的行动。1991 年 8 月在一次中央领导会议上，邓明确表示，“虽然强调稳定是正确的，但过分强调稳定就会错失良机”（Deng 1993g: 368）。邓对增长缓慢的担忧，与苏联解体和其他亚洲国家的快速崛起有着密切关系。他曾对年轻同僚说，“如果我们不能确保经济跃上新阶段……我们就会落后”（Deng 19939: 396）。然而，他的言论未能激起领导层发动分权运动的意愿，迫使他在 1992 年初再次进行南巡，最终激发地方的热情。
Because of the successful effort to reduce triangular debt and strong export growth, industrial production in 1991 registered growth above 60 percent for all four quarters. As a result, local governments clamored for more policy autonomy and more funds to be made available to firms and infrastructure building (Li and Wu 1992). Sensing the right economic conditions, Deng decided to send an even stronger message of decentralization by visiting the birthplace of the reform, Guangdong Province. In January 1992, Deng took a train down to Shenzhen and Zhuhai before turning north to Wuchang and Shanghai. In those places, Deng unleashed some of the most poignant phrases in the Party’s political lexicon to galvanize local officials into pursuing high growth. For example, Deng told officials in Shenzhen that “reform requires greater courage and a willingness to experiment; one cannot be like a woman with bound feet (xiaojiao nuren)” (Deng 1993f). “Woman with bound feet” was a phrase that Mao had used in 1955 to pressure local officials into pursuing rapid collectivization. Although Deng’s goal was the opposite of Mao’s, he conveyed a similar message urging local officials to be daring and bold. Deng also put the ideological left on the defensive by saying “we must guard against the right, but mainly we must prevent the ‘left’” (Deng 1993f). During the tour, he also issued an ultimatum to Jiang Zemin, Li Peng, and perhaps even Zhu Rongji: “Whoever does not support reforms should step down” (Nathan and Gilley 2002: 151). His unmistakable warning to the leadership was that their current state of passive resistance was unacceptable.
由于三角债务成功清理和强劲的出口增长，1991 年工业产出四个季度的增长均超过 60%。因此，地方政府纷纷要求更大的政策自主权以及向企业和基础设施建设提供更多资金（Li and Wu 1992）。判断经济条件已成熟，邓决定通过访问改革发源地广东省，发出更加强烈的去中心化信号。1992 年 1 月，邓乘火车先后到深圳和珠海，随后北上到武昌和上海。在这些地方，邓使用了党内政治话语中一些最有力的表述，激励地方官员追求高增长。例如，邓在深圳对官员说，“改革需要更大的勇气和试验精神，不能像小脚女人那样”（Deng 1993f）。“小脚女人”这一说法是毛在 1955 年用来向地方官员施压，推动迅速集体化的表述。 虽然邓的目标与毛相反，但他传达了类似的信息，敦促地方官员要大胆勇敢。邓还通过说“我们要防右，但主要要防‘左’”（Deng 1993f）将意识形态上的左派置于防御位置。在这次巡视中，他还向江泽民、李鹏，甚至可能还有朱镕基发出最后通牒：“不支持改革的，应该下台”（Nathan and Gilley 2002: 151）。他对领导层的明确警告是，他们目前这种消极抵抗的状态是不可接受的。
Deng’s message to the local cadres was not simply a general call for reform and opening, but a specific endorsement of high growth through inflationary financing by local governments. The following remarks, which were later publicized nationally, demonstrate Deng’s preference:
邓对地方干部的要求不仅仅是一般性的改革开放号召，而是明确支持地方政府通过通货膨胀性融资来实现高增长。以下言论后来被在全国范围内公布，展示了邓的偏好：
If we issue a bit too much currency, or if price fluctuation is a bit too large, or if redundant investment is a bit too serious, we create some waste. But, how should we comprehensively view those five years of high-speed growth? (1984-1988)…In my evaluation, the high speed growth in those five years achieved quite a bit. (Deng 1993f)
“如果我们多印一点货币，或者价格波动大一点，或者过剩投资严重一点，就会造成一些浪费。但是，应该如何全面看待那五年的高速增长？（1984–1988）……在我看来，那五年的高速增长是取得了相当大的成就。”（Deng 1993f）
Local officials who heard or saw the text of Deng’s remarks could not but interpret it as a carte blanche to intervene in local financial institutions to generate high growth. These remarks also suggest that despite previous inflationary crises, Deng was willing to accept another bout of inflation to generate growth. His acceptance of inflation remained at a high level. It also shows that Hu Yaobang and Zhao Ziyang’s preference for economic policies much more closely coincided with Deng’s preference than Jiang’s inclination. Political circumstances rather than divergence of economic opinion forced Deng to give up on Hu and Zhao.
听到或看到邓的讲话原文的地方官员只能将其解释为干预地方金融机构以刺激高速增长的放任令。这些话也表明，尽管此前发生过通货膨胀危机，邓仍愿意接受新一轮通货膨胀以换取增长。他对通货膨胀的容忍度仍然很高。也显示出胡耀邦和赵紫阳的经济政策偏好与邓的偏好远比江的倾向更为接近。促使邓放弃胡和赵的，是政治环境而非经济观点的分歧。
Even after such strong language, however, Deng still encountered stiff resistance to his call for reform and decentralization. First, the mass media initially did not report Deng’s trip to the south. The Xinhua News Agency only reported that Yang Shangkun had visited Shenzhen and Shanghai (Editors 1993b). The editor of the People’s Daily, Gao Di, also tried to dilute Deng’s message in the
然而，即便用了如此强烈的措辞，邓推动改革和下放权力的呼吁仍遭遇强烈抵制。首先，大众媒体最初并未报道邓的南巡。新华社只报道了杨尚昆访问深圳和上海（Editors 1993b）。《人民日报》社长高谊也试图在...
newspaper’s editorial (Lam 1995: 179). Li Peng resisted passively by admitting that the period of correction and rectification was over but stressed that growth should still “pay attention to stability” (Fourth Editorial Bureau of the Central Document Research Center 1999).
报纸的社论（Lam 1995: 179）。李鹏消极抵抗，承认整顿纠正的时期已过，但强调增长仍应“注意稳定”（中央文献研究室第四编辑局 1999）。
At this moment, however, Jiang finally realized that his passivity might lead Deng to abandon him in favor of one of his factional rivals. Jiang was especially alarmed by the fact that two of Deng’s long-time protégés - Li Ruihuan and Qiao Shi - gave speeches to trumpet the Southern Tour before Jiang had a chance to digest the implications of Deng’s remarks on the tour. On January 21 even before Deng had completed his trip in Guangdong - Li Ruihuan, the Deng loyalist who had narrowly lost out to Jiang for the top post, repeated Deng’s call for more growth and reform at a national meeting of propaganda chiefs and announced that “…the task of correction and readjustment is basically over” (Li 1993c). Likewise, Qiao Shi, who by then was a Standing Committee member in charge of the entire police and anticorruption apparatus in China, proclaimed at the national law and politics meeting that “as Comrade Deng Xiaoping repeatedly emphasized, economic construction is the center of our work, and all other tasks must obey this center” (Qiao 1993). 8 8 ^(8){ }^{8} Making matters worse, Yang Baibing, the ambitious younger brother of Deng’s longtime friend Yang Shangkun and the head of the PLA political department, proclaimed that the army would serve as the “protective escort” of Deng’s reform line (Gilley 1998: 195).
然而就在此时，江泽民终于意识到，他的被动可能会导致邓小平放弃他，而转而支持邓的某个派系对手。江尤其为两位邓长期提携的亲信——李瑞环和乔石——感到震惊：他们在江还来不及消化邓关于南巡讲话的含义之前，就在公开场合为南巡呐喊助威。1 月 21 日，甚至在邓还未完成在广东的行程之前——曾在争夺最高职务中以微弱差距败给江的邓系亲信李瑞环，在全国宣传部长会议上重复了邓关于更多增长和改革的呼吁，并宣布“……矫正和调整的任务基本完成了”（李 1993c）。同样，乔石——此时已是中共中央政治局常务委员会成员，负责全国公安和反腐体系——在全国政法会议上宣称：“正如邓小平同志反复强调的，经济建设是我们的中心，其他一切工作都必须服从这个中心”（乔 1993）。 更糟的是，野心勃勃的杨白冰——邓的长期好友杨尚昆的弟弟、解放军政治部负责人——宣称军队将作为邓改革路线的“保护护航”（Gilley 1998: 195）。
Confronted with such enthusiastic endorsement of Deng’s message by his politically astute rivals, Jiang realized he also had to embrace the high-growth, decentralization agenda, or else face dismissal. At the March 10, 1992, Politburo meeting, when Yang Shangkun openly called for further reform and criticized the left, Jiang joined the bandwagon and made a self criticism about his passivity in the previous year (Fewsmith 2001: 59). Despite some grumbling from Song Ping and Yao Yilin, the Politburo meeting gave full endorsement to Deng’s new decentralization effort. The spirit of the meeting was summarized in the Central Committee Document Number Two, which harshly criticized the left and called for “daring experiments” and “speeding up the pace of economic development” (Fourth Editorial Bureau of the Central Document Research Center 1999).
面对这些政治精明的对手对邓信息的热烈支持，江泽民意识到自己也必须接受高增长、分权化的议程，否则就面临被免职的风险。1992 年 3 月 10 日的政治局会议上，当杨尚昆公开呼吁进一步改革并批评左派时，江随波逐流，针对自己上一年的消极态度作了检讨（Fewsmith 2001: 59）。尽管宋平和姚依林有些抱怨，政治局会议还是对邓的新一轮分权努力给予了充分认可。会议精神被概括在中共中央文件二号中，文件严厉批评左派，并呼吁“大胆试验”和“加快经济发展步伐”（中央文件研究中心第四编辑室 1999）。
Even after the Politburo had finally endorsed the high-growth agenda, Deng did not let up the pressure. In May, he had another one of Jiang’s rivals, Beijing party secretary and Politburo member Chen Xitong, arrange an inspection at the Capital Iron and Steel, where he complained that “(Western capitalist countries) are quite content with 2 to 3 percent growth, but for us 6 percent is not necessarily a good speed” (Deng 1993b). In direct response to Deng’s request for faster growth, Jiang declared in a speech at the Central Party School in June that
即便在政治局最终批准高增长议程之后，邓仍然没有放松压力。五月，他又让江的另一位对手、北京市委书记、政治局委员陈希同安排对首都钢铁的视察，在那里他抱怨说“（西方资本主义国家）满足于 2 到 3%的增长，但对我们来说 6%不一定是一个好的速度”（Deng 1993b）。作为对邓要求加快增长的直接回应，江在六月中央党校的一次讲话中宣称
“…perhaps we can go faster, toward 9 percent or 10 percent as we move forward” (Jiang 1993) 9 9 ^(9){ }^{9}
“…也许我们可以走得更快，向前推进到 9%或 10%”（Jiang 1993） 9 9 ^(9){ }^{9}
With the political tide completely turned, the Central Committee began to issue formal decrees to give concrete shape to decentralization. Central Committee Document Four made another thirty cities special zones, along with all the provincial capitals. They would enjoy preferential policies in terms of attracting foreign investment and in launching their own investment projects (Lam 1995: 77). The SEZ Office of the State Council, which had been in hibernation through much of the previous three years, immediately dispatched three teams to coastal cities to work out decentralization measures with the local governments (Peng and Xu 1992). To further free up local initiatives, the Party ordered the State Council and local governments to review all the decrees passed during the correction and rectification period and to abolish all the inappropriate decrees (Peng and Xu 1992). In the meantime, Jiang left his technocratic past behind and began to encourage his followers in the Yangtze River Delta (Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang) to speed up growth. In June 1992, Jiang chaired a meeting on the development of the Yangtze River Delta where he urged central ministries to decentralize power to the region and his local followers to “take full advantage of the strategic importance” of the region to speed up growth (Jiang 2006c: 208). As Deng and Zhao had done in the early 1980s, Jiang further rallied his followers to support the Pudong SEZ, a bold developmental project launched by Jiang’s core followers in Shanghai (Jiang 2006c: 209).
随着政治局势彻底逆转，中央开始发布正式法令，具体落实分权。中央第四号文件又将三十个城市及所有省会设为特区。它们在吸引外商投资和开展本地投资项目方面将享有优惠政策（Lam 1995：77）。国务院经济特区办公室在过去三年大部分时间处于休眠状态，立即派出三支工作组前往沿海城市与地方政府共同制定分权措施（Peng 和 Xu 1992）。为进一步释放地方积极性，中共要求国务院和地方政府审核整顿时期通过的所有法令，并废止所有不当法令（Peng 和 Xu 1992）。与此同时，江泽民放下了他的技官主义过去，开始鼓励长江三角洲（上海、江苏、浙江）的追随者加快增长。 1992 年 6 月，江主持召开了关于长江三角洲发展的会议，他督促中央各部委向该地区下放权力，并鼓动他的地方追随者“充分利用该地区的战略重要性”以加快增长（Jiang 2006c: 208）。正如邓和赵在 20 世纪 80 年代初所做的那样，江进一步号召其追随者支持浦东经济特区，这是由江的核心追随者在上海发起的一项大胆发展项目（Jiang 2006c: 209）。
At the grassroots level, the local government heeded the generalists’ call for “bold experiment” and found new ways to raise funds for local development. The most common means of raising funds was to form local trust and investment companies that paid higher deposit interest than the state banks. By April 1993, such institutions had absorbed deposits equivalent to 20 percent of the deposits held by state banks, causing a substantial decline in state bank deposits (Chen 2005: 271). In response, state banks had to raise deposit interest rates against PBOC regulations to prevent a serious run on the banks. Other means by which the local government bypassed the credit plan included using the nascent interbank market and false repurchasing agreements to raise long-term capital, rather than short-term liquidity (Pei 1998). Interbank loans used to finance fixed asset investment reached 300 billion yuan in 1993 (Wang 1999). Local governments also moved part of the budgetary fund into extrabudgetary accounts and lent out funds from these accounts to local enterprises (Chen 2005: 277).
在基层，地方政府响应泛化派关于“大胆试验”的号召，寻找筹集地方发展资金的新途径。最常见的筹资方式是成立地方信托和投资公司，这些公司支付的存款利息高于国有银行。到 1993 年 4 月，此类机构吸收的存款相当于国有银行存款的 20%，导致国有银行存款大幅下降（Chen 2005: 271）。作为应对，国有银行不得不违反 PBOC 的规定提高存款利率，以防止严重的银行挤兑。地方政府规避信贷计划的其他方式包括使用新兴的同业市场和虚假的回购协议来筹集长期资本，而非短期流动性（Pei 1998）。用于固定资产投资的同业贷款在 1993 年达到 3000 亿元（Wang 1999）。地方政府还将部分预算资金转入预算外账户，并将这些账户中的资金贷给地方企业（Chen 2005: 277）。
As seen in Figure 7.2, Deng’s trip and the March Politburo meeting in 1992 rekindled inflationary pressure in China during the second quarter. Unlike the previous inflationary cycles, there was no apparent spike in state bank lending, which had been growing steadily at an annual rate of around 20 percent. But
如图 7.2 所示，邓小平 1992 年的南巡及三月政治局会议在第二季度重新点燃了中国的通货膨胀压力。与之前的通胀周期不同的是，当时并未出现国有银行放贷的明显激增，国有银行放贷一直以约 20%的年增长率稳定增长。但
Figure 16: FIGURE 7.2. Percentage Change in Quarterly Lending and Change in Inflation from One Year Ago: 1991-1995. Source: Quarterly Database. See Appendix for details. Figures are percentage change in state bank lending and change in inflation from four quarters ago.
图 16：图 7.2。季度放贷百分比变化及同比通货膨胀变化：1991-1995。来源：季度数据库。详见附录。图中数值为国有银行放贷的百分比变化及与四个季度前相比的通货膨胀变化。
the destination of the loans was very different in 1992. In 1991, much of the new increases in loans went to Zhu’s triangular debt write-off, whereas new loans in 1992 went toward real estate development in the coastal regions, which tightened the material bottleneck and exacerbated inflationary pressure. Moreover, as mentioned earlier, nonstate financial institutions, including semiofficial trust and investment companies and informal financial institutions, became a significant force in this inflationary cycle and accounted for much of the acceleration in money supply expansion. Although precise statistics on the growth of nonstate financial activities in this period are unavailable, one indirect indicator, the 40 percent growth of cash circulation - more than twice as high as the growth rate in 1991 - suggests a vibrant curb-side financial market. 10 10 ^(10){ }^{10}
1992 年贷款的去向与 1991 年大不相同。1991 年，大量新增贷款用于朱的三角债核销，而 1992 年的新增贷款则流向沿海地区的房地产开发，这收紧了物资瓶颈并加剧了通货膨胀压力。此外，如前所述，非国有金融机构，包括半官方的信托和投资公司以及非正规金融机构，成为此次通胀周期中的重要力量，并且占了货币供应加速扩张的很大一部分。尽管该时期非国有金融活动增长的精确统计数据不可得，但一个间接指标——现金流通量增长 40%（是 1991 年增长率的两倍多）——表明了活跃的场外金融市场。 10 10 ^(10){ }^{10}
Although inflation remained within reasonable bounds for much of 1992, various State Council think-tanks began to produce reports warning of accelerating inflationary pressure (Liang 1994). A SPC report diplomatically pointed out that the growth of fixed asset investment was only 1.5 percent less than that at the height of the 1988 inflation (Research Team at the SPC Investment Research Center 1992). Yet not much was done to constrain the growth of money supply because the fall Fourteenth Party Congress was to decide important succession issues: whether Jiang Zemin and Li Peng would continue to
尽管在 1992 年大部分时间里通货膨胀仍保持在合理范围内，各种国务院智库开始发布报告，警告通货膨胀压力正在加速（Liang 1994）。最高人民法院的一份报告委婉指出，固定资产投资的增长仅比 1988 年通货膨胀高峰时低 1.5 个百分点（最高人民法院投资研究中心研究组 1992）。然而并没有采取太多措施来约束货币供应的增长，因为当年秋季的十四届党代会将决定重要的接班问题：江泽民和李鹏是否会继续担任…
lead the Party and the government and whether Zhu Rongji would be promoted to the Standing Committee. No one dared to “pour cold water” on local enthusiasm for fear of losing their positions. As expected, the Fourteenth Party Congress in October gave another ringing endorsement to local pursuit of high growth. Meanwhile, inflation began to rise and broke through the io percent mark during the first quarter in 1993. By the end of 1993, inflation had climbed to over 20 percent, some 10 percent higher than inflation in the previous year (Figure 7.2).
领导党和政府，以及朱镕基是否会被提升到常务委员会。没有人敢“浇冷水”以免丢掉位置。如预期，十月的第十四次党代会再次明确支持地方追求高增长。与此同时，通货膨胀开始上升，并在 1993 年第一季度突破 10%的关口。到 1993 年底，通货膨胀已升至 20%以上，比上一年高出约 10 个百分点（图 7.2）。

The Making of a New Economic Tsar
新经济沙皇的崛起

Despite Deng’s pivotal role in Zhu’s promotion to the center, Zhu eventually elected to take over as the head of the technocratic faction partly because he had more resources in the central bureaucracy. Already in early 1992, there was little indication that Zhu led the crusade to lessen central domination in response to the Southern Tour. Nonetheless, Deng continued to support his favorite technocrat. In 1992, Zhu’s power was further consolidated when Deng, with Bo Yibo’s support, transformed the State Council Production Office into the more permanent State Economic and Trade Office and placed Zhu at the head of it (Gao and He 1998). On Deng’s May 1992 inspection trip to the Capital Iron and Steel, Deng further praised Zhu for his technical ability (Fewsmith 2001: 62). Despite opposition by the ideological left of his promotion, Deng’s endorsement ensured Zhu’s rise to the Standing Committee at the Fourteenth Party Congress. Here, again, Chen Yun’s support for Zhu’s promotion cannot be underestimated. In Chen’s eulogy of Li Xiannian in July 1992, Chen wrote a passage that endorsed Zhu’s approach of managing the economy indirectly:
尽管邓在朱晋升到中央过程中发挥了关键作用，朱最终还是选择接掌技术官僚派系，部分原因是他在中央官僚体系中拥有更多资源。早在 1992 年初，就几乎没有迹象表明朱在南巡后领导了一场削弱中央支配的运动。尽管如此，邓仍继续支持他所青睐的技术官僚。1992 年，在薄一波的支持下，邓将国务院生产办公室改组为更为常设的国家经济贸易办公室并任命朱为主任，进一步巩固了朱的权力（Gao and He 1998）。在邓 1992 年 5 月视察首都钢铁时，邓又称赞了朱的技术能力（Fewsmith 2001: 62）。尽管他的提升遭到意识形态左派的反对，邓的背书确保了朱在第十四次党代会上进入政治局常务委员会。在这里，陈云对朱的支持也不容忽视。在 1992 年 7 月陈云为李先念所写的悼文中，陈云写下了一段认可朱间接管理经济方法的文字：
Now the scale of economic construction in our country is much greater and more complicated than before, so many effective measures in the past are no longer appropriate in the new situation of reform and opening. This means we have to work hard to learn new things and ceaselessly solve new problems. (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000)
现在我国经济建设的规模比过去大得多、复杂得多，因此过去许多行之有效的办法在改革开放的新形势下已不再适用。这就要求我们努力学习新事物，继续不断地解决新问题。（中共中央文件研究室 2000）
Although Li Peng had also supported the move toward indirect planning, he was certainly not known as a problem-solver. Rather, Zhu’s success with the triangular debt problem had established him as the foremost trouble-shooter in the central government. With endorsements from the two most important elders, Zhu was elected to the Standing Committee of the Politburo in October, leaping four steps in the Party hierarchy.
虽然李鹏也支持向间接计划转变，但他并不以善于解决问题著称。相反，朱镕基在三角债问题上的成功使他成为中央政府中首屈一指的排难解纷者。在两位最重要的元老的背书下，朱于十月当选为政治局常委，在党内等级上跃升了四级。
With his election to the highest ruling body in the Party and inflation rising at a rapid pace, Zhu had to make a choice about what type of official he would become. On the one hand, he could obey Deng’s wishes and become a cheerleader of local economic growth.
