On the other hand, he could take the place of the ailing Chen Yun and become China’s next economic tsar. Zhu chose the latter course probably out of two important considerations. First, looking forward to the post-Deng era, if he chose to play to the provinces, he would have had to contend with Jiang Zemin, Li Ruihuan, and possibly Qiao Shi
随着他当选为党内最高裁定机构成员且通货膨胀迅速上升，朱不得不决定自己将成为哪种类型的官员。一方面，他可以遵从邓的愿望，成为地方经济增长的鼓吹者。另一方面，他可以取代病重的陈云，成为中国下一任经济沙皇。朱很可能出于两个重要考虑而选择了后者。首先，展望后邓时代，如果他选择讨好地方，他将不得不与江泽民、李瑞环，甚至可能的乔石竞争。
for the support of provincial officials. He already lagged behind them in terms of local support network because Li Ruihuan had been a longtime local official, while Jiang had maneuvered many of his followers to top provincial posts following the Fourteenth Party Congress. At the same time, he had much less competition and many more resources in the central bureaucracy. Although Li Peng still headed the State Council, he was politically vulnerable after his leading role in the highly unpopular Tiananmen Massacre. Of the other vice premiers elected at the Eighth NPC at the beginning of 1993, only Li Lanqing posed a possible threat to him. More important, if he became the economic tsar, he could easily draw from an established network of central officials who had worked for him previously. When he was elevated to the vice premier position, Zhu recruited former colleagues to work in the Production Office, including former SEC colleagues Zhang Yanning and Zhao Weichen (Gao and He 1998: 332). Zhu also recruited many of Wu Jinglian and Liu Hongru’s students to work in senior positions at the State Council, including Zhou Xiaochuan, Lou Jiwei, Wu Xiaoling, and Guo Shuqing (Lam 1995: 342). Wang Zhongyu, Zhu’s right-hand man at the Production Office, became the new head of the State Economic and Trade Commission after the Fourteenth Party Congress, giving Zhu direct control over the powerful agency.
来争取省级官员的支持。他在地方支持网络方面已经落后于他们，因为李瑞环长期担任地方官员，而江泽民在第十四次党代会后将许多追随者调到了省级高位。与此同时，他在中央机构中面临的竞争少得多，资源也多得多。虽然李鹏仍然主持国务院，但由于他在极不受欢迎的天安门屠杀中扮演了主导角色，政治上已然脆弱。在 1993 年初第八届人大选出的其他副总理中，只有李岚清可能构成对他的威胁。更重要的是，如果他成为经济总管，他可以轻易动用一张由以前为他工作过的中央官员组成的既有网络。当他被提升为副总理时，朱镕基招募了以前的同事到生产办公室工作，包括前证监会同事张亚宁和赵卫辰（高和何 1998：332）。 朱还招募了吴敬琏和刘鸿儒的许多学生在国务院担任高级职务，包括周小川、楼继伟、吴晓灵和郭树清（Lam 1995: 342）。在十四大之后，朱在生产办公室的得力助手王忠宇成为新的国家经贸委主任，使朱直接掌控这一强大的机构。
The other possible rationale of becoming a centralizer was political ambition. Because the Fourteenth Party Congress had reaffirmed Jiang Zemin as the core of the Party leadership, it was all but certain that he would continue as General Secretary after the Fifteenth Party Congress. On the Party side, Zhu had risen as high as he could have as a member of the Standing Committee. Li Peng, however, had already served one full term as the Premier and had to retire from his post at the Fifteenth Party Congress. If Zhu established himself as an effective central administrator, he could well gather sufficient support for a bid to be the next Premier of China. It would be the ultimate fulfillment of a long and distinguished career in the central bureaucracy. In this case, both motive and opportunity combined to make the path of the top technocrat extremely attractive to Zhu.
成为集权者的另一个可能动机是政治抱负。由于第十四次党代会已重申江泽民为党内领导核心，几乎可以确定他在第十五次党代会后将继续担任总书记。在党内，朱已作为常务委员会成员上升到他所能达到的最高位置。然而李鹏已完整任满一届总理，并须在第十五次党代会上从其职务上退休。如果朱能确立自己为一名有效的中央行政管理者，他很可能获得足够的支持，竞选下一任中国国务院总理。这将是其长期且卓越的中央官僚生涯的终极实现。就此而言，动机与机会二者结合，使得走上首席技术官这一道路对朱极具吸引力。
Zhu began to reveal his anti-inflationary preference in the spring of 1993. The break came when Li Peng suffered a heart attack and was hospitalized in April, which made Zhu the acting premier. At the end of May, Chen Yun returned to Beijing to coordinate retrenchment one last time (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000). With Li Peng in convalescence and Yao Yilin gravely ill, Chen relied on Zhu to carry out the retrenchment. Soon after Chen’s return, Zhu Rongji held an emergency meeting on the economy at the Fengtai Hotel in Beijing, where he invited numerous veteran state planners to provide him political support (Brahm 2002: 17). To the astonishment of his audience of central and local officials, Zhu first announced that the current PBOC governor Li Guixian - a Li Peng loyalist - would be removed from his post, replaced by Zhu himself. Second, Zhu issued the “Sixteen Measures” (shiliu tiao) to constrain inflationary pressure, anchored by strict limits on fixed asset investment, real estate development, lending, the flow of foreign exchange, and the issuance
朱镕基在 1993 年春天开始显露出反通胀取向。转折发生在李鹏于 4 月突发心脏病入院，使朱成为代总理。五月底，陈云回到北京最后一次协调紧缩（中国共产党中央文献研究室 2000）。在李鹏康复期间、姚依林病重之时，陈云依靠朱来执行紧缩。不久在陈云回京后，朱镕基在北京丰台宾馆召开了一次关于经济的紧急会议，邀请了众多资深国家计划者为他提供政治支持（Brahm 2002: 17）。令中央和地方官员听众惊讶的是，朱首先宣布将撤换当时的中国人民银行行长李贵鲜——一位李鹏的忠实支持者——由他本人接任。其次，朱发布了“十六条”以遏制通胀压力，其核心是严格限制固定资产投资、房地产开发、放贷、外汇流动及票据的发行

With the premier in convalescence, Zhu worked in earnest to stifle inflationary pressure and to centralize China’s monetary system. Although Zhu’s replacement of Li Guixian as the head of the PBOC reflected a certain amount of enmity between him and Li Peng, Zhu also wanted a firm grasp on money supply in order to assure Chen Yun and Yao Yilin that he was up to the challenge. A clear sign of Zhu’s ties with the elder planners was his choice for the vice governors of the PBOC. Zhu elevated Chen Yuan, the son of Chen Yun, to become the executive vice governor of the PBOC and promoted Wang Qishan, the son-in-law of Yao Yilin, to serve as another vice-governor (Gao and He 1998). To the multitude of local officials watching for political signals from the center, these promotions provided clear signs that Zhu had taken over from Chen as the next economic tsar of China. The question now was whether Zhu could become a credible politician who could bring about local compliance.
在总理休养期间，朱镕基全力以赴遏制通胀压力并整合中国的货币体系。虽然朱将李贵宪换下中国人民银行行长一职在一定程度上反映了他与李鹏之间的敌意，但朱也希望牢牢掌控货币供给，以向陈云和姚依林证明他有能力应对挑战。朱与这些资深计划者关系的一个明显标志，是他对人民银行副行长人选的任命。朱提拔了陈云之子陈元为人民银行常务副行长，并提升了姚依林女婿王岐山任另一位副行长（Gao and He 1998）。对于众多关注中央政治信号的地方官员而言，这些晋升清楚地表明朱已接替陈成为中国下一任经济枢纽。现在的问题是，朱能否成为一位可信的政治家，从而促使地方服从。
While Zhu was establishing himself as the head of the technocratic faction, Jiang also adapted to his role as the head of the dominant generalist faction. After Deng’s threat of removing him shocked him out of his planners’ mold, Jiang began to pay much closer attention to the needs of the local governments, especially given that Li Ruihuan and Qiao Shi stood ready to replace him. Since taking office, Jiang had begun to give more financial authority and central subsides to Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Jilin, where his close followers headed the provincial leadership (Cotton 1996; Lin 1998). In the spring and summer of 1993, Jiang visited a string of provinces in eastern and western China. Although initially he did not work against Zhu’s retrenchment efforts, he also did not stress retrenchment in his remarks to local officials. In his remarks in Xi’an, for example, Jiang began with an extensive praise of Deng’s line of rapid reform and development and spent only the last part of his speech mentioning the “contradiction” in the economy (Fourth Editorial Bureau of the Central Document Research Center 1999).
在朱确立自己作为技术官僚派系首脑的同时，江也在适应他作为主导的通才派系首脑的角色。在邓以罢免威胁把他从计划者模式中惊醒之后，江开始更加关注地方政府的需求，尤其是考虑到李瑞环和乔石随时可以取而代之。上任以来，江已开始向上海、江苏、浙江和吉林——他的亲信担任省委领导的省份——给予更多财政权力和中央补贴（Cotton 1996；Lin 1998）。1993 年春夏，江走访了中国东部和西部的一系列省份。尽管起初他并未反对朱的收缩政策，他在对地方官员的讲话中也没有强调收缩。例如在西安的讲话中，江以对邓的快速改革发展路线的广泛赞誉开篇，只有在讲话的最后部分才提到经济中的“矛盾”（中央文献研究室第四编辑室 1999）。
As Zhu’s anti-inflation stance hardened in the summer and fall of 1993, however, Jiang began actively to undermine Zhu’s effort. Again, pressure from factional rival Li Ruihuan played a crucial part in Jiang’s action. In the midst of rising inflation, Li Ruihuan continued to espouse high-speed growth without reservation: “any government unit or individual can only find a legitimate position, serve one’s intended role, and demonstrate one’s worth by insisting on, obeying, and serving the central task of economic construction” (Li 1999). With this reminder of the dire consequences of deviating from the Dengist line of high growth and decentralization, Jiang subverted the retrenchment in various ways. For one, during the discussion on what to name the Sixteen Measures, State Council technocrats originally suggested calling it a “Decision” (jueding), which was the harshest kind of central decree demanding absolute obedience. However, a coalition in the Standing Committee, most likely including Jiang,
然而，随着朱镕基在 1993 年夏季和秋季对抗通货膨胀立场的加强，江泽民开始积极削弱朱的努力。同样，来自政治对手李瑞环的压力在江的行动中发挥了关键作用。在通货膨胀上升之际，李瑞环继续毫无保留地鼓吹高速增长：“任何政府部门或个人只能找到合乎合法的位置，通过坚持、服从并服务于经济建设这一中心任务来发挥其应有作用、体现其价值”（李 1999）。借此提醒偏离邓小平式的高速增长与分权路线会带来严重后果，江以各种方式破坏了紧缩政策。例如，在关于将“十六条”命名为何物的讨论中，国务院技术官僚最初建议称之为“决定”（jueding），这是最严厉的一类中央法令，要求绝对的服从。然而，常委会内的一个联盟，很可能包括江在内，...
vetoed it and suggested a milder “Opinion” (yijian) (Chen 2005: 273). I2 I2  ^("I2 "){ }^{\text {I2 }} Furthermore, after the issuance of the Sixteen Measures, Jiang vetoed the SPC’s proposal of holding a national conference to sternly convey the spirit of the Sixteen Measures to local leaders. Instead of showing the unity of the leadership through a central work conference, as had been the practice in previous inflationary cycles, Jiang opted to chair two separate work conferences in Dalian and Guangzhou so that local cadres could “convey to him what specific policies they would implement” during the retrenchment (Chen 2005: 272). However, the separation of the work conference completely turned the intention of the Sixteen Measures on its head. Like previous austerity plans, the Sixteen Measures contained fairly specific demands with which all local officials were required to comply. Instead of demanding uniform compliance, Jiang used the Sixteen Measures as a means of garnering local support through granting local officials individual exemptions. In September, Jiang further went on a tour of Guangdong and urged cadres to “not lose the opportunity to push forward reform and opening and to sustain high speed growth” (Editors 1994).
否决了它，并建议改为较温和的“意见”（yijian）（Chen 2005: 273）。 I2 I2  ^("I2 "){ }^{\text {I2 }} 此外，在《十六条》发布后，江否决了最高人民法院关于召开全国会议以严肃向地方领导传达《十六条》精神的提议。江没有像以往通货膨胀周期那样通过中央工作会议来显示领导层的统一，而是选择在大连和广州分别主持两次工作会议，以便地方干部能在紧缩期间“向他传达他们将实施哪些具体政策”（Chen 2005: 272）。然而，工作会议的分离完全颠倒了《十六条》的初衷。与以往的紧缩方案一样，《十六条》包含了相当具体的要求，所有地方官员都必须遵守。江并未要求统一遵守，而是利用《十六条》作为通过给予地方官员个别豁免来争取地方支持的手段。 九月，江进一步赴广东视察，并敦促干部“不要放过推进改革开放的机会，要保持高速增长”（Editors 1994）。
Given the mixed signals emanating from the central leadership, it was not surprising that the Sixteen Measures were met with stiff local resistance. In July 1993, the State Council sent out seven work teams to determine the amount of irregular loans in twenty provinces and to ensure that local banks were earnestly recalling these loans before the August 15 deadline. However, the work teams had to contend with recalcitrant local officials in many places. In one case, the local government shut down all the banks, causing depositors to stage largescale protests, which forced Zhu to give additional liquidity to the province to preserve social stability (Chen 2005: 277). In other cases, work teams could not find the provincial leadership, who were “out on inspection,” which paralyzed the work teams’ progress (Chen 2005:277). Furthermore, even after the issuance of the Sixteen Measures, local governments continued to pressure banks for generous loans (Zhu 1999). Strong-arm tactics had allowed Zhu to solve the triangular debt problem quickly in 1991. Nonetheless, Zhu’s earlier effort with triangular debt had enjoyed Deng’s support; these retrenchment measures were subverted by Jiang. According to the Hong Kong press, the PBOC was only able to collect one-third of all irregular loans by mid-August. Guangdong only recovered 40 percent of the loans, whereas Hainan collected 50 percent (Lam 1995: 123).
鉴于中央领导层发出的混合信号，十六条措施遭到地方强烈抵制并不令人意外。1993 年 7 月，国务院派出七个工作组到二十个省份查明违规贷款数额，并确保地方银行在 8 月 15 日截止日前认真收回这些贷款。然而，工作组在许多地方不得不应对顽固的地方官员。在一起案件中，当地政府关闭了所有银行，导致存款人发起大规模抗议，迫使朱为了维护社会稳定向该省追加流动性（陈 2005：277）。在其他情况下，工作组无法找到省级领导，因为他们“外出视察”，这使工作组的工作陷入瘫痪（陈 2005：277）。此外，即便在十六条措施发布之后，地方政府仍继续向银行施压要求发放大额贷款（朱 1999）。强硬手段曾使朱在 1991 年迅速解决了三角债问题。然而，朱早先处理三角债时得到了邓的支持；这些紧缩措施则被江所破坏。 据香港媒体报道，截至八月中旬，PBOC 仅收回了三分之一的全部违规贷款。广东只收回了 40%的贷款，而海南收回了 50%（Lam 1995: 123）。
Making matters worse for Zhu, mixed signals from the Standing Committee also undermined the resolve of the central bureaucracy to carry out the
更糟的是，来自常务委员会的混乱信号也削弱了中央官僚机构执行收缩政策的决心，这对朱的处境雪上加霜。
retrenchment. As the head of the SPC at the time put it, “most of all, I was afraid I did not understand the instructions of Deng Xiaoping well enough and might blunder. . . . I also could not afford to offend the ‘dukes’ at the local level” (Chen 2005: 265). To the multitude of besieged bankers and technocrats, Zhu could only offer words of encouragement at the July Central Finance Conference: “I know you confront pressure from two sides and criticism from three sides…I completely understand your situation, and I express my heartfelt well-wishes” (Zhu 1999).
正如当时 SPC 负责人所言，“最重要的是，我担心自己对邓小平的指示理解得不够透彻，可能会犯错误……我也不能冒犯地方上的‘大人’”（Chen 2005: 265）。对于众多被围困的银行家和技术官僚，朱在七月中央财政会议上只能给予鼓励的话语：“我知道你们面临两方面的压力，三方面的批评……我完全理解你们的处境，并表示衷心的祝愿”（Zhu 1999）。
Zhu’s retrenchment efforts suffered another major setback in February 1994 when Deng signaled a strong desire to end austerity. On his last tour to the provinces, Deng poignantly revealed this desire to the party secretary of Jiangsu: “When you develop the economy, go as fast as you can. Do not debate whether growth should be fast or slow” (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2004). Deng likely chose that time to act because Chen Yun’s health suffered a serious setback in September of 1993 and had to return to Shanghai for convalescence (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000: 445). Although Zhu was able to push through several measures that improved the performance of the banking system at the end of 1993, including the strengthening of the PBOC and the creation of policy banks to take over policy lending, he also was forced to release an extra 100 billion yuan into the state banking system, which generated an additional 260 billion yuan in bank loans (Lam 1995: 126; State Economic System Reform Commission Investigation Team to Liaoning 1994). As Figure 7.2 demonstrates, Deng’s remarks accelerated lending and rekindled inflationary pressure for the next several quarters. The events in the fall and winter of 1993 constituted an enormous blow to Zhu’s budding credibility. At the Fengtai meeting, Zhu had sternly warned local officials that the state banks could not exceed the revised credit quota, or else face Zhu’s wrath (Zhu 1993). Jiang’s effort to undermine the Sixteen Measures and Deng’s February remarks made his threat completely empty.
朱镕基的紧缩努力在 1994 年 2 月遭遇了又一次重大挫折，当时邓小平表达了强烈的结束紧缩的意愿。在他最后一次下省视察时，邓深情地对江苏省委书记透露了这一愿望：“发展经济要抓紧发展，不能争论快还是慢”（中共中央文献研究室 2004）。邓很可能选择在那时采取行动，因为陈云在 1993 年 9 月健康状况严重恶化，不得不回上海休养（中共中央文献研究室 2000：445）。尽管朱在 1993 年底推动通过了几项改善银行体系表现的措施，包括加强人民银行职能和设立政策性银行以接管政策性贷款，但他也被迫向国有银行体系额外注入 1000 亿元人民币，这又产生了 2600 亿元的银行贷款（Lam 1995：126；国家经济体制改革委员会调查组致辽宁 1994）。如图 7.2 所示，邓的言论加速了放贷并在随后的几个季度重新点燃了通胀压力。 1993 年秋冬发生的事件对朱镕基新生的公信力造成了巨大打击。在丰台会议上，朱曾严厉警告地方官员，国有银行不得超过修订后的信贷配额，否则将面临朱的惩处（Zhu 1993）。江泽民削弱《十六条措施》的努力以及邓小平二月的表态使得他的威胁完全失去了作用。
The change in policy direction quickly exacerbated inflationary pressure. Although increases in lending had a lag effect on inflation, speculators saw the change in monetary policy as the beginning of another real estate bubble. According to a secret government report, speculators bought up large quantity of steel and construction material during the fourth quarter in 1993 in anticipation of another building boom, which further increased inflationary pressure (Li 1994b). The first quarter of 1994 saw inflation creeping up beyond the 20 percent mark (Wu 1994).
政策方向的转变迅速加剧了通货膨胀压力。尽管放贷增加对通胀有滞后效应，但投机者将货币政策的变化视为另一轮房地产泡沫的开端。根据一份政府内部的秘密报告，投机者在 1993 年第四季度囤积了大量钢材和建筑材料，预期又一轮建筑热潮，从而进一步推高了通胀压力（Li 1994b）。1994 年第一季度，通货膨胀率攀升并超过 20%（Wu 1994）。
Despite initial setbacks for Zhu’s bid to establish himself as a credible politician, 1994 saw Zhu Rongji developing into a powerful figure in his own right, which gradually increased the credibility of the anti-inflationary measures. In March, Zhu was formally designated as the stand-in Premier if Li Peng was absent. This allowed him to attend Central Military Commission meetings and other high level meetings unrelated to economic affairs, giving him access to a wide range of information beyond economic affairs (Ren 1999). Two events in the first half of 1994 provided significant boosts to Zhu’s political credibility.
尽管朱旨在确立自己作为一名可信政治家的努力最初遭遇挫折，1994 年朱镕基逐渐发展成为一位独立的强有力人物，这也逐步提升了反通胀措施的可信度。3 月，朱被正式指定为在李鹏缺席时代理总理。这使他得以出席中央军委会议及其他与经济事务无关的高层会议，使他能够获取超出经济事务范围的广泛信息（Ren 1999）。1994 年上半年发生的两件事显著增强了朱的政治信誉。
During an inspection tour to Heilongjiang in April, Zhu personally removed Governor Sun Weiben from power for failing to prevent workers’ unrest and for his failure to rein in inflation (Jen 1994b). This episode demonstrated Zhu’s no nonsense style, but it also signaled to local officials that Zhu was a powerful politician in his own right who could make major decisions on the spot. The second event involved a Hong Kong journalist named Xi Wang who had apparently quoted an anonymous PBOC official about Chinese interest rate policies. On his next trip to China, the State Security Ministry arrested him and kept him in detention without a formal charge for six months. In April 1994, he was sentenced to prison for twelve years for “stealing and probing into state financial secrets” (Leung 1994). According to Hong Kong sources, although the liberal faction within the Party had lobbied for the reporter’s release, Zhu personally ordered harsh punishment for him (Leung 1994). Whether this was true or not, this rumor doubtless suggested to local officials Zhu’s increasing clout as a politician instead of merely a technocrat.
在四月的一次黑龙江视察中，朱亲自免去了孙维本的职务，理由是他未能阻止工人骚乱以及未能控制通货膨胀（Jen 1994b）。此事显示了朱的雷厉风行风格，但也向地方官员表明朱是个有实权的政治家，能够当场做出重大决定。第二件事涉及一名名叫习旺的香港记者，他显然引用了一位匿名 PBOC 官员关于中国利率政策的言论。在他下一次来华时，国家安全部逮捕了他，并在没有正式指控的情况下拘押了他六个月。1994 年 4 月，他因“窃取和探取国家金融秘密”被判处十二年监禁（Leung 1994）。据香港方面消息，尽管党内自由派曾游说释放该记者，朱个人下令对他严厉处置（Leung 1994）。不论此事真假，这一传闻无疑向地方官员暗示了朱作为政治人物而非仅仅技术官僚的影响力日益增强。
As Zhu worked to establish his credibility, inflation continued to climb in the first half of 1994, reaching the post-1978 high of 27.5 percent during the third quarter. The emerging financial crisis finally prepared the way for retrenchment. In June, Zhu chaired a Seven-Province Economic Work Conference involving Hubei, Hunan, Anhui, Jiangxi, Hebei, Shandong, and Henan to enforce compliance with a host of policy issues, including monetary control (Ho 1994; Jen 1994a). He might have chosen to crack down on these provinces first because they were not economic powerhouses. If they obeyed central policies, he could then focus his attention on more independent provinces like Guangdong and Jiangsu.
随着朱努力建立自己的信誉，1994 年上半年通货膨胀继续攀升，第三季度达到自 1978 年以来的最高点 27.5%。新出现的金融危机最终为收缩政策铺平了道路。6 月，朱主持召开了一个由湖北、湖南、安徽、江西、河北、山东和河南七省参加的经济工作会议，以加强对包括货币控制在内的一系列政策问题的合规（Ho 1994；Jen 1994a）。他之所以可能先选择对这些省份严厉执法，是因为它们并非经济强省。如果它们遵守中央政策，他随后就可以把注意力集中到像广东和江苏这样更独立的省份上。
Zhu’s full assault on decentralized finance came at the Beidaihe Conference in August 1994. At that time, inflation in some provinces was rapidly climbing past 30 percent, and reports of panic buying began to pour into the central government (Chen 2005: 280; Ren 1994). Beyond the developing crisis, Zhu also took advantage of Jiang’s need for political allies at that crucial moment to launch credible retrenchment. We can surmise from subsequent events that Zhu was a member of a pro-Jiang coalition that allowed Jiang to make three crucial maneuvers in the fall of 1994 and in 1995. First, the September fourth plenum granted Jiang the title “the core of the third generation leadership,” confirming Jiang’s leading role in the Standing Committee. Second, the fourth plenum also saw the promotion of Wu Bangguo and Huang Ju - two officials from Shanghai who had worked closely with both Jiang and Zhu - into the Politburo (Fewsmith 2001: 162). According to the Hong Kong press, these promotions angered officials from the other regions because they clearly showed regional favoritism (Lam 1994). Finally, in the winter of 1994-1995, a corruption investigation was launched against the Beijing city government, which ultimately led to the removal of one of Jiang’s main political rivals, Beijing party secretary and Politburo member Chen Xitong (Gilley 1998: 244). Although no one openly opposed the investigation and the eventual arrest, Zhu’s uncompromising stance throughout the investigation balanced against those who urged more lenience,
朱在 1994 年 8 月北戴河会议上对地方分权金融的全面进攻。当时，部分省份的通货膨胀率快速攀升至 30%以上，关于抢购恐慌的报告开始大量涌入中央（Chen 2005: 280；Ren 1994）。除了利用正在发展的危机外，朱还借助江在这一关键时刻对政治盟友的需要，发起了可信的收缩政策。我们可以从随后发生的事件推测，朱是一个亲江联盟的成员，该联盟使江在 1994 年秋和 1995 年得以实施三项关键举措。首先，九月的第四次全体会议赋予江“第三代领导核心”的称号，确认了江在常委会的领导地位。其次，第四次全体会议还将吴邦国和黄菊——两位曾在上海与江和朱密切合作的官员——提拔进了政治局（Fewsmith 2001: 162）。据香港媒体报道，这些提拔激怒了来自其他地区的官员，因为它们明显显示出地区偏袒（Lam 1994）。 最后，在 1994—1995 年冬季，对北京市政府发起了一项反腐调查，最终导致江泽民的一个主要政治对手、北京市委书记兼政治局委员陈希同被免职（Gilley 1998: 244）。 尽管没有人公开反对这项调查和最终的逮捕，朱镕基在整个调查过程中采取的不妥协立场与那些主张更宽大处理的人形成了制衡，
which made it easier for Jiang to fully dismantle Chen Xitong’s faction and to send a stern warning to his other rivals (Ren 1999: 31).
这使得江泽民更容易彻底瓦解陈希同的派系，并向他的其他对手发出严厉警告（Ren 1999: 31）。
Although Deng doubtless gave his blessing to all three maneuvers, Jiang nonetheless needed allies in the Politburo Standing Committee (PSC) to ensure all three decisions pass PSC votes. Although Li Peng’s fate was tied with Jiang because of his role in Tiananmen and junior Hu Jintao could be counted on to vote for the General Secretary, Li Ruihuan, Qiao Shi, and PLA veteran Liu Huaqing were powerful and independent figures in their own right who could potentially form an anti-Jiang coalition. This left Zhu Rongji the crucial swing vote, which could ensure Jiang’s victory. Although Zhu and Jiang had been colleagues in Shanghai, Zhu’s rising political authority in 1994 meant that his political support could not be taken for granted and would not have come cheaply. Still, Jiang knew that Zhu did not have the means to challenge him for ultimate power but instead demanded reign over economic policies in exchange for his support.
尽管邓肯定对这三项举措都表示赞同，但江仍然需要政治局常务委员会（PSC）中的盟友以确保三项决定在常务委员会投票通过。虽然李鹏因其在天安门事件中的角色与江命运相连，年幼的胡锦涛可以被寄望为总书记投票，但李瑞环、乔石和解放军老将刘华清本身都是强大且独立的人物，可能会组成一个反江联盟。这就使得朱镕基成为决定性的摇摆票，能够确保江的胜利。尽管朱与江曾在上海共事，但朱在 1994 年日益上升的政治权威意味着不能把他的政治支持视为理所当然，且不会轻易得到。尽管如此，江知道朱并无手段挑战他的最高权力，而是要求以掌控经济政策作为其支持的交换条件。
Thus, similar to the pacts that Deng and Chen had struck in 1978 and again in 1989, Zhu Rongji agreed to support Jiang at this crucial moment in exchange for financial centralization. At the Beidaihe Conference, Zhu made forceful arguments to the other central leaders that harsh retrenchment measures, rather than “soft-landing” policies, were needed to rein in inflation. Despite dangerously high inflation, some at the meeting - most likely either Li Ruihuan or Qiao Shi - still made the Zhaoist argument of “acceptable inflation” (Hsu 1994). With Jiang’s support, Zhu ultimately prevailed in the debate, and a group of PBOC technocrats was hurriedly convened at Beidaihe to draft a series of retrenchment measures in late August. In classic planners’ fashion, Zhu held PBOC branch managers personally responsible for controlling the expansion of fixed-asset lending and for cracking down on illegal financial institutions (Fourth Editorial Bureau of the Central Document Research Center 1999). Moreover, for the remainder of 1994, working capital loans could only be issued for a few uses specified by the State Council (Xinhua News Agency 1994b).
因此，类似于邓小平和陈云在 1978 年及 1989 年所达成的协议，朱镕基在这个关键时刻同意以支持江泽民作为交换条件，推动金融集中化。在北戴河会议上，朱向其他中央领导人强烈论证，必须采取严厉的紧缩措施，而不是“软着陆”政策，来遏制通货膨胀。尽管通货膨胀高得危险，会议上仍有人——很可能是李瑞环或乔石——提出了赵氏的“可接受通胀”论点（Hsu 1994）。在江的支持下，朱最终在辩论中获胜，一批中国人民银行的技术官僚在八月底被匆忙召集到北戴河，起草了一系列紧缩措施。按照典型的计划者作风，朱要求中国人民银行各分行行长对控制固定资产贷款扩张和打击非法金融机构负起个人责任（中央文献研究室第四编辑室 1999）。此外，在 1994 年剩余时间里，营运资金贷款只能按照国务院规定的少数用途发放（新华社 1994b）。
To ensure disinflation, Zhu resorted to direct administrative controls favored by his predecessors. In early September, Zhu chaired a televised conference on price control and announced stringent measures to control the prices of grain, vegetables, and meats. New measures were implemented to ensure the adequate supply of food at state mandated prices (Fourth Editorial Bureau of the Central Document Research Center 1999). Because Shanghai, Guangdong, and Beijing were known to be the major sources of inflation, Zhu held the party secretaries of these places personally responsible for the adequate supply of cheap food (Ren 1999). Zhu’s retrenchment effort was further affirmed at the November 1994 Central Economic Work Conference, where Jiang told cadres that the foremost task in the coming year was inflation control. Instead of the mixed signals sent in the previous year, the leadership presented a unified front against inflation. In the spring of 1995, as anticorruption investigators swooped down on the Beijing municipal government, Zhu’s centralization policy finally managed to first flatten and then reduce inflation. It is unclear what Deng thought of
为确保抑制通货膨胀，朱采取了其前任偏好的直接行政控制。九月初，朱主持了一次关于价格管制的电视会议，并宣布采取严格措施控制谷物、蔬菜和肉类的价格。新措施被实施以确保在国家规定价格下食品的充足供应（中央文献研究室第四编辑室 1999）。因为上海、广东和北京被认为是通货膨胀的主要源头，朱亲自追究这些地区党委书记对廉价食品充足供应的责任（任 1999）。朱的收缩努力在 1994 年 11 月的中央经济工作会议上进一步得到确认，会上江告诉干部们来年首要任务是控制通货膨胀。与前一年发出的混合信号不同，领导层在对抗通货膨胀上呈现出统一阵线。1995 年春，当反腐调查突袭北京市政府时，朱的集权政策最终设法先抑制后降低了通货膨胀。邓对此的看法尚不清楚。
Zhu’s retrenchment drive. He probably gave his reluctant endorsement, as he had done several times before. His declining health in the second half of 1994 likely prevented him from doing more. It is clear, however, that the retrenchment drive in 1994, unlike the one in 1993, relied mainly on the political clout of Zhu Rongji and, to a lesser extent, Li Peng. In May 1994, Chen Yun had fallen seriously ill and did not engage in any more policy making before his death in early 1995. Yao was similarly indisposed for much of 1994 and passed away at the end of the year (Document Research Center of the CCP CC 2000: 447). Despite Chen’s fast declining health, he was comforted by the fact that Zhu had made a successful transition to become China’s next economic tsar. When the leadership went to the hospital to report the successes of the stabilization policies in January 1995, Chen Yun, who by then could no longer speak, expressed approval with “a grateful smile” (Yang 2005: 292).
朱的紧缩运动。他大概像以前几次那样不情愿地表示了支持。1994 年下半年他身体状况恶化，可能使他无法做更多事情。然而，很明显 1994 年的紧缩运动与 1993 年的不同，主要依靠朱镕基的政治影响力，李鹏在较小程度上也起了作用。1994 年 5 月，陈云病重，在 1995 年初去世前不再参与任何政策制定。姚也在 1994 年大部分时间身体欠佳，并于年末去世（中共中央文献研究室 2000：447）。尽管陈云身体快速恶化，但他因朱成功过渡并成为中国下任经济权威而感到欣慰。1995 年 1 月领导人到医院汇报稳定政策的成果时，陈云那时已不能言语，只是以“感激的微笑”表示赞同（杨 2005：292）。

The Continuation of the Two Tendencies
两种倾向的延续

Whereas the first two inflationary cycles in the reform era mainly involved the interplay between Deng and Chen, the 1987-1990 and the 1991-1996 inflationary cycles saw the emergence of the next generation of leaders playing the roles of financial decentralizers and centralizers. While Zhao - and, to a lesser extent, Jiang - championed local causes and attempted to increase the regime’s tolerance for inflation, Zhu took over from Chen in 1994 to maintain central control of monetary policies. Although Zhu’s vision of central control was closer to Western notions of monetary policy, his main priority was to uphold central authority and to control inflation, as seen in his willingness to use administrative measures.
在改革时期最初的两轮通货膨胀周期主要体现为邓与陈之间的相互作用，而 1987–1990 年和 1991–1996 年的通货膨胀周期则出现了新一代领导人扮演金融分权者与集权者的角色。赵——在较小程度上还有江——拥护地方利益并试图提高政权对通货膨胀的容忍度，1994 年朱接替陈以维持对货币政策的中央控制。尽管朱对中央控制的构想更接近西方的货币政策理念，但他的主要优先事项是维护中央权威并控制通货膨胀，这从他愿意使用行政手段中可见一斑。
That these younger leaders fell into their respective roles could partially be explained by their factional bases. Zhao had a wide network of local supporters by the time he became premier, which made him a natural champion of decentralized finance. Although Jiang showed initial reluctance to galvanize local enthusiasm, Deng’s threat to remove him and his expanding network of local supporters soon compelled him to actively support inflationary finance at the local level. On the centralizer’s side, Li Peng never worked a day in the local government and became the natural successor to the planners. He filled that role marvelously during the correction and rectification phase. Zhu, in contrast, started out as Deng’s designated cheerleader for renewed local enthusiasm. But as a result of political exigencies and his long career in the central bureaucracy, he ended up as China’s new economic tsar. Although exogenous political factors played an important role in determining these leaders’ preference for financial policies, they also were driven to a significant extent by the preferences of their main support bases. It simply made little sense in the long run to champion policies that went against the interests of one’s factional support base.
这些年轻领导人落到各自位置上，部分可以用他们的派系基础来解释。赵在出任总理时已有广泛的地方支持网络，这使他成为分权金融的天然拥护者。尽管江起初对调动地方热情表现出犹豫，但邓威胁要罢免他以及他日益扩大的地方支持网络，很快迫使他积极支持地方层面的通货膨胀性财政。拥护集权者一方，李鹏从未在地方政府工作过一天，因而成为计划者的自然继承人。在整顿整饬阶段，他极好地担当了这一角色。相比之下，朱最初被邓指定为恢复地方热情的助威者。但由于政治上的紧迫需要以及他在中央官僚体系中的长期任职，最终他成了中国新的经济沙皇。尽管外生政治因素在决定这些领导人对财政政策偏好方面起了重要作用，但他们在相当程度上也受到了其主要支持基础偏好的驱动。 从长远看，鼓吹与自身派系支持基础利益相悖的政策本来就毫无意义。
The most extraordinary aspect of financial politics illustrated by these cases was that all the actors involved were powerful political figures in their own right.
这些案例所展示的金融政治中最非同寻常的一点是：所有参与者本身都是颇具权势的政治人物。
Unlike the usual portrayal of technocrats who were either agents to political principals or “insulated” technocrats operating beyond the pull of politics, technocrats in China were highly politicized. In fact, these cases clearly show that it was precisely their political involvement that allowed them to balance against inflationary tendencies. If Chen Yun had not been able to blackmail Deng over the SEZ issue and with a possible corruption investigation of his son, inflationary pressure would have reached Brazilian proportion in 1988. If Zhu had not been able to provide crucial political support for Jiang’s consolidation, Jiang could not have credibly delegated financial authorities to Zhu. In the absence of a politically credible centralizer, China would have experienced much higher inflation.
与通常将技术官僚描绘为政治主子的代理人或“被隔离”的、超脱政治影响的技术官僚不同，中国的技术官僚高度政治化。事实上，这些案例清楚地表明，正是他们的政治参与使他们能够平衡通货膨胀倾向。如果陈云不能在经济特区问题上对邓施加胁迫并以其子可能面临的腐败调查作为筹码，1988 年的通货膨胀压力本会达到巴西式的程度。如果朱镕基不能为江泽民的巩固提供关键的政治支持，江就无法有可信度地将金融权力委托给朱。在缺乏政治上可信的中央集权者的情况下，中国本会经历更高的通货膨胀。
Elite struggle over monetary centralization, however, did not produce a similar struggle over the status of the state banks. Deng, Zhao, and Jiang all encouraged local officials to intervene in the state banking system to boost local growth. Although the central bureaucracy implemented some policies to modernize the state banking system, the new generation of bureaucrats did not hesitate to use the banking system to solve pressing policy problems. Zhu Rongji first established himself as a capable problem solver by injection 8 o billion yuan in bank loans into ailing SOEs. As the next chapter reveals, even after the technocratic faction gained unprecedented power in 1997, it continued to use the banking system to fulfill various policy missions.
然而，围绕货币集中化的精英斗争并未在国有银行地位上引发同样的斗争。邓小平、赵紫阳和江泽民都鼓励地方官员干预国家银行体系以促进地方增长。尽管中央官僚机构实施了一些使国有银行体系现代化的政策，新一代官僚并不犹豫于利用银行体系来解决迫切的政策问题。朱镕基首先通过向陷入困境的国有企业注入 800 亿元银行贷款，确立了自己作为能干的解决者的形象。正如下一章所揭示的，即便在技官派在 1997 年获得空前权力之后，仍然继续利用银行体系来完成各种政策任务。

The Long Cycle: 1997-2006
长周期：1997–2006

The most recent monetary cycle in China persisted for nearly a decade. Despite a seeming lull in monetary fluctuation under Zhu Rongji, the sudden surge of lending and investment in 2002 suggests that monetary cycles are by no means artifacts of the Deng era. Even as China established a series of monetary institutions modeled after Western central banks, politics continued to play an important role in driving monetary outcomes. The central technocrats’ prolonged domination over financial policy began in 1997. Unlike previous times when they had gained such control, the cause was an external shock - the Asian Financial Crisis - rather than an internal inflationary crisis. The Asian Financial Crisis gave the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) leadership a rude awakening on the economic front similar to the political shock they had received from the dissolution of the Soviet Union. The crisis, however, was more anticipated than real because foreign exchange control minimized the possibility of capital flight from China. Despite the remoteness of an actual crisis, Zhu Rongji, newly promoted to the position of Premier, mobilized the State Council research apparatus to paint a bleak portrait of the Chinese financial sector in order to centralize financial power. Jiang Zemin, not wanting to risk any instability after Deng’s death, abandoned his plans to pursue energetic growth and sanctioned Zhu’s centralization policies.
中国最近一次货币周期持续了近十年。尽管在朱镕基执政期间货币波动似乎有所平静，但 2002 年信贷和投资的突然激增表明，货币周期绝非邓小平时代的产物。即便中国建立了一系列以西方中央银行为范式的货币机构，政治仍然在驱动货币结果方面发挥着重要作用。中央技术官僚对金融政策的长期主导始于 1997 年。与以往通过内部通胀危机取得控制不同，这次的起因是外部冲击——亚洲金融危机——而非内部通胀危机。亚洲金融危机给中国共产党（CCP）领导层在经济层面带来了类似于苏联解体对政治层面的严重震动。然而，这场危机较之实际影响更像是被预期的，因为外汇管制将资本外逃的可能性降到了最低。 尽管实际危机并不迫在眉睫，新近晋升为国务院总理的朱镕基还是动员了国务院的研究机构，描绘出中国金融业一副黯淡的图景，以集中金融权力。江泽民为了避免在邓小平去世后冒任何不稳定的风险，放弃了推动积极增长的计划，并批准了朱的金融集中政策。
In the aftermath of the Asian Financial Crisis, Jiang continued to face challenges from the army and the security apparatus, which perpetuated his reliance on Zhu for crucial political support. As a result, financial centralization continued uninterrupted under Zhu. These political contingencies conspired to create the longest period of monetary stability in the reform era, despite historically low inflation. However, after Jiang finally managed to consolidate control over the regime, historically low inflation and robust growth created favorable conditions for him to renew monetary decentralization. In order to firm up his legacy in the runup to the Sixteenth Party Congress in 2002, Jiang launched the campaign for “a well-off society,” a Dengist drive to stimulate local investment. This campaign exerted the familiar effect of exploding lending
在亚洲金融危机之后，江继续面临来自军队和安全机构的挑战，这使他不得不继续依赖朱在关键政治支持上的作用。因此，在朱的掌控下，金融集中化保持不变。这些政治偶发事件共同促成了改革时期最长的一段货币稳定期，尽管通货膨胀处于历史低位。然而，在江最终设法巩固对政权的控制后，历史性低通胀与强劲增长为他重新推动货币分权创造了有利条件。为了在 2002 年十六大前巩固自己的政治遗产，江发起了“全面建成小康社会”运动，这是一场邓氏风格的刺激地方投资的运动。该运动产生了熟悉的效果——放贷激增
and fixed asset investment, which left the new leadership with a growing economic problem. Much as Deng and Chen had done in the late 1970s, the newly appointed generalist - Hu Jintao - and the newly appointed technocrat - Wen Jiabao - cooperated with each other to establish their authorities and in the process recentralized the financial sector. This final monetary cycle reveals that the political logic first established in the late 1970s continues to exert a familiar effect on monetary policy today.
以及固定资产投资，这使新领导层面临日益严重的经济问题。正如邓小平和陈云在 1970 年代末所做的那样，新任的通才——胡锦涛——和新任的技术官僚——温家宝——相互配合以确立各自的权威，并在此过程中重新集中化了金融领域。这个最后的货币周期表明，1970 年代末首次确立的政治逻辑继续对当前的货币政策产生熟悉的影响。
Contemporary banking policies also serve to illustrate the difficulties of reforming the banking sector in China. The favorable conditions at the beginning of the Zhu administration generated great expectations of significant financial reform. After all, Zhu Rongji was universally heralded as a tough reformer (Chen 1998b; Hajari 1998; Melloan 1998). When he became China’s premier, he brought with him a “change team” of financial experts and economists to oversee the financial sector (Chen 1998a). Meanwhile, the Fifteenth Party Congress in the autumn of 1997 finally legitimized the private sector. Furthermore, China’s financial elite had by then accepted the superiority of the market economy. I I  ^("I "){ }^{\text {I }} Finally, the Asian Financial Crisis compelled the dominant generalist faction headed by General Secretary Jiang Zemin to relinquish control over the financial system. All the pieces for a major financial reform seemed in place.
当代的银行政策也说明了在中国改革银行业的难度。朱政权初期的有利条件曾激发人们对重大金融改革的高度期望。毕竟，朱镕基被普遍誉为强硬的改革派（Chen 1998b；Hajari 1998；Melloan 1998）。他出任中国总理时，带来了一支由金融专家和经济学家组成的“变革团队”来监管金融部门（Chen 1998a）。与此同时，1997 年秋季的十五大最终确立了私营部门的合法地位。此外，中国的金融精英到那时已接受市场经济的优越性。 I I  ^("I "){ }^{\text {I }} 最后，亚洲金融危机迫使以总书记江泽民为首的占主导地位的通才派放弃对金融体系的控制。所有推动重大金融改革的条件似乎都已具备。
The broad range of changes made by Zhu at first glance suggests a substantial departure from the past. Yet, as we evaluate the net effect of Zhu’s financial policies in hindsight, it is evident that the financial sector was little more market-oriented than when he had first taken office. Although some of his efforts furthered market allocation of capital, other policies pulled China back to the planned economy. Thus, explanations that rely on his reform orientation, the capability of technocrats, or the diffusion of market-oriented ideas cannot satisfactorily account for the lack of significant financial sector reform during his administration; those conditions were all present at the beginning of his administration. According to the factional framework, central discretion over financial resources allows members of the technocratic faction to earn administrative merits through pouring funds toward perceived policy and political problems. This framework predicts policies that tend to maximize short-term improvements even if they create long-term problems. Compared to the outcomes predicted by the other hypotheses, the factional framework’s predictions provide a superior fit to the actual policy outcomes in the banking sector.
朱镕基所实施的一系列变化乍看之下似乎是对过去的重大背离。然而，当我们事后评估朱的金融政策的净效应时，就会发现金融部门并没有比他上任之初更趋市场化。尽管他的部分努力促进了资本的市场配置，其他政策却把中国拉回到计划经济的轨道。因此，单凭他的改革取向、技术官僚的能力或市场化思想的传播来解释其任内金融部门缺乏重大改革是无法令人信服的；这些条件在他上任之初就已具备。根据派系框架，对金融资源的中央裁量权允许技术官僚派系成员通过将资金投入到被视为政策和政治问题的领域来获取行政功绩。该框架预测的政策倾向于最大化短期改进，即便这些改进会造成长期问题。 与其他假设所预测的结果相比，派系框架的预测与银行业的实际政策结果更为契合。

Crisis and Command: Zhu's Centralization Drive
危机与指挥：朱的中央集权推进

Although Zhu Rongji’s credibility as the new economic tsar had been established in 1994, he continued to guard against local lobbying for decentralized finance and high-speed growth. As the inflation rate declined in 1995 and in
尽管朱镕基作为新的经济“沙皇”的信誉在 1994 年已经确立，他仍然防范地方为分权金融和高速增长进行游说。随着 1995 年以及
1996, local criticism against the center’s restrictive monetary policies increased. Although Jiang, now the head of the dominant generalist faction, had ceded financial control to Zhu in 1994, he increasingly defended his factional interest by supporting local demand for more funds. Jiang’s unwillingness to risk any instability during the crucial succession process, however, prevented him from launching an official campaign to decentralize finance. Rather than waiting for the next decentralization campaign, Zhu used the occasion of the Asian Financial Crisis to further consolidate financial centralization.
1996 年通货膨胀率下降，对中央限制性货币政策的地方批评增加。尽管江泽民作为当时占主导地位的通才派系首脑在 1994 年将金融控制让渡给朱，但他越来越通过支持地方对更多资金的需求来维护其派系利益。然而，江在关键的接班过程中不愿冒任何不稳风险，这阻止了他发起正式的金融分权运动。朱并未等待下一次分权运动，而是利用亚洲金融危机的契机进一步巩固了金融中央集权。

The Calculus of Succession
继承的演算

In late 1994, rumors of Deng’s illness began to circulate around Beijing. Although Jiang remained the designated successor, his position was far from secure. Despite Chen Xitong’s removal, both Qiao Shi and Li Ruihuan remained highly popular Standing Committee members, and in the case of Li Ruihuan, he was much younger than Jiang (Nathan and Gilley 2002). In this highly uncertain atmosphere, Zhu’s support continued to be indispensable. As someone personally endorsed by both Deng and Chen Yun and untainted by the Tiananmen Square massacre, Zhu provided more important political support for Jiang than the politically vulnerable Li Peng could. Despite the importance of Zhu in Jiang’s political strategy, he was nonetheless trying to strengthen his faction by lavishing subsidies to his regional followers.
1994 年底，关于邓小平身体状况的谣言开始在北京流传。尽管江泽民仍被视为指定接班人，但他的地位远未稳固。尽管陈希同已被罢免，乔石和李瑞环仍是极受欢迎的政治局常委，就李瑞环而言，他比江泽民年轻得多（Nathan 和 Gilley 2002）。在这种高度不确定的氛围中，朱镕基的支持仍不可或缺。作为既受邓小平又受陈云个人认可且未染天安门事件污点的人物，朱在政治上对江提供的支持，比政治上脆弱的李鹏更为重要。尽管朱在江的政治战略中举足轻重，他仍通过向其地区追随者大肆发放补贴来强化自己的派系。
Officially, Jiang adhered to the 1994 pact and gave public support to continual retrenchment. At the September 1995 Fifth Plenum, Jiang called for the strengthening of central authorities and castigated local governments for “considering local interest too much” (Jiang 1998b). Unofficially, however, Jiang gave every indication that he was concerned with the interest of his factional followers at the local level. Between 1994 and 1997, Jiang visited Guangdong in three separate occasions, and each time, he made a special point to visit Shenzhen, the first SEZ and a symbol of decentralized finance. Each time that Jiang was there, he called on Shenzhen cadres to continue its bold experiment and to “create new advantages to attain new heights,” not a phrase that conjured Zhu’s centralization policies (Chen 1995b; Shenzhen Economic Daily 1997; Xinhua News Agency 1994a).
在公开场合，江泽民遵守 1994 年的协议，并公开支持持续的收缩政策。在 1995 年 9 月的第五次全体会议上，江泽民呼吁加强中央权威，并谴责地方政府“太顾及地方利益”（Jiang 1998b）。然而在非正式场合，江泽民则表现出明显关心其派系在地方层面的利益。在 1994 年至 1997 年间，江泽民三次访问广东，每次都特别到访深圳——第一个经济特区，也是分权金融的象征。每次到访时，江都要求深圳干部继续大胆试验，“创造新优势，登上新高峰”，这句话并不让人联想到朱镕基的中央集权政策（Chen 1995b；Shenzhen Economic Daily 1997；Xinhua News Agency 1994a）。
Particularly revealing was Jiang’s reaction to Guangdong’s request for more financial control at a NPC session in March 1995. At the meeting, Jiang paid special homage to Guangdong by holding a discussion meeting with delegates from Guangdong, a special privilege for the province. When he heard a Guangdong official make the suggestion to “ease the present shortage of funds,” the official report recorded that Jiang “nodded in approval and conscientiously jotted down notes” (Guangdong People’s Broadcasting Station 1995). This episode reveals that local officials were disgruntled at Zhu’s financial centralization drive, which deprived local governments of funds for new investment. Furthermore, the description of Jiang’s reaction to the report, if accurate, intimates his sympathy with Guangdong’s gripe.
尤为耐人寻味的是，1995 年 3 月全国人大会议上江泽民对广东要求更多财政自主权的反应。大会期间，江专门与广东代表举行座谈，这对该省而言是特殊礼遇。当听到一名广东官员提出“缓解目前资金短缺”的建议时，官方报告记载江“点头表示赞同并认真记下笔记”（Guangdong People’s Broadcasting Station 1995）。这一插曲表明地方官员对朱的财政集中化举措感到不满，该举措剥夺了地方政府用于新投资的资金。此外，如果对报告中对江反应的描述属实，则暗示他同情广东的抱怨。
Yet, with Deng increasingly ill and the succession looming, Jiang dared not risk an inflationary crisis by encouraging uncontrolled local lending. The Central Economic Work Conference at the end of 1996 officially announced the continuation of Zhu’s retrenchment policies, despite a rapidly falling inflation rate. The official press release of the conference stated unambiguously that “the policy to strengthen and perfect macroeconomic adjustment is completely correct” (Luo, Zhao, and He 1996). The other indication of Jiang’s support of Zhu was Zhu’s promotion to the post of premier at the Fifteenth Party Congress. Without Jiang’s approval, Zhu’s final triumph would have been impossible. In the end, Jiang’s cautious policies paid off. When Deng passed away in February 1997, inflation was low, providing a stable economic environment for the transition.
然而，随着邓小平身体日益虚弱、接班问题迫近，江泽民不敢通过鼓励地方不受控制的放贷来冒通货膨胀危机的险。尽管通胀率迅速下降，1996 年底的中央经济工作会议仍正式宣布继续奉行朱镕基的收缩政策。会议的官方新闻稿明确指出：“加强和完善宏观经济调控的方针是完全正确的”（Luo, Zhao, and He 1996）。江对朱的支持的另一体现是朱在第十五次党代会上被提升为国务院总理。没有江的认可，朱的最终胜利是不可能的。最终，江的谨慎政策得到了回报。邓小平于 1997 年 2 月逝世时，通货膨胀率很低，为权力交接提供了稳定的经济环境。

Asian Financial Crisis and Zhu's Preemptive Strike
亚洲金融危机与朱的先发制人行动

Given his success in continuing retrenchment, why did Zhu seek to further centralize the banking system after the Fifteenth Party Congress? The conventional interpretation at the time was that Zhu implemented further reform as a part of a long-term plan to commercialize the banking sector in China (Chen 1998b; Lardy 1998: 18). The Asian Financial Crisis simply gave the leadership further resolve to do so. Yet, the centerpiece of Zhu’s restructuring - financial centralization - had not been under serious discussion until the Asian Financial Crisis. Furthermore, Zhu’s financial policies did not have a clear positive impact on the efficiency of the banking sector. Many of his policies in fact turned out to be short-sighted and involved substantial government intervention.
在继续缩减开支取得成功的情况下，为什么朱镕基在十五大之后还要进一步中央集权化银行体系？当时的常规解释是，朱将进一步改革作为中国银行业商业化长期计划的一部分（Chen 1998b；Lardy 1998：18）。亚洲金融危机只是增强了领导层推进这一计划的决心。然而，朱的重组核心——金融中央集权——在亚洲金融危机之前并未成为认真讨论的问题。此外，朱的金融政策并未对银行业效率产生明显的积极影响。事实上，他的许多政策被证明目光短浅，并涉及大量政府干预。
Available evidence suggests that the centralization drive stemmed from Zhu’s desire to forestall an inevitable assault on central power triggered by a healthy economy with little inflation. An internal Party document in the spring of 1997 urged local officials to not put any more pressure on the central government to “make the cake bigger” or “give more water to the fish,” both metaphors for more local access to funds (Editors 1997). Another government report suggests that local officials were ordering banks to accelerate lending despite the continuation of austerity (Li 1997b). Indeed, government economists admitted in a secret government journal that it was entirely possible that the Fifteenth Party Congress and the return of Hong Kong to China would generate another wave of reckless investment at the local level (Tian 1997). Although Jiang still gave his official support for centralization, local officials might have anticipated a decentralization drive in the near future. After all, it was the chorus of local complaints against retrenchment in 1991 that created the propitious political environment for Deng’s tour to the south in 1992. If Zhu had indeed faced this political environment, it would have made sense for him to seek the first opportunity to further consolidate the center’s control over the financial sector before the political tide turned. In this scenario, the Asian Financial Crisis provided the perfect opportunity.
现有证据表明，这一中央集权运动源于朱镕基希望阻止由健康的低通货膨胀经济引发的对中央权力的不可避免的攻击。1997 年春的一份党内文件敦促地方官员不要再向中央政府施压以“把蛋糕做大”或“给鱼更多的水”，这两种比喻都指更多的地方资金来源（Editors 1997）。另一份政府报告表明，尽管实行紧缩政策，地方官员仍在指示银行加快放贷（Li 1997b）。事实上，政府经济学家在一份秘密的政府期刊中承认，第十五次党代会和香港回归中国完全有可能在地方层面引发又一波鲁莽的投资浪潮（Tian 1997）。尽管江泽民仍公开支持中央集权，地方官员可能预期不久的将来会有一次分权运动。毕竟，正是 1991 年地方对削减开支的群起抗议为 1992 年邓小平南巡创造了有利的政治环境。 如果朱确实面临这样的政治环境，那么他在政治局势逆转之前寻求第一个机会进一步巩固中央对金融部门的控制是有道理的。在这种情形下，亚洲金融危机提供了完美的机会。
Whatever the elite political motives, available evidence strongly suggests that the banking centralization drive of 1997-1998 was the manifestation of another
无论精英政治动机如何，现有证据强烈表明，1997–1998 年的银行集中化推动是另一种表现。
retrenchment drive initiated by the dominant technocratic faction, rather than the natural culmination of decades of banking reform. First, it was clear that the State Council research apparatus, as it had done in previous crises, played a major role in highlighting the weaknesses in the economy. Zhu’s firm control over the State’s Council’s sprawling research apparatus enabled him to elevate nonperforming loans (NPLs) from an issue debated in the expert community to the top of the regime’s agenda. State Council researchers also quickly worked out an optimal strategy for Zhu, the administrative centralization of the banking system, even though few had considered it before the crisis. Moreover, the net effect of these policies was the centralization of financial power, not the commercialization of banks.
由主导的技术官僚派发起的紧缩运动，而非数十年银行改革的自然 culmination。首先，很明显国务院的研究机构像以往危机中那样，在凸显经济弱点方面发挥了重要作用。朱对国务院庞大研究机构的坚强控制，使他能够将不良贷款（NPLs）从专家群体内部讨论的问题提升到政权议程的首位。国务院研究人员还迅速为朱制定出一项最佳策略——即使在危机之前很少有人考虑过的银行体系行政集中化。此外，这些政策的净效应是金融权力的集中，而不是银行的商业化。
In the autumn of 1997, the most dynamic economies neighboring China were toppling one after another even as the Fifteenth Party Congress confirmed Jiang Zemin as Deng’s successor. Initially, China seemed completely unaffected. After all, China did not have capital account convertibility and thus did not face the specter of massive capital flight. Published transcripts of the Fifteenth Party Congress indeed made no mention of the Asian Financial Crisis (AFC). Yet, soon afterward, the crisis became an urgent topic of discussion for Chinese leaders behind the scene. At the first plenum - just one week after the Fifteenth Party Congress -Jiang declared that “the prevention and resolution of financial risk is an important and urgent task…” (Zhu 1998d). 2 2 ^(2){ }^{2} His remarks were by no means insincere. Officials and bankers interviewed uniformly attributed major shifts in banking policies in 1998 to the economic and political crises that unfolded in neighboring countries during the AFC. The central leadership genuinely feared that China would follow Indonesia’s path of economic collapse and political chaos. 3 3 ^(3){ }^{3} As Jiang put it in the November Central Work Conference on Finance, “If our financial system is not stable, it will also affect economic and social stability” (Jiang 2006f: 7I). Although the Politburo had reasonable cause for worry, the new premier also played his part in elevating the crisis to the center of the regime’s focus, thus greatly facilitating banking centralization.
1997 年秋天，当中国周边最具活力的经济体接连崩塌时，第十五次全国代表大会确认江泽民为邓小平的接班人。起初，中国似乎完全不受影响。毕竟，中国没有资本账户可兑换，因此不会面临大规模资本外逃的威胁。第十五次党代会的公开记录确实没有提到亚洲金融危机（AFC）。然而，不久之后，这场危机在幕后成为中国领导人急切讨论的话题。在大会结束仅一周后的第一次全体会议上，江宣布“防范和化解金融风险是一项重要而紧迫的任务……”（Zhu 1998d）。他的表述绝非虚言。受访的官员和银行家一致认为，1998 年银行业政策的重大转变，是对邻国在亚洲金融危机中爆发的经济与政治危机的回应。中央领导层真切地担心中国会走上印尼那样的经济崩溃和政治混乱的道路。 正如江在十一月中央财经工作会议上所说：“如果我们的金融体系不稳定，也会影响经济和社会稳定”（Jiang 2006f: 7I）。 尽管政治局有充分理由担忧，新任总理也在将这一危机提升到政权关注中心方面发挥了作用，从而极大地促进了银行业的集权化。
Although government researchers had long realized that administrative intervention in the banks would produce mounting nonperforming loans (NPLs), only a handful of financial experts were concerned about the issue. As early as the 1980s, veteran central banker Liu Hongru had warned that persistent government intervention in the banks would end in a financial crisis (Liu 2000d). In 1995, an expert at the Central Party School similarly warned that a high NPL ratio had great inflationary potential (Zhou 1995). In several government reports just before the AFC, banking experts cautioned that the government’s effort to bankrupt and merge SOEs had created an enormous amount of NPLs for banks because local governments used bankruptcies and restructuring to default on bank loans (Bi 1997; Zhang 1997).
尽管政府研究人员早已意识到对银行的行政干预会导致不良贷款（NPLs）不断增加，但关心这一问题的金融专家寥寥无几。早在上世纪八十年代，资深央行官员刘鸿儒就警告说，政府对银行的持续干预将以金融危机告终（Liu 2000d）。1995 年，中共中央党校的一位专家同样警告说，高比例的不良贷款具有巨大的通胀潜力（Zhou 1995）。在亚洲金融危机前的几份政府报告中，银行业专家提醒称，政府为使国有企业破产或重组而采取的行动已为银行制造了大量不良贷款，因为地方政府利用破产和重组来对银行贷款进行违约（Bi 1997; Zhang 1997）。
Despite warnings from banking experts throughout the two decades of reform, NPLs had not been an important issue at the top level before the AFC. As earlier chapters document, the government had bailed out the banking sector several times, but the NPL issue never made it to the top of the regime’s agenda. Top politicians in both the generalist and technocratic factions neglected the issue even though there had been widespread runs on the banks during both the 1988 inflation and the mid-1990s inflation. During the 1993-1994 retrenchment, Zhu focused on control over the banks and limiting money supply rather than on the NPL problem. In 1996, the PBOC issued the “Lending Communicate” (Daikuan Tongce), which systematically addressed the questions of loan quality, loan classification, and NPLs for the first time (People’s Bank of China 1997a). Nonetheless, the political leadership did not raise these issues at all during the Central Economic Work Conference at the end of 1996 (Luo, Zhao, and He 1996). As late as March 1997, the central government had planned to write off only 30 billion yuan in bad debt, a drop in the 3 trillion yuan NPL bucket (State Economic and Trade Commission and People’s Bank of China 1997).
尽管在改革的二十年里银行业专家多次发出警告，但在亚洲金融危机之前，不良贷款对最高层并不是一个重要议题。如前几章所述，政府曾多次对银行业进行救助，但不良贷款问题从未进入政权议程的首位。无论是一般派还是技术派的高级政治家都对这一问题置之不理，尽管在 1988 年通货膨胀和 1990 年代中期的通货膨胀期间曾发生广泛的挤兑。在 1993–1994 年的紧缩期间，朱镕基着重于对银行的控制和限制货币供应，而不是不良贷款问题。1996 年，PBOC 发布了“贷款通策”(Daikuan Tongce)，首次系统地处理了贷款质量、贷款分类和不良贷款问题（人民银行 1997a）。尽管如此，政治领导层在 1996 年底的中央经济工作会议上根本没有提出这些问题（罗、赵和何 1996）。 直到 1997 年 3 月，中央政府仍计划只核销 300 亿元不良债务，这在 3 万亿元的不良贷款总额中只是九牛一毛（国家经贸委和中国人民银行 1997）。
Not only was NPL not seen as a top priority, few at the State Council had considered centralizing the banking system administratively by removing the appointment authorities over local bank managers from the local Party committees. Instead, State Council technocrats proposed a series of other policy measures. One group of researchers proposed the establishment of a commission for coordinating investment and lending in order to ensure the efficiency of fixed asset investments (ICBC Research Group on Problems of Enterprise Bankruptcy 1998). Another popular suggestion was to reduce the center’s monitoring problem and increase profitability by merging SOEs into large conglomerates along the lines of South Korean chaebols (1997a; 1997b; 1997c). Finally, a PBOC researcher urged the government to forgive the interest payments of a substantial portion of NPLs in order to “vitalize” (gaohuo) loans (Zhang 1997). 4 4 ^(4){ }^{4} Still, no one had proposed the unthinkable: the centralization of banks. 5 5 ^(5){ }^{5}
不仅不把不良贷款视为首要任务，国务院内部很少有人考虑通过剥夺地方党委对地方银行经理的任免权来在行政上实现银行体系的集中化。相反，国务院的技术官僚提出了一系列其他政策措施。一组研究人员建议成立一个用于协调投资和贷款的委员会，以确保固定资产投资的效率（ICBC Research Group on Problems of Enterprise Bankruptcy 1998）。另一个流行的建议是仿照韩国财阀，将国有企业合并为大型企业集团，以减少中央的监管问题并提高盈利能力（1997a；1997b；1997c）。最后，一位人民银行的研究员敦促政府免除相当一部分不良贷款的利息，以“盘活”贷款（gaohuo）（Zhang 1997）。 4 4 ^(4){ }^{4} 尽管如此，仍然没有人提出那个不可想象的方案：对银行进行集中化。 5 5 ^(5){ }^{5}
Before these policies could be tested, the AFC transformed the NPL issue from a mere accounting annoyance to a symbol of economic collapse and political instability. About to begin his tenure as premier, Zhu Rongji, along with State Council technocrats, exaggerated the threat posed by the crisis in order to increase the center’s financial discretion. Because Zhu had spent the bulk of his career in the central bureaucracy, his faction resembled the one that had been led by Chen Yun, composed mainly of researchers and bureaucrats in the central government (Huang 2000: 139). Thus, he had firm control over
在这些政策得到检验之前，AFC 已将不良贷款问题从单纯的会计烦恼转变为经济崩溃和政治不稳定的象征。即将开始总理任期的朱镕基与国务院的技术官僚们夸大了这一危机所构成的威胁，以便增加中央的财政裁量权。由于朱的大部分职业生涯都在中央官僚体系度过，他的派系类似于陈云所领导的那一派，主要由中央政府的研究人员和官僚组成（Huang 2000: 139）。因此，他牢牢掌控着
the banking sector through Dai Xianglong, a protégé whom he had promoted rapidly to the head of the PBOC (Zong 2002: 510). He also retained firm control over the State Economic and Trade Commission through Wang Zhongyu and Sheng Huaren. His other followers, including Zhou Xiaochuan, Lou Jiwei, Wang Qishan, Wang Xuebing, Zhu Xiaohua, and Liu Jinbao, all held important positions in securities, banking, and the treasury (Chen 1998a; Lam 2000) Like Chen Yun, the extensive support network gave Zhu extensive research and analytical capabilities.
通过戴相龙控制了银行部门，戴相龙是他提拔迅速、担任人民银行行长的门生（Zong 2002: 510）。他还通过王忠禹和盛华仁牢牢掌控着国家经贸委。他的其他追随者，包括周小川、楼继伟、王岐山、王学兵、朱晓华和刘金宝，都在证券、银行和财政部门担任重要职务（Chen 1998a；Lam 2000）。像陈云一样，广泛的支持网络赋予了朱广泛的研究和分析能力。
Zhu’s crucial weapon came expectedly from within the banking sector. In the midst of the AFC, a research team at the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) headquarters had been preparing a research report on NPLs and redundant local investment. The report first circulated internally among government technocrats in mid-1997 before the full development of the AFC (Zhan 2000 ). However, its political significance rapidly increased as Asian economies went under in rapid succession. The report’s findings of rampant redundant investment, nonperforming loans, and widespread liquidity problems in banks gave central bureaucrats the perfect device with which to connect what was occurring in the rest of Asia with what could happen in China (ICBC Research Group on Problems of Enterprise Bankruptcy 1998). Moreover, this report blamed China’s NPL problem primarily on the local governments and on bad industrial policies made by Zhu’s predecessor, Premier Li Peng.
朱的关键武器如预期来自银行业内部。在亚洲金融危机（AFC）期间，中国工商银行（ICBC）总部的一个研究小组一直在准备一份关于不良贷款和地方重复投资的研究报告。该报告在 1997 年中期、AFC 全面爆发之前，先在政府技术官僚内部流传（Zhan 2000）。然而，随着亚洲各经济体接连陷落，其政治意义迅速提升。报告发现大量重复投资、普遍的不良贷款和银行广泛的流动性问题，为中央官僚提供了一个完美的工具，将亚洲其他地区正在发生的事与中国可能发生的情况联系起来（ICBC Research Group on Problems of Enterprise Bankruptcy 1998）。此外，报告主要将中国的不良贷款问题归咎于地方政府以及朱的前任李鹏总理制定的错误产业政策。
The report was extremely successful in creating a crisis mentality among China’s leadership. And to further reinforce this notion, a flood of reports from various State Council research organizations soon followed to tie the crisis with China’s NPL problem (Bureau of Economic Prediction of the State Information Center 1998; Er 1999; Guangdong Branch of the PBOC 1998). The First Plenum of the Fifteenth Central Committee in September decided to give Zhu enormous discretion to change the financial system. In October 1997, the Central Committee and the State Council jointly issued the “Notice Concerning Deepening Financial Reform, Rectifying Financial Order, and Preventing Financial Risk (Guanyu shenhua jinrong gaige, zhengdun jinrong jiexu, fangfan jinrong fengxian de tongzhi).” Unlike the ineffective “Lending Communicate” issued one year earlier, this jointly endorsed document sent an unmistakable, authoritative signal about the importance of NPLs and the need for further centralization. In one fell swoop, local branches of the state banks and the PBOC were removed from local Party committees’ jurisdiction and placed under the newly formed Central Finance Work Commission; hundreds of locally controlled trust and investment companies and informal private banks were closed; and strict NPL reduction quotas were imposed on the state banks (Heilmann 2005; Zhu 1998c).
该报告在中国领导层中极为成功地制造了危机意识。为了进一步强化这一观念，随后各类国务院研究机构纷纷发表大量报告，将危机与中国的不良贷款问题联系起来（国家信息中心经济预测局 1998；二 1999；中国人民银行广东分行 1998）。十五届中央委员会第一次全体会议在九月决定赋予朱极大的权限以改变金融体系。1997 年 10 月，中共中央和国务院联合发布了《关于深化金融改革、整顿金融秩序、防范金融风险的通知（Guanyu shenhua jinrong gaige, zhengdun jinrong jiexu, fangfan jinrong fengxian de tongzhi）》。与一年前发布但未见成效的“放贷通知”不同，这份经联合背书的文件发出了一个明确而权威的信号，表明不良贷款的重要性以及进一步中央集权的必要性。 地方国有银行和中国人民银行的地方分支机构一举被从地方党组织的管辖权中剥离，转而隶属于新成立的中央金融工作委员会；数以百计由地方控制的信托和投资公司以及非正式的私人银行被关闭；对国有银行强制实施了严格的不良贷款削减配额（Heilmann 2005；Zhu 1998c）。
To ensure compliance with these stunning announcements, Zhu, who was slated to become premier in the spring of 1998, chaired an emergency Central Finance Conference in November 1997. 6 6 ^(6){ }^{6} The conference had the main theme
为确保对这些惊人公告的执行，朱镕基——原定于 1998 年春季出任总理——于 1997 年 11 月主持召开了一次紧急中央金融会议。 6 6 ^(6){ }^{6} 会议的主要议题
of “preventing financial risk” (fangfan jinrong fengxian), which meant dealing with the massive nonperforming loan problem. In his main remarks, Zhu first reminded his audience of central and local government officials that he had gained enormous latitude to make policies because of a putative national crisis. As Chen Yun and Yao Yilin had done numerous times before, Zhu instructed local officials that “if thoughts are unified (sixiang tongyi), then we can speed up work, but if thoughts are not unified, we will see winds of chaos (luanfeng)” (Zhu 1998d). Although Jiang attended the meeting and urged banks to continue “financial services to local development…,” he nonetheless supported Zhu’s drive to “… deepen financial reform, rectify financial order, and prevent and resolve financial crises” (Jiang 2006f: 74). At the December 1997 Central Economic Conference, Zhu again drove home the lesson of the Asian Financial Crisis: “This Southeast Asian financial crisis proves that our measures to prevent and resolve financial risk are timely and correct” (Zhu 1998d). Whereas earlier crises in Latin America were merely discussed among academics and bureaucrats, the AFC became a rallying cry for centralization in China. 7 7 ^(7){ }^{7}
“防范金融风险”（fangfan jinrong fengxian），即处理大量不良贷款问题。在主要讲话中，朱首先提醒中央和地方政府官员，他因一个所谓的国家危机而获得了制定政策的巨大自由度。正如陈云和姚依林此前多次所为，朱指示地方官员“如果思想统一（sixiang tongyi），就可以加快工作，但如果思想不统一，就会看到乱风（luanfeng）”（Zhu 1998d）。虽然江出席了会议并督促银行继续“为地方发展提供金融服务……”，但他仍支持朱的主张，即“……深化金融改革，整顿金融秩序，防范和化解金融危机”（Jiang 2006f: 74）。在 1997 年 12 月的中央经济会议上，朱再次强调亚洲金融危机的教训：“这次东南亚金融危机证明我们防范和化解金融风险的措施是及时和正确的”（Zhu 1998d）。 早期在拉丁美洲的危机只是学者和官僚之间讨论的话题，而亚洲金融危机却成为中国集中权力的号召。 7 7 ^(7){ }^{7}
As could be expected, provincial officials were outraged by this sudden surge of central power. Zhu attempted to comfort the disgruntled local leaders: “[The centralization of monetary authority] does not mean that we do not trust local officials. It is just that the center and localities should each divide up our labor accordingly” (Zhu 1998d). Aside from verbal amelioration, Zhu also offered two concessions to the provinces. First, he allowed the provinces to charter more local banks to aid development (Zhu 1998d). 8 8 ^(8){ }^{8} This concession, however, was a token gesture, since Zhu had just closed down hundreds of local financial institutions and deprived local governments of control of the state banks. The other concession was a promise to use the new central power to fund the development of western provinces. At the December 1997 Central Economic Conference, he made an explicit political promise to the western provinces “…now that state commercial banks can unify allocation of capital, they are even more flexible than before, so the economic development of the central and western areas will not be affected” (Zhu 1998c). Jiang may have played a role in wrangling this concession from Zhu because he had promised western provinces a significant boost in central financial subsidies (Fourth Editorial Bureau of the Central Document Research Center 1999). Although the crisis gave him enormous leverage, Zhu bolstered support for centralization with a side-payment to the western provinces and possibly to Jiang himself. This again shows Zhu to be a savvy politician, not just a technocrat.
正如可以预料的那样，省级官员对这一中央权力的突然增强感到愤怒。朱镕基试图安抚这些不满的地方领导人：“（货币权力的集中）并不意味着我们不信任地方官员。只是中央和地方应各自分工而已”（Zhu 1998d）。除了口头上的缓和之外，朱还向各省做出了两项让步。首先，他允许各省批准更多地方性银行以助发展（Zhu 1998d）。然而，这一让步只是象征性的，因为朱刚刚关闭了数百家地方金融机构，并剥夺了地方政府对国有银行的控制。另一项让步是承诺利用新的中央权力资助西部省份的发展。在 1997 年 12 月的中央经济工作会议上，他向西部省份做出了明确的政治承诺：“……既然国有商业银行可以统一配置资金，那么它们的灵活性比以前更强，因此中西部地区的经济发展不会受到影响”（Zhu 1998c）。 姜可能在从朱那里争取到这一让步中起了作用，因为他曾向西部省份承诺大幅增加中央财政补贴（中共中央文件研究室第四编辑局 1999）。尽管这场危机给了他巨大的筹码，朱通过向西部省份并可能向姜本人提供额外补偿来巩固对中央集权的支持。这再次显示出朱是个精明的政治家，而不仅仅是个技术官僚。
The centralization of the financial system was further confirmed when the ICBC report was published in Seeking Truth (Qiu Shi), the official publication of the Central Committee, days after Zhu was formally appointed premier in
当《求是》，中共中央的官方刊物，在朱被正式任命为国务院总理几天后刊登了工商银行的报告时，金融体系的集中化得到了进一步确认。
1998. Since the journal defined the Party line in China, the inclusion of the ICBC report sent a strong signal to local officials about the Party’s stance: banks would no longer serve as tools for local development (ICBC Research Group on Problems of Enterprise Bankruptcy 1998). Moreover, the report’s condemnation of industrial policies under the Li Peng administration clearly demarcated the new administration from the previous one, though both pursued similar policies toward large SOEs. Indeed, the conclusion drawn in this article was not that China needed to carry out fundamental banking reform but that the central government knew the country’s interests better than the local government. In contrast, a 1998 PBOC research report that chastised both central and local governmental intervention remained in the obscurity of internal circulation (Guangdong Branch of the PBOC 1998).
1998 年。由于该期刊界定了中国的党路线，载有工商银行报告的刊登向地方官员发出了强烈信号：银行不再会作为地方发展的工具（ICBC Research Group on Problems of Enterprise Bankruptcy 1998）。此外，该报告对李鹏政府时期产业政策的谴责明确将新一届政府与前一届政府划清了界限，尽管两者对大型国有企业采取了类似政策。实际上，本文得出的结论并不是中国需要进行根本性的银行改革，而是中央政府比地方政府更懂得国家利益。相比之下，一份在 1998 年由中国人民银行发布、批评中央与地方政府干预的研究报告仍在内部流通的默默无闻中（Guangdong Branch of the PBOC 1998）。
The heart of the centralization drive was the establishment of a vertical Party committee system within the financial system that was immune to the influence of the local Party committees. At the top of this new hierarchy sat the Central Finance Work Commission (CFWC), headed by vice premier Wen Jiabao. By all accounts, this institutional change was finally able to remove local branch banks from the grasp of the local government. Although informal influence and the giving of “face” continued between local officials and bank managers, bank managers were no longer required to respond to the wishes of the local leadership. 9 9 ^(9){ }^{9}
中央集权推进的核心是建立在金融系统内部的垂直党委员会体系，使其不受地方党委员会的影响。在这一新层级的顶端是由副总理温家宝主持的中央金融工作委员会（CFWC）。据各方说法，这一制度性变革最终能够将地方分行从地方政府的控制中解脱出来。尽管地方官员与银行经理之间的非正式影响和“面子”往来仍然存在，但银行经理不再被要求服从地方领导的意愿。 9 9 ^(9){ }^{9}
The establishment of a Party committee system in the financial industry served as the backbone for a series of other centralization efforts. For one, PBOC provincial offices were abandoned in favor of regional offices that oversaw banking activities in several provinces. This measure was designed to elevate regional PBOC offices above the reach of provincial governments, although its actual effectiveness remains doubtful. 10 10  ^("10 "){ }^{\text {10 }} Within the Big Four banks, the establishment of a Party committee within each bank meant that their headquarters in Beijing could finally order local branches to do its bidding without local interference. In concert with Zhu’s drive to lower the NPL ratio, the Big Four banks also lowered the lending authority of the local branches. Whereas provincial and city level branches had been able to authorize loans over one billion yuan before 1998, bank centralization gave headquarters the sole authority to approve loans even in the 100 million yuan to 300 million yuan range. 11 11 ^(11){ }^{11} Moreover, banks, now armed with the full power to dismiss local managers, instituted the lifetime responsibility system to hold local managers accountable in the event of defaults. Finally, headquarters of state banks offered local branches interest slightly above deposit rate to encourage local branches to pass
在金融行业建立党的委员会制度成为一系列其他集权努力的支柱。首先，中国人民银行的省级办事处被取消，取而代之的是负责若干省份银行业务的区域办事处。此举旨在将区域人民银行办事处置于省级政府的监管之外，尽管其实际效果仍然值得怀疑。 10 10  ^("10 "){ }^{\text {10 }} 在四大行内部，在每家银行设立党的委员会意味着它们位于北京的总部终于可以在没有地方干预的情况下命令地方分支机构按其意图行事。配合朱镕基降低不良贷款率的推动，四大行同时降低了地方分支的放贷权限。此前省级和地市级分支在 1998 年前能够批准超过十亿元的贷款，而银行的集中化使得总部拥有独家审批权，甚至对一亿元到三亿元区间的贷款也由总部决定。 11 11 ^(11){ }^{11} 此外，银行现在掌握了解雇地方管理者的全部权力，实行了终身责任制，以在发生违约时追究地方管理者的责任。 最后，国有银行总部为了鼓励地方分行放贷，向地方分行提供略高于存款利率的利息
deposits up to the headquarters level (Ren 2000 ). The net effect of these policies was a new autonomy for the financial sector from local influence and the concentration of enormous financial resources at the central level. If combined with market-promoting policies, these changes could have furthered financial reform significantly. Instead, Premier Zhu mainly used heightened central control to achieve short-term policy goals.
直到总部层面的存款（Ren 2000）。这些政策的净效应是金融部门从地方影响中获得了新的自主性，并且巨大的金融资源集中到了中央层面。如果与促进市场的政策相结合，这些变化本可以大幅推动金融改革。相反，朱镕基总理主要利用加强的中央控制来实现短期政策目标。

The Height of Central Power and Stagnant Banking Reform
中央权力巅峰与停滞的银行改革

The AFC was indeed cause for alarm, although the lesson the Chinese leadership learned from it was unclear. On the one hand, Chinese leaders became even more convinced that capital control should remain in place indefinitely. On the other hand, they had a vague sense that something must be done to rectify the financial system. As his bureaucratic predecessor had done after the 1988 crisis, Zhu framed the AFC in terms of weakening central power and demanded unprecedented levels of centralization. Previous proposals concerning the NPL issue were either abandoned or incorporated into the new campaign for central power. The immense financial power Zhu amassed at the center ultimately did not bring about genuine financial reform in China. Instead, as predicted by the factional framework, short-term fixes were pursued to make the problem seem better in the near term. Zhu’ policies toward the nonperforming loan problem and ailing SOEs clearly illustrate this logic. At the same time, market enhancing reform such as interest rate liberalization and the legalization of private banks, which would have substantially improved the efficiency of capital allocation, were vetoed by Zhu (Shih 2007).
亚洲金融危机的确令人警觉，不过中国领导层从中吸取的教训并不明确。一方面，中国领导人更加确信资本管制应当无限期维持。另一方面，他们隐约觉得必须采取一些措施来修复金融体系。正如他的前任在 1988 年危机后所做的那样，朱镕基将亚洲金融危机归结为中央权力被削弱，并要求前所未有的集中化。此前关于不良贷款问题的建议要么被放弃，要么被纳入新的中央权力运动中。朱在中央集聚的庞大财政权力最终并未带来中国真正的金融改革。相反，正如派系框架所预测的那样，采取了短期修补措施以在短期内让问题看起来有所好转。朱对不良贷款问题和濒临困境的国有企业所采取的政策清楚地说明了这一逻辑。与此同时，能够大幅提高资本配置效率的市场化改革——例如利率放开和私人银行合法化——被朱否决了（Shih 2007）。
Vested with unprecedented control of the banks, Zhu immediately set out to resolve the putative source of the potential crisis - nonperforming loans (NPLs). In order to generate impressive short-term results, Zhu devised a twopronged strategy. First, he recapitalized banks and set up asset management companies to remove the existing pool of NPLs from the state banks. Second, he centralized the banking system and implemented strict policies to prevent the formation of new NPLs. Had Zhu been a reform-maximizer, his policies could have radically transformed the Chinese banking sector and drastically increased the efficiency of capital allocation in China. Evaluating it after the Zhu administration, his two-pronged strategy primarily deferred the fiscal and inflationary risks of NPLs to the future and concentrated financial resources to the central government.
朱在获得对银行前所未有的控制权后，立即着手解决潜在危机的假定根源——不良贷款（NPLs）。为了在短期内取得显著成果，朱制定了双管齐下的策略。首先，他对银行进行资本充实，并设立资产管理公司以将现有的不良贷款从国有银行中剥离出去。其次，他对银行体系进行集中化管理，并实施严格政策以防止新的不良贷款形成。若朱是一个改革极大化者，他的政策本可以彻底改造中国的银行业，并大幅提高中国资本配置的效率。在评估其离任后的影响时，他的双管齐下策略主要是将不良贷款带来的财政与通胀风险推迟到未来，并将金融资源集中到中央政府手中。
In order to decrease the massive pool of NPLs in China’s financial system and increase capitalization in the banking system, Zhu devised three major policies: recapitalization of the state banks, writing off the NPLs, and transferring the NPLs to asset management companies. In 1998, the central government issued 270 billion yuan of special financial bonds to banks. The government then took this money to recapitalize the same state banks which had bought the bonds. State banks gained enormously from this process as they obtained both good assets in the form of government backed bonds and higher capital ratio from
为了减少中国金融体系中大量的不良贷款(NPLs)并提高银行体系的资本化程度，朱提出了三项主要政策：对国有银行进行增资、冲销不良贷款以及将不良贷款转移到资产管理公司。1998 年，中央政府向银行发行了 2700 亿元的专项金融债券。政府随后用这笔钱对购买了这些债券的同一国有银行进行增资。国有银行从这一过程中获得了巨大利益，因为它们既得到了以政府担保债券形式存在的良好资产，又提高了资本充足率，从而...
government injection. Instead of banks bearing the burden of NPLs as a result of state policies, this process also transferred the NPL burden to the government budgetary balance, transforming NPLs from implicit deficit to explicit government debt. Had Zhu allowed further issuance of treasuries to write off NPLs, state banks would have been freed of the “historical burden” caused by past state intervention.
政府注入。与其让银行因国家政策承受不良贷款的负担，这一过程还将不良贷款的负担转移到政府的预算余额上，把不良贷款从隐性赤字转变为显性的政府债务。如果朱允许运行进一步发行国债来冲销不良贷款，国有银行本可以摆脱由过去国家干预造成的“历史包袱”。
Instead of issuing treasuries to write off nonperforming loans, however, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) continued to set the maximum write-off amount to ɪ percent of all loans outstanding during a given year. This regulation, in place since the early 1990s, was primarily designed to control the amount of NPLs that was reflected on the budget deficit. Banks using too much to write off loans would be unable to hand “profit” over to the Ministry of Finance. Although the government briefly considered a gradual increase of this ratio at the beginning of Zhu’s term, it ultimately decided against it in order to minimize explicit national debt (1998). I2 I2  ^("I2 "){ }^{\text {I2 }} What was worse, state banks had little authority over which loans to write off. Writing off loans had become a key component in Zhu’s strategy to save SOEs. As such, the State Economic and Trade Commission (SETC) determined where much of the 40 − 50 40 − 50 40-5040-50 billion yuan or so in annual write-off allotment would go. By various accounts, much of the money went to politically connected large SOEs and state corporations or to mergers that involved large SOEs (Bureau of Economic Prediction of the State Information Center 1999a; Bureau of Economic Prediction of the State Information Center 1999b). I3 I3  ^("I3 "){ }^{\text {I3 }}
然而，财政部（MOF）并未通过发行国债来冲销不良贷款，而是继续将年度内可冲销的贷款最高额度设定为ɪ个百分点。自 1990 年代初实施的这项监管主要旨在控制记入预算赤字的不良贷款规模。若银行用过多额度来冲销贷款，就无法将“利润”上缴财政部。尽管政府在朱任期初曾短暂考虑逐步提高这一比例，但最终为了尽量减少显性国家债务而放弃了该想法（1998 年）。 I2 I2  ^("I2 "){ }^{\text {I2 }} 更糟的是，国有银行在选择冲销哪些贷款方面几乎没有自主权。冲销贷款已成为朱拯救国企策略的关键组成部分。因此，国家经贸委（SETC）决定了每年约 40 − 50 40 − 50 40-5040-50 十几亿至几十亿人民币的冲销拨款大部分去向。 据多方记载，大部分资金流向了与政治有联系的大型国有企业和国有公司，或流向了涉及大型国有企业的并购项目（State Information Center, Bureau of Economic Prediction 1999a；State Information Center, Bureau of Economic Prediction 1999b）。 I3 I3  ^("I3 "){ }^{\text {I3 }}
Because existing policy on write-offs only resolved a tiny fraction of the estimated 3.3 trillion yuan in NPLs, the Zhu administration had to devise an alternative policy to reduce NPLs (Chan et al. 200I). I4 I4  ^("I4 "){ }^{\text {I4 }} Again, several proposals were put forth. The first proposal was to securitize NPLs into government bonds and directly sell them to the public (1997d). This proposal was eliminated early on, presumably because it required the government to publicize performance of SOEs and to decrease the pool of money going into the stock market. More important, this would have made explicit the government’s obligation with respect to the NPLs. Another general policy to decrease NPL was to transform debt to state investment (daigaitou). Again, Zhu rejected all the proposals in this category that increased explicit deficit (1997d; Er 1999: 220).
由于现行的核销政策只能解决估计为 3.3 万亿元不良贷款中的极少部分，朱镕基政府不得不设计替代政策以减少不良贷款（Chan et al. 2001）。 I4 I4  ^("I4 "){ }^{\text {I4 }} 再次，有若干建议被提出。第一项建议是将不良贷款证券化为政府债券并直接向公众出售（1997d）。这一建议很早就被排除，推测原因是它要求政府公开国有企业的绩效并减少流入股市的资金池。更重要的是，这会明确政府就不良贷款所承担的义务。另一项减少不良贷款的通用政策是将债务转为国家投资（代改投）。同样，朱拒绝了所有这类会增加显性赤字的提案（1997d；Er 1999：220）。
The most promising option within the “daigaitou” category was to set up some kind of financial company to take over the NPLs. Within this rubric, one option was to set up state-owned asset management companies (AMCs) which
在“大改头”类别中，最有希望的选项是设立某种金融公司来接管不良贷款。在这一范畴内，一个选项是设立国有资产管理公司（AMCs），其...
gave either bonds or stocks to the banks in exchange for bad debts. This could clean up the bank’s balance sheet without increasing explicit deficit substantially. Soon after becoming premier in 1998, Zhu discarded other options and instead set up state-owned AMCs to take over a massive portfolio of NPLs at face value - to be slowly digested over time. 15 15 ^(15){ }^{15} The four AMCs, Xinda, Changcheng, Huarong, and Dongfang, took over NPLs from China Construction Bank, the Agricultural Bank of China, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, and the Bank of China, respectively. Each AMC received io billion yuan in initial capital from the MOF (People’s Bank of China, Ministry of Finance, and China Securities Regulatory Commission 2000). On that basis, the four AMCs issued 1.4 trillion yuan in financial bonds to the state banks and used the funds to purchase 1.4 trillion yuan in NPLs from the Big Four banks at face value.
向银行提供了债券或股票以换取不良债务。这可以在不大幅增加显性赤字的情况下清理银行的资产负债表。朱镕基于 1998 年出任总理后不久，放弃了其他选项，而是设立了国有资产管理公司（AMCs），以面值接管大规模的不良贷款组合——并在一段时间内逐步消化。 15 15 ^(15){ }^{15} 这四家 AMC——信达、长城、华融和东方，分别接管了来自中国建设银行、农业银行、中国工商银行和中国银行的不良贷款。每家 AMC 从财政部获得了 100 亿元的启动资本（中国人民银行、财政部和中国证券监督管理委员会 2000）。在此基础上，这四家 AMC 向国有银行发行了 1.4 万亿元的金融债，并用这些资金以面值从四大行购买了 1.4 万亿元的不良贷款。
AMCs had a charter of ten years and were tasked with recovering as much of the NPLs as possible through debt-to-equity swap, bankruptcy, auctions to the private sector, and restructuring debt. At the end of the ten-year charter, the MOF would issue bonds or inject government surplus to write off the remaining amount. In this manner, state banks replaced 1.4 trillion yuan in NPLs with I. 4 trillion yuan in MOF backed AMC bonds, thereby getting rid of some twofifths of the estimated 3.3 trillion yuan in NPLs. 16 16 ^(16){ }^{16} Meanwhile, the MOF did not have to list the 1.4 trillion yuan in special bonds on the official budget, since the MOF merely guaranteed the bonds issued by the AMCs. The AMCs, by contrast, were saddled with 1.4 trillion yuan in NPLs and 1.4 trillion yuan in debt to the state banks. Although AMC officials initially resisted purchasing NPLs at face value, they soon realized that the MOF, rather than the AMCs, was ultimately responsible for the remaining pool of NPLs at the end of the ten-year charter. 17 17 ^(17){ }^{17}
资产管理公司（AMC）的章程为期十年，其任务是通过债转股、破产、拍卖给私营部门以及重组债务等方式尽可能回收不良贷款（NPLs）。在十年章程结束时，财政部（MOF）将发行债券或注入政府结余来核销剩余金额。通过这种方式，国有银行以 1.4 万亿元的不良贷款置换为由财政部担保的 1.4 万亿元 AMC 债券，从而消除了估计 3.3 万亿元不良贷款的大约五分之二。 16 16 ^(16){ }^{16} 与此同时，财政部无需在官方预算中列示这 1.4 万亿元专项债券，因为财政部仅对 AMC 发行的债券提供担保。相比之下，AMC 则背负了 1.4 万亿元的不良贷款和对国有银行的 1.4 万亿元债务。尽管 AMC 官员最初抵制按面值购买不良贷款，但他们很快意识到，在十年章程结束时，最终对剩余不良贷款池负责的是财政部而非 AMC。 17 17 ^(17){ }^{17}
In the short run, all the bureaucratic interests, as well as the political interest of Zhu Rongji, gained from the transfer of NPLs to AMCs. The state banks and the PBOC effortlessly swapped NPLs with performing assets backed by the MOF. AMC-issued bonds bore interest rates benchmarked to bonds issued by the policy banks, which provided banks with healthy profits. 18 18 ^(18){ }^{18} The Ministry of Finance (MOF) supported this plan because it did not immediately require the MOF to make explicit the treasury’s obligation to the public by massively issuing bonds and injecting capital into the banks. Although the MOF would have to deal with the remaining NPLs in ten years, top MOF officials were mainly
在短期内，所有官僚利益以及朱镕基的政治利益，都从将不良贷款转移到资产管理公司中获益。国有银行和中国人民银行轻而易举地用财政部担保的良性资产置换了不良贷款。资产管理公司发行的债券的利率参照政策性银行发行的债券，为银行带来了可观的利润。 18 18 ^(18){ }^{18} 财政部支持这一方案，因为这并不立即要求财政部通过大量发行国债和向银行注资来明确向公众承担国库责任。尽管财政部将在十年内必须处理剩余的不良贷款，但财政部高层官员主要...
interested in providing a short-term solution to the NPL problem, which served to promote their career prospects. 19 19 ^(19){ }^{19} The SETC gained control over the debt-toequity swap (discussed later), which gave it enormous power to decide the fate of thousands of SOEs. Although technocrats involved in setting up AMCs all realized that the recovery ratio for NPLs was likely to be low ( 10 − 20 10 − 20 10-2010-20 percent range) and that the treasury would have to write off an enormous amount of NPL in the future, their main objective was to minimize the short-term burden for themselves and for the Zhu administration (Bureau of Economic Prediction of the State Information Center 2000). 20 20 ^(20){ }^{20} In fact, the central government found AMCs the ideal policy tool and increased the amount of NPLs transferred to AMCs from the originally planned 400 billion yuan to 1.3 trillion yuan and finally to ɪ. 4 trillion yuan (Chang 2001: 133). In this process, Zhu could claim that he “solved” a major problem while not jeopardizing the short-term fiscal balance of the central government.
