他们有兴趣提供一个短期解决方案来应对不良贷款问题，这有利于提升他们的职业前景。 19 19 ^(19){ }^{19} 国有资产管理委员会获得了对债转股（后文讨论）的控制权，这赋予了它决定数千家国有企业命运的巨大权力。参与设立资产管理公司的技术官僚都意识到，不良贷款的回收比率很可能很低（大约 10 − 20 10 − 20 10-2010-20 百分比范围），国库将在未来不得不核销大量不良贷款，但他们的主要目标是将短期负担降到最低，以利于他们自己和朱镕基政府（国家信息中心经济预测局 2000）。 20 20 ^(20){ }^{20} 事实上，中央政府发现资产管理公司是理想的政策工具，并将转移给资产管理公司的不良贷款金额从最初计划的 4000 亿元增加到 1.3 万亿元，最后达到 1.4 万亿元（Chang 2001: 133）。在这一过程中，朱镕基可以宣称他“解决”了一个重大问题，同时又不危及中央政府的短期财政平衡。
In addition to dealing with the existing amount of NPLs, Zhu also implemented a series of measures to slow the creation of new NPLs. The foremost policy was the centralization of the banking system, which bereft local governments of the authority to intervene in major state banks. The hope was to decrease the amount of administrative intervention in state banks, thereby decreasing NPLs. Once the headquarters of each bank gained control over the appointment of local managers, state banks instituted strict responsibility system for managers in the event of a default. The punishment for approving a loan that ended up defaulting ranged from outright firing to wage reduction (Shenyang Branch of the PBOC 1999). In order to bring Chinese accounting more in line with global practice, the PBOC also ordered banks to use the international five-category system to classify loans. Furthermore, the Big Four banks instituted independent credit evaluation that ensured some degree of autonomy for accountants to evaluate the merit of a loan. In addition, new regulations required state investment projects to raise at least 30 percent of the required capital before applying for a bank loan. 21 21 ^(21){ }^{21} These new regulations reduced the possibility of lapsed interest payment in the short run. Finally, in classic planned economy fashion, Zhu issued annual NPL reduction targets to the major state banks. In 2000, for example, PBOC governor Dai Xianglong ordered the Big Four state banks to lower NPL ratio by 2 to 4 percent annually depending on the quality of their portfolios (Editorial Committee of Great Reference of Economics 2001).
除了处理现有的不良贷款规模外，朱还实施了一系列措施以减缓新不良贷款的产生。最重要的政策是对银行体系的集中化，剥夺了地方政府干预大型国有银行的权力。希望通过减少对国有银行的行政干预来降低不良贷款。一旦各银行总部获得了对地方管理者任命的控制权，国有银行对管理者在发生违约时实行严格的责任制。批准最终违约贷款的惩罚从直接解雇到减薪不等（PBOC 沈阳分行 1999）。为了使中国会计更符合全球惯例，PBOC 还要求银行使用国际五类分类法对贷款进行分类。此外，四大行建立了独立的信用评估，确保会计人员在评估贷款优劣时具有一定的自主性。此外，新的法规要求国家投资项目在申请银行贷款前至少筹集所需资本的 30%。 这些新监管在短期内降低了利息支付中断的可能性。最后，按典型的计划经济作风，朱发出了对主要国有银行每年减少不良贷款的目标。例如在 2000 年，PBOC 行长戴相龙下令四大国有银行根据其投资组合质量每年将不良贷款率降低 2%至 4%（Editorial Committee of Great Reference of Economics 2001）。
These policies indeed generated impressive results. Government deficit remained at the same level while NPLs worth over I trillion yuan was removed from the banks virtually overnight. The central government also reduced intervention by local level rent-seekers. Within the Big Four banks, Western accounting practices were introduced, while managers were held accountable for bad
这些政策确实产生了显著成效。政府赤字保持在相同水平，而价值超过 1 万亿元的不良贷款几乎在一夜之间从银行系统中剔除。中央政府还减少了地方寻租者的干预。四大行内部引入了西方会计做法，同时对管理者因不良...
commercial decisions for the first time. Without a doubt, state banks made important strides toward becoming commercial entities. Nevertheless, the primary effects of Zhu’s anti-NPL policies were transferring the fiscal pressure of the NPLs to the future and centralizing financial powers. Although official announcements claimed that AMCs would recover 30 percent- 50 percent of the NPLs, Western analysts and government experts agreed that the actual cash recovery ratio was likely to be much lower (Bureau of Economic Prediction of the State Information Center 2000; Gilley 2000). 22 22 ^(22){ }^{22} Recovering transferred asset in real estate proved to be extremely difficult. According to an internal report, the Hainan Branch of the Changcheng AMC could not locate borrowers of 40 percent of the transferred real estate related loans. For the remaining amount, real estate prices in Hainan had collapsed since the heady days in the early 1990s, allowing AMCs to recover only a small fraction of the transferred real estate assets (Ge 2001). Moreover, although debt-to-equity swaps gave AMCs shares of SOEs, they ultimately needed to find buyers for their SOE shares to repay the interest and principal of the bonds (Zhang, Ji, and Xu 2002). As of the end of 2005, the AMCs have digested over 400 billion yuan in NPLs but have only recovered some 154 billion yuan in cash, or ɪɪ percent of the total (Wang 2005 ). In order to maintain interest payments on the bonds and to pay for operating expenses, it turned out that the PBOC provided 570 billion yuan in “reloans” to the AMCs (Jiang 2006a). Thus, the AMC project continues to generate liabilities for the government nearing a decade after its inception. It is hard to believe that Zhu had not foreseen the long-term outcome of forming AMCs.
首次作出商业决策。毫无疑问，国有银行在向商业实体转型方面取得了重要进展。然而，朱镕基反不良贷款政策的主要效果是将不良贷款的财政压力转移到未来并集中过金融权力。尽管官方宣称资产管理公司将回收 30%–50%的不良贷款，西方分析人士和政府专家一致认为实际的现金回收率可能远低于此（国家信息中心经济预测局 2000；Gilley 2000）。 22 22 ^(22){ }^{22} 在房地产中回收已转移资产被证明极为困难。根据一份内部报告，长城资产管理公司海南分公司无法找到 40%的已转移房地产相关贷款的借款人。对于剩余部分，自 1990 年代初的繁荣时期以来，海南的房价已经崩溃，使得资产管理公司只能回收极少部分已转移的房地产资产（Ge 2001）。 此外，尽管债转股使资产管理公司（AMC）获得了国有企业的股权，但他们最终仍需找到买家来出售这些国有企业股份，以偿还债券的本息（Zhang, Ji, and Xu 2002）。截至 2005 年底，AMC 已处置了超过 4000 亿元的不良贷款，但仅回收了约 1540 亿元现金，即总额的约ɪɪ个百分点（Wang 2005）。为维持债券利息支付并支付运营费用，结果央行向 AMC 提供了 5700 亿元的“再贷款”（Jiang 2006a）。因此，AMC 项目在启动近十年后仍为政府带来持续的负债。很难相信朱没有预见到设立 AMC 的长期后果。
In addition, both the volume of NPLs still in the banking system and the rate of new NPL creation remain unclear. After the transfer of NPLs to AMCs, the government repeatedly revised the remaining NPL ratio. In 1999, PBOC Governor Dai announced that NPL ratio was at 20 percent, suggesting that the transfer of NPLs to AMCs would have basically solved the problem (Holland 1999). In July, 2001, the Bank of China first broke rank with the official line and admitted that NPL ratio at BOC was 28.78 percent, even after the transfer of NPLs (Sito 200I). During a 2002 meeting with international investors, Governor Dai hinted that the NPL ratio among all financial institutions might be as high as 30 percent if calculated by Western accounting standard (Beijing Xin Bang Investment & Consulting Ltd 2002b). Although the massive U.S.$60 billion ( 480 billion yuan) injection from China’s blooming foreign exchange reserve in 2003 and subsequent transfer of a further 60 billion yuan in NPLs to the AMCs drastically reduced official NPL ratio in the state banking sector, Western analysts continue to suspect that lax monitoring and heated real estate investment in recent years generated enormous amount of new NPLs (Ernst & Young 2006; Shih 2005).
此外，仍留在银行体系中的不良贷款规模以及新产生不良贷款的比率仍不清楚。在不良贷款被转移到资产管理公司（AMCs）之后，政府多次修订剩余不良贷款比率。1999 年，中国人民银行行长戴相龙宣布不良贷款比率为 20%，暗示不良贷款转移到资产管理公司基本上已解决该问题（Holland 1999）。2001 年 7 月，中国银行首次与官方口径出现分歧，并承认即使在转移不良贷款之后，中国银行的不良贷款比率仍为 28.78%（Sito 2001）。在 2002 年与国际投资者的会议上，戴行长暗示，如果按西方会计标准计算，所有金融机构的不良贷款比率可能高达 30%（北京新邦投资咨询有限公司 2002b）。尽管大规模的美国...2003 年从中国快速增长的外汇储备中注入的 600 亿美元（4800 亿元）以及随后再向资产管理公司转移的 600 亿元不良贷款，大幅降低了国有银行体系的官方不良贷款率，但西方分析人士仍然怀疑，近年来监管松懈和房地产投资过热产生了大量新的不良贷款（Ernst & Young 2006；Shih 2005）。
Although the centralization of the banking sector and the NPL resolution program improved some aspects of the previously crumbling banking sector,
尽管银行业的集中化和不良贷款处置计划改善了先前濒临崩溃的银行业的某些方面，
Zhu mainly mobilized financial resources to achieve another impressive administrative feat: the rescuing of China’s dilapidated state sector. At the First Plenum of the Fifteenth Central Committee and at the December 1997 Central Economic Conference, Zhu articulated his goal to bring China’s troubling SOEs “out of difficulties” (tuokun) in three years. This was indeed an ambitious goal. Despite repeated efforts to improve SOE performance since the 1990s, the official asset-to-liability ratio for SOEs in 1998 remained at an alarming 65 percent. Moreover, the ratio of SOE short-term loans to working capital was over ɪ૦૦ percent, which meant that SOEs completely relied on bank loans for daily operation. Meanwhile, over 40 percent of SOEs were making losses (Bureau of Economic Prediction of the State Information Center 1999a). Even these mediocre figures were likely the products of imaginative accounting. A 2000 MOF survey discovered that 99 percent of SOEs had falsified their accounts to some extent (Chang 2001).
朱鎔基主要动员金融资源以完成另一项令人瞩目的行政壮举：拯救中国日益萧条的国有部门。在第十五届中央委员会第一次全体会议和 1997 年 12 月的中央经济工作会议上，朱阐明了他要在三年内把中国问题重重的国有企业“脱困”的目标（tuokun）。这确实是一个雄心勃勃的目标。尽管自 1990 年代以来多次努力改善国企绩效，1998 年官方披露的国有企业资产负债率仍高达令人警戒的 65%。此外，国企短期贷款与流动资金的比率超过 100%，这意味着国企完全依赖银行贷款来维持日常经营。与此同时，超过 40%的国企出现亏损（国家信息中心经济预测局 1999a）。即便这些平庸的数据也很可能是经过巧妙会计处理的产物。财政部 2000 年的一项调查发现，99%的国企在不同程度上存在虚报账目现象（Chang 2001）。
The concentration of China’s enormous financial assets at the center’s disposal allowed Zhu to provide impressive, but short-term, solutions to the SOE problem. Zhu’s first step was to form a subcommittee on large SOEs under the Central Finance and Economic Leading Group, the highest body of economic policies (Forney and Yatsko 1998). He then implemented a series of policies that mobilized substantial banking resources in the service of large and medium SOEs, including debt-for-equity swaps (zhaizhuangu), interest subsidies for technical innovation investment (jigai lixi butie), and closed-ended loans (fengbi daikuan) (Zhu 1998a). In this process, large SOEs and central ministries gained enormous amounts of financial resources and policy discretion, but it also stalled reforms in the financial sector and created enormous opportunity costs to China’s economy.
中国中央掌握的大量金融资产集中使得朱能够为国有企业问题提供令人瞩目但短期的解决方案。朱的第一步是在中央财经领导小组下成立了大型国有企业小组委员会，中央财经领导小组是最高的经济政策机构（Forney 和 Yatsko 1998）。随后他实施了一系列政策，将大量银行资源动员用于服务大型和中型国有企业，包括债转股（zhaizhuangu）、技术创新投资利息补贴（jigai lixi butie）和封闭式贷款（fengbi daikuan）（Zhu 1998a）。在此过程中，大型国有企业和中央部委获得了大量金融资源和政策自主权，但这也阻滞了金融领域的改革，并给中国经济带来了巨大的机会成本。
As discussed earlier, the main strategy by which AMCs converted bad asset into performing asset was debt-for-equity swap, or transforming the debt owed by SOEs to SOE shares. 23 23 ^(23){ }^{23} Instead of deciding which SOEs qualified for debt-forequity swaps themselves, AMCs received SETC “recommendations” on which SOEs could receive the privilege of the swaps. Because a debt-for-equity swap essentially gave the debtor firm a free pass to default on a loan, the policy created a “long line of Red Flag sedans” (yilian chuande Hongqi fangche) filled with local officials in front of the SETC’s headquarters at 7 : 30 7 : 30 7:307: 30 every morning (Zhan 2000: 199). In choosing the beneficiaries, the SETC focused on large SOEs and state corporations, as well as SOEs in the pillar industries (Zhan 2000: 203). Moreover, by all accounts, the process of picking beneficiaries was a highly politicized one in which personal connections and factional ties played a substantial role. 24 24 ^(24){ }^{24} Politicized or not, the discretion to essentially forgive
如前所述，AMC 将不良资产转换为可持续性资产的主要策略是以债务换股，即将国有企业所欠的债务转化为国有企业的股权。 23 23 ^(23){ }^{23} AMC 并不自行决定哪些国有企业有资格进行债转股，而是接受 SETC 就哪些国有企业可以享有该特权的“建议”。因为债转股本质上给了债务企业一个对贷款违约的免死金牌，这项政策每天早晨在 SETC 总部前就形成了一条“排着队的红旗轿车长队”（yilian chuande Hongqi fangche），车上坐满了地方官员（Zhan 2000: 199）。在选择受益者时，SETC 侧重于大型国有企业和国有集团，以及支柱产业中的国企（Zhan 2000: 203）。此外，据所有报道，挑选受益者的过程高度政治化，个人关系和派系关联在其中起着重要作用。 24 24 ^(24){ }^{24} 无论是否政治化，实际上具有豁免债务的裁量权
debt resided in the central bureaucracy rather than in the local government. Undoubtedly, the SETC’s control over this process gave the central bureaucracy and ultimately Zhu Rongji a wealth of political capital in the Politburo.
债务集中在中央机构而非地方政府。毫无疑问，电子工业部对这一过程的控制使中央机构并最终使朱镕基在政治局中获得了大量政治资本。
In addition, the long-established practice of subsidizing technical innovation loans was given a further boost during the Zhu administration. The policy required large and medium SOEs to submit proposals for improving production technology to the SETC. On SETC approval of a given project, the MOF would pay for all bank interest of the approved loan until the completion of the project. In 1998 alone, ɪo billion yuan in treasury bond issuance was earmarked for this purpose, which was expected to generate loans amounting to 200 billion yuan (Bureau of Economic Prediction of the State Information Center 1999b). Although banks were under no formal obligation to approve a technical innovation loan, bank managers in reality competed with each other to lend to projects that had been approved by the SETC because these loans were essentially risk-free for them bureaucratically. In other words, even if these loans became nonperforming at some point, the fact that the SETC and the MOF had approved them meant that bankers were not responsible. 25 25 ^(25){ }^{25} Because of these incentives, banks approved over 90 percent of all loans proposed by the SETC. 26 26 ^(26){ }^{26}
此外，朱镕基政府期间，长期以来对技术革新贷款的补贴做法又得到进一步推动。该政策要求大型和中型国有企业向 SETC 提交改进生产技术的项目建议。经 SETC 批准某一项目后，MOF 将支付该批准贷款在项目完成前的全部银行利息。仅在 1998 年，就有 100 亿元国债发行专项用于此目的，预计可带动 2000 亿元贷款（国家信息中心经济预报局 1999b）。尽管银行在形式上并无批准技术革新贷款的义务，但实际上银行经理们为了与彼此竞争，纷纷向那些已获 SETC 批准的项目放贷，因为从官僚角度看这些贷款对他们来说基本上毫无风险。换言之，即便这些贷款在某个时候成为不良贷款，SETC 和 MOF 的批准意味着银行家不需承担责任。 25 25 ^(25){ }^{25} 由于这些激励，银行批准了 SETC 提出的超过 90%的所有贷款。 26 26 ^(26){ }^{26}
In addition to these forms of subsidies, the State Council also concocted the policy of close-ended loans, which specifically directed credit toward lossmaking large SOEs. Under this policy, banks were instructed by the SETC to lend to loss-making SOEs that had a production line with reasonable market and profit potential. Presumably, if funds were directed at improving the promising production line rather than at wage arrears or other investment, the SOE would have a better chance of becoming profitable (Bureau of Economic Prediction of the State Information Center 1999b). Although the scope of this policy was limited, banks were nevertheless forced to lend to firms with exceptionally high levels of debt.
除了这些形式的补贴外，国务院还炮制了封闭式贷款政策，专门将信贷定向到亏损的大型国有企业。在这一政策下，银行受到国家经委的指示，向那些拥有具有合理市场和利润潜力的生产线的亏损国企放贷。推测是，如果资金被用于改善有前景的生产线，而不是用于拖欠工资或其他投资，该国企就更有可能实现盈利（国家信息中心经济预测局 1999b）。尽管该政策的适用范围有限，银行仍被迫向债务水平异常高的企业放贷。
In addition to general policies, the State Council occasionally demanded state commercial banks to rescue certain industries. For example, in 1999, banks were ordered to “lend” to qualified loss-making SOEs so that they could repay coal fees to large state coal mines (Bureau of Economic Prediction of the State Information Center 1999b). Similar to the program to “solve” the triangular debt problem in the early ɪ990s, banks were unlikely to see any return on these loans. Finally, in order to ensure stability in poor regions, the State Council still occasionally ordered commercial banks to make “peace and unity loans” (anding tuanjie daikuan) to pay unemployed workers. 27 27 ^(27){ }^{27} Although mid-level
除了总体政策外，国务院有时还要求国有商业银行救助某些行业。例如，1999 年，银行被下令向符合条件的亏损国有企业“借款”，以便这些企业能够向大型国有煤矿偿付煤费（国家信息中心经济预报局 1999b）。与 1990 年代初旨在“解决”三角债问题的计划类似，银行不太可能从这些贷款中获得任何回报。最后，为了保障贫困地区的稳定，国务院仍偶尔命令商业银行发放“安定团结贷款”（anding tuanjie daikuan）以支付失业工人的工资。 27 27 ^(27){ }^{27} 尽管中层
bankers disliked these deliberate policies to help troublesome SOEs, they recognized that senior managers needed to respond to the policy demands of the premier. 28 28 ^(28){ }^{28}
银行家不喜欢这些旨在帮助麻烦国企的刻意政策，但他们认识到高级管理者需要对总理的政策要求做出回应。 28 28 ^(28){ }^{28}
In addition to specific policies, the combination of bank centralization, emphasis on risk prevention, and bias toward large SOEs created an extremely favorable environment for large SOEs and state corporations to obtain bank loans. First, under enormous pressure to maintain growth, banks lent to firms that had minimal risk in the short-run. In addition to SOEs that had received SETC or SPC blessings, SOEs or state corporations that had recently offered their shares publicly were also ideal clients for banks. Because most publicly traded state firms had undergone debt-to-equity swaps, their asset-to-liability ratios were likely low, while their short-term ability to meet interest payments was likely high. Moreover, a publicly traded company also signaled to banks that the SOE enjoyed SETC protection (Chen 2000a). Indeed, an internal decree of the Construction Bank strongly urged its branch banks to lend to listed firms because "… the listing process not only increases the capital of a company and decreases its debt ratio, it also allows the firm to raise a large amount of capital in a short time, which can invigorate our deposit base (Construction Bank of China 1998). In addition to publicly traded SOEs, banks also favored large SOEs, especially those that were on the list of “key point enterprises” (zhongdian qiye), because, again, lending to them entailed less bureaucratic risk for managers in the event of a default. 29 29 ^(29){ }^{29}
除了具体政策之外，银行的集中化、对风险预防的重视以及对大型国有企业的偏好，共同为大型国有企业和国有公司获得银行贷款创造了极其有利的环境。首先，在维持增长的巨大压力下，银行向在短期内风险极小的企业放贷。除了获得 SETC 或 SPC 支持的国有企业外，最近公开发行股份的国有企业或国有公司也是银行的理想客户。因为大多数上市国有企业已完成了债转股，其资产负债率往往较低，而其短期偿付利息的能力往往较强。此外，上市公司也向银行传递了该国企享有 SETC 保护的信号（Chen 2000a）。事实上，建设银行的一项内部法令强烈敦促其各分行向上市公司放贷，理由是“……上市程序不仅增加了公司的资本并降低了其负债率，还使公司能够在短时间内筹集大量资本，从而能振兴我们的存款基础（Construction Bank of China 1998）。” 除了上市的国有企业外，银行也偏好大型国有企业，尤其是列入“重点企业”(zhongdian qiye)名单的那些企业，因为同样地，如果发生违约，向它们放贷对管理者来说在官僚风险方面较低。 29 29 ^(29){ }^{29}
The net effects of these policy biases were startling. During Zhu’s tenure, state owned enterprises shed a quarter of its workforce. Yet, state bank loans to the state sector increased from 4.6 trillion yuan ( 67 percent of GDP) in the first quarter of 1997 to more than 9 trillion yuan at the end of 2003 ( 77 percent of GDP) (China Statistical Information and Consultancy Service Center 2004). Anecdotal cases further suggest that bank credit was withdrawn from small SOEs and given overwhelmingly to large and medium SOEs at the city level or above. According to a 2000 survey in Hubei, the top three companies in the province, including the Three Gorges Corporation, Huazhong Electricity, and Wugang Steel, received over 17 percent of total commercial loans (Research Team of the PBOC Wuhan Branch 200I). In Chongqing, the eleven key-point industries identified by the SETC received 22 percent of new industrial loans in 2000 (Chongqing Branch of the PBOC 2000).
这些政策偏向的净效应令人震惊。朱任内，国有企业裁减了四分之一的劳动力。然而，国有银行对国有部门的贷款从 1997 年第一季度的 4.6 万亿元（占 GDP 的 67%）增加到 2003 年底的超过 9 万亿元（占 GDP 的 77%）（China Statistical Information and Consultancy Service Center 2004）。轶事案例进一步表明，银行信贷从小型国有企业撤出，并压倒性地转向市级及以上的大中型国有企业。根据 2000 年湖北的一项调查，该省三家最大公司——包括三峡集团、华中电力和武钢——获得了超过 17%的商业贷款总额（Research Team of the PBOC Wuhan Branch 200I）。在重庆，由 SETC 确定的 11 个重点行业在 2000 年获得了 22%的新工业贷款（Chongqing Branch of the PBOC 2000）。
Despite the end of local government influence, banks instead became an integral part of the center’s plan to rescue large SOEs and continued to deprive the vibrant private sector of capital. Premier Zhu compounded the private sector’s capital shortage with a ban of private financial institutions which had financed much of the private sector (State Council 1998a). Finally, continual
尽管地方政府影响力消失，银行反而成为中央拯救大型国有企业计划的组成部分，继续剥夺充满活力的私营部门的资金。朱镕基总理通过禁止曾为私营部门提供大量融资的民营金融机构（国务院 1998a），加剧了私营部门的资本短缺。最后，不断的
government control over interest rates encouraged risk-averse state banks to direct funds toward “safe borrowers,” that is, major state owned conglomerates (Xie 200I). In order to maintain strict central control over the financial system, Zhu ignored repeated pleads by both local governments and banking specialists to legalize private banks and to liberalize interest rates (Tsai 2002: 208; Xie 1995). 30 30 ^(30){ }^{30} As a result of the myriad policy bias against the private sector, state bank loans to the nonstate sector only saw anemic growth from ɪɪ percent to 14 percent of loans outstanding between 1997 and 2003 (China Statistical Information and Consultancy Service Center 2004). 31 31 ^(31){ }^{31}
政府对利率的控制促使风险厌恶的国有银行将资金投向“安全借款人”，即大型国有企业集团（Xie 2001）。为了保持对金融体系的严格中央控制，朱忽视了地方政府和银行专家反复要求将私人银行合法化和放开利率的呼吁（Tsai 2002: 208；Xie 1995）。 30 30 ^(30){ }^{30} 由于众多政策对私营部门的偏向性限制，国有银行对非国有部门的贷款在 1997 年至 2003 年间仅从贷款余额的 11%增长到 14%，增幅微弱（China Statistical Information and Consultancy Service Center 2004）。 31 31 ^(31){ }^{31}

Jiang Reinvigorates Decentralization
江泽民重新推动权力下放

In the aftermath of the Asian Financial Crisis, Zhu enjoyed an unprecedented period of financial centralization that surpassed even the correction and rectification period after 1989. With the centralization of the banking sector, Premier Zhu seemingly rendered inflationary cycles an artifact of the past. Indeed, banking centralization in combination with a surplus economy in China produced several years of negative inflation during the Zhu administration. Local governments eager to increase the availability of credit struggled to provide sufficient funds to local enterprises because bank managers were no longer beholden to local leaders. Although institutional changes in the banking sector might have increased the cost of decentralizing financial power for generalist factions, the underlying logic driving inflationary cycles in China remained in place. Although continual political vulnerability delayed Jiang’s decentralization drive until the end of his term, the floodgates of China’s financial institution once again opened in the runup to the Sixteenth Party Congress in the fall of 2002, causing a rapid increase in the money supply and rising inflationary pressure by the spring of 2004 .
在亚洲金融危机之后，朱享有一段前所未有的金融集权时期，甚至超过了 1989 年后的纠偏整顿期。随着银行业的集中化，朱总理似乎使通货膨胀周期成为过去的遗物。实际上，银行集中化与中国的盈余型经济相结合，在朱任内产生了数年负通胀。渴望增加信贷可得性的地方政府因为银行经理不再对地方领导负责，而难以为地方企业提供足够的资金。尽管银行业的制度性变革可能提高了将金融权力下放给泛能派系的成本，但驱动中国通货膨胀周期的潜在逻辑依然存在。 尽管持续的政治脆弱性将江的分权推动一再推迟到任期结束，但在 2002 年秋季十六大召开前夕，中国金融机构的闸门再次打开，导致货币供应量在 2004 年春季迅速增加并产生上升的通胀压力。

The Woes of Centralization: Deflation
集权的灾难：通货紧缩

In a way, Zhu’s banking centralization drive was probably more successful than he had originally hoped. Overnight, local bank branches found themselves serving new masters. Instead of taking orders from the local governments, provincial bank branches now had to adhere to lending limitation from the banks’ headquarters, which in turn received their lending quotas and loan-to-deposit ratios from the PBOC. The PBOC itself made monetary policy at the behest of the premier’s office. Institutionally, Zhu found himself in almost complete control over Asia’s second largest banking sector behind Japan. However, this success also had a downside, especially when the country faced slowing growth, declining prices, struggling SOEs, and sluggish exports in the aftermath of the
在某种程度上，朱的银行集权推进可能比他最初期望的还要成功。一夜之间，地方银行网点发现自己服从了新的主子。省级分行不再听命于地方政府，而必须遵守由总行下达的放贷限制，总行又从中国人民银行那里获得放贷配额和存贷比率。中国人民银行本身是在总理办公室的要求下制定货币政策。在体制上，朱几乎完全控制了仅次于日本的亚洲第二大银行业。然而，这一成功也有其负面影响，特别是在全国经历增长放缓、价格下跌、国有企业困难和出口疲弱的情况下。
Asian Financial Crisis. Because local bankers were no longer pressured to lend by local governments, they did not lend any more than was mandated by the PBOC credit plan.
亚洲金融危机。由于地方银行家不再受到地方政府的压力去放贷，他们按照中国人民银行的信贷计划放贷，不会超过该计划规定的数量。
To increase money supply in 1998 and 1999, Zhu ordered the PBOC to increase allowable loan-to-deposits ratios, lower reserve requirements, and lower interest rates. However, because bank branches still had to adhere to strict nonperforming loan reduction targets, they were hardly motivated to increase lending. Growth in money supply fell from 24.8 percent at the beginning of 1997 to 17.4 percent at the beginning of 1998, and it further fell to 14.6 percent by June of 1998. Moreover, the retail price index, which first dipped below 100 in October 1997, fell to 97 in June 1998, signifying a deflation rate of 3 percent (Secretariat of PBOC Monetary Policy Committee 2000a). To prevent a further slide in prices, Zhu was compelled to order banks to increase lending every year between 1998 and 2001 (Dai 2002b; PBOC Monetary Policy Committee 2000 d). For the first time since the reform, the credit plan became a floor on how much banks had to lend rather than a ceiling that limited what they could lend. Even with these concerted efforts, bank lending increased by 15 percent in 1998, a much lower figure than in previous years (Secretariat of PBOC Monetary Policy Committee 2000a).
为在 1998 年和 1999 年增加货币供应，朱要求 PBOC 提高允许的贷款与存款比率、降低准备金率并下调利率。然而，由于各银行分支仍必须遵守严格的不良贷款减少目标，它们几乎没有动力增加放贷。货币供应增长率从 1997 年初的 24.8%降至 1998 年初的 17.4%，并在 1998 年 6 月进一步降至 14.6%。此外，零售价格指数在 1997 年 10 月首次跌破 100 后，于 1998 年 6 月降至 97，意味着 3%的通货紧缩率（Secretariat of PBOC Monetary Policy Committee 2000a）。为防止物价进一步下滑，朱被迫在 1998 年至 2001 年间每年下令银行增加信贷（Dai 2002b；PBOC Monetary Policy Committee 2000 d）。自改革以来首次，信贷计划成为银行必须放贷的下限，而不再是限制其放贷的上限。即便有这些协调努力，1998 年银行放贷仍仅增长 15%，远低于前些年（Secretariat of PBOC Monetary Policy Committee 2000a）。
Although Zhu mobilized the centralized banking sector to fight off slow growth and deflation, the chorus of complaints against banks’ reluctance to lend (xidai) increased in 1999 (Bureau of Economic Prediction of the State Information Center 1999c). Export, which had grown a sluggish U.S.$1.1 billion in 1998, lunged ahead and grew by U.S.$11.1 billion in 1999 (National Bureau of Statistics 2004). Bank lending and money supply (M2), however, grew at a stagnant rate of just over 14 percent, precisely what the PBOC monetary target and credit plan had called for (Secretariat of PBOC Monetary Policy Committee 2000a). Because bankers were punished for new nonperforming loans, they were only eager to provide long-term loans to state-mandated projects and large SOEs, which carried little short-term risks. They became extremely reluctant to finance small and medium local enterprises.
尽管朱利用集中的银行业来对抗经济增长放缓和通货紧缩，但对银行不愿放贷（xidai）的抱怨声在 1999 年增加（国家信息中心经济预测局 1999c）。出口从 1998 年低迷的 11 亿美元一跃增长，1999 年增长了 111 亿美元（国家统计局 2004）。然而，银行放贷和货币供应量（M2）仅以略高于 14%的停滞速度增长，正好与 PBOC 的货币目标和信贷计划所要求的相符（PBOC 货币政策委员会秘书处 2000a）。由于银行家因新的不良贷款受到惩罚，他们只愿意向国家指定的项目和大型国有企业提供长期贷款，这些主体短期风险较小。他们极不愿意为中小地方企业提供融资。
With inflation at a historically low level and with the passing of the AFC, why did Jiang hesitate to launch a decentralization drive? The short answer is simply that Jiang was no Deng. Whereas Deng only relied on the technocrats’ political support during two crucial periods - in the late 1970s and after 1989Jiang continued to face myriad challenges from within the regime even after the Fifteenth Party Congress. Although Chen Xitong’s removal gave him firm control over the party, Jiang continued to struggle with control over the military and the security apparatus. In order to consolidate control over the military, Jiang relied heavily on Zhu to both act as a buffer between Jiang himself and the military and to provide the necessary funds to placate grumblings from the military. Jiang’s heavy reliance on Zhu in the 1998-2000 period provided Zhu the leverage with which to delay financial decentralization.
在通货膨胀处于历史低位并且 AFC 已过去的情况下，为什么江犹豫不决于发起一场分权运动？简短的回答是江不是邓。邓在两个关键时期——1970 年代末和 1989 年之后——只依赖技术官僚的政治支持，而江即便在十五大之后，仍然面临来自政权内部的各种挑战。尽管陈希同的罢免使他对党取得了稳固控制，江在对军队和安全机构的控制上仍然苦苦挣扎。为了巩固对军队的控制，江在很大程度上依赖朱既在他本人和军队之间充当缓冲，又提供必要资金以平息军中的怨声。江在 1998–2000 年期间对朱的高度依赖，赋予了朱延缓金融分权的杠杆。
Although Jiang was able to install several officers loyal to him in the Central Military Commission at the Fifteenth Party Congress, the children and followers
尽管江在十五大期间能够在中央军委安插几名对他忠诚的军官，但这些子女和追随者
of veteran military figures continued to hold important positions in the military (Yang 2004: 117). Not only did these officers passively resist Jiang’s authorities, they also ran enormous business empires involved in everything from night clubs to smuggling (Yang 2004: 128). In the summer of 1998, navy cruisers escorting smugglers engaged in a fifty-minute fire-fight with police gunboats in pursuit of smugglers, resulting in scores of injuries on both sides (Inside Mainland China 1998). The leadership was shocked by this event, but Jiang also took this opportunity to clean house in the army. In addition to launching a wideranging crackdown on smuggling along the coast, he also issued an order to ban all military and police units from engaging in business, something he had struggled with unsuccessfully since the early 1990s (Jiang 2006b). In a July emergency meeting on antismuggling attended by senior military officers, Jiang drove home the necessity of civilian leadership of the military: “If you do not obey the center, who are you obeying! If there are those who dare to go their own way and conduct their own affairs, they will have to bear all responsibilities on their own - just don’t be surprised!” (Jiang 2006d: 168). Compared to the perfunctory speeches typical at party meetings, Jiang revealed the depth of his frustration with army unruliness at this meeting: “Today, I do not have a smile on my face. I am worried, and my patience is running low. So my remarks were a bit emotional. Some remarks were also very sharp, which may have shocked some of you” (Jiang 2006d).
许多资深军方人物继续在军中担任重要职务（Yang 2004: 117）。这些军官不仅被动抵抗江的权威，他们还经营着庞大的商业帝国，涉足夜总会到走私等各种活动（Yang 2004: 128）。1998 年夏天，护航走私者的海军巡洋舰与追击走私者的警方快艇发生了长达五十分钟的交火，导致双方多人受伤（Inside Mainland China 1998）。这一事件令领导层震惊，但江也借此机会在军队内部进行清理。除了在沿海地区发起更大规模的缉私行动外，他还发布命令禁止所有军队和警察部门经商——这是他自 1990 年代初以来一直未能成功解决的问题（Jiang 2006b）。在一次七月召开的反走私紧急会议上，出席的高级军官面前江再次强调军队必须由文职领导：“如果你不服从中央，你要服从谁！” “如果有人胆敢另行其是，擅自行事，那就得自负其责——只要别感到惊讶！”（Jiang 2006d: 168）。与党内会议上惯常的例行发言相比，江在此次会议上流露出对军队不守纪律深深的忧虑：“今天我脸上没有笑容。我很担心，耐心也快耗尽了。所以我的发言有点情绪化。有些话也很尖锐，可能把你们中的一些人震住了”（Jiang 2006d）。
After the meeting, the central government sent teams of investigators to trouble spots along the coast to crack down on smuggling rings and to arrest local and People’s Liberation Army (PLA) officials involved in illegal activities. Instead of appointing Wei Jianxing - Standing Committee member and head of the CDIC - to lead the main investigation effort, Jiang put Zhu Rongji in charge of the frontline antismuggling operation. Jiang chose Zhu instead of Wei presumably because Wei was the protégé of Jiang’s recently retired rival Qiao Shi (Lam 1999: 24). Additionally, Zhu also had an interest to see an end to smuggling because such activities took billions away from the central treasury, a main resource of the central technocrats. In October 1998, Zhu, along with his technocratic protégé Wu Yi, led a eighty-member investigation team to oversee the dismantling of massive smuggling rings based in Zhanjiang and Shantou in Guangdong Province (Office of Striking on Smuggling and Overall Rectification in Guangdong 2006; Yang 2004: 118). Jiang also took this opportunity to thoroughly undo the business empire operated by the “Guangdong Gang” children and protégés of Marshal Ye Jianying who had gained great autonomy by playing Jiang against his rival Li Ruihuan (Gao 1999: 12). Again, Zhu sent one of his protégés, PBOC vice-governor Wang Qishan - also Yao Yilin’s son-in-law - to dismantle financial institutions controlled by the Guangdong faction (Brahm 2002: 78).
会后，中央派出调查组前往沿海问题地区，打击走私集团并逮捕参与非法活动的地方官员和中国人民解放军官员。中央并未任命中央纪律检查委员会常务委员兼书记处成员魏建兴领导主要调查行动，而是让朱镕基负责第一线的反走私行动。江泽民选择朱镕基而非魏建兴，很可能是因为魏是江最近退休的对手乔石的门生（Lam 1999: 24）。此外，朱镕基也有兴趣铲除走私，因为这类活动使中央财政损失数十亿，而中央技术官僚的主要资源正来自中央财政。1998 年 10 月，朱镕基与他的技术官僚门生伍毅率领一支八十人的调查队，监督拆除以广东湛江和汕头为基地的大规模走私集团（Office of Striking on Smuggling and Overall Rectification in Guangdong 2006；Yang 2004: 118）。 江泽民也借此机会彻底摧毁了由叶剑英元帅的子女及门生经营的“广东帮”商业帝国，这些人在利用江与其对手李瑞环相互争斗中获得了极大的自主权（Gao 1999: 12）。同样，朱镕基派出他的亲信之一、人民银行副行长王岐山——也是姚依林的女婿——去拆解由广东派系控制的金融机构（Brahm 2002: 78）。
Although Zhu’s prestige suffered in 1999 as a result of the failed WTO negotiations, Jiang continued to rely on him to oversee antismuggling operations (Fewsmith 2001: 208). In the spring of 1999, the central government decided to shut down a well-known smuggling operation based in Fujian Province that
尽管由于 1999 年未能成功加入 WTO 而使朱的声望受损，江仍继续依靠他监督缉私行动（Fewsmith 2001: 208）。1999 年春，中央决定取缔一家以福建省为基地的著名走私集团，该集团...
had smuggled goods worth some U.S.$ɪo billion (Pomfret 2000). By the mid1990s, the Yuanhua Group had become an “independent kingdom” in the city of Xiamen through having thousands of local and central officials and military officers on its payroll (Straits Times 2000). Again, instead of Wei Jianxing, Jiang had Zhu and the vice director of the CDIC Liu Liying spearhead the investigations (Fewsmith 2001: 226). Why? One reason of course was that Zhu had a reputation for having an uncompromising stance against corruption. Yet, another reason may be that Jiang needed to ensure that the investigation - useful as it was in demolishing a major smuggling operation related to the PLA would not jeopardize the career of Jiang’s own protégé Jia Qinglin, who had served as Fujian governor in the mid-r990s and was then the party secretary of Beijing.
走私货物总价值约 100 亿美元（Pomfret 2000）。到 1990 年代中期，冠华集团通过大量安插地方和中央官员及军官，已在厦门成为一个“独立王国”（Straits Times 2000）。同样地，负责调查的并不是魏建兴，而是由江泽民指派朱和中国信保副主任刘利英牵头（Fewsmith 2001: 226）。为什么？一个原因当然是朱以对腐败采取强硬立场而著称。另一个原因可能是江需要确保这场调查——虽然有助于摧毁与解放军有关的一次重大走私行动——不会危及江的亲信贾庆林的仕途。贾庆林曾在 1990 年代中期任福建省省长，后来担任北京市委书记。
The Yuanhua case turned out to be a smashing success for Jiang’s consolidation of power over the army and the police. It led to the arrests of Ji Shengde, the head of the PLA Military Intelligence, and Li Jizhou, vice minister of public security and the head of the National Anti-Smuggling Task Force, as well as hundreds of local customs, police, and administrative officials (Straits Times 2000 ). However, it was also widely believed that Jia Qinglin’s wife and possibly Jia himself were on the Yuanhua payroll because Jia’s wife had been in charge of foreign trade in Fujian during the height of Yuanhua’s influence (Straits Times 2000 ). Despite the cloud of suspicion, Jiang went on an inspection tour of Beijing and held Jia’s hand in solidarity in front of millions of television viewers, and Jia’s wife also appeared on television declaring her “happy” state of mind (Fewsmith 2001: 226). After these appearances, rumors of Jia’s removal or his forced divorce from his wife dissipated, and Jia was promoted to the Standing Committee at the Sixteenth Party Congress. Although Jia survived mainly because of Jiang’s dominating influence in the regime, Zhu also did not press the case against Jia very hard. Had Wei Jianxing been in charge of the investigations, he may have pressed the case much harder in order to diminish Jiang’s influence in the runup to the Sixteenth Party Congress.
鸳华案对于江对军队和公安的权力巩固来说被证明是一次巨大成功。此案导致解放军军事情报负责人吉胜德、公安部副部长兼国家打私办负责人李继洲，以及数百名地方海关、警察和行政官员被捕（Straits Times 2000）。然而，人们普遍认为贾庆林的妻子乃至贾庆林本人可能在鸳华的薪酬名单上，因为贾的妻子在鸳华势力最盛时期曾掌管福建的对外贸易（Straits Times 2000）。尽管笼罩着怀疑的阴影，江在北京进行视察时在数百万电视观众面前与贾手挽手表示团结，贾的妻子也出现在电视上宣称自己“很高兴”（Fewsmith 2001: 226）。在这些露面之后，关于要撤掉贾或迫使贾与妻子离婚的谣言消散，贾在十六大上被提升为常委。 尽管贾主要是因为江在政权中的主导影响而幸免，朱也并未对贾大力追究。如果当时由魏建兴负责调查，他可能会更严厉地追究，以削弱江在十六大前夕的影响力。
In addition to cracking down on smuggling, Zhu also served as the lead negotiator with the PLA over compensation for divesting army businesses. Even officers loyal to Jiang only agreed to the massive divestiture of PLA businesses on condition of generous increases in the military budget (Mulvenon 2001). Likely with Jiang’s support, Zhu succeeded in giving the military only modest enlargement in spending in exchange for the divestiture (Mulvenon 2001). Furthermore, Zhu handled the transfer of PLA businesses to civilian control through the SETC, Zhu’s bureaucratic powerbase (Mulvenon 2001). By the end of 1998, local and central economic and trade offices had handled the transfer of over 200 billion yuan in PLA assets, and more were transferred in 1999 (Yang 2004: 137). This made the SETC an even more powerful agency, which undoubtedly provided Zhu with additional political capital.
除了打击走私之外，朱还担任与解放军就剥离军队商业利益赔偿问题的首席谈判代表。即便是忠于江的人也仅在获得大幅增加军费的条件下才同意大规模剥离解放军企业（Mulvenon 2001）。在很可能得到江支持的情况下，朱成功地以剥离为交换，仅让军队在支出方面获得了适度的扩张（Mulvenon 2001）。此外，朱通过作为其官僚权力基础的对外经济贸易部（SETC）将解放军企业移交给文官控制（Mulvenon 2001）。到 1998 年底，地方和中央的经济与贸易办事机构已处理了超过 2000 亿元人民币的解放军资产移交，1999 年又有更多资产被移交（Yang 2004: 137）。这使得 SETC 成为一个更有权力的机构，毫无疑问为朱提供了额外的政治资本。
Because of Zhu’s crucial role in Jiang’s effort to dominate the army, centralized finance continued into the new millennium. Nonetheless, Zhu was under increasing pressure to raise sluggish growth rate and to enhance SOE
由于朱在江主导军队事务中的关键作用，集中化的财政体制延续到了新千年。尽管如此，朱面临着越来越大的压力，需要提高停滞的增长率并增强国有企业的...
profitability. Instead of decentralization, Zhu used even more top-down measures to affect the policy of “two prevents, one encourage” (liangfang yisu): prevent financial risk, prevent deflation, and encourage economic growth (Secretariat of PBOC Monetary Policy Committee 2000c). First, the PBOC issued decrees in 1999 ordering banks to raise lending to small and medium enterprises, the main victims of recent banking policies (Secretariat of PBOC Monetary Policy Committee 2000b). Furthermore, the PBOC released a controlled amount of relending funds to rural credit cooperatives to bolster rural lending (Secretariat of PBOC Monetary Policy Committee 2000c). The central government also increased liquidity in the economy through massive spending financed by bond issuances, which banks eagerly bought at no risk in lieu of making loans (Dai 2002b). Despite these measures, lending in 2000 and 2001 still saw some of the slowest growth rates since the reform (Figure 8.1). 32 32 ^(32){ }^{32}
盈利能力。朱镕基并没有选择下放权力，而是采取了更多自上而下的措施来实施“两防一促”（liangfang yisu）政策：防范金融风险、防止通货紧缩、促进经济增长（PBOC 货币政策委员会秘书处 2000c）。首先，人民银行于 1999 年发布法令，要求银行增加对中小企业的放贷，这些企业是近期银行政策的主要受害者（PBOC 货币政策委员会秘书处 2000b）。此外，人民银行向农村信用合作社发放了受控额度的再贷款资金，以支持农村信贷（PBOC 货币政策委员会秘书处 2000c）。中央政府还通过以国债发行融资的大规模支出来增加经济中的流动性，银行为回避风险热衷于购买这些国债，而不是发放贷款（Dai 2002b）。尽管采取了这些措施，2000 年和 2001 年的贷款增长率仍然是改革以来最慢的时期之一（图 8.1）。 32 32 ^(32){ }^{32}

A "Well-Off Society"  “全面小康”

By 2002, however, Jiang Zemin had fully consolidated his power and was growing impatient with Zhu’s strict monetary policy, especially given that the Sixteenth Party Congress was on the horizon. Because Jiang was slated for retirement in the fall Sixteenth Party Congress, he hoped for a faster pace of growth in 2002 and 2003 to seal his legacy and to ensure top positions for his followers after the congress. At the end of January 2002, Jiang used his “inspection” of Beijing as an opportunity to unleash some familiar phrases from the Dengist arsenal: “Beijing completely has the conditions to develop faster and better. I hope that Beijing grasp the opportunity, face the new challenge…” (People’s Daily 2002). He also introduced the phrase “a well-off society” (xiaokang shehui) into the party’s lexicon as the official slogan of the upcoming party congress.
然而到 2002 年，江泽民已完全巩固了自己的权力，并且对朱镕基的严格货币政策日益不耐烦，尤其是考虑到第十六次党代会在即。因为江在秋季的第十六次党代会上将届退位，他希望在 2002 和 2003 年实现更快的增长，以巩固自己的政治遗产并确保大会后其追随者获得高位。2002 年 1 月底，江以视察北京为契机，释放出一些来自邓小平策略库的熟悉措辞：“北京完全有条件发展得更快、更好。我希望北京把握机遇，面对新的挑战……”（《人民日报》2002）。他还把“小康社会”一词引入党内话语，作为即将召开的党代会的官方口号。
Jiang’s hand was further strengthened by the January 2002 removal of Zhu protégé and Construction Bank president Wang Xuebing on charges of corruption (Pottinger 2002). Although Wang’s removal was triggered by an investigation by the U.S. Treasury Department, Jiang used this occasion to press his advantage. At the February 2002 Central Finance Conference, Zhu was forced to engage in a lengthy criticism of Wang Xuebing, which was tantamount to a self-criticism (Beijing Xin Bang Investment & Consulting Ltd 2002C). In the meantime, Jiang set about dismantling five years of centralized finance. Jiang began his remarks at the Central Finance Conference with Dengist exhortations: “In the new century, our country is entering a new developmental stage of comprehensively constructing a well-off society and speeding up of socialist modernization” (Jiang 2006e). Although paying lip-service to vigilance against financial risks, Jiang argued that the mutual dependence between banks and firms should motivate banks to lend more freely: "Only when banks fully demonstrate their financial role and increase their support of enterprises and economic development can they increase the efficiency of enterprises and improve their ability
江的权力因 2002 年 1 月因腐败指控被罷免的朱的门生、建设银行行长王学兵而进一步巩固（Pottinger 2002）。尽管王学兵的被罢免是由美国财政部的调查触发，江利用这一契机扩大了自己的优势。在 2002 年 2 月的中央财经会议上，朱被迫对王学兵进行长时间的批评，这在实质上等同于一次自我批评（北京新邦投资咨询有限公司 2002C）。与此同时，江着手拆解五年来的中央集权式财政。在中央财经会议的开场发言中，江以邓小平式的劝勉开头：“在新世纪，我们国家正进入全面建设小康社会、加快推进社会主义现代化的新发展阶段”（Jiang 2006e）。 尽管口头上宣称要提防金融风险，蒋指出，银行与企业的相互依赖应促使银行更宽松地放贷：“只有当银行充分发挥其金融职能并加大对企业和经济发展的支持，才能提高企业的效率并增强它们的能力
Figure 17: figure 8.1. Percentage Change in Quarterly Lending and Change in Inflation from One Year Ago: 1997-2006. Source: Quarterly Database; see Appendix for detail. Unlike similar graphs in previous chapters, this graph plots total loans rather than just state bank loans. The PBOC stopped reporting loans outstanding for state banks in 2002.
图 17：图 8.1。季度贷款同比百分比变化与通货膨胀同比变化：1997–2006。资料来源：季度数据库；详见附录。与前几章类似图表不同，本图绘制的是贷款总额，而不仅仅是国有银行贷款。PBOC 于 2002 年停止公布国有银行未偿贷款数据。
to repay loans . . . only in this way can we realize sustained economic growth" (Jiang 2006e). As the first vertical line in Figure 8.1 reveals, this speech had an immediate effect, as growth in bank loans jumped to above 20 percent by the end of the first quarter in 2002 - the first time it had done so since the mid-i99os.
偿还贷款……只有这样我们才能实现持续的经济增长”（Jiang 2006e）。正如图 8.1 中的第一条垂直线所示，这次讲话立即产生了影响，银行贷款增长在 2002 年第一季度末跃升至 20%以上——这是自 1990 年代中期以来的首次。
On May 31, Jiang further articulated the “well-off society” line in a speech at the Central Party School: “Development needs new thinking; reform needs new breakthroughs, and opening needs new situation”(Editors 2002). Because the students at the Central Party School were all rising political stars in various provinces and ministries, words of Jiang’s speech quickly spread. Local governments in many regions immediately gathered local banking officials and urged them to “regard development as a first priority” with NPL prevention presumably a second priority (Financial Times 2002a; 2002e). PBOC technocrats also realized the political significance of the speech. Days after Jiang’s speech, PBOC regional branches in Shenyang, Jinan, Wuhan, and Xi’an ordered banks within their jurisdictions to heed Jiang’s speech and to simplify lending procedures (Financial Times 2002d).
5 月 31 日，江在中央党校的一次讲话中进一步阐述了“小康社会”路线：“发展需要新思路；改革需要新突破，开放需要新局面”（Editors 2002）。由于中央党校的学员都是来自各省和各部委的冉冉升起的政治新星，江的讲话迅速传播开来。许多地区的地方政府立即召集当地的银行官员，敦促他们“把发展放在首位”，不良贷款防范大概成为第二位的优先事项（Financial Times 2002a；2002e）。中国人民银行的技术官僚也意识到了这次讲话的政治意义。在江的讲话几天后，中国人民银行沈阳、济南、武汉和西安分行下令其管辖范围内的银行遵照江的讲话精神，简化贷款程序（Financial Times 2002d）。
As the Sixteenth Party Congress approached, local governments began to reestablish channels of communication with and policy influence over local financial institutions with the formation of financial offices (jinrongban). Financial offices, which were spearheaded by Shanghai and Beijing in late 1999, initially aimed at helping the local PBOC and state bank branches to limit
随着十六大临近，各地政府开始通过设立金融办（jinrongban）重新建立与地方金融机构的沟通渠道并恢复对其政策影响力。金融办由上海和北京于 1999 年底率先推动，最初旨在帮助地方人民银行和国有银行分支机构限制
nonperforming loans and to enforce repayment from debtors (Wang and Wang 2003). These offices were led by the vice mayor or vice governor in charge of finance and held regular meetings with local state bankers and PBOC officials. As the political atmosphere shifted, these financial offices, which spread rapidly in 2002 and 2003, quickly evolved into forums for pressuring banks to lend to local enterprises and projects (Economic Observation News 2003). The Hebei Financial and Securities Office, for example, explicitly told banks to “change their attitude and fully support the development of small and medium enterprises and support the objective needs of local development” (Office of the Hebei Financial Securities Work Leading Group 2003). The Yueyang City Financial Office in Hunan hand-picked some forty enterprises and presented them to local state bank branches at a bank-business conference. Within two days, these enterprises signed over 400 million yuan in loan agreements with banks (Financial Times 2002c, 2003).
不良贷款并向债务人追偿（Wang and Wang 2003）。这些办公室由主管财政的副市长或副省长领导，并定期与地方国有银行和中国人民银行官员召开会议。随着政治氛围的变化，这些在 2002 和 2003 年迅速扩散的金融办公室很快演变为向银行施压、要求其向地方企业和项目放贷的论坛（Economic Observation News 2003）。例如，河北省金融证券办明确要求银行“转变观念，全力支持中小企业发展，支持地方发展的现实需要”（Office of the Hebei Financial Securities Work Leading Group 2003）。湖南岳阳市金融办从中精心挑选了约四十家企业，并在一次银企大会上把它们推荐给当地国有银行分支机构。两天内，这些企业与银行签署了超过 4 亿元人民币的贷款协议（Financial Times 2002c, 2003）。
The November 2002 Sixteenth Party Congress fully endorsed the drive toward building a “well-off society” as the main goal of the party. Zhu Rongji, who had successfully maintained centralized financial control since 1995, ended his career with investment and lending slipping out of central control. Although the Sixteenth Party Congress saw the retirement of Jiang Zemin from the President and the Party Secretary General positions, Jiang continued to hold the powerful chairmanship of the Central Military Commission, and his core followers, including Huang Ju, Jia Qinglin, Wu Bangguo, and Zeng Qinghong, gained entries into the Standing Committee. Thus, local officials felt confident about accelerating economic growth. The developmental euphoria even pervaded central ministries. Ministry of Transportation, for example, originally had a highway construction target of 80,000 kilometers by 2020 , but after the Sixteenth Party Congress, it almost doubled the target to 150,000 kilometers by 2020 (Beijing Xin Bang Investment & Consulting Ltd 2002a).
2002 年 11 月召开的十六大全面认可以建设“全面小康社会”为党的主要目标。自 1995 年起成功维持中央财政控制的朱镕基，在任期结束时出现了投资和放贷脱离中央控制的局面。尽管十六大后江泽民卸任国家主席和党总书记职务，但他依然掌握着强大的中央军委主席一职，他的核心追随者包括黄菊、贾庆林、吴邦国和曾庆红等进入了常委。因此，地方官员对加快经济增长充满信心。这种发展狂热甚至蔓延到中央各部委。例如，交通运输部原定到 2020 年完成 8 万公里的公路建设目标，但十六大之后，该目标几乎翻倍至到 2020 年 15 万公里（北京新邦投资咨询有限公司 2002a）。
More surprisingly, even bank regulators and bankers who had focused on trimming bad debt just months earlier fully supported using financial institutions to aid local economic development. This once again demonstrates that local officials and central technocrats alike responded to the same elite political signals. Two days after the Sixteenth Party Congress, the Central Finance Work Commission (CFWC), the backbone of Zhu’s banking centralization, sent out an announcement urging bankers to “guarantee that the financial sector will support the construction of the well-off society” (Central Finance Work Commission 2002). Whereas the CFWC is a party organization, even technocrats speaking at specialized financial meetings counseled bankers to increase lending to support growth (Financial Times 2002b).
更令人惊讶的是，甚至那些几个月前还专注于削减不良债务的银行监管者和银行家，也完全支持利用金融机构来帮助地方经济发展。这再次表明，地方官员和中央技术官僚都对相同的精英政治信号作出反应。十六大召开两天后，朱的银行集中化核心——中央金融工作委员会（CFWC）发出一则公告，敦促银行业“确保金融部门支持建设小康社会”（Central Finance Work Commission 2002）。虽然中央金融工作委员会是一个党组织，但即便是在专门的金融会议上发言的技术官僚也劝告银行家增加放贷以支持增长（Financial Times 2002b）。
When Wen Jiabao - Zhu’s right-hand man who had overseen the financial sector - succeeded Zhu in 2003, the “well-off society” drive was beginning to exert a familiar effect on the economy. Both money supply (M2) and total lending had year-to-year growth of above 20 percent by the end of 2002, whereas the year-to-year growth of lending had been less than 15 percent previously (Figure 8.1). This rate of increase was sustained throughout 2003 (Figure 8.1).
当时负责金融领域、朱镕基的得力助手温家宝于 2003 年接替朱镕基时，“小康社会”建设开始对经济产生一种熟悉的影响。到 2002 年底，货币供应量（M2）和总贷款的同比增长均超过 20%，而此前贷款的同比增长一直低于 15%（见图 8.1）。这一增长速度在 2003 年全年持续保持（见图 8.1）。
Meanwhile, growth in fixed asset investment reached a ten-year high of 31 percent in the first half of 2003 (Xu and Xiao 2003). As in the early 1990s, the skylines of Chinese cities were quickly covered by building cranes, and new industrial parks, entertainment centers, shopping malls, and luxury apartments sprouted up overnight. Investment rocketed ahead despite the fact that severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS) had spread to several major cities in China in the spring of 2003 , stifling consumption and investment. Both Chinese and Western financial experts agreed that had it not been for SARS, money supply and lending would have expanded even more (Cheng and Liu 2003; Kyne and Wonacott 2003; Reuters 2003).
与此同时，固定资产投资在 2003 年上半年达到了 31%的十年高点（Xu and Xiao 2003）。如同 1990 年代初，中国城市的天际线上很快被建筑升降机覆盖，新建的工业园区、娱乐中心、购物中心和豪华公寓如雨后春笋般出现。尽管 2003 年春季严重急性呼吸综合征（SARS）已蔓延至中国数个大城市，抑制了消费和投资，投资仍然迅猛增长。中外金融专家一致认为，如果不是 SARS，货币供应和贷款本可增长得更多（Cheng and Liu 2003; Kyne and Wonacott 2003; Reuters 2003）。
Because of SARS and because of China’s surplus economy, inflation did not increase rapidly, although it reached its highest level for several years (Figure 8.1). In the spring of 2003 , the PBOC carried out a few mild maneuvers to slow the growth of money supply, including raising reserve requirement by I percent and selling central-bank bills. In December, the PBOC further increased the interest rate for banks’ excess reserve, again another minor adjustment (People’s Bank of China 2004). Although the PBOC has moved toward more moderate adjustments as opposed to the major crackdowns of the previous inflationary cycles, the gentleness of these adjustments also reflected the lack of political will to slow lending and investment. Lending continued to grow at a rate above 20 percent into 2004.
由于 SARS 以及中国的顺差经济，通货膨胀并未迅速上升，尽管达到了数年来的最高水平（图 8.1）。2003 年春季，中国人民银行采取了一些温和的操作以放缓货币供应增长，包括将存款准备金率提高 1 个百分点并出售央行票据。12 月，人民银行又上调了银行超额准备金利率，这同样是另一项小幅调整（People’s Bank of China 2004）。虽然人民银行已倾向于采取较为温和的调整，而不是以往通胀周期中的大规模严厉打击，这些温和调整也反映出缺乏遏制贷款与投资的政治意愿。贷款增长率在 2004 年仍维持在 20% 以上。

Politics and Retrenchment
政治与收缩

For 2004, the PBOC had optimistically hoped for a money supply growth rate of 17 percent and lending increase of 15.3 percent (People’s Bank of China 2004). However, the first quarter in 2004 saw money supply growth of 19 percent, while lending grew by 21 percent. The fastest loan expansion took place in Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Shanghai, and Shandong, most of which were provinces governed by Jiang followers. In sectoral terms, investment grew especially fast in steel, automobile, and real estate (People’s Bank of China 2004). 33 33 ^(33){ }^{33} With unprecedented monetary expansion, why couldn’t the central bureaucracy mobilize another monetary retrenchment?
2004 年，PBOC 曾乐观地希望货币供应增长率为 17%，贷款增长为 15.3%（中国人民银行 2004）。然而，2004 年第一季度货币供应增长为 19%，贷款增长为 21%。贷款扩张最快的地区是江苏、浙江、广东、上海和山东，这些大多数由江派支持者治理的省份。按行业划分，投资在钢铁、汽车和房地产领域增长尤其快速（中国人民银行 2004）。 33 33 ^(33){ }^{33} 在如此前所未有的货币扩张下，中央官僚体系为何无法再推进一次货币收缩？
The first and foremost reason was that inflation did not climb to alarming levels, nor was there any crisis on the horizon. Unlike the previous monetary cycles, inflation only rose to 2.8 percent at the end of the first quarter in 2004. At the same time, the rapid expansion of Chinese export lifted both growth and the foreign exchange reserve. However, this low inflation rate belied a torrential increase in fixed asset investment and reckless lending. Politically, another reason for a hesitant response to the rapid rise in money supply was an elite division over the proper monetary policy. Jiang’s faction of mostly local officials did not wish to see a sudden contraction in money supply, whereas
首要原因是通货膨胀并未上升到令人警觉的程度，也不存在迫在眉睫的危机。与此前的货币周期不同，通货膨胀在 2004 年第一季度末仅上升到 2.8%。与此同时，中国出口的快速扩张提升了增速和外汇储备。然而，这一低通货膨胀率掩盖了固定资产投资的激增和肆无忌惮的放贷。在政治上，对货币供应量快速上升采取谨慎应对的另一个原因是精英之间就适当的货币政策存在分歧。江派以大多数地方官员为主，不希望看到货币供应的突然收缩，而…
the central bureaucrats under Premier Wen Jiabao wanted tougher measures toward lending. The new Party Secretary General Hu Jintao also sided with Wen because local governments, particularly on the prosperous east coast, were still dominated by Jiang followers. All of this came to a head when Secretary General Hu Jintao and Premier Wen Jiabao finally mobilized a part of the central bureaucracy to crack down on lending in the eastern provinces, although their efforts were stymied by recalcitrant local officials and factional rivals in the central government.
温家宝总理麾下的中央官僚希望在信贷方面采取更严厉的措施。新的党总书记胡锦涛也站在温的一边，因为地方政府，尤其是东部沿海的富裕地区，仍然由江派追随者主导。所有这些在胡锦涛总书记和温家宝总理最终动员中央部分官僚机构对东部各省的信贷进行打压时达到了顶点，尽管他们的努力被顽固的地方官员和中央政府内的派系对手所阻挠。
In the summer of 2003, the new Hu Jintao-Wen Jiabao leadership attempted to leverage the popularity the new leadership had gained from successfully handling the SARS crisis to deal an early blow to the Shanghai Gang, composed of Jiang followers. However, the probe into Shanghai real estate tycoon Zhou Zhengyi, who reputedly had close connections with both past and present Shanghai officials, ground to a halt when Jiang appointed Vice Premier and former Shanghai Party Secretary Huang Ju as the leader of the investigations (Lam 2004a). Because of the failure of this early attempt at undoing the Shanghai gang, investment continued unimpeded. At the March 2004 National People’s Congress meeting, Jiang Zemin, Vice Premier Huang Ju, and the serving Shanghai party secretary Chen Liangyu held a meeting where Jiang urged Shanghai officials to “continually improve the livelihood of the people… and effectively promote development, which is the first task of a ruling party” (Ding 2004). Huang Ju, who was then the vice premier in charge of finance, also endorsed this view to a group of Guizhou officials: “Grasp the opportunity, use the opportunity, and speed up the pace of development” (Xinhua News Agency 2004a). In contrast, Premier Wen - echoing Chen Yun’s cautious attitude - urged a group of Jiangsu officials to: “…start from reality, conduct affairs according to objective laws, combine enthusiasm to move forward with a knowledge of one’s actual strength, and do not blindly compare oneself with others…” (Xinhua News Agency 2004a).
2003 年夏天，新一届胡锦涛—温家宝领导层试图利用在成功应对 SARS 危机中获得的人气，对以上海帮（由江氏追随者组成）进行一次早期打击。然而，对据称与上海前任及现任官员都有密切关系的上海地产大亨周正毅的调查在江任命时任上海市委书记、后升任国务院副总理的黄菊为调查组组长后陷入停滞（Lam 2004a）。由于这次早期解除上海帮的尝试失败，投资得以继续不受阻碍。在 2004 年 3 月的人大会议上，江泽民、国务院副总理黄菊以及时任上海市委书记陈良宇会面，江敦促上海官员“不断改善人民生活……切实促进发展，发展是执政党的首要任务”（Ding 2004）。 时任主管金融的副总理黄菊也向一批贵州官员赞同这一观点：“把握机遇、利用机遇、加快发展步伐”（新华社 2004a）。相对而言，总理温家宝——呼应陈云的谨慎态度——则督促一批江苏官员：“……从实际出发，按照客观规律办事，把推进的热情同清楚自己的实际情况相结合，不要盲目与人比较……”（新华社 2004a）。
With April lending and investment still growing at a fast pace and inflation slowly creeping upward, Premier Wen Jiabao decided to copy a political maneuver from his predecessor; he made an example of several local leaders. The target of this exercise was Tieben Steel in Changzhou City in Jiangsu, just a few miles from Jiang Zemin’s birthplace. City governments in Changzhou and Yangzhong had approved Tieben’s proposed steel foundry, which required over ro billion yuan in investment and some 6,54 mou (around x , ooo x , ooo x,ooo\mathrm{x}, \mathrm{ooo} acres) of land. 34 34 ^(34){ }^{34} A project of this size required approval from the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) - the offspring of SPC - as well as the Ministry of Land and Resources, but the city governments approved the project on their own (People’s Daily 2004). After a Politburo meeting in which excessive investment had been the main topic of discussion, Wen launched a well-publicized investigation into this affair and punished a sleuth of city
随着四月份贷款和投资仍保持快速增长，通货膨胀缓慢抬头，温家宝总理决定复制其前任的一项政治手腕；他以若干地方领导人为例予以惩戒。此次行动的目标是位于江苏常州市的铁本钢铁，距离江泽民的出生地仅数英里。常州和扬中市政府曾批准铁本拟建的钢铁铸造厂，该项目需投资超过 20 亿元人民币，并占用约 6,540 亩土地（约 x , ooo x , ooo x,ooo\mathrm{x}, \mathrm{ooo} 英亩）。 34 34 ^(34){ }^{34} 该规模的项目需要国家发展和改革委员会（NDRC——原属国家计划委员会）以及国土资源部的审批，但市政府自行批准了该项目（人民日报，2004）。在一次以过度投资为主要议题的政治局会议之后，温发起了对该事件的广泛调查并处罚了多名市级
and local banking officials (Xinhua News Agency 2004b). The investigation revealed that local branches of the state banks lent over 4 billion yuan to this project under heavy pressure from the local government (Wu 2004).
及地方银行官员（新华社，2004b）。调查显示，国有银行的地方分行在地方政府的强大压力下向该项目发放了超过 40 亿元的贷款（吴，2004）。
In concert with the Tieben crackdown, the Central Banking Regulatory Commission (CBRC), an agency controlled by Wen loyalist Yan Haiwang, issued a circular ordering banks to suspend lending in the runup to the May First holiday in order to limit investment and inflation in April. However, the elite consensus on retrenchment was tenuous. Within two days of issuing these instructions, the CBRC backtracked and claimed that the order was merely a “guidance” for banks to slow lending (Wonacott 2004). Despite elite level disputes, Wen’s Tieben crackdown managed to bring year-to-year growth in lending back to below the 20 percent level by the third quarter of 2004 .
与铁本（Tieben）整肃同时，由温派忠诚分子阎海旺掌控的中央银行监管委员会（CBRC）发布通告，要求银行在“五一”假期前暂停放贷，以限制四月份的投资和通货膨胀。然而，关于收缩政策的精英共识并不牢固。CBRC 在发出这些指示两天内又收回，并声称该命令只是督促银行放缓贷款的“指导意见”（Wonacott 2004）。尽管高层存在争议，温的铁本整肃仍成功使贷款的同比增长在 2004 年第三季度回落到 20%以下。
The Shanghai faction, however, did not give up so easily, especially when inflation remained at historically low levels. At a July 2004 Politburo meeting, Shanghai party secretary Chen Liangyu openly disputed Wen’s retrenchment policies, arguing that they would slow growth in eastern China (Lam 2004b; Wang 2004). Presumably with the backing of Jiang and Vice Premier Huang Ju, Chen went as far as to warn Wen that he would bear “political responsibility” for slowing growth with retrenchment policies (Fong 2004). Although investment and lending slowed in 2005, the lack of clear elite consensus on monetary policy saw the renewal of high speed investment at the beginning of 2006. Although lending grew at 18 percent, fixed asset investment grew by 30 percent for the first half of 2006. In Jilin, Anhui, and Henan, growth in urban fixed asset investment registered an astonishing 50-plus percent growth rates in the same period (Liu 2006). The mild monetary adjustments during the first half of the year, including increases in interest rates and reserve requirement, clearly failed to slow the torrential growth in investment. On July 25, Premier Wen held a State Council meeting, at which he announced a series of policy changes to restrict real estate investment (Xinhua News Agency 2006a). At the beginning of August, the NDRC ordered a halt of all investment projects above roo million yuan if they violated existing regulations (China Commercial Times 2006).
然而，上海派并未轻易放弃，尤其是在通货膨胀仍处于历史低位时。2004 年 7 月的一次政治局会议上，上海市委书记陈良宇公开反对温的紧缩政策，认为这些政策会放缓中国东部的增长（Lam 2004b；Wang 2004）。据推测，在江及副总理黄菊的支持下，陈甚至警告温，如果用紧缩政策导致增长放缓，他将承担“政治责任”（Fong 2004）。尽管 2005 年投资和放贷有所放缓，但由于精英在货币政策上缺乏明确共识，2006 年初又出现了高速投资复苏。上半年贷款增长 18%，而固定资产投资首次达到 30%的增长。同期吉林、安徽和河南的城镇固定资产投资增长率竟超过 50%（Liu 2006）。年上半年包括提高利率和提高存款准备金率在内的温和货币调整，显然未能遏制投资的汹涌增长。 7 月 25 日，温家宝总理主持召开国务院会议，宣布了一系列限制房地产投资的政策调整（新华社 2006a）。8 月初，国家发改委下令，凡违反现行法规的、金额超过一亿元人民币的所有投资项目一律停止（中国商报 2006）。
As with the Deng-Chen alliance in the late 1970s, the intersecting political interests of the emerging generalist faction headed by Hu Jintao and the technocrats led by Wen allowed them to cooperate in a retrenchment campaign in 2006. For Hu Jintao, he sought to remove the residual influence of his predecessor in the runup to the 2007 Seventeenth Party Congress. Meanwhile, Premier Wen aimed at regaining central control over money supply and investment. The tactic they agreed on was a familiar one: an anticorruption sweep. Fully aware that real estate development was a great source of corruption, the Hu-Wen alliance first made an example of a few vice provincial level officials, including Vice Governor He Minxu of Anhui, Tianjin’s lead procurator Li Baojin, and Vice Mayor Liu Zhihua of Beijing. All of them were accused of taking bribes in exchange for securing land for real estate developers. In August 2006, Wen Jiabao also ordered the governor of Inner Mongolia, Yang Jing,
与 1970 年代末的邓陈联盟类似，新兴的以胡锦涛为首的通才派与以温家宝为首的技术官僚派在政治利益上的交集使得他们能够在 2006 年合作发动一场收缩运动。对胡锦涛而言，他在为 2007 年十七大做准备时，寻求清除其前任的残余影响。与此同时，温总理的目标是重新夺回对货币供应和投资的中央控制权。他们达成的战术是一个熟悉的做法：反腐肃贪行动。深知房地产开发是腐败的重要来源，胡温联盟首先拿几位副省级官员作了典型，包括安徽省副省长何敏旭、天津市首席检察官李宝金和北京市副市长刘志华。他们均被指控收受贿赂以为房地产开发商争取土地。2006 年 8 月，温家宝还下令内蒙古自治区省长杨晶，
to write a self-criticism for allowing the completion of a banned power plant (Xinhua News Agency 2006b).
写检讨，承认自己在允许一个被禁电厂完工一事上的错误（新华社 2006b）。
These disciplinary actions turned out to be mere preamble to the main crackdown: the unraveling of a web of corruption centered in Shanghai, the powerbase of the Jiang faction. In July 2006, a team of CDIC investigators descended on Shanghai and quickly arrested the chief of the Shanghai Social Security Bureau Zhu Junyi. Zhu was the most senior Shanghai official placed under arrest since the 1980s. The investigation focused on the misappropriation of 3.2 billion yuan from the Shanghai social security fund to finance the privately owned infrastructure firm Fuxi Investment founded by entrepreneur Zhang Rongkun. Zhang bribed senior Shanghai officials to obtain loans from the social security fund, which he used to acquire shares of state-owned enterprises and leases to operate Shanghai infrastructure (Chen 2006). Following Zhu Junyi’s down-fall, the CDIC team proceeded to detain a series of Shanghai officials and entrepreneurs, including Wang Chengming - the chairman of the state-owned Shanghai Electric -, Zhang Rongkun himself, Chen Liangyu’s former private secretary Qin Yu, and the chairman of the state-owned Xinhuangpu Corporation Wu Minglie (Zuo 2006). Both Qin Yu and Wu Minglie maintained close ties with Shanghai party secretary and Politburo member Chen Liangyu.
这些纪律处分不过是主要打击行动的序幕：对以上海为中心、江派势力根基的一张腐败网络的瓦解。2006 年 7 月，一支来自 CDIC 的调查小组来到上海，迅速逮捕了上海社会保障局局长朱俊义。自 1980 年代以来，朱是被捕的级别最高的上海官员。调查集中在将 32 亿元人民币的上海社会保障基金挪用于为企业家张荣坤创办的民营基础设施公司富熙投资提供资金的问题上。张通过贿赂上海高层官员，从社会保障基金获得贷款，用于收购国有企业股份和经营上海基础设施的租约（Chen 2006）。在朱俊义垮台后，CDIC 小组继续拘留了一系列上海官员和企业家，包括国有企业上海电气董事长王成明、张荣坤本人、陈良宇的前私人秘书秦雨，以及国有新黄浦公司的董事长吴明烈（Zuo 2006）。 秦禹和吴明列都与上海市委书记、政治局委员陈良玉保持着密切关系。
With the rising crescendo of rumors about Chen Liangyu’s impending arrest, he tried to save himself by vowing to thoroughly cleanse the Shanghai government of corruption (Chen 2006). However, mounting evidence against Chen Liangyu collected by the CDIC team and cooperation by a former core member of the Shanghai faction - Vice President Zeng Qinghong - ultimately forced Jiang and Huang Ju to abandon Chen Liangyu (Kahn 2006). On September 25, central investigators stunned all of China by detaining Chen Liangyu on suspicion of corruption. With the Chen arrest, both Hu and Wen’s political interests were served. Much as Jiang had consolidated his control through the Chen Xitong investigation, Hu sent an unambiguous signal of his authority through Chen Liangyu’s arrest. As Jiang and Huang Ju were unable to protect their Politburo-level protégé, they signaled their waning power in the face of rising Hu dominance. For Premier Wen, this arrest was a triumphant moment after suffering Chen Liangyu’s humiliating criticism at the July 2004 Politburo meeting. More important, Chen’s arrest signaled to local officials that they could no longer exploit the division between Hu and Jiang in order to ignore central restrictions against investment. If the center was determined enough to remove a Politburo member, it could easily remove a Central Committee-level provincial leader.
随着关于陈良玉即将被捕的谣言愈演愈烈，他试图通过誓言彻底清除上海政府的腐败来自救（Chen 2006）。然而，中省纪委调查小组收集到对陈良玉不利的越来越多证据，以及上海派系前核心人物——副主席曾庆红的配合，最终迫使江泽民和黄菊放弃了陈良玉（Kahn 2006）。9 月 25 日，中央调查人员以涉嫌腐败的理由扣押了陈良玉，震动了全中国。随着陈良玉被捕，胡锦涛和温家宝的政治利益都得到了维护。正如江泽民通过调查陈希同巩固了自己的控制权一样，胡锦涛通过陈良玉被捕发出了他权威的明确信号。由于江泽民和黄菊无法保护这位政治局级的亲信，他们在面对胡锦涛日益上升的主导地位时，显示出权力的衰退。对温家宝而言，这次逮捕是在 2004 年 7 月政治局会议上遭受陈良玉羞辱性批评后的一个胜利时刻。 更重要的是，陈的被捕向地方官员发出了信号：他们不能再利用胡与江之间的分歧来无视中央对投资的限制。如果中央决心如此强烈以致能罢免一名政治局成员，那么同样可以轻易罢免一名中央委员会级别的省级领导。
Although Chen Liangyu’s downfall marked a moment of victory for the Hu-Wen leadership, past experience suggests that temporary unity augurs divergent opinions over monetary policy in the future. As Hu Jintao fills provincial leadership posts with his own followers from the Communist Youth League, he increasingly will favor decentralized finance. Meanwhile, Premier Wen Jiabao, who will likely serve another term as premier, will continue to prefer centralized
尽管陈良宇的垮台标志着胡温领导层的一次胜利，但过往经验表明，暂时的团结预示着未来在货币政策上会出现分歧。随着胡锦涛在省级领导岗位上安插来自共青团的追随者，他将越来越倾向于分权化的金融政策。与此同时，可能连任国务院总理的温家宝将继续偏好中央集权的
finance. There is yet little reason to believe that the factional logic of monetary swings will cease to apply to China.
金融。尚无充分理由相信货币政策摆动的派系逻辑将不再适用于中国。

Conclusion  结论

As with previous retrenchment drives, a perceived economic crisis again gave the technocratic faction the upper hand. Although the Asian Financial Crisis was an external crisis that had little direct impact on China, Premier Zhu mobilized the State Council bureaucracy to link the crisis to China, allowing him to impose an unprecedented degree of central control over the financial sector. Although his action was not prompted by a decentralization campaign launched by the generalist faction, it sought to preempt such a campaign. As a result of the centralization policies, state-owned commercial banks finally operated as unified entities without interference from local governments. This period of centralization was further prolonged by Jiang Zemin’s reliance on Zhu to aid his consolidation of power over the military through antismuggling sweeps and the divestiture of PLA businesses. Had Zhu not been a credible politician, Jiang would not have needed to rely on Zhu, and would have pursued decentralization policies sooner than he did.
与以往的紧缩行动一样，一场被认为是经济危机的事件再次使技术官僚派占据上风。尽管亚洲金融危机是一个对中国几乎没有直接冲击的外部危机，朱总理还是动员国务院官僚体系将该危机与中国联系起来，从而使他得以对金融部门施加前所未有的中央控制。尽管他的作为并非由全能派发起的分权运动所促成，但其目的是先发制地主动阻止此类运动。由于中央集权政策，国有商业银行最终作为统一实体运作，不再受到地方政府的干预。江泽民依靠朱来通过打击走私和剥离解放军企业来巩固对军队的控制，这进一步延长了这一集中化时期。若朱不是一位有信誉的政治家，江就不必依赖朱，也会比实际更早地实施分权政策。
With the consolidation of Jiang’s power toward the end of his term as party secretary general, however, he launched a drive to decentralize financial control to the local level in order to galvanize support for his faction in the runup to the Sixteenth Party Congress. The consequence - rapid growth in lending and investment - created macroeconomic imbalance that the new leadership had to confront immediately on taking power. In order to effectively carry out retrenchment in the face of uncontrolled investment and recalcitrant local officials, the new dominant generalist faction and the technocrats formed a temporary alliance to remove Hu’s rivals and to implement financial centralization.
然而，随着江在其任期末期作为党中央总书记权力的巩固，他发起了一项将金融控制下放到地方的运动，以在十六大前夕为其派系争取支持。其后果——信贷和投资的快速增长——造成了新领导层上台后必须立即应对的宏观经济失衡。为在失控的投资和顽固的地方官员面前有效实施收缩，新兴的主导概括派系（generalist faction）与技术官僚结成了临时联盟，以肃清胡的对手并实施金融集中化。
Banking policies also exhibited a familiar pattern in the contemporary period, although China had much greater capacity to write-off banking losses. Under Premier Zhu, state banks implemented a series of measures to digest NPLs and to check the growth of new NPLs. Rather than accompanying these impressive changes with further measures, such as interest rate liberalization and the legalization of private banks, Zhu imposed planning-era lending targets and priorities on the banking sector to save ailing SOEs, which effectively decreased the efficiency of capital allocation in China. Because of the factional imperatives, he was reluctant to transform the financial sector. Premier Wen likewise left the state-dominated banking sector unchanged, except that China’s ballooning foreign exchange reserve was used to write-off NPLs. The factional framework argues that top leaders in the Chinese political system endorsed policies that enhanced the power of their respective factions rather than those that promoted purely economic goals. As this chapter has shown, Chinese leaders - both generalists and technocrats - continued to pursue this primary goal into the new millennium.
在当代时期，银行政策也呈现出类似的模式，尽管中国在核销银行损失方面具备更大的能力。在朱镕基任期内，国有银行实施了一系列措施以消化不良贷款并遏制新增不良贷款的增长。但朱并未将这些显著变化与进一步措施配套推进，例如利率放开和私人银行合法化；相反，他将计划经济时代的信贷目标和优先顺序强加于银行部门以挽救陷入困境的国有企业，这实际上降低了中国资本配置的效率。出于派系利益的考量，他不愿彻底改造金融部门。温家宝总理同样保持了以国家为主导的银行业格局，唯一不同的是中国不断膨胀的外汇储备被用来核销不良贷款。派系框架认为，中国政治体系的最高领导人支持那些增强其各自派系权力的政策，而非仅仅促进纯粹经济目标的政策。如本章所示，无论是泛政务型领导人还是技术官僚，中国领导人都在进入新千年后继续追求这一首要目标。

Concluding Discussion  结论性讨论

The two contingent future paths for China’s economy are both embedded in its financial sector. On the one hand, extremely rapid financial deepening accompanied by relatively stable prices drives a vigorous growth trajectory that will one-day make China the world’s largest economy. On the other hand, the colossal store of nonperforming loans in the banking sector augurs stagnant growth and even an economic collapse. This study argued that China’s elite political dynamic has played an important role in fashioning the foundation of both outcomes.
中国经济的两条或然性未来路径都植根于其金融部门。一方面，伴随价格相对稳定的极为迅速的金融深化，会推动强劲的增长轨迹，从而有朝一日使中国成为世界上最大的经济体。另一方面，银行部门庞大的不良贷款存量预示着增长停滞甚至经济崩溃。本研究认为，中国精英的政治动态在构建这两种结果的基础方面发挥了重要作用。
The persistent tension between generalist factions and technocratic factions engendered a credible constraint against high inflation. On the one hand, the generalist factions comprised mainly of local officials favored financial decentralization, which increased inflationary pressure since provincial leaders competed with one another to boost investment and, thus, lending and monetary expansion in their respective jurisdictions. On the other hand, central technocrats, whose power depended on accomplishing monumental tasks for the regime, had an interest to centralize financial authorities in order to finance major undertakings. The divergent policy preferences of these two types of factions meant that each sought to take advantage of both economic and political conditions to implement their preferred financial policies.
普通派派系与技术官僚派系之间持续的紧张关系对高通货膨胀形成了一个可信的约束。一方面，由地方官员为主的普通派倾向于财政分权，这增加了通货膨胀压力，因为省级领导人相互竞争以推动投资，从而在各自的管辖权内促进信贷和货币扩张。另一方面，中央技术官僚的权力依赖于为政权完成重大任务，他们有意集中金融权力以资助重大工程。这两类派系的政策偏好分歧意味着各自会利用经济和政治条件来推行其偏好的金融政策。
Because party generalists commanded authorities that allowed them to set the agenda in the elite decision process, under normal economic conditions, they could enact their favored policy of decentralizing financial authorities to the provinces. However, central technocrats were powerful politicians in their own right and were able to leverage their authorities to force generalists to delegate financial control to them. High inflation or other economic crises in particular provided moments of opportunities to do so. In the reform era, central technocrats took advantage of both domestic inflationary crises and international financial shocks to accomplish their preferred outcome of financial centralization. Because the technocratic factions possessed the political leverage to sustain centralization policies, these policies were credible and sustainable. This elite
由于党内通才掌握的权力使他们能够在精英决策过程中制定议程，在正常经济状况下，他们可以推行自己偏好的政策——将金融权力下放到省级。然而，中央技术官僚本身也是强有力的政治人物，能够利用他们的权力迫使通才将金融控制权让渡给他们。尤其是在高通胀或其他经济危机时期，这类时刻为他们提供了这样做的机会。在改革时期，中央技术官僚利用国内的通胀危机和国际金融冲击，来实现他们偏好的金融中央化结果。由于技术官僚派系拥有维持中央集权政策的政治杠杆，这些政策具有可信性并且可持续。此一精英
dynamic, in combination with the CCP’s continual iron grip on the financial sector, saved China from the woes of high inflation. This work has demonstrated this logic through both quantitative analysis and qualitative case studies covering China’s reform era monetary cycles. The results reveal a picture of elite conflicts that gave rise to monetary upswings and retrenchments.
动态性与中共对金融部门持续的铁腕控制相结合，使中国免于高通货膨胀的困扰。本研究通过定量分析和关于中国改革时期货币周期的定性案例研究展示了这一逻辑。研究结果呈现出一幅精英冲突导致货币扩张与收缩交替的图景。
At the same time, the pervasive influence of the CCP in the financial sector also tied the fate of banks to the ebbs and flow of factional politics and doomed the banking sector to persistent political intervention. Although particular financial outcomes or control over the banking sector were not the ultimate objectives of factional politics, the banking sector became an important means of political survival in China. With its vast store of money from increasingly prosperous depositors, the banking sector became a victim of its own success as the party leadership - both generalists and technocrats - increasingly saw banks as a bountiful source of political resource. Although the Chinese leadership willingly liberalized other sectors of the economy, the enormous pool of savings in the banking sector made it an indispensable policy and political instrument. Despite some impetus to reform the banking sector, the political elite’s need for a highly fungible policy and political resource - money - led to a persistent reluctance to liberalize the banking sector beyond state control. Banking policies were made to bolster the short-term strength of both generalist and technocratic factions with little regard to long-term consequences.
与此同时，中国共产党在金融领域的广泛影响也把银行的命运绑在了派系政治的起伏上，使银行业注定长期遭受政治干预。虽然具体的金融结果或对银行业的控制并非派系政治的最终目标，但银行业成为了中国政治生存的重要手段。随着储户日益富裕、存款规模巨大，银行业成为自身成功的牺牲品：党内领导——既有通才也有技术官僚——越来越将银行视为丰厚的政治资源来源。尽管中国领导层愿意放开其他经济部门的管制，但银行业中巨额的储蓄使其成为不可或缺的政策与政治工具。尽管存在推动银行业改革的动力，政治精英对一种高度通用的政策与政治资源——资金的需求，导致他们长期不愿将银行业的控制彻底放开。 银行政策被制定用以增强一般派和技术官僚派在短期内的实力，而几乎不顾及长期后果。

The Pressure of Globalization and Reform Impetus
全球化压力与改革动力

Although a book on the financial policies of a developing country usually includes prescriptions for needed changes, this work proposes no policy prescription. Foreign experts, international institutions, and private investors have already provided a flood of policy recommendations to the Chinese government about needed reforms in the financial sector. I doubt that I have anything to add in this regard. If anything, my advice is directed toward those who try to reform the Chinese financial system through providing consultation. This study suggests that their effort is likely to only produce cosmetic changes on the banking sector because financial policies are ultimately governed by an internal political logic that pays scant attention to external opinions. Although an exogenous economic or political shock may one day transform the Chinese financial system, the source of that shock is unlikely to be an ideational one. After all, Chinese policy makers have known all along how to commercialize the banking sector. They simply lacked the incentive to do so, and no amount of talk will change that fact.
虽然一本关于发展中国家金融政策的著作通常会给出所需变革的政策建议，但本书并不提出任何政策处方。外国专家、国际机构和私人投资者已经向中国政府提供了大量关于金融部门改革的政策建议。我怀疑在这方面我还有什么可补充的。如果有建议的话，更多是针对那些试图通过提供咨询来推动中国金融体系改革的人群。本研究表明，他们的努力很可能只会在银行部门带来表面化的变化，因为金融政策最终由一种忽视外部意见的内部政治逻辑所支配。尽管外生的经济或政治冲击有朝一日可能会改变中国的金融体系，但那种冲击的来源不太可能是观念层面的。毕竟，中国的政策制定者从一开始就知道如何使银行业商业化。只是他们缺乏这样做的激励，而任何空谈都无法改变这一事实。
If banking sector reform is tied to top leaders’ short-term interest, what can motivate reform in China’s banking sector? Increasing foreign participation in the Chinese market and the general rise of China in the world constitute important sources of reform. As foreign investment and exports become an ever larger part of China’s economy, even short-sighted politicians and bureaucrats can ill afford to undermine foreign investors’ confidence in the long-term
如果银行业改革与最高领导人的短期利益相关，是什么能激励中国银行业的改革？外国在中国市场参与度的增加以及中国在世界上的总体崛起构成了重要的改革动因。随着外商投资和出口成为中国经济越来越大的一部分，即便是目光短浅的政治家和官僚也难以承受破坏外国投资者对经济长期
well-being of the economy (Maxfield 1997). Already, China has increased efforts to clean up the banking sector and to shore up its budget partly to assure foreign investors that China remains a stable destination of investment (Jiang 2006g). Although this concern is still balanced by the need to mobilize the banking sector to finance various policy demands, it has brought about some improvement in transparency and commercialization. It is worthwhile to note, however, that efforts to clean up the banks have mainly come in the form of massive capital injections rather than structural reform. Because of China’s rising budgetary income and trade surplus, these fixes have been largely painless for all parties involved.
稳定的信心（Maxfield 1997）。中国已经加大了整顿银行业和强化财政的力度，部分目的是向外国投资者保证中国仍然是一个稳定的投资目的地（Jiang 2006g）。尽管这种顾虑仍需与动员银行业为各种政策需求提供资金的需要相平衡，但它确实带来了一些透明度和商业化方面的改善。不过值得注意的是，整顿银行的努力主要以大规模注资的形式出现，而非结构性改革。由于中国不断上升的财政收入和贸易顺差，这些修补对所有相关方来说在很大程度上都比较无痛。
In the long run, foreign acquisition of minority stakes in the Big Four state banks might provide impetus for fundamental banking reform. As things stand, however, foreign investors control less than a 25 percent share of most Chinese banks. The vast majority of shares are still controlled by state holding companies or by the Ministry of Finance. Although the injection of over 2.5 trillion yuan (approximately U.S. $ 325 $ 325 $325\$ 325 billion) into the Big Four banks produced historically low NPL ratios, it is extremely doubtful that the state banks are in reality operating as fully commercialized entities (International Finance Times 2006). With bureaucratic masters exerting influence as major shareholders, elite politicians can continue to intervene in the banks. Meanwhile, foreign investors at most can protest the political intervention in the banks. They possess far too few shares to exercise vetoes. Although foreign pressure may generate meaningful changes in the long run, foreign investors have yet to show any willingness to confront the government over banking issues.
从长远看，外资收购四大国有银行的少数股权可能为根本性的银行改革提供动力。然而，按现状，外资在大多数中国银行中的持股不足 25%。绝大多数股权仍由国有控股公司或财政部控制。尽管向四大银行注入了超过 2.5 万亿元（约合美国 $ 325 $ 325 $325\$ 325 十亿美元）使得不良贷款率降至历史低位，但这些国有银行实际上是否已完全商业化运作仍极其成疑（International Finance Times 2006）。由于具有官僚背景的主控股东施加影响，精英政治人物仍可继续干预银行。同时，外资至多只能对银行中的政治干预提出抗议。它们持股远不足以行使否决权。尽管外部压力可能在长期内带来有意义的变化，但外资迄今尚未显示出在银行问题上愿意与政府对抗的意愿。
Reform motivated by foreign investment, moreover, has its limit because foreign investors ultimately do not rely on Chinese banks for their funds. Thus, foreign investors’ demand on the Chinese government is simply that it provide a stable macroeconomic environment and not necessarily that it create a fully commercialized banking sector. Moreover, many seasoned foreign investment bankers working in China count on insider access to rent-seeking opportunities as their main sources of profit. For example, most foreign investors of China’s nonperforming loan market prefer closed negotiations with the government to open auction as a means of acquiring nonperforming loans (Shih, Huang, and Lee 2005). Other foreign investment banks seek to gain a competitive edge by hiring children of past and current senior officials - the princelings - to facilitate business (Collier 2004). Rather than reforming the Chinese banking sector, foreign banks in that environment are forced to invest in political ties rather than better services.
此外，受外资驱动的改革也有其局限性，因为外资最终并不依赖中国银行体系提供资金。因此，外资对中国政府的要求仅仅是提供稳定的宏观经济环境，而不必然要求建立一个完全商业化的银行部门。此外，许多在华的资深外资投资银行家将获取内线渠道的寻租机会作为主要利润来源。例如，中国不良贷款市场的大多数外资投资者更倾向于与政府进行封闭谈判以获取不良贷款，而不是通过公开拍卖（Shih, Huang, and Lee 2005）。其他外资投资银行则通过雇用过往和在任高级官员的子女——太子党——来获取竞争优势以促进业务（Collier 2004）。在这种环境下，外资银行被迫投资于政治关系，而非改进服务。
Although some have placed their hope on China’s membership in the World Trade Organization (WTO) as a catalyst for fundamental reform, the findings of this study suggest that this expectation may prove disappointing. To be sure, WTO membership will increase trade and foreign investment, which put pressure on the Chinese government to increase transparency and to maintain a certain degree of macroeconomic stability. However, the entry of foreign banks into the Chinese market by itself is unlikely to induce any significant changes.
尽管有人寄希望于中国加入世界贸易组织（WTO）能成为推动根本性改革的催化剂，本研究的发现表明这种期待可能会令人失望。可以肯定的是，加入 WTO 将增加贸易和外国投资，这会迫使中国政府提高透明度并维持一定程度的宏观经济稳定。然而，外国银行进入中国市场本身不太可能引发任何重大变化。
Already, the Chinese government has decreed a number of regulations that hinder foreign banks’ ability to make a profit, all of which allowable under the national treatment clause of the WTO. I I  ^("I "){ }^{\text {I }} If the Chinese government needs to, it can decree even more regulations that make banking in China totally unprofitable for foreign banks. The major state banks can survive without any profit - and they have - but foreign banks cannot do so.
中国政府已颁布若干限制外国银行盈利能力的法规，而这些法规都在 WTO 的国民待遇条款允许范围内。如果中国政府需要，它可以制定更多法规，使外国银行在中国经营完全无利可图。主要国有银行可以在没有任何利润的情况下生存——而且确实如此——但外国银行无法做到这一点。
A possible source of genuine reform is increasing private sector participation in the policy process, which would increase the influence of the most significant beneficiary of banking reform.
