Despite the rapidly growing role of the domestic private sector in the economy, the private sector continues to have a difficult time obtaining financing from the formal banking sector. The emerging private sector, especially small and medium enterprises, would benefit greatly from fundamental reform that gives rise to a truly competitive banking sector. Unfortunately, the private sector is barely represented in the Chinese Communist Party. Since the 1980s, private entrepreneurs have lobbied the local governments to allow the formation of informal financial institutions to circumvent the confining state banking system. In fact, instances of “financial chaos” suppressed by the PBOC often were local attempts to liberalize interest rates or to form alternative financial institutions. Their influence on the local policy process, however, has not translated to a significant presence in national politics. The Sixteenth Party Congress in 2002 formally allowed private entrepreneurs to join the CCP, but it would presumably be a long time before a major private sector figure becomes a senior politician in China. If the National People’s Congress (NPC) increases its power to appoint and dismiss senior officials, private entrepreneurs can potentially influence the policy process through their participation in the NPC, a much more likely venue of political participation than promotion through the CCP ranks. Closer linkage between private entrepreneurs and policy makers, however, may just produce more rent-seeking and corruption. Already, both the Yuanhua smuggling case and the Shanghai real estate scandal show that private entrepreneurs are prone to use influence over officials for private gains rather than to lobby for policy changes. Of course, this phenomenon may itself be a function of the dearth of institutional channels for interest group lobbying.
真正改革的一个可能来源是私营部门在政策制定过程中的参与增加，这将增强银行改革最大受益者的影响力。尽管国内私营部门在经济中迅速壮大，但私营部门从正规银行体系获得融资仍然十分困难。新兴私营部门，尤其是中小企业，将大大受益于能够催生真正有竞争性的银行体系的根本性改革。不幸的是，私营部门在中国共产党内几乎没有代表性。自 20 世纪 80 年代以来，私人企业家一直游说地方政府允许设立非正规金融机构，以规避受限的国有银行体系。实际上，中国人民银行镇压的“金融混乱”事件往往是地方上放开利率或设立替代性金融机构的尝试。然而，他们在地方政策过程中的影响并未转化为在国家政治中的重要存在。 2002 年的十六大正式允许私营企业家加入中共，但要等到主要的私营部门人物成为中国的高级政治家，可能还需要很长时间。如果全国人民代表大会（人大）增强了任免高级官员的权力，私营企业家就有可能通过他们在人大中的参与影响政策过程——这比通过中共党内的晋升更可能成为政治参与的渠道。然而，私营企业家与决策者的更紧密联系可能只会带来更多的寻租和腐败。早在袁华走私案和上海房地产丑闻中就已经显示，私营企业家更倾向于利用对官员的影响谋取私利，而不是为了游说改变政策。 当然，这种现象本身可能也是利益集团游说的制度性渠道匮乏的结果。
To be sure, the combination of increasingly knowledgeable banking professionals and the abundance of financial resources at the state’s disposal has produced ample cosmetic changes in the financial sector. China has gone as far as mobilizing its vast foreign exchange reserve to recapitalize its ailing banks. However, in the short and medium term, there is no strong reason to believe
可以肯定的是，越来越有知识的银行专业人员与国家可支配的充足金融资源相结合，确实在金融领域带来了大量表面性的变化。中国甚至动用了其庞大的外汇储备来对濒临困境的银行进行资本充实。然而，从短期和中期来看，没有充分理由相信
that the bulk of the financial sector will evolve beyond state control or that the state itself will undertake to privatize much of the financial sector. As experience from around the world tells us, fundamental change will most likely require a severe economic shock that the current system cannot handle or a major realignment of the political system.
金融部门的大部分会脱离国家控制发展，或国家本身会着手将金融部门的大部分私有化。正如世界各地的经验告诉我们的那样，根本性变革最有可能需要一个当前体制无法应对的严重经济冲击，或是政治体制的重大重新排列。

Power in Authoritarian Regimes
权力在威权政体中的运作

In examining the political motives behind financial policies, this work has developed a fairly complete account of elite factional politics in China. In addition to explaining financial outcomes, a more general application of this framework also sheds light on power struggle in authoritarian regimes in general and factional politics in China.
在考察金融政策背后的政治动机时，本研究构建了一个相当完整的中国精英派系政治的论述。除了对金融结果的解释外，这一框架的更一般性应用也有助于阐明威权政体中的权力斗争以及中国的派系政治。
The starting point of this framework is that factions divide into different types - generalist and specialist - depending on the career trajectories of the factional patron. Although this book mainly concerns the interaction between generalist factions and a particular subset of specialist factions - technocratic factions - there are in reality other kinds of specialist factions. Just as technocratic factions are mainly endowed with members and resources from the economic bureaucracy, other kinds of specialist factions are endowed with resources in their respective xitongs, or bureaucratic groupings, including propaganda, organization, internal security, and the military (Lieberthal 2004: 218). Furthermore, the various specialist factions lie on a continuum according to their ability to bargain with generalist factions. At one extreme, army factions have great bargaining power with the dominant civilian faction since they control the ultimate arbiter of power. Historically, army factions, such as those headed by Lin Biao and Ye Jianying, had great influence over the selection of civilian leaders. Yet, unless a senior army figure also had close ties with provincial leaders and senior cadres in the central party organs, army factions remained specialist factions. Nonetheless, out of all the specialist factions, an army faction has the most potential of becoming a generalist faction and of vying for ultimate control of the CCP. Chairman Mao, for one, orchestrated the purges of several army leaders, including Gao Gang, Peng Dehuai, and Lin Biao, for fear of their rising status (MacFarquhar and Schoenhals 2006). At the other extreme, the head of the education bureaucracy likely has far less bargaining power.
该框架的出发点是宗派可根据宗派首脑的职业轨迹分为不同类型——通才派和专才派。尽管本书主要关注通才派与特定子集的专才派——技术官僚派之间的互动，但现实中还有其他类型的专才派。正如技术官僚派主要由来自经济官僚体系的成员和资源构成，其他类型的专才派则在各自的系统（即官僚集团）中拥有资源，包括宣传、组织、内部安全和军队（Lieberthal 2004: 218）。此外，各种专才派在与通才派讨价还价的能力上构成一个连续体。在一端，军队派由于掌控最终的权力仲裁者，因而对占主导地位的文官派具有很强的讨价还价能力。历史上，以林彪和叶剑英为首的军队派在文官领导人的遴选上具有重大影响力。 然而，除非一位高级军方人物同时与省级领导人和中央党机关的高级干部保持密切联系，否则军队派系仍维持为专业派系。然而，在所有专业派系中，军队派系最有可能转变为通才派系并争夺中共的最终控制权。就拿毛主席来说，他曾为了防范他们地位上升而策划清洗了若干军队领导人，包括高岗、彭德怀和林彪（MacFarquhar and Schoenhals 2006）。在另一极端，教育系统的首脑很可能拥有的博弈筹码要小得多。
If one is to analyze Chinese politics from a factional perspective, the main selectorates in the system would be the patrons of the various specialists and generalist factions. 2 2 ^(2){ }^{2} Selectorates are defined as "the set of people whose endowments include the qualities or characteristics institutionally required to choose
如果要从派系视角来分析中国政治，体制内的主要择选群体将是各专业和通才派系的赞助人。 2 2 ^(2){ }^{2} 择选群体被定义为“其赋予的资质或特征在制度上被要求用于作出选择的那一群人”
the government’s leadership and necessary for gaining access to private benefits doled out by the government’s leadership" (Bueno de Mesquita et al. 2003: 42). The dominant generalist faction constructs a winning coalition out of a mix of both specialist and generalist factions, each with their own weight in the elite selection process (Bueno de Mesquita et al. 2003: 8). For the incumbent leader the head of the dominant generalist faction - the ability to distinguish between colleagues who can directly challenge one’s power and those who cannot is likely crucial. Because specialist factions can only withdraw support, a sidepayment in the form of money, promotion, or policy concession is sufficient to maintain their support. By contrast, it is much harder to trust a generalist colleague, even if this person has shown great loyalty in the past. Unless there is some way of allowing generalist colleagues to credibly demonstrate their loyalty, an incumbent leader must live in fear of a potential coup because other generalists have sufficient connections and resources across the regime to overthrow the incumbent.
“政府领导层并且有助于获得由政府领导层分配的私利”（Bueno de Mesquita 等，2003：42）。占主导地位的一般派系通过将专才派系和一般派系混合起来构建一个获胜联盟，二者在精英遴选过程中各自具有自身的分量（Bueno de Mesquita 等，2003：8）。对于现任领导人——即占主导地位的一般派系的首脑——能够区分那些能直接挑战其权力的同僚与那些不能的同僚，可能至关重要。由于专才派系只能撤回支持，以金钱、晋升或政策让步形式的边际支付足以维持他们的支持。相比之下，即便某位一般派同僚过去表现出极大的忠诚，也很难对其产生信任。除非存在使一般派同僚能够可信地表明其忠诚的某种方式，否则现任领导人必须担心潜在的政变，因为其他一般派拥有足够的关系和资源遍布政权各处，足以推翻现任者。
If every member of the winning coalition has the capacity to replace the incumbent, the leader is likely to live in constant fear of a coup (Wintrobe 1998: 20). Additionally, this situation would compel authoritarian leaders to pursue suboptimal policies. First, the leader would become extremely suspicious of everyone around him or her, which results in a highly repressive regime or a regime that seeks to pay off key members of the selectorate at the expense of the general economy (Bueno de Mesquita et al. 2003; Wintrobe 1998). Second, there could be a war of attrition between various factions during an economic crisis that delays fixes indefinitely (Alesina and Drazen 1995). Third, the winning coalition might dissolve as a result of a competition between its members to incorporate new social classes into the winning coalition (Ramseyer and Rosenbluth 1998). 3 3 ^(3){ }^{3} In the reform era, China has largely avoided these disastrous outcomes - at least from the perspective of the regime. 4 4 ^(4){ }^{4}
如果执政联盟的每个成员都有能力替换现任领导人，领导人很可能会不断惧怕政变（Wintrobe 1998: 20）。此外，这种情况会迫使威权领导人采取次优政策。首先，领导人会对身边的所有人极度怀疑，导致高度压制性的政权，或者导致政权以牺牲总体经济为代价，向选拔圈中的关键成员进行回报（Bueno de Mesquita et al. 2003；Wintrobe 1998）。其次，在经济危机中，各派之间可能发生消耗战，从而无限期地拖延问题的解决（Alesina and Drazen 1995）。第三，执政联盟可能因其成员之间为了将新的社会阶层纳入执政联盟而发生竞争而解体（Ramseyer and Rosenbluth 1998）。在改革时期，中国在很大程度上避免了这些灾难性的后果——至少从政权的角度来看是如此。
The interaction between the dominant generalist faction and the technocratic faction suggests that the key to this stability is a symbiotic relationship between the dominant generalist faction and various specialist factions. For the incumbent generalist, he or she does not have to worry about direct challenges from the specialists in the winning coalition. At their worst, they would withdraw their support, but given their initial endowment, specialist factions do not seek ultimate power but instead seek to enrich their respective bureaucratic groupings. There are divergent policy preferences and clashes over policy disputes - as this work has shown - but the incumbent leader can buy specialists off with more resources and policy concessions. Although both Deng and Jiang disagreed with the central bureaucracy on monetary policy, they were willing to concede to the central bureaucracy in exchange for support during crucial
占主导地位的全能派与技术官僚派之间的互动表明，稳定的关键在于主导性的全能派与各类专门派系之间的共生关系。对于在位的全能派领导人来说，他或她无需担心来自获胜联盟中专门派系的直接挑战。最严重的情况也只是这些派系撤回支持，但鉴于它们最初的资源禀赋，专门派系并不追求最终掌权，而是寻求壮大各自的官僚群体。正如本书所展示的，存在分歧的政策偏好和围绕政策争端的冲突——但在位领导人可以通过提供更多资源和政策让步来收买专门派系。尽管邓小平和江泽民在货币政策上与中央官僚机构意见不合，但他们愿意为在关键时刻获得支持而向中央官僚机构让步。
political fights against opponents from within the regime. By many indicators, Hu Jintao also made a similar pact with Premier Wen Jiabao. Thus, despite the at times fierce contests over specific policies between the incumbent generalist and various specialists, they ultimately do not seek to destroy each other. We even observe specialist factions lending support to the dominant generalists at crucial moments. In contrast, other generalists endowed with a follower network across the party and the military - even if they have shown past loyalty are in the position to usurp the incumbent’s power. The potential of a coup launched by other generalists is a constant source of worry for the incumbent generalist.
针对政权内部对手的政治斗争。按照许多指标，胡锦涛也与温家宝总理达成了类似的默契。因此，尽管在具体政策上在任的一般派与各类专才之间有时存在激烈的争论，但他们最终并不寻求互相摧毁。我们甚至观察到专才派别在关键时刻会对占主导地位的一般派提供支持。相比之下，另一些在党内和军中拥有追随者网络的一般派――即便他们过去表现出忠诚――却有可能篡夺在任者的权力。由其他一般派发动政变的可能性，始终是对在任一般派的一个持续忧虑来源。
Although specialists at times cooperated with the dominant generalist only in order to secure policy autonomy, resources, and promotions, this willingness to support the dominant faction has engendered relatively stable authoritarianism in China. There is every reason to think that this dynamic also applies to other authoritarian regimes. In order for this stabilizing dynamic to take hold, a subset of senior officials must be able to signal their inability to usurp the power of the incumbent leader. Here, a developed bureaucracy facilitates a subset of the elite to signal their specialist role. That is, in a tinpot regime with minimal bureaucracy, every member of the junta seems a potential coup plotter because they all have similar experience in the military. In contrast, in a highly bureaucratized regime like China, the incumbent leader can more easily observe which members of the regime have dedicated their careers to specialized tasks and which members have built up extensive connections across the regime. With a specialized bureaucracy, the leader can further observe how sincere his or her colleagues are at being specialists. That is, if a self-proclaimed specialist is doing a poor job at leading a group of bureaucracies, perhaps he or she is instead spending time building connections across the regime. The dictator would then have reason to be suspicious. By being able to distinguish between generalists and specialists, the dictator can construct a more stable winning coalition composed mainly of specialist factions. The existence of specialized bureaucracies also allows a subset of the elite to invest away from general resources toward a specialization in order to credibly signal their intention to disengage from the competition for ultimate power (Spence 1973). In the Chinese case, it was clear that Zhou Enlai, who had served as party secretary general, intentionally abandoned his connections in the party in favor of cultivating resources in the economic and diplomatic bureaucracies in order to put Mao at ease of his intention.
尽管专家有时只为保障政策自主、资源和晋升而与占主导地位的通才合作，但这种支持主导派系的意愿已经促成了中国相对稳定的威权统治。有充分理由认为，这种动力也适用于其他威权政体。要使这种稳定化动力生效，必须有一部分高层官员能够表明他们无力篡夺在位领导人的权力。在这里，发达的官僚体系使得一部分精英能够表明自己是担任专门职能的人。也就是说，在一个官僚机构薄弱的小国政权中，军政府的每个成员都因具有类似的军旅经历而看起来可能是政变密谋者。相比之下，在像中国这样高度官僚化的政权中，现任领导人更容易分辨出哪些成员把事业奉献给了专门性的任务，哪些成员在整个政权中建立了广泛的人脉。有了专业化的官僚机构，领导人还能进一步判断同僚作为专家的诚意程度。 也就是说，如果一个自称为专才的人在领导一组官僚机构时表现不佳，或许他/她实际上是在花时间在政权内部建立人脉。独裁者因此有理由产生怀疑。通过能够分辨通才与专才，独裁者可以构建一个更稳定的胜利联盟，主要由专才派系组成。专门化的官僚机构的存在也使一部分精英能够将投资从通用资源转向某一专门化，以便可信地表明他们打算退出争夺最终权力的竞争（Spence 1973）。 在中国的例子中，很明显周恩来曾任党总秘书， 有意放弃在党内的人脉，转而在经济和外交官僚机构培养资源，以使毛对他的意图放心。
This stabilizing dynamic can exert substantial impact on regime survivability. For one, instead of engaging in a war of attrition with rival factions during a crisis, the dominant generalist faction can safely delegate crisis management to a specialist faction, knowing that it has no design to usurp the incumbent’s power. The case of financial politics in China reveals that although policy delegation can be costly for the ruler, he or she can delegate without losing power, as long as specialists receive satisfying payoffs. This on average increases a regime’s ability to deal with crises and thus strengthens its survivability. With the existence of
这种稳定的动态会对政权的存续产生重大影响。首先，在危机中，主导的通才派系可以不用与敌对派系耗尽对抗，而是放心地将危机管理委托给专才派系，因为它知道后者无意篡夺现任者的权力。中国金融政治的案例表明，尽管政策委托对统治者可能代价高昂，但只要专才获得令人满意的回报，统治者就可以在不失权的情况下进行委托。这平均而言提高了政权应对危机的能力，从而增强了其存续性。由于存在
specialist factions, rival generalist factions further have less need to incorporate new social groups into the selectorate. Rather, they can expend political capital to woo the various specialist factions. The restricted bidding provides more stability and longevity to the regime.
专才派系，敌对的通才派系进一步减少了将新社会群体纳入选择者池的需要。相反，他们可以动用政治资本去拉拢各类专才派系。这种有限的竞标为政权提供了更多稳定性和更长的寿命。
The distinction between generalists and specialists can also shed light on the debate in the China field about the elite political equilibrium. In Nathan’s (1973) seminal article and in subsequent articulation of the theory (Nathan and Tsai 1995), he argues that the transaction costs of maintaining a faction renders total domination by a faction unsustainable. Thus, the resulting balance of power produces a code of civility among the factions. Tsou’s well-known rebuttal argues that the equilibrium in elite politics in China is often total victory by the dominant faction (Tsou 1976, 1995). Thirty years after the publication of Nathan’s original article, the debate persists (Dittmer 1995). The persistence of this debate is in large part a result of instances of both total domination and balance of power in the CCP’s history, making it difficult to empirically assess the merits of these two claims.
通才与专才之间的区别也能为中国研究领域关于精英政治均衡的争论提供启示。在 Nathan（1973）的开创性文章以及随后对该理论的表达（Nathan 和 Tsai 1995）中，他认为维持一个派系的交易成本使得某一派系的完全统治不可持续。因此，所产生的力量平衡在各派系之间形成了一种礼让规范。邹（Tsou）著名的反驳认为，中国精英政治的均衡往往是由占主导地位的派系的彻底胜利（Tsou 1976, 1995）。在 Nathan 原文发表三十年后，这一争论仍然存在（Dittmer 1995）。这一争论长期存在在很大程度上是因为中国共产党历史上既有完全统治的例子，也有力量平衡的例子，使得对这两种观点的实证评估变得困难。
Work by Huang (2000) suggests that succession politics in the CCP induced consolidation cycles in which periods of consolidation were followed by periods of competition and seeming balance of power. The problem faced by the incumbent leaders was that in order to ensure regime survival and postretirement influence, they needed to cultivate younger leaders who possessed all the qualifications of a successful leader. However, these qualities also made this person a viable threat to the incumbent leader (Huang 2000: 19). In fact, as a leader approached death or retirement, he likely faced several factions led by aspiring helmsmen. Although succession competition between several aspiring factions gave the incumbent leader more latitude to balance them against one another, he could not be sure that one of them would not preemptively take power.
Huang (2000) 的研究表明，中共的接班人政治会引发整合周期：一段整合期之后是竞争期和看似的权力平衡。在位领导人面临的问题是，为了确保政权存续和退休后的影响力，他们需要培养具备所有成功领导人资格的年轻接班人。然而，这些素质也使得该接班人成为对在位领导人的现实威胁（Huang 2000: 19）。实际上，随着领导人临近死亡或退休，他很可能面临由多个有抱负的舵手领导的派系。尽管数个有抱负的派系之间的接班竞争让在位领导人在派系之间进行制衡时拥有更大回旋余地，但他无法确定其中不会有某个派系先发制人夺取权力。
This work adds to this discussion by introducing specialist factions to the latent competition between incumbent generalist factions and their aspiring successors, which are also generalist factions. The introduction of specialist factions provides a mechanism whereby the rising generalist faction can consolidate power without engaging in a prolonged struggle with rival factions. Essentially, as the succession looms on the horizon, various specialist factions must make a decision about whom to back in order to maximize the resources available to their respective bureaucratic groupings. Likewise, rival generalist factions decide on how much payoff to promise specialist factions and even other generalist factions. Again, without specialist factions, a generalist faction which wins in one round always has to wonder whether the other generalists in the winning coalition would revolt in a subsequent round. This situation would give rise to constant elite distrust and competition which may result in a balance of power. However, the existence of powerful specialist factions without design for overall control allows the victorious generalist faction to consolidate power without constantly worrying about potential usurpers in subsequent rounds. Because specialist factions only want more resources and power for
本文通过引入专业派系，丰富了在现任通才派系与其有抱负的继任者（同样为通才派系）之间潜在竞争的讨论。专业派系的出现提供了一种机制，使得上升的通才派系可以在不与对手派系进行长期斗争的情况下巩固权力。本质上，随着接班临近，各种专业派系必须决定支持谁，以便最大化其各自官僚集团可获取的资源。同样，竞争的通才派系也要决定向专业派系乃至其他通才派系承诺多少回报。同样地，如果没有专业派系，在一轮中获胜的通才派系始终要担心胜利联盟中的其他通才派系是否会在后续轮次中起义。这种情况会导致持续的精英不信任和竞争，并可能导致势力均衡。 然而，强大的专科医生派系若并未谋求对整体的控制，就会使胜出的通才派系能够巩固权力，而无需在随后的回合中不断担忧潜在的篡位者。因为党内专业派系只想要更多的资源和权力以便
their own bureaucracies, they calculate which generalist faction can maximize their expected payoff. As the outcome of the political struggle between generalists becomes clear, specialist factions bandwagon around the likely winner.
他们自己的官僚机构，会计算哪个通才派系可以最大化其预期收益。随着通才之间政治斗争的结果变得明朗，专才派系便会跟随可能的赢家。
What does this understanding of elite Chinese politics suggest for China’s future? This understanding of elite politics explains the relative stability of Chinese authoritarianism compared with tinpot dictatorships in other developing countries. As a result of the highly bureaucratized nature of the CCP and the state apparatus, senior leaders can specialize in a narrow set of policies and signal credibly their inability to challenge the incumbent leader. This creates a higher expectation of coordination rather than zero-sum competition in elite policy making. To the extent that the Chinese government is becoming more specialized over time (Yang 2004), it creates opportunities for senior officials to signal their “type” to the incumbent leader. Over time, as senior officials increasingly rise up through specialized bureaucracies rather than through the army, it also becomes easier for them to credibly signal their specialist roles.
这种对中国精英政治的理解对中国的未来有何启示？这种精英政治的理解解释了中国威权体制相对于其他发展中国家那些小规模独裁政权的相对稳定性。由于中共和国家机构高度官僚化，高级领导人可以在一小部分政策领域内专业化，并可信地表明他们无法挑战现任领导人。这在精英决策中创造了更多协调预期，而不是零和竞争。随着中国政府随着时间推移变得更加专业化（Yang 2004），高级官员有机会向现任领导人传达他们的“类型”。随着高级官员越来越多地通过专业化的官僚体系而非通过军队晋升，他们也更容易可信地表明自己的专业角色。
For members of the revolutionary generation, it was difficult for them to signal their specialist role because the prolonged revolutionary struggle in which they partook often endowed them with a wide range of connections across the regime. Thus, Mao’s wide-ranging purges of his colleagues during the Cultural Revolution in part stemmed from Mao’s suspicion of the rich store of connections enjoyed by members of the revolutionary generation. With the rapid promotion of technocrats into the senior ranks of the Party since 1978, fewer senior leaders have the extensive connections necessary to compete for ultimate power. The promotion of cadres with technical background to senior positions, however, does not spell the end of elite competition. Because of factional politics, senior leaders continue to cultivate potential successors by intentionally rotating them to a wide range of local and central posts. These budding generalists eventually acquire wide-ranging connections across the regime and begin to distrust each other.
对于革命一代的成员来说，他们很难通过标示自己为“专门人员”来表明角色，因为他们参与的长期革命斗争往往赋予他们在政权内部广泛的人脉联系。因此，毛在文化大革命中对同僚的大规模清洗，部分源于他对革命一代成员所享有的丰富人脉的怀疑。自 1978 年以来，技术官僚迅速晋升到党内高级层级，较少有高级领导人具备竞争最高权力所需的广泛人脉。然而，具有技术背景的干部升任高级职务并不意味着精英竞争的终结。由于派系政治，高层领导仍然通过有意将潜在接班人轮岗到各类地方和中央职位来培养接班人。这些初露锋芒的通才最终在政权内获得广泛的人脉，并开始相互不信任。
Nonetheless, the dearth of extensive revolutionary experience among younger leaders makes it easier to distinguish between generalists, who actively cultivate ties with various constituencies in the regime, and specialists who continue to manage affairs in their original xitong. The relatively clear identities of generalists and specialists stabilized politics in the 1990s because the incumbent could form winning coalitions with technocrats and other specialists to defeat any actual or potential threats from other generalists. Jiang Zemin formed such coalitions with Zhu Rongji and other specialists to defeat potential threats from Yang Baibing, Chen Xitong, Qiao Shi, and Li Ruihuan. In a way, Jiang’s effort to defeat so many generalists paved the way for Hu’s rise because Hu only had to contend with generalists who were cultivated by Jiang himself rather than a wide array of other generalists.
尽管如此，年轻领导人普遍缺乏广泛的革命经历，这使得区分“通才”（积极与政权内各类选区建立联系）和继续在原有系统中处理事务的“专才”变得更容易。通才和专才相对清晰的身份在 1990 年代稳定了政治局势，因为在任者可以与技术官僚及其他专才结成胜利联盟，以击败来自其他通才的实际或潜在威胁。江泽民便与朱镕基及其他专才结成了这样的联盟，以击败来自杨白冰、陈希同、乔石和李瑞环的潜在威胁。在某种程度上，江泽民打击如此多的通才为胡锦涛的崛起铺平了道路，因为胡只需与由江本人培养的通才们竞争，而不用面对来自更多其他通才的广泛挑战。
The stability of this dynamic may be threatened in the future by the rise of the princelings in Chinese politics. The children of revolutionary veterans and senior officials, often labeled princelings, have some of the characteristics of their parents. That is, they are endowed with a wide network of close
这种动态的稳定性未来可能会受到中国政治中“太子党”崛起的威胁。革命元老和高级官员的子女，通常被称为太子党，具有其父辈的一些特征。也就是说，他们拥有广泛的亲密关系网，...
connections across the government, army, and the emerging corporate sector because children of senior officials often attended the same elite elementary or high schools around Beijing (He and Gao 2000). Although they do not constitute a single interest bloc, they have access to elite social networks not available to ordinary officials. Thus, even if princeling officials spend their entire careers in particular bureaucracies, such as banking, they can draw on additional political resources through their princeling connections, thus making them more ambiguous specialists. That is, princeling officials are less able to credibly signal their specialist roles because they have access to the princeling social networks. As the upper echelon of the party becomes increasingly filled with princeling officials, the incumbent leader faces a rising number of officials who, although cultivated as technocrats, have strong personal connections with a wide range of officials across the regime. Faced with increasing ambiguity about the potential threat posed by members of the winning coalition, the incumbent leader may shift more resources toward the provision of private goods in order to maintain the loyalty of those in the winning coalition. Furthermore, if the lead technocrat is seen as an ambiguous specialist due to his or her princeling connections, the leader of the dominant generalist faction may hesitate to delegate economic control to the lead technocrat in a time of crisis. More so than any other scenarios, the findings presented in this work suggest that deep distrust between the dominant generalist and the lead technocrat, leading to delayed delegation of economic control to the lead technocrat in a time of crisis, may well bring about the unraveling of the Chinese economic miracle.
他们在政府、军队和新兴企业部门之间有着广泛的联系，因为高级官员的子女常常在北京周边上的同样的精英小学或中学（He and Gao 2000）。尽管他们并不构成单一的利益集团，但他们可以进入普通官员无法触及的精英社交网络。因此，即便太子党官员将整个职业生涯都投入到特定的官僚机构中，比如银行业，他们仍然可以通过与其他太子党关系获取额外的政治资源，这使得他们成为更为模糊的专家。也就是说，太子党官员更难以可信地传达其专业人员角色，因为他们可以动用太子党社交网络。随着党内高层越来越多地被太子党官员占据，现任领导人面临的官员数量也在上升——这些官员虽被培养为技术官僚，但与政权内各类官员都有着广泛的私人关系。 面对关于胜利联盟成员可能构成的威胁愈发模糊不清的情况，现任领导人可能会将更多资源转向提供私人物品，以维持胜利联盟中成员的忠诚。此外，如果首席技术官因其太子党背景被视为一个模糊的专业人士，主导的通才派领导人在危机时期可能会对将经济控制权下放给该首席技术官犹豫不决。与其他任何情形相比，本书所呈现的研究结果表明，主导的通才与首席技术官之间的深度不信任，导致在危机时期延迟将经济控制权下放给首席技术官，极有可能导致中国经济奇迹的解体。

Appendix on Data  数据附录

The quantitative data used throughout this study are broken into three main databases: Annual Database, Quarterly Database, and Time Series-Cross Section Database. Because no one has attempted to construct three separate financial data sets on China, I had to draw from numerous primary sources from the Chinese government to construct these data sets. This discussion details the structure and the sources of each of the databases in turn.
本研究中使用的定量数据分为三大数据库：年度数据库、季度数据库和时序-横截面数据库。由于此前无人尝试构建三套独立的中国金融数据集，我不得不从众多中国政府的原始资料中抽取信息以构建这些数据集。下面依次详细说明每个数据库的结构和来源。
Annual Database contains national level economic data from 1978 to 2006 and is a time-series data set. The data set includes data on lending, bank deposits, inflation, industrial output, fixed-asset investment, and interest rates. The main sources of this data set are:
年度数据库包含 1978 年至 2006 年的全国层面经济数据，是一个时间序列数据集。该数据集包括有关放贷、银行存款、通货膨胀、工业产出、固定资产投资和利率的数据。该数据集的主要来源有：
National Bureau of Statistics. 1999. Xin Zhongguo Wushinian Tongji Ziliao Huibian (A Collection of Statistical Material for the Fifty Years of New China). Beijing: China Statistics Press.
National Bureau of Statistics. 2000. China Monthly Economic Indicators 2000: I (January). Beijing: China Statistical Press.
National Bureau of Statistics. 2001. China Monthly Economic Indicators 2001: 3 (March). Beijing: China Statistical Press.
国家统计局。2001 年。《China Monthly Economic Indicators 2001：3（月度，3 月）》。北京：中国统计出版社。
National Bureau of Statistics. 2003. China Monthly Economic Indicators 2003: 2 (February). Beijing: China Statistical Press.

China Data Online。2006 年。《China Yearly Macro-economy Statistics》。China Data Center，University of Michigan。http://www.chinadataonline.org。
More specific data on banks come from:
关于银行的更具体数据来自：

Statistical Division of the PBOC. 2000. Zhongguo Jinrong Tongji: 1997-1999 (Financial Statistics of China: 1997-1999). Beijing: China Financial Publisher.
Quarterly Database contains quarterly national level economic data from the first quarter of 1978 to the fourth quarter of 2006. However, because the
Chinese statistical apparatus was just recovering from the Cultural Revolution in the late 1970s, most variables are not available until the first quarter of 1980. This data set contains data on state bank lending and deposits, inflation (CPI), fixed asset investment, industrial output, agricultural output, and official interest rates. In the 1990s, quarterly data on overall money supply and total lending and deposits are also available.
The banking data available in this data set come from official sources, but valuable data on interest rates and specific categories of lending also come from Li (1994):
本数据集中可获得的银行数据来自官方来源，但有关利率和特定贷款类别的有价值数据也来自 Li (1994)：
People’s Bank of China. 1997. Zhongguo Jinrong Tonji: 1952-1996 (China Financial Statistics: 1952-1996). Beijing: China Financial Publisher.
Statistical Division of the PBOC. 2000. Zhongguo Jinrong Tongji: 1997-1999 (Financial Statistics of China: 1997-1999). Beijing: China Financial Publisher.
Li, Kui-wai. 1994. Financial Repression and Economic Reform in China. Westport, CT: Praeger.

Finally, Time Series-Cross Section Database comprises provincial level annual economic and political data from 1978 to 2006. It covers all of China’s provinces, directly administered cities, and autonomous regions, including the newly added Hainan Province and Chongqing City. The political variables in this data record the observed factional ties between a Party secretary or a governor of a province and a serving Standing Committee member (see details in Chapter 5). This requires the careful matching up of provincial officials’ and Standing Committee members’ biographical data throughout the entire period. Sources used to construct these factional variables include the following:

    1 1 ^(1){ }^{1} 参见例如 Naughton, Barry, 1996。《Growing Out of the Plan: Chinese Economic Reform 1978-1993》。New York: Cambridge University Press；Shirk, Susan，1993。《The Political Logic of Economic Reform in China》。Berkeley: University of California Press；Qian, Yingyi, Barry Weingast, 和 Gabriella Montinola，1995。《Federalism, Chinese style: the political basis for economic success in China》。World Politics 48 (1):50-81；Oi, Jean Chun，1999。《Rural China Takes Off: Institutional Foundations of Economic Reform》。Berkeley: University of California Press。
    2 2 ^(2){ }^{2} Nonperforming loan ratio is the ratio of total loans that are lapsing in timely interest payment or payment of principal. According to U.S. financial accounting, loans are classified into five categories depending on the financial health and future business prospects of the borrower: normal, special mention, substandard, doubtful, and loss. The last three categories of loans are considered nonperforming. Loans in China have long been divided into four categories: normal (zhengchang), overdue (yuqi), congested (daizhi), and bad (daizhang), which mostly are based on the time period for which loans and interest payments are overdue. In the Chinese system, the last three categories are considered nonperforming.
    不良贷款率是指在利息或本金支付上逾期的贷款总额占总贷款的比率。根据美国的财务会计，贷款根据借款人的财务状况和未来经营前景分为五类：正常、关注、次级、可疑和损失。最后三类贷款被视为不良贷款。中国的贷款长期以来被划分为四类：正常（zhengchang）、逾期（yuqi）、滞留（daizhi）和呆账（daizhang），这些分类主要基于贷款及利息逾期的时长。在中国体系中，后三类被视为不良。
  2. 3 3 ^(3){ }^{3} This brings to mind the senior banking officials I interviewed in China, who were much more interested in trading stocks than in their work.
    这让我想起我在中国采访过的一些高级银行官员，他们对交易股票比对工作更感兴趣。
  3. 4 4 ^(4){ }^{4} The notion that better ideas and institutions can resolve China’s problems underlies many of the policy recommendations made by the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund (IMF). See, for example, Prasad, Eswar. 2004. China’s Growth and Integration into the World Economy: Prospects and Challenges. In IMF Occasional Paper. Washington, DC: IMF.
    4 4 ^(4){ }^{4} 认为更好的观念和制度能够解决中国问题的想法，是世界银行和国际货币基金组织（IMF）许多政策建议的理论基础。参见例如 Prasad, Eswar. 2004. China’s Growth and Integration into the World Economy: Prospects and Challenges. 收录于 IMF Occasional Paper. Washington, DC: IMF.
  4. 5 5 ^(5){ }^{5} This is the top-secret (jimi) version of the Sanzhong Quanhui Yilai, which contains more than twice as many speeches and decrees as the internal (neibu) version.
    5 5 ^(5){ }^{5} 这是《三重全会以来》的绝密（jimi）版本，包含的讲话和法令数量是内部（neibu）版本的两倍多。

Ferri. 1998. Foundations of Financial Markets and Institutions. 2nd ed. New York: Prentice-Hall International Inc.
    1 1 ^(1){ }^{1} 贷款的期望收益是不同可能收益乘以各自概率之和。参见 Fabozzi, Frank J., Franco Modigliani, and Michael G. Ferri. 1998. Foundations of Financial Markets and Institutions. 2nd ed. New York: Prentice-Hall International Inc.
  6. 2 2 ^(2){ }^{2} In banks where loans constitute the majority of assets, which is most often the case for banks in developing countries, asset quality refers to the risk profile of loans. Different countries classify loans differently. See footnote 2 in Chapter 1 for details on loan classification in the U.S. and in China.
    2 2 ^(2){ }^{2} 在贷款构成资产大头的银行——这在发展中国家的银行中最为常见——资产质量指的是贷款的风险特征。不同国家对贷款的分类各不相同。有关美国和中国贷款分类的详细信息，见第 1 章脚注 2。
    3 3 ^(3){ }^{3} Although major banking crises are usually related to the deterioration in asset quality, a banking crisis can be triggered by a number of exogenous factors, including the devaluation of a central commodity in the economy, financial liberalization, and changes in government policy. See Allen, Franklin, and Douglas Gale. 2001. Comparing Financial Systems. Cambridge, MA: MIT Press.

    8 8 ^(8){ }^{8} The concept here is similar to but distinct from Hirschman’s concept of loyalty. In Hirschman’s work, loyalty is purely an irrational phenomenon whereby the consumer remains with a product despite the presence of an obviously better choice. Loyalty, or factional stickiness, here is a product of uncertainty about the outcome of a struggle and the opportunity cost of defecting. See Hirschman, Albert O. 1970. Exit, Voice, and Loyalty: Responses to Decline in Firms, Organizations, and States. Cambridge, MA: Harvard University Press.
    这里的概念与 Hirschman 的忠诚概念相似但有所不同。在 Hirschman 的研究中，忠诚是纯粹的非理性现象，消费者尽管存在明显更好的选择仍坚持使用某一产品。这里的忠诚，或派系粘性，则是对斗争结果不确定性以及脱离所带来机会成本的产物。参见 Hirschman, Albert O. 1970. Exit, Voice, and Loyalty: Responses to Decline in Firms, Organizations, and States. Cambridge, MA: Harvard University Press.

Macroeconomics. 2nd ed. New York: Worth Publishers.
    根据 Mankiw，货币余额需求 M/P 是实物产出、利率和通胀预期的函数。随着实物产出的增加，货币需求随之上升以满足经济中日益增加的交易。在中国的情形下，实际余额需求的增加很可能体现在国有企业和私营企业对流动资金贷款的需求上，以跟上产出增长。参见 Mankiw, N. Gregory. 1994. Macroeconomics. 2nd ed. New York: Worth Publishers.

In Western accounting, these loans would be considered lost loans to be written off by bank capital. This suggests that nonperforming loan, a broader concept than lost loans, was considerably higher at that time.
    7 这里的“坏账”指完全无法收回的贷款。根据刘鸿儒的说法，“挂账”从 700 亿元增加到 1040 亿元。挂账是指国家认定为无法收回、允许停止计息的贷款。在西方会计中，这些贷款会被视为应由银行资本核销的损失贷款。这表明，不良贷款（比损失贷款范围更广）在当时要高得多。

  71. 12 12 ^(12){ }^{12} The final official name of the Sixteen Measures was “Opinions on the current economic situation and the strengthening of macroeconomic adjustment.” According to Chen Jinhua (2005: 273), the head of the SPC at the time, there were three options on the title of the Sixteen Measures: decision (jueding), opinion (yijian), and notice (tongzhi). Zhu almost certainly supported “decision,” as he would have wanted his policies to have the greatest effectiveness. Deng followers, including Qiao Shi and Li Ruihuan, most likely supported the mildest option of entitling it a “notice.” Jiang either sided with Qiao and Li or opted for the compromise “opinion.”
    12 12 ^(12){ }^{12} 十六条措施的最终官方名称是“关于当前经济形势和加强宏观调控的若干意见”。据时任国务院办公厅主任陈锦华（2005：273）称，关于十六条措施的标题有三种选择：决定（jueding）、意见（yijian）和通知（tongzhi）。朱镕基几乎肯定支持“决定”，因为他会希望自己的政策具有最大的效力。邓的追随者，包括乔石和李瑞环，很可能支持最温和的“通知”称谓。江泽民要么与乔石、李瑞环站在一起，要么选择妥协性的“意见”。
